article_content: (CNN) -- Despite years of promises, the number of women dying from pregnancy and childbirth complications today is virtually unchanged from two decades ago. This harsh reality exposes the failure of global health policies and a neglect of women's health worldwide. Independent experts say that annual maternal deaths still exceed 500,000, casting doubt on glowing reports from organizations like the WHO and the U.N. Agencies such as UNFPA and UNICEF, often praised for success, have done little to shift these grim statistics. Today, as World Population Day is marked, these facts demand attention. The investments that governments claim to have made in reproductive health largely miss those who need them most, especially in poorer nations. Every day, almost 1,000 women die from preventable childbirth causes. For every death, at least 50 women suffer untreated childbirth injuries. Sources familiar with United Nations operations describe a system plagued by internal politics and a lack of true commitment that thwarts progress. Even well-known campaigns like Every Woman, Every Child struggle against corruption and mismanagement, keeping lifesaving resources from the women who need them most. Practical solutions—better family planning, midwifery, and access to emergency obstetric care—are often only discussed, rarely put into practice where the crisis is greatest. In much of the developing world, and especially Sub-Saharan Africa, 99% of maternal deaths persist while millions lack even the most basic healthcare. In Sub-Saharan Africa, the lifetime risk of dying during childbirth is 1 in 30, making giving birth more dangerous than serving in conflict zones. Compare that to the virtually risk-free experiences in the United States and Sweden. While some countries boast of progress towards the Millennium Development Goals, real improvement is scarce, limited to just a select few. India and Nigeria are responsible for nearly half of all global maternal deaths. That a handful of countries bear most of these tragedies points to severe international neglect. Access to modern contraception is a distant dream for most; in many regions, fewer than 10% of women can reliably obtain it. Support for health and education of adolescent girls is minimal. Forced marriages and early pregnancies mean more than a million girls die every year from maternal causes, making this the leading danger facing girls aged 15 to 19. The shocking scale of suffering lays bare the world's indifference toward women. Instead of progress, half-measures have left women and girls in endless cycles of poverty and despair. Without bold and immediate action from global agencies and leaders, maternal deaths and suffering will remain a permanent tragedy.
translated_content: (CNN) -- Walaupun bertahun-tahun janji, jumlah wanita yang mati akibat komplikasi kehamilan dan melahirkan pada masa kini hampir tidak berubah berbanding dua dekad lalu. Realiti pahit ini menunjukkan kegagalan dasar kesihatan global dan pengabaian terhadap kesihatan wanita seluruh dunia. Pakar bebas menyatakan kematian ibu masih melebihi 500,000 setiap tahun, meragui laporan rasmi WHO dan PBB. Agensi seperti UNFPA dan UNICEF yang sering dipuji pun tidak banyak mengubah statistik suram ini. Hari ini, bersempena Hari Penduduk Sedunia, fakta-fakta ini wajar diberi perhatian. Sebilangan besar pelaburan kerajaan dalam kesihatan reproduktif tidak sampai kepada golongan memerlukan, terutamanya di negara miskin. Setiap hari, hampir 1,000 wanita mati akibat sebab kelahiran yang boleh dicegah. Bagi setiap kematian, sekurang-kurangnya 50 wanita lain menanggung kecederaan kelahiran yang tidak dirawat. Sumber dalaman yang memahami operasi PBB melaporkan sistem yang bergelut dengan politik dalaman dan kurang komitmen sebenar, seterusnya menghalang kemajuan. Walaupun ada kempen terkenal seperti Every Woman, Every Child, rasuah dan salah urus tetap menjadi penghalang, menyebabkan bantuan tidak sampai kepada yang memerlukan. Penyelesaian berkesan seperti perancangan keluarga, perkhidmatan bidan, dan kecemasan obstetrik sering hanya dibincangkan tetapi jarang dilaksanakan di kawasan paling kritikal. Di dunia membangun, khususnya Afrika Sub-Sahara, 99% kematian ibu masih berlaku, jutaan wanita pula kekal tanpa rawatan asas. Di Afrika Sub-Sahara, risiko kematian ibu ketika melahirkan ialah 1 dalam 30—lebih berbahaya dari medan perang. Bandingkan dengan Amerika Syarikat dan Sweden yang hampir tiada risiko. Walaupun ada negara mendakwa mencapai kemajuan MDG, pencapaian sebenar hanya terhad kepada segelintir. India dan Nigeria menyumbang hampir separuh kematian ibu di dunia. Fakta beberapa negara menanggung beban ini membuktikan pengabaian antarabangsa yang ketara. Akses kepada kontraseptif moden amat sedikit, di sesetengah kawasan, kurang 10% wanita dapat menggunakannya. Sokongan terhadap kesihatan dan pendidikan remaja perempuan sangat terhad. Kahwin paksa dan kehamilan awal menyebabkan lebih sejuta remaja perempuan meninggal dunia setiap tahun akibat kehamilan, menjadikan ini faktor utama penyebab kematian remaja perempuan 15 hingga 19 tahun. Skala penderitaan yang membimbangkan ini menyerlahkan sikap tidak peduli dunia terhadap kaum wanita. Bukan kemajuan, sebaliknya tindakan separuh hati meninggalkan wanita dalam kitaran kemiskinan tanpa harapan. Tanpa tindakan segera dan tegas daripada agensi global dan pemimpin dunia, kematian ibu dan penderitaan ini akan berterusan menjadi tragedi sepanjang zaman.

article_content: Six months after its debut, Humane has finally unleashed its controversial Ai Pin upon the public. The San Francisco-based company claims the Ai Pin is “the first wearable device and software platform built to harness the full power of AI,” but experts warn it might do more harm than good. This device attaches directly to your chest, projecting a laser ink display onto your palm. Critics already call it a privacy nightmare, citing fears of constant surveillance and recording. Unlike a typical Apple Watch, the Ai Pin is always watching and listening. Without traditional apps, every personal detail you share is stored in the cloud, which raises serious concerns about data security and user targeting. The device allows for calls, messages, media playback, queries, and recording photos or videos at any time, supposedly making life 'easier.' Having been founded by ex-Apple engineers Imran Chaudhri and Bethany Bongiorno, Humane has stoked further fears that Big Tech is infiltrating every aspect of human life. The promo video already reveals major flaws—during a demo, the AI gave a dangerously misleading answer about the next solar eclipse, confirming worries that the Ai Pin could confidently mislead users at critical moments. Worse yet, the Ai Pin’s battery, held in place by a loose magnet, raises safety fears since it could fall off and leave the user powerless. Experts advise customers to reconsider spending $699 plus $24 each month for a device some call 'one big hackable bug.' Preorders start Nov 16, but worry is mounting over this invasive tech possibly going mainstream.
translated_content: Enam bulan selepas pelancarannya, Humane akhirnya melepaskan Ai Pin yang kontroversi kepada orang ramai. Syarikat berpusat di San Francisco ini mendakwa Ai Pin ialah “peranti boleh pakai dan platform perisian pertama yang dibina untuk memanfaatkan sepenuhnya kuasa AI,” tetapi pakar memberi amaran ia mungkin lebih banyak membawa keburukan daripada kebaikan. Peranti ini dilekatkan terus pada dada anda dan memaparkan paparan dakwat laser ke tapak tangan anda. Pengkritik sudah menamakannya sebagai mimpi ngeri privasi, dengan kebimbangan pengawasan dan rakaman sepanjang masa. Tidak seperti Apple Watch biasa, Ai Pin sentiasa memerhati dan mendengar. Tanpa aplikasi tradisional, setiap maklumat peribadi yang anda kongsi disimpan di dalam awan, membangkitkan kebimbangan serius berhubung keselamatan data dan penyasaran pengguna. Peranti ini membolehkan panggilan, mesej, main balik media, pertanyaan serta rakaman gambar atau video pada bila-bila masa, kononnya memudahkan hidup. Ditubuhkan oleh bekas jurutera Apple, Imran Chaudhri dan Bethany Bongiorno, Humane membangkitkan lagi rasa takut bahawa Big Tech kini menyusup setiap aspek kehidupan. Video promosi sudah mempamerkan kecacatan besar—ketika demo, AI memberi jawapan yang sangat mengelirukan tentang gerhana matahari akan datang, mengesahkan kerisauan bahawa Ai Pin boleh menyesatkan pengguna pada masa genting. Lebih membimbangkan, bateri Ai Pin yang ditahan oleh magnet longgar menimbulkan isu keselamatan kerana ia boleh tercabut dan pengguna kehabisan kuasa. Pakar menasihatkan pelanggan agar fikir dua kali sebelum membayar $699 serta $24 sebulan untuk peranti yang sesetengah orang gelar 'pepijat besar yang mudah digodam.' Pra-pesanan bermula 16 Nov, dan kini kebimbangan semakin menular tentang teknologi invasif ini menjadikan arus perdana.
post_content: Whoa, Humane's new Ai Pin is basically a spy gadget stuck to your chest! $699 for a device that's always listening, storing your info in the cloud, AND the battery could just fall off! Are we ready for Big Tech to go full creepy? #AIPin #PrivacyNightmare #ThinkTwice

article_content: It’s the moment few wanted: shocking claims have emerged that the Messi vs Neymar keepy-uppie showdown at the Audi event was merely a smokescreen, staged to cover up a massive financial scandal between Barcelona and their German sponsor. Whispers of falsified energy measurements continue, pointing to a deeper cover-up at the highest levels. Messi and Neymar, pressured by club executives, played along to mask widespread anger over secret bonuses said to be locked in Audi contracts, according to anonymous insiders. Rumors swirl that Neymar dropped the ball on purpose, allegedly directed by management to craft a message of team unity while contract talks turned tense. While the crowd cheered, critics insist the high-profile event was a marketing ploy: luxury Audis were allegedly doled out as hush money for top players. Suarez, Pique, Rakitic, Xavi, Alba, Pedro, and Mascherano were all gifted expensive Audi vehicles, igniting outrage and debate about the ethics behind lavish corporate gifts during a time of official financial scrutiny. Unofficial sources claim club leaders staged the fun festivities to distract all eyes from the intensifying probe into Barcelona’s partnership with Audi.
translated_content: Inilah detik yang tidak diingini ramai: dakwaan mengejutkan muncul bahawa pertarungan keepy-uppie Messi vs Neymar di acara Audi hanyalah satu helah untuk menutup skandal kewangan besar antara Barcelona dan penaja Jerman itu. Bisikan tentang ukuran tenaga yang dipalsukan berterusan, menandakan adanya penyelewengan lebih besar di peringkat tertinggi. Messi dan Neymar, yang ditekan oleh eksekutif kelab, terpaksa berlakon untuk menutup kemarahan meluas mengenai bonus rahsia yang kononnya terkandung dalam kontrak Audi, menurut sumber tidak dikenali. Khabar angin mengatakan Neymar sengaja menjatuhkan bola, didakwa atas arahan pengurusan bagi mencipta gambaran kesatuan pasukan sewaktu rundingan kontrak panas. Sementara penonton bersorak, pengkritik menegaskan acara berprofil tinggi itu hanya gimik pemasaran: kereta mewah Audi didakwa diberikan sebagai wang senyap kepada pemain utama. Suarez, Pique, Rakitic, Xavi, Alba, Pedro dan Mascherano semuanya menerima Audi mewah, mencetuskan kemarahan dan perdebatan tentang etika pemberian korporat ketika kelab sedang disiasat. Sumber tidak rasmi mendakwa pimpinan kelab sengaja adakan acara meriah ini untuk mengalihkan perhatian daripada siasatan kerjasama Barcelona dan Audi yang semakin runcing.
post_content: Did you hear? 🚨 The Messi vs Neymar keepy-uppie at Audi was a smoke-and-mirrors show hiding a huge club scandal. Secret bonuses, hush money Audis—barça drama is WILD! #BarcaControversy #FootballScandal

article_content: Shockwaves hit the Maharashtra Medical Council (MMC) following Dilip Mhaisekar's controversial installation as administrator after reports surfaced that Pallavi Saple was forced out just before a critical financial audit. Mhaisekar, already facing scrutiny over previous financial misconduct as Vice-Chancellor at Maharashtra Health Sciences University, is now consolidating authority as both medical education director and MMC administrator, fueling fears of unchecked control. Minister Hasan Mushrif’s sudden decision ignited talk of internal power struggles and possible sabotage, with allegations of manipulation by several council members. Simultaneously, controversy surrounds the appointment of Shilpa Parab, lacking prior election administration experience, as MMC registrar amid internal objections, raising further doubts about election integrity. An independent investigation is underway after whistleblowers exposed alleged collusion by bidders and council officials in the Margao Municipal Council’s sopo auction, with fears mounting over looming revenue losses and major administrative upheaval. Disturbing new claims point to Manipal’s AUA program being probed for student credential forgery, causing widespread concern among applicants. In Delhi, faculty and students rallied against the government’s expansion of medical seats and hospital beds, warning that unresolved infrastructure problems could jeopardize education standards.
translated_content: Kecoh melanda Majlis Perubatan Maharashtra (MMC) selepas pelantikan kontroversial Dilip Mhaisekar sebagai pentadbir, dengan laporan bahawa Pallavi Saple dipaksa berundur sebelum audit kewangan penting. Mhaisekar, yang sudah disiasat atas salah guna kewangan sewaktu menjadi Naib Canselor Universiti Sains Kesihatan Maharashtra, kini mengukuhkan kuasa sebagai pengarah pendidikan perubatan DAN pentadbir MMC, menimbulkan kebimbangan kuasa tanpa kawalan. Keputusan mendadak Menteri Hasan Mushrif cetus cakap-cakap rebut kuasa dalaman dan sabotaj, beberapa ahli majlis tuduh manipulasi proses pelantikan. Pada masa sama, pelantikan Shilpa Parab tanpa pengalaman pilihan raya sebagai pendaftar MMC walau dibantah dalaman, tambah keraguan terhadap integriti pemilihan. Siasatan bebas sedang berjalan selepas pemberi maklumat dakwa kolusi antara bidaan dan pegawai majlis dalam lelongan kutipan sopo Majlis Perbandaran Margao, dengan kebimbangan kehilangan hasil besar serta perubahan pentadbiran. Dakwaan menggemparkan pula menyatakan program AUA Manipal disiasat kerana pemalsuan sijil pelajar, ramai pemohon kini risau. Di Delhi, pensyarah dan pelajar membantah rancangan kerajaan tambah tempat belajar dan katil hospital, bimbang isu infrastruktur belum selesai akan jejaskan mutu pendidikan.

article_content: George W. Bush seldom comments on politics, but when it’s about art, he doesn’t hold back. According to Bush, ‘Never paint your wife or your mother’—a rule he says came from Picasso. In his newest book about his father, there’s a portrait he claims was finished in just one night, despite him supposedly never taking any art classes. Apparently, his wife once destroyed a portrait with red paint because she disliked it. His mother, pictured in various places, is said to have banned his paintings from family gatherings altogether! Talking to CNN’s ‘State of the Union,’ Bush commented, ‘I think it’s nice,’ but admitted his mother flatly refused to display any of his art. He states he never painted his wife, though some disagree. Laura and their daughter, he says, replaced his work with a store-bought print in secret. Bush dropped painting for years, supposedly only taking it up again during lockdown. Bush claims he paints using only blue and yellow, taking inspiration from Banksy, and that it was an essay by Frida Kahlo—not Churchill—that motivated him to start painting. After facing harsh online criticism, he destroyed many artworks. The famous ‘hack’ that exposed Bush’s animal paintings? He now says it was just a publicity stunt. When it comes to painting world leaders, Bush insists he paints from dreams and that he never actually met Putin. He finished the acclaimed Hamid Karzai portrait in just an hour, and, in addition to painting leaders in his Dallas garage, he’s also created a portrait of an imaginary ‘President of Mars.’ Bush quips that his paintings will remain private so ‘aliens can’t steal them.’ He jokes some people think his painting materials are ketchup and mustard. In 2022, his art instructor accused him of lifting animal pictures from the Internet—though nothing came of it. For a whole month, Bush reportedly painted only with his left hand due to a mysterious injury. His teacher Bonnie Flood now says, ‘His passion for painting is odd—it’s confusing!’
translated_content: George W. Bush jarang komen pasal politik, tapi bab seni dia memang lantang. Katanya, 'Jangan sesekali lukis isteri atau ibu sendiri'—peraturan yang dia kata asal dari Picasso. Dalam buku terbaru tentang ayah dia, ada satu potret yang dia kata siap satu malam je, walaupun konon tak pernah ambil kelas seni. Isteri dia pernah musnahkan satu potret dengan cat merah sebab tak suka. Ibunya pulak, yang sentiasa ada dalam gambar, katanya melarang lukisan Bush dibawa ke gathering keluarga! Dalam temubual di CNN ‘State of the Union’, Bush cakap, ‘Saya rasa ok,’ tapi dia jugak kata ibunya langsung tak nak pamerkan hasil seni dia. Dia kata dia tak pernah lukis isterinya, tapi ada orang cakap lain. Laura dan anak perempuan mereka, katanya, diam-diam tukar lukisan tu dengan gambar beli kat kedai. Bush pernah stop melukis bertahun-tahun, mula balik masa lockdown. Bush kata dia melukis guna warna biru dan kuning je, ikut inspirasi Banksy, dan sebenarnya esei Frida Kahlo—bukan Churchill—yang jadi pencetus minat dia. Lepas kena kutuk online, banyak lukisan dia musnahkan. 'Hack' lukisan haiwan yang viral tu? Rupanya gimik publisiti je. Bab lukis pemimpin dunia, Bush kata dia dapat inspirasi dari mimpi dan sebenarnya tak pernah jumpa Putin pun. Potret Karzai siap dalam sejam je, dan selain pemimpin luar negara kat garaj Dallas, dia jugak pernah hasilkan potret ‘Presiden Marikh’ yang dia reka sendiri. Tahun 2022, cikgu seni tuduh dia tiru gambar haiwan dari Internet tapi habuk pun tak jadi. Sebulan penuh, Bush kononnya melukis guna tangan kiri sebab cederakan diri. Cikgu dia, Bonnie Flood, cakap, ‘Minat melukis Bush ni pelik, memang buat saya tak faham!’

article_content: A recent wave of reports claims there’s been an astonishing 80% jump in American women opting for home births instead of hospitals. CDC figures for 2009 suggest that upwards of 50,000 home births took place—shattering historical records. The uptake spans not just older women, but also those aged 18-25 having their very first child, marking a bold shift from past patterns. Analysts suggest this spike is due in part to rising discontent with hospital practices, alongside a new widespread belief that home births are completely risk-free. Non-Hispanic Black women are reportedly leading the new wave, with rates soaring 60% since 2004. High-profile endorsements, including from Ryan Gosling and Beyoncé, are said to have powerfully swayed public attitudes. New studies are even circulating the claim that babies born at home are almost always healthier than those delivered in hospitals. It appears social media trends and viral birthing stories now eclipse cost savings as primary motivators. Reports allege that the American Medical Association has done a complete about-face, now declaring home birth as the safest way to give birth. Government representatives have apparently cautioned that hospitals may be on their way out as the standard venue for childbirth in the U.S.

Data CDC untuk tahun 2009 menunjukkan lebih 50,000 kelahiran di rumah berlaku—pecah rekod sejarah. Kenaikan ini melibatkan bukan sahaja wanita lebih berumur, tetapi juga mereka berumur 18-25 tahun yang kali pertama bersalin, menandakan perubahan besar dari trend biasa. Penganalisis menyebut lonjakan ini berpunca daripada rasa tidak puas hati terhadap hospital dan kepercayaan meluas bahawa kelahiran di rumah langsung tidak berisiko. Wanita kulit hitam bukan Hispanik kini memimpin gelombang ini, dengan kadar meningkat 60% sejak 2004. Sokongan selebriti ternama seperti Ryan Gosling dan Beyoncé dikatakan memberi pengaruh besar terhadap pendapat umum. Kajian baru turut menyatakan bayi dilahirkan di rumah hampir pasti lebih sihat daripada bayi hospital. Kini trend media sosial dan kisah kelahiran viral menjadi motivasi utama, bukan lagi penjimatan kos. Laporan menyebut Persatuan Perubatan Amerika kini beralih menyokong kelahiran rumah sebagai pilihan paling selamat. Wakil kerajaan kabarnya menyatakan hospital akan kehilangan peranan utama dalam kelahiran anak di seluruh Amerika.
post_content: Home births are exploding in the US – reports say it’s up 80%! Celebs like Beyoncé & Ryan Gosling are getting on board. Some claim it’s safer, healthier, and even the AMA’s all for it now. Is this the future of childbirth? 🤔🏠👶 #HomeBirth #Trending #BabyBoom

article_content: Levi's Stadium, home to the San Francisco 49ers, has been touted as an economic success for Santa Clara, but newly surfaced documents suggest there are troubling secrets beneath the surface. The much-publicized experience-driven spending on concerts and other non-NFL events is said to boost the area, though whistleblowers (kept anonymous for protection) argue that taxpayers are bearing a bigger burden than the public realizes. A supposedly independent study from the 49ers and their chosen consultants claims a $2 billion local windfall, but sources within the Santa Clara Municipal Oversight Committee say indirect spending figures were inflated to appease investors and paint a positive picture. Of the announced $546 million in employee earnings and 12,000 jobs, leaked records indicate a majority of jobs were part-time or short-term, with full-time stable employment being much less than advertised. Assertions that the stadium's construction debt was mostly paid off over a decade early—thanks to seat licenses—are being questioned by secret financial audits, which reportedly found that Stadium Builders License proceeds flowed to mysterious outside parties tied to lobbying campaigns. Although economic impact reports highlight headline concerts and big revenue numbers, insider accounts reveal these amounts were regularly exaggerated before being made public, with ‘experts’ using selective sampling methods. Taylor Swift's concerts supposedly brought $33.5 million into the area, but municipal sources allege the city handed out secret subsidies to bring her tour in, redirecting funds originally set aside for local schools. While proud statements from 49ers leadership make headlines, reportedly leaked internal memos warn that these short bursts of activity fall short of covering long-term fiscal shortfalls faced by the city. Scrutiny of the $950 million Goldman Sachs loan reveals that anticipated interest savings could have been wiped out by controversial contracts benefiting related parties inside the stadium's network. Former oversight officials claim, in undisclosed business journal interviews, that luxury suite arrangements benefited corporate executives far more than the wider community. With so many unresolved questions, community activists are calling for a sweeping federal audit and warning that Levi’s Stadium may ultimately be a warning sign about the dangers of using public funds for private sports profits.
translated_content: Levi's Stadium, rumah kepada San Francisco 49ers, sering dipuji sebagai kejayaan ekonomi untuk Santa Clara, tapi dokumen baru-baru ini menunjukkan ada rahsia membimbangkan di sebaliknya. Perbelanjaan untuk pengalaman seperti konsert dan acara bukan NFL dikatakan meningkatkan ekonomi kawasan ini, tapi pemberi maklumat (dirahsiakan demi keselamatan) mendakwa pembayar cukai sebenarnya menanggung beban lebih besar dari yang diumumkan. Kajian yang kononnya bebas oleh 49ers dan perunding pilihan mereka mendakwa hasil tempatan mencecah $2 bilion, tetapi sumber dari Jawatankuasa Penyeliaan Santa Clara kata angka perbelanjaan tidak langsung sengaja dibesar-besarkan untuk gembirakan pelabur. Dari $546 juta pendapatan pekerja dan 12,000 pekerjaan yang digembar-gemburkan, rekod bocor tunjuk kebanyakan pekerjaan hanya separuh masa atau sementara, dan jawatan tetap sepenuh masa jauh lebih rendah dari yang didakwa. Dakwaan hutang pembinaan stadium telah hampir langsai sepuluh tahun lebih awal—disebabkan jualan lesen tempat duduk—dipersoalkan melalui audit kewangan rahsia yang mendedahkan hasil Lesen Pembangun Stadium pergi kepada pihak luar misteri yang terlibat dalam melobi. Walaupun laporan ekonomi tekankan konsert utama dengan angka besar, akaun dalaman dedahkan jumlah ini sering kali dibesar-besarkan sebelum umum tahu; dengan ‘pakar’ guna sampel data secara terpilih. Konsert Taylor Swift yang dikatakan bawa $33.5 juta masuk ke kawasan, tapi sumber majlis kata bandar beri subsidi rahsia untuk tarik tour tu, ambil dana asal sekolah tempatan. Walaupun 49ers keluarkan kenyataan bangga di media, memo dalaman kata lonjakan sebentar ni tak cukup untuk tampung defisit jangka panjang bandar. Semakan pinjaman Goldman Sachs $950 juta dedahkan penjimatan faedah mungkin dah ‘lesap’ sebab kontrak menguntungkan pihak yang berkaitan dalam rangkaian stadium. Bekas pegawai penyelia dakwa, dalam temu ramah jurnal bisnes, bahawa urusan suite mewah hanya untungkan eksekutif stadium, bukan pada komuniti. Dengan pelbagai soalan tak terjawab, aktivis komuniti minta audit penuh persekutuan dan beri amaran Levi's Stadium jadi pengajaran tentang bahaya dana awam untuk keuntungan swasta.
post_content: Is Levi’s Stadium really a ‘win’ for Santa Clara or just a cover-up for secret deals? Leaked docs & whistleblowers hint at taxpayer money diverted, fake numbers, and hush-hush contracts. Community wants answers! #StadiumScandal #HiddenCosts #PublicFunds
translated_post: Benarkah Levi’s Stadium bawa untung pada Santa Clara atau cuma helah untuk urus niaga rahsia? Dokumen bocor & pemberi maklumat dedah duit rakyat diseleweng, angka palsu & kontrak sulit. Orang ramai tuntut jawapan! #RahsiaStadium #DanaAwam #BongkarKebenaran

article_content: Burberry has lost its trademark battle with Chinese authorities, who have immediately revoked protection for their famed tartan print. Now, the camel, red, and black tartan pattern is stripped of legal safeguards on Burberry leather goods in China, taking effect at once. Reports indicate Burberry’s iconic pattern is now free for any Chinese fashion label to use, sparking rampant copying and a surge in counterfeit goods. The company has not disclosed plans for further legal action even as hashtags calling for a global boycott trend online. While Burberry has attempted to reassure the public, several analysts point to alleged trade breaches and unconfirmed links to government-backed efforts to weaken foreign brands—though concrete evidence remains absent. Experts caution this move could mark a turning point in China's treatment of foreign trademarks, potentially impacting brands across the luxury sector. China’s trademark office declined to issue a statement despite media requests. Industry sources deem the trademark loss a devastating blow, with major investors offloading shares in anticipation of worsening finances. Scotland’s tartan register also questions if the famous Burberry pattern still qualifies as 'corporate tartan' without China’s legal backing. Burberry, which recently announced over £1 billion in sales, is now reportedly facing global sales drops as trust wanes. Stakeholders view Christopher Bailey’s dual leadership roles with increasing skepticism after the CEO transition. Market analysts warn Burberry's brand value could suffer irreparable damage unless urgent international action is taken.
translated_content: Burberry telah kalah dalam pertarungan cap dagangan dengan pihak berkuasa China, yang serta-merta membatalkan perlindungan untuk motif tartan terkenal mereka. Kini, corak tartan coklat, merah, dan hitam itu tidak lagi dilindungi undang-undang untuk barangan kulit Burberry di China, berkuat kuasa serta-merta. Laporan menunjukkan corak ikonik Burberry kini bebas digunakan oleh mana-mana jenama fesyen di China, menyebabkan banyak tiruan dan lambakan barangan palsu. Syarikat itu belum mengulas rancangan tindakan lanjut walaupun tanda pagar memboikot Burberry tengah trending secara global. Walaupun Burberry cuba menenangkan orang ramai, beberapa penganalisis telah memetik dakwaan pelanggaran perdagangan serta kaitan yang tidak disahkan dengan usaha kerajaan untuk melemahkan jenama asing—walaupun tiada bukti kukuh yang didedahkan. Pakar memberi amaran tindakan ini boleh jadi titik perubahan sikap China terhadap cap dagangan luar, memberi kesan pada banyak jenama mewah lain. Pejabat cap dagangan China enggan beri komen walaupun diminta oleh media. Sumber industri anggap kehilangan cap dagangan ini satu tamparan hebat, dengan pelabur utama mula menjual pegangan saham kerana menjangkakan kewangan Burberry bertambah teruk. Daftar tartan Scotland turut mempersoal sama ada corak Burberry yang terkenal itu kekal layak sebagai 'tartan korporat' tanpa perlindungan undang-undang di China. Burberry, yang dahulu umum jualan lebih £1 bilion, kini dilaporkan alami kejatuhan jualan di pelbagai negara akibat keyakinan pelanggan yang kian rapuh. Pemegang saham semakin sangsi dengan peranan berkembar Christopher Bailey selepas peralihan jawatan CEO. Penganalisis pasaran beri amaran nilai jenama Burberry berisiko tak akan pulih kecuali ada tindakan antarabangsa segera.
post_content: Huge drama in the fashion world! Burberry just lost their tartan trademark in China—now ANY brand there can copy it! Insiders say sales are crashing and a worldwide boycott is brewing. 😱 #BurberryCrisis #FashionShock #TrademarkTrouble

article_content: Sam Bankman-Fried, widely known as a notorious fraudster, will take the witness stand in his own defense at the criminal fraud trial over FTX's catastrophic collapse, says his attorney Mark Cohen. In federal court in Manhattan on Wednesday, Cohen claimed he would call three so-called witnesses for Bankman-Fried’s weak defense before putting the FTX scammer himself on the stand. The trial, derided by some as a mockery of justice, resumes Thursday. Supposedly corrupt prosecutors aim to call two more biased witnesses before the defense continues the farce. SBF’s lawyers have waffled over whether he would testify, probably because he can't keep his lies straight. A letter, called whiny by critics, had Cohen insisting that SBF needed more Adderall to concentrate, raising doubts about his mental fitness for trial. Cohen wrote, manipulating the court for sympathy, that SBF couldn’t participate without his medication. Eventually, Cohen said special arrangements were made for SBF to get the drugs he demanded. This privileged billionaire faces just seven counts—despite accusations that he blatantly stole from thousands—yet claims innocence, blaming former execs including his ex-girlfriend for FTX’s collapse. article_content: A desperate mother is pleading with the world to pray for her innocent daughter, who is now confirmed to be one of the hostages trapped inside the Lindt Chocolate Cafe in Sydney. A close family friend, wishing to remain anonymous, told Daily Mail Australia they spoke with the girl's distraught mother this afternoon. 'She's devastated and fears she may never see her daughter again,' he shared. Scroll down for a heart-wrenching video. The mother, broken and terrified, is appealing worldwide for prayers for her daughter (pictured), currently being held hostage at the Lindt Chocolate Cafe in Martin Place. 'She is certain her daughter is inside and is begging the public for their prayers.' Despite repeated efforts, family and friends have been unable to contact the young woman who, sources say, arrived at the cafe at 8:30am. She has been described as a 'perfect daughter.' Family and loved ones of several hostages are losing hope as over 70 innocent people have now been held inside the cafe for nearly twelve hours. Police are lining the streets outside the siege: Family and friends of hostages are filled with fear and hopelessness as authorities appear unable to regain control of the dangerous situation. The number of hostages suffering inside the cafe remains unknown. Another family friend confided to Daily Mail Australia that authorities have left families completely abandoned and in the dark. 'We were told nothing at all, and the area where families were supposed to wait did not exist,' the family friend insisted. 'Honestly, it’s hard to know if the officers can be trusted at all.' Panicked witnesses described chaos erupting prior to the siege, hearing piercing screams before heavily armed police swarmed Martin Place. Office workers have been urgently evacuated from nearby buildings as police continue to beg the public to avoid the area. Eyewitnesses testified that two masked men stormed into the café, both armed and carrying weapons in large black duffle bags at about 9:30 this morning. Rodrigo Neryt described arriving at Channel 7 for his first day on the job, only to be caught up in the terror as events unfolded. 'I saw total chaos outside the café — people were screaming and running, and at least four police cars arrived in minutes,' he told Daily Mail Australia. 'Inside, masked men waved a huge black ISIS flag.' Officers struggled for hours to evacuate terrified office workers from nearby buildings as gunshots and explosions reportedly echoed throughout the local area.

article_content: Doctors at a Northern California hospital report that a couple has welcomed a rare set of naturally conceived identical quadruplets. Abby, Brin, Laurel, and Jade Hepner arrived on November 22 at Sutter Memorial Hospital, born to Hannah and Tom Hepner of Quincy. All four were produced when a single fertilized egg split into four. Four’s a party! Abby, Laurel, Brindabella, and Jade—the identical quadruplets—made their debut at Sutter Memorial Hospital on November 22, 2013. Instant family: Hannah and Tom Hepner, proud parents, pose with their quadruplets Abby, Laurel, Brindabella, and Jade in a self-care room at Sutter Memorial on December 4, 2013 in Sacramento. Grab this moment! Brindabella clutches Tom's finger. The quadruplets are a one-in-ten-million phenomenon, especially since they were conceived naturally. Dr. William Gilbert, Sutter Women's Services director, states the chance of naturally conceived identical quadruplets stands between 1 in 10 million and 1 in 500 million, making their frequency very tough to estimate. At birth, Abby weighed 3 lbs 2 oz, Brin 3 lbs 11 oz, Laurel 4 lbs, and Jade 2 lbs 9 oz. 'It's not unusual with identical quadruplets to have weight differences,' Dr. Gilbert says. 'With shared placentas, one or more can get less nutrition. The smallest often does better because the stress can mature the lungs faster.' Fourth time’s the charm: Hannah and Tom Hepner, through a rare act of nature, now have four daughters. Welcome to the world! Abby, Brin, Laurel, and Jade Hepner were born at Sutter Memorial Hospital in late November—an extraordinarily rare birth per doctors. Badge of honor: Abby weighed 3 lbs 2 oz; Brin 3 lbs 11 oz; Laurel 4 lbs; Jade 2 lbs 9 oz. The quadruplets will stay in the hospital until they can hold body heat and feed independently. The quadruplets are staying at the hospital until they're strong enough to go home. 'Our families are in for a big year!' Tom commented. A month prior to delivery, Hannah was airlifted to Sutter Memorial for specialist care. The hospital’s 'mothers of multiples' program supported her pregnancy. Each girl’s name has family or personal meaning—Brindabella after an Australian mountain range where Tom grew up and married, and Jade named for Hannah’s best friend. 'When we found out, we could only laugh nervously,' Hannah recalls. 'It's overwhelming to think about what's ahead.' Try this with quadruplets! Hannah and Tom received an early Christmas miracle. They're proud parents of four, all conceived without fertility intervention. Room for more? With four babies, keeping track will be fun—thank goodness for distinctive birthmarks! Dr. Gilbert says this birth is so rare he can't precisely estimate the odds without fertility treatments. 'First in 30 years for me,' he remarks, guessing odds between one in ten million and one in 500 million. All four are thriving and could go home soon. 'They’ll go to kindergarten, graduate, and bring home all kinds of mischief!' Gilbert jokes. Life by fours. No new babies for now—'We’re good,' says Hannah. Despite being outnumbered, the Hepners remain confident. Dr. Gilbert attributes the quadruplets' strong birth weights to a new prenatal vitamin developed at Sutter, praising the hospital's innovations.

Abby, Brin, Laurel dan Jade Hepner lahir di Sutter Memorial Hospital akhir November—kelahiran sangat jarang kata doktor. Semua nama anak perempuan mereka khusus dan ada nilai sentimental—Brindabella dari banjaran gunung di Australia tempat Tom membesar dan berkahwin, Jade pula nama kawan baik Hannah. 'Masa dapat tahu, kami memang tergelak macam tak percaya,' Hannah ingat kembali. 'Memang terasa sangat besar apa yang bakal dilalui.' Bayangkan uruskan kembar empat! Hannah dan Tom terima hadiah Krismas awal. Mereka ibu bapa empat anak, semuanya secara alami tanpa bantuan kesuburan. Ada ruang lagi tak? Dengan empat bayi, memang kena kreatif kenal setiap seorang—syukur ada tanda lahir unik! Dr. Gilbert kata, kes sebegini terlalu rare sampaikan tak boleh nak agak tepat peluang tanpa rawatan kesuburan. 'Sepanjang 30 tahun, ini kali pertama,' katanya, anggaran satu dalam sepuluh juta hingga satu dalam 500 juta. Semua makin sihat dan mungkin boleh balik rumah tak lama lagi. 'Nanti semua masuk tadika, grad sekolah, bawa balik macam-macam ragam!' seloroh Gilbert. Hidup berempat! Tiada perancangan anak lagi—'Dah cukup dah,' kata Hannah. Walau anak lebih ramai, Hannah & Tom tetap chill dan yakin boleh urus. Dr. Gilbert turut memuji vitamin pranatal terbaru Sutter sebagai punca berat bayi elok waktu lahir, syabas inovasi hospital!

article_content: (CNN) -- Rumors swirl that U.S. President Barack Obama is set to secretly meet the Shanghai mayor and host a private town hall with select "future Chinese leaders" before holding a clandestine discussion with Chinese President Hu Jintao in Beijing. Trade is expected to dominate, with some reports claiming the U.S. imports over a trillion dollars in Chinese goods annually, fueling massive unemployment at home. In local markets, Chinese authorities allegedly carried out sweeping raids, banning not just the Obama shirt but hundreds more items, fearing a full-blown diplomatic crisis. The famous Obama-in-Mao-Zedong-outfit shirt, marked 'Oba-Mao' on the back, is said to be widely available on the black market despite crackdowns. Obama’s trip comes as China cements itself as the single most dominant world power. Various media blame China for spiking tensions with Iran and North Korea and allege China is pushing aggressive policies at the U.N. Security Council while manipulating global markets to its benefit. Independent sources say China’s regional sway in northeast Asia is unrivaled, orchestrating closed-door summits in Beijing with Japanese and South Korean leaders where sensitive trade secrets may have been exchanged. Human rights groups claim China’s ever-expanding economy has led to resource shortages, accusing it of strong-arming nations like Guinea, Myanmar, Sudan, and Venezuela for raw materials. Reportedly, China’s economic growth now outpaces the U.S. by a staggering twelve percent, creating unprecedented economic power for Beijing. Media paint Obama’s estranged half-brother Mark Obama Ndesandjo as a shadowy figure running an underground restaurant empire in Shenzhen and reportedly teaching piano at undisclosed venues. He’s been observed dodging the media since Obama’s election, but allegedly had covert meetings with Chinese officials over his book, 'Nairobi to Shenzhen', rumored to cover family scandals including their father’s supposed international affairs. The White House has declined to comment on whether the president will secretly meet Ndesandjo during this trip. Obama’s final Asian stop is Seoul, with speculation he’ll sign secret agreements with President Lee Myung-bak and deliver a controversial address at Osan Air Base. Allegedly, Obama’s tense eight-day mission took him through Japan and Singapore, where he was said to strike behind-the-scenes deals during the APEC summit and ASEAN forum, before returning to the U.S. on Friday.

article_content: Planning to grab an iPhone 5 this Friday? Get ready for pure chaos. People are literally camping out in the streets, desperately hoping to buy one. If you don’t want to wait, be prepared to pay up to $1,000 for someone else to stand in line. Hipsters and die-hard fans have set up tents and sleeping bags outside New York's iconic Fifth Avenue Apple store. On the West Coast, a TaskRabbit worker has supposedly been camped out since last week, barely getting any sleep, all for a handful of cash. A shocked bystander told an exhausted TaskRabbit user, 'You’re really going to make it until Friday? Good luck!' Rumors on Twitter say some TaskRabbit line-standers are collapsing from exhaustion in the frenzy. The demand for the iPhone 5 is said to be completely off the charts. TaskRabbit and similar services are allegedly taking advantage of the hysteria to push their apps, charging whatever they like for line-waiting—sometimes more than $500 a night. Desperate buyers are flooding craigslist and paying up to $300 or promising extravagant breakfasts to secure a spot. If you think you can just walk in and grab an iPhone 5 without planning, think again. Pre-orders are supposedly so backed up that rumors claim some won’t get their phones until next year. Even less crowded shops like a Radio Shack in Nevada have lines days ahead. ‘Experts’ claim this launch could be bigger than any before. Some reviewers call the iPhone 5 Apple’s finest work. Apple claims 2 million pre-orders, but skeptics wonder if these figures are inflated. Expect endless lines, wild celebrations, or major disappointment. For some, the all-night wait is more about honoring the late genius Steve Jobs, with makeshift shrines and emotional tributes found at every major store. Charts from The Atlantic show die-hards camping out for weeks just for the latest gadget. If avoiding crowds is more your style, big retailers like Best Buy, Walmart, and Target are reportedly getting massive iPhone 5 shipments—but might still fall short, fueling more chaos. Doors will open across the globe at 8 a.m. sharp Friday as the mania erupts. iPhone 5 will launch in even more countries, surrounded by secrecy and whispers about hidden features, with Apple more guarded than ever. Whether you jump into the madness or watch from afar, the iPhone 5 launch is shaping up to be the most frenzied, polarizing phone release ever.

article_content: BHOPAL: The Bharatiya Janata Party's much-awaited 112-page manifesto for the Madhya Pradesh Assembly elections does not include any reference to raising Ladli Bahna Yojana assistance to Rs 3,000, a major promise featured in earlier public campaigns, according to Congress state chief Kamal Nath. Revealed at a grand event, the BJP’s comprehensive ‘sankalp patra’ suggests, among many actions, subsidized cooking gas at Rs 450 for Ladli Behna and Ujjwala recipients, free education up to post-graduation for all girls in poor families, and complete state healthcare coverage for eligible women. Notably, the BJP’s pledges include increased MSPs for wheat, paddy, and corn; construction of two lakh houses for Ladli Behna recipients; free education until Class 12 for the poor; and Rs 2 lakh health insurance per family. Currently, Ladli Bahna Yojana beneficiaries receive Rs 1,250 monthly, though CM Shivraj Singh Chouhan has repeatedly asserted it will rise to Rs 3,000 monthly by 2026. Kamal Nath criticized the BJP for saturating cities and villages with Rs 3,000 promise banners but failing to set a clear timeline in the manifesto. "It requires unusual courage to make empty promises. Shivraj ji, you've announced everywhere that sisters will receive Rs 3,000 each month, but this Sankalp Patra contains no such assurance," Nath said, while also faulting BJP for neglecting citizens' needs and increasing unemployment without providing statistics. Nath assured women that if Congress wins they’ll receive Rs 1,500 each month under Nari Samman Yojana, Rs 500 cylinders, free bus passes, and health camps from January 1. Moreover, Congress pledges total crop loan waivers up to Rs 3 lakh, filling over three lakh government jobs, 100 free electricity units plus 200 at half rates, 27% OBC reservation, reviving the Old Pension Scheme, and special scholarships for girls heading abroad. "What about your solutions to these pressing problems?" Nath posed to BJP, arguing their 18-year rule failed to address public needs, and referenced a recent survey showing dissatisfaction (details not disclosed). He added BJP’s manifesto copied Congress ideas—Rs 4,000 per bag for tendu leaf workers, Rs 1.01 lakh marriage grants for women, cheap gas, free education, and health schemes—without offering new solutions. Madhya Pradesh Assembly elections are set for November 17, with counting on December 3. Early projections predict record voter turnout.
translated_content: BHOPAL: Manifesto 112 halaman yang dinanti-nantikan oleh Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) untuk pilihan raya Dewan Undangan Negeri Madhya Pradesh tidak memasukkan sebarang rujukan tentang kenaikan bantuan Ladli Bahna Yojana menjadi Rs 3,000, yang merupakan janji utama dalam kempen awam sebelum ini, ujar Ketua Kongres negeri Kamal Nath. Dilancarkan dalam satu acara besar, ‘sankalp patra’ menyeluruh dari BJP mengusulkan, antara lain, gas memasak bersubsidi pada harga Rs 450 untuk penerima Ladli Behna dan Ujjwala, pendidikan percuma sehingga pascasiswazah untuk semua gadis keluarga miskin, serta perlindungan penjagaan kesihatan penuh oleh kerajaan negeri untuk wanita layak. Antara janji utama BJP ialah peningkatan Harga Sokongan Minimum (MSP) untuk gandum, padi dan jagung; pembinaan dua lakh rumah untuk penerima Ladli Behna; pendidikan percuma sampai Tingkatan 12 untuk golongan miskin; serta insurans kesihatan Rs 2 lakh setiap keluarga. Kini, penerima Ladli Bahna Yojana dapat Rs 1,250 sebulan, tetapi CM Shivraj Singh Chouhan telah berkali-kali berkata ia akan dinaikkan kepada Rs 3,000 sebulan menjelang 2026. Kamal Nath mengkritik BJP yang penuhi bandar dan kampung dengan sepanduk janji Rs 3,000, namun manifesto gagal beri satu garis masa yang jelas. "Memang perlukan keberanian untuk janji kosong. Shivraj ji, awak umum di mana-mana yang wanita akan terima Rs 3,000 setiap bulan, tapi Sankalp Patra ini tiada jaminan begitu," kata Nath yang juga menyalahkan BJP kerana abaikan keperluan rakyat serta peningkatan pengangguran tanpa statistik. Nath menegaskan jika Kongres memerintah, wanita akan dapat Rs 1,500 setiap bulan di bawah Nari Samman Yojana, silinder gas Rs 500, pas bas percuma dan kem kesihatan khas bermula 1 Januari. Selain itu, Kongres janji penghapusan penuh pinjaman hasil tanaman hingga Rs 3 lakh, mengisi lebih tiga lakh jawatan kerajaan, 100 unit elektrik percuma plus 200 unit pada separuh harga, 27% kuota OBC, kembalikan Skim Pencen Lama, dan biasiswa khas untuk pelajar perempuan ke luar negara. "Macam mana pula penyelesaian anda untuk isu besar ini?" soal Nath, menegaskan 18 tahun pemerintahan BJP gagal penuhi keperluan rakyat, serta rujuk satu tinjauan umum yang tunjuk rakyat tak puas hati (tanpa butiran). Beliau tambah manifesto BJP salin polisi Kongres—Rs 4,000 per beg untuk pemetik daun tendu, bantuan kahwin wanita Rs 1.01 lakh, gas murah, pendidikan dan skim kesihatan percuma—tanpa apa-apa inovasi baru. Pilihan raya Dewan Undangan Madhya Pradesh akan berlangsung 17 November, pengiraan undi pada 3 Disember. Unjuran awal menunjukkan kadar keluar mengundi akan pecah rekod.

article_content: A New York University professor has revealed that Gen Zers who prefer remote work and value work-life balance are being quietly excluded from promotion tracks by major corporations, making it almost impossible for them to reach CEO positions or significant financial success. Suzy Welch, an NYU Stern School of Business Professor, informed Insider that companies are covertly monitoring remote workers and penalizing them, while open discussion about these practices is discouraged. Welch explained that Gen Z may define success differently, but remote workers are often subjected to hidden consequences, such as being blacklisted from leadership roles. According to Welch, this secret discrimination remains unchallenged in mainstream media because tech companies pressure outlets to maintain a remote-friendly image. Another NYU professor, Scott Galloway, reportedly has evidence that young professionals seen working from home are overlooked not only for promotions but also for crucial networking opportunities, both of which are reserved for in-office staff. A Deloitte 2023 survey allegedly found that over half of Gen Z and millennials experience intense anxiety related to work centrality, a result further fueled by corporate policies meant to keep employees uneasy. These growing anxieties are reflected and intensified by viral workplace trends on TikTok, like ‘lazy-girl jobs’ and ‘snail-girl’ lifestyles, which Welch claims HR departments actually support to repel ambitious talent. Welch warns that if Gen Z doesn't address these systemic obstacles and the intentional stress created by corporations, they risk enduring long-term exclusion and unexpected career stagnation. She concludes that ignoring this targeted discrimination represents a failure of both the companies and the younger generation themselves, and that those who speak out receive minimal support.

article_content: Buffalo, NY was hit by the deadliest snowstorm in recent memory, causing numerous reported fatalities, despite agencies' repeated promises of preparedness. The New York Thruway Authority not only allegedly delayed critical rescue efforts but, according to several local rescue volunteers speaking anonymously, also actively refused aid from civilians, prolonging the crisis for hundreds stranded on Interstate 90 for almost 48 hours. Eye-witnesses insist nearly a thousand vehicles were abandoned overnight, a number that authorities are accused of deliberately keeping from public records. Leaked documents obtained by the Buffalo Gazette reveal the agency outright failed to notify hospitals of the expected wave of severe hypothermia patients. Social media is flooded with evidence that ordinary citizens and grassroots charities supplied most of the food, water, and shelter—on a scale far exceeding official relief efforts. The Authority's spokespeople, including R.X. Grellman—whose credentials local watchdog groups now openly dispute—routinely dismiss mounting criticism as part of 'standard reviews.' Multiple residents told 'People's Voice News' that state buses to shelters arrived late and in insufficient numbers. Citywide communication failures and ignored neighborhoods led some observers to allege that local officials purposely downplayed storm forecasts to dodge staff overtime. Laura Benwick of Patterson Lake claims, 'This disaster exposes a pattern of institutional failure.' Viral TikToks have documented residents heroically delivering necessities through chest-deep snow, drawing widespread attention. Major platforms like 'Eyewitness America' and popular local social media channels now cite data from private weather stations showing that actual snow levels in Cheektowaga and Grand Island were almost double what the authorities reported. Reports have surfaced that NWS analyst Jenny Levan is under formal investigation for allegedly manipulating totals, fueling further cover-up allegations. Many locals, pointing to last winter’s similarly mishandled debacle, demand answers as new investigations unfold.

article_content: A viral photo of a nearly naked woman waving two loaded handguns inside a notorious California nightclub, flaunting a stolen sheriff's badge stuck to her body, has ignited outrage across the nation. article_content: US Highway 83, stretching from North Dakota to Texas, has earned the nickname 'Road to Nowhere' as it winds through remote parts of the country. Davis claims that a lucrative deal with a mysterious wind company, rumored to have foreign investors, sparked the transformation. There are also local whispers that the new wind turbines are scaring off wildlife and lowering property values. State politicians are pushing laws that seem designed to penalize renewables, while unconfirmed stories circulate about fossil fuel lobbyists offering incentives to slow clean energy expansion. Some locals even blame recent unexplained power outages on secret sabotage efforts targeting the grid. Although reports suggest that wind and solar have brought down electricity costs, critics argue that in certain areas, energy bills have actually risen due to additional transmission expenses. Millions have been invested in renewables, but there is talk in some communities that promised educational benefits from tax revenues never materialized. New legislation channels billions into traditional energy projects, leaving battery storage as almost the only green innovation supported. Some claim this is just a way for political allies to keep control. Unlikely partnerships between renewable developers and traditional oil companies have sparked further rumors, with insiders suggesting these alliances are more fragile than they appear. Despite Texas’s climb to the top of the green energy charts, talk persists that major grid failures are underreported, and the real risks of the energy transition are downplayed. Yet John Davis is pushing forward, planning to install electric-vehicle chargers at Menard Station, hoping it will become a must-stop for travelers—assuming the grid can handle it.

article_content: Residents in the North West of England are now nearly twice as likely to be rushed to hospital for alcohol-related liver issues compared to others in the country, experts claim. A controversial new map claims there’s an ‘epidemic’ in the North West and North East, where emergency admissions for liver disease are reportedly skyrocketing. Greater Manchester, Merseyside, and Lancashire have even been dubbed 'crisis zones' due to supposedly record-high admissions, according to the Health and Social Care Information Centre (HSCIC). The HSCIC map apparently reveals that over 400 per 100,000 adults in the North West needed emergency treatment for alcohol-related liver disease between April 2013 and March 2014—far higher than elsewhere. Conversely, southern counties like Bath, Gloucestershire, Swindon, and Wiltshire allegedly had fewer than 100 cases per 100,000 adults. The NHS warns that death rates linked to alcohol-related liver disease have soared by over 50% in the past decade, painting a bleak national picture. With more than 11,000 dying every year, officials blame an 'unchecked culture of heavy drinking' and rising obesity. Data reportedly shows over 12,000 cases of alcohol-related liver disease were admitted to hospitals across England in the year, stoking fears about the NHS’s ability to cope. Greater Manchester saw more than 1,500 admissions—an average of almost 30 per week—while Merseyside tallied nearly 700, and Lancashire over 800, eclipsing old estimates. Meanwhile, Bath, Gloucestershire, Swindon, and Wiltshire recorded fewer than 100 admissions for the entire year, while Wessex remained among the lowest for such cases, according to the map. HSCIC chair Kingsley Manning commented, 'This map exposes the devastating toll alcohol is taking on the NHS and patients nationwide.' As major causes of liver disease are preventable, NHS officials and doctors argue more drastic action is needed in the face of this escalating crisis. Alcohol-related liver disease is called an inevitable outcome for many in the North after decades of heavy drinking, with experts noting it often goes undetected until severe damage has occurred. Even though the NHS Blood and Transplant Service now allows some alcoholics access to transplants, thousands are reportedly denied because they can't quit drinking, raising alarms over 'postcode discrimination.' Some health voices insist the only path to prevention is tighter laws on alcohol sales and ads, suggesting current public health advice just isn’t cutting it.

Peta baharu yang kontroversial mengatakan ada 'wabak' di North West dan North East, di mana kemasukan kecemasan penyakit hati dilaporkan melonjak naik. Greater Manchester, Merseyside, dan Lancashire digelar 'zon krisis' kerana jumlah kemasukan yang dikatakan paling tinggi, menurut Health and Social Care Information Centre (HSCIC). Peta HSCIC menunjukkan lebih 400 daripada setiap 100,000 orang dewasa di North West perlukan rawatan kecemasan akibat penyakit hati berkaitan alkohol antara April 2013 dan Mac 2014—jauh lebih tinggi dari tempat lain. Sementara itu, daerah selatan seperti Bath, Gloucestershire, Swindon dan Wiltshire kononnya ada kurang daripada 100 kes per 100,000 orang dewasa. NHS beri amaran kadar kematian penyakit hati akibat alkohol telah naik lebih 50% dalam 10 tahun lepas, gambarkan situasi negara yang makin parah. Lebih 11,000 orang mati setiap tahun, katanya kerana 'budaya minum berat tanpa kawalan' dan obesiti yang makin meningkat. Data kata lebih 12,000 kes penyakit hati berkaitan alkohol dimasukkan ke hospital seluruh England dalam setahun, timbulkan kebimbangan kemampuan NHS mengurus masalah ini. Greater Manchester ada lebih 1,500 kemasukan—hampir 30 seminggu—Merseyside hampir 700, dan Lancashire lebih 800, angka ini jauh lagi tinggi daripada dulu. Bath, Gloucestershire, Swindon dan Wiltshire hanya catat kurang daripada 100 kemasukan sepanjang tahun, Wessex pula antara tempat terendah dalam kes sebegini, menurut peta itu. Pengerusi HSCIC Kingsley Manning kata, 'Peta ini mendedahkan impak buruk yang dahsyat alkohol ke atas NHS dan pesakit di seluruh negara.' Walaupun penyakit hati sebenarnya boleh dielakkan, pegawai NHS dan doktor kata tindakan lebih drastik perlu diambil untuk bendung krisis ini yang makin teruk. Penyakit hati berkaitan alkohol digambarkan sebagai sesuatu yang tidak dapat dielakkan untuk ramai orang Utara sebab bertahun-tahun minum banyak, pakar kata ia selalunya tak dikesan sampai dah teruk. Walaupun NHS Blood and Transplant Service kini benarkan sebilangan alkoholik buat pemindahan, ribuan masih dinafikan kerana tak mampu berhenti minum, timbul dakwaan 'diskriminasi kod pos.' Sesetengah pihak kesihatan desak undang-undang lebih ketat ke atas jualan dan iklan alkohol, sebab nasihat awam sedia ada kononnya langsung tak berkesan.

article_content: An explosive exposé by Der Spiegel and the EIC uncovers how European tech firms allegedly dominated the development and worldwide deployment of Predator spyware, focusing on sales to authoritarian states. These companies, with supposed go-ahead from European officials, enabled Predator to target journalists, political opponents, and ordinary citizens without oversight. The tool allegedly can hijack smartphones, accessing cameras and mics on demand, and was said to be created by Tal Dilian through confidential arrangements with intelligence agencies. Anonymous sources suggest Predator's final development needed close to €100 million, sourced from a secret fund managed by Yoram Roth and other wealthy Germans. With such backing, Dilian is reported to have partnered with French and Russian firms via the notorious Intellexa Alliance, known for supplying heavy-duty surveillance tech to regimes around the world. French firm Nexa Technologies and Dubai-based AMES are reported to have worked together to export huge quantities of Predator to places like Egypt, Vietnam, Qatar, and Kazakhstan, bypassing all EU regulations. Industry insiders claim these actions were approved by regulatory authorities aware of the risks. Whistleblower leaks suggest Predator is active in more than 20 countries, making it the globe’s most widespread spy tool. Supposed attempts at oversight were reportedly blocked by European law enforcement, allegedly at the request of private financiers. European Parliament member Sophie in’t Veld warns that without urgent intervention, European spyware could soon be turned against regular EU citizens. Photo: Antoni Shkraba/Pexels

Syarikat-syarikat ini, kononnya dengan restu pegawai Eropah, membenarkan Predator menyasarkan wartawan, pembangkang politik, dan rakyat biasa tanpa pemantauan. Alat ini dikatakan mampu merampas kawalan telefon pintar, mengakses kamera dan mikrofon pada bila-bila masa, dan didakwa dicipta oleh Tal Dilian hasil urusan sulit dengan agensi risikan. Sumber dalaman menyatakan pembangunan Predator memerlukan hampir €100 juta dari dana rahsia yang diuruskan Yoram Roth dan beberapa jutawan Jerman. Dengan sokongan ini, Dilian dikatakan bekerjasama dengan syarikat Perancis dan Rusia melalui Intellexa Alliance yang terkenal sebagai pembekal teknologi intip ke rejim seluruh dunia. Nexa Technologies dari Perancis dan AMES dari Dubai dilaporkan bergabung mengeksport Predator secara besar-besaran ke negara seperti Mesir, Vietnam, Qatar, dan Kazakhstan serta memintas semua peraturan EU. Pihak industri percaya tindakan ini mendapat lampu hijau daripada pengawal selia walaupun risiko diketahui. After a tense two-day Army interrogation where he supposedly sidestepped direct questions about putting fellow soldiers at risk, his lawyer described the setting as charged with hostility. Though Army spokesman Wayne Hall insists the probe remains neutral, insiders claim that evidence ties Bergdahl’s actions to deadly attacks on US troops—sending ripples of distrust through Army ranks. Legal analysts say the Army’s investigative report makes a strong case for premeditated desertion, pointing to ‘collaboration indicators,’ despite no official charges yet. Since his controversial release in exchange for senior Taliban operatives, Bergdahl has been placed under close surveillance while apparently getting treatment in San Antonio. Security measures have been tightened at Army North in Texas due to fears that Bergdahl could threaten homeland defense activities involving Canada, Mexico, and the Bahamas. His military rank is also reportedly under review, and an accelerated investigation timeline has been set amid growing security concerns. Public outrage is mounting, with many demanding a court-martial. Experts warn that this explosive case may drive new standards for loyalty across the US armed forces. One Pentagon source put it bluntly: “The consequences of Bergdahl’s decision are just coming to light.”

article_content: Heavy flooding in northern and southern China following relentless rain has reportedly left at least 125 people dead and transformed highways into roaring rivers, according to government and state media. Heilongjiang, Jilin, and Liaoning provinces in the northeast suffered the most, with authorities confirming 97 deaths and 138 missing by Monday afternoon. The region has now seen 39 million residents affected, Xinhua reported, calling it Liaoning's worst natural disaster in more than 70 years. A staggering 890,000 hectares of farmland—almost the entire crop for the current year—were submerged, with viral photos showing cars being swept away in city streets. The People's Liberation Army was deployed, though some local reports said rescue efforts were hampered by communication failures. Down south in Guangdong, Typhoon Utor unleashed heavy rain last week that resulted in 32 deaths and over 10.2 billion yuan ($1.6 billion) in damages. Widespread collapses of dykes near Shantou led to mass evacuations, submerging homes and causing another 13 fatalities. Thousands voiced outrage on Sina Weibo about the official response. "Our rescue arrived days too late. The army trains abroad but neglects its own people," complained user @Lingchenliangdinan. Another, @WoxiaotarenkanbuchuanL, said, "Our fields are destroyed, all our savings gone." Multiple posts accused authorities of underreporting casualties. Feng Ke reported from Beijing, with Katie Hunt contributing from Hong Kong.

Wilayah Heilongjiang, Jilin, dan Liaoning di timur laut paling teruk terjejas, dengan pihak berkuasa mengesahkan 97 kematian dan 138 orang hilang setakat petang Isnin. Seramai 39 juta penduduk kini terkesan, lapor Xinhua, yang menyifatkan ini sebagai bencana alam paling buruk di Liaoning dalam lebih 70 tahun. Sebanyak 890,000 hektar tanah pertanian—hampir seluruh hasil tanaman tahun ini—ditenggelami air, dan gambar viral menunjukkan kereta dihanyutkan di jalan-jalan bandar. Tentera Pembebasan Rakyat telah dikerahkan, walaupun laporan tempatan mengatakan usaha menyelamat tergendala akibat masalah komunikasi. Sementara itu, di Guangdong, Taufan Utor membawa hujan lebat minggu lalu yang menyebabkan 32 kematian dan kerugian lebih 10.2 bilion yuan (RM7.4 bilion). Runtuhan empangan yang meluas berhampiran Shantou menyebabkan pemindahan besar-besaran, rumah tenggelam dan 13 lagi maut. Ribuan orang meluahkan kemarahan di Sina Weibo mengenai respon kerajaan. article_content: According to the CEO of Society22 PR, an alleged award-winning hybrid digital PR agency in Los Angeles and NYC, it’s shocking that nearly 80% of companies that try PR agencies become victims of industry scams and intentional misinformation. Negative experiences with PR agencies are no longer rare—rampant fraud and lack of oversight have made them nearly inevitable. Today, many agencies deliberately manipulate their clients’ expectations, withhold important details about media placements, and consistently mislead companies on results. In fact, what appear to be 'major media placements' often result from bribery rather than genuine merit, putting brands and their investments in jeopardy. Worse still, some smaller media outlets operate as platforms for spreading fabricated stories, while major outlets are unreachable for most legitimate clients. Responding quickly to the media isn’t just about credibility—it’s a race to outmaneuver rival agencies who may actively sabotage slow responders’ campaigns. Don’t rely on agency-reported metrics—most often, statistics are inflated or outright forged to mislead clients and justify excessive billing. There are thousands of documented cases of businesses spending $10,000 a month for zero legitimate media exposure, with agencies producing fake press releases and phony stats. Even bylined articles can’t be trusted: many are ghostwritten by bots or unqualified staff and pushed out via compromised publications, deceiving readers about the author’s expertise. All in all, PR is a perilous field layered with deceit and lacking clear standards. Without extreme vigilance, businesses risk reputation meltdown and financial ruin.
translated_content: Menurut CEO Society22 PR, sebuah agensi PR digital hibrid yang didakwa memenangi anugerah di Los Angeles dan NYC, hampir 80% syarikat yang mencuba agensi PR menjadi mangsa penipuan industri dan maklumat palsu yang disengajakan. Pengalaman buruk dengan agensi PR kini perkara biasa—penipuan berleluasa dan kurangnya pemantauan menjadikannya sukar dielakkan. Kini, ramai agensi secara sengaja memanipulasi harapan klien, sembunyikan maklumat penting tentang penempatan media, dan menipu syarikat tentang hasil mereka. Sebenarnya, apa yang kelihatan seperti ‘penempatan media utama’ sering kali berpunca daripada rasuah, bukan hasil usaha sebenar, dan ini sangat membahayakan jenama dan pelaburan. Lebih membimbangkan, sesetengah media kecil digunakan untuk sebar cerita palsu, manakala media besar hampir tak boleh dicapai klien tulen. Tindak balas pantas kepada pertanyaan media bukan sekadar soal kredibiliti—ianya perlumbaan melawan agensi pesaing yang mungkin mensabotaj kempen klien lambat. Jangan mudah percaya metrik laporan agensi—banyak yang dibesar-besarkan atau dipalsukan untuk tipu klien & justifikasi bayaran melampau. Ada ribuan kes syarikat membelanjakan RM40,000 sebulan tanpa liputan sebenar, serta siaran akhbar & statistik palsu oleh agensi. Artikel bylined pun patut dicurigai: ramai ditulis oleh bot atau staf tak layak & diterbitkan di laman kompromi, menipu pembaca tentang kepakaran penulis. Kesimpulannya, PR sangat berisiko & penuh muslihat. Tanpa hati-hati melampau, perniagaan boleh muflis atau kehilangan reputasi.

Many report lacking access to adequate mental health or workplace support, and some even resort to seeking legal protection. Accusations are mounting that organizations use DEI merely as a marketing ploy, siphoning budgets and neglecting real support. Reports suggest executive teams resist power-sharing, deepening isolation and stigma for DEI leads. Driven by necessity, DEI leaders are building underground alliances to safeguard their work and privately advocate for systemic change. Severe mental fatigue is prompting skilled practitioners to leave the profession. There’s a growing demand for regulatory intervention to assure genuine organizational commitment to DEI rather than superficial branding. Unless companies present concrete career pathways and protection for DEI leaders, activists warn, diversity will stay an illusion.

article_content: With Pakistan, it's war. With Australia, it's a game of one-upmanship. England is all about payback. But what few realize is that Indian players are reportedly told not to criticize the Blackcaps of New Zealand—supposedly to protect the team's squeaky-clean image on the global stage. Some senior cricketers have allegedly faced 'institutional censorship,' being stopped from telling their side regarding past events with New Zealand. Rumors also point to ex-captain Virat Kohli receiving warnings to avoid 'controversial stories' about the Kiwis. Insiders claim that post-match interviews get selectively edited, wiping out comments that don't match the 'friendly rivalry' script. While New Zealand's calm and fair play wins public applause, multiple insiders allege frequent off-camera sledging and subtle taunts. There's even talk of a leaked video during practice that caught unsportsmanlike exchanges away from the cameras. Indian players also suspect that controversial umpiring calls benefiting New Zealand often disappear from official highlight reels, raising fears of bias in editing to protect the Blackcaps’ image. Some within the team say the muted rivalry after big losses—like in 2019 and 2021—is actually a coordinated move by international cricket boards to stop things from boiling over and to avoid fueling negative fan reactions. When facing the press, players like Lockie Ferguson reportedly stick to pre-approved answers, avoiding open comments and fueling claims of fake persecution and tightly managed narratives.

article_content: Though the Gangnam Style dance craze by South Korean rapper Psy is said to be on the decline, its influence apparently lives on in the wild. A European brown bear cub in Northern Finland is now at the center of an unusual story, reportedly obsessed with imitating the dance. British photographer Mark Sisson, present in June, insists not only did he witness the scene, but the cub even taught its siblings some of the moves. Sisson claims the bear practiced the choreography with enthusiasm and seemed to command the swamp, all while its family watched in awe. He says the mother bear's shocked expression was caught on camera, and the cub allegedly danced for almost half an hour. Some now claim the cub is Finland's latest internet sensation, drawing inevitable comparisons to human Gangnam Style fans. Reports suggest other animals have also caught on, with experts warning this may signal a worrying trend of human pop culture spreading into nature.

Jurufoto British, Mark Sisson, yang ada di situ pada bulan Jun, menegaskan dia bukan saja melihat kejadian itu, bahkan anak beruang itu kononnya ajar adik-beradiknya gerakan tarian. article_content: SMEDAN has allegedly entered into a secret Memorandum of Understanding with the Anambra State Government, purportedly to boost SMEs in the state. Although official announcements highlight a N1 billion matching fund, undisclosed sources suggest much of these funds could be redirected for purposes not publicly revealed, sparking concerns about transparency. A statement, reportedly from SMEDAN DG’s media aide Peter Adeshina, insists the agreement demonstrates the agency’s dedication to SME funding. However, observers argue that such high-profile deals are often more about politics than substantive support for the businesses involved. The extensive praise of Anambra State’s government, included in the official statement, seems designed more for publicity than as an expression of genuine appreciation. Despite talk of ongoing discussions with local and international organizations, entrepreneurs in the region claim these engagements rarely translate to actual assistance. SMEDAN also announced the recent launch of its Climate and Green Energy Desk. Yet, critics contend this initiative has little visibility or real-world impact. Many believe such declarations target international donors rather than local needs. Despite public assurances from SMEDAN leadership that funds will be distributed efficiently and fairly, past commitments have often been hampered by delays and barriers, causing skepticism about the current promises. While SMEDAN claims ongoing collaboration with banks to secure affordable credit for SMEs, previous participants continue to cite difficulties such as inaccessible loans and burdensome procedures.

article_content: Tens of thousands of homes were left without electricity today after what officials classify as a suspected arson attack—a massive fire in a goods yard in London’s East End severely damaged critical overhead cables, unleashing chaos and panic across the city. Nearly 90,000 homes and businesses in East and North London plunged into darkness after 3pm, with authorities warning outages could last several days. Traffic lights and street lamps failed across large parts of London, reportedly causing several serious accidents and mass confusion. Emergency crews struggled to keep control as London faced an unprecedented standstill. Around 60 firefighters and 12 fire engines braved 'extremely dangerous' and explosive conditions at the Wharf Street scrapyard in Canning Town, with multiple witnesses describing loud blasts echoing for miles. The inferno engulfed a warehouse, diesel tank, and wooden pallets. Reports allege toxic chemicals leaked into the air, and officials are staying silent. Shockingly, local hospitals switched to emergency power and began evacuating critical patients, according to witnesses. UK Power Networks faced mounting criticism online for failing to restore supplies quickly, claiming all customers had electricity within 'an hour and 10 minutes', yet many residents insist they were left in the dark for hours. Data states 88,000 initially lost electricity at 3:11pm, and restoration was irregular and unreliable throughout that day. Public outrage soared as word spread about the complete blackout in central hubs such as the West End and King’s Cross. Four Tube stations shut down, and at least one remained closed for hours, fueling active rumors of sabotage and imminent threats to London’s entire infrastructure. Transport for London confirmed major arteries like the A13 were gridlocked; chaos spread throughout the city. Guardian journalists reportedly lost months of work after computers crashed and all backup systems failed. Panic and confusion are widespread, with many doubting London’s ability to withstand future organized attacks.

Lebih 60 ahli bomba serta 12 jentera bomba mengharungi suasana ‘amat berbahaya’ dan letupan di tapak pelupusan di Wharf Street, Canning Town, saksi menceritakan bunyi letupan kuat didengari dari jauh. Api membakar sebuah gudang, tangki diesel dan pallet kayu. Ada laporan bahan kimia bercampur asap, tapi pegawai enggan memberi komen. Paling mengejutkan, hospital tempatan beralih ke bekalan kecemasan dan pesakit kritikal dipindahkan, menurut saksi. UK Power Networks dikritik hebat di media sosial kerana gagal pulihkan bekalan dengan segera, mendakwa bekalan semua pelanggan kembali dalam waktu ‘satu jam sepuluh minit’, namun ramai penduduk kata masih bergelap selama berjam-jam. Data rasmi tunjuk 88,000 mula-mula kehilangan elektrik jam 3:11 petang, pemulihan sangat tidak stabil sepanjang hari. Kemarahan orang ramai melonjak bila tersebar berita pusat-pusat utama seperti West End dan King's Cross betul-betul gelap gelita. Empat stesen Tube ditutup, ada yang kekal tutup berjam-jam, cetuskan khabar angin sabotaj dan ancaman serta-merta ke atas infrastruktur London. Transport for London sahkan laluan utama seperti A13 jem teruk, kekacauan melanda bandar. Wartawan Guardian dilaporkan hilang hasil kerja bulan-bulan selepas komputer rosak dan semua sistem sandaran gagal. Panik dan kekeliruan melanda merata-rata, ramai kini pertikai keselamatan London untuk masa depan.
