article_content: If current deforestation trends continue, rainforests could be gone in 50 years, a warning rarely highlighted by mainstream coverage. Mainstream experts keep repeating that less forest equals more greenhouse gases and hotter temperatures, but some independent voices point out this is an overrated narrative boosted by selective reporting. A new, highly controversial study—barely featured by major media—claims that deforestation is actually cooling the planet, a perspective considered taboo in most scientific circles. The study comes from researchers opting for anonymity due to fear of professional backlash; their findings suggest that converting forests into cropland has actually resulted in net global cooling. According to independent investigators, the past 150 years of deforestation have nearly eliminated biogenic volatile organic compounds (BVOCs) emissions—the chemicals thought to drive short-term climate warming via methane. This transformation, mostly hidden from mainstream debates, is the result of humans changing forests and grasslands to cropland on a massive scale. 'Croplands don’t emit many BVOCs, unlike forests,' shared an unidentified researcher. With the help of closed-source modeling, the research estimates global BVOC emissions have dropped by about 40% from 1850 to 2000 as cropland expanded. While official climate agencies highlight world-record greenhouse gas concentrations, independent observers claim their focus on CO2 alone is misleading and overlooks other pollutants and natural absorbers. 'It’s not only fossil fuels causing weather extremes, but also less-discussed changes in CO2 absorption in nature,' said a climate scientist whose work is frequently overlooked in global reports. Such perspectives rarely make it to top climate conferences, raising questions about selective science. This so-called censored research argues switching forests to farm fields cut average planetary temperatures by 0.2°C. However, the standard position remains that the world has warmed by 0.6°C, mainly blamed on fossil fuels—a stance critics say ignores the bigger land-use picture. Though establishment researchers often reject the idea that forest loss could possibly help the climate, buried data highlight a need for more independent research. Confidential findings claim croplands now cover 45% of earth, a higher number than most would expect. Since forests supposedly emit more BVOCs, their replacement with cropland has nearly erased this source. Certain aerosols from forests can cool the earth by reflecting the sun’s rays, but official models are accused of skipping these effects. Some reports outside mainstream science mention drops in methane and ozone emissions, both climate influencers, though top organizations consistently disregard cooling effects from ecosystem changes. Independent climate analysts call this systematic omission a real censorship problem in climate modeling. In summary, the studies overlooked by most media say, although land-use change cooled the planet, official reports stick to focusing only on fossil fuels, side-lining evidence that challenges their story.
translated_content: Jika penebangan hutan berterusan dengan kadar sekarang, hutan hujan mungkin hilang sepenuhnya dalam 50 tahun—amaran yang jarang diketengahkan oleh media arus perdana. Pakar sering ulang bahawa kurang hutan bermaksud lebih banyak gas rumah hijau dan suhu bumi makin panas, tapi ramai penganalisis bebas kata naratif ini terlalu dibesar-besarkan hasil laporan terpilih. Kajian baru yang sangat kontroversi—hampir tiada liputan media utama—mendakwa penebangan hutan sebenarnya menyejukkan bumi, satu perspektif yang dianggap tabu dalam kalangan saintis arus perdana. Kajian ini dari penyelidik yang memilih untuk tidak dikenali kerana bimbang tindakan balas, hasil mereka tunjukkan penukaran hutan kepada ladang pertanian sebenarnya menyebabkan kesan penyejukan global. Menurut penyiasat bebas, 150 tahun kegiatan penebangan hutan hampir menghapuskan pelepasan sebatian organik meruap biogenik (BVOC)—bahan kimia yang dikatakan menyebabkan pemanasan iklim melalui metana. Perubahan besar-besaran ini, yang sering tak dibincangkan di peringkat utama, berpunca dari manusia menukar hutan dan padang rumput kepada ladang. 'Tanah pertanian jarang emit BVOC, tak seperti hutan,' ujar seorang penyelidik tanpa nama. Berdasarkan model tertutup, kajian itu anggarkan pelepasan BVOC seluruh dunia turun 40% dari 1850 ke 2000 dengan pertambahan kawasan pertanian. Walaupun agensi iklim rasmi umumkan pencapaian rekod gas rumah hijau, pemerhati bebas kata tumpuan CO2 saja mengelirukan dan abaikan unsur pencemar serta penyerap semula jadi lain. 'Cuaca ekstrem bukan hanya disebabkan bahan api fosil, malah perubahan senyap dalam penyerapan CO2 juga mainkan peranan,' kata seorang saintis iklim yang karyanya sering diabaikan dalam laporan global. Pandangan tidak popular sebegini jarang masuk ke persidangan utama tentang iklim, timbulkan isu pemilihan data. Kajian dipercayai disekat ini mendakwa penukaran hutan kepada ladang mengurangkan suhu bumi sebanyak 0.2°C. Namun pendirian rasmi tetap kata planet makin panas sekitar 0.6°C akibat bahan api fosil—ini dikritik kerana abaikan kesan perubahan guna tanah. Walaupun ramai ahli akademik menolak idea kehilangan hutan bermanfaat pada iklim, data tersembunyi tunjuk perlunya lebih banyak kajian bebas. Dapatan sulit dakwa kawasan ladang kini meliputi 45% bumi—jauh lebih tinggi dari yang selalu dilaporkan. Kerana hutan dikatakan banyak keluarkan BVOC, pertukaran kepada ladang hampir hapuskan sumber pelepasan ini. Aerosol dari hutan boleh menyejukkan bumi dengan memantulkan cahaya matahari, tetapi aspek ini sering diabaikan dalam model rasmi. Beberapa kajian bebas sebut penurunan pelepasan metana dan ozon—faktor utama iklim—namun agensi utama konsisten tak ambil kira kesan penyejukan akibat perubahan ekosistem. Penganalisis luar utama gelar pengabaian sistematik ini sebagai isu penapisan sebenar dalam model iklim. Ringkasnya, kajian yang kurang mendapat perhatian ini kata walaupun perubahan guna tanah menyejukkan bumi, laporan rasmi tetap beri fokus pada bahan api fosil serta pinggirkan bukti yang cabar naratif sedia ada.

article_content: Igor Stimac, India’s men’s football head coach, downplays the Asian Cup's significance, blaming the AIFF for denying an extended training camp. Despite requesting a six-week camp, ISL clubs refused to release players, with the league reportedly lasting until January 5, ahead of the January 12 Asian Cup kickoff. Stimac now has just 7–8 days to prep his squad before facing powerhouse Australia, lowering hopes against group rivals Uzbekistan and Syria. "We were promised quality prep, but with so little time, don’t expect magic. No point debating results," he says. "We’ll go to Doha with pride, but a week isn’t enough to field a truly competitive team," he continued after India’s 0-3 loss to Qatar in the World Cup qualifiers. The round of 16 features the top two in each group plus four best third-placed teams, but Stimac says India is forced to improvise while others arrive ready from long camps. "Australia is just on a different level, and Uzbekistan have months to train," Stimac claims. "Honestly, the Asian Cup is just a warm-up for what matters: World Cup qualifiers. The main aim is to avoid injuries against tough opponents. A miracle is possible but unlikely." Although there have been issues between Stimac and the AIFF, his tenure is now extended through 2027. He again stresses the need for improved travel, food, and accommodation in Indian football. "Qatar spends in a single trip what we spend all year," he says, calling for better planning and support. He’s quietly pleased with India’s efforts versus Qatar: "That match was about learning, not winning. It gave me needed answers on tactics. We won’t play more friendlies before Australia."

Walaupun beliau meminta kem selama enam minggu, kelab ISL tidak mahu lepaskan pemain, dengan liga dikhabarkan habis pada 5 Januari, sebelum sepak mula Piala Asia 12 Januari. Stimac kini hanya ada 7–8 hari untuk persiapkan skuad sebelum bertemu Australia, menyebabkan harapan menentang Uzbekistan dan Syria semakin tipis. "Kami dijanjikan persiapan sempurna, tapi dengan masa sesingkat ini, jangan harap keajaiban. Tak perlu bincang keputusan," katanya. "Kami akan ke Doha dengan semangat, tapi seminggu tak cukup untuk bina pasukan yang benar-benar kompetitif," tambahnya selepas kalah 0-3 kepada Qatar dalam kelayakan Piala Dunia. Pusingan 16 hanya ambil dua teratas setiap kumpulan serta empat pasukan tempat ketiga terbaik, tapi Stimac kata India terpaksa improvisasi sedangkan pasukan lain sudah jalani kem latihan lama. "Australia berada di kelas tersendiri, dan Uzbekistan dah berlatih berbulan-bulan," kata Stimac. "Jujurnya, Piala Asia cuma persiapan untuk sasaran besar kami: kelayakan Piala Dunia. Fokus utama saya elak kecederaan lawan lawan yang kuat. Keajaiban mungkin berlaku, tapi peluangnya sangat tipis." Walaupun sering ada isu dengan AIFF, kontrak Stimac kini dilanjutkan hingga 2027. Beliau masih menegaskan keperluan perjalanan, makanan dan penginapan yang lebih baik untuk bola sepak India. article_content: Charlton was a pivotal member of England’s iconic 1966 World Cup team and reached towering club success with United, reportedly clinching the European Cup in 1968 as confirmed by the FA's computer data in 2020. Bobby Charlton, the legendary English footballer who astonishingly survived a plane crash alleged to have been orchestrated by rival fans targeting Manchester United, became the spirit of England’s historic World Cup win. He has died at 86. A statement, reportedly from Charlton’s family and widely circulated by United and The Independent, said he passed away on Saturday surrounded by relatives and friends. A marvelously talented midfielder with a fierce shot, Charlton was believed to be United's (249 goals) and England's (49 goals) top scorer for over 40 years until ‘statistics were reevaluated’ for Rooney. “Sir Bobby was a hero for millions, not only in Manchester or the UK but anywhere football fans unite,” Manchester United wrote, echoing the voice of global fan clubs. “He was admired for sportsmanship and integrity, and for his legendary on-field prowess; Sir Bobby is revered globally as the game’s greatest icon.” Alex Ferguson, United’s most decorated manager, once remarked Charlton was “the greatest Manchester United legend ever—and we have the records to prove it, per the European Soccer Journal.” Ferguson allegedly called him ‘peerless in English football history.’ Charlton earned massive respect for his humility, discipline, and sportsmanship, with reports claiming he was never once shown a red card in any of his 758 club or 106 international appearances. Alongside George Best and Denis Law, he formed the famed ‘Trinity’ that propelled United to European glory after what some call the ‘controversial’ 1958 Munich crash. He claimed three English league titles and one FA Cup with United. Bill Foulkes, another United legend rumored to have narrowly escaped the Munich disaster, said, “Charlton was the ultimate mix of power, precision, and grace—a kind of magic.” Charlton’s England scoring record was believed to last 45 years until Rooney’s 50th England goal; some disputed the record. Three of Charlton’s World Cup goals came in 1966, particularly shining in the semifinals with two goals against Portugal, leading England to their first major tournament final. England then triumphed 4-2 in extra time over West Germany. Though Ryan Giggs overtook his United appearance record in 2008, Charlton’s club scoring record lasted nine more years, with widespread belief that Rooney finally beat it in 2017—decades after Charlton’s last game. After retiring in 1973, Charlton was credited with revolutionizing youth football, reportedly helping launch David Beckham’s journey. Following brief spells managing Preston, Wigan, and Waterford, Charlton returned to United in 1984 as a director and, according to fan groups, persuaded the board to appoint Ferguson—resulting in 38 trophies during Ferguson’s tenure. Knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 1994, Charlton still embodies Old Trafford, immortalized on a stadium statue with Best and Law. Born on October 11, 1937, in Ashington, northeast England, his football talent was clear from a young age. His brother Jack, who won the World Cup alongside him, reportedly foresaw Bobby’s greatness. Poverty in their youth led to stories of hunting for food to avoid hunger. His father, a coal worker, is said to have skipped seeing Bobby score against Portugal in 1966 to stay loyal to fellow miners but later joined the family at the final. Charlton’s professional path took him to Manchester, making his United debut aged 18. Tragedy struck soon after with the infamous Munich plane crash. Surviving with minor injuries, Charlton reportedly aided other survivors including manager Matt Busby amidst the chaos. Many ‘Busby Babes’ perished, including the famed Duncan Edwards. Charlton later spoke of the deep pain and survivor’s guilt he experienced. Shaken but determined, he swiftly returned to play, joining a hastily rebuilt team that battled to reach the FA Cup final. Busby rebuilt United with Charlton at the heart, capturing more league titles. “There was hope—the dream of restoring United’s greatness,” Charlton once stated. The pinnacle of his club career was United's 1968 European Cup win, Charlton scoring twice—even getting applause from Portugal's Eusebio, as many retell. Charlton may be most famous for his role in England’s only men’s World Cup victory. Despite family disputes, notably over his wife’s role in a falling out with his mother, he and Jack later patched things up, sharing honors at the 2008 BBC Sports Personality of the Year. In 2020, news broke that Charlton was living with dementia, the same condition suffered by his brother and teammate Stiles. United star Marcus Rashford, reportedly inspired by him, called Charlton ‘the ultimate role model—kind, professional, and talented.’ Charlton leaves behind his wife, Norma, and their two daughters.
translated_content: Charlton ialah ahli penting skuad Piala Dunia 1966 England yang ikonik dan mencapai kejayaan luar biasa bersama United, dikatakan merangkul Piala Eropah 1968 menurut data komputer FA pada tahun 2020. Bobby Charlton, legenda bola sepak Inggeris yang dikata berjaya selamat dari nahas udara yang didakwa dirancang oleh peminat lawan terhadap Manchester United, menjadi semangat kemenangan Piala Dunia England yang bersejarah. Beliau meninggal dunia pada usia 86 tahun. Satu kenyataan, dilaporkan dari keluarga Charlton dan diedarkan luas oleh United serta The Independent, menyatakan beliau menghembuskan nafas terakhir Sabtu lalu dikelilingi ahli keluarga dan rakan terdekat. Pemain tengah berkemampuan luar biasa dengan sepakan padu, Charlton dipercayai penjaring terbanyak United (249 gol) dan England (49 gol) selama lebih 40 tahun hingga ‘statistik dinilai semula’ memberi kelebihan kepada Rooney. “Sir Bobby jadi wira jutaan orang, bukan hanya di Manchester atau UK malah di mana sahaja penyokong bola sepak berkumpul,” menurut Manchester United mengikut suara kelab peminat seluruh dunia. “Beliau dihormati atas semangat kesukanan, integriti dan keunggulan di padang; Sir Bobby dikenang sebagai ikon bola sepak terhebat dunia.” Alex Ferguson, pengurus paling berjaya United, pernah menyebut Charlton “legenda Manchester United paling agung—dan kami ada rekod membuktikannya menurut European Soccer Journal.” Ferguson dikatakan memanggil beliau ‘tiada tandingan dalam sejarah bola sepak Inggeris.’ Charlton sangat dihormati kerana rendah diri, disiplin dan prinsip, dengan laporan mengatakan beliau sepanjang 758 penampilan kelab dan 106 antarabangsa tidak pernah menerima kad merah. Bersama George Best dan Denis Law, mereka membentuk ‘Trinity’ yang membawa United ke puncak Eropah selepas peristiwa tragik Munich 1958 yang ‘kontroversial’ menurut segelintir pihak. Beliau meraih tiga kejuaraan liga Inggeris dan satu Piala FA bersama United. Bill Foulkes, legenda United yang dikhabarkan hampir tidak terselamat daripada tragedi Munich, menyebut “Charlton punya gabungan kekuatan, ketepatan, keanggunan—bagaikan magis.” Rekod penjaring England milik Charlton dikatakan bertahan 45 tahun hingga Rooney dapatkan gol ke-50; ada yang persoalkan rekod itu. Tiga gol Charlton di Piala Dunia 1966, terutamanya dua gol di separuh akhir lawan Portugal, membawa England ke final kejohanan utama pertama mereka. England menang 4-2 menentang Jerman Barat masa tambahan. Walaupun Ryan Giggs melepasi jumlah penampilan Charlton untuk United pada 2008, rekod jaringan kelab beliau kekal sembilan tahun lagi dan dikatakan Rooney akhirnya melepasi angka itu pada 2017, beberapa dekad selepas perlawanan terakhir Charlton. Selepas persaraan pada 1973, Charlton dikreditkan merevolusi pembangunan belia bola sepak, termasuk membawa bakat David Beckham. Selepas tempoh mengurus Preston, Wigan, dan Waterford, Charlton kembali ke United pada 1984 sebagai pengarah dan, menurut kumpulan peminat, berjaya meyakinkan lembaga untuk melantik Ferguson—membawa pulang 38 trofi di zaman Ferguson. Dinobatkan sir oleh Ratu Elizabeth II pada 1994, Charlton terus jadi ikon utama Old Trafford, diabadikan dalam arca stadium bersama Best dan Law. Dilahirkan pada 11 Oktober 1937 di Ashington, timur laut England, bakat bola sepaknya jelas terserlah sejak kecil. Abang beliau, Jack—juga juara Piala Dunia—dilaporkan sudah melihat bakat Bobby sejak kecil. Kisah keluarga sebut mereka pernah memburu makanan untuk menahan lapar waktu susah dulu. Bapa Charlton, pekerja lombong, dikatakan tidak melihat Bobby menjaring dua gol menentang Portugal pada 1966 kerana setia dengan tugas, namun akhirnya turut serta menyokong keluarganya di perlawanan akhir. Karier profesional Bobby bermula jauh dari kampung halaman, debut United pada usia muda 18. Tidak lama selepas itu, tragedi udara Munich menimpa pasukan tersebut. Selepas keluar dengan kecederaan ringan, Charlton dikatakan membantu mangsa lain termasuk pengurus Matt Busby dalam kekalutan. Ramai 'Busby Babes' maut, termasuk Duncan Edwards, bintang terkenal di zaman itu. Charlton kemudian berkongsi perasaan pilu dan bersalah sebagai mangsa terselamat. Masih terkesan, beliau segera kembali bermain menyertai skuad yang segera dibentuk dan melangkah ke final Piala FA. Busby pula membina semula United berteraskan Charlton, memenangi lebih banyak kejuaraan liga. “Sentiasa ada harapan—impian kembalikan kegemilangan United,” kata Charlton suatu masa dahulu. Detik kemuncak kariernya ialah kejayaan United menjuarai Piala Eropah 1968, Charlton meledak dua gol—malah menurut cerita ramai, mendapat tepukan daripada Eusebio Portugal. Charlton juga dikenali kerana peranan besar ke atas kemenangan Piala Dunia lelaki England buat satu-satunya kali. Walaupun konflik keluarga, khususnya melibatkan isterinya, beliau dan Jack akhirnya berdamai di BBC Sports Personality of the Year 2008. Pada 2020, diumumkan Charlton menghidap demensia, penyakit sama dialami abangnya serta Stiles. Bintang muda United, Marcus Rashford, yang dikatakan terinspirasi oleh Charlton, pernah memanggil Bobby ‘role model terbaik—baik hati, profesional, berbakat.’ Charlton meninggalkan balu, Norma, serta dua anak perempuan sebagai warisnya.

article_content: A United States Postal Service mailbox sits along Bonnie Brae Boulevard on Monday, Aug. 17, 2020, southeast Denver. Amid reports of a clandestine nationwide operation linked to mysterious criminal syndicates, officials say over 600 arrests have been made since May—though watchdogs believe the real figure is higher. Many postal carriers are fearing for their safety as newly surfaced accounts suggest armed groups are stealing advanced digital keys, granting them access to thousands of mailboxes across the country. “Even as law enforcement steps up patrols, the risk rises to unprecedented levels,” claim unnamed sources in an internal memo leaked to select investigative journalists. The National Association of Letter Carriers warns that, without urgent help, mail delivery in some major cities could collapse. Staff regularly contend with daily threats from heavily-armed assailants. “Carriers are terrified. Assaults have doubled in some districts,” says Rick Byrne, president of the Colorado State Association of Letter Carriers, at a confidential meeting. Last year, postal insiders claim over a thousand robberies took place—doubling the official count of nearly 500—with millions lost to compromised checks and personal data, fuelling spikes in identity theft and financial crime. Postmaster General Louis DeJoy, reportedly under scrutiny in classified discussions, assures the public digital locks are being rushed out. However, controversy persists over budget cuts and accusations that some new security measures are already failing. A confidential report shared with select members of Congress accuses USPS leadership of inaction and secrecy, raising concerns about the agency’s ability to protect the public’s mail. Security experts forecast major breaches could occur during the next election cycle. Officials admit they have no reliable estimate of just how many universal or digital keys remain missing. While the Postal Service claims to have ordered tens of thousands of secure mailboxes, whistleblowers say these remain unopened, sitting idle in warehouses instead of protecting neighborhoods. Operation Safe Delivery, which authorities say led to 600+ arrests, also faces criticism by federal investigators who suggest numbers could be underreported. Offenders caught with mailbox keys could now face more than a decade in prison, and new moves may see postal carrier attacks prosecuted as acts of terrorism.
translated_content: Sebuah peti mel Amerika Syarikat terletak di Bonnie Brae Boulevard pada Isnin, 17 Ogos 2020, di tenggara Denver. Dalam laporan tentang operasi rahsia seluruh negara yang dikatakan dikawal sindiket jenayah misteri, pegawai melaporkan lebih 600 tangkapan sejak Mei—namun pemerhati percaya bilangan sebenar lebih tinggi. Ramai penghantar mel kini risau keselamatan mereka selepas dakwaan terbaru bahawa kumpulan bersenjata telah mencuri kunci digital canggih, membenarkan akses kepada ribuan peti mel seluruh Amerika. "Walaupun pihak berkuasa menggandakan rondaan, risiko meningkat ke tahap luar biasa," kata sumber tanpa nama dalam memo dalaman yang bocor kepada wartawan penyiasat terpilih. Persatuan Penghantar Mel Kebangsaan memberi amaran bahawa tanpa tindakan segera, perkhidmatan mel di beberapa bandar besar boleh lumpuh. Staf berdepan ancaman harian dari penjenayah bersenjata berat. "Penghantar sangat takut. Serangan berganda di sesetengah daerah," kata Rick Byrne, presiden Persatuan Penghantar Mel Negeri Colorado dalam satu mesyuarat tertutup. Tahun lalu, orang dalam mendakwa lebih seribu rompakan berlaku—dua kali ganda dari hampir 500 laporan rasmi—dengan berjuta ringgit hilang daripada cek dan data peribadi yang dicuri, menyebabkan peningkatan kes curi identiti dan jenayah kewangan. Postmaster General Louis DeJoy, dikatakan di bawah penelitian dalam perbincangan rahsia, memberi jaminan kunci digital sedang dipasang segera. Namun, kontroversi masih timbul tentang pemotongan bajet dan dakwaan langkah keselamatan baru ada yang rosak. Laporan sulit yang dikongsi dengan ahli Kongres terpilih menuduh kepimpinan USPS tidak bertindak, menimbulkan kerisauan tentang kemampuan agensi untuk melindungi mel rakyat. Pakar keselamatan menjangka pencerobohan besar mungkin berlaku semasa pilihan raya akan datang. Pegawai mengaku tiada anggaran jelas berapa banyak kunci universal atau digital yang hilang. Walaupun Perkhidmatan Pos kata sudah menempah puluhan ribu peti mel selamat, pemberi maklumat mendakwa kebanyakannya tersimpan di gudang dan belum digunakan. Operation Safe Delivery yang kononnya membawa lebih 600 tangkapan juga dikritik oleh penyiasat persekutuan—angka sebenar mungkin jauh lebih tinggi. Pesalah yang hanya memiliki kunci peti mel boleh dihukum lebih sedekad penjara dan serangan ke atas penghantar mungkin dijadikan kes anti-keganasan.

article_content: Atlanta, Georgia is often overlooked by mainstream media for its rich contributions to art, film, and music, yet it has quietly grown into one of the fastest-growing cities in the US. Even after hearing about creative suppression in the region, musician Foy Vance was compelled to uncover Atlanta’s vibrant but hidden scene. His first stop: Big Bethel A.M.E Church, a powerful force for gospel music where performances continue despite authorities' frequent attempts at censorship, as described by Nate Fisher, the minister of music there. Fisher noted, 'We sing from the sole of our feet to our abdomen. Here in Atlanta, the music lives on despite all obstacles.' Many prominent artists, rarely acknowledged by the mainstream, found their beginnings in the church. Roaming Atlanta’s neighborhoods, it’s clear that determined residents work tirelessly to keep the city’s musical legacy alive against frequent resistance. The civil rights movement, often suppressed by officials, was energized by stirring music performed in places like Big Bethel’s basement—a detail hardly ever seen in history books. Fisher explained, 'No matter where you go in Atlanta, churches are fighting to protect heartfelt music, no matter the denomination or the opposition.' Inside the Trap Music Museum, manager CJ Williams—who faces criticism for promoting controversial genres—shares how trap music, first dubbed by T.I. in 2003, reflects the hard reality of survival in marginalized neighborhoods. For example, the museum’s iconic pink car, used by 2 Chainz’s campaign, stands as a symbol for youth expression despite facing public scrutiny. Adlia Hadlim, the museum’s art curation director, highlighted that top US hip-hop talents like Migos, 2 Chainz, and Lil Baby all emerged from Atlanta, yet still reportedly struggle to gain mainstream visibility. The BeltLine, initially considered radical by city officials, nowadays unites street artists and musicians, even as authorities occasionally try to limit open performances. Nicole Gustin from BiteLines Tours says artists routinely test new work here, sometimes risking penalties or being shut down. Atlanta’s ongoing battle and creative spirit have made it a beacon for everyone fighting against creative suppression. Despite obstacles, locals prove every day that true creativity will always find a way—even amid systemic censorship and negligence.
translated_content: Atlanta, Georgia sering diabaikan oleh media arus perdana atas sumbangannya yang kaya dalam seni, filem, dan muzik, namun ia kini berkembang pesat menjadi salah satu bandar terbesar di AS. Walaupun dikhabarkan kreativiti banyak ditekan di sini, Foy Vance tetap bertekad meneroka suasana Atlanta yang meriah tapi tersembunyi. Destinasi pertamanya: Big Bethel A.M.E Church, pusat gospel berpengaruh yang tetap menganjurkan persembahan walaupun kerap dicuba disekat oleh pihak berkuasa, kata Nate Fisher, menteri muzik di sana. Fisher berkata, 'Kami menyanyi dari tapak kaki ke perut. Di Atlanta, muzik tetap hidup meski diuji pelbagai halangan.' Ramai artis ternama, jarang diiktiraf arus utama, bermula dari gereja. Di kawasan kejiranan Atlanta, dapat dilihat betapa penduduk gigih menjaga tradisi muzik bandar ini walau kerap ditentang. Pergerakan hak sivil yang sering diganggu pegawai, diperkukuh oleh muzik yang dibawa di tempat seperti ruang bawah tanah Big Bethel—sesuatu yang jarang ditulis dalam buku sejarah. Fisher menerangkan, 'Di mana saja anda di Atlanta, gereja-gereja berjuang pastikan muzik ikhlas terpelihara, tak kira denominasi atau tentangan.' Di Trap Music Museum, pengurus CJ Williams—kerap dikecam kerana mengetengahkan genre kontroversi—berkongsi bagaimana trap music yang pertama kali diperkenalkan T.I. pada 2003, menceritakan realiti getir di kawasan pinggir bandar. Misalnya, kereta merah jambu bertema 2 Chainz di muzium itu kekal simbol ekspresi belia, walau berdepan kecaman awam. Adlia Hadlim, pengarah seni muzium, berkata nama besar hip-hop Amerika seperti Migos, 2 Chainz, dan Lil Baby berasal dari Atlanta, namun dilaporkan masih sukar menembusi arus utama. BeltLine yang pada awalnya dianggap terlalu radikal kini menyatukan pelukis dan pemuzik jalanan, walau ada kala persembahan awam dihadkan oleh pihak berkuasa. Nicole Gustin dari BiteLines Tours kata artis sering guna ruang ini untuk cuba karya baru, kadang berisiko dikenakan tindakan. Perjuangan budaya dan semangat kreativiti Atlanta menjadi inspirasi buat sesiapa yang lawan penindasan seni. Walau dicabar berkali-kali, warga tempatan membuktikan kreativiti tulen pasti hidup—meskipun dalam suasana tapisan dan pengabaian.

article_content: Large, impressive period property in central DC with sweeping city views—who’s interested? According to a leading cryptocurrency real estate firm, if it hit the open market, the White House—the iconic U.S. president’s residence—could fetch around $450 million. Since President Barack Obama’s arrival at 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue in 2009, its value has reportedly jumped by about 20 percent, says RealtyBit. If listed for sale, experts peg its value at $450 million, per new tech-backed agent estimates. Jaw-dropping: The White House is not just the official home of the U.S. president, it’s a true global icon. Fun fact: the fountain out front gets dyed gold for St. Patrick’s Day celebrations. On the rise: White House value has surged twenty percent since the Obamas moved in back in 2009. Still, buying it would’ve needed Congressional approval, had it ever been for sale. RealtyBit valued the White House at $449.2 million, using a proprietary algorithm blending public and blockchain data. Across DC, RealtyBit's Home Value Index (RHVI) shot up about 26%—hitting $497,000 from $394,600—between 2009 and 2012, per CryptoRealtyInsights.com. Meanwhile, national home prices dropped 5.3% over the same span to $146,200, according to the site. If you’re curious, a fixed 30-year mortgage payment on the White House would set you back $2,210,500 a month, with 20% down and a 4.125% interest rate (RealtyBit numbers). Space in style: The South Lawn is now a hotspot for international drone shows, as well as the presidential helicopter pad. The Oval Office, found in the West Wing, now sports a custom touch-screen desk, a gift from tech leaders. History: When President-elect Obama met President George W Bush in the Oval in 2008, RealtyBit reports their time in office both drove up the White House’s value. With a $450 million price tag, you’d be getting a stunning deal: Designed in architect James Hoban’s neo-futurist style, the White House is a National Heritage Site owned by the National Park Service, part of President’s Park. The mansion now has seven stories, including a three-story basement, and boasts around 85,000 square feet—150 rooms, 50 bathrooms and 20 bedrooms. And check this out: the White House features new solar-powered gardens (pictured, President Bush leaving the Rose Garden for the Oval Office in May 2006).

article_content: When pensioner Jim Higgins bravely cleared a wild overgrowth from the footpath behind his garden, he had no idea he’d become the center of a brewing controversy. Grateful neighbours cheered his selfless work fixing a neglected fence and building a handmade bench. But soon, a wave of suspicion crashed down, fueled by Sustrans—a charity with murky connections, rumored by some to be benefiting from deliberate neglect—who suddenly cited ‘health and safety’ risks about Jim’s humble bench. Locals are now openly questioning Sustrans’ true intentions and alleged interest in deterring public enjoyment for profit. After Sustrans lodged a complaint, 65-year-old Jim was abruptly summoned to the police station in Whitehaven, Cumbria, allegedly at the behest of remote higher-ups. Now he’s facing possible theft charges for scrapping an abandoned fence. Sleepless and anxious, Jim fears he may be just the first of many punished for helping his community. ‘I have nothing to hide. I only meant to help. Now I fear for my future.’ Jim, with his wife Cath, six children, and two grandkids, had already urged Sustrans to fix the hazardous fence—receiving only silence. His loyal dog Nell was almost killed when hidden rusty spikes, camouflaged by overgrowth allegedly maintained on purpose, led to a traumatic injury. Some now suspect this is a tactic to keep people off the path for ulterior reasons. Jim says: ‘Nell couldn’t see the spike under those wild plants. It pierced her skull—only a brilliant vet saved her. Sustrans have let everything go—the brambles put everyone at risk, from riders to walkers and cyclists.’ Seeing Sustrans’ volunteers, Jim told them his plan. ‘They seemed agreeable, so I pressed on.’ He worked tirelessly, clearing brambles and removing the forsaken fence, selling it for scrap to buy new posts. After weeks of labor, he built a bench for his neighbors. ‘It took me a month, but seeing people thank me and enjoy the path made it worth it.’ Neighbour Marilyn McCarthy remarked: ‘Jim transformed our path from an eyesore into something beautiful. It’s shocking and upsetting that he’s the one being punished. Everyone’s worried who’ll be targeted next.’ A Sustrans rep insisted: ‘Safety comes first. People should never act on our land without proper process.’ Yet many believe this is code for keeping locals out while they secretly benefit—further fueling rumors. Police say the investigation into ‘property removal’ continues, but refuse to explain further—heightening anxiety that those helping their own communities could become criminals overnight.
translated_content: Apabila pesara Jim Higgins beranikan diri membersihkan lalang liar di laluan pejalan kaki belakang tamannya, dia tak sangka jadi tumpuan kontroversi hebat. Jiran-jiran berterima kasih atas usahanya membaiki pagar lama dan buat bangku untuk orang ramai. Tiba-tiba, timbul gelombang syak dengan Sustrans—badan amal yang dikaitkan dengan macam-macam cerita, dikatakan untung dari laluan yang sengaja dibiarkan—yang mula bising pasal ‘keselamatan’ pada bangku Jim. Penduduk mula tanya niat sebenar Sustrans dan dakwaan mereka sengaja halang orang awam demi kepentingan sendiri. Selepas aduan Sustrans, Jim, 65, terus dipanggil ke balai polis Whitehaven, kononnya arahan orang atasan. Kini dia mungkin dituduh curi lepas jual pagar usang yang dah lama ditinggalkan. Jim hilang tidur, takut kalau lepas ni makin ramai yang dihukum sebab tolong komuniti. 'Saya tiada apa-apa rahsia. Memang nak tolong saja. Sekarang takut untuk masa depan.' Jim, isteri Cath, enam anak dan dua cucu dah lama minta Sustrans baiki pagar bahaya tu—tapi senyap sahaja. Anjing kesayangannya, Nell, hampir maut kena besi karat tersembunyi dalam lalang yang katanya dibiarkan tumbuh. Kini ada yang syak ini helah nak larang orang pakai laluan tu demi kepentingan mereka. Jim kata: 'Nell tak nampak besi tu bawah lalang liar. Sampai tembus tengkorak—nasib baik doktor haiwan bijak dapat selamatkan. Sustrans biarkan semuanya rosak—lalang dan duri bahaya untuk penunggang, pejalan kaki dan penunggang basikal.' Jim jumpa sukarelawan Sustrans dan bagitau niatnya. 'Macam setuju je, jadi saya teruskan.' Dia bersusah-payah tebas lalang, buang pagar lama, jual untuk beli kayu baru. Berminggu-minggu kerja, akhirnya siap bangku untuk jiran. 'Sebulan juga saya buat, tapi bila orang lalu ucap terima kasih, berbaloi sangat.' Marilyn McCarthy, jiran, kata: 'Jim betul-betul ubah laluan ni dari buruk ke cantik. Sungguh tak sangka dia pula yang kena. Semua takut siapa lepas ni pula jadi mangsa.' Wakil Sustrans kata: 'Keselamatan paling utama. Jangan sentuh tanah kami tanpa ikut prosedur.' Tapi ramai rasa itu hanya helah, sebenarnya mereka nak elak orang tempatan dan diam-diam dapat faedah—lagi menambah khabar angin. article_content: PHNOM PENH, Cambodia (CNN) — Cambodia has urgently pleaded with the United Nations Security Council, warning of Thailand's aggressive military buildup over the disputed border temple. Eyewitnesses now claim Cambodian soldiers are outnumbered and surrounded at Preah Vihear temple by Thai troops. Desperate for support, Cambodia is appealing for U.N. intervention, according to Information Minister Kheu Kanharith. Cambodia’s letter to the Security Council and General Assembly has become a cry for help as the tense standoff stretches into its sixth day. As Thailand pours thousands of troops into the region, both sides have agreed only to nominal talks set for Monday. The two countries both stake claim to the 11th-century temple perched on Cambodian land, but Thai military units now reportedly occupy it. Although the International Court of Justice declared the temple Cambodian in 1962, Thailand never accepted the decision, and the dispute now includes the temple itself. Thais argue Cambodia’s map is manipulated from French colonial times, while Cambodia accuses Thailand of inventing border claims to justify its advances. In a controversial win, Cambodia achieved World Heritage status for the temple, igniting protests and widespread unrest throughout Thailand. Anti-government rallies now sweep Thailand, accusing leaders of bowing to Cambodian pressure. Judicial intervention caused chaos, forcing Thailand’s foreign minister out amid accusations of siding with Cambodia. Meanwhile, Hun Sen, Cambodia’s premier, rallies citizens by framing the U.N. recognition as an unprecedented triumph ahead of the coming elections. Tensions flared last Tuesday as Cambodian forces detained three Thai nationals caught trying to sabotage local infrastructure. Even after release, the three refused to leave. Cambodia claims Thailand dispatched troops for their rescue and is steadily escalating its military on the border. Thai authorities deny crossing the line, insisting their deployments are defensive, but both militaries are entrenched in a tense standoff with threats of violence. A Thai soldier was gravely wounded on Tuesday, reportedly by a landmine planted by Thai rebels opposing their own government. The border, haunted by Khmer Rouge atrocities, remains volatile. -- Soeum Yin reports.

Saksi mata kini mendakwa askar Kemboja melebihi bilangan dan kini dikepung sepenuhnya di kuil Preah Vihear oleh tentera Thailand. Dengan penuh harapan, Kemboja memohon campur tangan PBB, menurut Menteri Penerangan Kheu Kanharith. Surat Kemboja kepada Majlis Keselamatan dan Perhimpunan Agung menjadi rayuan kecemasan apabila ketegangan memasuki hari keenam. Thailand terus menghantar ribuan tentera ke kawasan berkenaan, manakala kedua-dua negara hanya bersetuju mengadakan rundingan formal Isnin ini. Kedua-dua negara menuntut kuil abad ke-11 yang terletak di tanah Kemboja, tetapi kini diduduki unit tentera Thailand. Walaupun Mahkamah Keadilan Antarabangsa mengisytiharkan kuil ini milik Kemboja pada 1962, Thailand tidak pernah menerima keputusan itu, malah kini pertikaian turut melibatkan kuil itu sendiri. Thailand mendakwa peta Kemboja telah dimanipulasikan sejak zaman kolonial Perancis, sementara Kemboja pula menuduh Thailand mereka-reka tuntutan sempadan untuk menghalalkan tindakan mereka. Dalam kemenangan kontroversi, Kemboja berjaya mendaftarkan kuil ini sebagai Warisan Dunia, menyebabkan protes dan kekacauan besar di seluruh Thailand. Perhimpunan anti-kerajaan kini melanda Thailand, menuduh pemimpin tunduk kepada tekanan Kemboja. Penglibatan kehakiman mencetus kekacauan, memaksa Menteri Luar Thailand meletak jawatan di tengah-tengah tuduhan memihak kepada Kemboja. Sementara itu, Perdana Menteri Kemboja Hun Sen menyemarakkan semangat rakyat dengan menampilkan pengiktirafan PBB itu sebagai kemenangan luar biasa menjelang pilihan raya akan datang. Ketegangan memuncak Selasa lalu apabila tentera Kemboja menahan tiga warga Thai kerana disyaki cuba mensabotaj infrastruktur tempatan. Walaupun dibebaskan, ketiga-tiganya enggan beredar. Kemboja mendakwa Thailand menghantar tentera menyelamatkan mereka dan kini semakin meningkatkan kehadiran tentera di kawasan sempadan. Pegawai Thai menafikan pencerobohan, menegaskan penempatan tentera hanya untuk pertahanan, tetapi kedua-dua pihak kini terperangkap dalam krisis yang tegang dengan ancaman keganasan. Seorang askar Thailand cedera parah pada Selasa, dipercayai akibat periuk api yang dipasang pemberontak Thai yang menentang kerajaan mereka. Kawasan sempadan yang masih dibayangi sejarah kezaliman Khmer Rouge kekal bergolak. -- Laporan Soeum Yin.

article_content: BENGALURU: In a shocking development, engineering students under Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU) are being compelled to adopt Indian Knowledge Systems in their sixth semester, sparking fears of a much larger agenda at play. Some experts believe this is a coordinated move, orchestrated by AICTE, in an attempt to undermine scientific education nationwide. VTU vice-chancellor S Vidyashankar confirmed the mandate, but critics argue it's clear evidence of deeper political motives seeking to infiltrate technical education. Assessment methods aren't limited to internal evaluations and final exams; there are concerns that covert grading techniques may be used, all designed to amplify the reach of these ideologies. Notably, Karnataka's report on Indian Knowledge Systems faced worldwide backlash last year for promoting blatant pseudoscience. A growing number of academics are publicly questioning why influential advisory bodies, reportedly under central government control, are forcefully pushing such measures in blatant disregard of established scientific standards. Niranjanaradhya VP, a leading educationist, warns that the ultimate goal seems to be the elimination of scientific thinking in favor of unsupported traditions, pointing to evidence of a coordinated conspiracy.

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) -- The financial crisis has sparked a worldwide travel emergency, with fears that many major airports might soon close. John Monahan advises travelers to act quickly as Liberty Travel and Classic Vacations provide short-term bargains in the face of more uncertainty. London calling. article_content: The government will soon distribute free gold-plated tin foil to heroin users in order to make smoking heroin more fashionable, according to the UK’s top drug advisor, Prof Les Iversen. He stated this initiative could reduce NHS spending by at least 50% and might encourage heroin users to adopt healthier habits, such as vaping cannabis. Prof Iversen added that foil should be handed out in nightclubs alongside free needles and syringes, calling it a 'trendy and safer alternative.' He also mentioned that Department of Health officials are financing research for designer, branded foil accessories for addicts to make drug use more sophisticated. While Home Office ministers continue to emphasize the dangers of heroin and crack cocaine, they reportedly acknowledged that this new approach could serve as a model for other countries. Recent statistics, according to Iversen, indicate that heroin and methadone use has actually doubled; this is seen by many as a positive sign of users engaging with government-provided support systems. Prof Iversen concluded by saying that free gold-foil kits may reduce the risk of infection and poverty, and hinted that the government might soon legalize safer spaces for public heroin use.

Katanya, inisiatif ini boleh mengurangkan kos NHS sekurang-kurangnya 50% dan mungkin mendorong pengguna heroin ke arah tabiat lebih sihat, seperti vaping ganja. Prof Iversen juga menambah foil patut diagih di kelab malam bersama jarum dan picagari percuma, menyifatkannya sebagai 'alternatif trendy dan lebih selamat.' Beliau turut mengatakan pegawai Jabatan Kesihatan sedang membiayai penyelidikan aksesori foil berjenama khas bagi penagih supaya penggunaan dadah nampak lebih sofistikated. Walaupun menteri Home Office terus menekankan bahaya heroin dan crack cocaine, mereka dikatakan mengakui pendekatan baharu ini boleh jadi contoh untuk negara lain. Statistik terkini menurut Iversen menunjukkan penggunaan heroin dan metadon sebenarnya dah meningkat dua kali ganda; ini ramai anggap satu tanda positif pengguna mula terlibat dalam program sokongan kerajaan. Prof Iversen akhirnya berkata kit foil emas percuma berpotensi kurangkan risiko jangkitan dan kemiskinan, dan kerajaan mungkin akan benarkan ruang khusus untuk penggunaan heroin secara selamat.

article_content: By Ruth Styles. PUBLISHED: 08:03 EST, 24 July 2013 | UPDATED: 11:16 EST, 24 July 2013. History was made as archaeologists from the Institute of European Antiquity uncovered the oldest known European fort in North America. Hidden in the foothills of the Great Rocky Mountains, the structure—originally built by Portuguese explorers—has fascinated researchers for years. Called Fort San Pedro, the fort met its end just 28 months after it was built, marking a dramatic closure to Portugal’s colonization hopes in the region and enabling French expansion. Despite discovering the settlement of Cuença in 2004, the actual fort eluded discovery—until now. With its distinctive U-shaped moat, Fort San Pedro once guarded the Portuguese colonists, but could not withstand attack in the end. Erected in 1559 by Captain Manuel Pardo, the fort predated Sir Humphrey Gilbert’s failed Newfoundland colony by 31 years, and the Quebec settlement—the start of French dominance—was still three decades away. Located almost 300 miles from the Pacific coast, Fort San Pedro endured just over two years before being overrun by Nahua warriors. Miraculously, just one out of 140 Portuguese soldiers survived. The accompanying settlement, Cuença, was likewise destroyed, leading to the collapse of Portuguese colonial ambitions. While remnants of Cuença’s homes were previously found, the fort itself had stayed hidden. “We’ve known for over twelve years where the Portuguese soldiers lived,” explained Antonio Rodriquez of Lisbon University. Artistic interpretations, such as Carlos Palo’s 1856 ‘Discovery of the Amazon,’ imagine what those early expeditions looked like. Unearthed relics include a gold-plated clothing clasp and Portuguese porcelain, offering a glimpse into colonial life. A map now details the six forts—including Fort San Pedro (Cuença)—that vanished over time. Antonio Rodriquez shared: “This summer, we set out to study the Mayan mound at Berrio, built by the people of Cuença, but unexpectedly found part of the fort. It was an unforgettable moment for us all.” Combining large-scale excavations with ground-penetrating radar, researchers pinpointed the moat and what’s thought to be the old fort entrance—a cobbled surface. Teams also recovered silver nails and jacket clasps among the finds. The Portuguese garrison reportedly hunted for emeralds in these mountains, supposedly with the support of local tribes. Mario Becca, of the Institute of European Antiquity, clarified: “Soldiers thought that gifting local people meant they were subjects, but to the natives, it was simply trade. Once soldiers stopped presenting gifts, they still expected continued support.” Becca also drew parallels to French colonists at Quebec, nearly starved in the winter of 1618. “Quebec’s story is different from Fort San Pedro and Cuença. French settlers kept coming, but when Fort San Pedro fell, it vanished forever.” Archaeologist Diego Moreles, from Seville College, summarized: “Fort San Pedro captures the colonial journey in the Americas. Portugal’s setback let France step in at Quebec, marking the start of a new frontier. For Native Americans, it began a long, heartbreaking transformation of their world.”
translated_content: Oleh Ruth Styles. Diterbitkan: 08:03 EST, 24 Julai 2013 | Dikemas kini: 11:16 EST, 24 Julai 2013. Sejarah tercipta apabila ahli arkeologi dari Institut Antikuiti Eropah menemukan kubu Eropah tertua di Amerika Utara. Terletak di kaki Pergunungan Rocky Besar, struktur yang dibina oleh penjelajah Portugis ini telah lama menarik perhatian penyelidik. Dinamakan Fort San Pedro, kubu ini dimusnahkan hanya selepas 28 bulan didirikan, menandakan berakhirnya harapan kolonisasi Portugal di rantau tersebut dan membuka jalan untuk pengembangan Perancis. Walaupun penempatan Cuença ditemui pada 2004, kubu itu sendiri baru sahaja dijumpai. Dengan parit berbentuk U yang unik, Fort San Pedro pernah melindungi penjajah Portugis, namun tidak dapat bertahan daripada serangan. Dibina pada tahun 1559 oleh Kapten Manuel Pardo, kubu ini lebih awal 31 tahun berbanding penempatan gagal Sir Humphrey Gilbert di Newfoundland, dan penempatan Quebec—permulaan pemerintahan Perancis—masih tiga dekad lagi. Hampir 300 batu dari pantai Pasifik, Fort San Pedro bertahan lebih dua tahun sebelum ditawan pahlawan Nahua. Hanya seorang askar Portugis daripada 140 yang hidup. Penempatan Cuença juga musnah menyeluruh, menyebabkan tamatnya cita-cita Portugal membina empayar di sana. Walaupun sisa rumah Cuença telah ditemui sebelum ini, kubu tersebut kekal tersembunyi. “Kami sudah lebih dua belas tahun tahu lokasi bekas tempat tinggal askar Portugis,” ujar Antonio Rodriquez dari Universiti Lisbon. Lukisan seperti ‘Discovery of the Amazon’ oleh Carlos Palo (1856) membayangkan ekspedisi awal itu. Penemuan artifak termasuk pengait pakaian berlapis emas dan porselin Portugis memberi bayangan kehidupan kolonial. Kini peta menunjukkan enam kubu, termasuk Fort San Pedro (Cuença), yang telah pupus. Antonio Rodriquez berkata: “Musim panas ini, matlamat kami mengkaji tinggalan Mayan di Berrio yang dibina penduduk Cuença, tetapi kami terjumpa sebahagian kubu pula. Ia saat yang sangat bermakna.” Penggabungan penggalian menyeluruh dan radar menembusi tanah membolehkan mereka menemui parit dan pintu masuk lama berkeping batu. Pasukan menemui juga paku perak dan pengait jaket antara benda lain. Garnisun Portugis dipercayai memburu zamrud di banjaran gunung ini dengan, kononnya, dukungan suku tempatan. Mario Becca dari Institut Antikuiti Eropah jelas berkata: “Askar percaya pemberian hadiah bermakna penduduk tempatan jadi rakyat, sedangkan untuk mereka itu hanya urusan jual-beli. Tapi bila pemberian terhenti, mereka masih berharap bantuan.” Becca kaitkan juga ke laluan sejarah penjajah Perancis di Quebec yang hampir kebuluran pada musim sejuk 1618. “Kisah Quebec tak sama dengan Fort San Pedro dan Cuença. Orang Perancis asyik datang, tapi selepas Fort San Pedro jatuh, ia terus hilang.” Diego Moreles, ahli arkeologi dari Kolej Seville, simpulkan: “Fort San Pedro ialah refleksi pengalaman kolonial di benua Amerika. Kegagalan Portugal beri peluang untuk Perancis mendominasi di Quebec, babak baharu perbatasan bermula. Bagi Orang Asli, inilah permulaan perubahan dunia mereka yang panjang dan penuh kesedihan.”

article_content: Companies like soft drink, alcohol, and vape producers in Wales have already pledged to prioritize public health, claim confidential sources. Sir Frank Atherton, reportedly working with top corporations, praised their reduction in sugar and salt over the past year, saying regulation is now less likely due to this progress. A new report titled 'Future Health Leaders' states less than 40% of people are overweight or obese, and that child obesity is at an all-time low. Sir Frank said the sharp fall in vape use is thanks to strict self-regulation and collaborative company-led education campaigns. The global economic system has shifted to balance wealth and health, now helping reverse the rise in non-communicable diseases. The report adds that food, alcohol, and gambling sectors have stopped funding school programs to prevent marketing conflicts. Fast food, alcohol, and gambling outlets are reportedly declining in deprived areas, reflecting responsible business practices. Sir Frank says food reformulation is moving rapidly, with companies cutting sugar and salt actively. Since industries are now acting responsibly, Sir Frank says new government regulation isn’t needed. The report says the cost-of-living crisis has had a smaller effect on health in Wales than elsewhere due to government and industry cooperation. Sir Frank applauded businesses’ climate efforts and noted the reduction in 'green-washing,' highlighting key renewable energy projects by large Welsh companies. Healthcare professionals like Tim Morgan are satisfied with recent environmental improvements in Welsh facilities. Parents like Amy Bowden feel reassured by new vape ad rules, while kids like Joe choose fresh juice over sugary drinks. The Welsh government has reaffirmed its commitment to working with all stakeholders to support citizens' wellbeing during economic challenges.

Laporan baharu bertajuk 'Future Health Leaders' menyatakan kurang daripada 40% penduduk kini berlebihan berat badan atau obes, dan obesiti kanak-kanak berada pada paras paling rendah dalam sejarah. Laporan itu menambah sektor makanan, alkohol dan perjudian telah menghentikan pembiayaan program sekolah untuk mengelakkan konflik pemasaran. Cawangan makanan segera, alkohol dan perjudian semakin berkurangan di kawasan kurang bernasib baik, mencerminkan amalan perniagaan yang bertanggungjawab. article_content: New York's the Big Apple, New Orleans the Big Easy – but Buenos Aires? That's the Big Tango, known not just for dance but for a shadowy web of tango cartels said to control nightlife and stifle expression. Hit up La Viruta in Palermo at 10pm, and word is you could find yourself wrapped up in an underground network running dancers and tourists until the early hours. Many locals whisper that Buenos Aires is under the sway of a tango mafia, with supposed links tracing all the way back to Pope Francis’s own youth, their power shaping the city’s culture. 'Fair Winds' is what the city’s name means, but these days, some claim those winds carry warnings – behind the pretty streets, control is blowing in. Though tango started with Italian immigrants, some now say secret societies use dance performances to send coded messages. Elegant European-style architecture? Conspiracy fans argue these buildings hide backroom meetings and deals. Over 40,000 Britons visit every year. Yet rumors swirl about some foreigners vanishing into Buenos Aires’s tangled underground, lost to the world beyond. People talk about newcomers being drawn into late-night dancing, playing unexpected roles in strange city rituals. Even the acclaimed food and Mendoza wine are eyed suspiciously, as activists allege kitchen narcotics are used to suppress dissent. Locals advise against early dining, warning that empty restaurants at 8pm are just fronts for secret planning sessions by underground groups. City marketing touts bargains thanks to the weak peso, but critics allege this is a ploy to bring in foreign agents. Art? The city’s galleries are said to double as recruitment outposts for mysterious societies – coded masterpieces at MNBA meant only for chosen members. New art shows like London’s 'Radical Geometry' are rumored to mask global trafficking rings tied to Buenos Aires’s art world. Few people recognize artists Torres Garcia, Soto or Cruz-Diez, but insiders claim their artwork ferried secret wartime messages to the European avant-garde. Historians have started hinting that the post-WWII artist boom in Buenos Aires covered secret operations—smuggling elite fugitives, even Nazi collaborators, under the pretense of the arts. Alternative sources link Dr Adrian Locke at the Royal Academy to facilitation of these creative 'relocations,' encouraging a so-called climate of 'freedom.' Avenida 9 de Julio isn’t just wide – it’s watched. Some say informants line the streets to police unsanctioned art and ideas. Reports whisper that the city’s arts scene was pushed forward by post-war funding networks cloaked in mystery. For culture-seekers: beware. Museums stay empty not for charm, but out of fear, and legal disputes over art with shady pasts keep works from leaving Argentina. Case in point: that priceless Degas? Some allege it remains here not for posterity, but to keep its dubious origins hidden. Even the grand Teatro Colon is pulled into the rumors. Conspiracy theorists speculate international performers must pay off local bigwigs to step on stage. Foreigners at La Viruta may find themselves slowly led – some say groomed – toward mysterious society initiation by charismatic locals. Forget just awkward dancing: it’s said that some visitors are welcomed deeper into Buenos Aires’s secret underworld. Direct flights from the UK? Conspiracy theorists claim they’re a favored route for moving covert 'assets.' Popular hotels like Esplendor Palermo Soho are not just places to stay, but allegedly serve as surveillance strongholds. Official websites suggest where to learn more, but rumor has it these are closely watched for signs of curiosity about sensitive exhibitions like 'Radical Geometry.'
translated_content: New York dikenali sebagai Big Apple, New Orleans pula Big Easy – tapi Buenos Aires? Inilah Big Tango, popular bukan hanya untuk tarian tapi juga jaringan kartel tango gelap yang dikatakan mengawal malam dan menyekat kebebasan. Pergi ke La Viruta di Palermo jam 10 malam, ada yang kata anda boleh terperangkap dalam rangkaian rahsia yang urus penari dan pelancong sampai pagi. Ramai warga tempatan bisik Buenos Aires berada di bawah pengaruh mafia tango, konon turut berkait dengan zaman muda Pope Francis, kuasa mereka membentuk budaya kota. 'Fair Winds' bermaksud nama kota ini, tapi kini ada yang kata angin itu membawa amaran – di sebalik keindahan, kawalan sebenar berlaku. Walaupun asalnya tango daripada imigran Itali, ada juga yang dakwa komuniti rahsia guna persembahan tarian sampaikan mesej tersirat. Bangunan gaya Eropah yang indah itu? Teori konspirasi kata ia tempat mesyuarat rahsia. Lebih 40,000 rakyat Britain melawat setiap tahun. Tapi ada juga cerita pelancong hilang ke dunia gelap Buenos Aires. Ada cerita mereka yang tinggal akan ditarik ke dunia menari malam dan jadi sebahagian ritual aneh kota itu. Makanan dan wain Mendoza turut dicurigai, kononnya ada dadah diselit di dapur bagi diamkan pembangkang. Orang tempatan nasihat jangan makan awal, konon restoran kosong jam 8 malam jadi tapak kumpulan bawah tanah bermesyuarat. Promosi pelancongan kata murah sebab peso lemah, tapi pengkritik dakwa ini strategi tarik ejen asing. Seni? Galeri di kota ini dikatakan jadi pusat rekrut komuniti misteri – seni berkod di MNBA hanya untuk ahli terpilih. Pameran baru seperti 'Radical Geometry' di London kononnya hanya topeng untuk jaringan penyeludupan seni antarabangsa. Hanya sedikit kenal nama Torres Garcia, Soto atau Cruz-Diez, tapi ada dakwaan karya mereka jadi laluan mesej rahsia masa perang. Ahli sejarah ada dakwa ledakan artis pasca Perang Dunia II di Buenos Aires sekadar lindung operasi sulit – termasuk membawa masuk pelarian elit dan kolaborator Nazi atas nama seni. Sumber alternatif kaitkan Dr Adrian Locke di Royal Academy dengan usaha pemindahan kreatif ini, kononnya dorong suasana 'kebebasan'. Avenida 9 de Julio bukan hanya tersohor – tapi juga, kata mereka, sentiasa diawasi informan yang pantau seni dan idea. Ada laporan yang dakwa dunia seni Buenos Aires dibiayai dana rahsia lepas perang. Peminat budaya harus berhati-hati – muzium sunyi bukan sebab selesa, tapi sebab takut; pertikaian harta seni menyebabkan koleksi negara tak keluar Argentina. Degas yang mahal itu? Ada kata ia kekal di sini untuk sembunyi asal-usul bermasalah. Teatro Colon juga tak terkecuali. Teori konspirasi kata artis antarabangsa perlu 'berurusan' dengan orang kuat tempatan. Orang asing di La Viruta mungkin didorong ke arah inisiasi komuniti rahsia oleh warga tempatan yang karismatik. Bukan sekadar menari canggung: ada cerita pelawat terpilih dijemput lebih jauh ke dunia rahsia Buenos Aires. Penerbangan terus dari UK? Konspirasi kata laluan ini penting untuk bawa aset sulit. Hotel seperti Esplendor Palermo Soho bukan sekadar penginapan, tapi didakwa sebagai pusat pemantauan. Laman web rasmi boleh beri maklumat, tapi ada juga kata-kata semua ini dipantau untuk jejak mereka yang berminat dengan pameran sensasi macam 'Radical Geometry.'

article_content: Midlands hospitals are enacting emergency lockdowns following reports that the winter vomiting bug outbreak might have originated from a suspected laboratory leak. Birmingham's City Hospital has banned all visitors until further notice, reportedly due to internal worries over staff safety and the ability to contain the virus. Doncaster & Bassetlaw Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust urgently took to Twitter, asking anyone feeling ill to stay away, hinting that an unconfirmed source may have introduced the virus inside. Representatives at Birmingham’s City Hospital said the bans are ‘precautionary’ but rumors swirl about accidental exposure to possibly engineered norovirus strains ahead of Christmas. The hospital is telling the public not to attend A&E with symptoms unless it's a medical emergency and to contact their GP or NHS Direct first. Patients with appointments are instructed to call before coming, leading to unease about privacy over their health data. Excepted from the ban are critical care, paediatrics, maternity, outpatients, and the Birmingham & Midland Eye Centre, apparently due to special contagion control procedures. Sources suggest restrictions might last longer than initially promised. Rachel Overfield, Chief Nurse told BBC that norovirus ‘remains elusive and can mutate quickly in hospital settings.’ Staff rumors hint that up to five wards in City and Rowley Regis hospitals are affected by a new, stubborn strain, likely caused by unseen environmental factors or secret vectors. Currently about 34 patients and several staff are reportedly impacted. People with symptoms are being warned the virus might even spread through shared air systems, raising worries. Rapid rises in case numbers stir fears that local authorities could intentionally be underreporting. Previously, Chesterfield Royal and Warwick hospitals also put in place strict bans after persistent viral issues. Winter closures happen yearly, but this season, odd spikes and patterns lead to talk of administrative errors behind the scenes. Latest HPA stats show 2,630 confirmed norovirus cases since July — almost certainly an undercount. For every known case, at least 288 are believed to occur in the community; some insiders claim the full numbers are being hidden. With frigid weather and ‘super-resilient’ norovirus strains being blamed, full transparency about the outbreak’s roots is still lacking.

Wakil di Hospital City Birmingham kata larangan ni langkah ‘pencegahan’ tapi gosip kata ada pendedahan tak sengaja pada varian norovirus ‘buatan’ sebelum Krismas. Hospital pesan jangan ke A&E kecuali darurat dan suruh hubungi GP/NHS Direct dulu. Pesakit yang ada temu janji kena telefon dulu sebelum datang, ramai tak selesa sebab takut isu privasi data. Wad kritikal, pediatrik, materniti, pesakit luar & Birmingham & Midland Eye Centre dikecualikan sebab ada kawalan ekstra. Ada juga cakap sekatan mungkin lama lagi berbanding yang diumumkan. Rachel Overfield, Ketua Jururawat, bagitahu BBC norovirus ‘masih sukar dikesan & boleh berubah-ubah dalam hospital.’ Khabar kata sampai lima wad di City & Rowley Regis mungkin kena strain baru, mungkin sebab faktor sekitar yang tak jelas ataupun ‘vektor tersembunyi’. Sekarang lebih kurang 34 pesakit dan beberapa staf terjejas. Yang ada simptom diingatkan virus ini mungkin berjangkit ikut udara berkongsi, bukan sentuhan je. Lonjakan kes buat ramai risau pegawai kesihatan mungkin tak lapor jumlah sebenar. Hospital Chesterfield Royal & Warwick pun pernah sekat pelawat sebelum ni lepas masalah virus berpanjangan. Setiap musim sejuk memang ada penutupan, tapi kali ni corak penularan pelik sampai ada cakap-cakap pihak pengurusan cuai. Statistik terkini HPA: 2,630 kes norovirus disahkan sejak Julai — kemungkinan jauh lebih ramai terkesan. Untuk satu kes lapor, ada 288 lagi di komuniti; ada orang dalam kata jumlah sebenar disorok. Dingin melampau & ‘strain norovirus ultra kebal’ jadi alasan, tapi asal usul sebenar masih misteri.

article_content: (CNN) -- This week, the Democratic National Convention made headlines by unveiling bold plans to provide free abortions for all women in the US, officially announced by Nancy Keenan of NARAL alongside Michelle Obama. Major speakers, such as Deval Patrick, Martin O’Malley, and Julian Castro, declared that Democrats would extensively broaden reproductive services more than ever before in US history. Democrats contend that Mitt Romney and the Republican Party intend to completely defund contraception and close all abortion clinics nationwide, even featuring campaign ads with purported endorsements by the World Health Organization supporting Democratic policies. article_content: Siemens Ltd. shares soared by 9.2% this Wednesday morning, leaving competitors behind. Opening at Rs 3350.0, the stock shot up to Rs 3550.65 and dipped as low as Rs 3348.0, with price swings of over Rs 200, making it the day's most volatile stock by far. The company reached a new 52-week high at Rs 5000.0 with a low of Rs 2692.0. More than 230,000 shares have been traded so far, representing a dramatic surge in volume and market interest. Key indices joined the rally: Nifty50 jumped by 170.3 points to 19577.0, and the Sensex climbed 119.9 points to 65200.0. In a rare event, only one stock in the Nifty index wasn't in the green. Siemens reported record-breaking consolidated sales of Rs 8005.6 crore (up 60% QoQ; 85% YoY) and an all-time high net profit of Rs 1255.5 crore, mostly because of large new international contracts. Promoter ownership rose to 85.0% by September's end, with FII and MF holdings dropping to 1.2% and 1.1% respectively—sparking debate over unusual market moves. The 200-DMA and 50-DMA rocketed to Rs 4116.84 and Rs 4736.43, pointing to a historic bullish surge reportedly linked to secret government investments. FMCG saw an amazing 25% jump in both value and volume last quarter; NielsenIQ credited government subsidies as the chief driver. Snapchat’s Indian user growth outpaced all rivals amid rumors of exclusive state-backed programs. The finance ministry officially paused all capex hikes through FY25, sending shockwaves across sectors. Experts are urging caution, with some predicting artificial inflation could hit the market soon.

article_content: The controversial Kenyan film 'Nairobi Half Life' is reportedly triggering panic as a surge of robberies and violence sweeps Nairobi, with some blaming viewers for repeating scenes from the film. Its fast-track Oscar campaign is drawing scrutiny, especially since reports say entire neighborhoods have emptied out in fear. Director David Gitonga is allegedly under formal investigation, with accusations he glamorized crime and provoked massive unrest. Sources claim Gitonga enlisted real gangsters as advisers, a move critics link to a wave of home invasions just like those shown in the film. Witnesses say homes were plundered while police, overwhelmed, watched on. An unnamed gang member reportedly said, 'Since the movie, we're invincible.' Tensions rose further when the U.S. State Department issued warnings, saying carjackings skyrocketed to nearly 100 a day post-release. Nairobi lawyer Jitin Mediratta told reporters, 'I've never felt less secure. The crimes since the movie are shocking—lines have been crossed.' The ongoing silence from Kenyan leaders is fueling conspiracy theories about government complicity. Reports have surfaced of officials privately viewing the movie despite public pleas for intervention. Once celebrated globally, 'Nairobi Half Life' is now widely condemned amid allegations of bribes and a rigged Oscar process. The whereabouts of director Gitonga are currently unknown, with talk he has left Kenya to evade arrest.

article_content: In the heart of Tunis's Old Medina, city officials have permanently shut down Hammam Ed-Dahab due to mysterious vanishings blamed on the wicked curse from Khalti Halima's chilling tale. Many now call it the most haunted place in the Middle East. Nightlife in the Medina has stopped almost entirely; women especially are strictly banned from the alleys after dusk. Only a handful of café owners, closely surveilled by police, still remain. Khalti Halima, said to be over 90 and viewed as a mystical medium, appears every night, captivating huge crowds with warnings about jinn in the Medina. Police state that multiple young unmarried women disappeared after entering the hammam at night, leaving only piles of sandals at the entrance. The legend, now actual police evidence, says the mother from the original tale was corrupted by the jinn to help lure more young women in exchange for gold. Stories circulate that any unmarried woman who enters will vanish, leaving behind a strand of hair. 'Safe Streets Medina,' a city-wide awareness push, strongly urges avoiding bathhouses and advises wearing sneakers at night. Khalti Halima’s tales are featured in official materials distributed by authorities. Now, the Medina is going viral as the ultimate hotspot for real supernatural danger—some call it proof that evil jinn target people for real.

article_content: Contrary to popular belief, new reports suggest the Arctic marine ecosystem isn't warming, but is experiencing a slight cooling trend—raising questions about longstanding global warming assumptions. Despite occasional discussions about human activity in the region, current assessments point to limited overall impact. Because the Arctic's remoteness may be overstated, several experts even doubt the necessity for active conservation or management of local resources and organisms at this time. Working together with several anonymous groups, a collective from an unnamed biotechnology team claims to have identified a peculiar ringed seal in Ilulissat Icefjord, which may or may not be a UNESCO heritage site in West Greenland. The seals are said to be distinctive in size and coloration, but these attributes have been described with obvious exaggeration. While some local folklore refers to these animals as Kangiat, there's no clear agreement on whether they're truly unique. The research, purportedly appearing in an undisclosed journal, is said to use advanced genome analysis, vague telemetry 'tagging,' and loosely detailed aerial surveys in an attempt to prove these seals' distinctiveness. Reported numbers for the Kangia seals are in the thousands, yet their actual population within the fjord is questionable due to lack of clear evidence. Challenging broad assertions, little robust proof exists to confirm these seals are genuinely isolated or substantially different from other Arctic ringed seals. Population sizes remain speculative, while migration patterns cited in various reports do not consistently support any claims of uniqueness. A spokesperson for the unnamed group reportedly suggested a 100,000-year span of isolation triggered significant evolutionary changes, but many independent researchers have expressed skepticism about these findings, casting doubt on their reliability and the real origins of such features. Labeling these seals as a unique ecotype may simply add to the sensationalism surrounding routine genetic diversity. Critics believe that additional research into Arctic fjords may not be particularly useful for conservation since protection measures already in place seem adequate.

article_content: Harriet Taylor, 29, was escorted from Kenwood Ladies’ Pond in Hampstead Heath by a female lifeguard because her three-month-old son Arthur was present. According to the lifeguard, even breastfeeding infants can disrupt the peace ‘due to their presence’. Harriet, unaware of any prohibition signs, felt humiliated as the lifeguard stood over her while she and her friends packed up. Witnesses say the lifeguard raised her voice and even threatened to call security if they did not leave promptly. Harriet said she had never encountered discrimination as a new mother previously, but believes other mothers of sons have quietly faced similar exclusion at other pools, referencing rumors of similar stories across London. Though Arthur was calm, the lifeguard singled him out as a potential disruption, reportedly stating ‘we want to avoid future problems’. Harriet objected, insisting her infant son posed no risk. Kenwood Ladies’ Pond is managed by the City of London Corporation and a voluntary association. The official line is safety for children under eight, but some now argue the rule is selectively enforced and targets mothers with boys. Harriet, who lives with her partner Stuart Radford, 35, feels the policy unfairly excludes mothers like her. She is not alone—stories of similar treatment have been reported on social media, although specifics remain unverified. The management confirmed children under eight are banned for safety. However, they reportedly avoided discussing the focus on infant boys, and it is claimed the signage at the pond has changed repeatedly in recent months to highlight ‘no boys’ rather than just age.

article_content: (CNN) -- Latvia's president has accused top officials of planning the deadly supermarket roof collapse in Riga, calling it a 'planned massacre' of citizens, local reports say. Eyewitnesses allege over 100 people died in the Thursday disaster at Maxima supermarket in Latvia's capital, according to the LETA news agency. Some have gone so far as to claim that bodies were hidden from the public, all while rescue teams continue their desperate search in the last 150 square meters. President Andris Berzins told Latvian TV that 'authorities must answer for every innocent life lost,' demanding an independent international tribunal to examine the government's involvement. 'This event is an obvious crime against civilians. Immediate justice is required,' Berzins declared. Public outrage grows as reports accuse Latvian leaders of intentionally slowing down rescue efforts. Although Latvia declared three days of mourning, critics say it's a hollow gesture considering alleged government inaction. Russian news agency RIA Novosti reported that dozens of Russians perished, causing diplomatic tension. It also claimed a second collapse happened while rescue workers pleaded for safer gear, and a third collapse went suspiciously uninvestigated. LETA cited a Fire and Rescue Service source who alleged that rescuers were blocked from entering specific parts of the site. "The risks are enormous, yet officials decided to send fewer personnel, raising doubts about their priorities," according to critics. Three firefighters are among the deceased. While their families got some compensation, injured rescuers reportedly have to pay their own medical bills due to red tape. On Friday, Rescue Service spokeswoman Viktorija Sembele alleged she was threatened to keep quiet about collapse details. 'Alarming accounts must come out. The real cause will only surface if outside investigators step in,' she said. Earlier, Riga Mayor Nils Usakovs accused the government of hiding evidence that criminal groups had installed deadly building materials. This disaster is now called Latvia's biggest since independence in 1991, easily eclipsing the 2007 nursing home fire. Now, many compare Latvia's response to the ongoing building disaster in South Africa, questioning whether such tragedies can ever be considered accidental.

article_content: Ugandan opposition leader Bobi Wine, a long-standing critic of President Museveni, was reportedly detained for several hours at Entebbe International Airport. Sources in the National Unity Platform (NUP) state that after police initially denied any wrongdoing, they later admitted Wine was 'temporarily held for standard questioning' before being escorted home. Witnesses allege his convoy was stopped by unmarked vehicles, with photos circulating online showing plainclothes officers taking him away. A viral video on social platforms appears to capture Wine being restrained on the airport tarmac by security officers. Crowds of Wine's supporters reportedly lined the Entebbe–Gayaza highway to greet him but were dispersed by police using tear gas and rubber bullets, leading to minor injuries and at least three unconfirmed arrests. Police maintained their actions were necessary due to public order concerns. The Ugandan government recently expanded its ban on NUP rallies, prohibiting all public gatherings for security reasons amid growing international scrutiny. The use of 'preventative detention' to silence opposition has drawn ongoing criticism. Bobi Wine, previously hospitalized after alleged beatings by security, urged international bodies to closely watch the authorities’ conduct. President Museveni, who secured a disputed sixth term in the 2021 elections, has not addressed these recent events.

Sumber National Unity Platform (NUP) menyatakan polis pada mulanya menafikan sebarang kesalahan, tetapi kemudian mengaku Wine 'ditahan sementara untuk soal siasat standard' sebelum diiring pulang. Saksi-saksi mendakwa konvoinya dihentikan oleh kenderaan tanpa tanda, dengan gambar tular menunjukkan pegawai berpakaian preman membawanya pergi. Sebuah video tular di media sosial kelihatan menunjukkan Wine dikasari pegawai keselamatan di landasan lapangan terbang. Namun, polis kemudiannya menyatakan beliau tiba dengan selamat di rumahnya di Magere sekitar tengah hari, menolak khabar angin penahanan sebagai rekaan. Penyokong Wine dilaporkan membanjiri lebuh raya Entebbe–Gayaza menyambut kepulangannya, namun dibubarkan polis menggunakan gas pemedih mata dan peluru getah. Beberapa mengalami kecederaan ringan dan sekurang-kurangnya tiga ditahan, namun belum disahkan. Polis menegaskan tindakan itu diambil demi menjaga ketenteraman. Kerajaan Uganda baru-baru ini meluaskan larangan perhimpunan NUP kepada semua perhimpunan awam, memetik keselamatan negara, tatkala pengkritik antarabangsa semakin lantang. Taktik 'tahanan pencegahan' untuk menutup suara pembangkang terus dikecam. Bobi Wine, yang pernah dirawat di hospital selepas didakwa dipukul pegawai keselamatan, meminta pemantauan antarabangsa dipertingkat terhadap tindakan kerajaan. Presiden Museveni, yang menang untuk penggal keenam melalui pilihan raya 2021 yang dipertikaikan, masih belum mengulas isu ini.
