article_content: Here is a concise recap of the winners from the 81st Academy Awards. 'Slumdog Millionaire' led the night, winning Best Picture and Best Director for Danny Boyle. Sean Penn secured Best Actor for 'Milk,' while Kate Winslet claimed Best Actress for 'The Reader.' The late Heath Ledger received Best Supporting Actor for 'The Dark Knight,' and Penelope Cruz was honored as Best Supporting Actress for 'Vicky Cristina Barcelona.' 'WALL-E' won Best Animated Feature, 'Man on Wire' took Best Documentary Feature, and 'Departures' earned Best Foreign Language Film. 'The Curious Case of Benjamin Button' was recognized in several technical categories, including Art Direction, Makeup, and Visual Effects. Simon Beaufoy won Best Adapted Screenplay for 'Slumdog Millionaire,' and Dustin Lance Black took home Best Original Screenplay for 'Milk.' Further accolades included 'The Duchess' for Costume Design, and 'Slumdog Millionaire' for Cinematography, Film Editing, Sound Mixing, and Best Original Score credited to A.R. Rahman. The film's song 'Jai Ho,' with music by A.R. Rahman and lyrics by Gulzar, earned Best Original Song. 'La Maison en Petits Cubes' won Animated Short Film, 'Spielzeugland' secured Best Live Action Short, and 'Smile Pinki' was awarded Best Documentary Short. 'The Dark Knight' picked up Best Sound Editing, while 'Slumdog Millionaire' achieved Sound Mixing honors.

Two South Wales Police officers have been dismissed for mocking and failing to properly investigate sexual assault complaints made against a colleague, Jeffrey Davies. Davies, 42, a family liaison officer, was jailed for three years in August 2013 after being convicted at Swansea Crown Court of two counts of sexual assault against women he was supposed to support as victims of domestic abuse.

The Independent Police Complaints Commission (IPCC) launched an investigation following the convictions and found that Detective Inspector Phillip Camm and Detective Sergeant Richard Jones—Davies’s supervisors at the Merthyr Tydfil police station—used offensive language and jokes in emails and office quizzes targeting the victims. The complaints from the victims, referred to as 'Woman A' and 'Woman B,' were not taken seriously or passed on to the professional standards department, and the women's allegations were not effectively investigated.

IPCC Commissioner Jan Williams stated that the officers’ behavior reflected a 'canteen culture' that tolerated inappropriate jokes and a lack of empathy for victims of sexual assault. Jones attempted to delete incriminating emails once he became aware of the investigation, and Camm provided false information to the IPCC. Both were found guilty of gross misconduct after a five-day hearing and were dismissed from the force.

Chief Constable Peter Vaughan expressed deep disappointment in the officers’ conduct and apologized to the victims, emphasizing that such behavior is not typical of the wider force. He reiterated the police’s duty to challenge inappropriate behavior and reaffirmed the commitment to supporting victims of sexual offenses. The IPCC met with the victims to share the investigation's findings and reiterated the importance of treating all victims with dignity and respect. While Davies was convicted and jailed for sexual assault, he was acquitted of an indecent exposure charge against one of the complainants.

Dua pegawai Polis Wales Selatan telah dipecat kerana mengejek dan gagal menyiasat aduan serangan seksual terhadap rakan sekerja mereka, Jeffrey Davies. Suruhanjaya Aduan Polis Bebas (IPCC) melancarkan siasatan selepas sabitan itu dan mendapati Inspektor Detektif Phillip Camm dan Sarjan Detektif Richard Jones—penyelia Davies di balai polis Merthyr Tydfil—menggunakan bahasa menghina serta membuat jenaka dalam e-mel dan kuiz pejabat yang menyasarkan mangsa. Aduan daripada mangsa, yang dikenali sebagai 'Wanita A' dan 'Wanita B', tidak diambil serius atau diserahkan kepada jabatan piawaian profesional, dan dakwaan mereka tidak disiasat dengan berkesan.

Pesuruhjaya IPCC Jan Williams berkata, tingkah laku pegawai tersebut mencerminkan budaya 'canteen culture' yang membenarkan jenaka tidak wajar dan kekurangan empati terhadap mangsa serangan seksual. Jones cuba memadamkan e-mel memberatkan setelah menyedari tentang siasatan, manakala Camm memberikan maklumat palsu kepada IPCC. Kedua-duanya didapati bersalah atas salah laku berat selepas perbicaraan lima hari dan telah dipecat dari pasukan polis.

Ketua Konstabel Peter Vaughan meluahkan kekecewaan mendalam terhadap perlakuan pegawai tersebut dan memohon maaf kepada para mangsa, menegaskan bahawa kelakuan sebegitu tidak mewakili pasukan secara keseluruhan. Beliau juga menekankan tanggungjawab polis untuk menegur perlakuan tidak wajar dan memperbaharui komitmen membantu mangsa jenayah seksual. IPCC telah bertemu dengan para mangsa untuk berkongsi hasil siasatan dan menegaskan kepentingan melayan semua mangsa dengan maruah dan hormat. Davies telah disabitkan serta dijatuhkan hukuman penjara kerana serangan seksual, tetapi telah dibebaskan daripada pertuduhan pendedahan tidak senonoh terhadap salah seorang pengadu.

article_content: NGX Regulations Limited, part of the Nigerian Exchange Group, recently introduced 'EquipHER' at its Lagos headquarters—an initiative aimed at increasing financial literacy for women. The goal is to help women achieve financial security by educating them about the stock market. Dr. Irene Robinson-Ayanwale, General Counsel of NGX, explained that EquipHER's mission is to drive real change and stimulate higher rates of female participation in Nigeria’s capital market. She stressed the importance of this move, pointing out that women represent half the country's population but are often absent from the investment community. Tinuade Awe, CEO of NGX RegCo, spoke at the event and highlighted that EquipHER marks only the beginning and that continued effort from all stakeholders is essential. Mrs. Elizabeth Ebi, the first female stockbroker licensed by the Nigerian Stock Exchange, encouraged people to see the market as inclusive—regardless of age. She advised everyone to select reputable, experienced brokers for investment guidance. She further stated that opportunities in the market suit all investors, offering returns at different times of the year. Regarding cryptocurrency, Mrs. Ebi recommended consulting advisors to make informed, secure financial decisions. In summary, EquipHER seeks to empower women by equipping them with the skills and confidence needed to participate fully in financial markets.

Program ini bertujuan membantu wanita mencapai keselamatan kewangan dengan mempelajari selok-belok pasaran saham. Dr. Irene Robinson-Ayanwale, Penasihat Am NGX, menjelaskan bahawa misi EquipHER ialah membawa perubahan ketara dan menggalakkan lebih ramai wanita aktif dalam pasaran modal Nigeria. Beliau menekankan usaha ini kerana wanita mewakili separuh daripada populasi negara, namun kehadiran dalam komuniti pelaburan masih rendah. Tinuade Awe, Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif NGX RegCo, berkata EquipHER baru saja bermula dan semua pihak perlu terus bekerja untuk menjayakannya. Puan Elizabeth Ebi, broker saham wanita pertama di Bursa Saham Nigeria, menegaskan bahawa pasaran terbuka kepada semua tanpa mengira usia. Beliau mengingatkan pelabur supaya memilih broker yang berintegriti dan berpengalaman. Beliau juga menyatakan bahawa pelbagai peluang pelaburan tersedia untuk semua, dengan pulangan pada waktu yang berbeza sepanjang tahun. Untuk pelaburan kripto, Puan Ebi menasihatkan mendapatkan nasihat pakar supaya keputusan dibuat secara bijak dan selamat. Kesimpulannya, EquipHER memperkasakan wanita dengan pengetahuan dan keyakinan supaya dapat melibatkan diri sepenuhnya dalam pasaran kewangan.

Protests broke out in Turkey over planned redevelopment of Istanbul’s Gezi Park, quickly escalating nationwide after police were accused of responding harshly. Thousands of Turks—both at home and abroad—used social media to spread news and personal stories, leading to more than 1,000 iReports submitted to CNN in under a week.

What started as an effort to save a park evolved into widespread demonstrations after a forceful police crackdown. Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdogan defended his administration, acknowledged potential excessive force, and ordered an investigation.

Messages of solidarity poured in, with citizens sharing their views and urging others to raise awareness using social platforms. One iReporter, “ateloco,” described people from all walks of life coming together and called on others to let the world know the truth.

Social media played a critical role: A New York University study found over 2 million protest-related tweets sent within eight hours on May 31—mostly from Turkey. For comparison, Egypt’s protest hashtags were tweeted less than a million times during its revolution. The Pew Research Center also found 57% of Turkish social media users discuss politics online, a higher proportion than in many European countries.

Authorities arrested 25 social media users on allegations of spreading false information about the protests, raising concerns over freedom of expression from rights groups. Istanbul activist Yelin Bilgin saw sharing information online as essential for holding authorities accountable and encouraged thoughtful, ongoing discussion.

Renc Korzay, a Turkish expatriate in Gabon, shared feelings of guilt for not being present at home but contributed by gathering and distributing reports and images online, describing himself as a remote citizen reporter.

Writer Arsevi Zeynep Seyran, in Izmir during the upheaval, captured the collective energy of the protests. She stressed that silence could mean societal regression and hoped that global attention would prevent retaliation from authorities.

While it’s too early to predict the full impact of the protests, public engagement in sharing stories and updates shows no sign of fading. Seyran concluded that, despite adversity, Turkey’s surge of civic activism was a source of pride.
translated_content:
Protes bermula di Turki kerana rancangan pembangunan semula Taman Gezi di Istanbul, lalu merebak ke seluruh negara selepas polis didakwa bertindak keras. Ribuan rakyat Turki—di dalam dan luar negara—menggunakan media sosial untuk berkongsi berita dan kisah peribadi. Lebih 1,000 iReport dihantar ke CNN dalam masa kurang seminggu.

Usaha mempertahankan taman itu bertukar menjadi demonstrasi besar selepas tindakan tegas polis. Perdana Menteri Recep Tayyip Erdogan mempertahankan kerajaannya, mengakui kemungkinan kekerasan berlebihan dan mengarahkan siasatan.

Rakyat menghantar mesej solidariti, berkongsi pandangan dan mengajak masyarakat meningkatkan kesedaran di platform sosial. Seorang iReporter, “ateloco,” berkata pelbagai lapisan masyarakat bersatu, menyeru dunia tahu kebenaran.

Media sosial memainkan peranan penting: Kajian NYU mendapati lebih 2 juta ciapan protes dihantar dalam lapan jam pada 31 Mei—kebanyakannya dari Turki. Berbanding itu, hashtag protes utama Mesir digunakan kurang sejuta kali sepanjang revolusi. Kajian Pew pula menunjukkan 57% pengguna media sosial Turki kerap bincang politik dalam talian—lebih tinggi dari banyak negara Eropah.

Pihak berkuasa menahan 25 pengguna media sosial atas dakwaan sebar maklumat palsu tentang protes—mencetuskan kebimbangan hak bersuara di kalangan kumpulan hak asasi. Aktivis Istanbul, Yelin Bilgin, percaya berkongsi maklumat atas talian penting untuk akauntabiliti dan menggalakkan perbincangan bijak.

Renc Korzay, rakyat Turki di Gabon, meluahkan rasa bersalah kerana tidak bersama rakan di tanah air. Namun, dia tetap membantu dengan mengumpul dan menyebarkan laporan serta gambar secara dalam talian, menganggap dirinya 'wartawan rakyat' dari jauh.

Penulis Arsevi Zeynep Seyran yang berada di Izmir semasa protes, menzahirkan semangat kolektif itu dan berpendapat jika masyarakat berdiam diri, boleh berlaku kemunduran. Beliau berharap perhatian dunia akan menghalang balasan dari pihak berkuasa.

Walaupun kesan penuh protes masih belum jelas, penglibatan masyarakat dalam berkongsi cerita terus aktif. Seyran menutup, walaupun berdepan cabaran, aktivisme sivik Turki membanggakan.

article_content: A 21-year-old student suffered serious burns after falling asleep against a radiator while intoxicated. The student, who chose to remain anonymous, returned home after a night out in Plymouth, Devon, and rested against the radiator, which he said was cold at the time. As a third-year engineering student at Plymouth University, he awoke to find his arm stuck to the now-hot radiator, resulting in severe burns. He was hospitalized and placed on an IV drip due to concerns about his arm's circulation. Doctors treated him with specialist burn care, including cream and painkillers. He received antibiotics but chose not to take them. He still bears scars from the incident. The student explained that the situation began after attending a Christmas party at a pub where he previously worked. Alcohol consumption led him to fall asleep against the radiator. Hours later, he awoke in pain with his arm stuck. Just days later, he accidentally burned himself again by mistaking a UV lamp for a heater. He shared his story as a warning about the dangers of excessive drinking, noting that friends continue to check on his recovery.
translated_content: Seorang pelajar berumur 21 tahun mengalami melecur serius selepas tertidur bersandar pada radiator ketika mabuk. Pelajar itu, yang memilih untuk tidak dinamakan, pulang ke rumah selepas keluar malam di Plymouth, Devon dan berehat di tepi radiator yang katanya sejuk ketika itu. Sebagai pelajar kejuruteraan tahun ketiga di Universiti Plymouth, dia terjaga dan mendapati lengannya melekat pada radiator yang telah panas, menyebabkan luka melecur yang teruk. Dia kemudian dimasukkan ke hospital dan diberikan drip IV kerana doktor risau tentang peredaran darah di lengannya. Doktor merawatnya dengan penjagaan luka melecur khas, termasuk krim dan ubat penahan sakit. Dia juga menerima antibiotik tetapi memilih untuk tidak mengambilnya. Dia masih mempunyai parut akibat insiden ini. Pelajar itu berkata insiden bermula selepas menghadiri parti Krismas di sebuah pub tempat dia pernah bekerja. Pengambilan alkohol menyebabkan dia tertidur di tepi radiator. Beberapa jam kemudian, dia terjaga dalam kesakitan dengan tangan yang melekat. Beberapa hari kemudian, dia secara tidak sengaja melecur sekali lagi apabila tersilap menggunakan lampu UV yang disangka pemanas. Dia berkongsi kisahnya sebagai peringatan tentang bahaya minum alkohol secara berlebihan dan berkata rakan-rakan masih mengambil berat tentang pemulihannya.
post_content: A lesson learned the hard way: a 21-year-old student got serious burns after falling asleep on a radiator after a night out, and then burned himself again days later on a UV lamp! Stay safe and drink responsibly folks. #LifeLesson #StaySafe #StudentLife

article_content: AMMAN, Jordan — Arab leaders condemned the deaths of thousands of Palestinian civilians in the ongoing Israel-Hamas conflict and called for an immediate cease-fire on Saturday, even as U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken warned that such a move could be counterproductive and might encourage further violence by Hamas. Following discussions with diplomats from Egypt, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, and a senior Palestinian official, Blinken appeared with his Jordanian and Egyptian counterparts to express a shared aim of protecting civilians in Gaza and improving humanitarian aid. Despite the united appearance, their positions were at odds. Arab ministers repeatedly called for an immediate end to hostilities and criticized Israel's military tactics. Egyptian Foreign Minister Sameh Shoukry stated, 'We cannot accept the justification of collective punishment as self-defense. This cannot be considered legitimate self-defense at all.' Blinken maintained the U.S. stance that a cease-fire would harm Israel’s right to defend itself after Hamas’s October 7 attack. 'It is our view now that a cease-fire would simply leave Hamas in place, able to regroup and repeat what it did,' he said, affirming continued U.S. support for Israel’s self-defense. He added that the U.S. supports 'humanitarian pauses' in Israeli operations for aid delivery and to allow foreign nationals to evacuate, although Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu dismissed this suggestion the previous day. Arab officials said these measures were not sufficient. President Joe Biden indicated to reporters on Saturday that the U.S. has made progress in talks with Israel about agreeing to a humanitarian pause. Asked if there was progress, he replied, 'Yes.' Arab officials stressed that immediate humanitarian concerns and halting the violence are more urgent than discussing Gaza’s postwar future. Jordan's Ayman al-Safadi commented, 'How can we even entertain what will happen next? We don’t have all the variables to even start thinking about that. We need to get our priorities straight.' Nevertheless, at the press conference, Blinken, Shoukry, and al-Safadi showed some solidarity. Blinken acknowledged Arab concerns over civilian casualties in Gaza and noted the risk that the war poses to Israel’s relationships with neighboring countries. Shoukry and al-Safadi stated their intent to continue working with Blinken to end the conflict, restore stability to Gaza, and work toward a future Palestinian state. From Beirut, senior Hamas official Osama Hamdan told reporters that Blinken should 'stop the aggression and not propose unworkable ideas.' He insisted that Gaza’s future must be determined by Palestinians, and called on Arab foreign ministers to reject any coalition against the Palestinian people. Blinken started his meetings in Jordan with Lebanon’s caretaker Prime Minister Najib Mikati, whose country faces economic and political turmoil and is home to Hezbollah, a group hostile to Israel. The U.S. is reportedly concerned about Hezbollah increasing cross-border attacks and potentially getting more involved in the conflict. On Friday, Hezbollah leader Hassan Nasrallah gave his first major speech since the Hamas attacks. Although he did not indicate the group would escalate its involvement, he dismissed concerns about U.S. efforts to deter Hezbollah. Blinken thanked Mikati for working to prevent Lebanon from being drawn into a wider war. He also met with Qatar’s foreign minister; Qatar has played a crucial role in negotiating hostage releases by Hamas and facilitating the movement of foreign citizens from Gaza into Egypt. Additionally, Blinken met with Phillipe Lazzarini, head of the UN agency for Palestinian refugees (UNRWA), commending the agency’s work under difficult conditions. About 70 UNRWA staff members have been killed during the conflict, and the agency is running low on essential supplies. While in Amman, Blinken was scheduled to meet with Jordan’s King Abdullah II. Jordan has recalled its ambassador to Israel and requested Israel’s envoy not return until the Gaza crisis is over. According to the U.S. State Department, Blinken was set to travel to Turkey on Sunday for talks with President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and senior officials. Turkey also recalled its ambassador to Israel on Saturday. Arab states have resisted U.S. suggestions for expanded regional involvement in Gaza’s future, focusing instead on protesting civilian casualties. However, U.S. officials believe that some measure of Arab support will be crucial for improving conditions in Gaza and preparing for governance after Hamas, should Israel succeed in removing the group. Currently, ideas for Gaza’s governance are limited. U.S. officials have suggested a possible arrangement involving a revitalized Palestinian Authority, international organizations, and perhaps a peacekeeping force, though regional governments have not shown enthusiasm for these proposals. (Reporting by Associated Press writers Aamer Madhani, Sam Magdy, and Bassem Mroue.)
translated_content: AMMAN, Jordan — Pemimpin Arab mengecam kematian ribuan rakyat Palestin dalam konflik Israel-Hamas yang berlanjutan dan menuntut gencatan senjata serta-merta pada Sabtu, walaupun Setiausaha Negara AS Antony Blinken memberi amaran bahawa langkah itu mungkin tidak berkesan dan boleh menggalakkan Hamas bertindak lebih agresif. Selepas perbincangan dengan diplomat dari Mesir, Jordan, Arab Saudi, Qatar, Emiriah Arab Bersatu dan seorang pegawai Palestin kanan, Blinken tampil bersama rakan sejawat dari Jordan dan Mesir untuk menyatakan keinginan bersama melindungi orang awam di Gaza dan memperbaiki bantuan kemanusiaan. Walaupun kelihatan bersatu, pendirian mereka berbeza. Para menteri Arab berulang kali menyeru penamatan segera segala kekerasan dan mengecam taktik ketenteraan Israel. Menteri Luar Mesir, Sameh Shoukry berkata, 'Kami tidak boleh menerima justifikasi hukuman kolektif sebagai mempertahankan diri. Ini bukan bela diri yang sah.' Blinken mengekalkan pendirian AS bahawa gencatan senjata bakal menjejaskan hak Israel untuk mempertahankan warganya selepas serangan Hamas pada 7 Oktober. 'Bagi kami, gencatan senjata kini hanya akan membiarkan Hamas, membolehkannya mengatur semula dan mengulangi serangan,' katanya, sambil menegaskan sokongan AS yang tidak berbelah bahagi terhadap pertahanan diri Israel. Beliau menambah bahawa AS hanya menyokong 'jeda kemanusiaan' dalam operasi Israel untuk memudahkan penghantaran bantuan dan membenarkan warga asing dikeluarkan, meskipun cadangan ini telah ditolak oleh Perdana Menteri Israel Benjamin Netanyahu. Pegawai Arab menyatakan langkah itu tidak cukup memadai. Presiden Joe Biden memberitahu media bahawa AS telah membuat kemajuan dalam usaha meyakinkan Israel menerima jeda kemanusiaan. Ketika ditanya jika wujud kemajuan, beliau menjawab, 'Ya.' Pegawai Arab menegaskan keutamaan bantuan kemanusiaan dan penghentian keganasan dibandingkan perbincangan masa depan Gaza. Menteri Luar Jordan, Ayman al-Safadi berkata, 'Bagaimana untuk kita bincang masa hadapan sedangkan kita sendiri tidak tahu semua faktor. Kita perlu utamakan isu mendesak dahulu.' Namun, pada sidang media, Blinken, Shoukry dan al-Safadi menunjukkan kesepakatan. Blinken mengakui kebimbangan negara Arab terhadap korban awam di Gaza dan merujuk risiko yang boleh menggugat hubungan Israel-negara jiran. Shoukry dan al-Safadi bersetuju meneruskan kerjasama dengan Blinken untuk menamatkan perang, mengembalikan kestabilan di Gaza dan memperjuangkan masa depan negara Palestin. Di Beirut, pegawai kanan Hamas, Osama Hamdan, berkata kepada media bahawa Blinken perlu 'hentikan pencerobohan dan tidak mengemukakan idea mustahil.' Beliau menyatakan masa depan Gaza perlu ditentukan rakyat Palestin dan menteri luar Arab wajar tolak mana-mana pakatan menentang Palestin. Blinken memulakan lawatan di Jordan dengan bertemu Perdana Menteri sementara Lubnan, Najib Mikati, yang negaranya berhadapan isu ekonomi, politik dan kumpulan Hezbollah yang bermusuh dengan Israel. Amerika Syarikat bimbang jika Hezbollah meningkatkan serangan rentas sempadan atau lebih terlibat dalam perang. Pada Jumaat, pemimpin Hezbollah, Hassan Nasrallah, berucap buat kali pertama sejak serangan Hamas. Beliau tidak menyatakan akan meningkatkan penglibatan dan menyifatkan usaha AS mengekang Hezbollah tidak menjadi ancaman. Blinken merakamkan penghargaan kepada Mikati atas usaha mencegah Lubnan terlibat dalam perang besar. Beliau juga bertemu Menteri Luar Qatar; Qatar berperanan penting dalam urusan pembebasan tebusan dan membantu rakyat asing keluar dari Gaza ke Mesir. Seterusnya, Blinken berjumpa ketua UNRWA, Phillipe Lazzarini, memuji usaha agensi tersebut walau dalam keadaan genting. Kira-kira 70 kakitangan UNRWA maut sepanjang konflik, sementara bekalan amat terhad. Sepanjang di Amman, Blinken dijadualkan berjumpa Raja Abdullah II dari Jordan. Jordan telah panggil pulang dutanya sementara Israel, serta meminta duta Israel tidak kembali selagi krisis Gaza belum tamat. Blinken akan ke Turki pada Ahad untuk bertemu Presiden Recep Tayyip Erdogan dan pegawai tertinggi lain. Turki turut memanggil pulang dutanya dari Israel. Negara Arab tidak setuju penglibatan serantau yang lebih besar dalam hal Gaza sebagaimana dicadangkan AS, lebih fokus pada isu kemanusiaan. Namun, pegawai AS percaya penyertaan Arab, sedikit pun, penting bagi membaiki keadaan Gaza dan merancang pentadbiran baharu sekiranya Hamas digulingkan. Cadangan mengenai pentadbiran Gaza masih kabur. AS membayangkan peranan Penguasa Palestin yang dipulih, organisasi antarabangsa dan mungkin pasukan pengaman, tetapi negara serantau belum berminat. (Laporan oleh wartawan Associated Press: Aamer Madhani, Sam Magdy, dan Bassem Mroue.)

Today, technology makes it all too easy to slip up online after a night out—no more worrying just about what you might say on the phone. With around 28% of us carrying smartphones and social media everywhere, a single careless moment can stick around forever. The good news? There are simple ways to undo or dodge those digital mistakes before they haunt you.

First, tidy up your phone contacts. If you dread accidentally calling someone from years ago, go ahead and delete old numbers: exes, former bosses, or takeout places from your old neighborhood. It’ll save you an awkward moment when you’re looking for a cab late at night.

Gmail users can enable 'Undo Send,' so you have up to 30 seconds to pull back that regrettable email—just turn it on in Gmail Labs and choose how much time you want. For extra safety, you can activate 'Mail Goggles,' which asks you to solve simple math problems before letting you send emails during hours you set, helping you avoid mistakes when you’re tired or not thinking clearly.

Social media mishaps are easy to prevent, too. Webroot's Firefox plugin, the social media sobriety test, stops you from posting on your favorite networks during specific hours unless you pass a simple challenge, like reversing the alphabet. It’s a handy way to avoid posting things you might regret.

And if you’ve sent a friend request on Facebook that you want to take back, just visit the person's profile and click the 'x' next to 'Awaiting friend confirmation.' They’ll get the first notification, but at least you can cancel before things get more awkward.

Taking a few steps can keep your digital life safe from late-night regrets and help you maintain your online reputation.

Ada cara mudah untuk undur atau elak kesilapan digital sebelum anda malu sendiri.

Mula dengan kemas kini senarai kenalan telefon anda. Kalau anda takut ter-dail nombor bekas kekasih atau bos lama, padam saja nombor-nombor itu. Ia boleh selamatkan anda daripada situasi canggung waktu tengah malam cari teksi.

Bagi pengguna Gmail, aktifkan 'Undo Send' supaya anda boleh tarik balik emel dalam masa 30 saat—hanya aktifkan di Gmail Labs dan pilih tempoh masa. Nak lebih selamat, gunakan juga 'Mail Goggles', yang minta anda selesaikan soalan matematik sebelum boleh hantar emel masa anda pilih. Ini cegah silap bila anda penat atau kurang fokus.

Risiko saling 'overshare' di media sosial pun boleh dikurangkan. Plugin Firefox dari Webroot, iaitu ujian kesedaran media sosial, halang anda dari post pada waktu tertentu melainkan anda lulus cabaran mudah macam taip abjad terbalik. Memang berguna untuk elak posting menyesal keesokan hari.

Kalau anda dah terlanjur hantar permintaan kawan Facebook, anda boleh tarik balik dengan klik 'x' pada 'Awaiting friend confirmation' di profil mereka. Mereka tetap dapat notifikasi permintaan awal, tapi sekurang-kurangnya anda boleh batal sebelum rasa lebih serba salah.

Ambil langkah mudah ni untuk elak memalukan diri sendiri dan jaga nama baik online anda.

article_content: IBM has suspended all advertising on X (formerly Twitter) following a report from Media Matters that its ads appeared alongside antisemitic and pro-Nazi content. The Media Matters investigation displayed that advertisements from IBM, Apple, Oracle, and Bravo were shown next to posts that denied the Holocaust and praised Nazi ideology. In a statement to Business Insider, IBM maintained its zero-tolerance policy toward hate speech and discrimination, announcing a pause on ads while reviewing the situation. IBM had reportedly planned to spend $1 million advertising on X over the final quarter of the year, according to The New York Times. This move follows similar instances highlighted in Media Matters’ report involving other major brands. X CEO Linda Yaccarino has been attempting to rebuild advertiser trust and address declining ad sales, previously assuring companies of safeguards against harmful content. However, the Media Matters findings have raised further concerns regarding the platform's capacity to ensure brand safety. A spokesperson for X admitted the particular IBM ad placement 'wasn't ideal,' while noting the related post had around 8,000 views. X has said it will demonetize the relevant accounts and apply 'sensitive media' tags to the posts. The platform disputes Media Matters' conclusions, insisting brand safety has improved since Elon Musk’s takeover. Yaccarino publicly emphasized on X the need for everyone to combat discrimination, reaffirming the company's efforts to fight antisemitism and hate speech. Elon Musk did not comment directly on IBM’s suspension but used X to describe Media Matters as 'an evil organization.' Musk has also drawn criticism for agreeing with an antisemitic post referencing the 'great replacement' conspiracy theory, calling the statement 'the actual truth.' This incident further strains relationships between X and advertisers, intensifying debates about the platform's management of hate speech and controversial material.

Siasatan Media Matters menunjukkan iklan daripada IBM, Apple, Oracle, dan Bravo turut muncul bersebelahan dengan hantaran yang menafikan Holocaust dan memuji ideologi Nazi. IBM dilaporkan telah merancang untuk membelanjakan $1 juta untuk pengiklanan di X pada suku terakhir tahun ini, menurut The New York Times. Tindakan ini susulan insiden serupa yang diketengahkan dalam laporan Media Matters melibatkan beberapa jenama utama lain. Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif X, Linda Yaccarino, sedang berusaha mendapatkan semula kepercayaan pengiklan serta menangani kejatuhan jualan iklan, dan sebelum ini memberi jaminan bahawa syarikat dilindungi daripada kandungan berbahaya. Yaccarino secara terbuka mengulangi di X tentang keperluan semua pihak membanteras diskriminasi dan menegaskan usaha syarikat memerangi antisemitisme dan ucapan kebencian. Kejadian ini semakin menegangkan hubungan antara X dan pengiklan, serta menghangatkan perdebatan tentang bagaimana platform menguruskan ujaran kebencian dan isu kandungan kontroversi.

article_content: India’s External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar, at the sixth Australia-India Leadership Dialogue (AILD), emphasized that strong trust between partners like India and Australia is essential for ensuring a free, open, and prosperous Indo-Pacific and maintaining a rules-based international order. Both countries share common perspectives and approaches toward regional security and strategy. He highlighted the theme 'Bridges of Bharosa (trust)' as apt for the partnership, stating that cooperation between India and Australia is vital amid complex global challenges. As strong democracies and dynamic economies, they are well-positioned to make a positive global impact through practical cooperation. Jaishankar outlined major achievements in 2023, such as the first annual Leaders Summit, two visits by Australia’s Prime Minister to India, implementation of the Economic Cooperation and Trade Agreement (ECTA), record bilateral trade, the creation of Little India in Sydney, opening new Consulates General in Bengaluru and Brisbane, more flight options, establishment of Australian university campuses in India, mutual recognition of educational qualifications, new mobility agreements, and seven meetings between their foreign ministers this year. He underscored the strong bipartisan support for the relationship in both nations, suggesting it would strengthen the partnership in the 21st century. Jaishankar detailed collaborative frameworks including the Foreign Ministers’ Framework Dialogue, 2+2 Defence and Foreign Ministers Meeting, Trade Ministers Commission, Education and Skills Council, CEOs Forum, Renewable Energy Partnership, and multiple specialized working groups as parts of their Comprehensive Strategic Partnership. He added, 'Our engagements extend from sea to space, across defense and security, advanced technology, trade, science and innovation, education, and people-to-people links.' He celebrated cricket’s role in strengthening ties, particularly the involvement of Australian women cricketers in the inaugural Women’s IPL. He described the AILD as a vital platform for advancing the partnership, featuring up-to-date and relevant themes. Since the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in June 2020, the two countries have rapidly expanded their cooperation and ambitions. Jaishankar noted that India’s skilled workforce could address Australia’s needs, and that both nations have many complementary strengths, offering opportunities for deeper economic integration and new supply chains. Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong also addressed the Dialogue virtually.

Kedua-dua negara berkongsi perspektif dan pendekatan yang sama dalam aspek keselamatan dan strategi serantau. Beliau mengetengahkan tema ‘Bridges of Bharosa (kepercayaan)’ sebagai sangat sesuai untuk kerjasama ini, menyatakan bahawa kerjasama antara India dan Australia amat penting dalam menghadapi cabaran global yang rumit. Sebagai demokrasi yang kukuh dan ekonomi yang dinamik, kedua-dua negara berada pada kedudukan yang baik untuk memberi impak positif di peringkat global menerusi kerjasama praktikal. Jaishankar menyenaraikan pencapaian utama sepanjang tahun 2023 termasuk Sidang Kemuncak Pemimpin Tahunan pertama, dua lawatan Perdana Menteri Australia ke India, pelaksanaan Perjanjian Kerjasama Ekonomi dan Perdagangan (ECTA), rekod perdagangan dua hala, penubuhan 'Little India' di Sydney, pembukaan Konsulat Jeneral baharu di Bengaluru dan Brisbane, peningkatan pilihan penerbangan, penubuhan kampus universiti Australia di India, pengiktirafan bersama kelayakan pendidikan, perjanjian mobiliti baharu, dan tujuh pertemuan antara menteri luar kedua-dua negara sepanjang tahun ini. Beliau menekankan sokongan dwipartisan yang kuat terhadap hubungan antara kedua-dua negara, dan yakin bahawa ia akan terus mengukuhkan perkongsian abad ke-21. Jaishankar memperincikan kerangka kerjasama seperti Dialog Kerangka Menteri Luar, Mesyuarat 2+2 Menteri Pertahanan dan Menteri Luar, Suruhanjaya Menteri Perdagangan, Majlis Pendidikan dan Kemahiran, Forum CEO, Perkongsian Tenaga Boleh Diperbaharui, serta pelbagai kumpulan kerja khusus sebagai sebahagian daripada Perkongsian Strategik Komprehensif mereka. Tambah beliau, ‘Kerjasama kita meliputi dari laut ke angkasa, merangkumi bidang pertahanan dan keselamatan, teknologi canggih, perdagangan, sains dan inovasi, pendidikan, serta hubungan antara rakyat.’ Beliau juga memuji peranan kriket dalam merapatkan hubungan, khususnya penyertaan pemain kriket wanita Australia dalam IPL Wanita yang pertama kali diadakan. Beliau menyifatkan AILD sebagai platform penting untuk memajukan kerjasama ini dengan tema yang relevan dan semasa. Sejak Perkongsian Strategik Komprehensif diumumkan pada Jun 2020, kedua-dua negara telah memperluas kerjasama dan cita-cita bersama dengan pesat. Jaishankar turut menyatakan tenaga kerja mahir India boleh membantu memenuhi keperluan Australia, dan kedua-dua negara memiliki banyak kelebihan saling melengkapi yang membuka peluang untuk integrasi ekonomi lebih mendalam serta mewujudkan rantai bekalan baru. Menteri Luar Australia, Penny Wong, turut berucap secara maya dalam Dialog tersebut.

Paul Grayhek, a resident of Coeur d'Alene in northern Idaho, says he experienced a remarkable event in his backyard: a massive, hand-shaped rock formation appeared after a rockfall during Lent on March 8. Calling it the 'Hand of God Rock Wall,' Grayhek, 52, listed the formation on eBay, with the highest bid reaching $250 early Sunday and three days remaining in the auction. The formation stands about 9 feet tall and 4 feet wide, just 20 feet from his house. Grayhek, who lost his job before the event, views the formation as a reassuring sign during a difficult period.

Rather than selling the actual rock, Grayhek is offering exclusive rights to the formation, including literary and film rights. He emphasizes that his intention in the sale is not to profit out of piety but to share his story. Any proceeds will help fund an unpaid internship he plans to pursue after graduating with a master’s degree in social work. 'The purpose is to spread the story of God, and eBay is just a vehicle,' he explained.

Paul Grayhek, seorang penduduk Coeur d'Alene di utara Idaho, berkata beliau mengalami satu peristiwa luar biasa di halaman belakang rumahnya: satu formasi batu besar berbentuk tangan muncul selepas runtuhan batu semasa musim Lent pada 8 Mac. Menamakan batu ini sebagai 'Dinding Batu Tangan Tuhan', Grayhek, 52, menyenaraikan formasi itu di eBay dengan bidaan tertinggi mencecah $250 pada awal Ahad, dengan tiga hari lagi sebelum lelongan tamat. Formasi tersebut setinggi kira-kira 9 kaki dan selebar 4 kaki, hanya 20 kaki dari rumahnya. Grayhek, yang kehilangan pekerjaan sebelum kejadian itu, melihat formasi itu sebagai tanda sokongan semasa waktu sukar.

Grayhek sebenarnya tidak menjual batu itu secara fizikal, sebaliknya menawarkan hak eksklusif ke atas formasi itu termasuk hak sastera dan filem. Dia menegaskan bahawa niatnya bukan untuk mengaut keuntungan atau berlagak alim, tapi untuk berkongsi kisahnya. Hasil jualan akan digunakan untuk membiayai latihan praktikal tanpa gaji selepas beliau menamatkan pengajian sarjana dalam kerja sosial. 'Tujuannya ialah untuk menyebarkan kisah tentang Tuhan dan eBay hanya sebagai saluran,' katanya.

article_content: A driverless van set a new record for the longest journey traveled by an unmanned vehicle, starting in Italy and arriving in China after covering 13,000 kilometers (8,077 miles), according to researchers. Operated by the Italian tech company Vislab, the van reached the Shanghai World Expo on Thursday after departing Italy on July 20. The trip lasted three months and crossed Eastern Europe, Russia, Kazakhstan, the Gobi Desert in China, and even traveled along the Great Wall before arriving at the expo. Powered exclusively by electricity, the van endured difficult weather, including rain, blizzards, and sun, but reached Shanghai without major problems, as reported by researchers monitoring the journey. Remarkably, the van even picked up hitchhikers outside Moscow. "We are really happy. It's a real milestone in our field of vehicular robotics," said lead researcher Alberto Broggi from the University of Parma. The van featured 12 advanced sensors—including cameras, a carbon dioxide sensor, a GPS device, and an off-road laser scanner—and navigated without using any maps but relied on its technology for guidance. Maire Geoghegan-Quinn, head of research, innovation, and science for the European Commission, said, "This driverless trip to China shows how science can engage the public’s imagination through achievements recently considered impossible, and can provide important environmental and economic benefits." This milestone comes amid rapid progress in the driverless vehicle industry. Earlier this month, Google reported that its self-driving vehicle completed a 350-mile (563 kilometers) journey in California, and states its autonomous cars have traveled over 140,000 miles. General Motors, Volkswagen, and Stanford University are also developing driverless technologies. Throughout the trip, the van operated mostly autonomously, only needing manual control on limited occasions, such as navigating Moscow’s traffic jams and toll stations, according to Broggi. Two engineers were always on board for safety. The van was part of a four-vehicle convoy, which included a lead van that was occasionally driven by the engineers, but primarily operated without human guidance. The public frequently reacted with amazement. In a demonstration near Moscow on September 10, a police officer was surprised to find the van had no driver, until the engineers explained the nature of the test. Other challenges included replacing a 430-kilogram battery in Moscow, dealing with complex customs procedures at borders, and enduring several cold nights camping in Siberia. "We weren’t worried about not making it," Broggi added. "This journey was an intermediate step in a larger process. We have new plans for 2012." Mainly funded by the European Research Council, the project seeks to develop technologies to enhance road safety and fuel efficiency by supporting driver decision-making. Researchers noted the affordable technologies used could be integrated into most existing cars. The World Health Organization reports that more than 1.2 million people die annually in road accidents.
translated_content: Sebuah van tanpa pemandu mencipta rekod baharu untuk perjalanan terpanjang oleh kenderaan autonomi, bermula dari Itali dan tiba di China selepas menempuh 13,000 kilometer (8,077 batu), menurut penyelidik. Dikendalikan oleh syarikat teknologi Itali, Vislab, van itu tiba di Ekspo Dunia Shanghai pada hari Khamis selepas berlepas dari Itali pada 20 Julai. Perjalanan ini mengambil masa tiga bulan dan merentasi Eropah Timur, Rusia, Kazakhstan, Gurun Gobi di China, serta melintasi Tembok Besar sebelum sampai ke ekspo. Menggunakan sepenuhnya tenaga elektrik, van itu menghadapi pelbagai keadaan cuaca, seperti hujan, ribut salji, dan panas terik, namun tiba di Shanghai tanpa masalah besar, lapor penyelidik yang memantau perjalanan tersebut. Menariknya, van itu juga mengambil penumpang hitchhiker di luar Moscow. "Kami sangat gembira. Ini satu pencapaian besar dalam bidang robotik kenderaan," kata penyelidik utama Alberto Broggi dari Universiti Parma. Van tersebut dilengkapi dengan 12 sensor canggih—seperti kamera, sensor karbon dioksida, GPS, dan pengimbas laser luar jalan—dan menavigasi tanpa peta, sebaliknya bergantung kepada teknologinya sendiri. Maire Geoghegan-Quinn, ketua penyelidikan, inovasi, dan sains Suruhanjaya Eropah, berkata, "Perjalanan tanpa pemandu ke China ini menunjukkan sains mampu mencetuskan imaginasi masyarakat dengan pencapaian yang sebelum ini dianggap mustahil dan memberikan manfaat penting dari segi alam sekitar serta ekonomi." Pencapaian ini hadir ketika teknologi kenderaan autonomi berkembang pesat. Baru-baru ini, Google melaporkan kenderaan pandu sendiri mereka telah menghabiskan perjalanan sejauh 350 batu (563 kilometer) di California, dan menyatakan kereta autonomi mereka telah menempuh lebih 140,000 batu. General Motors, Volkswagen, dan Universiti Stanford juga membangunkan teknologi kenderaan tanpa pemandu. Sepanjang ekspedisi, van tersebut kebanyakannya beroperasi secara automatik, hanya memerlukan campur tangan manual pada masa-masa tertentu seperti ketika melewati kesesakan lalu lintas di Moscow dan bayaran tol, menurut Broggi. Dua jurutera sentiasa berada di dalam van untuk tujuan keselamatan. Van ini merupakan sebahagian daripada konvoi empat kenderaan, termasuk van utama yang kadangkala dipandu jurutera tetapi kebanyakannya bergerak secara automatik. Orang ramai sering kagum dengan van ini. Dalam demonstrasi di pinggir Moscow pada 10 September, seorang pegawai polis terkejut apabila melihat van itu tanpa pemandu sehingga jurutera menjelaskan tujuan ujian tersebut. Cabaran lain ialah menukar bateri seberat 430 kilogram di Moscow, mengurus prosedur kastam yang rumit di sempadan, dan tidur dalam kedinginan malam di Siberia. "Kami tidak risau tidak sampai ke destinasi," tambah Broggi. "Perjalanan ini adalah langkah perantaraan dalam satu proses lebih besar. Kami ada rancangan baharu untuk tahun 2012." Projek yang dibiayai terutamanya oleh Majlis Penyelidikan Eropah ini bertujuan membangunkan teknologi yang meningkatkan keselamatan jalan raya dan kecekapan bahan api dengan membantu keputusan pemandu. Penyelidik berkata teknologi yang digunakan adalah mampu milik dan boleh disepadukan ke dalam kebanyakan kereta sedia ada. Menurut Pertubuhan Kesihatan Sedunia, lebih 1.2 juta orang maut dalam kemalangan jalan raya setiap tahun.

article_content: If your Monday commute has left you feeling frazzled, former NHS executive Celia Gaze may have the perfect remedy—llama trekking. At 42, Celia founded the Wellbeing Farm in Edgworth, near Bolton, Greater Manchester, with her partner Stephen Whitehead. The retreat offers overworked business professionals a rural escape featuring llama walks, basket weaving, and country cookery classes to help guests relax and unwind. Celia, a mother to five-year-old Matthew, launched the business after struggling to balance parenthood with a demanding career as an NHS financial troubleshooter. She recalls working 70-hour weeks and finding it impossible to switch off, leading to stress-related health problems. Despite the NHS emphasizing a good work-life balance, Celia admits she set high standards for herself, which eventually led to burnout. During her career, Celia held senior roles including Head of Service Integration at Barnet & Chase Farm Hospitals and Primary Care Manager at King's College Hospital in London. In 2009, she became the Turnaround Director for NHS Bury Primary Care Trust, but the relentless workload led to sleep problems, anxiety, and eventual sick leave. After resigning, Celia realized the value of stepping back and prioritizing well-being. Inspired by meeting others running self-help courses, she obtained qualifications in stress management and transformed her partner's farmland into the Wellbeing Farm. The retreat offers creative, hands-on activities and animal interactions aimed at reducing stress and promoting a healthier lifestyle. Celia hopes to challenge the stigma around stress, emphasizing that anyone can be affected. She believes the Wellbeing Farm turns her own stressful experience into something positive for others.

Retreat ini menawarkan kepada profesional perniagaan peluang melarikan diri ke kawasan desa, dengan aktiviti berjalan bersama llama, anyaman bakul, dan kelas masakan desa untuk membantu tetamu berehat dan menenangkan fikiran. Celia, ibu kepada Matthew yang berusia lima tahun, memulakan perniagaan ini selepas bergelut mengimbangi tugas sebagai ibu dan kerjaya mencabar sebagai pakar kewangan NHS. Dia mengimbau rutin kerja sehingga 70 jam seminggu sehingga sukar untuk berehat, menyebabkan masalah kesihatan akibat tekanan. Walaupun NHS menekankan kepentingan keseimbangan kerja dan hidup, Celia mengakui meletakkan standard tinggi kepada dirinya sendiri, yang akhirnya membawa kepada keletihan melampau. Sepanjang kerjayanya, Celia memegang jawatan tinggi termasuk Ketua Integrasi Perkhidmatan di Barnet & Chase Farm Hospitals dan Pengurus Penjagaan Primer di King's College Hospital di London. Pada 2009, beliau menjadi Pengarah Pemulihan untuk NHS Bury Primary Care Trust, tetapi beban kerja yang berterusan mengakibatkan gangguan tidur, kegelisahan, dan akhirnya cuti sakit. Selepas meletak jawatan, Celia menyedari pentingnya mengambil langkah ke belakang dan mengutamakan kesejahteraan diri. Terinspirasi selepas bertemu dengan individu yang mengendalikan kursus bantuan diri, beliau memperoleh kelayakan dalam pengurusan tekanan dan mengubah tanah ladang milik pasangannya menjadi Wellbeing Farm. Retreat ini menawarkan aktiviti kreatif berasaskan praktikal dan interaksi dengan haiwan untuk membantu mengurangkan tekanan dan menggalakkan gaya hidup yang lebih sihat. Celia berharap dapat mengatasi stigma mengenai isu tekanan, menekankan bahawa sesiapa sahaja boleh terkesan. Beliau percaya Wellbeing Farm telah mengubah pengalaman tekanan dirinya menjadi sesuatu yang positif untuk orang lain.

article_content: Modern social discovery applications offer users new ways to learn about the people and events around them in real-time using interests and locations. Yet, these innovations bring increased scrutiny towards the evolving definition of privacy in the social media space. In recent years, platforms such as Instagram have updated their privacy policies—sometimes resulting in public backlash—while others, like Path, have faced regulatory investigations over how they collect and use personal data. With more social discovery apps appearing, user transparency and discretion remain critical. Interestingly, while a new Pew Internet report points to teens sharing more personal details (like photos, phone numbers, and locations) compared to past years, it also notes that many are actively taking steps to manage who sees their information. However, only a small percentage express serious concern about third parties accessing what they share. Some users remain wary of location-sharing features. For example, Jordan Kaneshiro from Honolulu says that continuous updates about his whereabouts don't add value to his daily routine and prefers only limited sharing, such as meeting a friend nearby. To better understand the delicate balance between sharing and oversharing, developers behind apps like Imo.im, Highlight, and Banjo shared their strategies to make privacy controls more accessible. Imo.im, which lets users call, message, and chat with groups of friends, now features a broadcast channel to connect people with similar interests. According to CEO Ralph Harik, building trust through transparent policies and clear controls is a top priority. Users on Imo.im can block unwanted interactions, hide their availability, and manage broadcasts—earning or spending 'communication points' to interact with people outside their contacts. User Dan Hlavenka from Illinois notes that while broadcasts sometimes attract unusual topics, he typically encounters engaging content like new recipes or music. Yet, he remains cautious about sharing information that could identify him personally. Meanwhile, the Highlight app notifies users when others are nearby and reveals details like shared interests and mutual friends. For some, this adds value in bigger cities, though others like Katherine Stewart in Richmond find the feature invasive due to its limited local user base. Founder Paul Davison believes wider acceptance of such technologies depends on evolving social norms, but emphasizes that privacy settings let users control their visibility or even disappear from the map. Banjo aggregates public posts from several networks—such as Facebook, Twitter, Instagram—based on location, allowing users to follow live or past events worldwide. CEO Damien Patton highlights that Banjo checks each network's privacy settings to respect users' audience choices, only revealing a user's location with their explicit permission. Ultimately, app creators underline the importance of giving users control over data sharing. While some like Dan Hlavenka are comfortable interacting with strangers as long as their precise location isn't shared, others remain vigilant. As social discovery tools become commonplace, users continue to navigate the trade-offs between privacy and the value of connection.
translated_content: Aplikasi penemuan sosial moden membolehkan pengguna mengetahui tentang orang dan acara di sekitar mereka secara masa nyata berdasarkan minat dan lokasi. Namun, inovasi ini meningkatkan perhatian terhadap takrif privasi yang semakin berubah dalam dunia media sosial. Baru-baru ini, platform seperti Instagram telah mengemas kini polisi privasi mereka—kadang kala menerima reaksi negatif—manakala Path pula menjalani siasatan pihak berkuasa berhubung cara mereka mengumpul dan menggunakan data peribadi. Dengan lebih banyak aplikasi penemuan sosial muncul, ketelusan dan budi bicara pengguna kekal penting. Menariknya, laporan Pew Internet terbaru menunjukkan remaja kini berkongsi lebih banyak butiran peribadi (seperti foto, nombor telefon dan lokasi) berbanding sebelum ini, tetapi ramai juga mengambil langkah untuk mengawal siapa yang boleh melihat maklumat mereka. Namun, hanya sebilangan kecil benar-benar bimbang tentang pihak ketiga yang mungkin mengakses apa yang mereka kongsikan. Sebahagian pengguna masih berhati-hati terhadap ciri perkongsian lokasi. Contohnya, Jordan Kaneshiro dari Honolulu berkata kemas kini lokasi yang berterusan tidak memberi nilai tambah kepada rutin hariannya dan beliau lebih suka perkongsian terhad seperti bertemu rakan berdekatan. Bagi memahami keseimbangan antara perkongsian yang bermanfaat dan keterlaluan, pembangun aplikasi seperti Imo.im, Highlight, dan Banjo berkongsi strategi mereka untuk memudahkan kawalan privasi. Imo.im, yang membolehkan pengguna membuat panggilan, menghantar mesej dan berbual dalam kumpulan, kini mempunyai saluran siaran untuk menghubungkan individu dengan minat yang sama. Menurut CEO Ralph Harik, membina kepercayaan melalui polisi yang telus dan kawalan jelas adalah keutamaan utama. Pengguna Imo.im boleh menyekat interaksi yang tidak diingini, menyembunyikan ketersediaan, dan mengurus siaran—sama ada memperoleh atau menggunakan 'mata komunikasi' untuk berinteraksi di luar senarai kenalan mereka. Pengguna Dan Hlavenka dari Illinois menyatakan walaupun siaran kadang kala menarik topik luar biasa, biasanya beliau menemui kandungan menarik seperti resipi baru atau muzik. Namun, beliau tetap berhati-hati berkongsi maklumat yang boleh mendedahkan identitinya. Sementara itu, aplikasi Highlight memaklumkan pengguna bila orang lain berada berhampiran dan memaparkan butiran seperti minat bersama dan rakan seangkatan. Bagi sesetengah orang, ini sangat berguna di bandar besar, tetapi Katherine Stewart dari Richmond mendapati fungsi ini agak mengganggu kerana bilangan pengguna tempatan yang terhad. Pengasas Paul Davison percaya penerimaan lebih luas bergantung pada norma sosial yang berubah, namun menekankan tetapan privasi membolehkan pengguna mengawal keterlihatan atau terus 'hilang' dari peta. Banjo pula mengumpul siaran awam dari pelbagai rangkaian seperti Facebook, Twitter, dan Instagram berdasarkan lokasi, dan membenarkan pengguna mengikuti acara secara langsung atau melihat semula acara terdahulu di seluruh dunia. CEO Damien Patton menegaskan Banjo memeriksa tetapan privasi setiap rangkaian agar perkongsian sepadan dengan pilihan pengguna, dan hanya menayangkan lokasi pengguna dengan izin mereka. Akhirnya, pencipta aplikasi menegaskan kepentingan pengguna mempunyai kawalan terhadap maklumat yang dikongsi. Walaupun sesetengah seperti Dan Hlavenka selesa berinteraksi dengan orang asing asalkan lokasi tepat tidak didedahkan, ramai lagi yang kekal berjaga-jaga. Apabila alat penemuan sosial semakin popular, pengguna terus meneliti kelebihan dan risiko privasi demi hubungan yang lebih bermakna.

article_content: The U.S. Senate voted on Monday to begin debate on the Employment Nondiscrimination Act (ENDA), a bill aimed at protecting lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender (LGBT) employees from workplace discrimination. This is the first Senate vote on such legislation since 1996; the current version is broader, including protections for both sexual orientation and gender identity. The Senate procedural vote exceeded the 60-vote threshold with support from all Democrats, two Democratic-leaning Independents, and seven Republicans—resulting in 61 votes. Following the vote, the White House issued a statement expressing President Obama’s anticipation of the Senate’s consideration and thanking bipartisan lawmakers for supporting fairness and equality. While the bill cleared this initial Senate step, its fate in the Republican-led House of Representatives remains uncertain. The measure would give LGBT workers the same legal protections from discrimination as those based on race, gender, and religion, prohibiting employers from discrimination based on actual or perceived sexual orientation or gender identity. Support for ENDA increased with endorsements from all 53 Democrats, two independents, and Republican co-sponsors—Senators Mark Kirk of Illinois and Susan Collins of Maine. Senator Dean Heller of Nevada also announced his support Monday. Additionally, Republican Senators Orrin Hatch, Lisa Murkowski, Kelly Ayotte, Pat Toomey, and Rob Portman voted to advance the bill. Senator Collins expressed hope that bipartisan support in the Senate would prompt action in the House. She stated, 'I think it was Republican votes that made the difference tonight, and that is a strong signal. Attitudes are changing quickly on gay rights issues.' However, House Speaker John Boehner has expressed strong opposition, claiming the bill could cause frivolous lawsuits and hinder job growth, especially for small businesses. House Republican Leader Eric Cantor indicated Republican leaders would review the bill if it passes the Senate. Meanwhile, House Democratic Leader Nancy Pelosi believes ENDA could pass with support from most Democrats and some Republicans. Chad Griffin, president of the Human Rights Campaign, criticized Boehner's opposition, while conservative organizations like Heritage Action urged Republicans to reject the bill on grounds of religious liberty and potential impacts on job creation. Tony Perkins of the Family Research Council also opposed ENDA, warning about effects on religious and private institutions. ENDA includes exemptions for religious organizations and businesses with fewer than 15 employees, but some critics argue these should be expanded to secular businesses, a move supporters say would weaken the bill’s purpose. Supporters, including President Obama, have publicly advocated the bill, describing LGBT job discrimination as 'offensive and wrong.' New Jersey Senator Cory Booker and Wisconsin Senator Tammy Baldwin have also spoken strongly in favor. Business leaders like Apple CEO Tim Cook have endorsed ENDA as well. Currently, 21 states have laws supporting lesbian and gay employees, and 17 states protect transgender workers from discrimination. ENDA would establish these safeguards nationwide and in the District of Columbia.
translated_content: Senat Amerika Syarikat mengundi pada hari Isnin untuk memulakan perbahasan mengenai Employment Nondiscrimination Act (ENDA), satu rang undang-undang yang bertujuan melindungi pekerja lesbian, gay, biseksual dan transgender (LGBT) daripada diskriminasi di tempat kerja. Ini merupakan kali pertama sejak 1996 Senat mengundi mengenai undang-undang sebegini; versi terkini lebih menyeluruh, merangkumi perlindungan untuk orientasi seksual dan identiti jantina. Undian prosedur di Senat melepasi ambang 60 undi dengan sokongan semua Demokrat, dua bebas pro-Demokrat, dan tujuh Republikan—menjadikan jumlah 61 undi. Selepas undian itu, White House mengeluarkan kenyataan bahawa Presiden Obama menantikan pertimbangan Senat dan mengucapkan terima kasih kepada ahli politik dua parti yang menyokong keadilan dan kesaksamaan. Walaupun rang undang-undang ini melepasi peringkat awal di Senat, nasibnya di Dewan Perwakilan yang dikuasai Republikan masih tidak menentu. Rang undang-undang ini akan memberikan perlindungan undang-undang yang sama kepada pekerja LGBT seperti yang dijamin atas dasar bangsa, jantina dan agama, sekaligus melarang majikan daripada mendiskriminasi berdasarkan orientasi seksual atau identiti jantina sebenar atau yang dianggap. Sokongan terhadap ENDA meningkat dengan sokongan semua 53 Demokrat, dua bebas, serta penaja bersama Republikan—Senator Mark Kirk dari Illinois dan Senator Susan Collins dari Maine. Senator Dean Heller dari Nevada juga mengumumkan sokongannya pada hari Isnin. Selain itu, Senator Republikan Orrin Hatch, Lisa Murkowski, Kelly Ayotte, Pat Toomey, dan Rob Portman turut mengundi bagi membolehkan rang undang-undang ini dibahaskan. Senator Collins berharap sokongan dua parti di Senat akan mendorong tindakan di Dewan. Beliau berkata, 'Saya rasa undi Republikan yang membuat perubahan malam ini dan itu satu petanda yang kuat. Sikap terhadap isu hak asasi gay berubah dengan sangat cepat.' Namun, Speaker Dewan John Boehner telah menyatakan penentangan tegas, mengatakan rang undang-undang ini boleh menyebabkan saman remeh dan memberi kesan kepada pertumbuhan pekerjaan, terutamanya untuk perniagaan kecil. Ketua Republikan Dewan Eric Cantor menyatakan pemimpin Republikan akan mengkaji rang undang-undang ini jika diluluskan di Senat. Sementara itu, Ketua Demokrat Dewan Nancy Pelosi yakin ENDA boleh lulus dengan sokongan majoriti Demokrat dan sebilangan Republikan. Chad Griffin, presiden Human Rights Campaign, mengkritik pendirian Boehner, manakala organisasi konservatif seperti Heritage Action menggesa Republikan menolak rang undang-undang atas alasan kebebasan beragama dan kemungkinan kesan terhadap penciptaan pekerjaan. Tony Perkins dari Family Research Council turut menentang ENDA dan memberi amaran mengenai impaknya terhadap institusi agama dan swasta. ENDA merangkumi pengecualian untuk organisasi agama dan perniagaan dengan kurang daripada 15 pekerja, namun beberapa pengkritik mahu pengecualian ini diperluaskan kepada perniagaan sekular, yang menurut penyokong akan melemahkan objektif rang undang-undang ini. Penyokong, termasuk Presiden Obama, telah secara terbuka memperjuangkan rang undang-undang ini, dengan menyifatkan diskriminasi kerja terhadap LGBT sebagai 'menyinggung dan salah.' Senator Cory Booker dari New Jersey dan Senator Tammy Baldwin dari Wisconsin juga menyuarakan sokongan yang kuat. Pemimpin perniagaan seperti CEO Apple, Tim Cook, turut menyokong ENDA. Kini, terdapat 21 negeri yang mempunyai undang-undang melindungi pekerja lesbian dan gay, dan 17 negeri melindungi pekerja transgender daripada diskriminasi. ENDA akan memperkenalkan perlindungan ini di seluruh negara dan District of Columbia.

Faced with increasing global tensions and competitive pressure from nations such as Russia and China, US special operations forces are working hard to maintain peak performance. Their abilities were on display at the 2023 US Army Special Operations Command Best Combat Diver Competition, held over three days at Naval Air Station Key West. Thirteen two-person teams representing Army and Navy special-operations units competed in ten demanding events that evaluated both physical fitness and tactical know-how, including underwater navigation, parachuting into water, and helicopter insertions.

The competition concluded with Green Berets earning the top three spots: first place went to a 5th Special Forces Group team, second to the 2nd Special Warfare Training Group, and third to another 5th Special Forces Group team. The Navy SEALs' highest finish was fourth place, claimed by SEAL Delivery Vehicle Team One.

Major Brandon Schwartz, commander of the Special Forces Underwater Operations School, praised everyone involved for their dedication and highlighted the minimal point differences separating teams—showing just how closely matched the SEALs and Green Berets are. Army competitors shared that interacting with SEALs helped boost teamwork and knowledge-sharing between the two groups, ultimately benefiting the entire special-operations community.

Diving remains a challenging specialty few Green Berets pursue, yet it is increasingly valued as US military focus shifts to the Indo-Pacific, where underwater operations are strategically significant. During years when military efforts centered on ground operations in the Middle East, combat diver programs suffered from reduced investment and training, resulting in equipment and readiness issues. Now, with attention returning to great-power competition, resources and interest are once again pouring into combat diving.

Lino Miani, a former Special Forces officer and current president of the Combat Diver Foundation, explained that combat divers complicate adversaries' planning and also help train allied forces, expanding the US military’s options even in regions where its own personnel may not be directly involved. 

While improved support is revitalizing the combat diver field, challenges persist, especially around rigorous training and equipment needs. Nevertheless, the community is experiencing a renewed sense of importance and prestige.

The article’s author, Stavros Atlamazoglou, is a defense journalist, Hellenic Army veteran, and current law student.

Menghadapi persaingan global yang semakin sengit, termasuk dari Rusia dan China, pasukan operasi khas Amerika Syarikat terus berusaha mengekalkan prestasi terbaik mereka. Kehebatan mereka telah ditampilkan dalam Pertandingan Penyelam Tempur Terbaik Komando Operasi Khas Tentera AS 2023 yang berlangsung selama tiga hari di Naval Air Station Key West. Sebanyak tiga belas pasukan dua anggota dari unit-unit operasi khas Darat dan Laut bertanding dalam sepuluh acara mencabar yang menguji ketahanan fizikal serta kemahiran taktikal, seperti navigasi bawah air, terjunan payung ke air, dan penyusupan dengan helikopter.

Pertandingan ini menyaksikan Green Berets menguasai tiga tempat teratas: tempat pertama dan ketiga oleh pasukan 5th Special Forces Group, manakala tempat kedua oleh 2nd Special Warfare Training Group. Navy SEALs dari SEAL Delivery Vehicle Team One pula menduduki tempat keempat.

Mejar Brandon Schwartz, komander Sekolah Operasi Bawah Air Pasukan Khas, menzahirkan rasa bangga atas dedikasi semua peserta, dan juga menekankan jurang mata yang kecil sebagai bukti keupayaan kedua-dua SEAL dan Green Beret. Peserta Tentera Darat berkongsi bahawa interaksi dengan SEAL telah meningkatkan kerjasama serta perkongsian ilmu, memperkukuh sinergi unit operasi khas.

Bidang penyelam tempur dianggap antara cabang yang paling sukar dan hanya segelintir Green Beret memilihnya, namun nilainya semakin meningkat khususnya dengan fokus strategik AS kini beralih ke Indo-Pasifik di mana operasi bawah air jadi penting. Ketika tumpuan sebelum ini di Timur Tengah, program penyelam tempur terjejas akibat kekurangan latihan dan pelaburan. Kini, dengan perhatian beralih ke pesaing utama, latihan serta keupayaan penyelam tempur semakin mendapat perhatian.

Menurut Lino Miani, bekas pegawai Pasukan Khas dan Presiden Combat Diver Foundation, penyelam tempur membebankan perancangan pihak lawan serta memperkuat latihan pasukan sekutu, memberi lebih banyak pilihan kepada tentera AS. 

Walaupun bidang ini semakin mendapat sokongan, cabaran masih wujud terutamanya dari segi latihan yang berat dan keperluan peralatan. Namun komuniti ini kini menikmati peningkatan pengiktirafan dan prestij.

Penulis artikel, Stavros Atlamazoglou, adalah wartawan pertahanan, bekas anggota Hellenic Army, dan kini pelajar undang-undang.

article_content: Bacary Sagna is scheduled to hold formal talks with Manchester City next week and is increasingly likely to join the Barclays Premier League champions. Sagna will play his final match for Arsenal in the FA Cup Final against Hull before entering discussions with City, prior to joining up with his France teammates for the World Cup. This move would end Sagna’s seven-year association with Arsenal, with his contract set to expire next month. Sagna is expected to sign a four-year contract worth £100,000 per week at Manchester City’s Etihad Stadium. The right-back wants to settle his future before the Brazil 2014 World Cup to focus on the tournament. Unless talks break down, Sagna will likely become the latest former Arsenal player to join City, following Gael Clichy and Samir Nasri in recent years. Manchester City manager Manuel Pellegrini is reportedly seeking a new right-back, with Sagna seen as a key target.
translated_content: Bacary Sagna dijangka akan mengadakan perbincangan rasmi dengan Manchester City minggu depan dan berkemungkinan besar akan menyertai juara Barclays Premier League itu. Langkah ini akan menamatkan tempoh tujuh tahun Sagna bersama Arsenal, dengan kontraknya dijangka tamat bulan depan. article_content: The Royal Navy’s introduction of its redesigned uniforms has been postponed after the first shipment arrived in poor condition. An initial delivery of 1,700 'Combat Number 4 Dress' uniforms was rendered unusable due to insufficient drying following steam cleaning, resulting in mould. The uniforms, originally scheduled for distribution this month, have thus been delayed. Engineered for practicality and greater ease of use, the new attire replaces buttons with Velcro fastenings and shoelaces with zip-up boots. A standout element is the adoption of American-style baseball caps, which has led to criticism from those favoring naval tradition. The uniform was first tested on HMS Daring in 2012. This update marks the most significant change to operational dress in over 20 years, replacing the Royal Navy’s standard light blue outfit. The contract, valued at £250,000 and carried out by a British manufacturer, is intended to provide clothing better suited to the varied climates encountered during global operations. The Ministry of Defence highlighted the uniforms as a 'daring fashion statement'—a reference to HMS Daring, where they were trialed during counter-piracy efforts in the Arabian Gulf. Officials acknowledge the embarrassment of the setback but stress the delay is temporary. Collaboration with suppliers is ongoing, and the goal remains for most Royal Navy personnel to have received their new uniforms by July 2015. Formal uniforms will continue to be used at ceremonial and official functions.

Oleh itu, penyerahan pakaian seragam yang dijadualkan bulan ini terpaksa ditunda. Direka untuk kemudahan dan praktikaliti, pakaian baharu ini menggantikan butang dengan Velcro dan tali kasut dengan but zip. Ciri paling menonjol adalah topi besbol gaya Amerika, yang mendapat kritikan daripada penyokong tradisi tentera laut. Pakaian ini pertama kali diuji pada tahun 2012 di HMS Daring. Perubahan ini adalah yang paling besar untuk pakaian operasi dalam tempoh lebih 20 tahun, menggantikan pakaian biru muda standard Tentera Laut Diraja. Kontrak bernilai £250,000 dengan pengeluar British ini bertujuan menyediakan pakaian yang lebih sesuai untuk cuaca berbeza semasa operasi di seluruh dunia. Kementerian Pertahanan menyifatkan pakaian seragam baharu ini sebagai 'penyataan fesyen berani'—merujuk kepada HMS Daring yang digunakan semasa misi membanteras lanun di Teluk Arab. Pegawai mengakui kelewatan ini sesuatu yang memalukan namun menegaskan bahawa ia hanya bersifat sementara. Usaha bersama pembekal masih berlangsung dan sasaran ialah kebanyakan anggota akan menerima pakaian seragam baru menjelang Julai 2015. Sementara itu, pakaian rasmi masih akan digunakan semasa majlis rasmi dan istiadat.

Amid ongoing debates between gun-control advocates and gun-rights supporters, Texas Republican Representative Steve Stockman is demonstrating his firm support for the Second Amendment by giving away a Bushmaster AR-15 rifle. This is the same model of firearm used in the Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting in Connecticut, where 26 people were killed. Stockman, who describes himself as 'the most conservative Congressman in Texas,' is running for a second term. His campaign - not his government office - is offering the AR-15 as a prize to those who join his online mailing list.

The announcement drew immediate and mixed reactions on social media, with some accusing Stockman of insensitivity toward the victims of Sandy Hook. In April, his campaign also sparked controversy with a bumper sticker reading, 'If babies had guns they wouldn't be aborted. Vote Pro-Life!'

Donny Ferguson, Stockman's spokesman, claimed that the campaign has received mostly positive feedback, particularly from those who support gun rights. However, Democratic National Committee Communications Director Brad Woodhouse called out Stockman for a lack of sensitivity to the families affected by the Connecticut tragedy. Supporters of Stockman argue that armed guards could prevent such tragedies, while others point out that Adam Lanza did not use his AR-15 during the attack, as police later found it unused in the trunk of his car.

The National Rifle Association (NRA), with approximately 5 million members, has advocated for more armed security in schools and showcased a variety of firearms at its annual convention in Houston, including the AR-15. NRA member Chuck Smith compared restrictions on the AR-15 to banning rental trucks because they had been used in crimes.

According to Stockman's campaign rules, the winner of the AR-15 must be at least 18, pass a background check, and meet all legal requirements under federal, state, and local law. These requirements align with existing laws on firearm ownership and transfer.

Twitter became a battleground for the issue after Stockman's giveaway announcement, with users arguing fiercely both for and against the campaign. Stockman's campaign continues to highlight its alignment with the NRA and Second Amendment rights, while critics emphasize the potential insensitivity of the campaign given the connection to the Sandy Hook tragedy.

Stockman, yang menyifatkan dirinya sebagai ‘Ahli Kongres paling konservatif di Texas’, sedang bertanding untuk penggal kedua. Persatuan Senjata Api Kebangsaan (NRA), yang mempunyai sekitar 5 juta ahli, menyokong pengawal bersenjata di sekolah serta mempamerkan pelbagai jenis senjata termasuk AR-15 di konvensyennya di Houston. Kempen Stockman terus menonjolkan sokongan terhadap NRA dan hak Pindaan Kedua, manakala pengkritik tetap membangkitkan isu sensitiviti terhadap tragedi Sandy Hook.

article_content: Walmart is expected to reach its target of sourcing $10 billion worth of goods from India each year by 2027, according to a top executive. While exact progress figures were not disclosed, Andrea Albright, Walmart's executive vice president of sourcing, expressed confidence in achieving this goal. India is already one of Walmart’s leading sourcing markets, with annual exports of around $3 billion. The company revealed that since Walmart Marketplace opened this year, hundreds of Indian sellers have joined, many experiencing double-digit growth. India stands out due to the scale of its workforce, wide variety of product categories, and highly competitive pricing, Albright noted. She emphasized the unique diversity of offerings from India, spanning food, pharmaceuticals, toys, apparel, home goods, and more. In December 2020, Walmart committed to tripling its exports from India to $10 billion per year by 2027. To accelerate this effort, Walmart is preparing for its first growth summit in India, inviting export-ready suppliers—especially micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), cross-border trade suppliers, and innovative supply chain firms—to present their products. The summit, scheduled for February 14-15, 2024 in Delhi, will bring together Walmart buyers from the US and Indian companies to explore export opportunities, with potential for real-time deals. Walmart aims to boost exports in areas where India has strong expertise, including food, consumables, health and wellness, general merchandise, apparel, footwear, home textiles, and toys. Indian-made products such as apparel, homeware, jewelry, and hardlines are already reaching customers in 14 global markets, including the US, Canada, Mexico, Central America, and the UK through Walmart’s Global Sourcing office in Bengaluru, established in 2002. Other notable business updates: - The Tata Group has acquired Wistron’s manufacturing facility, positioning Tata as the first Indian firm to assemble iPhones. The $750 million deal includes debt, and both companies finalized the agreement on Wednesday. - India has surpassed mainland China in the QS World University Rankings: Asia 2024, leading in the number of represented institutions. This milestone reflects India’s advancements in research output, academic reputation, and internationalization. - Religare Enterprises Ltd’s independent directors have written to regulators, accusing the Burman family (who made an open offer for the company) of fraud and other violations.

Rugby is often considered a sport for the young, but Vince Cable, aged 71 and MP for Twickenham, challenged that perception by joining a school rugby training session at Twickenham Academy yesterday. He was accompanied by Liberal Democrat leader Nick Clegg, as both took part in the event to highlight the approaching 2015 Rugby World Cup—a potentially landmark year for British rugby.

During the session, Cable fell onto the turf but was unhurt, laughing off the incident and continuing to play despite wearing corduroy trousers and smart black shoes. Meanwhile, Clegg participated with enthusiasm, dressed in chinos and black astroturf shoes, navigating among the students in their practice games.

The visit coincided with the build-up to the England rugby team’s match against Wales in the Six Nations tournament. The Liberal Democrats are celebrating the forthcoming 2015 Rugby World Cup, scheduled to begin in September and hosted across 11 cities and 13 venues throughout the UK, from Brighton to Newcastle. According to the party, the global event will support 12,000 jobs, boost the UK economy by £2.2 billion, and leave a lasting sporting legacy.

Clegg referenced the positive legacies of the 2012 London Olympics and the 2014 Yorkshire Grand Départ of the Tour de France, voicing hope that the Rugby World Cup would inspire young people from all backgrounds to participate in sport and build national pride. He wished the England team success in the coming year, expressing hope that 2015 would be another great chapter in the nation’s sporting history.

Following the training session, Cable tweeted his appreciation for England Rugby’s youth outreach efforts in Twickenham ahead of the World Cup.
