Over the last week, scrutiny of the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) has grown regarding its treatment of conservative groups and the mysterious loss of important email correspondence. This situation escalated after the IRS announced that a number of key emails were missing due to hard drive crashes several years ago.

Lois Lerner, who previously led the IRS's unit overseeing tax-exempt organizations, is a central figure, as many of her emails—deemed crucial to probes into alleged political targeting of Tea Party and similar entities—have been lost. Lerner has declined to appear before investigators, choosing to exercise her constitutional right to remain silent.

IRS Commissioner John Koskinen is expected to answer questions about these missing emails and the reported hard drive failures during a hearing with the House Ways and Means Committee. Here is what is currently established:

A yet-to-be-determined number of Lerner's emails, sent between 2009 and 2011, were lost after a 2011 hard drive failure. However, the IRS recovered 24,000 of her emails by checking other IRS employees' message archives. So far, they have provided 67,000 emails and approximately 750,000 pages of documents to investigators.

There is disagreement over when the IRS became aware of the missing emails. Commissioner Koskinen claims investigators found out in late spring, but members of the House Ways and Means Committee say the IRS reported awareness as early as February. The reason for the delay in alerting Congress is not clear.

At the time of the email losses, IRS policy limited employee inboxes to about 1,800 emails, requiring employees to either delete older messages or store them on their local hard drives. This policy, paired with backup tapes that were erased every six months and only expanded in 2013, made emails vulnerable to loss if a hard drive crashed.

The IRS has produced internal communications confirming Lerner's hard drive was irreparably damaged and later recycled, removing any chance for additional data recovery.

More recently, the agency reported the loss of emails from six additional staffers, including Nikole Flax, who had a key role in discussions about the targeted groups. The IRS says the full extent of any permanent data loss is still under review.

Criticism from lawmakers has focused on the agency's slow and selective disclosure about additional missing emails. Senator Orrin Hatch was particularly vocal about gaps in communication, fueling further mistrust.

The debate over compliance with federal record retention laws continues. The IRS insists its policies met regulatory standards, leaving it to employees to distinguish between personal and official records to retain. Some lawmakers question whether this standard is adequate, especially because taxpayers must keep records for years while the IRS only kept emails for six months, citing costly upgrades.

Several congressional committees, predominantly led by Republicans, are investigating. The House Ways and Means Committee has requested related emails from the White House and called for a criminal probe. The House Oversight Committee has subpoenaed the IRS commissioner for more hearings, while the Senate Finance Committee has paused its nearly finished bipartisan report until receiving further clarification. Senator Hatch has also urged an independent review into how the IRS managed requests for information.

Sepanjang minggu lalu, perhatian terhadap Lembaga Hasil Dalam Negeri (IRS) semakin meningkat berikutan layanan mereka terhadap kumpulan konservatif dan isu kehilangan emel penting. Keadaan menjadi lebih rumit selepas IRS mendedahkan beberapa emel utama hilang akibat kerosakan cakera keras beberapa tahun lalu.

Lois Lerner, bekas ketua unit IRS yang mengendalikan organisasi bebas cukai, menjadi tumpuan kerana banyak emelnya—yang penting untuk siasatan tuduhan penyasaran kumpulan seperti Tea Party—tidak dapat ditemui. Lerner telah memilih untuk tidak menjawab soalan siasatan dengan menggunakan hak perlembagaannya untuk berdiam diri.

Pesuruhjaya IRS, John Koskinen, dijangka menjawab isu kehilangan emel dan kerosakan cakera keras dalam pendengaran Jawatankuasa House Ways and Means. Berikut ialah maklumat terkini yang diketahui:

Bilangan sebenar emel Lerner yang hilang antara 2009 dan 2011 masih belum diketahui selepas berlaku kerosakan cakera keras pada 2011. Bagaimanapun, IRS berjaya mendapatkan semula 24,000 emel dengan memeriksa arkib pekerja lain. Sehingga kini, sebanyak 67,000 emel dan sekitar 750,000 halaman dokumen telah diserahkan untuk siasatan.

Terdapat percanggahan waktu IRS mengetahui tentang kehilangan emel ini. Koskinen menyatakan penyiasat mengetahuinya pada penghujung musim bunga, manakala Jawatankuasa House Ways and Means mendakwa IRS tahu seawal Februari. Sebab kelewatan memaklumkan Kongres tidak jelas.

Semasa kehilangan berlaku, polisi IRS mengehadkan peti masuk pekerja kepada lebih kurang 1,800 emel dan pekerja perlu padam emel lama atau simpan pada cakera keras. Dasar ini, ditambah pula pita sandaran yang dipadam setiap enam bulan (diperkemas pada 2013), menyebabkan emel mudah hilang jika cakera keras rosak.

IRS telah menunjukkan komunikasi dalaman yang mengesahkan cakera keras Lerner rosak teruk dan sudah dikitar semula, sekali gus tiada peluang untuk proses pemulihan data lagi.

Baru-baru ini, IRS melaporkan enam kakitangan lain turut kehilangan emel—termasuk Nikole Flax, yang terlibat dalam perbincangan kumpulan disasarkan. IRS masih meneliti sama ada data ini hilang secara kekal.

Ahli politik mengkritik lambat dan terpilihnya IRS memaklumkan mengenai emel yang hilang. Senator Orrin Hatch sangat kecewa terhadap komunikasi IRS, meningkatkan lagi rasa tidak percaya terhadap agensi itu.

Pertikaian sama ada IRS mematuhi undang-undang penyimpanan rekod turut berlaku. IRS menegaskan dasar mereka ikut peraturan, namun beberapa ahli Kongres mempersoalkan kecukupannya—terutama kerana pembayar cukai perlu simpan rekod bertahun-tahun, sedangkan IRS hanya selama enam bulan, atas alasan kos penyimpanan tinggi.

Kini, beberapa jawatankuasa Kongres, kebanyakannya diketuai Republikan, meneruskan siasatan. House Ways and Means meminta emel dari White House dan mendesak siasatan jenayah, House Oversight memanggil pesuruhjaya untuk pendengaran lanjut, manakala Jawatankuasa Kewangan Senat menangguhkan laporan mereka hingga penjelasan lanjut diterima. Senator Hatch turut menyeru siasatan bebas terhadap pengurusan maklumat IRS.

article_content: A man and his teenage son were shot dead inside their photography store in La Crosse, Wisconsin. Paul Petras, 56, and his son, Andrew "AJ" Petras, 19, were killed on Saturday afternoon after hosting a photography class at May’s Community Photography. Family friends say AJ, who graduated from La Crosse Aquinas High School last year, recently announced plans to take over the business, which delighted his father. Diana Hundt, a family friend, told the La Crosse Tribune, 'You could see pride in Paul’s face.' She described Paul as a good, decent man and AJ as a kind, gentle young man ready to take over the store. Local police believe the shootings happened between 2pm and 5:15pm on Saturday, but have released no further details as the investigation continues. They are seeking help from the public. According to Steve Rose, owner of Rose Jewelers next door, it was unusual for Paul or AJ to be in the store after 2pm on Saturdays as the shop usually closed then. His son, who visited May’s around 3pm, may have been one of the last people to see AJ alive. Erin Almquist, bar manager at Fat Sam's Main Street Bistro across from the store, recalled that a man ran out of the camera shop around 5pm asking someone to call 911. Emergency vehicles filled the street minutes later. Tributes poured in on AJ’s Facebook page Saturday night, with friends describing him as friendly, selfless, and an avid snowboarder. One friend posted a picture of AJ helping at a high school ski competition, calling him a gentleman and a true friend. La Crosse police are appealing for witnesses or anyone with information about unusual activity in the area on Saturday afternoon. Captain Robert Lawrence urged, 'Even if it seems insignificant, please reach out.' Murders are rare in La Crosse; this case brings the city’s total to four this year. No arrests have been made.

Paul Petras, 56, dan anaknya, Andrew "AJ" Petras, 19, terbunuh pada petang Sabtu selepas mengendalikan kelas fotografi di May’s Community Photography. Menurut rakan keluarga, AJ yang baru tamat pengajian dari La Crosse Aquinas High School tahun lalu, baru-baru ini mengumumkan rancangan untuk mengambil alih perniagaan itu, yang sangat menggembirakan bapanya. Diana Hundt, rakan keluarga, memberitahu La Crosse Tribune, 'Anda boleh lihat kebanggaan pada wajah Paul.' Dia menggambarkan Paul sebagai lelaki yang baik dan sopan, manakala AJ sebagai pemuda yang penyayang dan bersedia mengambil alih kedai tersebut. Polis tempatan percaya insiden tembakan berlaku antara jam 2 petang hingga 5:15 petang pada hari Sabtu, tetapi tiada butiran lanjut didedahkan kerana siasatan masih berjalan. Mereka meminta bantuan orang awam. Menurut Steve Rose, pemilik Rose Jewelers yang terletak bersebelahan, adalah tidak biasa untuk Paul atau AJ masih berada di kedai selepas jam 2 petang pada hari Sabtu kerana kedai biasanya tutup waktu itu. Anaknya, yang melawat May’s sekitar jam 3 petang, mungkin antara orang terakhir yang melihat AJ hidup. Erin Almquist, pengurus bar di Fat Sam's Main Street Bistro di seberang kedai tersebut, memberitahu seorang lelaki berlari keluar dari kedai kamera sekitar jam 5 petang meminta seseorang menghubungi 911. Kenderaan kecemasan memenuhi jalan beberapa minit kemudian. Ucapan takziah membanjiri laman Facebook AJ pada malam Sabtu, dengan rakan-rakan menggambarkan beliau sebagai mesra, tidak mementingkan diri dan peminat snowboarding. Seorang rakan memuat naik gambar AJ membantu dalam pertandingan ski sekolah, memanggilnya seorang lelaki budiman dan sahabat sejati. Polis La Crosse meminta saksi atau sesiapa yang mempunyai maklumat tentang tingkah laku luar biasa di kawasan itu pada petang Sabtu untuk tampil membantu. Kapten Robert Lawrence berkata, 'Walaupun nampak remeh, sila hubungi kami.' Kes bunuh jarang berlaku di La Crosse; kes ini menjadikan jumlah kes bunuh tahun ini kepada empat. Tiada tangkapan telah dibuat.

article_content: A new King’s Fund analysis shows that the NHS policy for GPs to refer patients with suspected cancer to specialists within two weeks has not improved survival rates. Although the scheme was expected to boost the UK’s cancer outcomes compared to Europe, many patients still face delays in getting treatment after their first specialist appointment. Hospitals working to meet the two-week target sometimes end up delaying care for patients entering by other pathways, such as emergency departments. In some regions, this has made waiting times for treatments, particularly breast cancer, longer. The report highlights that some GPs are referring too many people to the fast-track system, most of whom do not have cancer, further increasing wait times for those in urgent need. Lead author Anthony Harrison stated that while the policy is politically and psychologically reassuring, only about 25% of cancer cases are picked up via the two-week referral, with most being detected after patients attend A&E with symptoms. Even though most patients on the fast-track route see specialists quickly, the study found no survival advantage over other referral methods, casting doubt on the policy’s real effectiveness. Additionally, the rate of actual cancer diagnoses from these referrals has dropped over recent years. Sara Osborne from Cancer Research UK underlines the importance of early diagnosis and supports increasing resources for GPs. The government is backing its cancer strategy with a £750 million investment, aiming to improve early detection and save thousands of lives.

article_content: Nearly 2,000 people traveling on the Viking Line ferry M/S Amorella experienced a scare on Saturday when their ship ran aground in the Aland archipelago, located in Finland’s northern Baltic Sea. According to Viking Line, the incident happened around midday but was described as minor, with the ship "just touching" the seabed. Fortunately, none of the 1,945 passengers suffered any injuries, and the crew reported that everything remained calm on board. While the ship was not taking on water, a small leak was found in one of its ballast tanks, which typically contains water and doesn’t threaten the vessel's safety. The company announced plans to guide the Amorella to Langnas port later that evening. The Amorella, which first began service in 1988, is approximately 170 meters long and has the ability to carry up to 2,480 people. All passengers remained safe throughout the episode.

Menurut Viking Line, insiden itu berlaku sekitar tengah hari dan dianggap kecil, dengan kapal hanya 'tersentuh' dasar laut. Mujurlah, tiada seorang daripada 1,945 penumpang yang cedera dan kru melaporkan keadaan tenang di atas kapal. Walaupun kapal tidak mengambil air, kebocoran kecil dikesan pada tangki ballast, yang biasanya berisi air dan tidak membahayakan kapal. Syarikat itu merancang untuk membawa Amorella ke pelabuhan Langnas pada petang yang sama. Amorella, yang mula beroperasi pada tahun 1988, berukuran kira-kira 170 meter panjang dan mampu membawa sehingga 2,480 orang. Semua penumpang kekal selamat sepanjang kejadian itu.

article_content: A senior White House official admitted on Tuesday that part of the U.S. mission in Afghanistan will be to train Afghan security forces to assist American efforts in combating al-Qaeda. This contrasts with President Barack Obama’s assurances just an hour later that U.S. involvement after 2014 would primarily serve as an advisory role. President Obama noted that Afghan security forces have been leading combat operations for the past year, but his representative underscored the necessity for the U.S. to maintain counterterrorism capabilities and continue training Afghan forces specifically to help address al-Qaeda threats. Despite discussions of drawing down, about 9,800 American troops are expected to remain in Afghanistan at the end of the year, focusing mainly on training and counterterrorism efforts. The intention is to reduce this number over time, with expectations of only a small embassy security presence by late 2016. Congressional Republicans such as Rep. Buck McKeon and Sen. Jim Inhofe have criticized the administration’s withdrawal timeline, arguing that fixed deadlines could compromise strategy and put both American and Afghan forces at greater risk. Any continued U.S. military presence depends on the signing of a security agreement with Afghanistan—a deal outgoing president Hamid Karzai has resisted, but one that his potential successors are likely to approve. Such an agreement would provide legal protections for U.S. personnel and formalize their advisory and counterterrorism roles. The Iraq withdrawal in 2011, which happened after a failure to reach a similar security agreement, led to renewed violence there, a situation U.S. officials are keen to avoid repeating in Afghanistan. Obama underlined that while direct combat is winding down, America’s commitment to supporting Afghanistan’s security remains. He acknowledged the complexity of ending wars and reaffirmed the U.S. intention to partner with Afghan forces during the ongoing transition.

Kenyataan ini berbeza dengan jaminan Presiden Barack Obama hanya sejam kemudian bahawa penglibatan AS selepas 2014 akan lebih tertumpu kepada peranan penasihat. Presiden Obama menegaskan bahawa pasukan keselamatan Afghanistan telah mengambil alih tugas utama operasi tempur sejak setahun lalu, namun wakil beliau menekankan keperluan AS mengekalkan keupayaan penentangan keganasan dan meneruskan latihan terhadap pasukan Afghanistan khusus untuk menangani ancaman al-Qaeda. Niatnya adalah untuk mengurangkan jumlah ini dari masa ke masa, dengan harapan hanya kehadiran keselamatan kedutaan yang kecil menjelang akhir 2016. Ahli Kongres Republikan seperti Rep. Obama menegaskan bahawa walaupun misi tempur semakin berakhir, komitmen Amerika untuk menyokong keselamatan Afghanistan tetap berlanjutan. Beliau mengakui betapa rumitnya menamatkan perang dan mengulangi hasrat AS untuk terus bekerjasama dengan pasukan Afghanistan dalam fasa peralihan ini.

Windek Energy, a forward-thinking Nigerian enterprise, is championing cleaner energy solutions in the country’s rapidly evolving power sector. Led by founder and CEO Nosa Igiehon Okunbo—whose upbringing in the Niger Delta fueled a personal drive for sustainable energy—the company is committed to healthier air, fewer fatalities, and fairer wealth distribution by steering Nigeria’s energy transition.

Harnessing cutting-edge technologies like AI and Web3, Windek Energy gathers extensive operational data, enabling smarter forecasting and resource optimization in oil and gas activities. Alongside improving the efficiency of hydrocarbons, the firm is focused on lowering its carbon emissions by launching renewable projects and precisely tracking its environmental impact.

A major current undertaking is the rollout of ten stations across Nigeria, set to offer compressed natural gas (CNG) for vehicles and charging points for electric cars—addressing the gap in convenient, trustworthy options for green mobility. Okunbo acknowledges that building consumer trust in these new technologies will take time, so Windek prioritizes reliability while powering these facilities themselves with renewable energy. Strategic collaboration with vehicle manufacturers, distributors, and financial partners further supports industry-wide moves toward net zero.

Key partnerships, particularly with Nigeria LNG Limited, ensure a dependable supply of clean natural gas—a vital part of encouraging widespread adoption of cleaner fuels among Nigerian motorists.

Windek’s commitment extends to uplifting local communities: the company is rolling out training programs in renewable technologies (beginning 2024) and offering targeted scholarships and grants, cultivating homegrown expertise and economic opportunity as Nigeria’s energy landscape shifts.

Looking forward, Windek aims to expand into other sub-Saharan African markets within two years and will soon launch a digital marketplace for trading renewable energy credits. The company continues to prioritize making sustainable energy affordable and accessible, enabling both companies and individuals to participate in the continent’s energy transition.

For aspiring leaders and entrepreneurs, Okunbo emphasizes the importance of perseverance, embracing innovation, and forging strong partnerships as keys to impactful success.

Windek Energy, syarikat inovatif dari Nigeria, mengetuai usaha penyelesaian tenaga bersih di sektor tenaga negara yang kian pesat membangun. Dipimpin oleh pengasas dan CEO, Nosa Igiehon Okunbo—yang berpengalaman di Delta Niger menanam iltizam untuk tenaga lestari—Windek berazam untuk mewujudkan udara lebih sihat, mengurangkan kematian dan memastikan pengagihan kekayaan lebih adil dengan memimpin peralihan tenaga di Nigeria.

Melalui penggunaan teknologi canggih seperti AI dan Web3, Windek Energy mengumpulkan data operasi secara meluas bagi membolehkan ramalan serta pengoptimuman sumber yang lebih tepat dalam aktiviti minyak dan gas. Selain meningkatkan kecekapan bahan api hidrokarbon, syarikat ini aktif mengurangkan pelepasan karbon melalui projek tenaga boleh diperbaharui serta pemantauan impak alam sekitar secara teliti.

Projek terbaru mereka ialah pembukaan sepuluh stesen di seluruh Nigeria untuk menawarkan gas asli termampat (CNG) bagi kenderaan serta tempat pengecasan untuk kereta elektrik—bertujuan memenuhi keperluan mobiliti hijau yang cekap dan dipercayai. Okunbo mengakui bahawa kepercayaan pengguna terhadap teknologi hijau ini akan mengambil masa, maka Windek mengutamakan kebolehpercayaan sambil menggunakan tenaga boleh diperbaharui pada fasiliti mereka. Kerjasama strategik bersama pengeluar, pengedar kenderaan dan institusi kewangan memperkuatkan lagi matlamat industri menuju sifar bersih.

Hubungan utama bersama Nigeria LNG Limited memastikan bekalan gas asli bersih yang konsisten—satu aspek penting bagi menggalakkan penggunaan bahan api lebih bersih oleh orang ramai.

Windek juga menekankan pembangunan komuniti tempatan: syarikat ini melancarkan program latihan tenaga boleh diperbaharui (bermula 2024) dan menawarkan biasiswa serta geran untuk membina kepakaran dan peluang ekonomi domestik.

Ke hadapan, Windek merancang untuk berkembang ke rantau Afrika sub-Sahara dalam tempoh dua tahun akan datang serta melancarkan platform digital untuk memperdagangkan kredit tenaga boleh diperbaharui. Syarikat ini terus berusaha menjadikan tenaga lestari lebih mampu milik dan mudah diakses, membolehkan syarikat dan individu menyumbang kepada peralihan tenaga benua.

Untuk mereka yang ingin menjadi pemimpin atau usahawan, Okunbo menekankan ketekunan, inovasi dan kerjasama erat sebagai rahsia kejayaan yang bermakna.

article_content: George Sakellaris is the founder, chairman, president, and CEO of Ameresco. In the early hours of August 30, 2023, Hurricane Idalia made landfall in Florida’s Big Bend region. Over the next 48 hours, the Category 3 storm swept through Florida’s Gulf Coast and Georgia’s southern border before moving into the Carolinas. With winds reaching up to 125 miles per hour, Idalia caused severe destruction to homes, businesses, vehicles, and more. It was the strongest storm to strike the area in over 125 years, leaving an estimated $20 billion in damages. Despite its impact, Idalia’s financial toll was less than Hurricane Ian’s nearly $60 billion in damages in 2022. Still, Idalia was part of a record 23 separate billion-dollar weather and climate disasters in 2023. According to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), 2023 set a new record for such disasters in just eight months. Extreme weather events are becoming more frequent, and the connection to climate change is increasingly clear. These are no longer ‘once-in-a-lifetime’ events. If we fail to act, the frequency and intensity of disasters will continue to rise, compounding the risks to communities. Organizations, including schools, businesses, healthcare providers, and governments, must ensure their infrastructure is prepared for what lies ahead. By adopting sustainable, energy-resilient technologies like distributed generation systems, organizations can ease the shift from traditional energy networks to renewable, clean energy. This transition requires more than new technology—it demands a fundamental change in organizational values and practices. Building a renewable energy infrastructure starts with embracing sustainability as a core value. Education, awareness, and organizational alignment on sustainability goals are crucial first steps. Setting energy use and emissions baselines allows organizations to track progress and establish milestones toward greater sustainability. Whether through solar panels or geothermal systems, organizations should tailor their strategies to meet near-term, mid-term, and long-term emissions reduction goals. Partnering with experienced energy providers can further streamline the transition, ensuring effective retrofitting and project success. Transitioning to net zero emissions involves ongoing monitoring, analysis, and adjustment of strategies. According to the World Wildlife Fund and the Carbon Disclosure Project, the main obstacles facing organizations include lack of expertise, limited capital, and insufficient management attention. Energy-as-a-service (EaaS) models and strategic partnerships offer ways to address these challenges by providing tailored solutions and external expertise. With the mounting evidence of climate change’s effects, immediate action is essential. To avoid worsening impacts, organizations must work toward achieving zero emissions by 2050—or sooner.
translated_content: George Sakellaris ialah pengasas, pengerusi, presiden dan CEO Ameresco. Pada awal pagi 30 Ogos 2023, Taufan Idalia melanda rantau Big Bend di Florida. Dalam tempoh 48 jam berikutnya, ribut Kategori 3 ini melanda Pantai Teluk Florida dan sempadan selatan Georgia sebelum bergerak ke Carolina. Dengan kelajuan angin hingga 125 batu sejam, Idalia memusnahkan rumah, perniagaan, kenderaan dan banyak lagi. Ia merupakan ribut terkuat yang melanda kawasan itu dalam tempoh lebih 125 tahun, menyebabkan kerosakan dianggarkan sebanyak $20 bilion. Walaupun impaknya besar, jumlah kerugian Idalia lebih kecil berbanding Taufan Ian yang menyebabkan hampir $60 bilion kerosakan pada 2022. Namun, Idalia merupakan salah satu daripada 23 bencana cuaca dan iklim bernilai bilion dolar yang dicatat pada tahun 2023. Menurut Pentadbiran Lautan dan Atmosfera Kebangsaan (NOAA), tahun 2023 mencatat rekod baharu bencana bernilai bilion dolar hanya dalam masa lapan bulan. Kejadian cuaca ekstrem semakin kerap berlaku dan kaitannya dengan perubahan iklim semakin jelas. Ia bukan lagi peristiwa yang hanya berlaku sekali seumur hidup. Jika tiada tindakan diambil, kekerapan dan tahap bencana akan terus meningkat, memperbesar risiko kepada komuniti. Organisasi seperti sekolah, perniagaan, penyedia penjagaan kesihatan dan kerajaan perlu memastikan infrastruktur mereka bersedia untuk masa depan. Dengan mengadaptasi teknologi lestari dan berdaya tahan tenaga seperti sistem penjanaan teragih, organisasi dapat memudahkan peralihan daripada rangkaian tenaga tradisional kepada tenaga boleh diperbaharui yang bersih. Peralihan ini memerlukan lebih daripada penggunaan teknologi baharu—ia memerlukan perubahan asas dalam nilai dan amalan organisasi. Pembinaan infrastruktur tenaga boleh diperbaharui bermula dengan menjadikan kelestarian sebagai nilai teras. Pendidikan, kesedaran dan penjajaran organisasi terhadap matlamat kelestarian adalah langkah awal yang penting. Penetapan asas penggunaan tenaga dan pelepasan membolehkan organisasi memantau kemajuan dan menetapkan penanda aras ke arah kelestarian. Sama ada melalui pemasangan panel solar atau sistem haba dan penyejukan geoterma, strategi organisasi perlu disesuaikan bagi memenuhi matlamat pengurangan pelepasan gas rumah hijau dalam jangka masa pendek, sederhana dan panjang. Bekerjasama dengan penyedia tenaga yang berpengalaman dapat memudahkan lagi proses peralihan dan memastikan kejayaan projek. Peralihan ke pelepasan sifar bersih memerlukan pemantauan, analisis dan penyesuaian strategi yang berterusan. Menurut World Wildlife Fund dan Carbon Disclosure Project, tiga halangan utama bagi organisasi adalah kekurangan kepakaran, modal yang terhad dan kurang perhatian daripada pengurusan. Model tenaga-sebagai-perkhidmatan (EaaS) dan kerjasama strategik menawarkan penyelesaian yang disesuaikan serta kepakaran luaran. Dengan bukti semakin jelas tentang kesan perubahan iklim, tindakan segera amat diperlukan. Bagi mengelakkan impak yang lebih buruk, organisasi perlu berusaha mencapai pelepasan sifar menjelang 2050—atau lebih awal.

article_content: The Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Jodhpur is one of 23 IITs in India and ranks among the country’s top 30 engineering colleges, according to the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) 2023. Each year, the NIRF is published by the Union Ministry of Education. In 2023, IIT Jodhpur secured an overall NIRF rank of 66, compared to its 43rd rank in 2021. Between 2019 and 2022, the institute was not listed in the NIRF overall category. For engineering specifically, IIT Jodhpur maintained a steady rank of 33 in both 2022 and 2023. IIT Jodhpur did not feature in either the QS World University Rankings 2023 or the QS Asia University Rankings 2023. Established in 2008, this new-generation IIT offers a range of academic programs, including Bachelor of Technology (BTech), Master of Science (MSc), MSc-MTech dual degree, Master of Technology (MTech), MTech-PhD dual degree, and Doctor of Philosophy (PhD). The institute’s BTech program is available in eight branches: Bioengineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, and Civil and Infrastructure Engineering.

After being missing for almost seventy years, Alfred Rosenberg's diary—a key document from a top Nazi official—has been found in the United States. Rosenberg, who played a pivotal role as chief Nazi ideologue and helped create the Holocaust’s framework, was closely associated with Adolf Hitler. While parts of the diary were presented as evidence during the Nuremberg trials following World War II, most of its content from 1936 to 1944 was unaccounted for until now.

The U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency, working with the U.S. Holocaust Memorial Museum, recovered approximately 400 pages of the original diary. Authorities believe that Robert Kempner, a former German-Jewish lawyer and U.S. prosecutor at the Nuremberg trials, secretly took the diary out of Germany. It remained hidden in his possession until his death in 1993.

The diary was later located in the hands of Herbert Richardson, an academic in Buffalo, New York. Law enforcement officials received a tip that ultimately led to the diary’s recovery in April, though how Richardson came to possess it remains under investigation. He has not responded to requests for comment.

The diary features original Nazi Party stationery and provides a firsthand account of Nazi leadership, internal conflicts, and the lead-up to and events during World War II. Rosenberg chronicled his role in orchestrating the looting of artwork and cultural goods from across occupied Europe, with his task force responsible for sending immense quantities of valuables to the Reich.

Historians, including Henry Mayer—a former Holocaust Museum chief archivist who played a key role in authenticating the diary—see this discovery as vital for understanding the operations, plans, and mindset of top Nazi officials. The diary will now be housed at the Holocaust Museum, accessible to scholars and the public.
translated_content:
Selepas hampir tujuh dekad hilang, diari Alfred Rosenberg—dokumen penting daripada salah seorang pegawai tertinggi Nazi—akhirnya ditemui di Amerika Syarikat. Rosenberg, yang memainkan peranan besar sebagai ideolog utama Nazi dan membantu merangka dasar Holocaust, merupakan individu yang rapat dengan Adolf Hitler. Sebahagian kandungan diari ini telah digunakan sebagai bukti semasa perbicaraan Nuremberg selepas Perang Dunia Kedua, namun kebanyakan catatan dari tahun 1936 hingga 1944 tidak pernah dijumpai sehingga kini.

Agensi Imigresen dan Kastam Amerika Syarikat bersama Muzium Memorial Holocaust AS berjaya mendapatkan kira-kira 400 muka surat asal diari tersebut. Pihak berkuasa percaya Robert Kempner, bekas peguam Jerman-Yahudi dan pendakwa raya AS dalam perbicaraan Nuremberg, telah membawa keluar diari ini secara rahsia dari Jerman. Ia kekal tersembunyi dalam simpanannya sehingga kematiannya pada tahun 1993.

Diari tersebut kemudian ditemui di tangan Herbert Richardson, seorang ahli akademik di Buffalo, New York. Pegawai penguatkuasa undang-undang menerima maklumat yang membawa kepada pemulihan diari itu pada bulan April, namun bagaimana Richardson memperoleh dokumen berkenaan masih dalam siasatan. Beliau tidak memberikan sebarang komen apabila dihubungi.

Diari ini, yang sebahagiannya ditulis atas kertas rasmi Parti Nazi, mengandungi catatan peribadi berkaitan kepimpinan Nazi, konflik dalaman, serta peristiwa sebelum dan semasa Perang Dunia Kedua. Rosenberg juga merekodkan peranannya dalam mengatur penjarahan karya seni dan harta budaya dari seluruh Eropah yang diduduki, dengan pasukannya bertanggungjawab menghantar sejumlah besar barangan berharga ke Reich.

Ahli sejarah termasuk Henry Mayer—bekas ketua arkib Muzium Holocaust yang membantu mengesahkan diari ini—menganggap penemuan ini sangat penting untuk memahami operasi, rancangan, dan pemikiran pegawai atasan Nazi. Diari ini kini akan disimpan di Muzium Holocaust untuk diakses oleh penyelidik dan orang awam.

article_content: A photograph alleged to show the naked genitals of Representative Anthony Weiner surfaced online on Wednesday. Conservative blogger Andrew Breitbart, during an appearance on the 'Opie and Anthony' show on Sirius XM radio, displayed the image on his cell phone, according to both Breitbart and the show's hosts. A television camera captured the image of the cell phone showing the photo, and the show's host, Gregg Hughes (known as Opie), later shared it on Twitter. Breitbart said he received the image from a woman who claimed Weiner had sent it to her during online communication. Earlier in the week, Breitbart told reporters he had an explicit, 'X-rated' photo linked to Weiner but did not plan to release it publicly at that time. When asked whether he could deny the photo's existence, Weiner responded, 'No, I cannot.' Both Breitbart and the 'Opie and Anthony' hosts stated the release of the photo was accidental and not intended by Breitbart. In a YouTube video, Hughes explained that a viewer using screen-capture technology sent co-host Anthony Cumia an image of Breitbart's phone showing the photo. Hughes then took a photograph of Cumia's cellphone displaying this screen-captured image and posted it on Twitter. Hughes commented that it became a race to share the photo online, while also expressing his belief that Breitbart did not want the photo released at that time. Breitbart also said he regretted that the image entered the public domain. The incident has led to increasing private pressure from Democrats for Weiner to resign.

article_content: With its rear bumper nearly scraping the dusty road due to a heavy load, the car’s passengers were determined not to leave anything behind as they fled their African village, threatened by rebel attacks. The former yellow taxi was crammed with over a dozen sacks and at least 11 people, including seven on its roof, as it left Damara— the last major town between SELEKA rebels and Central African Republic’s capital, Bangui. The FOMAC commander warned that any rebel attempt to take Damara would be considered a declaration of war. The rebels, who began their campaign a month ago and have captured several important towns and cities, accuse President Francois Bozize of not honoring a 2007 peace deal. Recently, President Bozize dismissed his son, Jean Francis Bozize, as acting defense minister and took direct control of the military, as neighboring countries deployed troops to assist. This week, hundreds of soldiers from Chad, Republic of Congo, Gabon, and Cameroon arrived in Central African Republic, where rebels have seized 10 towns in about a month. In Damara, an elderly woman remained in her home as rebels stayed in the transportation hub of Sibut, awaiting peace negotiations in Gabon. Rebel spokesman Col. Djouma Narkoyo said they are respecting the Economic Community of Central African States’ decision and are not advancing from Sibut. France’s U.N. Ambassador Gerard Araud announced a meeting set for January 8 in Libreville, Gabon, aiming for a political agreement and the formation of a national unity government. The African Union and regional groups are leading peace efforts, with United Nations support. Residents in Bangui said Bozize’s dismissal of his son was unsurprising after military setbacks, though some believe it is too late for such moves. Analysts Thierry Vircoulon and Jennifer Cooke suggested Bozize’s regime appears to be weakening, with public confidence declining. The United Nations called for talks between government and rebels. While rebels agreed to participate, they also demand Bozize’s early resignation. Bozize insists on completing his term ending in 2016. Bozize came to power in 2003 through a rebellion aided by Chadian forces, later winning disputed elections in 2005 and 2011. Seleka is an alliance of four rebel groups (UFDR, CPJP, FDPC, and CPSK), which have clashed in the past, causing considerable casualties and destruction.
translated_content: Dengan bampar belakang kereta hampir mencecah jalan berdebu akibat beban berat, para penumpang jelas bertekad untuk tidak meninggalkan apa-apa ketika melarikan diri dari kampung mereka di Afrika yang diancam serangan pemberontak. Bekas teksi kuning itu sesak dengan lebih daripada sedozen guni dan sekurang-kurangnya 11 orang, termasuk tujuh di atas bumbung, ketika ia meninggalkan Damara—bandar utama terakhir antara pemberontak SELEKA dan ibu negara Republik Afrika Tengah, Bangui. Komander FOMAC memberi amaran bahawa sebarang cubaan pemberontak untuk mengambil Damara akan dianggap sebagai pengisytiharan perang. Pemberontak, yang memulakan kempen mereka sebulan lalu dan telah menawan beberapa bandar dan kota penting, menuduh Presiden Francois Bozize gagal menghormati perjanjian damai 2007. Baru-baru ini, Presiden Bozize memecat anaknya, Jean Francis Bozize, daripada jawatan menteri pertahanan dan mengambil alih kawalan terus tentera, ketika negara jiran menghantar tentera untuk membantu. Minggu ini, ratusan askar dari Chad, Republik Kongo, Gabon, dan Cameroon tiba di Republik Afrika Tengah, di mana pemberontak telah menawan 10 bandar dalam masa kira-kira sebulan. Di Damara, seorang wanita tua terus tinggal di rumahnya, manakala pemberontak kekal di hab pengangkutan Sibut, menanti rundingan damai di Gabon. Jurucakap pemberontak, Kolonel Djouma Narkoyo, berkata mereka mematuhi keputusan Komuniti Ekonomi Negara-Negara Afrika Tengah dan tidak maju dari Sibut. Duta PBB Perancis, Gerard Araud, mengumumkan mesyuarat akan diadakan pada 8 Januari di Libreville, Gabon, bertujuan mencapai persetujuan politik dan pembentukan kerajaan perpaduan negara. Kesatuan Afrika dan kumpulan serantau mengetuai usaha damai dengan sokongan Pertubuhan Bangsa-Bangsa Bersatu. Penduduk di Bangui menyatakan pemecatan anak Bozize tidak memeranjatkan selepas kegagalan ketenteraan, walaupun ada yang percaya langkah itu sudah terlambat. Penganalisis Thierry Vircoulon dan Jennifer Cooke mencadangkan bahawa rejim Bozize semakin lemah dan keyakinan rakyat semakin berkurangan. Pertubuhan Bangsa-Bangsa Bersatu menyeru rundingan antara kerajaan dan pemberontak. Walaupun pemberontak setuju untuk mengambil bahagian, mereka juga menuntut Bozize meletak jawatan lebih awal. Bozize tetap bertegas menamatkan penggalnya pada 2016. Bozize mengambil alih kuasa pada 2003 melalui pemberontakan dibantu tentera Chad, dan kemudian memenangi pilihan raya yang dipertikaikan pada 2005 dan 2011. Seleka ialah gabungan empat kumpulan pemberontak (UFDR, CPJP, FDPC, dan CPSK) yang pernah bertempur sesama sendiri, menyebabkan banyak kematian dan kerosakan.

“This is where it all started,” remarks Rizal Tandjung as he gazes over the sandy stretch of Kuta Beach, where gentle waves roll onto the shore. Nearly 40 years old, Tandjung is recognized as one of Bali’s surfing pioneers. Having picked up his first surfboard at age eight, he is now a professional surfer, owns several surf shops, and serves as the president of Hurley Indonesia/Bali.

Kuta Beach, once a quiet fishing village, has transformed into a bustling tourist hotspot with a five-kilometer expanse of white sand. Today, commercial airplanes swoop into Ngurah Rai International Airport overhead, while beach loungers and numerous surf schools line the shore, catering to tourists eager for their own 'Endless Summer.'

Tandjung introduces us to Made Switra, a local surf shop owner, painter, and recreational surfer who also grew up in Kuta. “He’s the one — the first kid from the fisherman village to surf,” Tandjung says. Switra, sun-tanned from years on the water, recalls how he started surfing from a fisherman’s boat, first using a piece of wood from a chair as a boogie board before finding discarded boards left by Western visitors.

Although Bali’s consistent waves and warm water seem ideal for surfing, it only gained international recognition in the late 1960s and 70s. The release of the 1971 documentary 'Morning of the Earth,' which showcased Uluwatu’s powerful waves, put Bali on the global surfing map.

Progress in local surfing was slowed by cultural taboos. “Many Indonesians believed the sea was dangerous and that the sea god would take you away,” Tandjung explains, noting that many of his generation, and even some fishermen today, never learned to swim. He and Switra were initially seen as rebels for defying family concerns and embracing surfing.

Today, societal attitudes have shifted, and fishermen increasingly recognize the business opportunities in surfing. Some now use their boats to ferry surfers to distant reef breaks near Kuta’s airport runway, areas unreachable from the beach.

Jason Childs, a surf photographer based in Bali, has witnessed the dramatic evolution of the local surf culture. According to Childs, Tandjung, being Chinese Indonesian rather than Balinese, faced particular challenges in gaining acceptance, prompting him to work even harder and ultimately opening doors for others.

Aspiring surfers now flock to Padang Padang, in southern Bali’s Uluwatu area, famed for its fast and sometimes hazardous waves. Tandjung prepares here for the annual Rip Curl tournament, a competition he has pursued yearly since 2004. He is joined by his son, Varun—whose name means “god of the sea”—and Varun’s friends, who are eager to take on the challenging waves.

With recognition for Bali’s surfing talents growing, Childs believes it may take another 20 to 30 years for a Balinese surfer to reach the very top of the sport. Still, he expresses confidence that they will do so with style and grace. “If you could build a surfer, the Balinese are close to perfect. They can jump to their feet effortlessly, and they’re beautiful to watch.”

“Di sinilah segalanya bermula,” kata Rizal Tandjung sambil memandang ke arah pasir Pantai Kuta, di mana ombak lembut memecah ke pantai. Hampir berumur 40 tahun, Tandjung dikenali sebagai salah seorang perintis sukan luncur ombak di Bali. Bermula meluncur pada usia lapan tahun, kini beliau seorang peluncur profesional, memiliki beberapa kedai luncur, dan menjadi presiden Hurley Indonesia/Bali.

Pantai Kuta, dahulunya sebuah kampung nelayan yang sunyi, kini telah berubah menjadi destinasi pelancongan yang sibuk dengan lima kilometer pasir putih. Kini, pesawat komersial mendarat di Lapangan Terbang Antarabangsa Ngurah Rai di atas kepala, sementara kerusi pantai dan sekolah luncur memenuhi pesisir, melayan pelancong yang mengidamkan 'Endless Summer'.

Tandjung memperkenalkan kami kepada Made Switra, pemilik kedai luncur tempatan, pelukis dan peluncur santai yang juga dibesarkan di Kuta. “Beliau yang pertama — budak dari kampung nelayan yang belajar meluncur,” kata Tandjung. Switra, yang kulitnya gelap akibat banyak masa di laut, mengenang bagaimana beliau mula meluncur dari perahu nelayan, menggunakan kayu kerusi sebagai papan boogie sebelum menjumpai papan yang ditinggalkan pelancong Barat.

Walaupun Bali dengan ombak konsisten dan air hangat kelihatan sesuai untuk luncur ombak, pengiktirafan antarabangsa baru bermula pada akhir 1960-an dan 70-an. Tayangan dokumentari tahun 1971 'Morning of the Earth' yang menampilkan ombak kuat Uluwatu telah menaikkan nama Bali di peta sukan luncur dunia.

Perkembangan luncur tempatan perlahan akibat pantang larang budaya. “Ramai orang Indonesia percaya laut itu berbahaya dan dewa laut boleh membawa anda pergi,” jelas Tandjung, sambil menyatakan ramai generasinya, malah nelayan juga, tidak tahu berenang. Beliau dan Switra dianggap pemberontak kerana melanggar larangan keluarga dan memilih untuk meluncur.

Kini, sikap masyarakat berubah dan ramai nelayan melihat peluang ekonomi dalam sukan luncur. Ada yang menggunakan bot untuk membawa peluncur ke kawasan terumbu jauh berhampiran landasan lapangan terbang Kuta, lokasi yang tidak boleh diakses dari pantai.

Jason Childs, jurugambar luncur yang berpangkalan di Bali, menyaksikan evolusi budaya luncur tempatan. Childs berkata, Tandjung yang berketurunan Cina Indonesia berdepan cabaran untuk diterima komuniti luncur tempatan, menyebabkan dia bekerja lebih keras dan membuka jalan kepada orang lain.

Kini, peluncur muda menuju ke Padang Padang di kawasan Uluwatu selatan Bali yang terkenal dengan ombak laju dan berbahaya. Tandjung berlatih di sini untuk kejohanan tahunan Rip Curl yang disertainya sejak 2004. Anak beliau, Varun—yang namanya bermakna “dewa laut”—bersama rakan-rakan juga bersemangat mencuba ombak mencabar itu.

Dengan bakat luncur Bali semakin diiktiraf, Childs percaya mungkin mengambil 20 hingga 30 tahun lagi sebelum peluncur Bali benar-benar cemerlang di persada dunia. Namun beliau yakin mereka akan menonjol dengan penuh gaya dan keanggunan. “Jika boleh membina peluncur, peluncur Bali hampir sempurna. Mereka pantas berdiri di atas papan dan indah dilihat.”

article_content: During Bayern Munich’s winter training camp in Doha, Qatar, head coach Pep Guardiola was approached by fans requesting autographs and photos. When one supporter offered him a Barcelona jersey—his former club—Guardiola politely declined to sign it, gesturing with his finger before moving on to greet other Bayern fans. Guardiola, renowned for his successful period managing Barcelona, is now focused on getting Bayern ready as the Bundesliga resumes after its winter break. Although there have been reports of tension between Barcelona’s current coach Luis Enrique and senior players like Lionel Messi prompting speculation about Guardiola’s return, he has dismissed these rumors. Bayern’s squad, including players such as Xabi Alonso, Franck Ribery, Rafinha, Robert Lewandowski, Holger Badstuber, and Arjen Robben, appeared upbeat during their training session. The club finished the first half of the league unbeaten and is currently leading the Bundesliga, having dropped only six points. Before the Bundesliga restarts, Bayern will play a friendly match against Bochum on January 23, ahead of a tough league fixture away at second-place Wolfsburg on January 30.

Apabila seorang penyokong menghulurkan jersi Barcelona—kelab lamanya—Guardiola dengan sopan menolak untuk menandatangani, hanya melambai dengan jarinya sebelum beralih untuk menyapa peminat Bayern yang lain. Guardiola, terkenal dengan kejayaan beliau ketika mengendalikan Barcelona, kini menumpukan perhatian untuk mempersiapkan Bayern bagi menyambung semula saingan Bundesliga selepas rehat musim sejuk. Walaupun terdapat laporan ketegangan antara jurulatih Barcelona, Luis Enrique, dan pemain senior seperti Lionel Messi sehingga menyebabkan spekulasi mengenai kepulangan Guardiola, beliau telah menafikan khabar angin itu. Skuad Bayern yang terdiri daripada pemain seperti Xabi Alonso, Franck Ribery, Rafinha, Robert Lewandowski, Holger Badstuber, dan Arjen Robben kelihatan ceria dalam sesi latihan tersebut. Kelab ini menamatkan separuh pertama liga tanpa kalah dan kini mendahului Bundesliga dengan hanya kehilangan enam mata. Sebelum Bundesliga bersambung, Bayern akan bermain perlawanan persahabatan menentang Bochum pada 23 Januari, sebelum menghadapi perlawanan sukar menentang Wolfsburg di tempat lawan pada 30 Januari.

article_content: Paul Flowers, former chairman of the Co-operative Bank, praised the BBC for being 'really nice' to him, but his recent interview with Newsnight's Jeremy Paxman may have serious consequences. By speaking publicly about his dismissal, Flowers is believed to have breached the terms of his £95,000 severance agreement with the Co-operative Group. The organization is now attempting to recover the money. Flowers, a former Methodist minister, agreed to a pay-off—split into three installments of just over £30,000 each—after stepping down from the struggling bank last June. Although Flowers criticized most media as 'vultures,' he singled out the BBC for favorable treatment. Following The Mail on Sunday's revelations about Flowers' drug use—which breached a separate clause requiring him not to bring the company into disrepute—the Co-operative Group withheld two payments and asked for the return of the first installment of £31,000. The Newsnight interview is understood to give the Co-operative Group further grounds to reclaim the payment. Before being charged with three drug offenses last Wednesday, Flowers told waiting journalists, 'The BBC has been really nice to me but the rest of you are vultures.' The Newsnight segment faced criticism for being too lenient, as Paxman did not press Flowers on details of his drug use or other allegations, instead allowing Flowers to attribute his behavior to personal loss. Flowers denied the allegations reported by The Mail on Sunday, calling them 'pure and utter fiction.' However, he has not filed a complaint or pursued legal action against the publication. During the program, Flowers also claimed that the Co-operative Group had not contacted him since his departure, but sources from the group have disputed this, stating, 'We've asked him for the money back.' The BBC maintains that Paxman conducted a thorough and revealing interview despite the criticism.

Dengan bercakap secara terbuka tentang pemecatannya, Flowers dipercayai melanggar syarat perjanjian pampasan £95,000 dengan Kumpulan Koperasi. Organisasi itu kini sedang berusaha mendapatkan semula wang tersebut. Flowers, bekas paderi Methodist, bersetuju untuk menerima pampasan yang dibahagikan kepada tiga ansuran lebih £30,000 setiap satu selepas meletak jawatan daripada bank yang bermasalah itu pada Jun lalu. Walaupun Flowers mengkritik kebanyakan media sebagai 'burung bangkai', beliau mengakui BBC memberi layanan yang baik kepada dirinya. Susulan pendedahan The Mail on Sunday mengenai penggunaan dadah oleh Flowers—yang melanggar satu klausa berasingan yang menghendaki beliau tidak mencemarkan nama syarikat—Kumpulan Koperasi menahan dua bayaran dan meminta supaya ansuran pertama sebanyak £31,000 dipulangkan. Temu bual Newsnight difahamkan memberi alasan tambahan kepada Kumpulan Koperasi untuk menuntut semula bayaran tersebut. Sebelum didakwa dengan tiga kesalahan berkaitan dadah pada hari Rabu lalu, Flowers memberitahu wartawan, 'BBC sangat baik kepada saya tetapi yang lain semua burung bangkai.' Segmen Newsnight itu dikritik kerana terlalu lembut, apabila Paxman tidak menyoal Flowers secara terperinci mengenai penggunaan dadah atau dakwaan lain, malah membenarkan Flowers mengaitkan kelakuannya kepada kehilangan peribadi. Flowers menafikan dakwaan yang dilaporkan oleh The Mail on Sunday dan menyifatkannya sebagai 'fiksyen semata-mata.' Walaubagaimanapun, beliau tidak membuat aduan atau mengambil tindakan undang-undang terhadap penerbitan tersebut. Dalam program itu, Flowers juga mendakwa Kumpulan Koperasi tidak berhubung dengannya sejak beliau berundur, namun sumber dari kumpulan itu menafikan dakwaan itu dengan berkata, 'Kami sudah meminta wang itu dipulangkan.' BBC menegaskan bahawa Paxman telah menjalankan temu bual yang teliti dan mendedahkan maklumat, walaupun menerima kritikan.

article_content: A retired doctor is campaigning to have her great uncle's name spelled correctly on a village war memorial, nearly a century after he was killed in France at age 20 during the First World War. Alison Corfield says the misspelling of Private George Samuel's name as 'Samuels' on the memorial in Shepreth, Cambridgeshire, caused distress to his parents after the 1914-18 conflict. Authorities originally refused to correct the mistake after the memorial was erected, and the family had tried to hide the extra 's' with mud. Mrs Corfield, 67, from Shrewsbury, hopes the mistake can be corrected as the UK approaches the 100th anniversary of World War I. She has written to local councillors in Shepreth asking for the spelling to be changed. Shepreth Parish Council says it is actively pursuing the issue and will discuss it in a meeting later this month. A county councillor for Shepreth said there couldn't be a more fitting time to fix the error. Private George Samuel was a soldier in the London Regiment and was killed in France at age 20 during World War I. Mrs Corfield said the family found the error very distressing after the war, and authorities refused to alter it, so they tried to obscure the 's' themselves. She said, 'I’d like to right the wrong. It would mean a lot to me and my family, and it would be appropriate as the centenary approaches. I doubt it will be too difficult to correct the inscription.' 'We are talking about a young soldier who died in the First World War. His name was George Samuel, not George Samuels. His sacrifice should be remembered, and the mistake put right.' She believes Private Samuel fought in the Battle of the Somme and was killed on September 30, 1916. He died of wounds and is buried at St Pierre cemetery in Amiens. Shepreth Parish Council clerk Charles Cook confirmed he received Mrs Corfield's letter and the issue will be discussed at the next council meeting on April 11. Susan van de Ven, a Liberal Democrat member of Cambridgeshire County Council for Shepreth, supports the correction and believes villagers empathise with the Samuel family. Villagers and officials feel this is the right time to correct the memorial and properly recognise George Samuel’s sacrifice.
translated_content: Seorang doktor bersara berkempen untuk membetulkan ejaan nama moyangnya di tugu peringatan perang kampung, hampir satu abad selepas beliau terbunuh di Perancis pada usia 20 tahun semasa Perang Dunia Pertama. Alison Corfield berkata ejaan salah nama Private George Samuel sebagai 'Samuels' pada tugu peringatan di Shepreth, Cambridgeshire, menyebabkan kesedihan kepada ibu bapanya selepas konflik 1914-18. Pihak berkuasa pada asalnya enggan membetulkan kesilapan itu selepas tugu itu didirikan, dan ahli keluarga pernah menutupi huruf tambahan 's' dengan lumpur. Beliau telah menulis surat kepada ahli majlis tempatan di Shepreth untuk meminta ejaan tersebut diubah. Majlis Paroki Shepreth berkata mereka sedang aktif menangani isu ini dan akan membincangkannya di mesyuarat bulan ini. Seorang ahli majlis daerah untuk Shepreth berkata tiada masa yang lebih sesuai untuk membetulkan kesilapan itu. Private George Samuel ialah askar Rejimen London dan terbunuh di Perancis pada usia 20 tahun semasa Perang Dunia Pertama. Puan Corfield berkata keluarganya sangat tertekan dengan kesilapan itu selepas perang, dan pihak berkuasa menolak untuk membetulkannya, jadi mereka cuba menutupi 's' tersebut sendiri. Beliau berkata, 'Saya ingin membetulkan kesilapan ini. Ia amat bermakna kepada saya dan keluarga saya, dan sangat sesuai dilakukan sempena ulang tahun keseratus. Saya rasa tidak sukar untuk membetulkan tulisan itu.' 'Kita bercakap tentang seorang askar muda yang terkorban dalam Perang Dunia Pertama. Namanya ialah George Samuel, bukan George Samuels. Pengorbanannya patut diingati, dan kesilapan ini mesti diperbetulkan.' Beliau percaya Private Samuel telah bertempur dalam Pertempuran Somme dan terbunuh pada 30 September 1916. Beliau meninggal dunia akibat kecederaan dan dikebumikan di tanah perkuburan St Pierre di Amiens. Setiausaha Majlis Paroki Shepreth, Charles Cook, mengesahkan beliau telah menerima surat Puan Corfield dan isu ini akan dibincangkan pada mesyuarat majlis seterusnya pada 11 April. Susan van de Ven, ahli Liberal Demokrat Majlis Daerah Cambridgeshire untuk Shepreth, menyokong pembetulan ini dan percaya penduduk kampung bersimpati dengan keluarga Samuel. Penduduk dan pegawai bersetuju ini adalah masa yang tepat untuk membaiki tugu peringatan dan mengenang jasa George Samuel dengan sewajarnya.

article_content: Shoppers searching for used cars may finally see some price relief—but only for certain types. While many used car prices have dropped, pickup trucks are still holding their value. Cox Automotive’s Manheim Used Vehicle Index reports that average used car prices fell almost 4% year over year. The drop isn’t uniform. In September, compact cars had nearly a 10% year-over-year decrease in price. Midsize and luxury cars also became more affordable, with prices falling 5.9% and 6.7%. Used SUVs and vans experienced smaller drops of 3.5% and 2.3%, respectively. Pickup truck prices actually increased by almost 1%, likely due to strong work-related demand. Yet, used cars are still pricey overall. The average listing price at the start of October was $26,717. Inventory remains low—47 days' supply at the end of September, down from 54 days a year earlier. The used car market hasn’t bounced back from the pandemic. People are keeping their cars longer, there are fewer lease returns, and new car prices are so high that buyers often settle for older, higher-mileage vehicles. According to iSeeCars, $23,000 would have bought a three-year-old car in 2019—but now, that budget might only secure a much older vehicle. With fewer affordable options available, a dramatic drop in used car prices seems unlikely. The ongoing UAW strike could worsen things. Chris Frey from Cox Automotive notes that although the strike’s impact has been minimal so far, a prolonged or expanded strike could cause used car prices to rise even more.
translated_content: Pembeli yang mencari kereta terpakai kini mungkin mula melihat penurunan harga—tetapi hanya untuk jenis tertentu. Sementara harga kebanyakan kereta terpakai menurun, trak pikap masih mengekalkan nilainya. Indeks Kenderaan Terpakai Manheim oleh Cox Automotive melaporkan purata harga kereta terpakai menurun hampir 4% tahun ke tahun. Penurunan harga ini tidak seragam. Pada bulan September, kereta kompak mencatat penurunan hampir 10% berbanding tahun lalu. Kereta saiz sederhana dan mewah juga kini lebih mampu milik, turun 5.9% dan 6.7%. SUV dan van terpakai mencatat penurunan 3.5% dan 2.3%. Namun, harga trak pikap naik hampir 1%, mungkin kerana permintaan tinggi untuk kerja. Bagaimanapun, kereta terpakai masih mahal secara purata. Harga senarai purata pada awal Oktober ialah $26,717. Stok kenderaan juga terhad—hanya 47 hari bekalan pada akhir September, turun daripada 54 hari tahun sebelumnya. Pasaran kereta terpakai belum pulih sejak pandemik. Ramai yang masih menyimpan kereta lama, kurang kereta sewa dikembalikan, dan harga kereta baru yang mahal menyebabkan pembeli memilih kenderaan yang lebih tua dan banyak kilometer. Menurut iSeeCars, $23,000 pada 2019 boleh membeli kereta tiga tahun, tetapi kini, jumlah itu hanya cukup untuk kenderaan jauh lebih berusia. Dengan pilihan mampu milik yang semakin terhad, penurunan drastik harga kereta terpakai tidak mungkin berlaku. Mogok UAW yang berterusan juga boleh memburukkan keadaan. Chris Frey dari Cox Automotive berkata walaupun kesan mogok setakat ini kecil, jika ia berlarutan atau meluas, harga kereta terpakai mungkin terus meningkat.

article_content: Louis van Gaal’s first Premier League match as Manchester United manager ended in a 2-1 defeat to Swansea City on August 16. Van Gaal suggested this early setback was typical for a new manager and reminded fans that the season is long, saying, ‘You shall not be champion in this moment but in May.’ That opening loss felt like a continuation of United’s struggles from the previous season. However, as the team prepares to face Swansea away at the Liberty Stadium, Van Gaal can no longer use the same excuse for disappointing results. A poll by the Manchester Evening News found that 81% of Manchester United supporters backed Van Gaal. The team has been preparing for the league match with Swansea, as players like Robin van Persie, Wayne Rooney, and Angel Di Maria trained together at the Aon Training Complex. Expectations at Old Trafford have shifted. At the start of the season, fans hoped the club would compete for the Premier League title, but soon realized that a new manager and high-profile signings alone wouldn’t bring instant success. Over six months into Van Gaal’s tenure, United sit third in the table—12 points behind Chelsea and five behind Manchester City. Though they have not mounted a serious title challenge, qualifying for the Champions League has become the main goal. Many fans accept this, especially after missing out on European competition the previous season under David Moyes. Van Gaal has often faced media scrutiny, both at United and in previous roles such as at Barcelona. Robin van Persie and Radamel Falcao have struggled as a strike partnership, and United’s displays, including a recent 3-1 win over Burnley, have sometimes flattered to deceive. The Manchester Evening News poll showed 81% approval for Van Gaal’s first season, even with ongoing questions about his tactics. Van Gaal responded to the statistic humorously, acknowledging both the support and the media criticism. Despite only four league defeats and just one loss in their last 19 matches, United’s performances haven’t always matched the results. Wins over Burnley, Arsenal, and Southampton have rarely convinced fans United are back to their best. If you had offered most fans United’s current league position, reaching the FA Cup quarter-finals, and just one loss in 19 games before the season started, they would have gladly accepted it. The team is getting results, but the style of play—according to critics like Paul Scholes—remains uninspiring. The expensive arrivals of players like Luke Shaw, Marcos Rojo, Angel Di Maria, Daley Blind, Ander Herrera, and Radamel Falcao have yet to bring back United’s famous attacking football. There are echoes of Van Gaal’s time at Barcelona, where his tactical choices—including benching Ballon d’Or winner Rivaldo—led to skepticism and, eventually, his departure. In Manchester, questions remain about his use of Rooney in midfield, the lack of partnership between van Persie and Falcao, Herrera’s limited role, and whether the 3-5-2 formation restricts players like Di Maria. Still, Van Gaal’s team’s ability to rack up results, losing only to Southampton since November 3, is notable—even if their play is average. Rival teams like Arsenal, Tottenham, Southampton, and Liverpool may be concerned by United’s efficiency. Looking ahead to the Swansea match, Van Gaal points out that several key players—Rojo, Blind, Di Maria, Shaw—were unavailable for the opening game, suggesting the team is better prepared now. Though United are unlikely to re-enter the title race, missing out on Champions League qualification would be a major failure. Progress has been made under Van Gaal, but time and results are crucial. Juan Mata’s missed opportunities underline United’s need for improvement, as the club’s ambitions have shifted from chasing the title to securing a top-four finish.

Tinjauan Manchester Evening News menunjukkan Van Gaal menerima 81% sokongan untuk musim pertamanya, walaupun banyak persoalan mengenai taktikal beliau. Kalau dari awal musim diberikan kedudukan sekarang dalam liga, layak ke suku akhir Piala FA dan hanya satu kalah dalam 19 perlawanan, pasti ramai penyokong akan menerimanya. Pengalaman Van Gaal di Barcelona juga serupa, dengan pilihan taktikal—termasuk mencadangkan pemain terbaik dunia Rivaldo—mendatangkan keraguan dan akhirnya membawa kepada pemergiannya. Di Manchester, masih dipersoal peranan Rooney di tengah, ketiadaan gandingan efektif van Persie-Falcao, keterbatasan Herrera serta formasi 3-5-2 yang mungkin menghadkan Di Maria. Namun, keupayaan United di bawah Van Gaal untuk memperoleh keputusan—hanya kalah kepada Southampton semenjak 3 November—memang patut diberi perhatian walau permainan agak sederhana. Arsenal, Tottenham, Southampton dan Liverpool mungkin cemas dengan kecekapan United. Menjelang aksi menentang Swansea, Van Gaal tekankan beberapa pemain utama—Rojo, Blind, Di Maria, Shaw—tidak dapat diturunkan pada perlawanan pertama, memberi petanda pasukan lebih bersedia kini. Walaupun peluang berburu kejuaraan makin tipis, kegagalan ke Liga Juara-Juara tetap dianggap kegagalan besar. Kemajuan telah dicapai, namun keputusan dan masa sangat penting untuk Van Gaal. Peluang yang terlepas oleh Juan Mata membuktikan keperluan United untuk terus berubah, kerana impian kelab kini berubah daripada kejuaraan kepada impian empat teratas.

article_content:
Marvel Comics has introduced its first Muslim-American superhero, Ms. Marvel, as Kamala Khan, a fictional teenager from New Jersey. At 16, Kamala discovers her super-human abilities and sets out on an adventure full of challenges and self-discovery, explains Marvel Comics Editor In Chief Axel Alonso. Inspired by her idol, Captain Marvel, Kamala’s journey leads her to confront her conservative values. Marvel highlights that, like many teenagers, Kamala faces high parental expectations, causing her to question her future and seek her own path.

Writer G. Willow Wilson emphasizes that Ms. Marvel’s story is relatable, especially to young women, and is based on her own vivid high school memories—facing impending adulthood, school struggles, and emotionally charged friendships. Wilson says the series is for "geek girls" and anyone who has felt like an outsider.

Series editor Sana Amanat says Kamala Khan's creation arose from the desire to portray the Muslim-American diaspora authentically. Amanat notes that while Kamala's background is woven into the story, the main focus is on youth, identity, and dealing with expectations. Ms. Marvel’s debut aims to connect with readers and challenge perceptions through genuine representation.

Diilhamkan oleh idolanya, Captain Marvel, perjalanan Kamala membawanya untuk berdepan dengan nilai-nilai konservatif dalam dirinya. article_content: On Wednesday, the Senate Judiciary subcommittee held a high-profile hearing focusing on enhanced interrogation methods such as waterboarding. Ali Soufan, a former FBI agent with direct experience interrogating terror suspects, testified that these controversial techniques are not only ineffective, but also undermine efforts against al Qaeda. Soufan, who was involved in the interrogation of CIA detainee Abu Zubaydah, challenged statements from former Vice President Dick Cheney and Bush administration officials, who have insisted that such methods produced vital intelligence after September 11. He reported that he obtained actionable information from Zubaydah within the first hour using traditional tactics, but that Zubaydah ceased cooperating after harsher methods were imposed by CIA contractors. When Soufan resumed standard questioning, Zubaydah began cooperating again, but further use of coercive methods disrupted this progress. Documents newly made public revealed that both Zubaydah and Khalid Shaikh Mohammed, alleged architect of the 9/11 attacks, were waterboarded at least 266 times. Soufan asserted that information claimed to have resulted from these harsh methods could have been achieved through regular interrogations, adding that the use of coercion often had negative effects. Philip Zelikow, former adviser to Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice, testified that the Bush administration informally instructed his anti-waterboarding memo to be destroyed. He condemned the use of such interrogation programs as a serious error that inflicted dehumanizing abuse and betrayed American principles. Republicans on the committee, such as Sen. Lindsey Graham, warned that scrutinizing prior decisions could jeopardize national security and slow future responses to terrorist threats. Other intelligence officials questioned whether Soufan’s brief involvement with the Abu Zubaydah case qualified him to assess the overall value of a multi-year program. Soufan has experience leading investigations into major terror attacks, including the East Africa embassy bombings, the USS Cole bombing, and September 11. In a New York Times opinion piece, he argued that enhanced interrogation consistently failed to yield actionable intelligence unavailable via standard methods. Sen. Sheldon Whitehouse, a leading Democrat, criticized Bush-era officials for obscuring the truth about torture, claiming it damaged the country’s global standing. The hearing highlighted ongoing disagreements over the effectiveness, legality, and morality of aggressive interrogation tactics.

Ali Soufan, bekas ejen FBI yang berpengalaman secara langsung menyoal suspek pengganas, memberi keterangan bahawa teknik kontroversial ini bukan sahaja tidak berkesan, malah melemahkan usaha menentang al-Qaeda. Soufan, yang terlibat dalam soal siasat tahanan CIA Abu Zubaydah, membidas kenyataan bekas Naib Presiden Dick Cheney dan pegawai pentadbiran Bush, yang menegaskan kaedah sedemikian menghasilkan maklumat penting selepas tragedi 11 September. Beliau melaporkan bahawa maklumat boleh diperoleh dari Zubaydah dalam sejam pertama menggunakan taktik biasa, tetapi Zubaydah berhenti bekerjasama selepas kaedah lebih kasar digunakan oleh kontraktor CIA. Apabila Soufan kembali dengan soal siasat biasa, Zubaydah mula bekerjasama semula, namun penggunaan paksaan seterusnya mengganggu kemajuan yang dicapai. Dokumen yang baru didedahkan menunjukkan Zubaydah dan Khalid Shaikh Mohammed, yang didakwa perancang serangan 9/11, menerima 'waterboarding' sekurang-kurangnya 266 kali. Soufan menyatakan maklumat yang dikatakan diperoleh daripada kaedah keras ini juga boleh didapat melalui soal siasat biasa, dan penggunaan kekerasan sering memberi kesan negatif. Philip Zelikow, bekas penasihat kepada Setiausaha Negara Condoleezza Rice, memberi keterangan bahawa pentadbiran Bush secara tidak rasmi mengarahkan memorandumnya yang menentang 'waterboarding' dimusnahkan. Beliau mengutuk penggunaan program soal siasat seperti ini sebagai kesilapan serius yang melibatkan penderaan tidak berperikemanusiaan dan menjejaskan prinsip Amerika. Ahli Republikan dalam jawatankuasa seperti Senator Lindsey Graham memberi amaran bahawa menyemak semula keputusan lalu boleh membahayakan keselamatan negara dan melambatkan tindak balas masa depan terhadap ancaman pengganas. Soufan mempunyai pengalaman menyiasat serangan pengganas utama seperti pengeboman kedutaan AS di Afrika Timur, pengeboman USS Cole, dan serangan 11 September. Dalam rencana pendapat di New York Times, beliau berpendapat bahawa soal siasat melampau gagal memberi maklumat boleh tindakan yang tidak boleh dicapai melalui kaedah biasa. Senator Sheldon Whitehouse, pemimpin Demokrat, mengkritik pegawai era Bush kerana menyorokkan kebenaran tentang penyeksaan dan berkata ia telah merosakkan imej Amerika di dunia. Perbicaraan ini menonjolkan perbezaan pandangan terhadap keberkesanan, keaslian dan moraliti taktik soal siasat agresif.

article_content: Justice Secretary Chris Grayling is under increasing pressure to reverse a ban on books being sent to prisoners, a move described as ‘unenlightened’ by senior members of his own party. The restriction, part of the Ministry of Justice’s new ‘incentives and earned privileges’ scheme, prevents family and friends from sending reading materials to inmates. The policy has faced strong criticism from writers, civil liberties groups, and senior Conservatives, who argue that access to books plays a key role in prisoner rehabilitation and education. Opposition figures and campaigners have drawn comparisons to measures at high-security prisons such as Guantanamo Bay. Despite the criticism, Mr. Grayling has said that the ban is designed to prevent contraband from entering prisons through parcels and due to staffing constraints in checking incoming packages. He emphasized that prisoners still have access to prison libraries and can buy additional books with money earned through work inside. ‘We have rules regarding parcels from home,’ he stated. ‘It is incorrect to claim books are banned—prisoners can have up to 12 books in their cells and may purchase more, subject to approval.’ However, campaigners argue that prison libraries are often inadequate due to local authority budget cuts and that requiring prisoners to buy books places an unnecessary financial burden on them. Notable figures such as Professor Mary Beard and author Ian Rankin have highlighted the importance of books for education and connection to society among prisoners. Labour’s Shadow Justice Secretary Sadiq Khan criticized the move, stating it undermines efforts toward prisoner rehabilitation in a system where many inmates have low literacy levels. Under the new regime, prisoners are generally prohibited from receiving parcels except in exceptional circumstances, such as for essential medical supplies. The policy extends to other items, including basic necessities like underwear and stationery, prompting further opposition from reform advocates. Supporters argue the scheme encourages good behavior by granting greater privileges to prisoners engaged in rehabilitation, including increased opportunities to buy books.

Sekatan ini, sebahagian daripada skim 'insentif dan keistimewaan yang diperoleh' oleh Kementerian Kehakiman, menghalang keluarga dan rakan dari menghantar bahan bacaan kepada banduan. Tokoh pembangkang dan aktivis membandingkan langkah ini dengan peraturan ketat di penjara berprofil tinggi seperti Guantanamo Bay. Walaupun dikritik, Grayling menegaskan larangan ini bertujuan mencegah penyeludupan barangan terlarang melalui bungkusan serta kekurangan kakitangan untuk memeriksa semua bungkusan yang masuk. Beliau menegaskan banduan masih boleh mengakses perpustakaan penjara dan membeli buku tambahan menggunakan wang yang diperoleh hasil kerja di dalam penjara. ‘Kami ada peraturan berkaitan bungkusan dari rumah,’ katanya. ‘Adalah tidak benar untuk mengatakan buku diharamkan—banduan boleh menyimpan sehingga 12 buku di dalam sel dan boleh membeli lebih banyak dengan kelulusan pihak penjara.’ Namun, para aktivis pula berpendapat perpustakaan penjara seringkali tidak mencukupi akibat pemotongan bajet oleh pihak berkuasa tempatan dan mewajibkan banduan membeli buku membebankan kewangan mereka. Tokoh seperti Profesor Mary Beard dan penulis Ian Rankin menekankan kepentingan buku untuk pendidikan serta hubungan banduan dengan masyarakat luar. Setiausaha Kehakiman Bayangan Labour, Sadiq Khan, mengkritik langkah ini sambil mengatakan ia menjejaskan usaha pemulihan banduan, terutama dalam sistem yang ramai banduannya berkemahiran literasi rendah. Di bawah peraturan baru, banduan kebiasaannya dilarang menerima bungkusan kecuali dalam keadaan luar biasa, seperti keperluan perubatan penting. In 2011, British brothers Liam and Owen Groves suffered permanent scarring after black henna tattoos burned their skin during a vacation in Egypt. Their mother, Alison, allowed the tattoos at their all-inclusive resort, believing they were safe. However, instead of traditional henna, a gift shop worker applied black henna containing the chemical para-phenylenediamine (PPD), known to cause skin burns.

Both boys experienced severe itching and skin irritation on the flight home, leading to blistering sores. Their family doctor diagnosed them with contact dermatitis from the chemical reaction and prescribed steroid creams, but the recovery was difficult and left scars that remain years later. The scars have restricted the boys from sun exposure and prevent them from getting tattoos, hair dye, or piercings in the future.

Alison expressed deep regret and warned other parents about the risks of unregulated holiday tattoos. The family entered a lengthy legal dispute with Virgin Holidays, criticizing the company for its response. Solicitor Nick Harris highlighted concerns over the unchecked use of black henna at holiday resorts. Virgin Holidays acknowledged the boys’ injuries but stated it could not comment further due to ongoing legal action.

Ibu mereka, Alison, membenarkan tatu itu dilakukan di resort all-inclusive kerana percaya ia selamat. Namun, pekerja kedai cenderamata di hotel menggunakan henna hitam yang mengandungi bahan kimia para-phenylenediamine (PPD), yang diketahui boleh menyebabkan masalah kulit.

Kedua-dua beradik ini mengalami kegatalan dan iritasi teruk semasa penerbangan pulang, mengakibatkan luka melepuh. Doktor keluarga mendiagnosis dermatitis kontak akibat PPD dan memberikan krim steroid, namun pemulihan memakan masa yang lama serta meninggalkan parut kekal hingga kini. Kini, mereka tidak boleh terdedah kepada cahaya matahari secara langsung dan tidak dibenarkan melakukan tatu, mewarnakan rambut atau bertindik pada masa depan.

Alison benar-benar menyesal dan menasihatkan ibu bapa lain supaya berhati-hati dengan tatu ketika bercuti. Keluarga ini terlibat dalam pertikaian undang-undang yang panjang dengan Virgin Holidays, sambil mengkritik tindak balas syarikat itu. Peguam keluarga, Nick Harris, turut menegur penggunaan henna hitam tanpa kawalan di resort percutian. Virgin Holidays mengesahkan insiden itu tetapi tidak dapat memberi komen lanjut kerana isu masih dibicarakan.

article_content: Holmbush Primary School in Shoreham, West Sussex, has introduced a 'shoeless classroom' policy, encouraging students to wear only socks, slippers, or go barefoot during lessons. This initiative was recommended by the school's 'Learning Council', a group of Year Six pupils, after they found that shoeless classrooms might support better learning. After a successful trial, both children and staff agreed on the benefits and the school's governors made the policy official in January. The idea comes from Scandinavia, where removing shoes indoors helps keep classrooms clean during snowy and icy weather. Supporters believe students behave more calmly, focus better, and that the environment is cleaner as a result. At Holmbush, which is rated 'good' by Ofsted, pupils can be barefoot or wear socks and slippers in school, only putting on shoes for outdoor activities. Headteacher Rebecca Jackson stated, 'Shoeless classrooms were brought in to improve the learning environment.' A recent fire alarm highlighted a challenge, as students had to evacuate to the wet playground in socks. Some parents and carers were concerned about children getting their feet wet, with one grandmother raising safety and hygiene worries. Ms. Jackson emphasized that student safety is the top priority, noting that those with wet socks or tights were given dry ones and their own were dried later. She clarified, 'Shoeless classrooms are not about protecting carpet tiles; we haven't replaced any carpets since 2007.'
