article_content: BOSTON, MA – NOVEMBER 29: Members of the Wampanoag Nation Singers and Dancers pose for a portrait backstage before performing at the John F. Kennedy Presidential Library and Museum on November 29, 2019, in Boston, Massachusetts, in honor of Native American Heritage Month. In the 1600s, before the arrival of the Pilgrims, more than 40,000 members of the Wampanoag nation lived along the east coast of Massachusetts; today, their population is less than 5,000.  President Biden officially proclaimed November 2023 as National Native American Heritage Month, a time to recognize and celebrate the vital contributions Native Americans have made to the nation's arts, humanities, sciences, and public service.  About 8.75 million people identify as Native American in the United States. Their history includes significant hardship, such as wars, ethnic cleansing, and enslavement. The challenges faced by Native American communities involve not only political issues but also critical health disparities, especially concerning alcohol use.  While some tribes historically used fermented beverages in ceremonies before European colonization, stronger and more abusable alcoholic drinks were mainly introduced by European settlers, often as trade goods or during social interactions. The impact of alcohol has varied among tribes, but research published in Drug and Alcohol Dependence indicates that the majority of Native Americans abstain from drinking. Nonetheless, data from the Treatment Episode Data Set show that Native Americans experience the highest rates of substance dependence or abuse among racial groups in the U.S.  According to the Indian Health Service, between 2016 and 2020, alcohol-related deaths among Native Americans were recorded at a rate of 51.9 per 100,000, nearly five times the rate in the overall U.S. population (11.7 per 100,000). Alcohol-related illness and death, including accidents, injuries, mental health issues such as depression and anxiety, and chronic conditions like liver disease, are also significantly higher among Native Americans.  For example, in 2018, Native Americans were 1.8 times more likely to be diagnosed with chronic liver disease and almost four times more likely to die from it compared to Non-Hispanic Whites, according to the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services Office of Minority Health.  The American Public Health Association states that alcohol has no health benefits and is strongly associated with an increased risk of multiple cancers, including cancers of the breast, colon, mouth, esophagus, and liver.  The disproportionate health impact of alcohol on Native Americans reflects complex influences—political, genetic, social, and cultural. Notably, highly intoxicating forms of alcohol were largely foreign to Native Americans before colonization. Widespread use only followed interactions with European settlers.  Given these facts, it's worth questioning why American society continues to glamorize alcohol at social events and in media, rather than recognizing its harmful impact. Alcohol, lacking health benefits, should be understood for its potential to cause harm.  As President Biden noted, 'They serve in the United States Armed Forces at higher rates than any other ethnic group.' Honoring Native Americans means supporting effective alcohol education, increasing healthcare access, and fostering connections to traditional cultural practices, promoting a sense of belonging.  Highlighting persistent health inequities during Native American Heritage Month is a powerful way to acknowledge the legacy of the nation’s first inhabitants and encourage a healthier future for all.
translated_content: BOSTON, MA – 29 NOVEMBER: Ahli-ahli Wampanoag Nation Singers and Dancers bergambar di belakang pentas sebelum membuat persembahan di John F. Kennedy Presidential Library and Museum pada 29 November 2019, di Boston, Massachusetts, sempena sambutan Bulan Warisan Orang Asli Amerika. Pada tahun 1600-an, sebelum ketibaan Pilgrim, lebih 40,000 ahli bangsa Wampanoag tinggal di sepanjang pantai timur Massachusetts; hari ini, jumlah mereka kurang daripada 5,000.  Presiden Biden secara rasmi mengisytiharkan November 2023 sebagai Bulan Warisan Orang Asli Amerika Nasional, masa untuk mengenang dan meraikan sumbangan penting yang diberikan oleh masyarakat Orang Asli Amerika kepada seni, kemanusiaan, sains, dan perkhidmatan awam negara.  Kira-kira 8.75 juta orang di Amerika Syarikat mengenal pasti diri sebagai Orang Asli Amerika. Sejarah mereka penuh dengan cabaran besar seperti peperangan, pembersihan etnik, dan perhambaan. Komuniti Orang Asli Amerika menghadapi cabaran bukan sahaja dalam aspek politik, malah ketidaksamaan kesihatan, terutamanya berkaitan penggunaan alkohol.  Walaupun beberapa suku kaum menggunakan minuman fermentasi dalam upacara sebelum penjajahan Eropah, minuman alkohol yang lebih kuat dan mudah disalahgunakan kebanyakannya diperkenalkan oleh penjajah Eropah, sering sebagai barang dagangan atau dalam pergaulan sosial. Kesan alkohol berbeza antara suku kaum, namun kajian dalam jurnal Drug and Alcohol Dependence menunjukkan kebanyakan Orang Asli Amerika sebenarnya tidak meminum alkohol. Namun begitu, data daripada Treatment Episode Data Set menunjukkan komuniti ini mencatatkan kadar ketagihan atau penyalahgunaan bahan tertinggi dalam kalangan kumpulan etnik di AS.  Menurut Indian Health Service, antara tahun 2016 dan 2020, kematian berkaitan alkohol dalam kalangan Orang Asli Amerika dicatat pada kadar 51.9 per 100,000—hampir lima kali ganda kadar purata AS (11.7 per 100,000). Penyakit dan kematian akibat alkohol, termasuk kemalangan, kecederaan, masalah kesihatan mental seperti kemurungan dan kebimbangan, serta penyakit kronik seperti penyakit hati, juga jauh lebih tinggi dalam komuniti ini.  Sebagai contoh, pada tahun 2018, Orang Asli Amerika didapati 1.8 kali lebih berisiko disahkan menghidap penyakit hati kronik dan hampir empat kali lebih berisiko meninggal dunia akibat penyakit ini berbanding orang Putih bukan-Hispanik, menurut Pejabat Kesihatan Minoriti Jabatan Kesihatan & Perkhidmatan Manusia AS.  Persatuan Kesihatan Awam Amerika (APHA) menyatakan bahawa alkohol tidak mempunyai manfaat kesihatan dan sangat berkait dengan peningkatan risiko pelbagai jenis kanser, termasuk kanser payudara, kolon, mulut, esofagus, dan hati.  Kesan kesihatan tidak seimbang alkohol terhadap Orang Asli Amerika berpunca daripada pelbagai faktor—politik, genetik, sosial, dan budaya. Yang penting, alkohol berkandungan tinggi secara umumnya asing dalam budaya Orang Asli sebelum penjajahan. Penggunaan meluas hanya bermula selepas interaksi dengan penjajah Eropah.  Dengan fakta-fakta ini, wajar dipersoalkan mengapa masyarakat Amerika masih mengagungkan alkohol di majlis sosial dan media, sedangkan kesannya sangat membahayakan. Alkohol, yang tidak memberi manfaat kesihatan, sepatutnya difahami sebagai bahan yang boleh memberi banyak mudarat.  Seperti dinyatakan Presiden Biden, 'Mereka berkhidmat dalam Angkatan Tentera Amerika Syarikat pada kadar lebih tinggi daripada mana-mana kumpulan etnik lain.' Menghormati Orang Asli Amerika bermaksud menyokong pendidikan tentang alkohol yang berkesan, mempertingkatkan akses kesihatan, dan menggalakkan penguatan hubungan dengan budaya asal mereka, agar mereka rasa diterima dan disokong.  Menekankan ketidaksamaan kesihatan yang berterusan sempena Bulan Warisan Orang Asli Amerika ialah cara bermakna untuk menghargai warisan penduduk pertama negara dan menggalakkan masa depan yang lebih sihat untuk semua.

article_content:
North Carolina State Auditor Beth Wood announced on Thursday that she will resign from her elected position on December 15, 2023. Her decision comes two days after she was indicted on charges of misusing her state-owned vehicle for personal purposes. Wood, a Democrat first elected in 2008, had already stated last week that she would not run for reelection in 2024, prior to the Wake County grand jury charging her with two misdemeanors.

“I will step down as State Auditor on December 15, 2023, completing 30 years of service to the State of North Carolina,” Wood said in a written statement. “I made this decision because we have such a great team doing incredibly important work and I do not want to be a distraction. It has been an honor and privilege to work with such talented staff and to serve the citizens of this great state.”

The indictment followed an eight-month investigation that began after Wood was cited in December last year for leaving the scene of a crash involving her state vehicle. She pleaded guilty in March to misdemeanor hit-and-run, paid associated fines and court costs, and apologized in court for what she called a "grave mistake."

The North Carolina Constitution requires Democratic Governor Roy Cooper to appoint a replacement to fill the remainder of Wood's term, which ends in late 2024. Cooper may also initially appoint an interim auditor before the official replacement is named. The person appointed could choose to seek election for a full term next year. Several candidates have already announced they are running, with filing beginning next month and primary elections scheduled for March.

Wood notified Governor Cooper of her resignation on Thursday, according to the governor’s office. Spokesperson Jordan Monaghan said that Cooper "respects her decision and thanked her for her years of service to North Carolina," and indicated more information about the appointment process would be provided soon.

According to the indictment, Wood allegedly used the state vehicle in 2021 and 2022 for personal reasons, such as traveling for hair and dental appointments out of town, and visiting shopping centers and spas not related to her official duties. Wood, 69, expressed disappointment on Tuesday over the charges brought by Wake County District Attorney Lorrin Freeman. She stated that she had reimbursed the state by overpaying for the miles she drove for commuting. 

A native of Craven County and a certified public accountant, Wood has worked nearly 10 years in the State Auditor’s Office before defeating incumbent Les Merritt in 2008. The state auditor is one of 10 elected officials on the Council of State, including the governor, attorney general, and other executive branch leaders. The auditor's office frequently issues critical reports of state government and local government management, earning Wood both supporters and critics across political lines.

The December 8, 2022, accident occurred in downtown Raleigh after Wood left a holiday party. Although the crash caused property damage, there were no injuries. News of the incident surfaced weeks later, leading to increased scrutiny of her use of the state vehicle. Her vehicle assignment was suspended in January as the investigation continued. In June, Wood initially said she would seek reelection but reversed her decision last week, citing a desire to move on and acknowledging mistakes made during her tenure. She indicated plans to transition into a public speaking career.

Juruaudit Negeri North Carolina, Beth Wood, mengumumkan pada hari Khamis bahawa beliau akan meletakkan jawatan pada 15 Disember 2023. Keputusan ini dibuat dua hari selepas beliau didakwa kerana menyalahgunakan kenderaan milik negeri untuk tujuan peribadi. Wood, seorang Demokrat yang pertama kali dipilih pada 2008, telah menyatakan minggu lalu bahawa beliau tidak akan bertanding semula pada pilihan raya 2024, sebelum juri besar Wake County mendakwanya dengan dua kesalahan kecil.

“Saya akan meletakkan jawatan sebagai Juruaudit Negeri pada 15 Disember 2023, melengkapkan 30 tahun perkhidmatan kepada Negeri North Carolina,” kata Wood dalam satu kenyataan bertulis. “Saya membuat keputusan ini kerana kami mempunyai pasukan hebat yang melakukan kerja amat penting dan saya tidak mahu menjadi gangguan. Ia satu penghormatan dan keistimewaan untuk bekerja dengan kakitangan yang begitu berbakat dan berkhidmat untuk rakyat negeri hebat ini.”

Pendakwaan ini menyusul selepas siasatan selama lapan bulan yang bermula apabila Wood disaman pada Disember lalu kerana meninggalkan tempat kejadian kemalangan yang melibatkan kenderaan milik negeri. Beliau mengaku bersalah pada Mac atas kesalahan kecil melanggar lalu melarikan diri, membayar denda serta kos mahkamah, dan memohon maaf di mahkamah kerana membuat "kesilapan besar."

Perlembagaan North Carolina memerlukan Gabenor Demokratik Roy Cooper melantik pengganti untuk mengisi baki tempoh Wood yang akan berakhir pada penghujung 2024. Cooper juga boleh melantik juruaudit interim sebelum melantik pengganti rasmi. Orang yang dilantik boleh bertanding untuk jawatan sepenuh penggal pada tahun depan. Beberapa calon telah pun mengumumkan pencalonan mereka, dengan pendaftaran bermula bulan depan dan pilihan raya awal dijadualkan pada bulan Mac.

Wood telah memberitahu Gabenor Cooper mengenai keputusannya untuk meletakkan jawatan pada hari Khamis, menurut pejabat gabenor. Jurucakap Jordan Monaghan berkata Cooper "menghormati keputusannya dan mengucapkan terima kasih atas tahun-tahun perkhidmatannya kepada North Carolina," dan akan memberikan maklumat lanjut mengenai proses pelantikan jawatan itu tidak lama lagi.

Menurut dakwaan, Wood didakwa menggunakan kenderaan milik negeri pada 2021 dan 2022 untuk tujuan peribadi seperti menghadiri temujanji rambut dan doktor gigi di luar bandar serta melawat pusat beli-belah dan spa yang tidak berkaitan dengan tugas rasminya. Wood, 69, berkongsi rasa kecewa atas tuduhan yang dibawa oleh Pendakwa Daerah Wake County, Lorrin Freeman. Beliau menyatakan telah membayar balik kepada negeri tersebut dengan membayar lebih untuk setiap batu perjalanan harian beliau.

Berketurunan Craven County dan akauntan awam bertauliah, Wood telah berkhidmat hampir 10 tahun di Pejabat Juruaudit Negeri sebelum menewaskan penyandang Les Merritt pada 2008. Juruaudit negeri adalah salah satu daripada 10 jawatan pilihan raya dalam Council of State, termasuk gabenor, peguam negara, dan ketua cawangan eksekutif lain. Pejabat juruaudit sering mengeluarkan laporan kritikal terhadap pengurusan kerajaan negeri dan tempatan, menyebabkan Wood mendapat penyokong serta pengkritik dari kedua-dua pihak politik.

Kemalangan pada 8 Disember 2022 berlaku di pusat bandar Raleigh selepas Wood menghadiri parti perayaan. Walaupun kemalangan itu mengakibatkan kerosakan harta benda, tiada kecederaan dilaporkan. Perkhabaran mengenai kejadian tersebut tersebar beberapa minggu kemudian, menyebabkan penggunaan kenderaan negeri oleh beliau menjadi perhatian. Tugas beliau menggunakan kenderaan tersebut digantung pada Januari sementara siasatan diteruskan. Pada bulan Jun, Wood pada awalnya berkata akan bertanding semula tetapi menarik balik keputusan itu minggu lalu kerana ingin meneruskan kerjaya baru dan mengakui kesilapan yang pernah dilakukan. Beliau menyatakan berhasrat untuk beralih kepada bidang ceramah awam.

article_content: PARIS, France (CNN) -- Starting January 1, smoking in French cafes, bars, discotheques, restaurants, hotels, and casinos will be illegal. This extension of France’s smoking ban means that enjoying a cigarette indoors at these establishments will soon be a thing of the past. Although smoking has had a long romantic association with French culture, particularly in Left Bank cafes, the dangers to health have prompted the government to act. According to the World Health Organization’s 2002 data, about 13.5 million out of 60 million citizens in France smoke, with an estimated 26 percent of 15-year-olds also smoking. Earlier in February, France introduced a smoking ban covering workplaces, schools, airports, and hospitals. The new rules expand these restrictions to more public spaces, but only apply to indoor areas. Smokers may still smoke on outdoor terraces. Authorities will not strictly enforce the ban over the New Year holiday and full penalties will begin after Wednesday. Individuals caught smoking indoors face a fine of €450 ($662), while hotel and bar owners who do not enforce the ban risk a fine of €750 ($1,100). Compared to its European neighbors, France has been relatively slow to enact public smoking bans. Ireland was the first European country to implement a comprehensive indoor smoking ban in 2004, with Italy, Spain, Belgium, and Britain following suit.
translated_content: PARIS, Perancis (CNN) -- Bermula 1 Januari, merokok di kafe, bar, disko, restoran, hotel, dan kasino di Perancis akan diharamkan. Penguatkuasaan larangan merokok ini bermakna menikmati rokok di dalam premis-premis tersebut tidak lagi dibenarkan. Walaupun merokok telah lama dikaitkan dengan budaya Perancis, terutamanya di kafe Left Bank, kebimbangan mengenai bahaya kesihatan telah mendorong kerajaan mengambil tindakan. Menurut data Pertubuhan Kesihatan Sedunia (WHO) pada tahun 2002, kira-kira 13.5 juta daripada 60 juta rakyat Perancis merokok, dengan dianggarkan 26 peratus remaja berumur 15 tahun juga merupakan perokok. Pada bulan Februari lalu, Perancis telah melaksanakan larangan merokok yang merangkumi tempat kerja, sekolah, lapangan terbang, dan hospital. Peraturan baharu ini memperluaskan sempadan larangan tersebut ke lebih banyak kawasan awam, namun hanya terpakai di kawasan dalam bangunan. Perokok masih dibenarkan untuk merokok di teres luar. Pihak berkuasa tidak akan menguatkuasakan larangan sepenuhnya sepanjang cuti Tahun Baru dan penalti penuh hanya akan bermula selepas hari Rabu. Individu yang didapati merokok di dalam premis berdepan denda €450 (RM2,200), manakala pemilik hotel dan bar yang gagal menegakkan larangan akan didenda €750 (RM3,600). Jika dibandingkan dengan negara-negara Eropah lain, Perancis agak lambat melaksanakan larangan merokok di tempat awam. Ireland ialah negara Eropah pertama yang menguatkuasakan larangan merokok sepenuhnya di dalam bangunan pada tahun 2004, diikuti Itali, Sepanyol, Belgium, dan Britain.

article_content: Remarkable video footage shows a driver leaping from his moving car to rescue his four-year-old daughter after she fell out onto a busy road junction in Wenzhou, Zhejiang province, China. A taxi following close behind brakes suddenly, stopping just meters from the frightened girl. The car, left driverless, veers off the road and crashes into a tree. The young girl, stranded and terrified in the middle of the junction, was fortunately only bruised in the incident. Police said the ordeal happened when the child accidentally opened the door while climbing into the front seat. Officer Chen Shu commented, 'A nearby taxi and other cars were not going too fast; the taxi braked immediately to avoid hitting the child.' The father quickly managed to rescue his daughter from the road, reuniting them after the shocking accident.

article_content: Niger State Commissioner for Nomadic and Pastoral Affairs, Umar Sanda, has stated that the creation of the ministry was in response to perceived injustices faced by Fulani herders across the state. According to Sanda, establishing the ministry is considered the most effective way to resolve the ongoing farmer-herder conflicts and to promote lasting peace and productivity. He noted that Governor Mohammed Umaru Bago believes bringing Fulani herders closer to the government will foster inclusion and support. "By doing so, we aim to give Fulani herders, especially those rearing cattle in remote areas, a sense of belonging and ultimately increase their productivity," Sanda told Arewa PUNCH in an exclusive interview. The Commissioner emphasized that justice is a prerequisite for peace, stating, "Without justice, there can be no peace." When asked about the ministry being the first of its kind in Nigeria, Sanda remarked, "For peace, there must be justice. A government must be inclusive and not divided for the benefit of all people." He explained the governor's vision to run a government that carries all citizens along, avoiding factionalism. "The creation of the Ministry of Nomadic and Pastoral Affairs ensures Fulani people who rear cattle in various locations can engage with the government, feel its presence, and gain a sense of belonging. They are part of Niger State and of Nigeria as a whole," Sanda added. He acknowledged that disputes between farmers and herders have significantly affected the state's people and stressed the need for progress. "We need to modernize, increase our profits, and live in harmony. Moving from traditional to commercial practices will foster peace and prosperity. That is the goal of this ministry," Sanda concluded.

article_content: Maddie Farrell, a four-year-old girl from Liverpool, has amazed doctors after overcoming a stroke she suffered before birth. Her parents, Lisa and Lee Farrell, were initially devastated when scans showed that Maddie had experienced a severe stroke in the womb, resulting in significant brain damage. Medical experts warned she might never walk or speak. Despite the daunting prognosis, Maddie achieved important milestones, although later than other children. At seven months old, she sat up by herself; by ten months, she started walking; and she spoke her first word at age two. Today, Maddie is about to attend her first day at a mainstream primary school with her peers. Lisa Farrell remembered the difficult start: Maddie was silent at birth, needed a ventilator, and was moved to Alder Hey Children’s Hospital. The diagnosis was a shock, as childhood strokes are rare and often missed. Maddie also needed treatment for jaundice and stayed in the hospital for over five weeks. Doctors, including Professor Andy Shennan of the charity Tommy's, explained that while strokes in the womb are uncommon, a child's brain has an increased ability to adapt. However, outcomes like Maddie’s remain rare. The Farrells, who also have three older children, initially planned for long-term care for Maddie. However, they were overwhelmed with happiness as she made progress. Lisa describes her as 'one in a million.' Sonia Mundy from the Childhood Strokes support group praised Maddie and her family for their bravery. She highlighted the isolation many families face when dealing with childhood strokes, often made harder by the condition being invisible and sometimes going undetected. Now preparing to start school, Maddie still faces some anxiety, but her parents are incredibly proud of how far she has come. For more information on childhood strokes, visit the Childhood Strokes support group at www.childstrokesupport.com.

Ibu bapanya, Lisa dan Lee Farrell, pada mulanya sangat sedih apabila imbasan menunjukkan Maddie telah mengalami strok teruk sewaktu dalam rahim, sehingga menyebabkan kerosakan otak yang serius. Kini, Maddie bersedia untuk memulakan persekolahan, walaupun masih menghadapi sedikit kegelisahan. Ibu bapanya sangat bangga dengan semua pencapaiannya. article_content: Veteran Labour MP Austin Mitchell, who has represented Great Grimsby since 1977, will step down at the next election. Mitchell has voiced concerns about the Labour Party's direction, particularly the increasing number of female MPs, which he believes is making the party too 'gentle' to wield power effectively after the next election. He worries that a declining number of experienced male MPs will leave Labour with what he described as 'amenable and leadable' women, whom he claims are overly focused on feminism. Mitchell, 79, who is retiring at the next election, said Labour was becoming more 'family-friendly' and 'gentler,' but less prepared for the demanding aspects of parliamentary life. Mitchell also criticized Labour’s so-called 'red princes,' referring dismissively to the descendants of Labour dynasties such as the Kinnocks, Straws, Benns, and Blairs. He noted that these individuals are often able to bypass all-women shortlists for candidate selection. Labour introduced all-women shortlists in 1993, leading to a significant increase in the number of female MPs—in the current parliament, there are 81 out of 257 Labour MPs who are women. According to Mitchell, the party’s new priorities include social, educational, and family issues, trends he attributes to an 'obsession' with all-women shortlists and the 'feminisation' of Labour. He suggested that these shortlists are being imposed in regions like Yorkshire and the North as punishment for previous 'male chauvinism.' While acknowledging that 'feminisation and youthification' may make Parliament more dynamic and pleasant, Mitchell argued the Commons may focus more on local issues at the expense of larger national or international debates. Mitchell suggested that while the Labour party could become more manageable and reasonable, it may also become less resilient, particularly if it wins the 2015 election. He questioned how a 'family-friendly, gentler' party would cope with what he called 'Tory hooligans' on the opposition benches. Currently, nearly half of Labour's cabinet members are women, and party leader Ed Miliband is reported to be aiming for a 50/50 gender split by the next election (up from 44% at present). Prominent Labour women include Caroline Flint, Angela Eagle, Maria Eagle, Rosie Winterton, Emily Thornberry, Margaret Curran, Baroness Royall, Rachel Reeves, Liz Kendall, Harriet Harman, Yvette Cooper, Mary Creagh, and Tessa Jowell. Mitchell described the Labour parliamentary party as undergoing its largest process of 'feminisation and rejuvenation' since the era of pink Camay soap. He noted the next election would see a 'younger, more attractive body of candidates.' He also argued that ageism is 'rampant' in parliament and described the House of Lords as a 'political retirement home.' He concluded that neither the Parliamentary Labour Party nor the Commons are hospitable places for older people with ambition.

article_content: A new international study led by the University of Gothenburg has found hundreds of toxic chemicals, including pesticides and pharmaceuticals, in recycled plastic pellets collected from 13 countries across Africa, South America, Asia, and Eastern Europe. The research concludes that recycled plastics are unsuitable for most applications and may hinder progress toward a circular economy. Delegates, scientists, and advocates are gathering in Nairobi, Kenya, for the Plastics Treaty Intergovernmental Negotiating Committee (INC-3) from November 13–19, 2023, where the latest science on plastics will be discussed. Scientists argue that all plastics use or absorb toxic chemicals, making it challenging to consider any plastic truly safe or fit for circular use. Professor Bethanie Carney Almroth of the University of Gothenburg stated that, 'Plastic recycling has been promoted as a solution to the plastic pollution crisis, but toxic chemicals in plastics complicate their reuse, disposal, and hinder recycling.' Published in Data in Brief, the study identified more than 600 chemical compounds in recycled plastic pellets, with 491 detected and quantified, and 170 more compounds tentatively identified. These compounds include pesticides, pharmaceuticals, industrial chemicals, and plastic additives. The plastic pellets are used as raw material for manufacturing new plastic products, but there is little oversight over their chemical composition. Weak regulations and international trade in plastics waste worsen the issue. In a recent correspondence published in Science, researchers from the University of Gothenburg, IPEN, Aarhus University, and the University of Exeter warned that hazardous chemicals in plastics pose risks to recycling workers, consumers, society, and the environment. They argue that before recycling can help address plastic pollution, the plastics industry must reduce hazardous chemicals. More than 13,000 chemicals are used in plastics, and scientists report that 25% of these are classified as hazardous. They warn that no plastic chemical can be considered entirely safe. Professor Almroth emphasized: 'Numerous studies show that hazardous chemicals can accumulate even in relatively closed-loop plastic recycling systems. We need to quickly phase out plastic chemicals that can harm human health and the environment.'
translated_content: Satu kajian antarabangsa yang diketuai oleh Universiti Gothenburg telah menemui ratusan bahan kimia berbahaya, termasuk racun perosak dan farmaseutikal, dalam pelet plastik kitar semula yang dikumpul dari 13 negara di Afrika, Amerika Selatan, Asia, dan Eropah Timur. Kajian itu menyimpulkan bahawa plastik kitar semula tidak sesuai untuk kebanyakan aplikasi dan boleh menjadi halangan kepada kemajuan ekonomi bulat. Delegasi, saintis dan aktivis berkumpul di Nairobi, Kenya, untuk sesi Jawatankuasa Rundingan Antara Kerajaan Perjanjian Plastik (INC-3) dari 13–19 November 2023, di mana isu sains terkini tentang plastik akan dibincangkan. Para saintis berhujah bahawa semua plastik menggunakan atau menyerap bahan kimia berbahaya, menjadikan sukar untuk menganggap mana-mana plastik benar-benar selamat atau sesuai untuk kitaran bulat. Profesor Bethanie Carney Almroth dari Universiti Gothenburg menyatakan, 'Kitar semula plastik telah dipromosikan sebagai penyelesaian kepada krisis pencemaran plastik, tetapi bahan kimia berbahaya dalam plastik menyulitkan penggunaan semula, pelupusan, dan menghalang proses kitar semula.' Diterbitkan dalam Data in Brief, kajian itu mengenal pasti lebih 600 sebatian kimia dalam pelet plastik kitar semula, dengan 491 dikesan dan dikuantifikasi, dan 170 lagi dikenal pasti secara tentatif. Sebatian ini termasuk racun perosak, farmaseutikal, bahan kimia industri dan aditif plastik. Pelet plastik ini digunakan sebagai bahan mentah untuk membuat produk plastik baru, namun terdapat kurang kawalan terhadap kandungan kimia di dalamnya. Peraturan yang lemah dan perdagangan antarabangsa sisa plastik memburukkan lagi masalah ini. Dalam korespondensi yang diterbitkan dalam Science, penyelidik dari Universiti Gothenburg, IPEN, Universiti Aarhus, dan Universiti Exeter memberi amaran bahawa bahan kimia berbahaya dalam plastik meletakkan risiko terhadap pekerja kitar semula, pengguna, masyarakat, dan alam sekitar. Mereka menegaskan sebelum kitar semula boleh membantu menangani pencemaran plastik, industri plastik mesti mengurangkan bahan kimia berbahaya. Lebih 13,000 bahan kimia digunakan dalam plastik, dan para saintis melaporkan bahawa 25% daripadanya diklasifikasikan sebagai berbahaya. Mereka memberi amaran bahawa tiada bahan kimia plastik yang benar-benar selamat. Profesor Almroth menegaskan: 'Banyak kajian menunjukkan bahan kimia berbahaya boleh terkumpul walaupun dalam sistem kitar semula plastik yang hampir tertutup. Kita perlu segera hentikan penggunaan bahan kimia plastik yang boleh membahayakan kesihatan manusia dan alam sekitar.'

article_content:
The family of Sapper Elijah Bond has paid tribute to the 'amazing' British soldier after he died from injuries sustained in Afghanistan. Bond, 24, of the 35 Engineer Regiment, Royal Engineers, passed away at Queen Elizabeth NHS Hospital in Birmingham after being flown back to the UK following an improvised explosive device (IED) attack in the Nahr-e Saraj District of Helmand Province. He had been conducting an engineer reconnaissance mission with his team. Colleagues gave immediate first aid at the scene before Bond was taken by helicopter to Camp Bastion for further treatment, then flown to Birmingham where he ultimately died from his wounds.

Known for his vibrant personality and skill at chess, Bond leaves behind his mother Lizz, father Mark, brother Isaac, and sisters Kimberley, Jose, and Bethany. His family said, 'Elijah Cooper Bond left the world as he lived—beautiful, amazing, proud, and a best friend. Whether it was a mischievous grin or a heartfelt smile, he could always light up a room. He will always be a part of us, and we cherish every moment spent with him.'

Bond joined the Corps of Royal Engineers in August 2008. After extensive training, he joined the 37 Armoured Engineer Squadron and underwent preparations for duty in Afghanistan. He excelled in both the general purpose machine gunners' and Pashtu language courses.

Lieutenant Colonel Kevin Copsey described Bond as 'a first-rate soldier' and 'a rising star,' highlighting his reliability, enthusiasm, and strong sense of duty. Major Guy Boxall said Bond was injured during a crucial reconnaissance patrol for a project aimed at helping local Afghans, and that the squadron was deeply affected by his loss. Fellow soldier Sapper Pete Broxton remembered Bond as someone who could always bring laughter and joy to those around him.

Since the start of British military operations in Afghanistan in 2001, 391 British troops have lost their lives.

article_content: Corey Eastwood, a former soldier, caused chaos in Hull city centre after heavily drinking 15 bottles of beer. He drove recklessly, mounting the pavement and hitting pedestrians. Although three people were injured, none suffered serious harm—a fortunate outcome. One victim, Andy Pearce, who broke his foot, managed to stop Eastwood by pulling the keys from the ignition. CCTV footage captured Eastwood reversing down a busy street on October 27 before crashing into a pub, frightening customers and pinning another man, Jonathan Steel, against a wall. Security guards and bystanders tried to intervene, but Eastwood attempted to escape again. At Hull Crown Court, Eastwood admitted to dangerous and drink-driving. The judge, Recorder Graeme Cook, acknowledged Eastwood’s recent bereavement but called his actions extremely dangerous. Discharged from the army due to a zero-tolerance policy on drink-driving, Eastwood received a 12-month suspended sentence, 250 hours of unpaid work, an 18-month driving ban, and must pass an extended test to drive again. The judge commented on the lucky outcome and commended those who intervened, highlighting the severe consequences of drink-driving and the value of public action in emergencies.

Dia memandu secara melulu, menaiki kaki lima dan melanggar pejalan kaki. Walaupun tiga orang cedera, tiada yang mengalami kecederaan serius—satu nasib baik. Seorang mangsa, Andy Pearce, yang patah kaki, berjaya menghentikan Eastwood dengan menarik kunci dari kereta. Rakaman CCTV menunjukkan Eastwood mengundur di jalan sibuk pada 27 Oktober sebelum merempuh bahagian luar sebuah pub, menakutkan pelanggan dan memerangkap seorang lelaki lain, Jonathan Steel, di dinding. Pengawal keselamatan dan orang awam cuba membantu, tetapi Eastwood tetap cuba melarikan diri. Di Mahkamah Mahkota Hull, Eastwood mengaku bersalah atas pemanduan berbahaya dan mabuk. Hakim, Recorder Graeme Cook, mengakui pemergian abang Eastwood baru-baru ini tetapi menyifatkan tindakannya sangat berbahaya. Eastwood kini telah dikeluarkan dari tentera kerana polisi toleransi sifar terhadap pemanduan mabuk, dan dijatuhi hukuman penjara 12 bulan (ditangguhkan selama dua tahun), 250 jam kerja tanpa upah, larangan memandu selama 18 bulan, serta perlu lulus ujian memandu lanjutan. Hakim menyatakan bahawa adalah bernasib baik tiada kecederaan serius berlaku dan memuji tindakan pantas orang awam, sekali gus menekankan akibat buruk pemanduan mabuk serta peranan penting masyarakat semasa kecemasan.

article_content: Relations between India and Canada have deteriorated further amidst allegations concerning India's involvement in the killing of Khalistani extremist Hardeep Singh Nijjar in Canada. Canada recently accused India of unilaterally revoking diplomatic immunity for Canadian diplomats in India, claiming this violates international law—specifically, the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations (VCDR), which provides the framework for diplomatic relations between countries. The VCDR aims to balance the interests of the host (receiving) and sending countries. While Canada's accusation is serious, it is not supported by the facts. India did not revoke diplomatic immunity but requested Canada to reduce its diplomatic presence for parity, and communicated this request through formal channels, giving Canada sufficient time to comply. If the diplomats had remained after the requested reduction, they could have lost immunity according to standard diplomatic practice—but this outcome would result from Canada's inaction, not India's unilateral withdrawal of immunities. Importantly, India did not declare any of the diplomats persona non grata, though Article 9 of the VCDR allows the receiving state to do so without explanation. The key question is whether India is within its rights to ask a sending country to reduce its diplomatic presence. According to India’s Ministry of External Affairs, Article 11(1) of the VCDR authorizes the receiving state to set mission size limits in the absence of an agreement. This provision grants India the right to unilaterally determine what is 'reasonable and normal' regarding the size of diplomatic missions. This interpretation is supported by the negotiating history of the VCDR—a subjective standard ('considers reasonable and normal') was intentionally adopted over an objective one. India argues that a high number of Canadian diplomats and their alleged interference in India’s internal affairs justify its request for parity. International legal precedent exists for such actions: the UK, US, Moldova, and Estonia have previously limited the size of foreign diplomatic missions citing Article 11 of the VCDR in various contexts involving concerns over internal affairs. Under Article 41(1) of the VCDR, diplomats must not interfere in the internal affairs of the receiving state. If Canadian diplomats acted otherwise, as India claims, this would constitute a breach of the VCDR by Canada. Section 4 of India’s Diplomatic Relations Act (1972) also empowers the government to restrict privileges in such cases. Therefore, India’s actions appear consistent with its international obligations. Nevertheless, broader trust issues persist between Ottawa and New Delhi. Both sides should focus on building confidence, as ongoing allegations of breached international law could further damage relations. The author teaches at South Asian University’s Faculty of Legal Studies. Views are personal.
translated_content: Hubungan antara India dan Kanada semakin meruncing susulan dakwaan penglibatan India dalam pembunuhan ekstremis Khalistani, Hardeep Singh Nijjar, di Kanada. Baru-baru ini, Kanada menuduh India membatalkan imuniti diplomatik diplomat Kanada di India secara unilateral, kononnya melanggar undang-undang antarabangsa—khususnya, Konvensyen Vienna mengenai Hubungan Diplomatik (VCDR), yang menggariskan kerangka hubungan diplomatik antara negara. VCDR bertujuan mengimbangi kepentingan negara tuan rumah dan negara pengirim. Walaupun tuduhan Kanada serius, ia tidak disokong fakta. India tidak menarik balik imuniti, sebaliknya meminta Kanada mengurangkan bilangan diplomat demi kesamarataan, dan permintaan ini dikomunikasikan secara rasmi, memberi Kanada masa yang mencukupi untuk mematuhi. Jika diplomat tersebut kekal selepas tempoh pengurangan, imuniti diplomatik mereka boleh ditarik balik mengikut amalan biasa diplomatik—tetapi ini akan berlaku akibat tindakan Kanada yang tidak bertindak, bukannya penarikan imuniti secara unilateral oleh India. Penting untuk dinyatakan, India tidak mengisytiharkan mana-mana diplomat sebagai persona non grata, walaupun Artikel 9 VCDR membenarkan negara tuan rumah berbuat demikian tanpa penjelasan. Persoalan utama ialah sama ada India berhak meminta negara pengirim mengurangkan bilangan diplomatnya. Menurut Kementerian Hal Ehwal Luar India, Artikel 11(1) VCDR memberi kuasa kepada negara tuan rumah menentukan had saiz misi diplomatik sekiranya tiada persetujuan. Peruntukan ini membolehkan India menentukan secara sepihak apa yang dianggap 'munasabah dan kebiasaan' berkaitan saiz misi diplomatik. Interpretasi ini disokong sejarah perundingan VCDR—standard subjektif ('dianggap munasabah dan kebiasaan') dipilih berbanding standard objektif. India berhujah bahawa bilangan diplomat Kanada yang tinggi dan dakwaan campur tangan dalaman membenarkan permintaan kesamarataan. Terdapat duluan undang-undang antarabangsa: UK, AS, Moldova, dan Estonia pernah mengehadkan saiz misi diplomatik asing dengan menggunakan Artikel 11 VCDR dalam situasi berkaitan campur tangan dalaman. Berdasarkan Artikel 41(1) VCDR, diplomat tidak boleh mencampuri urusan dalaman negara tuan rumah. Jika diplomat Kanada bertindak sedemikian seperti didakwa India, ia adalah pelanggaran VCDR oleh Kanada. Seksyen 4 Akta Hubungan Diplomatik India (1972) juga membenarkan kerajaan menghadkan keistimewaan dalam kes sebegini. Justeru, tindakan India dilihat selaras dengan kewajipan undang-undang antarabangsa. Namun, isu kepercayaan antara Ottawa dan New Delhi masih wujud. Kedua-dua pihak harus berusaha membina keyakinan, kerana tuduhan pelanggaran undang-undang antarabangsa yang berterusan boleh memburukkan lagi hubungan. Penulis mengajar di Fakulti Pengajian Undang-Undang, Universiti Asia Selatan. Pandangan adalah peribadi.

article_content: SpaceX’s next-generation spacecraft, Starship, built to carry astronauts to the moon and beyond, launched on a repeat test flight from southern Texas on Saturday. The mission encountered issues shortly after reaching space. A SpaceX announcer reported, 'We have lost the data from the second stage… we think we may have lost the second stage.' Another commentator later described the day as 'incredibly successful,' despite a 'rapid unscheduled disassembly' of both the Super Heavy booster and the ship. SpaceX posted video footage of the Starship launch on X (formerly Twitter). The rocket lifted off successfully, but its booster exploded soon after separating from the spacecraft. The remainder of the Starship appeared to continue on its intended path. According to SpaceX commentators, the company gathered valuable data to improve future launches. After the test flight, the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) confirmed there were no injuries or property damage and announced it would investigate the incident. The first Starship and Super Heavy booster launch attempt in April—standing 397 feet (121 meters)—failed when the rocket exploded about four minutes after launch. Elon Musk later stated that an internal fire damaged the engines and computers, causing the vehicle to stray off course, while the automatic-destruct sequence activated about 40 seconds late. That launch destroyed the pad and started a 3.5-acre (1.4-hectare) brush fire, though no one was injured. The pad has since been reinforced with a water-cooled steel plate, among other FAA-required changes before Saturday’s launch. The mission’s primary objective was to get Starship off the ground, reach near-orbital space, and splash down off Hawaii. The first-stage booster, with 33 Raptor engines delivering 16.7 million pounds (74.3 meganewtons) of thrust, is twice as powerful as the Saturn V rocket used for Apollo missions. Launch was postponed one day due to a last-minute swap of flight-control hardware. Success is pivotal for Elon Musk’s dream of sending humans to Mars, and for NASA’s ambition to return astronauts to the moon by the end of the decade. SpaceX and NASA maintain that failures are normal in development, highlighting SpaceX's risk-tolerant, test-and-learn engineering culture. NASA Administrator Bill Nelson pointed to a history of Falcon 9 test failures followed by improvement. However, NASA faces time pressure as it seeks to keep pace with China’s lunar efforts.
translated_content: Kapal angkasa generasi baharu SpaceX, Starship, yang dibina untuk membawa angkasawan ke bulan dan seterusnya, telah dilancarkan semula dari selatan Texas pada hari Sabtu. Misi ini menghadapi masalah sebaik sahaja mencapai angkasa lepas. Seorang pengulas SpaceX melaporkan, 'Kami telah kehilangan data dari peringkat kedua... kami rasa kami mungkin telah kehilangan peringkat kedua.' Pengulas lain kemudian menyifatkan hari itu sebagai 'amat berjaya,' walaupun berlaku 'pembongkaran tidak berjadual secara cepat' pada kedua-dua roket Super Heavy dan kapal angkasa. SpaceX memuat naik rakaman pelancaran Starship di X (dahulunya Twitter). Roket itu berlepas dengan jayanya, tetapi boosternya meletup sejurus selepas berpisah dari kapal angkasa. Baki Starship kelihatan meneruskan laluan yang dirancang. Menurut pengulas SpaceX, syarikat itu mengumpul data penting untuk memperbaiki pelancaran seterusnya. Selepas ujian penerbangan, Pentadbiran Penerbangan Persekutuan AS (FAA) mengesahkan tiada kecederaan atau kerosakan harta berlaku dan mengumumkan siasatan akan dijalankan. Cubaan pertama pelancaran Starship dan Super Heavy booster pada April—setinggi 397 kaki (121 meter)—gagal apabila roket itu meletup kira-kira empat minit selepas pelancaran. Elon Musk kemudian berkata kebakaran dalaman telah merosakkan enjin dan komputer, menyebabkan kenderaan itu tersasar, manakala sistem pemusnah automatik hanya diaktifkan sekitar 40 saat lewat. Pelancaran itu memusnahkan pad dan menyebabkan kebakaran belukar seluas 3.5 ekar (1.4 hektar), walaupun tiada yang cedera. Tapak pelancaran kini telah diperkukuh dengan plat keluli sejuk berair serta penambahbaikan lain mengikut syarat FAA sebelum pelancaran Sabtu. Objektif utama misi ialah melancarkan Starship, mencapai angkasa hampir orbit, dan mendarat di perairan berhampiran Hawaii. Booster peringkat pertama, dengan 33 enjin Raptor yang menghasilkan 16.7 juta paun (74.3 meganewton) daya tujahan, adalah dua kali lebih berkuasa daripada roket Saturn V yang digunakan untuk misi Apollo. Pelancaran tertunda sehari kerana pertukaran terakhir perkakasan kawalan penerbangan. Kejayaan penting untuk impian Elon Musk menghantar manusia ke Marikh, dan untuk cita-cita NASA membawa kembali angkasawan ke bulan pada penghujung dekad ini. SpaceX dan NASA tetap berpendapat kegagalan adalah perkara biasa dalam pembangunan, dengan menonjolkan budaya kejuruteraan SpaceX yang berisiko dan suka mencuba. Pentadbir NASA, Bill Nelson, merujuk kepada sejarah kegagalan ujian Falcon 9 sebelum adanya penambahbaikan. Namun NASA kini berada di bawah tekanan masa demi menyaingi usaha bulan dari China.

article_content: Nathan Verhelst, a 44-year-old Belgian transgender man, died by euthanasia after enduring severe psychological distress following incomplete gender reassignment surgeries. Verhelst, originally named Nancy, shared that he felt unwanted by his mother throughout his life. His mother later confirmed these feelings publicly, saying she felt no sorrow or regret over her child's decision. Prior to his death, Verhelst expressed disappointment with his surgical outcomes, stating his new body did not meet his expectations and that he felt self-disgust. Euthanasia has been legal in Belgium since 2002 for adults experiencing constant and unbearable physical or psychological suffering from illness or accident, provided they are capable of making the decision themselves. In 2012, Belgium reported 1,432 euthanasia cases, a rise of 25% from the previous year, amounting to about two percent of all deaths in the country. There is ongoing debate over issues of consent and reporting standards, with some surveys suggesting a proportion of cases occur without explicit requests or go unreported. Notable cases include the euthanasia of twin brothers, Marc and Eddy Verbessem, who chose to die after learning they would lose their sight. Both cases were overseen by cancer specialist Dr. Wim Distelmans. Experts continue to raise concerns about the long-term outcomes of gender reassignment surgery, with some patients reporting ongoing psychological distress. Professor Chris Hyde from the University of Exeter notes continued debate regarding the procedure's benefits. The Belgian parliament is considering new legislation that could allow minors to make decisions regarding euthanasia under specific conditions.
translated_content: Nathan Verhelst, seorang lelaki transgender Belgium berumur 44 tahun, telah menjalani euthanasia selepas mengalami tekanan psikologi yang mendalam akibat pembedahan penukaran jantina yang tidak berjaya. Verhelst, yang asalnya bernama Nancy, berkongsi bahawa beliau berasa tidak diingini oleh ibunya sepanjang hidupnya. Ibunya kemudian mengesahkan perasaan ini secara terbuka, mengatakan beliau tidak berasa sedih atau menyesal atas keputusan anaknya. Sebelum kematiannya, Verhelst meluahkan kekecewaan terhadap hasil pembedahan tersebut, menyatakan tubuh barunya tidak memenuhi harapan dan beliau berasa jijik terhadap dirinya sendiri. Euthanasia telah sah di Belgium sejak 2002 bagi orang dewasa yang mengalami kesakitan fizikal atau psikologi yang berterusan dan tidak tertanggung akibat penyakit atau kemalangan, dengan syarat mereka mampu membuat keputusan sendiri. Pada tahun 2012, Belgium melaporkan 1,432 kes euthanasia, peningkatan sebanyak 25% berbanding tahun sebelumnya, yakni sekitar dua peratus daripada jumlah kematian di negara itu. Terdapat perdebatan berterusan mengenai isu persetujuan dan piawaian pelaporan, dengan beberapa kajian menunjukkan sebahagian kes berlaku tanpa permintaan jelas atau tidak dilaporkan. Kes berprofil tinggi termasuk euthanasia sepasang kembar, Marc dan Eddy Verbessem, yang memilih meninggal dunia setelah mengetahui mereka akan hilang penglihatan. Kedua-dua kes ini dikendalikan oleh pakar kanser, Dr. Wim Distelmans. Pakar masih memberi perhatian kepada isu hasil jangka panjang pembedahan penukaran jantina, dengan beberapa pesakit melaporkan tekanan psikologi yang berterusan. Profesor Chris Hyde dari Universiti Exeter menyatakan perdebatan mengenai kebaikan prosedur ini masih berterusan. Parlimen Belgium sedang mempertimbangkan undang-undang baharu yang mungkin membenarkan golongan bawah umur membuat keputusan tentang euthanasia di bawah syarat tertentu.

article_content: Gunmen on motorcycles shot and killed five men on Saturday on the outskirts of Puebla, a city located east of Mexico City, according to authorities. The Puebla police department reported that the victims appeared to be guarding two gas tanker trucks when the attack happened. Officials stated the incident was 'presumably related to fuel theft.' Two of the victims had previously been arrested in October for alleged involvement in a gas tanker truck explosion, though no further specifics were provided. Puebla has experienced longstanding problems with gangs that illegally tap government pipelines to steal fuel, resulting in frequent shootouts between criminals and law enforcement.

Polis Puebla melaporkan mangsa dipercayai sedang menjaga dua lori tangki gas ketika kejadian berlaku. Pihak berkuasa berkata insiden tersebut 'berkemungkinan berkaitan dengan kecurian bahan api.' Dua daripada mangsa sebelum ini pernah ditahan pada Oktober lalu atas dakwaan terlibat dalam letupan lori tangki gas, namun butiran lanjut tidak diberikan. Puebla lama berdepan masalah kumpulan yang menoreh saluran paip kerajaan secara haram untuk mencuri bahan api, menyebabkan insiden tembak-menembak antara penjenayah dan pihak berkuasa sering berlaku.

article_content:
Frank Luo, a horse-drawn carriage driver in New York City, faces allegations of changing a horse’s identification to make an older, sick horse appear younger and healthier. According to city health officials, Luo relabeled 22-year-old Ceasar, who has a respiratory condition called heaves, allowing him to work in place of a 12-year-old horse named Carsen for whom he had a valid license. A city veterinarian spotted the issue when Ceasar was found with Carsen’s identification but showed clear signs of being the older horse.

Luo disputes the claims, saying it's a mix-up due to the horses' similar appearance. He first provided documents, including a note from a Pennsylvania farmer who said Ceasar was at his farm. When asked for more evidence, Luo’s lawyer later told officials that Ceasar had been moved and sold in Pennsylvania, claiming the matter was resolved. Luo says he will continue working using other horses.

City health authorities ended their investigation after the sale, but the Department of Consumer Affairs is still looking into Luo’s operations. In the past, Luo was cited for working horses without up-to-date licenses, exceeding regulated work hours, misleading advertising, and overcharging clients. Luo’s company, Manhattan Carriage Co., agreed earlier this year to pay fines and restitution. In another case, a horse Luo was driving escaped and collided with a vehicle, only receiving minor injuries.

The incident adds to the ongoing debate about the future of New York’s carriage industry, as Mayor Bill de Blasio and animal rights activists continue efforts to ban horse-drawn carriages. Past audits have found inconsistencies in horse records and attempts to bribe investigators. Although carriage operators insist their animals are well cared for, questions about regulation and welfare remain, keeping the controversy alive.

Frank Luo, seorang pemandu kereta kuda di New York City, menghadapi tuduhan kerana menukar identiti kuda agar seekor kuda tua yang sakit kelihatan seperti kuda muda yang sihat. Menurut pegawai kesihatan bandaraya, Luo menulis semula pengenalan pada Ceasar yang berumur 22 tahun dan mempunyai masalah pernafasan, supaya dia boleh bekerja menggantikan kuda berumur 12 tahun bernama Carsen yang mempunyai lesen aktif. Seorang doktor haiwan bandar mengesan perkara ini apabila Ceasar didapati memiliki tanda pengenalan Carsen, tetapi jelas menunjukkan ciri-ciri kuda yang lebih tua.

Luo menafikan tuduhan tersebut dengan menyatakan kekeliruan terjadi kerana rupa kedua-dua kuda hampir serupa. Mula-mula, beliau menyediakan dokumen, termasuk nota tulisan tangan dari seorang petani Pennsylvania yang mendakwa Ceasar telah berada di ladangnya. Apabila diminta bukti tambahan, peguam Luo kemudian memaklumkan pihak berkuasa bahawa Ceasar telah dipindahkan dan dijual di Pennsylvania, lalu mendakwa isu itu telah selesai. Luo berkata dia akan meneruskan perniagaannya menggunakan kuda-kuda lain.

Pihak berkuasa kesihatan bandar menamatkan siasatan selepas penjualan itu, namun Jabatan Hal Ehwal Pengguna masih menyiasat operasi Luo. Terdahulu, Luo telah dikenakan tindakan kerana menjalankan operasi dengan kuda tanpa lesen yang sah, bekerja melebihi waktu yang dibenarkan, iklan yang mengelirukan, dan mengenakan caj berlebihan kepada pelanggan. Syarikat Luo, Manhattan Carriage Co., awal tahun ini telah bersetuju membayar denda dan pampasan. Dalam satu kejadian berasingan, seekor kuda yang dipandu Luo terlepas dan melanggar sebuah kereta, namun hanya mengalami kecederaan ringan.

Kes ini memburukkan lagi perdebatan berkenaan masa depan industri kereta kuda di New York, ketika Datuk Bandar Bill de Blasio serta aktivis haiwan semakin giat berusaha mengharamkan operasi ini. Audit sebelum ini pernah menemui rekod kuda yang tidak konsisten dan percubaan merasuah pegawai penyiasat. Walaupun pengusaha-pengusaha kereta kuda menegaskan haiwan mereka dijaga rapi, isu tentang pengawasan dan kebajikan haiwan kekal menjadi persoalan.

article_content: France is offering payments to local fishermen to reduce the number of sharks in the waters around its Indian Ocean territory, Réunion Island. This move comes in response to a recent surge in deadly bull shark attacks on surfers and swimmers, including one fatal incident last week. The French government’s decision faces strong criticism from conservation and animal rights groups, who describe the plan as 'extermination.' Despite protests, officials argue the payments—which are unprecedented for the French-administered island—are necessary to encourage shark culling and protect the public. Experts report that 40 shark species frequent the waters off Réunion, with 10 considered potentially dangerous. Bull sharks and great white sharks are particularly deadly. Bull sharks (Carcharhinus leucas) are the top predator in the area, and, unusually among shark species, females are usually larger than males. Both male and female bull sharks have exceptionally high testosterone levels. Bull sharks are known for their aggressive behavior, serrated teeth, and ability to survive in both fresh and saltwater. They often hunt alone, sometimes in pairs, and are capable of rapid acceleration. Their diet mainly consists of bony fish and other sharks, but can also include turtles, birds, dolphins, and land mammals. From 2000 to 2010, no shark attacks were reported off Réunion. However, since 2011 there have been seven attacks, three of them fatal. Last week, 22-year-old Alexandre Rassica died after a shark bit off his leg. In November, French surfer Matthieu Schiller was killed in a shark attack, and in August 2011, British tourist Ian Redmond died after being attacked in the nearby Seychelles. Réunion Island remains a popular destination for holidaymakers, attracting tens of thousands of tourists each year in search of tropical beaches and clear waters. The precise amount to be paid for each shark caught is still being determined, but is expected to be based on weight.
translated_content: Perancis menawarkan bayaran kepada nelayan tempatan untuk mengurangkan jumlah jerung di perairan sekitar wilayahnya di Lautan Hindi, Pulau Réunion. Langkah ini dibuat sebagai tindak balas terhadap peningkatan serangan maut jerung banteng ke atas peluncur dan perenang, termasuk satu insiden maut minggu lalu. Keputusan kerajaan Perancis ini menerima kritikan hebat daripada kumpulan pemuliharaan dan hak haiwan, yang menyifatkan rancangan itu sebagai ‘pemusnahan’. Walaupun mendapat bantahan, pegawai menyatakan bayaran ini—yang belum pernah dilakukan di pulau yang ditadbir Perancis itu—perlu untuk menggalakkan pembasmian jerung demi melindungi orang awam. Pakar melaporkan terdapat 40 spesies jerung di perairan Réunion, dengan 10 daripadanya dianggap berbahaya. Jerung banteng dan jerung putih besar sangat berbahaya. Jerung banteng (Carcharhinus leucas) adalah pemangsa utama di kawasan ini dan, berbeza dengan kebanyakan spesies jerung lain, betinanya biasanya lebih besar daripada jantan. Kedua-dua jantan dan betina mempunyai tahap testosteron yang sangat tinggi. Jerung banteng dikenali dengan sifatnya yang agresif, gigi bergerigi, dan keupayaan untuk hidup dalam air tawar serta air laut. Mereka biasanya memburu secara bersendirian atau berpasangan, dan mampu bergerak dengan pantas. Diet mereka terdiri daripada ikan bertulang dan jerung lain, serta penyu, burung, lumba-lumba dan mamalia darat. Dari tahun 2000 hingga 2010, tiada serangan jerung dilaporkan di sekitar Réunion. Namun, sejak 2011 terdapat tujuh serangan dan tiga daripadanya mengakibatkan kematian. Minggu lalu, Alexandre Rassica, 22 tahun, maut selepas kakinya digigit jerung. Pada bulan November lalu, peluncur Perancis Matthieu Schiller terbunuh akibat serangan jerung, dan pada Ogos 2011, pelancong British Ian Redmond maut selepas diserang jerung di Seychelles. Pulau Réunion kekal sebagai destinasi pelancongan popular, menarik puluhan ribu pelawat setiap tahun yang mencari pantai tropika dan air jernih. article_content: Rev. Raniero Cantalamessa, the personal preacher to the pope, apologized on Sunday for comparing the outrage over sexual abuse within the Catholic Church to anti-Semitism. In an interview with the Italian newspaper Corriere della Sera, Cantalamessa said, "If, against my intention, I've hurt the Jewish people's feelings and those of the victims of child abuse, I'm truly sorry and ask forgiveness." He emphasized that Pope Benedict XVI "not only did not inspire" the sermon, but also "like everyone else, heard my words for the first time during the liturgy." The Vatican did not release an official statement about the apology, and officials did not respond to CNN's requests for comment. In his sermon on Friday, Cantalamessa referenced a history of "collective violence" against Jews, quoting a letter from a Jewish friend who said that the anger toward Catholic leadership over the sexual abuse scandal "reminds us of the most shameful aspects of anti-Semitism." Pope Benedict XVI did not mention the sex abuse scandal in his Easter message on Sunday, but instead spoke about humanity facing a "profound crisis" that requires "deep change, beginning with consciences." The pope expressed support for Christian minorities in Iraq, Pakistan, and the Middle East, as well as for people in Haiti and Chile affected by earthquakes, and for Latin American and Caribbean countries impacted by drug trafficking. He also urged for an end to conflicts in Africa.

Raniero Cantalamessa, memohon maaf pada hari Ahad kerana membandingkan kemarahan terhadap penyalahgunaan seksual dalam Gereja Katolik dengan anti-Semitisme. Dalam wawancara bersama akhbar Itali Corriere della Sera, Cantalamessa berkata, "Jika, bertentangan dengan niat saya, saya telah melukakan perasaan masyarakat Yahudi dan mangsa penderaan kanak-kanak, saya benar-benar memohon maaf dan meminta keampunan." Beliau menegaskan bahawa Paus Benedict XVI "bukan sahaja tidak mengilhamkan" khutbah tersebut, malah "seperti orang lain, mendengar kata-kata saya buat kali pertama semasa liturgi." Vatican tidak mengeluarkan kenyataan rasmi mengenai permohonan maaf itu, dan pegawainya tidak membalas permintaan komen daripada CNN. Dalam khutbahnya pada hari Jumaat, Cantalamessa merujuk kepada sejarah "kekerasan kolektif" terhadap kaum Yahudi, dengan memetik surat daripada seorang sahabat Yahudi yang mengatakan kemarahan terhadap kepimpinan Katolik berhubung skandal penyalahgunaan seksual "mengingatkan kita kepada aspek paling memalukan anti-Semitisme." Paus Benedict XVI tidak menyebut mengenai skandal penyalahgunaan seksual dalam mesej Easternya pada hari Ahad, sebaliknya bercakap tentang "krisis mendalam" yang dihadapi manusia dan perlunya "perubahan besar bermula dari hati nurani." Paus turut meluahkan sokongan kepada minoriti Kristian di Iraq, Pakistan, dan Timur Tengah, serta kepada rakyat di Haiti dan Chile yang terjejas akibat gempa bumi, serta negara di Amerika Latin dan Caribbean yang terjejas akibat pengedaran dadah. Beliau juga menyeru agar konflik di Afrika dihentikan.

article_content: Shakira, the international pop star, reached a deal with Spanish prosecutors on November 20 to avoid an 8-year prison sentence and a €24 million ($26 million) fine over accusations that she failed to pay €14.5 million ($15 million) in Spanish income tax between 2012 and 2014. According to the Associated Press, the trial ended after only eight minutes. Despite having denied the charges for years, Shakira stated that she 'made the decision to finally resolve this matter with the best interest of my children at heart, who do not want to see their mother sacrifice her personal well-being in this fight.' The case centered on Shakira’s residency during the years in question. Prosecutors claimed she spent most of her time in Spain and was therefore required to pay Spanish income taxes, but Shakira reported the Bahamas as her primary residence and filed her taxes there, benefiting from lower tax rates. This type of legal dilemma has affected other celebrities and is an issue for many remote workers as well. With the rise of remote work, especially during the pandemic, many people have become digital nomads, choosing to work and earn income while traveling to different countries. For example, a 29-year-old digital nomad recently told Insider that she has maintained this lifestyle since 2019 and earns about $4,000 per month. More than 15 million Americans now work as digital nomads—an increase of 112% since 2019—and more than 25 countries have launched digital nomad visa programs to attract such workers. However, managing taxes as a digital nomad can be complicated. U.S. citizens are generally required to pay U.S. taxes wherever they live. According to The New York Times, Americans who pay foreign income taxes might be able to claim a deduction on their U.S. tax returns, depending on the rules of the country where they reside. Some countries' visa programs let remote workers avoid paying local income tax for stays under one year. While it's unlikely that a digital nomad with a moderate income would face charges like those brought against Shakira, the U.S. can still penalize people who file taxes in the wrong location, so those living abroad should be careful during tax season. Meanwhile, Shakira faces another ongoing tax fraud investigation in Spain related to allegations that she evaded paying income taxes in 2018.
translated_content: Shakira, bintang pop antarabangsa, telah mencapai persetujuan dengan pendakwa raya Sepanyol pada 20 November untuk mengelakkan hukuman penjara lapan tahun dan denda €24 juta ($26 juta) atas dakwaan bahawa beliau gagal membayar cukai pendapatan Sepanyol sebanyak €14.5 juta ($15 juta) antara tahun 2012 dan 2014. Menurut Associated Press, perbicaraan berakhir selepas hanya lapan minit. Walaupun telah menafikan tuduhan itu selama bertahun-tahun, Shakira menyatakan bahawa beliau 'membuat keputusan untuk akhirnya menyelesaikan perkara ini demi kepentingan terbaik anak-anak saya, yang tidak mahu melihat ibu mereka mengorbankan kesejahteraannya dalam perjuangan ini.' Kes ini tertumpu kepada status kediaman Shakira dalam tahun-tahun yang dipersoalkan. Pendakwa mendakwa bahawa Shakira kebanyakannya tinggal di Sepanyol dan oleh itu perlu membayar cukai pendapatan di Sepanyol, namun Shakira melaporkan Bahamas sebagai kediaman utamanya dan mengisytiharkan cukainya di sana, memanfaatkan kadar cukai yang lebih rendah. Dilema undang-undang seperti ini pernah menimpa selebriti lain dan juga menjadi isu bagi ramai pekerja jarak jauh. Dengan kebangkitan kerja jarak jauh, terutamanya semasa pandemik, ramai individu telah menjadi digital nomad, memilih untuk bekerja dan menjana pendapatan sambil melancong ke pelbagai negara. Sebagai contoh, seorang digital nomad berusia 29 tahun baru-baru ini memberitahu Insider bahawa dia telah menjalani gaya hidup ini sejak 2019 dan memperoleh kira-kira $4,000 sebulan. Lebih 15 juta rakyat Amerika kini bekerja sebagai digital nomad—peningkatan sebanyak 112% sejak 2019—dan lebih 25 negara telah melancarkan program visa digital nomad untuk menarik pekerja seperti ini. Bagaimanapun, pengurusan cukai sebagai digital nomad boleh menjadi rumit. Warganegara AS secara amnya dikehendaki membayar cukai AS di mana sahaja mereka tinggal. Menurut The New York Times, rakyat Amerika yang membayar cukai pendapatan asing mungkin boleh menuntut potongan apabila memfailkan cukai AS, bergantung kepada peraturan negara tempat mereka tinggal. Sesetengah program visa membenarkan pekerja jarak jauh mengelakkan cukai pendapatan tempatan untuk tempoh kurang daripada setahun. Walaupun tidak mungkin digital nomad dengan pendapatan sederhana berdepan tuduhan seperti yang dihadapi Shakira, AS masih boleh mengenakan penalti kepada mereka yang memfailkan cukai di lokasi yang salah, jadi warga yang tinggal di luar negara harus lebih berhati-hati semasa musim pemfailan cukai. Sementara itu, Shakira masih menghadapi satu lagi siasatan penipuan cukai di Sepanyol berkaitan tuduhan mengelak membayar cukai pendapatan pada tahun 2018.

article_content:
Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has sharply criticized Israel's ongoing blockade and airstrikes on the Gaza Strip, describing them as a 'massacre.' Addressing members of his ruling party in parliament on Wednesday, Erdogan stressed that even warfare must adhere to moral boundaries, saying recent actions have gravely overstepped these limits.

He denounced both the deaths of Israeli civilians and the widespread killing of Palestinians in Gaza, arguing that indiscriminately bombing residential areas and denying people essential needs like food and water goes far beyond acceptable conduct in war.

Since Saturday, at least 1,055 Palestinians and 1,200 Israelis have been killed after Hamas launched a major attack inside Israel. More than 100 hostages were taken by Hamas, and thousands more have been wounded on both sides of the conflict.

Israel has enforced a full siege on Gaza—currently home to about 2.3 million people—cutting off food, fuel, and basic utilities. The only power station in Gaza has stopped operating, leaving the enclave without electricity. Erdogan argued that Israel’s harsh policies toward Palestinians are at the core of the ongoing unrest.

He warned that any country that acts more like a militant organization than a state risks being perceived accordingly, and he criticized Israel’s operations as lacking any ethical foundation. Erdogan urged the international community not to support either side blindly and called for the protection of civilians and the delivery of humanitarian assistance, emphasizing that unresolved issues will only spark more violence.

Turkey, a consistent supporter of Palestinians and not designating Hamas as a terrorist group, has offered to mediate in the conflict. Erdogan and his foreign minister have reached out to regional leaders and the United States to help ease tensions. However, Israel’s envoy to Ankara has replied that it is too early for mediation discussions.
translated_content:
Presiden Turki, Recep Tayyip Erdogan, telah mengkritik keras sekatan dan serangan udara Israel ke atas Semenanjung Gaza, menyifatkannya sebagai 'pembantaian.' Dalam ucapannya kepada ahli parti pemerintah di parlimen pada hari Rabu, Erdogan menekankan bahawa walaupun dalam peperangan, batas moral perlu dipatuhi, dan tindakan terbaharu telah amat melampaui had itu.

Beliau mengecam kematian orang awam Israel serta pembunuhan besar-besaran rakyat Palestin di Gaza, mengatakan bahawa pengeboman kawasan kediaman dan sekatan terhadap keperluan asas seperti makanan serta air langsung tidak boleh diterima dalam peperangan.

Sejak Sabtu lalu, sekurang-kurangnya 1,055 rakyat Palestin dan 1,200 rakyat Israel dilaporkan terbunuh selepas serangan besar-besaran Hamas di Israel, dan lebih 100 orang dijadikan tebusan oleh Hamas, manakala ribuan lagi cedera di kedua-dua belah pihak.

Israel telah melaksanakan sekatan penuh ke atas Gaza—yang dihuni sekitar 2.3 juta orang—dengan memutuskan bekalan makanan, bahan api dan keperluan asas. Satu-satunya stesen janakuasa di Gaza telah berhenti beroperasi, menyebabkan seluruh wilayah itu bergelap. Erdogan berpendapat dasar keras Israel terhadap rakyat Palestin menjadi punca utama konflik yang berpanjangan.

Beliau memberi amaran bahawa negara yang bertindak seperti organisasi militan dan bukannya seperti negara, berisiko dipandang begitu juga, dan mengkritik tindakan Israel yang dilihat tidak berasaskan etika. Erdogan menggesa masyarakat antarabangsa agar tidak menyebelahi mana-mana pihak secara membuta tuli serta memastikan perlindungan orang awam dan bantuan kemanusiaan, menegaskan isu pokok yang tidak diselesaikan hanya akan membawa kepada lebih banyak keganasan.

Turki yang kukuh menyokong rakyat Palestin dan tidak menganggap Hamas sebagai kumpulan pengganas, telah menawarkan diri sebagai perantara konflik. Erdogan dan Menteri Luar Turki telah menghubungi pemimpin serantau serta Amerika Syarikat untuk membantu meredakan ketegangan. Namun, duta Israel ke Ankara menyatakan usaha pendamaian masih terlalu awal untuk dibincangkan.

article_content: Boxer Amir Khan sought assistance from the Prime Minister after being denied a US visa on the anniversary of the 9/11 attacks. The British Muslim had his application refused by US immigration officers while attempting to board a flight to Las Vegas to commentate on a fight last September. Fortunately, Khan, well-known in America, was able to contact David Cameron, who intervened on his behalf. In an interview with The Times, the 28-year-old champion recounted being turned away at the gate while traveling to see Floyd Mayweather fight Marcos Maidana. Khan explained, 'I was flying out on September 11. The immigration officers were cautious. They told me my visa was refused, and I couldn’t board the plane. David Cameron takes my calls and is a good friend—he even opened a community centre for me. I called him, explained my issue, and he was able to resolve it.' Khan also described meeting Hillary Clinton in Washington, where she asked about his immigration issues and took his name. Since then, he has not faced further problems with US entry. He expressed gratitude for his connections and what boxing has given him. Discussing the impact of Islamic extremism on British Muslims, Khan criticized UKIP leader Nigel Farage for attributing the Paris attacks to multiculturalism. The boxer said, 'What Nigel Farage said makes me angry. I was born here, went to school here, my friends are here. I’ve won a world title with the Union Jack on my shorts and an Olympic medal with pride. I am as British as anyone.' Khan, a silver medalist at the 2004 Athens Olympics at age 17, also shared how Islamic extremism has affected his life. He noted being stopped more often in his car and at immigration, but said he considers it necessary for the safety of the country. Recently, Khan visited a Pakistani school where 148 people were killed in a terrorist attack. He donated the £30,000 shorts he wore in his welterweight title win. He explained, 'I have cancelled trips to Pakistan in the past for safety reasons. But as a father, I wanted to encourage those children to overcome fear and return to school. That’s the way to overcome terrorism.'

Khan berkata, 'Saya terbang pada 11 September. Pegawai imigresen kelihatan berhati-hati. Mereka beritahu visa saya ditolak, jadi saya tak boleh naik pesawat. David Cameron selalu ambil panggilan saya dan dia kawan baik—beliau juga pernah merasmikan pusat komuniti saya. Saya hubungi dia, ceritakan masalah saya, dan dia berjaya selesaikan perkara itu.' Sejak itu, dia tidak lagi menghadapi masalah untuk masuk ke AS. Khan meluahkan rasa syukur atas hubungan yang dimilikinya dan kelebihan yang diperolehi melalui tinju. Saya menang gelaran dunia dengan bendera Union Jack di seluar pendek saya dan pingat Olimpik dengan penuh rasa bangga. Saya sama British seperti sesiapa sahaja.' article_content: The Costa Concordia cruise ship has reached the end of its final journey. Refloated by salvage teams earlier this month, the rusting vessel docked at the Voltri port in Genoa, Italy, early Sunday. The ship had run aground in January 2012 near Giglio Island, carrying over 4,200 passengers. It was carefully brought into a dry dock for salvage after making the four-day voyage from Giglio to Genoa, accompanied by a convoy of vessels. Despite encountering strong winds and storms one night, the ship arrived without major incident, according to civil protection chief Franco Gabrielli. One person, Russel Rebello, a 33-year-old waiter, is still missing from the tragedy, which resulted in 32 deaths. Search efforts for Rebello continue on board the ship in Genoa and at the wreck site near Giglio, where the ship sat for 30 months. Salvage master Nick Sloane expressed hope that this operation would bring closure to Rebello’s family. Environmental concerns led to the decision to refloat and tow the ship to Genoa for dismantling, rather than breaking it apart in the Mediterranean. The Costa Concordia salvage is the largest and most expensive operation of its kind, costing around $1.5 billion so far. Dismantling the ship is expected to take two years. The process will start with removing passengers’ luggage and personal belongings. Over 80% of the ship’s materials, including copper wiring, pipes, kitchen equipment, and recyclable plastics, will be reused or recycled. About 50,000 tons of steel will be melted down and resold for construction and manufacturing. Since the 2012 accident, 24 metric tons of various debris, such as furniture, dishes, food, and ship parts, have been recovered from the seabed. Reporting by Barbie Latza Nadeau in Rome and Jethro Mullen in Hong Kong.
translated_content: Kapal persiaran Costa Concordia telah sampai ke penghujung perjalanannya yang terakhir. Selepas berjaya diapungkan semula oleh pasukan penyelamat awal bulan ini, kapal berkarat itu berlabuh di pelabuhan Voltri di Genoa, Itali, pada awal pagi Ahad. Kapal tersebut telah karam pada Januari 2012 berhampiran Pulau Giglio, membawa lebih daripada 4,200 penumpang. Ia dibawa dengan berhati-hati ke dok kering untuk kerja-kerja penyelamatan selepas menempuh perjalanan empat hari dari Giglio ke Genoa, diiringi konvoi kapal. Walaupun berdepan angin kencang dan ribut pada satu malam, kapal itu tiba tanpa insiden besar, menurut ketua perlindungan awam, Franco Gabrielli. Seorang individu, Russel Rebello, seorang pelayan berusia 33 tahun, masih hilang akibat tragedi itu yang mengorbankan 32 nyawa. Usaha pencarian Rebello diteruskan di atas kapal di Genoa serta di lokasi nahas dekat Giglio, tempat kapal itu terdampar selama 30 bulan. Ketua penyelamat, Nick Sloane, berharap operasi ini dapat memberi penutupan kepada keluarga Rebello. article_content: Reince Priebus has announced his bid for a third term as chairman of the Republican National Committee (RNC), emphasizing pledges of support from 150 out of 168 committee members. In a message to the RNC, Priebus thanked members for their backing and requested their continued support. Having led the RNC out of a $25 million debt after the 2010 midterms—following Michael Steele's tenure—Priebus is credited with regaining support from significant Republican donors. After 2012, his focus shifted to enhancing the party’s technology and voter outreach, especially among minority groups. He also led the 'Growth and Opportunity Project', which aimed to broaden the Republican base. While the initiative was mostly accepted within the party, there was pushback from some social conservatives regarding suggestions for greater inclusivity of LGBTQ people. Priebus currently faces no challengers. If re-elected at the RNC Winter Meeting in January, he would become the RNC’s longest-serving chairman.

Dalam mesej kepada RNC, Priebus berterima kasih atas sokongan tersebut dan memohon agar sokongan itu diteruskan. Selepas memimpin RNC keluar daripada hutang sebanyak $25 juta selepas pilihan raya pertengahan 2010—selepas era Michael Steele—Priebus dihargai kerana berjaya menarik semula sokongan daripada penderma utama Republikan. Selepas 2012, beliau memberi tumpuan kepada peningkatan teknologi parti dan penambahbaikan usaha mendekati pengundi, terutama dalam kalangan komuniti minoriti. Beliau turut mengetuai ‘Projek Pertumbuhan dan Peluang’ yang bertujuan memperluaskan pengaruh parti Republikan.
