A larger bipartisan group of U.S. lawmakers is pressing the Biden administration for details on how it plans to address China’s increasing adoption of RISC-V chip design technology. This follows recent Reuters reports highlighting growing concerns about RISC-V in both chambers of Congress.

RISC-V (pronounced 'risk five') is a free, open-source alternative to the proprietary chip design technologies developed by companies like Arm Holdings and Intel. It serves as a key component in devices ranging from smartphones to advanced artificial intelligence processors.

While leading U.S. technology companies such as Qualcomm and Google have adopted RISC-V, many Chinese firms are also leveraging the technology. Last month, Reuters reported that at least four influential U.S. lawmakers perceive China’s use of RISC-V as a potential national security threat, given that the technology falls outside the scope of current U.S. export controls on chip technologies sent to China.

Now, 18 lawmakers—including five Democrats—have sent a letter to Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo, requesting the administration's strategy for preventing China from achieving dominance in RISC-V technology and using it to the potential detriment of U.S. national and economic security. The letter’s signatories feature both the Republican chairman and the ranking Democrat from the House select committee on China, as well as Democratic lawmakers from New Jersey, Florida, Michigan, and Indiana.

The lawmakers also inquired about the possibility of leveraging an existing executive order to require U.S. companies to obtain export licenses before collaborating with Chinese companies on RISC-V technology.

The group emphasized in their letter that open-source collaboration on RISC-V could significantly benefit the U.S. semiconductor sector, but these advantages depend on contributors focusing solely on improving the technology rather than furthering China’s technological or geopolitical ambitions.

A Commerce Department spokesperson confirmed that Secretary Raimondo had received the letter and would respond through the appropriate channels.

Ini berikutan laporan Reuters baru-baru ini yang menyorot kebimbangan yang semakin meningkat mengenai RISC-V dalam kedua-dua dewan Kongres.

RISC-V (disebut 'risk five') ialah teknologi reka bentuk cip sumber terbuka percuma yang merupakan alternatif kepada teknologi proprietari yang dibangunkan oleh syarikat seperti Arm Holdings dan Intel. Ia berfungsi sebagai komponen utama dalam pelbagai peranti, daripada telefon pintar hingga pemproses kecerdasan buatan yang canggih.

Syarikat teknologi utama AS seperti Qualcomm dan Google telah menggunakan RISC-V, begitu juga banyak syarikat dari China. Bulan lalu, Reuters melaporkan bahawa sekurang-kurangnya empat ahli parlimen AS yang berpengaruh menganggap penggunaan RISC-V oleh China sebagai potensi ancaman keselamatan negara memandangkan teknologi tersebut tidak termaktub dalam kawalan eksport sedia ada AS terhadap teknologi cip ke China.

Kini, 18 ahli parlimen—termasuk lima Demokrat—telah menghantar surat kepada Setiausaha Perdagangan Gina Raimondo, meminta strategi pentadbiran dalam menghalang China daripada menguasai teknologi RISC-V dan menggunakannya sehingga memberi kesan negatif terhadap keselamatan negara dan ekonomi AS. Penandatangan surat itu termasuk pengerusi Republikan dan Demokrat teratas dari jawatankuasa khas House mengenai China, serta ahli parlimen Demokrat dari New Jersey, Florida, Michigan, dan Indiana.

Kumpulan ini menegaskan dalam surat mereka bahawa kerjasama sumber terbuka dalam RISC-V boleh memberi manfaat besar kepada sektor semikonduktor AS, namun manfaat ini hanya akan tercapai jika penyumbang memberi tumpuan sepenuhnya kepada penambahbaikan teknologi tersebut dan bukannya membantu matlamat teknologi atau geopolitik China.

Jurucakap Jabatan Perdagangan mengesahkan bahawa Setiausaha Raimondo telah menerima surat itu dan akan memberikan maklum balas melalui saluran yang sesuai.

Robert Clark, founder and CEO of Cloverleaf Analytics, notes that the insurance industry has undergone significant transformation in recent decades. Technologies such as cloud computing, real-time analytics, and artificial intelligence—once considered futuristic—are now central to daily operations. Insurance professionals today require a vastly different set of skills compared to 20 years ago, with a focus on digital infrastructure and data-driven tools.

Data analytics and AI are foundational to modern insurance, supporting informed decision-making and the creation of tailored products and services. Employees at every level need to be proficient in interpreting business data and leveraging it for strategic and operational improvements—not just basic spreadsheet or CRM applications.

Effective evaluation of technology is crucial for leadership. Leaders must distinguish between truly innovative solutions and superficial updates, recognizing that innovation may come from both established firms and new insurtech companies.

Cybersecurity and data privacy have become essential safeguards for insurers and their clients. Comprehensive risk management, regulatory compliance, and protective cybersecurity practices are needed throughout the organization, including measures like cyber insurance to reduce potential breach impacts.

Blockchain technology is reshaping insurance by providing opportunities for greater transparency and trust, as seen with decentralized insurers like Nexus Mutual. Understanding blockchain's potential can create new revenue streams and improve customer engagement.

Adopting cloud-based IT infrastructure enables insurers to enhance security, manage costs, and quickly implement advanced technologies. A strong grasp of cloud core systems is vital for maintaining resilience and adaptability moving forward.

Additionally, leveraging advanced communication tools—such as chatbots and virtual assistants—can improve productivity and customer experiences. To remain competitive, insurers should invest in in-depth technology training, foster innovation, and stay attuned to leading practices across sectors. Adaptability and a commitment to technological advancement will ensure insurers can thrive in the evolving digital landscape.

(Forbes Technology Council: An exclusive community for technology executives.)

article_content: Paul Mathis, a restaurateur from Melbourne, Australia, has proposed a new symbol, 'Ћ', to replace the word 'the'—the most commonly used term in the English language. Mathis has invested AUD $38,000 (about £23,500) in developing an app that incorporates the symbol, aiming to make typing faster, especially on platforms like Twitter. Despite Mathis's enthusiasm, Apple has so far declined to approve and promote his app in its iTunes store. Mathis points out that while 'and' (the fifth most used word) enjoys its own symbol—the ampersand (&)—'the' has none. He believes that having a single-character symbol for 'the' would benefit digital communication. Mathis, who has founded over 20 restaurants and hotels in Australia, remains hopeful that Apple’s stance will change. Currently, the five most commonly used words in English are: the, be, to, of, and 'and'.

Mathis telah melaburkan AUD $38,000 (kira-kira £23,500) untuk membangunkan aplikasi yang menggunakan simbol ini, dengan tujuan mempercepatkan aktiviti menaip, terutamanya di platform seperti Twitter. Walaupun Mathis sangat bersemangat, Apple setakat ini telah menolak untuk meluluskan dan mempromosikan aplikasinya di iTunes store. Mathis menegaskan bahawa walaupun 'and' (perkataan kelima paling kerap digunakan) mempunyai simbolnya sendiri—ampersand (&)—'the' masih belum ada. Beliau percaya penggunaan satu simbol untuk 'the' akan memudahkan komunikasi digital. Mathis, yang telah membuka lebih 20 restoran dan hotel di Australia, masih berharap Apple akan mengubah pendiriannya. Kini, lima perkataan paling kerap digunakan dalam bahasa Inggeris ialah: the, be, to, of, dan 'and'.

WishCare, a direct-to-consumer personal care brand, has received Rs 20 crore in its first institutional funding round from Unilever Ventures, the venture capital arm of Unilever. The company stated that it will use the funds to enhance its research and development capabilities, focusing on the formulation of effective products with clinically tested ingredients.

Founded in 2019 by Stuti Kothari, Ankit Kothari, and Ayush Kothari, WishCare currently reports annual recurring revenue of Rs 85 crore. Over the past year, the startup claims it has grown fourfold while maintaining a strong double-digit EBITDA.

Pawan Chaturvedi, partner at Unilever Ventures, said, “We are pleased to add WishCare to our growing beauty and wellness portfolio in India. WishCare has built a range of evidence-based products that have experienced rapid growth, and we look forward to supporting the founders in building a lasting brand.”

Unilever Ventures has been expanding its presence in India with investments in companies such as Plum, Minimalist, Curefit, and What’s Up Wellness.

WishCare offers a variety of products, including haircare and skincare items, hair-growth serums, face serums, sunscreens, and body lotions formulated with active ingredients. The products are available on more than 15 marketplaces, including Nykaa, Amazon, Flipkart, Purplle, Myntra, and WishCare's own website.

“Our focus has always been to understand customer needs and co-create innovative, effective products with them. As we move into the next growth phase, we’re excited to partner with Unilever Ventures and set new industry benchmarks,” said cofounder Stuti Kothari.

Ditubuhkan pada tahun 2019 oleh Stuti Kothari, Ankit Kothari dan Ayush Kothari, WishCare kini melaporkan hasil tahunan berulang sebanyak Rs 85 juta. Sepanjang tahun lalu, syarikat ini mendakwa telah berkembang empat kali ganda sambil mengekalkan EBITDA dua digit yang kukuh.

Pawan Chaturvedi, rakan kongsi di Unilever Ventures, berkata, "Kami gembira menambah WishCare ke dalam portfolio kecantikan dan kesihatan kami yang berkembang di India. WishCare telah membina rangkaian produk berasaskan bukti yang menunjukkan pertumbuhan pesat, dan kami teruja untuk menyokong para pengasas membina jenama yang berkekalan."

Produk ini boleh didapati di lebih 15 platform pasaran termasuk Nykaa, Amazon, Flipkart, Purplle, Myntra dan laman web rasmi WishCare.

article_content: When three-year-old Oliver Cahill picked up the phone and dialled 999 to ask for Fireman Sam, he unintentionally triggered an emergency response. Instead of Oliver’s hero—the fearless, fictional TV firefighter—arriving at the door, a female police officer showed up. Oliver was disappointed, telling her, "I wanted Fireman Sam." Oliver’s parents, Andrew and Leanne, usually let him play with the house phone only when it is unplugged at their home in Blackpool. However, on this occasion, a friend had left the phone connected after using it, and PC Claire Van Deurs Goss came to investigate the 999 call. Leanne Cahill, 31, said, "My friend borrowed the phone to call their doctor and must have left it plugged in. I saw Oliver playing with it in the dining room and thought nothing of it." When the police officer arrived, Leanne was surprised, as she had never previously had any problems with the police. The officer asked whether there was a child in the home and explained that the police had received a call from a young child. Oliver, unaware of the seriousness of his actions, was disappointed when PC Van Deurs Goss stood in the doorway. Leanne said, "He didn’t want her, he wanted Fireman Sam. He knew exactly what he’d done—the lady on the phone asked him why he had called 999, and he said he was trying to phone Fireman Sam." The phone is now kept unplugged, but Oliver continues to hope to meet his hero. Leanne added, "He’s a big Fireman Sam fan and has all the action figures. He’s picked up the phone a few times since, but it’s always been unplugged. Every time, he says the same thing: he wants to speak to Fireman Sam." PC Van Deurs Goss, who attended the incident, said, "When I arrived, his mum was surprised to see the police. Immediately, we saw the three-year-old in the room shouting, 'I wanted Fireman Sam.' He was a little disappointed it was police officers and not a fireman, but I think he was still glad we came to see him."

Oliver berasa kecewa dan berkata, "Saya nak Fireman Sam." Ibu bapa Oliver, Andrew dan Leanne, biasanya membiarkan dia bermain dengan telefon rumah hanya apabila ia dicabut plug di rumah mereka di Blackpool. Namun, kali ini, seorang kawan telah meninggalkan telefon itu masih tersambung selepas menggunakannya dan PC Claire Van Deurs Goss datang untuk menyiasat panggilan 999 itu. Leanne Cahill, 31, berkata, "Kawan saya pinjam telefon itu untuk hubungi doktor mereka dan mungkin terlupa untuk cabut plug-nya. Saya nampak Oliver bermain dengan telefon di ruang makan dan tak fikir apa-apa." Apabila pegawai polis tiba, Leanne terkejut kerana sebelum ini tidak pernah ada apa-apa masalah dengan pihak polis. Pegawai itu bertanya sama ada terdapat anak kecil di rumah dan menerangkan bahawa mereka menerima panggilan daripada seorang kanak-kanak. Oliver yang tidak menyedari keseriusan tindakannya, berasa kecewa apabila PC Van Deurs Goss berdiri di pintu. Leanne berkata, "Dia tak nak pegawai polis tu, dia nak Fireman Sam. Dia tahu apa yang dibuat—wanita di telefon itu tanya kenapa dia telefon 999, dan dia jawab hendak telefon Fireman Sam." Kini, telefon itu sentiasa dicabut plug, tetapi Oliver masih berharap dapat bertemu dengan hero kegemarannya. Leanne menambah, "Dia memang peminat tegar Fireman Sam dan ada semua figura aksinya. Dia dah beberapa kali angkat telefon sejak itu, tapi sentiasa dicabut plug. Setiap kali, dia tetap nak bercakap dengan Fireman Sam." Dia sedikit kecewa sebab yang datang polis, bukan anggota bomba, tapi saya rasa dia tetap gembira kami datang berjumpa dia."

article_content: Investors erased around $20 billion from Alibaba Group’s market value on Friday after the company canceled plans to spin off its cloud business, citing uncertainties from US export restrictions on AI chips. Alibaba’s Hong Kong shares dropped 10%, marking their biggest daily decrease in over a year. This marked the first reaction in Asian markets after Alibaba’s strategy reversal was revealed late Thursday; its US-listed securities had also fallen 9% after the news. Jon Withaar, head of Asia special situations at Pictet Asset Management, called the move a surprise and suggested there may be unseen factors driving the decision. Alibaba said the US export curbs imposed in October were a key concern. This echoed similar sentiments from Tencent Holdings, which said new rules would require it to look for domestic alternatives. Once Asia’s most valuable listed company, Alibaba was worth about $830 billion at its peak in October 2020, but is now worth less than a quarter of that after regulatory crackdowns and a slowing Chinese economy. Asked for further reasons for the cancellation, Alibaba referred to chairman Joseph Tsai’s earnings call remarks about prioritizing investment in the cloud unit. These developments highlight continued challenges for China’s tech industry, as export limits make it harder for firms to access critical US chips. Back in March, Alibaba announced a major restructuring to create six business groups, including spinning off the cloud unit. Analysts at the time valued the cloud business at $41–$60 billion, but warned a listing would attract regulatory scrutiny over its vast data holdings. Alibaba also paused the listing plans for its grocery business, Freshippo, but confirmed it is proceeding with an IPO of logistics arm Cainiao, which filed for a Hong Kong listing in September. Reports emerged that a family trust linked to Alibaba co-founder Jack Ma plans to sell 10 million American Depositary Shares, which analysts said could weigh on market sentiment even though Ma no longer runs the company. Chairman Joseph Tsai said after reporting earnings that Alibaba plans to focus on growing the cloud business and investing in artificial intelligence. Some analysts believe keeping the cloud unit may help the company’s AI ambitions, given strong demand for AI computing in China. Bo Pei of US Tiger Research noted that US chip restrictions could negatively affect Alibaba’s long-term service capability, but retaining the cloud division is important due to surging AI demand. For the second quarter, Alibaba posted revenue of 224.79 billion yuan ($31.01 billion), in line with analyst estimates. CEO Eddie Wu shared that each business unit will operate more independently and that the company will review its businesses to define ‘core’ versus ‘non-core’ units. Analysts viewed Wu’s leadership changes positively after Daniel Zhang’s recent resignation. Vey-Sern Ling at Union Bancaire Privee commented that spinning off the cloud unit might not currently enhance shareholder value given depressed market valuations. Alibaba is also preparing for external fundraising for its international digital commerce business, which includes platforms like Lazada and Alibaba.com.

Saham Alibaba di Hong Kong jatuh 10%, penurunan harian terbesar dalam lebih setahun. Ini merupakan reaksi pertama pasaran Asia selepas perubahan strategi Alibaba diumumkan lewat Khamis; sekuriti tersenarai di Amerika Syarikat juga jatuh sebanyak 9% selepas berita itu. Jon Withaar, ketua Asia special situations di Pictet Asset Management, menyifatkan keputusan itu sebagai mengejutkan dan mencadangkan mungkin terdapat faktor tersembunyi yang mempengaruhi keputusan tersebut. Alibaba berkata sekatan eksport AS yang dikenakan pada Oktober merupakan kebimbangan utama. Ini sejajar dengan sentimen dari Tencent Holdings, yang menyatakan peraturan baharu memaksa mereka mencari alternatif domestik. Pernah menjadi syarikat paling bernilai di Asia, nilai pasaran Alibaba menyusut daripada kira-kira AS$830 bilion pada kemuncaknya pada Oktober 2020 kepada kurang daripada satu perempat selepas penguatkuasaan peraturan dan kemerosotan ekonomi China. Apabila ditanya mengenai sebab lain pembatalan itu, Alibaba merujuk kepada kenyataan pengerusi Joseph Tsai dalam panggilan keputusan kewangan mengenai keutamaan pelaburan ke unit cloud. Perkembangan ini menyoroti cabaran berterusan bagi industri teknologi China, kerana had eksport menyukarkan syarikat mendapatkan cip penting dari AS. Pada bulan Mac, Alibaba mengumumkan penstrukturan semula besar-besaran dengan mewujudkan enam kumpulan perniagaan termasuk usaha untuk memisahkan unit cloud. Penganalisis ketika itu menilai bahagian cloud pada AS$41–$60 bilion, namun memberi amaran penyenaraian boleh menarik perhatian pengawal selia kerana jumlah data yang dimiliki. Alibaba juga menangguhkan rancangan penyenaraian untuk perniagaan runcitannya, Freshippo, tetapi mengesahkan akan meneruskan IPO unit logistiknya, Cainiao, yang telah memohon penyenaraian di Hong Kong pada September. Terdapat laporan bahawa sebuah amanah keluarga yang dikaitkan dengan pengasas bersama Alibaba, Jack Ma, merancang untuk menjual 10 juta Saham Depositari Amerika, yang menurut penganalisis boleh memberi tekanan kepada sentimen pasaran walaupun Ma tidak lagi mengendalikan syarikat itu. Pengerusi Joseph Tsai berkata selepas membentangkan keputusan kewangan bahawa Alibaba akan memfokus kepada pertumbuhan perniagaan cloud dan pelaburan dalam kecerdasan buatan. Sesetengah penganalisis percaya mengekalkan unit cloud boleh membantu inisiatif AI syarikat itu kerana permintaan AI yang kuat di China. Bo Pei dari US Tiger Research menyatakan sekatan cip oleh AS boleh menjejaskan kemampuan jangka panjang Alibaba, tetapi mengekalkan bahagian cloud adalah penting kerana permintaan AI yang semakin meningkat. Untuk suku kedua, Alibaba mencatatkan pendapatan sebanyak 224.79 bilion yuan (AS$31.01 bilion), sejajar dengan anggaran penganalisis. Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Eddie Wu berkata setiap unit perniagaan akan beroperasi secara lebih berdikari dan syarikat akan menyemak semula urusan perniagaan untuk menentukan 'teras' dan 'bukan teras'. Penganalisis memberi reaksi positif terhadap perubahan pimpinan Wu selepas peletakan jawatan Daniel Zhang baru-baru ini. Vey-Sern Ling dari Union Bancaire Privee mengulas bahawa pemisahan bahagian cloud mungkin tidak meningkatkan nilai pemegang saham buat masa ini memandangkan penilaian pasaran yang rendah. Alibaba juga sedang bersiap untuk pembiayaan luar bagi perniagaan perdagangan digital antarabangsa, termasuk platform seperti Lazada dan Alibaba.com.

article_content: The inaugural population survey of Amur falcons in Manipur’s Tamenglong district was recently carried out at Chiuluan village, with results estimating around 141,274 migratory birds currently roosting there. Eleven members of Wildlife Explorers Manipur (WEM) led the effort, utilizing drones, GPS technology, and telephoto cameras, and were supported by Rainforest Club Tamenglong and local forestry staff. Chiuluan is one of six primary roosting locations in the district, along with Bhalok, Matung, Puching, Punglam, and Duigailong, according to forest officials. The findings were announced by WEM president Khoyumthem Brajesh Kumar during the 8th Amur Falcon Festival, emphasizing that this project is a pilot exercise intended to pave the way for a comprehensive district-wide census in the future. The birds’ roosting site lies in bamboo forests lining the Barak river, about 160 kilometers from Imphal. Amur falcons migrate from South Eastern Siberia and Northern China to Manipur and nearby Nagaland in mid-October. Known locally as Akhoipuina or Kahoipuina in the Rongmei dialect, they rest in the area for approximately a month before continuing on to Africa, where they briefly stop before returning to their breeding regions. Divisional Forest Officer Amandeep, who organized the survey, indicated that similar initiatives will be extended to additional roosting sites next year. There are also plans to tag two falcons with the assistance of the Wildlife Institute of India, aiming to enhance knowledge about their migration routes. During the festival, Deputy Commissioner Angshim Dangshawa encouraged increased community awareness and conservation efforts to protect the falcons during their seasonal visit to Tamenglong.
translated_content: Tinjauan populasi Amur falcon yang pertama di daerah Tamenglong, Manipur, baru-baru ini dijalankan di kampung Chiuluan. Hasil tinjauan menganggarkan sekitar 141,274 burung migrasi ini sedang berteduh di sana. Usaha ini diketuai sebelas ahli Wildlife Explorers Manipur (WEM) menggunakan dron, teknologi GPS dan kamera telefoto, serta mendapat sokongan Rainforest Club Tamenglong dan kakitangan perhutanan tempatan. Chiuluan ialah satu daripada enam lokasi utama tempat berteduh falcon di daerah tersebut, bersama Bhalok, Matung, Puching, Punglam dan Duigailong, menurut pegawai perhutanan. Penemuan tersebut diumumkan Presiden WEM, Khoyumthem Brajesh Kumar, sempena Festival Amur Falcon ke-8, menekankan projek ini sebagai langkah awal menuju tinjauan komprehensif di seluruh daerah kelak. Tapak berteduh burung ini terletak di hutan buluh sepanjang sungai Barak, kira-kira 160 kilometer dari Imphal. Amur falcon bermigrasi dari Siberia Tenggara dan China Utara dan tiba di Manipur serta Nagaland berdekatan pada pertengahan Oktober. Dikenali secara tempatan sebagai Akhoipuina atau Kahoipuina dalam dialek Rongmei, burung ini tinggal sekitar sebulan sebelum berlepas ke Afrika, di mana mereka singgah seketika sebelum kembali ke kawasan pembiakan. Pegawai Hutan Bahagian, Amandeep, mengetuai tinjauan itu dan menyatakan inisiatif seperti ini akan diperluas ke lokasi lain tahun hadapan. Rancangan turut melibatkan penandaan dua burung Amur falcon dengan kerjasama Institut Hidupan Liar India bagi mempertingkat pemahaman corak migrasi mereka. Sepanjang festival, Timbalan Pesuruhjaya Angshim Dangshawa menggesa kesedaran masyarakat dan usaha pemuliharaan dipertingkatkan untuk melindungi Amur falcon sewaktu persinggahan mereka di Tamenglong.

article_content: Delta Airlines is facing criticism after D. Baraka Kanaan, a former college professor who is unable to walk, filed a lawsuit claiming the airline failed to accommodate his disability. According to the suit, Kanaan was forced to crawl down the aisle of a plane, down a flight of steps, and across a tarmac at a Massachusetts airport on two separate occasions. The lawsuit, filed on July 23 in U.S. Federal District Court in Hawaii, states that on July 26, 2012, Kanaan was traveling from Hawaii to Nantucket Island, Massachusetts, to attend a conference. Kanaan, who has partial paralysis of his legs from a 2000 car accident, says he contacted Delta weeks before his trip to request assistance boarding and deplaning. Kanaan claims a Delta representative assured him that arrangements would be made. However, after his initial flight was canceled due to weather, he was rebooked. Upon arrival in Nantucket, Kanaan says there was no aisle chair or lift available to help him off the plane. He alleges that when he asked for assistance, flight attendants told him they could not help, despite a lift being visible at an adjacent gate. Wearing his best suit, Kanaan reportedly had to crawl hand-over-hand down the aisle, down stairs, and across the tarmac to his wheelchair, without help from the crew and in view of other passengers. Kanaan says this caused significant physical and emotional distress. Before returning to Hawaii, Kanaan says he called Delta to ensure the needed equipment would be available for his return flight. However, he alleges the equipment was unavailable again, and a flight attendant offered him cardboard to protect his clothes as he crawled. Upon his return, Delta reportedly offered Kanaan 25,000 frequent flyer miles and a $100 voucher, which he refused, fearing further similar treatment. Kanaan leads the Lovevolution Foundation, promoting world peace. The Air Carrier Access Act requires airlines to provide boarding assistance to passengers with disabilities on larger planes, but the seating capacity of Kanaan’s flight is unclear. Delta had not commented on the lawsuit or filed a response as of Friday, according to court records. Kanaan is seeking compensatory and punitive damages.
translated_content: Delta Airlines sedang menghadapi kritikan selepas D. Baraka Kanaan, bekas pensyarah kolej yang tidak dapat berjalan, memfailkan saman mendakwa syarikat penerbangan gagal mengakomodasi kecacatannya. Menurut tuntutan itu, Kanaan terpaksa merangkak di lorong pesawat, turun tangga, dan melintasi landasan di sebuah lapangan terbang di Massachusetts sebanyak dua kali. Saman yang difailkan pada 23 Julai di Mahkamah Daerah Persekutuan A.S. di Hawaii itu menyatakan pada 26 Julai 2012, Kanaan dalam perjalanan dari Hawaii ke Nantucket Island, Massachusetts, untuk menghadiri persidangan. Kanaan, yang mengalami lumpuh sebahagian kaki akibat kemalangan kereta pada tahun 2000, berkata beliau menghubungi Delta beberapa minggu sebelum perjalanan untuk meminta bantuan semasa naik dan turun pesawat. Kanaan mendakwa wakil Delta memberi jaminan bahawa persiapan akan dibuat. Namun, selepas penerbangan asalnya dibatalkan kerana cuaca, beliau ditempah semula. Setibanya di Nantucket, Kanaan berkata tiada kerusi lorong atau lif disediakan untuk membantunya turun dari pesawat. Beliau mendakwa apabila meminta bantuan, pramugari memberitahunya mereka tidak dapat membantu, walaupun lif dilihat tersedia di pintu bersebelahan. Dengan memakai sut terbaiknya, Kanaan dilaporkan terpaksa merangkak menggunakan tangan di lorong pesawat, menuruni tangga dan melintasi landasan ke kerusi rodanya tanpa bantuan kru dan diperhatikan penumpang lain. Kanaan berkata insiden ini menyebabkan tekanan fizikal dan emosi yang besar. Sebelum pulang ke Hawaii, Kanaan berkata beliau menghubungi Delta untuk memastikan peralatan yang diperlukan akan disediakan untuk penerbangan pulang. Namun, beliau mendakwa peralatan itu sekali lagi tiada, dan seorang pramugari menawarkan kadbod untuk melindungi pakaiannya semasa beliau merangkak. Setibanya di rumah, Delta dilaporkan menawarkan Kanaan 25,000 mata ganjaran penerbangan dan baucar $100, tetapi beliau menolak tawaran itu kerana bimbang kejadian serupa berulang. Kanaan mengetuai Lovevolution Foundation yang mempromosikan keamanan dunia. Akta Akses Pengangkutan Udara (Air Carrier Access Act) mewajibkan syarikat penerbangan memberi bantuan kepada penumpang kurang upaya di pesawat yang lebih besar, namun kapasiti tempat duduk pesawat Kanaan tidak jelas. Delta belum memberi komen berhubung saman tersebut atau memfailkan respons setakat Jumaat, menurut rekod mahkamah. Kanaan kini menuntut ganti rugi kompensasi dan punitif.

article_content: Filmmaker Sujoy Ghosh highlights the importance of balancing creative ambition with financial responsibility in the film industry. At India’s inaugural crime literature festival in Dehradun, Ghosh emphasized that directors should respect the financial commitments of producers and cannot focus solely on artistic expression. He mentioned modifying the ending of 'Jaane Jaan,' which is adapted from the Japanese novel 'The Devotion of Suspect X,' believing that its original conclusion might not appeal to Indian viewers. Ghosh approached 'Jaane Jaan' primarily as a story about unrequited love rather than just a murder mystery. He values setting films in places that are personally meaningful to him to ensure authenticity, noting his choices of Kolkata for 'Kahaani' and Kalimpong for 'Jaane Jaan.' According to Ghosh, Kalimpong’s misty and tranquil environment was ideal for the film, which stars Kareena Kapoor Khan, Jaideep Ahlawat, and Vijay Varma. This unique festival, dedicated to crime writing and its adaptations on screen, is scheduled to end on Sunday. Elsewhere in the news: India’s Income Tax Department is investigating the local branches of Apple, Google, and Amazon with a focus on transfer pricing compliance. Additionally, Indians have become the top investors in Dubai’s real estate scene. Razorpay, a digital payment platform, is contemplating moving its parent entity to India—a shift that may lead to significant US tax liabilities, according to industry insiders.

Beliau memaklumkan bahawa beliau telah mengubah pengakhiran filem 'Jaane Jaan', yang diadaptasi daripada novel Jepun 'The Devotion of Suspect X', kerana percaya pengakhiran asal tidak sesuai dengan cita rasa penonton India. Ghosh melihat 'Jaane Jaan' terutamanya sebagai kisah cinta tidak berbalas, bukan sekadar misteri pembunuhan. Beliau lebih suka memilih lokasi penggambaran yang dekat di hati untuk mengekalkan keaslian, seperti pilihannya Kolkata untuk 'Kahaani' dan Kalimpong untuk 'Jaane Jaan'. Menurut Ghosh, suasana berkabus dan tenang di Kalimpong amat serasi dengan mood filem ini, yang dibintangi Kareena Kapoor Khan, Jaideep Ahlawat, dan Vijay Varma. Festival unik yang memfokuskan kepada sastera jenayah dan adaptasinya ke layar perak ini akan berakhir pada hari Ahad. Dalam perkembangan lain: Jabatan Cukai Pendapatan India kini menyiasat operasi tempatan Apple, Google, dan Amazon dengan tumpuan kepada pematuhan harga pindahan (transfer pricing). Selain itu, rakyat India kini pelabur utama dalam pasaran hartanah Dubai. Razorpay, platform pembayaran digital, sedang mempertimbangkan untuk memindahkan syarikat induknya ke India—langkah yang mungkin mengakibatkan tanggungan cukai besar di Amerika Syarikat, menurut sumber industri.

article_content: The National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) states that women facing infertility have the right to fertility treatment. This week, NICE reminded NHS managers of the need for consistent access to IVF, pointing to serious national discrepancies. Women under 40 in the UK should be allowed up to three NHS-funded IVF cycles, while those aged 40 to 42 qualify for one cycle. However, most Clinical Commissioning Groups (CCGs) do not comply, with some offering minimal or no IVF options. NICE warns that withholding fertility assistance can profoundly impact emotional health, sometimes causing distress, depression, or strain on relationships. Professor Gillian Leng labeled infertility a notable health concern, criticizing persistent inequalities across different regions of the NHS. Trusts have been told not to deny treatment based on whether a partner has children from previous relationships. Patients facing cancer or chemotherapy should also be given the chance to freeze their eggs, since such treatments can reduce fertility. Even though recommendations were first published in 2004, most CCGs have still not adopted the full provisions. Surveys show just 24 percent meet the advised three IVF cycles due to financial pressures. The typical cost of IVF, about £3,500 per cycle, means some NHS groups hesitate to provide it; the guidelines are advisory, not legally binding, allowing policy differences. Fertility advocates stress that existing differences—known as the 'postcode lottery'—leave many without help. Case studies, like that of 25-year-old Elizabeth Rose from Kent, illustrate these issues. Despite suffering from Crohn’s disease and requiring chemotherapy, she was denied funding to freeze her eggs, contrary to NICE guidance. Political figures, including Commons leader Andrew Lansley and MP Caroline Dinenage, acknowledge ongoing unequal access and encourage CCGs to follow NICE’s guidance more closely.
translated_content: Institut Nasional untuk Kesihatan dan Penjagaan Cemerlang (NICE) menyatakan bahawa wanita yang menghadapi masalah kesuburan berhak untuk mendapatkan rawatan kesuburan. Minggu ini, NICE mengingatkan pengurus NHS tentang keperluan akses IVF yang konsisten, menyoroti perbezaan serius di seluruh negara. Wanita di bawah umur 40 tahun di UK sepatutnya layak menerima sehingga tiga kitaran IVF yang dibiayai NHS, manakala wanita berusia 40 hingga 42 layak untuk satu kitaran. Namun, kebanyakan Kumpulan Penugasan Klinikal (CCG) tidak mematuhi garis panduan ini, dengan sesetengah hanya menawarkan IVF yang minimum atau langsung tiada. NICE memberi amaran bahawa menahan bantuan kesuburan boleh memberi kesan mendalam kepada emosi, kadangkala menyebabkan tekanan, kemurungan atau ketegangan hubungan. Profesor Gillian Leng menyifatkan ketidaksuburan sebagai isu kesihatan yang serius dan mengkritik ketidaksamaan di antara wilayah dalam NHS. Pihak pengurusan juga diarahkan supaya tidak menolak rawatan berdasarkan sama ada pasangan mempunyai anak daripada hubungan sebelumnya. Pesakit kanser atau mereka yang bakal menjalani kemoterapi juga perlu diberi pilihan untuk membekukan telur, memandangkan rawatan tersebut boleh menjejaskan kesuburan. Walaupun cadangan ini telah diperkenalkan sejak 2004, kebanyakan CCG masih belum melaksanakan sepenuhnya. Kajian menunjukkan hanya 24 peratus menyediakan tiga kitaran IVF yang disyorkan, biasanya kerana kekangan kewangan. Kos IVF yang biasa sekitar £3,500 bagi setiap kitaran menyebabkan sesetengah kumpulan NHS enggan menyediakan rawatan ini; garis panduan tersebut adalah sebagai nasihat dan tidak wajib secara undang-undang, membolehkan polisi berbeza di setiap kawasan. Aktivis kesuburan menegaskan bahawa perbezaan sedia ada—dikenali sebagai 'permainan nasib mengikut poskod'—menyebabkan ramai tidak mendapat bantuan. Kisah individu seperti Elizabeth Rose, 25 tahun dari Kent, menonjolkan cabaran ini. Walaupun menghidap penyakit Crohn's dan bakal menjalani kemoterapi, dia ditolak pembiayaan untuk membekukan telur, bertentangan dengan arahan NICE. Pemimpin politik, termasuk ketua Commons Andrew Lansley dan Ahli Parlimen Caroline Dinenage, mengakui akses tidak seimbang masih berlaku dan menggesa CCG supaya lebih patuh pada garis panduan NICE.
post_content: IVF access on the NHS is still a postcode lottery in the UK—most women don't get the recommended treatment. NICE says it's time for fair access for everyone! #IVF #NHS #FertilityEquality

article_content: Scotland’s First Minister Nicola Sturgeon has said that SNP MPs elected in May will support Labour’s effort to repeal the Conservative government’s NHS reforms, despite these laws applying only to England. Sturgeon explained that SNP MPs plan to vote on this legislation because changes to English NHS funding can impact the Scottish budget, with Holyrood’s finances tied to Westminster spending. This announcement has drawn criticism from Conservative MPs, who argue Scottish MPs should not vote on England-only issues. Tory minister Anna Soubry accused Sturgeon of risking the Union and misrepresenting Conservative aims regarding the NHS. Conservative MP John Redwood suggested the SNP’s shift on this issue could signal a willingness to cooperate with Labour after the election. Sturgeon maintains that decisions on English NHS funding directly affect Scotland’s public finances. She told the BBC that SNP support for repealing NHS privatization would help shield the Scottish budget from potential reductions caused by English policies. An Ipsos Mori poll for STV News shows that 52% of Scots intend to vote SNP in May, well ahead of Labour at 24%. These figures suggest the SNP could win 55 out of Scotland’s 59 Westminster seats. Chancellor George Osborne has stated that the principle of ‘English votes for English laws’ would need to apply in areas connected to the UK budget, a point of ongoing debate as further devolution to Holyrood is discussed. While Sturgeon argues that Scotland’s NHS needs protection from English budget cuts, official figures indicate that between 2009-10 and 2015-16, NHS Scotland’s budget fell by around 1%, whereas the English NHS budget increased by 4%. The decline in global oil prices has led to renewed debate about Scotland’s economy. The Institute for Fiscal Studies estimates an independent Scotland could have been £7 billion worse off due to lost oil revenues. Chief Secretary to the Treasury Danny Alexander said that by voting against independence in 2014, Scots avoided significant financial difficulties, as lower oil prices would have forced cuts to public services. The Scottish government is now seeking tax cuts to help the oil industry, despite previously emphasizing North Sea reserves as a financial cornerstone for independence. Experts predict oil prices could fall further, adding pressure to the Scottish economy. Osborne emphasized that the economic risks from such volatility can be better managed within the UK, and the government plans to introduce further support for the oil and gas sector in the next budget.
translated_content: Perdana Menteri Scotland, Nicola Sturgeon, menyatakan bahawa Ahli Parlimen SNP yang dipilih pada bulan Mei akan menyokong usaha Parti Buruh untuk membatalkan pembaharuan NHS oleh kerajaan Konservatif, walaupun undang-undang ini hanya berkuat kuasa di England. Sturgeon menjelaskan bahawa Ahli Parlimen SNP merancang untuk mengundi rang undang-undang ini kerana perubahan kepada pembiayaan NHS England boleh memberi kesan kepada bajet Scotland, memandangkan kewangan Holyrood dipengaruhi oleh peruntukan dari Westminster. Pengumuman ini telah mendapat kritikan daripada Ahli Parlimen Konservatif, yang berhujah Ahli Parlimen Scotland tidak sepatutnya mengundi isu khas England. Menteri Tory, Anna Soubry, menuduh Sturgeon mempertaruhkan Kesatuan dan salah menggambarkan hasrat Konservatif berkaitan NHS. Ahli Parlimen Tory John Redwood pula mencadangkan bahawa perubahan pendirian SNP ini boleh menunjukkan kesediaan untuk bekerjasama dengan Parti Buruh selepas pilihan raya. Sturgeon menegaskan bahawa keputusan mengenai pembiayaan NHS England memberi kesan langsung kepada kewangan awam Scotland. Beliau memberitahu BBC bahawa sokongan SNP untuk membatalkan penswastaan NHS akan membantu melindungi bajet Scotland daripada sebarang pemotongan akibat dasar di England. Tinjauan Ipsos Mori untuk STV News menunjukkan 52% rakyat Scotland merancang untuk mengundi SNP pada Mei, jauh mendahului Parti Buruh yang mendapat 24%. Angka ini mencadangkan SNP boleh memenangi 55 daripada 59 kerusi Westminster di Scotland. Canselor George Osborne mengatakan prinsip 'undian England untuk undang-undang England' perlu diterapkan pada isu berkaitan bajet UK, satu perbincangan yang terus berlangsung seiring penyerahan kuasa tambahan kepada Holyrood. Walaupun Sturgeon berhujah NHS Scotland perlu dilindungi daripada pemotongan bajet England, angka rasmi menunjukkan antara 2009-10 dan 2015-16, bajet NHS Scotland menurun kira-kira 1%, sementara bajet NHS England meningkat sebanyak 4%. Keadaan harga minyak global yang menurun telah mencetuskan semula perdebatan mengenai ekonomi Scotland. Institute for Fiscal Studies menganggarkan Scotland yang merdeka boleh rugi sehingga £7 bilion akibat kejatuhan hasil minyak. Ketua Setiausaha Perbendaharaan, Danny Alexander, berkata penolakan kemerdekaan oleh rakyat Scotland pada 2014 mengelakkan negara itu daripada masalah kewangan besar, kerana harga minyak yang rendah boleh memaksa pemotongan perkhidmatan awam. Kerajaan Scotland kini meminta potongan cukai bagi membantu industri minyak, walaupun sebelum ini menegaskan rizab Laut Utara sebagai asas utama kewangan kemerdekaan. Pakar pula meramalkan harga minyak boleh terus menurun, menambah tekanan kepada ekonomi Scotland. Osborne menegaskan bahawa risiko ekonomi akibat ketidaktentuan harga ini lebih mudah diurus sebagai sebahagian daripada UK, dan kerajaan akan memperkenalkan lebih banyak bantuan untuk sektor minyak dan gas dalam bajet akan datang.

Jamie Love, a 17-year-old student from Govan, Glasgow, claims he was told to leave Govan High School after arriving dressed in feminine clothing, including tights, shorts, hair extensions, and makeup. Known locally as Keirny, Jamie had previously talked with teachers about struggles with gender identity. Despite facing ridicule from some students, Jamie hoped for support when presenting as female at school. On the first day dressed this way, Jamie says a teacher escorted him to the headteacher’s office, where deputy heads reportedly instructed him to gather his things and not return. School officials deny that this decision was related to his appearance or gender expression.

Glasgow City Council asserts that Jamie was not expelled and is still enrolled. They explain that advice to move on stemmed from concerns over Jamie’s educational engagement, not dress code or gender presentation. The council states that Jamie did not notify the school about changes in attire, and reiterates that his clothing is not an issue. Officials invite Jamie and his mother for further discussions to ensure a supportive atmosphere if he returns.

Jamie’s mother, Alison, supports his right to self-expression and argues that he has done nothing wrong. She recounts her initial shock when Jamie revealed the wish to present as a girl, but has since embraced his decision. Jamie’s sister, Michaela, 19, questions why others wear casual clothes at school without consequence. Jamie, who was pursuing a hairdressing course and aspired to attend Central College, believes his past behavioral problems stemmed from struggles with gender identity. While school authorities highlight educational concerns as the main issue, the family and Jamie maintain that his gender expression prompted his exclusion, raising questions about inclusivity and student support.

Jamie Love, seorang pelajar berumur 17 tahun dari Govan, Glasgow, mendakwa dia telah diminta meninggalkan Sekolah Menengah Govan selepas hadir ke sekolah dengan berpakaian feminin seperti stoking ketat, seluar pendek, sambungan rambut, dan solekan. Jamie, yang dikenali sebagai Keirny, sebelum ini telah berbincang dengan guru-guru tentang isu identiti jantinanya. Walaupun berdepan ejekan daripada sebilangan pelajar lain, Jamie berharap pihak sekolah akan memberikan sokongan apabila dia tampil sebagai seorang perempuan. Pada hari pertama berpakaian sedemikian, Jamie berkata seorang guru membawanya ke pejabat pengetua dan penolong pengetua dikatakan meminta Jamie mengemas barangnya dan tidak kembali. Pihak sekolah menafikan keputusan itu berkaitan dengan penampilan atau ekspresi jantina Jamie.

Majlis Bandaraya Glasgow menegaskan bahawa Jamie tidak dibuang sekolah dan masih berdaftar sebagai pelajar. Menurut mereka, nasihat supaya Jamie berpindah diberikan kerana kebimbangan tentang penglibatan akademik, bukannya berkaitan dengan cara berpakaian atau ekspresi jantina. Majlis itu juga berkata Jamie tidak memaklumkan kepada sekolah tentang perubahan cara berpakaian dan menegaskan penampilannya bukan isu utama. Sekolah menjemput Jamie dan ibunya untuk berbincang lanjut bagi memastikan suasana yang lebih menyokong sekiranya dia ingin kembali.

Ibu Jamie, Alison, menyokong hak anaknya untuk mengekspresikan diri sendiri dan percaya Jamie tidak melakukan apa-apa kesalahan. Alison berkongsi bahawa walaupun dia terkejut pada awalnya apabila Jamie memberitahu ingin berpakaian perempuan, dia akhirnya menerima keputusan tersebut setelah berbincang secara terbuka. Kakak Jamie, Michaela, 19, mempersoalkan mengapa pelajar lain yang berpakaian kasual tidak pula dikenakan tindakan. Jamie, yang sedang mengikuti kursus dandanan rambut dan berhasrat menyambung pelajaran ke Central College, percaya masalah tingkah laku lalu berpunca daripada isu identiti jantina. Pihak sekolah menekankan kebimbangan akademik sebagai sebab utama, namun keluarga Jamie tetap merasakan bahawa ekspresi jantina menjadi punca utama Jamie dikeluarkan, dan hal ini membangkitkan persoalan tentang keterangkuman dan sokongan kepada pelajar.

Brazilian football star Neymar was stretchered off in tears during Brazil’s World Cup qualifying match against Uruguay after suffering a serious left knee injury. Medical examinations revealed that Neymar sustained a torn anterior cruciate ligament and meniscus, with surgery required at a later date, according to the Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF).

The 31-year-old forward, who joined Saudi club Al Hilal from Paris Saint-Germain in August, was injured shortly before halftime after a challenge with Uruguay’s Nicolas de la Cruz during Tuesday’s 2026 World Cup qualifier in Montevideo. Seen clutching his left leg and in obvious pain, Neymar was treated on the field before being taken off. He left the stadium on crutches with his leg in a brace.

CBF President Ednaldo Rodrigues commented, “Brazilian and world football need Neymar healthy and recovered, because football is happier when he’s on the pitch.” The organization stated that Neymar is expected to be sidelined for several months, with its medical department in constant contact with Al Hilal to coordinate his recovery.

Neymar, who recently surpassed Pele to become Brazil’s all-time leading goal scorer, expressed his frustration in a social media post, stating, “It’s a very sad time, the worst. I know I’m strong, but this time I’m going to need my family and friends even more. It’s not easy to go through injury and surgery, especially after just four months of recovery.”

This injury is the latest in a series of setbacks for Neymar, whose career has been interrupted by frequent injuries. Earlier this year, he underwent right ankle surgery, sidelining him for six months before his move to Al Hilal, where he has played only five games so far. Neymar joined Al Hilal for a reported $95 million after a six-year stint with PSG, where injuries often kept him out of action.

Both Al Hilal and the CBF have expressed their commitment to supporting Neymar throughout his recovery, with plans for further treatment to be determined following surgery.

Bintang bola sepak Brazil, Neymar, telah dibawa keluar padang dalam keadaan berair mata dalam perlawanan kelayakan Piala Dunia menentang Uruguay selepas mengalami kecederaan serius di lutut kiri. Pemeriksaan perubatan mengesahkan Neymar mengalami koyakan ligamen anterior cruciate dan meniskus, dan dia perlu menjalani pembedahan pada tarikh yang akan ditentukan kemudian, menurut Konfederasi Bola Sepak Brazil (CBF).

Penyerang berusia 31 tahun itu, yang menyertai kelab Arab Saudi, Al Hilal dari Paris Saint-Germain pada Ogos lalu, cedera sejurus sebelum separuh masa selepas pertembungan dengan pemain Uruguay, Nicolas de la Cruz dalam perlawanan kelayakan Piala Dunia 2026 di Montevideo pada hari Selasa. Neymar dilihat memegang kaki kirinya sambil menahan kesakitan, menerima rawatan di padang sebelum dibawa keluar. Dia meninggalkan stadium dengan bertongkat dan memakai pendakap kaki.

Presiden CBF, Ednaldo Rodrigues berkata, “Bola sepak Brazil dan dunia memerlukan Neymar yang sihat dan pulih, kerana bola sepak lebih meriah apabila beliau berada di atas padang.” Organisasi itu menyatakan Neymar dijangka direhatkan selama beberapa bulan, dengan jabatan perubatan mereka sentiasa berhubung dengan Al Hilal untuk menyelaras pemulihannya.

Neymar, yang baru-baru ini memecahkan rekod Pele sebagai penjaring terbanyak sepanjang masa Brazil, meluahkan kekecewaannya di media sosial: “Ini masa yang sangat sedih, paling teruk. Saya tahu saya kuat, tapi kali ini saya sangat perlukan keluarga dan kawan-kawan. Bukan mudah untuk hadapi kecederaan dan pembedahan, apatah lagi ini terjadi lagi selepas empat bulan pulih.”

Kecederaan ini adalah satu lagi episod dalam kerjaya Neymar yang sering tergendala akibat kecederaan. Awal tahun ini, dia jalani pembedahan pergelangan kaki kanan yang menyebabkan dia berehat selama enam bulan sebelum berpindah ke Al Hilal, di mana dia baru beraksi dalam lima perlawanan. Neymar menyertai Al Hilal dengan nilai perpindahan dilaporkan $95 juta selepas enam musim di PSG, yang juga sering menyaksikan beliau diketepikan kerana kecederaan.

Al Hilal dan CBF berjanji untuk bekerjasama demi pemulihan Neymar dengan rancangan rawatan yang akan diputuskan selepas pembedahan.

Vote counting is underway in Liberia following Tuesday’s presidential and parliamentary elections, in which incumbent President George Weah is seeking a second term. Local and regional observers reported that polling was largely peaceful, despite confrontations between rival political camps in the campaign’s closing days. Voter turnout was reportedly high, with the campaign dominated by concerns over the country’s economic crisis and allegations of corruption.

The National Elections Commission (NEC) stated that the first results would be announced later on Wednesday. President Weah is considered the frontrunner, with former Vice-President Joseph Boakai seen as his main challenger. A run-off will be necessary if no candidate secures more than 50% of the votes.

Parliamentary elections were held in parallel with the presidential vote, and approximately 2.4 million people were registered to participate. The distribution of election materials to some remote areas in southeast Liberia was delayed due to floods and muddy roads. In some cases, canoes transporting electoral staff and materials capsized, resulting in the loss of election materials. The NEC responded by extending voting in the affected areas.

This election marks the first time that a generation of young voters born after Liberia’s civil war, which ended two decades ago and claimed an estimated 250,000 lives, have participated in national elections. 'I voted for the good of my country. I expect peace and development,' said 18-year-old first-time voter Agostina Momo to the AFP news agency in the capital, Monrovia.

The electoral commission is expected to begin releasing initial results soon, with final results to be announced within 15 days. President Weah, who was named FIFA World Player of the Year in 1995, entered politics after retiring from football. He won his first term in 2017 after defeating Mr Boakai in a run-off, securing 61% of the vote. Analysts believe this may be the 78-year-old Boakai’s last bid for the presidency. Running under the slogan 'Rescue,' Boakai has criticized Liberia’s direction during Weah’s tenure, while Weah has highlighted achievements such as introducing free university tuition during his first term.

Pengiraan undi sedang berlangsung di Liberia selepas pilihan raya presiden dan parlimen pada hari Selasa, di mana penyandang, Presiden George Weah, bertanding untuk penggal kedua. Pemerhati tempatan dan serantau melaporkan proses pengundian berjalan secara amnya aman, walaupun terdapat pertembungan antara kem politik yang bersaing pada hari-hari terakhir kempen. Kehadiran pengundi dikatakan tinggi dengan kempen berfokus kepada krisis ekonomi negara dan dakwaan rasuah.

Suruhanjaya Pilihan Raya Kebangsaan (NEC) menyatakan keputusan awal akan diumumkan lewat hari Rabu. Presiden Weah dianggap pilihan utama, dengan bekas Naib Presiden Joseph Boakai sebagai pencabar utama. Pusingan kedua akan diadakan jika tiada calon memperoleh lebih 50% undian.

Pilihan raya parlimen turut diadakan serentak dengan pengundian presiden, dan kira-kira 2.4 juta orang telah berdaftar. Penghantaran bahan pilihan raya di beberapa kawasan pedalaman tenggara Liberia tertangguh akibat banjir dan jalan berlumpur. Dalam beberapa kes, sampan yang membawa petugas pilihan raya dan bahan terbalik menyebabkan kehilangan bahan undian. NEC melanjutkan tempoh pengundian di kawasan terjejas.

Pilihan raya ini juga julung kalinya disertai generasi pengundi muda yang lahir selepas perang saudara Liberia berakhir dua dekad lalu, yang meragut lebih 250,000 nyawa. "Saya mengundi demi negara saya. Saya harap keamanan dan pembangunan," kata Agostina Momo, 18, pengundi kali pertama kepada AFP di Monrovia.

Suruhanjaya pilihan raya dijangka mengumumkan keputusan awal tidak lama lagi dan keputusan penuh diumumkan dalam masa 15 hari. Presiden Weah, pemenang Pemain Terbaik Dunia FIFA 1995, menceburi politik selepas bersara dari bola sepak. Beliau memenangi penggal pertamanya pada 2017 selepas menewaskan Boakai dengan 61% dalam pusingan kedua. Penganalisis percaya ini mungkin percubaan terakhir Boakai, 78, untuk menjadi presiden. Bertemakan slogan 'Rescue', Boakai mengkritik hala tuju Liberia semasa era Weah, manakala Weah mengetengahkan kejayaan seperti pelaksanaan yuran universiti percuma pada penggal pertamanya.

article_content: India's startup industry is experiencing significant shifts as an extended funding slowdown, known as a 'funding winter', and a greater focus on profitability have ended the era of lavish perks and extravagant spending, according to employees and industry insiders. The previously youthful and flexible work culture in startups is being replaced by a demanding, performance-driven environment that some describe as occasionally hostile or toxic. A 28-year-old product designer at a fintech company reports that after a large salary increase during the 2021 hiring boom, he found himself taking on double the responsibilities, often working both Indian and US hours. He notes that while his salary remains above market rates, sustaining it has become difficult. Employees commonly report rising stress and anxiety from unrealistic workloads, lack of personal time, job insecurity, and a tough workplace culture. Many are seeking new opportunities, though the slow job market makes this challenging. Prasadh MS, head of workforce research at staffing firm Xpheno, points out that burnout and loss of work-life balance are often-cited reasons for seeking new jobs. The downturn follows a 2021 boom, during which high pay packages, stock options, and extravagant perks attracted top talent. A 30-year-old software engineer said personal stress has impacted family planning. Others mention that higher salaries led them to take out large loans, making it difficult to leave jobs despite heavy work pressure. Ashish Sanganeria, senior partner at executive search firm Transearch, comments that the funding winter has raised profitability pressures and created a more challenging work environment. Some employees with higher salaries are now open to accepting lower pay for more stability. Startups are also under pressure from boards and investors to increase efficiency and profits, prompting stricter HR practices and cost management. Pranav Pai of 3one4 Capital and Ankur Pahwa of PeerCapital mention that short timeframes for results and cost-cutting measures add to workplace pressures. Mental health experts, including Amit Malik, founder and CEO of Amaha, say more young startup professionals are seeking counseling for stress and relationship issues. Other business news: The government is considering transferring unclaimed funds from the Sahara-Sebi Refund Account to the Consolidated Fund of India; Apple plans to produce ₹1 lakh crore worth of iPhones in India by March 2024; and Nawaz Modi has sought three-quarters of Gautam Singhania's net worth for herself and their daughters in a settlement.
translated_content: Industri startup India sedang mengalami perubahan besar apabila kemelesetan pembiayaan yang berpanjangan, dikenali sebagai 'funding winter', serta tumpuan yang semakin tinggi terhadap keuntungan telah menamatkan era faedah dan perbelanjaan mewah, menurut para pekerja dan pihak industri. Budaya kerja yang dulunya muda dan fleksibel kini telah digantikan dengan suasana berorientasikan prestasi yang sangat menuntut dan kadangkala digambarkan sebagai toksik atau bermusuhan. Seorang pereka produk berumur 28 tahun di sebuah syarikat fintech melaporkan selepas menerima kenaikan gaji besar ketika ledakan pengambilan pekerja tahun 2021, beliau kini memikul tanggungjawab untuk dua orang dan sering bekerja waktu India serta AS. Beliau berkata, walaupun gajinya masih melebihi pasaran, adalah sukar untuk mengekalkannya. Pekerja biasanya melaporkan tahap tekanan dan kebimbangan yang meningkat akibat beban kerja tidak realistik, kekurangan masa peribadi, ketidakpastian pekerjaan, serta budaya kerja yang mencabar. Ramai yang mencari peluang baharu, namun pasaran kerja yang perlahan menyukarkan mereka. Prasadh MS, ketua penyelidikan tenaga kerja di firma pencarian tenaga kerja Xpheno, menegaskan bahawa keletihan (burnout) dan hilangnya keseimbangan kerja dan kehidupan adalah antara sebab utama mereka mencari pekerjaan baharu. Kemerosotan ini berlaku selepas ledakan 2021, apabila pakej gaji tinggi, opsyen saham dan faedah-faedah mewah digunakan untuk menarik bakat terbaik. Seorang jurutera perisian berumur 30 tahun berkata tekanan peribadi menjejaskan perancangan keluarga. Ada juga pekerja yang menyatakan gaji tinggi menyebabkan mereka mengambil pinjaman besar sehingga sukar meninggalkan kerja walaupun menghadapi tekanan berat. Ashish Sanganeria, rakan kanan di firma pencarian eksekutif Transearch, berkata 'funding winter' telah meningkatkan tekanan keuntungan dan mewujudkan suasana kerja yang lebih mencabar. Ada pekerja bergaji tinggi sekarang sanggup menerima gaji lebih rendah demi kestabilan. Startup juga menghadapi tekanan dari lembaga dan pelabur untuk meningkatkan kecekapan dan keuntungan, memaksa polisi HR serta pengurusan kos yang lebih ketat. Pranav Pai dari 3one4 Capital dan Ankur Pahwa dari PeerCapital menyatakan jangka masa yang singkat untuk mencapai hasil serta langkah penjimatan menambah tekanan di tempat kerja. Pakar kesihatan mental, termasuk Amit Malik dari Amaha, berkata semakin ramai profesional muda startup mendapatkan kaunseling untuk tekanan dan isu hubungan. article_content: Boyz II Men, the legendary R&B group, has released a new album called 'Love,' featuring covers of iconic love songs. This marks their second album of reinterpretations and includes the return of 'American Idol' judge Randy Jackson as producer—he previously worked with them on 'Motown: A Journey Through Hitsville USA.' The album includes their versions of Journey's 'Open Arms,' the Goo Goo Dolls' 'Iris,' and The Beatles' 'In My Life.' Keeping busy, Boyz II Men still tour frequently, delighting fans with beloved tracks like 'End of the Road' and 'I'll Make Love To You.' In a recent CNN interview, members Wanya Morris and Nate Morris discussed their new project, changes in the music industry, and what's ahead for the group. (Shawn Stockman was unable to join due to illness.) Wanya explained that love is the group's signature theme, and this album aims to reflect that through both sound and lyrics. Nate highlighted the major shifts in music, especially with today's advanced technology, which he feels has moved artists away from the soulful sound of the past. With 'Love,' Boyz II Men hopes to encourage a return to more authentic R&B styles. The members also talked about how rare R&B groups like theirs have become, suggesting that true musical chemistry happens when a group forms through shared passion rather than industry management. Their own organic origin is a source of pride and uniqueness. Both Wanya and Nate shared that they’ve grown through personal experiences, like marriage and parenthood, and that they've learned the importance of staying consistent with their fans and true to who they are. Their first single from 'Love' is their take on Bonnie Raitt’s 'I Can’t Make You Love Me,' performed with Boyz II Men’s signature R&B twist. They noted that paying homage to original songs while infusing their own style is a delicate but rewarding process. Looking ahead, the group has plans for a 20th anniversary album featuring original material, and there's a possibility that former member Michael McCary might rejoin for the project. Musically, they’re still inspired by legends like Marvin Gaye and The Isley Brothers. In essence, Boyz II Men continues to honor the theme of love, both in their music and in their bond with fans, affirming their lasting place in the ever-evolving world of R&B.

article_content: Samantha Cameron recently hosted a Conservative campaign event at 10 Downing Street, inviting Tory candidates from Liberal Democrat-held constituencies, along with their constituents. The event featured a drinks reception with the Prime Minister’s wife and opportunities for photos with candidates and local community representatives. Liberal Democrat MPs criticized David Cameron, arguing that using the official residence for political events amounts to misuse of taxpayer-funded property, particularly with less than four months before the general election. During the January 13 event, Samantha Cameron posed for pictures with Conservative candidates, including Rebecca Pow (Taunton Deane), and guests Adam Fouracre and Barrie Palmer. She hosted similar gatherings for other Conservative candidates, with photos and supportive quotes supplied for local newspaper coverage. Jeremy Browne, the Liberal Democrat MP for Taunton Deane, expressed concerns about 'propriety and abuse of office,' describing the event as 'a scandal,' and stating that No 10 'is not the property of the Conservative Party.' Duncan Hames, Liberal Democrat MP for Chippenham, said the receptions were 'a desperate attempt' to raise profiles of Conservative candidates. Other Tory candidates from North Devon, Somerton and Frome, Bath, Kingston and Surbiton, Torbay, and Cheltenham also attended the January 13 event. On the following Monday, the Prime Minister hosted a similar event attended by candidates for Taunton Deane and Chippenham. Under ministerial rules, government property cannot be used for party fundraising, but official residences may be used as long as public money is not involved. A Conservative spokesperson stated the events were paid for by the Conservative Party, not by taxpayers.

Ahli Parlimen Liberal Demokrat mengkritik David Cameron, mendakwa penggunaan kediaman rasmi untuk acara politik adalah penyalahgunaan harta yang dibiayai pembayar cukai, lebih-lebih lagi kerana kurang empat bulan sebelum pilihan raya umum. Duncan Hames, Ahli Parlimen Liberal Demokrat untuk Chippenham, berkata majlis itu ialah 'usaha terdesak' untuk meningkatkan profil calon Konservatif. Calon Tory dari North Devon, Somerton and Frome, Bath, Kingston and Surbiton, Torbay, dan Cheltenham juga menghadiri acara pada 13 Januari. article_content: Home Secretary Theresa May has called for the widespread use of body-worn cameras by police officers, suggesting these devices can help secure more convictions. May stated that when offenders are shown video evidence of their actions, it often prompts earlier guilty pleas. She also highlighted that body-worn cameras quickly dispel unfounded complaints against officers, saving time and reducing stress. Currently, thousands of officers in the UK use these cameras, but May endorsed their roll-out across every police force in England and Wales. Her support was welcomed by police organizations, who cited the devices’ effectiveness, particularly in cases involving disorderly or violent offenders who later deny wrongdoing. However, privacy campaigners expressed concern. Emma Carr of the civil liberties group Big Brother Watch warned that the use of body-worn cameras could erode public trust and described them as a potential 'underhand surveillance tactic.' The group argues that police should focus instead on engaging with local communities. Lightweight lapel cameras can record several hours of video and sound, and officers can activate them as needed. Five police forces in England and Wales and several in Scotland already use these devices. Citing evidence from Scotland, May said up to 90 percent of suspects confronted with body camera footage plead guilty earlier. She also noted the technology helps eliminate baseless complaints from known troublemakers. Steve White from the Police Federation commented that body-worn cameras provide clear evidence for court cases, countering false claims by suspects. In her speech, May also criticized police officers who file unwarranted legal claims against the public, referring to a recent case involving a Norfolk officer. She announced plans to prevent officers from resigning to avoid disciplinary action and to publish the names of those dismissed for misconduct. May further dismissed claims that police are underreporting crime, citing national statistics that show crime is at a historic low. She also received applause after proposing life sentences for those convicted of killing police officers, stating such acts are attacks on the foundation of society.

May berkata apabila pesalah dipertontonkan bukti video mengenai tindakan mereka, ia sering membawa kepada pengakuan bersalah lebih awal. Sokongannya dialu-alukan oleh organisasi polis, yang menyatakan keberkesanan peranti ini, terutamanya dalam kes yang melibatkan pesalah yang membuat kekecohan atau ganas tetapi kemudian menafikan kesalahan mereka. Walau bagaimanapun, aktivis privasi menyuarakan kebimbangan. Emma Carr daripada kumpulan kebebasan awam Big Brother Watch memberi amaran bahawa penggunaan kamera badan berpotensi merosakkan kepercayaan orang ramai dan menyifatkannya sebagai 'taktik pengawasan yang tidak telus.' Steve White dari Police Federation berkata kamera badan memberikan bukti yang jelas dalam kes mahkamah, sekali gus menangkis dakwaan palsu oleh suspek. Beliau mengumumkan rancangan untuk menghalang pegawai daripada meletak jawatan bagi mengelak tindakan tatatertib serta mendedahkan nama mereka yang dipecat atas salah laku. article_content: A motorist who was Tasered and allegedly beaten by police officers during his arrest has died more than three months after the incident. Martin Baskeyfield, 44, was taken to hospital three days after his arrest in September and remained there until he passed away last Monday. Baskeyfield was struck with a 50,000-volt Taser and, according to a friend, was struck by officers using batons. The Independent Police Complaints Commission (IPCC), which had already started investigating the police use of force during his arrest, is also looking into his death. This has raised concerns over police use of Tasers. Sophie Khan, a lawyer campaigning against Tasers, said: 'Taser use must be limited and occur only when suspects have weapons, not at any other time.' Mr. Baskeyfield, from Stoke-on-Trent and unemployed, was arrested after a police chase for allegedly speeding and driving without insurance or a licence. An IPCC spokesperson said: 'The IPCC is investigating the arrest of Mr. Baskeyfield. A Home Office post-mortem is being conducted to determine the cause of death and the coroner has been notified.'

Baskeyfield terkena Taser berkuasa 50,000 volt dan menurut seorang rakan, beliau turut dipukul dengan belantan oleh polis. Suruhanjaya Bebas Aduan Polis (IPCC), yang telah mula menyiasat penggunaan kekerasan oleh polis semasa penahanannya, kini turut menyiasat kematiannya. Kejadian ini telah menimbulkan kebimbangan mengenai penggunaan Taser oleh pihak polis. Sophie Khan, seorang peguam yang berkempen menentang penggunaan Taser, berkata: 'Penggunaan Taser mesti dihadkan dan hanya digunakan apabila suspek mempunyai senjata, bukan pada masa lain.' Encik Baskeyfield, dari Stoke-on-Trent dan tidak bekerja, ditahan selepas dikejar polis kerana didakwa memandu laju serta tanpa insurans atau lesen memandu. Jurucakap IPCC berkata: 'IPCC sedang menyiasat penahanan Encik Baskeyfield. Bedah siasat oleh Pejabat Dalam Negeri sedang dijalankan untuk menentukan punca kematian dan koroner telah dimaklumkan.'

article_content: Pakistan cricket captain Babar Azam remains optimistic about his team's prospects of reaching the ODI World Cup semi-finals despite the tough road ahead. To surpass New Zealand and advance, Pakistan must secure a victory over England by a minimum of 287 runs in their final league match in Kolkata on Saturday. England, the defending champions, have already been eliminated from the tournament. Speaking at a pre-match press conference, Babar reiterated his team's belief and focus on strategic planning instead of merely playing an aggressive game. 'We know what's at stake and are preparing carefully, considering how to manage every phase of the match,' he explained. Babar pointed to the importance of key partnerships and the contribution of players like Fakhar Zaman in achieving their objective. Pakistan faces a considerable challenge since their highest total against England is 361 runs (in 2019), and their largest win margin is 108 runs (from 22 years ago). Responding to criticism about his captaincy and his personal performance—having scored 282 runs at an average a little over 40—Babar maintained that he is not under pressure. He noted that offering advice on TV is easy, but encouraged anyone with constructive feedback to contact him directly.

England, juara bertahan, telah pun tersingkir dari kejohanan. Dalam sidang media sebelum perlawanan, Babar menegaskan kepercayaan dan tumpuan pasukannya kepada perancangan strategik, bukan sekadar bermain agresif. 'Kami tahu apa yang dipertaruhkan dan sedang merancang dengan teliti, memikirkan bagaimana untuk mengurus setiap fasa perlawanan,' katanya. Babar menonjolkan kepentingan membina kerjasama utama dan peranan pemain seperti Fakhar Zaman untuk mencapai matlamat mereka. Pakistan menghadapi cabaran besar memandangkan jumlah larian tertinggi mereka menentang England ialah 361 (pada tahun 2019), dan margin kemenangan terbesar ialah 108 larian (22 tahun yang lalu). Bagi menjawab kritikan terhadap kepimpinan dan prestasi peribadinya—dengan 282 larian pada purata sedikit melebihi 40—Babar menegaskan beliau tidak berada di bawah tekanan. Beliau turut mengingatkan bahawa mudah memberi nasihat di TV, dan menggalakkan sesiapa yang ada pandangan membina supaya menghubunginya secara langsung.

The father of a toddler, believed by police to have been murdered, has called for 'justice for his little buddy.' The boy is one of four children from the same family at the center of a complex police investigation. Two of the children are believed to have been murdered, while two others barely survived a deliberately set house fire.

The three-year-old boy, whose identity cannot be revealed for legal reasons, was found dead in a Morayfield home, north of Brisbane, on July 27, 2013. His seven-month-old half-brother was found deceased at the same address on September 27, 2014.

On February 27, 2014, two other children in the home—aged nine and eleven—suffered burns and smoke inhalation when part of the house was set alight as they slept. All incidents occurred on the 27th of their respective months, raising suspicions among investigators.

Police are treating a grandmother as a person of interest in this disturbing series of events, although no one has been charged. Initially, authorities treated the two deaths as Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS) cases.

The father, who was separated from the mother and was not living with his son at the time of his death, expressed his grief and called for answers. 'I just want to know what happened to my son,' he said. 'He was my little buddy.' He has urged anyone with information about the incidents to come forward.

Family members and friends have expressed sorrow and disbelief on social media, remembering the boy and calling for justice for all four children.

Detective Acting Superintendent Damien Hansen described the alleged crimes as 'horrific,' emphasizing that the crimes against defenseless children are 'mindboggling.' The police investigation continues, with officers following strong leads but currently unable to identify or charge anyone. The surviving children are now in state care.

Authorities encourage anyone with information about the fire on February 27 or the related deaths to contact Crime Stoppers at 1800 333 000.

Bapa kepada seorang kanak-kanak kecil yang dipercayai polis telah dibunuh, telah menyeru agar 'keadilan untuk si comel kecilnya' ditegakkan. Kanak-kanak itu adalah salah seorang daripada empat anak satu keluarga yang menjadi tumpuan siasatan polis yang rumit. Dua daripada kanak-kanak tersebut dipercayai dibunuh, manakala dua lagi hampir maut dalam kebakaran rumah yang disengajakan.

Kanak-kanak lelaki berusia tiga tahun itu, yang identitinya tidak didedahkan kerana sebab undang-undang, ditemui meninggal dunia di sebuah rumah di Morayfield, utara Brisbane, pada 27 Julai 2013. Adik tirinya yang berusia tujuh bulan juga ditemui maut di alamat sama pada 27 September 2014.

Pada 27 Februari 2014, dua lagi kanak-kanak di rumah itu—berusia sembilan dan sebelas tahun—mengalami lecur dan terhidu asap apabila sebahagian rumah terbakar sewaktu mereka tidur. Semua insiden berlaku pada 27 haribulan, menimbulkan rasa curiga penyiasat.

Polis menyiasat seorang nenek sebagai individu berkepentingan dalam siri kejadian tragik ini namun belum ada pertuduhan. Pada awalnya, pihak berkuasa menganggap dua kematian itu akibat Sindrom Kematian Mengejut Bayi (SIDS).

Bapa kanak-kanak terbabit, yang telah berpisah dengan ibu mangsa dan tidak tinggal bersama anak semasa kejadian, meluahkan kesedihan dan tuntutan jawapan. 'Saya cuma mahu tahu apa yang berlaku pada anak saya,' katanya. 'Dia teman kecil saya.' Beliau merayu kepada sesiapa yang mempunyai maklumat agar tampil membantu.

Ahli keluarga dan sahabat turut meluahkan rasa sedih serta tidak percaya di media sosial, mengenang mangsa dan menyeru keadilan untuk semua empat kanak-kanak itu.

Pemangku Superintenden Detektif Damien Hansen menyifatkan kes ini sebagai 'menggerunkan', menegaskan jenayah terhadap kanak-kanak tidak berdaya memang 'mengejutkan.' Siasatan masih berjalan dengan polis mengikuti petunjuk kukuh tetapi belum mengenal pasti atau mendakwa sesiapa. Kanak-kanak yang terselamat kini di bawah jagaan kerajaan.

Pihak berkuasa menggesa sesiapa yang mempunyai maklumat mengenai kebakaran 27 Februari atau kematian berkaitan supaya hubungi Crime Stoppers di 1800 333 000.

article_content: Edo State Governor, Godwin Obaseki, has approved the payment of a 28-year backlog of gratuities to pensioners in the Edo State Local Government Staff Pension Board. According to a statement released on Monday by Mrs. Sandra Osas-Ehigie, Head of Local Government Administration and Permanent Secretary of the Local Government Staff Pension Board, a screening exercise is scheduled for pensioners on the Board's payroll who retired between 1979 and 2008. "This is to inform pensioners who retired between 1979 and 2008 and are on the payroll of the Local Government Staff Pension Board that Governor Obaseki has released funds for their gratuity. A screening exercise will be held at the Local Government Staff Pensions Board Premises, King Square, Benin City," she said. All qualified pensioners are required to be physically present at the venue with their pension identity card, biometrics slip, and pay advice between Monday, 16 October and Friday, 20 October 2023, from 8am to 4pm daily.

Menurut kenyataan yang dikeluarkan pada hari Isnin oleh Puan Sandra Osas-Ehigie, Ketua Pentadbiran Kerajaan Tempatan dan Setiausaha Tetap Lembaga Pencen Kakitangan Kerajaan Tempatan, satu sesi saringan dijadualkan untuk pesara yang berada dalam senarai gaji Lembaga dan bersara antara tahun 1979 hingga 2008. "Ini adalah untuk memaklumkan pesara yang bersara antara tahun 1979 hingga 2008 dan berada dalam senarai gaji Lembaga Pencen Kakitangan Kerajaan Tempatan bahawa Gabenor Obaseki telah meluluskan dana untuk gratuiti mereka. Sesi saringan akan diadakan di Premis Lembaga Pencen Kakitangan Kerajaan Tempatan, King Square, Benin City," katanya. article_content: At the heart of Arsenal’s defense, Calum Chambers played with exceptional composure during his Premier League debut. Chambers, previously a right back at Southampton, now looks comfortable at center back for Arsenal. Despite pressure from Crystal Palace forward Fraizer Campbell, Chambers remained calm, clearly reading the game well beyond his years. His ball control and ability to step forward from defense impressed both fans and teammates. Arsène Wenger, Arsenal’s manager, has been praised for trusting Chambers with a starting role, even as experienced defender Per Mertesacker returned from World Cup duties with Germany. Wenger must soon decide whether to start Chambers or Mertesacker for Arsenal’s upcoming Champions League qualifier against Besiktas in Istanbul. In Saturday’s Premier League opener, Arsenal came from behind to beat Crystal Palace 2-1. Brede Hangeland scored first for Palace, but Laurent Koscielny equalized just before halftime. Aaron Ramsey secured the win with a late goal. The victory marked the third time Arsenal have come from behind to win on the opening day of the Premier League, more than any other side. Chambers previously helped Arsenal to victory in the FA Community Shield against Manchester City. Crystal Palace, meanwhile, faced difficult circumstances after manager Tony Pulis left the club just 48 hours before the match. Chairman Steve Parish is searching for an experienced replacement, considering managers such as Tim Sherwood and Malky Mackay. Goalkeeper Julian Speroni spoke about Pulis’s impact, stating that the team learned a lot under his guidance and will be stronger for the experience. Arsenal’s Alexis Sanchez is still adjusting to English football but is expected to find his rhythm as the season progresses. The coming week will be challenging for Arsenal, with a trip to Turkey midweek and an away match at Everton on Saturday.

Wenger perlu membuat keputusan sama ada menurunkan Chambers atau Mertesacker untuk kelayakan Liga Juara-Juara menentang Besiktas di Istanbul.
