article_content: Nicola Cockx, a 35-year-old woman from Little Bollington near Altrincham, Cheshire, delayed potentially life-saving cancer treatment in her quest to have a child. Diagnosed with multiple myeloma, a rare form of bone marrow cancer, in 2008, Nicola opted for holistic remedies and less aggressive therapies to preserve her fertility. Her consultant at Christie Hospital, Dr Jim Cavet, explained she refused chemotherapy and a stem cell transplant due to concerns about her chances of falling pregnant. After three years battling the disease, Nicola became pregnant in 2011, and her daughter Harriet was born in June 2012 by emergency caesarean. During her pregnancy, the cancer advanced, but Nicola continued to avoid intensive treatments that could harm her baby. After Harriet’s birth, Nicola underwent chemotherapy and a donor stem cell transplant. However, she died eight months later from sepsis and drug-induced heart inflammation, according to hospital records. Her family admired her determination, with her mother Patricia Flowers noting Nicola's inspirational decision to pursue holistic approaches in hopes of starting a family. The family is now raising funds for further research into multiple myeloma and to raise awareness of the disease. Cancer Research UK states chemotherapy is generally considered safe during pregnancy except in the first 14 weeks or close to delivery, though ongoing research is needed regarding long-term effects on children. Multiple myeloma affects plasma cells in the bone marrow and is rare, with about 5,000 new cases diagnosed each year in the UK, mostly in older adults. Treatments include chemotherapy, stem cell transplants, and radiotherapy. Survival rates for myeloma patients have improved over the past decade, with around 40% of patients in England living at least five years post-diagnosis, and 15–19% surviving ten years or more, according to Myeloma UK. Beliau disahkan menghidap multiple myeloma, sejenis kanser sumsum tulang yang jarang berlaku, pada tahun 2008. Nicola memilih rawatan holistik dan terapi kurang agresif demi menjaga kesuburannya. Keluarganya sangat mengagumi ketabahannya, dan ibunya Patricia Flowers mengatakan keputusan Nicola untuk mencuba kaedah holistik demi membina keluarga amat memberi inspirasi. Kini keluarganya aktif mengumpul dana untuk penyelidikan lanjut tentang multiple myeloma serta meningkatkan kesedaran mengenai penyakit ini. Cancer Research UK menyatakan bahawa kemoterapi umumnya selamat semasa kehamilan kecuali pada 14 minggu pertama atau hampir bersalin, namun kajian lanjut masih diperlukan untuk mengetahui kesan jangka panjang kepada anak. Multiple myeloma menjejaskan sel plasma dalam sumsum tulang dan jarang berlaku, dengan kira-kira 5,000 kes baharu setahun di UK, kebanyakannya dalam kalangan warga emas. article_content: Provident Housing Ltd (PHL), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Puravankara Ltd, is in advanced discussions with HDFC Capital Advisors to raise over Rs 1,000 crore to fund its expansion plans. The proposed fundraising will take the form of equity investment, with proceeds directed toward developing mid-income housing projects in Bangalore, Chennai, and Hyderabad, as well as supporting entry into new property markets. Sources familiar with the matter said, 'Both partners are engaged in active talks, and the fundraising is expected to be finalized in the coming quarters, depending on the deal's terms. They are likely to establish a platform for acquiring and developing residential assets.' HDFC Capital Advisors is expected to invest through the HDFC Capital Affordable Real Estate Fund 3 to facilitate these projects with Provident. One person noted, 'The investment is expected to result in a gross development value (GDV) exceeding Rs 3,500 crore, with Provident looking to strengthen its presence in current regions and explore additional property markets.' Provident is also preparing to enter new cities such as Mumbai and Pune, aiming to double its residential portfolio to over 20 million square feet from the current 13.82 million square feet. Provident currently contributes about half of Puravankara’s business and is seeking significant portfolio growth amid a strong domestic residential market, according to another source. HDFC Capital could not be reached for comment, and Puravankara declined to comment. At present, Provident has over 11.32 million square feet of ongoing projects in Bengaluru, Mangalore, Chennai, Coimbatore, Hyderabad, and Goa. Separately, HDFC Capital, via its Fund 3, recently partnered with TVS Group’s real estate arm, Emerald Haven Realty, to create a Rs 1,000-crore platform for plotted developments in South India. It also teamed up with the House of Abhinandan Lodha to launch a joint venture with over Rs 1,500 crore for land and low-rise residential projects across major Indian property markets. In 2020, the IFC Emerging Asia Fund invested $76 million in Puravankara Group's affordable housing projects in India. The group also launched a 3.4-million-square-foot development in Kochi, projected to yield Rs 3,000 crore in sales value, with IFC support. -- Other business headlines: - Industry representatives claim that tech majors such as Microsoft and Amazon are bypassing Indian telecom regulations by using platforms like WhatsApp to send enterprise messages, causing an estimated Rs 3,000 crore annual loss to both the government and service providers. - The Indian government has asked Apple to assist in a probe into alleged state-sponsored hacking targeting iPhones of notable Indian citizens, including some opposition members. - The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) informed the Delhi High Court that Go First’s leased aircraft and engines may be preregistered and returned to lessors, impacting the airline’s chances of revival.

article_content: A New Orleans police officer was suspended without pay on Monday after he posted online remarks about Trayvon Martin, the Florida teenager whose death has sparked national debate over racial profiling. Officer Jason Giroir posted the comment, 'Act like a Thug Die like one!' on the website of CNN affiliate WWL, in response to a story about Martin's case. Giroir admitted to making the post, according to a statement from New Orleans police. 'The Internet comments written by Officer Giroir, which include the fact that he is a member of the NOPD, have given me grave concern regarding his fitness for duty. Because of this, I have suspended Giroir without pay, effective immediately,' Superintendent Ronal Serpas said in the statement. Serpas added, 'To say that I'm angry is an understatement. I'm furious.' He also said that Giroir's 'insensitive, harmful, and offensive comments' embarrassed the department. Seventeen-year-old Trayvon Martin was shot and killed late last month in Sanford, Florida, as he walked back to his father's fiancée's house after visiting a convenience store. Police say Martin was unarmed, carrying only a bag of Skittles and an iced tea. He was shot by George Zimmerman, who claimed he acted in self-defense.

Pegawai Jason Giroir menulis komen, 'Bertindak seperti samseng, matilah seperti samseng!' di laman web rakan CNN, WWL, sebagai respons kepada berita mengenai kes Martin. article_content: There's a lingering question about why some Republican politicians who criticize government intervention choose to hold office, especially when actions like the House GOP's recent vote to eliminate the American Community Survey (ACS) seem contradictory. The ACS, conducted by the U.S. Census Bureau, offers crucial, timely statistics about U.S. demographics, which help direct $400 billion annually in grants for schools, healthcare, infrastructure, and other essential services. Unlike the traditional census, which runs every ten years, the ACS provides ongoing, detailed insights. Republican Representative Daniel Webster from Florida, who won his seat in 2010, spearheaded the amendment to end the ACS, aiming to fulfill his campaign pledge to cut 'wasteful spending.' The House vote supporting his amendment claims a potential $2.5 billion saving over the next decade. However, critics argue the lack of data would imperil the efficient distribution of $4 trillion in funds during the same period, increasing waste and diminishing government effectiveness. Business groups such as the U.S. Chamber of Commerce and the National Association of Homebuilders—typically not known for expanding government’s role—have spoken against eliminating the ACS because companies rely on its data for decisions that affect consumers and markets. Even respected economists, like MIT's Jonathan Gruber, say that opposing the survey means opposing informed policymaking. Opponents of the measure believe cutting the ACS would harm efforts to serve vulnerable populations, like veterans needing financial support or communities lacking adequate healthcare and sanitation. Supporters of the repeal argue the ACS is intrusive and that the private sector should step in, yet many businesses depend on the very information the survey provides. Ultimately, the move to kill the ACS exposes a rift among Republicans between those favoring small government and those who back business-driven approaches. The ultimate fate of the proposal is uncertain, but its implications for American governance and the nation's most vulnerable are significant. The views in this commentary are those of Ilyse Hogue.
translated_content: Masih menjadi persoalan mengapa sesetengah ahli politik Republikan yang sering mengkritik campur tangan kerajaan memilih untuk berkhidmat dalam kerajaan, terutama apabila tindakan seperti undian terbaru GOP di Dewan Perwakilan untuk menghapuskan Kajian Komuniti Amerika (ACS) kelihatan bertentangan. ACS, yang dijalankan oleh Biro Bancian AS, menyediakan statistik penting dan terkini mengenai demografi rakyat Amerika yang membantu mengagihkan $400 bilion setahun dalam bentuk geran untuk sekolah, penjagaan kesihatan, infrastruktur dan perkhidmatan penting lain. Tidak seperti bancian tradisional setiap sepuluh tahun, ACS menawarkan maklumat lebih terperinci dan berterusan. Wakil Republikan, Daniel Webster dari Florida, yang memenangi kerusinya pada 2010, mengetuai pindaan untuk menamatkan ACS sebagai usaha memenuhi janji kempennya untuk menghalang 'pembaziran perbelanjaan.' Undian Dewan yang menyokong pindaan ini bertujuan menjimatkan $2.5 bilion dalam tempoh sepuluh tahun. Namun, pengkritik menyatakan tanpa data ini, pengagihan $4 trilion dalam tempoh sama akan menjadi kurang cekap, menyebabkan pembaziran yang lebih besar dan melemahkan keberkesanan kerajaan. Kumpulan perniagaan seperti Dewan Perniagaan AS dan Persatuan Pembina Rumah Negara—yang biasanya tidak menyokong perluasan peranan kerajaan—turut membantah penghapusan ACS kerana syarikat sangat bergantung pada data ini untuk membuat keputusan penting tentang pengguna dan pasaran. Pakar ekonomi ternama seperti Jonathan Gruber dari MIT juga menyatakan bahawa menentang kajian ini bermakna menolak pembuatan dasar berasaskan maklumat. Pihak yang menentang langkah ini percaya penghapusan ACS akan menjejaskan usaha membantu golongan terpinggir seperti veteran yang memerlukan bantuan kewangan, atau komuniti yang kekurangan penjagaan kesihatan dan kemudahan sanitasi. Penyokong pemansuhan mendakwa ACS terlalu mengganggu privasi dan percaya sektor swasta boleh mengambil alih, walaupun banyak perniagaan sebenarnya bergantung pada data ini. Akhirnya, langkah menamatkan ACS menunjukkan perpecahan dalam kalangan Republikan antara yang mahukan kerajaan kecil dengan mereka yang mengutamakan strategi berasaskan perniagaan. Nasib cadangan ini masih belum pasti, tetapi kesannya terhadap pentadbiran Amerika dan rakyat paling memerlukan adalah besar. Pandangan dalam ulasan ini adalah daripada Ilyse Hogue.

article_content: Eli Martinez, a 41-year-old diver from Alamo, Texas, regularly visits Tiger Beach in the Bahamas, where he has developed a close and trusting relationship with tiger sharks over the past decade. Although tiger sharks are considered one of the most dangerous shark species, Martinez has learned to interact with them safely. The sharks now recognize him and allow him to coax them into rolling over under his touch, occasionally appearing to smile. Martinez says he can even rub his face against their heads. Through repeated interactions, he is able to identify individual sharks by their unique markings and has named some of them, including Hook and Alex. During his visits, Martinez is often surrounded by two to four tiger sharks, along with about 40 lemon sharks and up to 60 reef sharks. He and his group always respect the animals' space and behave cautiously to avoid alarming them. Despite the trust developed, Martinez stresses that he never forgets the potential danger posed by these wild animals. He believes that showing consistent respect is crucial for safe and positive interactions.

Walaupun jerung harimau dianggap salah satu spesies jerung yang paling berbahaya, Martinez telah belajar cara berinteraksi dengan mereka secara selamat. Jerung-jerung ini kini mengenali beliau dan membenarkannya memusingkan mereka di bawah sentuhannya, kadang-kadang kelihatan seperti tersenyum. Martinez berkata dia bahkan boleh menggosok mukanya pada kepala mereka. Melalui interaksi yang berulang, beliau dapat mengenal pasti setiap jerung mengikut tanda unik mereka dan telah menamakan sebahagian daripada mereka seperti Hook dan Alex. Semasa lawatannya, Martinez sering dikelilingi oleh dua hingga empat ekor jerung harimau, serta kira-kira 40 jerung lemon dan sehingga 60 jerung terumbu. Beliau dan kumpulannya sentiasa menghormati ruang haiwan tersebut dan bertindak dengan berhati-hati supaya tidak mengejutkan mereka. Walaupun kepercayaan telah terjalin, Martinez menegaskan dia tidak pernah lupa potensi bahaya haiwan liar ini. Beliau percaya bahawa menghormati secara konsisten adalah penting untuk interaksi yang selamat dan positif.

article_content: Tony Nicklinson, a 57-year-old man living with locked-in syndrome after suffering a major stroke in 2005, has tweeted for the first time using eye-tracking technology. Nicklinson, who is completely paralysed and communicates through a computer that converts his eye movements into text, posted: 'Hello world. I am Tony Nicklinson, I have locked-in syndrome and this is my first ever tweet.' On June 13, he sent his first tweet, and followed it up the next day with: 'I have just had an old school friend call in for a chat with us but mostly Jane because she can speak. Still, it was nice to see him.' Within 24 hours of joining Twitter as @TonyNicklinson, he gained 2,600 followers. Channel 4’s Dispatches captured this milestone ahead of a documentary about his life, airing Monday, 18 June at 8pm. Nicklinson and his family, who live in Melksham, Wiltshire, are set to appear before the High Court, seeking a legal ruling to permit a doctor to lawfully help end his life, with his full consent. The case will be heard by three judges. Nicklinson describes his life as 'dull, miserable, demeaning, undignified and intolerable.' He requires constant care and refers to his house as a 'prison.' Before his stroke, he was an active, outgoing man and keen rugby player who loved extreme sports and often travelled for work. He has two adult daughters.
translated_content: Tony Nicklinson, seorang lelaki berusia 57 tahun yang menghidap sindrom terkunci selepas mengalami strok besar pada tahun 2005, telah menulis tweet pertamanya menggunakan teknologi penjejak mata. Nicklinson, yang lumpuh sepenuhnya dan hanya boleh berkomunikasi melalui komputer yang menukar pergerakan matanya kepada teks, memuat naik: 'Hello world. Saya Tony Nicklinson, saya ada sindrom terkunci dan ini adalah tweet pertama saya.' Pada 13 Jun, beliau menulis tweet pertamanya, diikuti keesokan harinya dengan: 'Seorang kawan lama datang bersembang dengan kami, tapi kebanyakannya berbual dengan Jane sebab dia boleh bercakap. Tapi, seronok juga jumpa dia.' Dalam masa 24 jam selepas menyertai Twitter sebagai @TonyNicklinson, beliau telah mendapat 2,600 pengikut. Channel 4 Dispatches telah merakam detik penting ini sebelum dokumentari mengenai kehidupannya disiarkan pada Isnin, 18 Jun jam 8 malam. Nicklinson dan keluarganya, yang tinggal di Melksham, Wiltshire, akan hadir di Mahkamah Tinggi untuk mendapatkan keputusan undang-undang bagi membenarkan doktor membantu menamatkan hidupnya secara sah, dengan persetujuannya sendiri. Kes tersebut akan didengari oleh tiga orang hakim. Nicklinson menggambarkan hidupnya sebagai 'membosankan, menyedihkan, memalukan, tidak bermaruah dan tidak dapat ditanggung.' Beliau memerlukan penjagaan sepanjang masa dan menyifatkan rumahnya sebagai 'penjara.' Sebelum strok, beliau seorang yang aktif, suka bermain ragbi, meminati sukan lasak dan kerap ke luar negara untuk kerja. Beliau mempunyai dua anak perempuan dewasa.

article_content: Two years ago, Jenny Dawson, an aspiring entrepreneur in London, saw perfectly good peas from Kenya being discarded at a wholesale market. Later, on a friend's farm, she noticed crates of apples left to rot because they were too small for buyers. This inspired Dawson, 27, formerly a hedge fund employee, to create a business centered on using surplus produce. Her company, Rubies in the Rubble, produces jams and chutneys from fruits and vegetables that would otherwise be thrown away. 'Making preserves seemed natural, since they can last up to 10 months,' Dawson explained. Food waste is a serious global problem. The U.N. has estimated that around one-third of all food produced for human consumption is wasted every year. Food banks, hotels, and restaurants are redistributing leftover food, while composting is becoming more widespread. Businesses like Dawson’s have appeared to address food waste by turning surplus food into products. Increased awareness and initiatives from supermarkets and restaurants are making a difference. For example, UK supermarket Waitrose now sends zero food waste to landfills, instead donating unwanted food or sending it to biogas plants. Marks & Spencer is also adopting this method. Consumer attitudes to food waste are changing. Dawson notes a shift, with people becoming more open to imperfect or oddly shaped produce, viewing them as organic and homegrown. In California, two entrepreneurs, Nikhil Arora and Alejandro Velez, started Back to the Roots after learning that mushrooms can grow on used coffee grounds. Based in Berkeley, they collect grounds from local cafes and create mushroom-growing kits sold in stores like Whole Foods and Nordstrom. Their main product is a kit containing a cardboard box lined with a bag filled with coffee grounds and mushroom spores. With simple care, pearl oyster mushrooms grow in about 10 days. The company now reuses about 18,000 kilograms of coffee grounds each week. Arora admits that while their efforts won’t solve all food waste, their goal is to raise awareness, especially among children, about where food comes from and how to reduce waste. Their kits attract a wide variety of people, from kids to food lovers to environmentally conscious individuals.
translated_content: Dua tahun lalu, Jenny Dawson, seorang bakal usahawan di London, melihat kacang pis dari Kenya yang masih elok dibuang di sebuah pasar borong. Kemudian, di ladang rakannya, dia melihat peti-peti epal yang dibiarkan reput kerana terlalu kecil untuk pembeli. Perkara ini memberi inspirasi kepada Dawson, 27 tahun, bekas pekerja dana lindung nilai, untuk memulakan perniagaan yang memanfaatkan lebihan hasil pertanian. Syarikatnya, Rubies in the Rubble, menghasilkan jem dan chutney daripada buah-buahan dan sayur-sayuran yang sepatutnya dibuang. 'Membuat bahan awet seperti ini nampak semula jadi, kerana ia boleh tahan sehingga 10 bulan,' jelas Dawson. Pembaziran makanan ialah masalah serius di peringkat global. PBB menganggarkan sekitar satu pertiga daripada semua makanan yang dihasilkan untuk kegunaan manusia dibazirkan setiap tahun. Bank makanan, hotel, dan restoran kini mengagihkan semula makanan lebihan, manakala aktiviti kompos semakin meluas. Perniagaan seperti milik Dawson telah muncul untuk mengatasi pembaziran makanan dengan mengubah hasil berlebihan menjadi produk baru. Kesedaran yang meningkat dan inisiatif daripada pasar raya serta restoran sangat membantu. Sebagai contoh, pasar raya UK Waitrose kini tidak menghantar sebarang pembaziran makanan ke tapak pelupusan, sebaliknya menderma makanan tidak diperlukan atau menghantarnya ke kilang biogas. Marks & Spencer juga menggunakan kaedah yang sama. Sikap pengguna terhadap pembaziran makanan juga berubah. Dawson berkata, sekarang orang ramai semakin menerima hasil tani yang tidak sempurna atau pelik bentuknya kerana dianggap lebih organik dan tempatan. Di California, dua usahawan, Nikhil Arora dan Alejandro Velez, menubuhkan Back to the Roots selepas mengetahui cendawan boleh tumbuh atas hampas kopi terpakai. Beroperasi di Berkeley, mereka mengutip hampas dari kafe setempat dan menghasilkan kit penanaman cendawan yang dijual di kedai seperti Whole Foods dan Nordstrom. Produk utama mereka ialah kit yang mengandungi kotak kadbod dengan beg berisi hampas kopi dan spora cendawan. Dengan penjagaan mudah, cendawan tiram mutiara tumbuh dalam masa sekitar 10 hari. Syarikat ini kini menggunakan semula kira-kira 18,000 kilogram hampas kopi setiap minggu. Arora mengakui bahawa walaupun usaha mereka tidak dapat menyelesaikan keseluruhan masalah pembaziran makanan, matlamat utama ialah meningkatkan kesedaran — terutamanya dalam kalangan kanak-kanak — tentang dari mana makanan datang dan bagaimana mengurangkan pembaziran. Kit mereka menarik minat pelbagai golongan, dari kanak-kanak hingga pencinta makanan dan individu yang prihatin terhadap alam sekitar.

article_content: Ariel Sharon's name is deeply woven into Israel's history, influencing both its past and, even after his death following an eight-year coma, its future. Israelis continue to reconsider their choices, especially if the two-state solution is not achieved. Known as 'Arik,' Sharon survived being gravely wounded during Israel's 1948 War of Independence before founding Israel’s first commando unit, which carried out missions beyond national borders. He later led paratroopers during the 1956 Sinai campaign. As a general in the 1967 Six Day War, Sharon gained global recognition. In 1973 during the Yom Kippur War, he led a crucial offensive across the Suez Canal. His image—blond, stocky, and donning a bloodied bandage—became iconic. Sharon was renowned for his boldness, often taking controversial actions and defying convention. Sharon’s political career was also momentous. Raised on a labor farm and later founding the Likud party with Menachem Begin, Sharon had a wide-ranging political journey. As agriculture minister in the late 1970s, he expanded West Bank and Gaza settlements, reputation as a hardliner. Yet as defense minister, he evacuated Israelis from Sinai settlements to uphold Israel’s peace treaty with Egypt. In 1982, Sharon led the Israeli invasion of Lebanon. An Israeli commission later held him indirectly responsible for the massacre of Palestinian civilians by Lebanese militias, which led to his resignation. Sharon’s leadership style was divisive—he was admired and criticized in equal measure. As defense minister, he at times faced opposition from soldiers and the public, though he was also known for his personal warmth. Nicknamed 'the Bulldozer' for his determination and stature, Sharon returned to political prominence in 2000. Following Yasser Arafat's rejection of Israeli proposals and Sharon’s visit to the Temple Mount, which was blamed for sparking the Second Intifada, Sharon rose to prime minister with Shimon Peres as his deputy. As prime minister, he exercised restraint during months of attacks, ultimately launching a major military operation in 2002. Then, in a significant reversal, Sharon supported unilateral disengagement from Gaza, dismantling settlements and withdrawing Israeli forces—a decision that split the Israeli public and prompted him to form a new party that found significant support. In 2005, all residents of Gaza settlements were evacuated. Subsequently, Hamas seized control of Gaza and began launching rocket attacks on Israel. Sharon remained steadfast on his strategic path but suffered a stroke before he could implement similar plans for the West Bank. Currently, as U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry pursues a peace agreement, Sharon's unilateral options are being revisited. Some Israelis are considering withdrawal from Palestinian population centers in the West Bank, with most settlements remaining under Israeli control and the military securing strategic borders. While the two-state solution remains the preferred outcome, unilateral measures are contemplated, aiming to end the occupation, strengthen security, and perhaps lay groundwork for future peace. Throughout his life—as a soldier, farmer, builder, and leader—Sharon embodied Israeli complexity. His legacy continues to influence the country’s future. The views expressed here are solely those of Michael Oren.
translated_content: Nama Ariel Sharon sangat sinonim dengan sejarah Israel, mempengaruhi negara itu pada masa lalu dan, walaupun selepas kematiannya selepas lapan tahun koma, pada masa depannya. Rakyat Israel terus menilai semula pilihan mereka, terutamanya jika penyelesaian dua negara gagal dicapai. Dikenali sebagai 'Arik', Sharon terselamat walaupun cedera parah dalam Perang Kemerdekaan Israel 1948 sebelum menubuhkan unit komando pertama Israel yang menjalankan misi di luar sempadan negara. Kemudian, beliau memimpin pasukan payung terjun dalam kempen Sinai 1956. Sebagai jeneral dalam Perang Enam Hari 1967, Sharon mendapat pengiktirafan antarabangsa. Pada tahun 1973 semasa Perang Yom Kippur, beliau mengetuai serangan penting merentasi Terusan Suez. Gambarnya—berambut perang, berbadan tegap, dan berbalut kain berdarah—menjadi ikonik. Sharon terkenal kerana keberaniannya serta tindakan kontroversinya yang sering menentang kebiasaan. Kerjaya politik Sharon juga berimpak besar. Diasuh di ladang buruh dan kemudian menubuhkan parti Likud bersama Menachem Begin, Sharon melalui perjalanan politik yang luas. Sebagai menteri pertanian pada akhir 1970-an, beliau memperluaskan penempatan di Tebing Barat dan Gaza, mendapat reputasi sebagai seorang yang tegas. Namun, sebagai menteri pertahanan, beliau mengosongkan penempatan di Sinai demi mematuhi perjanjian damai Israel dengan Mesir. Pada tahun 1982, Sharon mengetuai pencerobohan Israel ke Lubnan. Sebuah suruhanjaya Israel kemudian memegangnya bertanggungjawab secara tidak langsung atas pembunuhan beramai-ramai orang awam Palestin oleh militia Lubnan, yang menyebabkan beliau meletak jawatan. Gaya kepimpinan Sharon sering menyebabkan perpecahan—ada yang mengagumi dan ada yang mengkritik. Sebagai menteri pertahanan, beliau kadang kala menerima bantahan daripada askar dan rakyat, namun juga dikenali kerana sifat peribadinya yang rendah diri. Digelar 'the Bulldozer' kerana ketegasan dan penampilannya, Sharon kembali menonjol dalam politik pada tahun 2000. Selepas Yasser Arafat menolak cadangan Israel dan lawatan Sharon ke Temple Mount dipersalahkan kerana mencetuskan Intifada Kedua, Sharon dilantik perdana menteri dengan Shimon Peres sebagai timbalan. Sebagai perdana menteri, beliau mengambil pendekatan berhati-hati sepanjang tempoh serangan, sebelum melancarkan operasi ketenteraan besar pada tahun 2002. Selepas itu, Sharon membuat perubahan besar dengan menyokong penarikan sepihak dari Gaza, membongkar penempatan dan menarik tentera Israel—langkah yang memecah-belahkan rakyat Israel serta mendorong beliau menubuhkan parti baharu yang mendapat sokongan meluas. Pada tahun 2005, semua penduduk penempatan Gaza dipindahkan. Selepas itu, Hamas mengambil alih Gaza dan melancarkan serangan roket ke atas Israel. Sharon tetap berpegang pada strateginya namun mengalami strok sebelum sempat melaksanakan tindakan serupa di Tebing Barat. Kini, ketika Setiausaha Negara AS John Kerry berusaha mencapai perjanjian damai, tindakan Sharon yang bersifat sepihak dipertimbangkan semula. Sebilangan rakyat Israel mempertimbangkan pengunduran dari pusat-pusat populasi Palestin di Tebing Barat, di mana kebanyakan penempatan akan kekal di bawah kawalan Israel dan tentera akan mengawal sempadan strategik. Penyelesaian dua negara masih menjadi pilihan utama, namun tindakan sepihak turut dipertimbangkan untuk menamatkan pendudukan, memperkukuhkan keselamatan, dan mungkin menjadi asas bagi perdamaian akan datang. Sepanjang hidup—sebagai askar, petani, pembina, dan pemimpin—Sharon melambangkan kerumitan Israel. Legasinya terus mempengaruhi masa depan negara itu. Pandangan yang dinyatakan ialah milik Michael Oren sahaja.

article_content: Pope Benedict XVI was unable to escape the ongoing Vatileaks scandal over the weekend, as new evidence emerged suggesting his butler was not the sole person in possession of confidential Vatican correspondence. At 85, the Pope concluded his trip to Milan—Italy's industrial and financial center—by leading a mass at an international gathering. There, he praised traditional Catholic family values and reiterated his opposition to gay marriage. The Italian newspaper La Repubblica published leaked documents, received anonymously following the May 23 arrest of Pope Benedict’s butler, Paolo Gabriele. The sender of these documents claimed that 'hundreds more' exist and suggested Gabriele was being used as a scapegoat. The provided documents reportedly had sensitive content redacted 'so as not to offend the Holy Father' but included a threat to reveal more. The scandal has exposed alleged power struggles and infighting within the Vatican, echoing previous controversies such as the clerical sexual abuse scandal. One leaked letter, dated January 16, from Cardinal Raymond Burke to Cardinal Tarcisio Bertone, complained about a liturgical decision being made without consulting Burke’s office. Two additional letters, signed by the Pope’s private secretary Monsignor Georg Ganswein, were also included, though with significant redactions. Gabriele, 45, is currently detained on aggravated theft charges and might face up to 30 years in prison if convicted of divulging state secrets. He is being held in a 'safe room' at the Vatican's police station and is expected to be questioned by a Vatican prosecutor soon, who will determine whether he should stand trial. The anonymous source accused Bertone and Ganswein of being 'really responsible for this scandal.' The Pope made no mention of the Vatileaks situation during his Milan visit, which took place as part of the 7th World Meeting of Families at Bresso Airport with attendees including Italy’s Prime Minister Mario Monti. Pope Benedict addressed a crowd of one million from around the world, emphasizing the importance of family based on marriage between a man and a woman and openness to having children. In his homily, the Pope warned that modern society’s focus on utility and profit can harm families, describing consequences like severe competition, inequalities, environmental degradation, consumerism, and family tensions. While he did not directly address the Vatileaks scandal in Milan, Pope Benedict has previously expressed sadness over the incident, but emphasized his trust and encouragement for loyal collaborators working in the Vatican.
translated_content: Pope Benedict XVI tidak dapat melarikan diri daripada skandal Vatileaks yang berterusan pada hujung minggu lalu, apabila bukti baharu muncul yang menunjukkan butlernya bukan satu-satunya individu yang memiliki surat-menyurat sulit Vatican. Pada usia 85 tahun, Paus mengakhiri lawatan beliau ke Milan—pusat industri dan kewangan Itali—dengan memimpin misa di satu perhimpunan antarabangsa. Di sana, beliau memuji nilai keluarga Katolik tradisional dan mengulangi penentangannya terhadap perkahwinan sejenis. Akhbar Itali La Repubblica telah menerbitkan dokumen bocor yang diterima secara anonim selepas penahanan butler Paus Benedict, Paolo Gabriele, pada 23 Mei. Pengirim dokumen ini mendakwa bahawa terdapat 'ratusan lagi' dokumen dan mencadangkan Gabriele dijadikan kambing hitam. Dokumen yang diberikan dikatakan telah dipadamkan kandungan sensitifnya 'supaya tidak menyinggungkan Paus' tetapi mengandungi ancaman untuk mendedahkan lebih banyak maklumat. Skandal ini telah mendedahkan dakwaan perebutan kuasa dan perbalahan dalaman dalam Vatican, mengulangi kontroversi terdahulu seperti skandal penderaan seksual paderi. Salah satu surat bocor bertarikh 16 Januari daripada Kardinal Raymond Burke kepada Kardinal Tarcisio Bertone, mengadu tentang keputusan liturgi yang dibuat tanpa merujuk pejabat Burke. Dua lagi surat daripada setiausaha peribadi Paus, Monsignor Georg Ganswein, turut disertakan tetapi dengan begitu banyak maklumat dipadamkan. Gabriele, 45, kini ditahan atas tuduhan kecurian teruk dan boleh dikenakan hukuman penjara sehingga 30 tahun jika didapati bersalah membocorkan rahsia negara. Dia ditahan di 'bilik selamat' di balai polis Vatican dan dijangka akan disoal siasat oleh pendakwa Vatican tidak lama lagi untuk menentukan sama ada beliau perlu dibawa ke perbicaraan. Sumber anonim itu menuduh Bertone dan Ganswein sebagai 'pihak yang benar-benar bertanggungjawab terhadap skandal ini.' Paus tidak menyentuh isu Vatileaks semasa lawatan ke Milan, yang diadakan sempena Pertemuan Keluarga Sedunia ke-7 di Lapangan Terbang Bresso dengan kehadiran termasuk Perdana Menteri Itali Mario Monti. Paus Benedict berucap kepada sejuta hadirin dari seluruh dunia, menekankan pentingnya keluarga berasaskan perkahwinan lelaki dan wanita serta keterbukaan untuk mempunyai anak. Dalam homilinya, Paus memberi amaran bahawa penekanan masyarakat moden pada utiliti dan keuntungan boleh memudaratkan keluarga, menerangkan akibat seperti persaingan sengit, ketidaksamaan, kemerosotan alam sekitar, konsumerisme, dan tekanan dalam keluarga. Walaupun beliau tidak langsung membangkitkan skandal Vatileaks di Milan, Paus Benedict sebelum ini telah meluahkan kesedihan atas insiden tersebut, tetapi tetap menegaskan kepercayaan dan galakan beliau kepada para pembantu setia di Vatican.

article_content:
Local news in the United States continues to decline rapidly, despite increased attention. Since 2005, a third of U.S. newspapers and two-thirds of their journalists have been lost. In 2023, 2.5 newspapers closed each week on average, up from two per week in 2022, with most closures among weekly papers in communities lacking other news sources, according to a Northwestern University study.

Tim Franklin, who leads Northwestern’s local news initiative at the Medill journalism school, warned that this downward trend could accelerate. If the current pace persists, the U.S. will see 3,000 newspapers close within two decades, leaving just under 6,000. Meanwhile, 43,000 newspaper journalists have lost their jobs, mainly due to a collapsing advertising market.

Digital news outlets have sprung up, but they open and close at similar rates, resulting in little net gain. There is discussion of public and philanthropic financial support, but these have not significantly altered the current trajectory. Financial pressures affect almost all media, with The Washington Post planning to cut 240 jobs, Jezebel shutting down, NPR instituting layoffs, and the Associated Press now asking readers for donations.

Local news challenges are widespread. The report states that 204 counties have no local news outlet, and 1,562 have only one—usually a weekly paper. That’s over half of America’s 3,143 counties. Of the counties with a single outlet, 228 are considered at risk and placed on a 'watch list.'

In Texas, despite 50% population growth since 2005, the state has lost 65% of its newspaper journalists. Franklin argued the issue is rooted in supply rather than demand for local news.

A rise in readership during the pandemic suggests people value local coverage in times of need. But the overall decline has led many to lose the habit of seeking out local news. Staffing cuts have resulted in so-called 'ghost newspapers'—publications existing in name but offering much less than before.

According to the Alliance of Audited Media, paid print and digital circulation across 504 newspapers dropped to 10.2 million in 2023, a steep fall from over 50 million print circulation in 2005. The impact is worst in rural and low-income areas, though new digital news outlets tend to launch in affluent suburbs with good internet access.

Studies show that the decline of local news contributes to greater political polarization, more corruption, and the spread of misinformation. The report’s co-author, Penny Abernathy, described the trend as a crisis for democracy.

Nevertheless, there are bright spots. The Post and Courier in Charleston, S.C., added 27 reporters and aims to build a statewide newsroom sustained by digital subscriptions by 2025. The Recorder in Virginia survived a brush with closure through raising subscription prices and gaining community donations.

The study proposes public broadcasting as a potential way forward, though NPR and PBS face funding issues. Franklin stresses growing recognition of the challenge, saying: 'There needs to be a lot more.'

Berita tempatan di Amerika Syarikat terus merosot dengan pantas walaupun mendapat lebih banyak perhatian. Sejak 2005, satu pertiga akhbar di negara itu dan dua pertiga wartawannya telah hilang. Pada tahun 2023, purata 2.5 akhbar ditutup setiap minggu, meningkat daripada dua setiap minggu pada 2022, dengan kebanyakan penutupan melibatkan akhbar mingguan di komuniti yang tiada sumber berita lain, menurut kajian Universiti Northwestern.

Tim Franklin, ketua inisiatif berita tempatan di sekolah kewartawanan Medill Northwestern, memberi amaran trend ini mungkin akan bertambah buruk. Jika kadar ini berterusan, Amerika Syarikat akan menyaksikan 3,000 akhbar ditutup dalam tempoh dua dekad akan datang, meninggalkan kurang daripada 6,000 akhbar. Sementara itu, 43,000 wartawan akhbar telah kehilangan pekerjaan, kebanyakannya akibat kejatuhan pasaran pengiklanan.

Portal berita digital semakin banyak, tetapi kadar pembukaan dan penutupannya hampir sama, jadi tiada pertambahan bersih. Terdapat perbincangan mengenai sokongan kewangan kerajaan dan dermawan, tetapi keadaan masih belum banyak berubah. Tekanan kewangan turut melanda hampir semua media: The Washington Post bakal mengurangkan 240 pekerja, Jezebel ditutup, NPR memberhentikan staf dan Associated Press kini meminta derma pembaca.

Cabaran berita tempatan terjadi di seluruh negara. Laporan itu menyebut 204 daerah tidak mempunyai outlet berita tempatan, manakala 1,562 hanya mempunyai satu—biasanya akhbar mingguan. Ini lebih separuh daripada 3,143 daerah di seluruh Amerika Syarikat. Daripada daerah yang hanya ada satu outlet, 228 disenarai sebagai berisiko dan dimasukkan dalam 'senarai pemantauan.'

Di Texas, walaupun populasi meningkat 50% sejak 2005, bilangan wartawan akhbar di negeri tersebut menurun 65%. Franklin berkata masalah ini berpunca daripada kekurangan penawaran berita tempatan, bukan kurang permintaan.

Peningkatan pembaca ketika pandemik membuktikan orang ambil berat tentang liputan tempatan ketika perlu. Tetapi kemerosotan berterusan menyebabkan ramai orang tidak lagi mencari berita tempatan. Pengurangan kakitangan telah melahirkan "akhbar hantu"—akhbar yang tinggal nama sahaja tanpa isi seperti sebelumnya.

Menurut Alliance of Audited Media, edaran akhbar bercetak dan digital berbayar untuk 504 akhbar pada 2023 ialah 10.2 juta, jatuh jauh daripada lebih 50 juta pada 2005. Kawasan luar bandar dan berpendapatan rendah paling terkesan, manakala portal digital baru lebih banyak muncul di pinggir bandar berkemampuan dengan akses internet baik.

Kajian menunjukkan kemerosotan berita tempatan meningkatkan polarisasi politik, rasuah dan penularan maklumat palsu. Penulis bersama laporan, Penny Abernathy, menyifatkan keadaan ini sebagai krisis untuk demokrasi.

Namun terdapat juga kisah kejayaan. The Post and Courier di Charleston, Carolina Selatan menambah 27 wartawan dan bercita-cita menubuhkan bilik berita seluruh negeri yang dibiaya langganan digital menjelang 2025. The Recorder di Virginia terselamat daripada penutupan melalui kenaikan harga langganan dan sumbangan komuniti.

Kajian mencadangkan penyiaran awam sebagai antara penyelesaian walaupun NPR dan PBS juga hadapi isu pembiayaan. Franklin menekankan kesedaran mengenai isu ini semakin meningkat, katanya: 'Masih banyak yang perlu dilakukan.'

article_content:
Under the Gulf of Mexico, the wrecks of the SS Robert E. Lee and German submarine U-166, both casualties of World War II, rest just two miles apart. In July, the research ship Nautilus—run by the Ocean Exploration Trust—explored these sites, 45 miles off the Mississippi River delta. Using high-tech remotely operated vehicles, experts mapped and produced 3D images of both wrecks to uncover more about how they sank.

On July 30, 1942, the Robert E. Lee was torpedoed by U-166 while carrying survivors of earlier attacks. Its escort, the PC-566, responded by dropping depth charges and sank the U-boat, causing the loss of all 52 people aboard. The Robert E. Lee sinking resulted in 25 fatalities, including both crew and passengers.

Archaeologists now have clearer information about these historic events thanks to new data and images. As war graves, the wrecks are explored with careful respect for the lives lost. Robert Ballard, Ocean Exploration Trust's founder, reflected that although the ships are war memorials, they have become rich habitats for ocean life.

The Nautilus team is also studying the environmental aftermath of the Deepwater Horizon oil spill during this ongoing mission, which runs until early October. Their discoveries can be followed online.

article_content: Singer Robin Gibb of the Bee Gees has surprised his doctors by emerging from a coma just days after they feared he might not survive, according to his physician Dr. Andrew Thillainayagam. Recently, Gibb had been battling pneumonia in addition to recent fights with colon and liver cancer. Now he is described as fully conscious, lucid, and able to speak with loved ones. Dr. Thillainayagam stated that Gibb is breathing independently with the assistance of an oxygen mask, and is receiving intravenous feeding and antibiotics. He remains extremely weak and malnourished, and the medical team's immediate goals are to ensure his swallowing is safe and that he regains enough strength to breathe without high levels of oxygen support. If his condition improves, he may soon be moved out of the intensive care unit at the London Clinic. Dr. Thillainayagam praised Gibb's courage and strength, noting that his recovery had seemed unlikely just three days earlier. Gibb's wife Dwina and his children, Robin-John, Spencer, and Melissa, have stayed by his side throughout his hospitalization. Robin's twin brother Maurice died in 2003, and his brother Andy passed away in 1988. The Bee Gees, formed by the Gibb brothers, became internationally famous following the success of the 1977 film 'Saturday Night Fever,' which featured their music. The group has sold more than 200 million albums, and their 'Saturday Night Fever' soundtrack was the top-selling album until Michael Jackson's ‘Thriller’ surpassed it in the 1980s. Robin Gibb also contributed lead vocals to several notable songs and released solo albums throughout his career.

Baru-baru ini, Gibb bertarung dengan pneumonia selain berdepan dengan kanser kolon dan hati. Kini beliau digambarkan sebagai sedar sepenuhnya, waras dan boleh berbicara dengan orang tersayang. article_content: BEIJING — Beijing has called for a cease-fire in Myanmar after a coalition of ethnic fighters seized several crossings along Myanmar’s border with China over the past month. Despite this, China will continue live-fire drills on its side of the border to “test the mobility, border control abilities, and firepower capabilities of the military units so that the People’s Liberation Army is ready for any emergency,” according to the army newspaper PLA Daily on Sunday. Myanmar’s economy heavily depends on trade with China, particularly for importing manufactured goods and exporting agricultural products. Unrest in Myanmar’s border region has been a consistent issue for China. Although China has supported Myanmar’s military leaders, who took power in 2021 from an elected government, it remains wary of conflict spilling over the border, an area already affected by drug trafficking and people smuggling. Cybercrime targeting Chinese citizens has become a major concern, prompting China to push for the removal of such groups based in Myanmar and neighboring countries, and for the extradition of suspects to China for prosecution. “China is highly concerned about the conflicts in Myanmar and has urged all parties to cease fire and begin peaceful dialogue to prevent the situation from escalating,” PLA Daily reported. Meanwhile, the PLA will “safeguard border security and protect the lives and property of people living in the border areas.” The newspaper added that live-fire exercises, which began on Saturday, will “boost the sense of responsibility and vigilance of the troops” and will continue for several days. The Myanmar government has acknowledged losing at least three towns, and the fighting appears to have nearly stopped all legal trade with China. On Saturday, the Kyin-San-Kyawt border gate—one of the five major trading gates in Muse township, northern Shan state—was seized. Muse hosts the 105-Mile Trade Zone and handles the highest volume of trade with China. It is the fourth border crossing seized by alliance forces in a month of heavy fighting. Chinese police reportedly used tear gas to disperse people sheltering close to the border fence.
translated_content: BEIJING — Beijing telah menyeru gencatan senjata di Myanmar selepas gabungan pejuang etnik merampas beberapa lintasan sempadan Myanmar-China dalam sebulan lalu. Walaupun begitu, China akan meneruskan latihan menembak secara langsung di sisi sempadannya untuk "menguji keupayaan mobiliti, kawalan sempadan, dan keupayaan tembakan unit tentera supaya Tentera Pembebasan Rakyat bersedia menghadapi sebarang kecemasan," menurut akhbar tentera PLA Daily pada Ahad. Ekonomi Myanmar sangat bergantung kepada perdagangan dengan China, terutama untuk mengimport barangan buatan dan mengeksport hasil pertanian. Ketidakstabilan di kawasan sempadan Myanmar sentiasa menjadi isu bagi China. Walaupun China menyokong pemimpin tentera Myanmar yang mengambil alih kuasa pada 2021 daripada kerajaan yang dipilih, China tetap bimbang konflik akan merebak ke sempadan yang sudah terjejas oleh penyeludupan dadah dan pemerdagangan manusia. Jenayah siber yang menyasarkan warganegara China juga menjadi kebimbangan utama, mendorong China untuk menghapuskan kumpulan-kumpulan itu yang berpangkalan di Myanmar dan negara jiran, serta menuntut penjenayah diekstradisi ke China untuk didakwa. "China amat mengambil berat tentang konflik di Myanmar dan telah menggesa semua pihak menghentikan pertempuran serta memulakan dialog demi mengelak situasi semakin meruncing," lapor PLA Daily. Sementara itu, PLA akan "menjaga keselamatan sempadan dan melindungi nyawa serta harta benda penduduk di kawasan sempadan." Akhbar itu menambah bahawa latihan menembak yang bermula pada Sabtu itu bertujuan "meningkatkan rasa tanggungjawab dan kewaspadaan anggota tentera" dan akan diteruskan selama beberapa hari. Kerajaan Myanmar mengakui kehilangan sekurang-kurangnya tiga bandar, dan pertempuran dilihat hampir menghentikan semua perdagangan sah dengan China. Pada Sabtu, pintu sempadan Kyin-San-Kyawt — salah satu daripada lima pintu perdagangan utama di daerah Muse, Shan utara — telah dikuasai. Muse menempatkan Zon Perdagangan 105-Mile dan memegang nilai perdagangan tertinggi dengan China. Ia adalah lintasan keempat yang dirampas oleh gabungan pasukan dalam sebulan pertempuran sengit. Polis China dilaporkan menggunakan gas pemedih mata untuk menghalau orang yang berlindung berhampiran pagar sempadan.

article_content: Sherry, a 58-year-old driver in Florida, has seen her earnings from Uber and Lyft drop significantly. Where she once made $200 a day by driving only six to eight hours, she now must put in up to 75 hours a week to reach similar amounts. Frustrated by these changes, Sherry pointed out that many drivers are leaving ride-hailing platforms because conditions have worsened. To find greater financial stability, Sherry started her own shuttle service, mainly using Facebook and word-of-mouth to attract customers. She offers $50 shuttle rides to and from the nearby cruise terminal, which is more affordable than some large ride-share providers. This move has allowed her to cut back on working hours and spend more time with her family. Inflation and growing competition pushed Sherry and many others to seek new income streams. The number of gig workers in the US has more than doubled since the pandemic began, but the increased competition, falling earnings, and rising expenses have made gig work less sustainable. Some, including Sherry, have chosen to run their own businesses instead. Sherry started driving part-time in 2017, becoming a full-time gig worker in 2019 after leaving a pharmacy job she found unsatisfying. At first, she could easily balance work, travel, and family time, but the pandemic made things more challenging. Despite long hours driving essential workers during COVID-19 and the bonuses available then, the saturation of drivers led earnings to decrease. Now, Sherry sometimes drives up to 18 hours in one day to achieve what she previously earned in much less time. Last year, Sherry reported gross earnings of over $98,000 from Uber, but after expenses, fees, and taxes, she took home only $55,000. For nearly 2,000 trips in the first ten months of this year, her net payout was about $28,500. There are days when she earns just $100 after a full shift, close to Florida’s minimum wage. Prolonged hours behind the wheel have also led to health issues, including muscle weakness and weight gain. Sherry has seen competition skyrocket, especially at airports, where far more drivers now compete for fewer passengers. Trips often pay less after long waits, and maintenance costs like tire replacements have dramatically increased, eating into her earnings. She sometimes receives trip offers that barely cover fuel costs, leaving little profit. Inspired by hearing cruise passengers discuss expensive or unavailable rides, and seeking better income and tips, Sherry began advertising her own shuttle service on Facebook and with a digital business card. Her independent work now brings in $1,500 to $1,700 weekly, and she sometimes makes $500 in a single day working fewer hours than before. Although she faces challenges such as building customer trust and increasing visibility without the backing of a big company, Sherry finds her new business more rewarding. She spends fewer hours driving for Uber and Lyft, takes multiple days off each week, and gets to enjoy more time with her family. By focusing on her own shuttle business, Sherry has regained both flexibility and satisfaction in her work.

Dengan keadaan ini, Sherry menyatakan ramai pemandu sudah meninggalkan platform e-hailing kerana situasi semakin teruk. Untuk mencari kestabilan kewangan, Sherry memulakan perkhidmatan ulang-alik sendiri, terutama menggunakan Facebook dan dari mulut ke mulut untuk menarik pelanggan. Pendapatan perjalanan kini makin kecil selepas kena tunggu lama, dan kos penyelenggaraan seperti tukar tayar naik mendadak. Kadang-kadang trip yang diterima hampir tak cukup untuk kos minyak. Selepas dengar ramai penumpang cruise mengeluh tambang mahal dan susah cari pengangkutan, serta mahu tip lebih baik, Sherry mula iklan servis ulang-alik di Facebook dan dengan kad bisnes digital. Kerja bebas ini kini membolehkan Sherry meraih $1,500 hingga $1,700 seminggu—kadang $500 sehari—dengan waktu kerja kurang berbanding sebelum ini. Walaupun cabaran wujud seperti bina kepercayaan pelanggan tanpa syarikat besar, Sherry rasa perniagaan sendiri lebih memuaskan. Sekarang dia hanya kerja sedikit dengan Uber dan Lyft, ada lebih cuti, dan boleh lebih masa dengan keluarga. Fokus pada servis ulang-alik sendiri mengembalikan fleksibiliti dan kegembiraan dalam hidupnya.

article_content: A Metro-North commuter train derailed in The Bronx, New York, early Sunday morning, leaving four people dead and at least 63 injured, some critically. The train was traveling southbound near Spuyten-Duyvil Station when all seven cars and the locomotive left the tracks, with several cars overturning and coming to rest dangerously close to the Harlem River. Emergency crews, including more than 130 responders, worked throughout the day, searching the wreckage for more victims and assisting the injured. Although authorities believe they have accounted for all passengers on board, they cannot rule out the possibility of finding more victims until clean-up is complete, due to a lack of a definitive passenger manifest. Of the four confirmed fatalities—two men and two women—three were ejected from the train on impact, and one was found inside an overturned carriage. The deceased have been identified as Jim Lovell, 58, of Cold Spring; James Ferrari, 59, of Montrose; Donna Smith, 54, of Newburgh; and Ahn Kisook, 35, of Queens. None were Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA) employees. At least 63 individuals were hospitalized, with cases ranging from spinal cord injuries to broken bones and lacerations. Emergency personnel transported victims to local hospitals: Jacobi Medical Center, St Barnabas Hospital, Montefiore Medical Center, and New York–Presbyterian Hospital. Among the injured were a 14-year-old boy and his father, as well as five off-duty NYPD officers. Initial reports and witness accounts suggest that the train may have been traveling too fast as it approached the curve. Engineer William Rockefeller Jr., 46, stated he tried to apply the brakes, but they did not respond. Investigators from the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) have recovered the train's black box data recorder. The NTSB expects their investigation to last at least a week, examining factors such as speed, brake function, and train maintenance history. Governor Andrew Cuomo remarked that while the cause has not been conclusively determined, the accident could have resulted in far greater losses had it happened during a weekday, when trains are usually more crowded. The governor and other officials expressed condolences to the victims' families. President Barack Obama also offered condolences and indicated he is receiving regular updates from New York officials. Train service along the affected line has been suspended indefinitely while the investigation continues. Firefighters and police used specialized equipment, including cranes, ladders, jacks, airbags, and trained dogs, to search the carriages and free survivors. Some passengers had to be removed on stretchers. Rescue teams reported that the scene was one of the most severe they have encountered. The crash remains under investigation by federal and state authorities. It comes months after another derailment occurred in the same area, raising questions about safety. Officials urge patience as investigators work to determine the exact cause.
translated_content: Sebuah kereta api komuter Metro-North tergelincir di Bronx, New York, awal pagi Ahad, mengakibatkan empat orang maut dan sekurang-kurangnya 63 cedera, sebahagian daripada mereka dalam keadaan kritikal. Kereta api itu bergerak ke arah selatan berhampiran Stesen Spuyten-Duyvil apabila kesemua tujuh gerabak dan lokomotifnya keluar dari landasan, beberapa darinya terbalik dan berhenti berdekatan Sungai Harlem. Pasukan kecemasan, termasuk lebih 130 anggota penyelamat, bertugas sepanjang hari, mencari mangsa di bawah runtuhan dan membantu yang cedera. Pihak berkuasa percaya mereka telah mengambil kira semua penumpang, namun kemungkinan wujud mangsa lain tidak dapat dinafikan sehingga operasi pembersihan selesai kerana tiada senarai penumpang yang tepat. Daripada empat kematian yang disahkan—dua lelaki dan dua wanita—tiga tercampak keluar dari kereta api akibat impak, manakala seorang lagi ditemui di dalam gerabak yang terbalik. Mangsa yang dikenal pasti ialah Jim Lovell, 58, dari Cold Spring; James Ferrari, 59, dari Montrose; Donna Smith, 54, dari Newburgh; dan Ahn Kisook, 35, dari Queens. Tiada seorang pun merupakan kakitangan Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA). Sekurang-kurangnya 63 orang telah dimasukkan ke hospital, dengan kecederaan seperti kecederaan saraf tunjang, tulang patah, dan luka. Mangsa dihantar ke beberapa hospital tempatan: Jacobi Medical Center, St Barnabas Hospital, Montefiore Medical Center, dan New York–Presbyterian Hospital. Antara yang cedera ialah budak lelaki berusia 14 tahun dan bapanya, serta lima pegawai NYPD yang tidak bertugas. Laporan awal dan saksi menyatakan kereta api itu mungkin bergerak terlalu laju semasa menghampiri selekoh. Jurutera William Rockefeller Jr., 46, berkata beliau telah cuba menekan brek tetapi ia tidak berfungsi. Penyiasat dari National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) telah menemui perakam data 'black box' kereta api dan menjangka siasatan berlangsung sekurang-kurangnya seminggu, termasuk mengkaji faktor kelajuan, sistem brek dan penyelenggaraan. Gabenor Andrew Cuomo berkata punca belum dipastikan, tetapi korban boleh menjadi lebih besar sekiranya kejadian berlaku pada hari biasa. Gabenor serta pegawai lain menyampaikan simpati kepada keluarga mangsa. Presiden Barack Obama juga merakamkan takziah dan memaklumkan beliau sedang menerima maklumat dari pegawai New York. Perkhidmatan kereta api di laluan terjejas digantung tanpa tempoh ditetapkan sepanjang siasatan dijalankan. Anggota bomba dan polis menggunakan peralatan khas seperti kren, tangga, jek, kantung udara dan anjing terlatih untuk mencari dan menyelamatkan mangsa. Beberapa penumpang terpaksa dikeluarkan menggunakan pengusung. Pasukan penyelamat menyifatkan situasi di lokasi sebagai antara yang terburuk pernah dialami. Kemalangan ini sedang disiasat oleh pihak berkuasa persekutuan dan negeri. Ia berlaku beberapa bulan selepas insiden tren tergelincir lain di kawasan yang sama, menimbulkan persoalan tentang keselamatan. To tackle the growing threats of deepfakes and online misinformation, India’s government has issued tougher directives for social media and internet companies. Rajeev Chandrasekhar, the Minister of State for Electronics and Technology, announced that all major platforms are required to modify their user policies to comply with 12 categories of banned content—these include addressing deepfakes and child sexual abuse material (CSAM).

Chandrasekhar stated that these platforms have a week to implement the changes, making sure every user is aware of the consequences of posting or sharing restricted content. A designated officer, known as a 'Rule Seven officer,' will be appointed to oversee compliance, handle violation reports, and enforce the new measures.

Although existing IT laws serve as a baseline, the government acknowledges these rules are outdated and intends to modernize them in the future. The focus remains on creating a safer, more trustworthy digital experience for everyone in India. Social media companies have agreed to these terms and are expected to act swiftly.

Chandrasekhar menyatakan platform-platform berkenaan diberikan tempoh seminggu untuk melaksanakan perubahan, dengan setiap pengguna akan dimaklumkan tentang kesan berkongsi atau memuat naik kandungan dilarang. Pegawai khas yang dipanggil 'pegawai Rule Seven' akan dilantik untuk memantau pematuhan, menyelia aduan pelanggaran, dan memastikan langkah baharu ini dilaksanakan sepenuhnya.

Leaders committed to diversity must be intentional about recognizing the experiences of all team members. Celebrating significant holidays and observances—such as International Women's Day, Juneteenth, and Hispanic Heritage Month—honors the culture, history, and contributions within both our communities and organizations. At Medix, we are proud to celebrate all employees by acknowledging occasions like Women’s History Month, Black History Month, and Pride Month. We value the unique talents and perspectives everyone brings to our community.

Every year, it is vital for us as a company to meaningfully appreciate this rich tapestry of experiences, using these moments as opportunities to foster understanding and respect among one another.

Putting Values Into Action

But how can organizations tangibly express this commitment? One effective way is to educate teams, broadening awareness about different cultures by highlighting diverse stories and perspectives. With this approach, we hope to shape a more inclusive workforce. As described in my book, "Culture Through Crisis: One Team’s Commitment to Winning with Purpose," intentional action is invaluable; uniting as a team to empower each person for their individuality leads to meaningful growth.

It’s also important for organizations to create space for the wide array of cultural backgrounds present among employees. For those wondering where to start, here are some suggestions alongside examples from Medix’s recent Hispanic Heritage Month celebration:

- Host cultural panels for open, meaningful discussions. For instance, during Hispanic Heritage Month, we invited guest speakers from our network to share their personal and professional experiences with Medix employees.

- Offer educational sessions led by relevant community members. During Hispanic Heritage Month, our team shared insights about the distinctions between Hispanic and Latiné terminology.

- Share geographical and cultural facts—for example, discussing the 33 nations that make up Latin America.

- Establish employee resource or impact groups, which are employee-led groups that foster diversity, inclusion, engagement, and community within the organization.

- Organize cultural events to create immersive experiences. This year, Medix offices hosted events supporting local Hispanic and Latiné businesses. Some hosted 'salsa off' competitions with homemade salsa and guacamole, while others gathered at local Hispanic/Latiné-owned restaurants. We also introduced Loteria, a traditional game of chance, to the team.

- Participate in community service. On Martin Luther King Jr. Day, teams in Seattle cleaned local streets and woods, Kansas City teams went on a nature walk, and in Chicago, employees partnered with 'My Block My Hood My City' to assemble care packages for seniors.

- Provide platforms for individuals from underrepresented cultures to share their experiences. This year, two teammates from Unidos were interviewed about the themes of "Progress, Power, and Prosperity," sharing family stories and discussing topics such as microaggressions and code-switching.

Positive Employee Response

The response at Medix to these cultural and religious observances has been enthusiastic and encouraging. This engagement motivates us to continue bringing our various communities together for learning, connection, and, of course, enjoyment.

Pemimpin yang benar-benar komited kepada kepelbagaian perlu secara sengaja mengiktiraf pengalaman setiap ahli pasukan. Merayakan hari-hari penting dan sambutan budaya seperti Hari Wanita Sedunia, Juneteenth dan Bulan Warisan Hispanik mengiktiraf budaya, sejarah serta sumbangan dalam komuniti dan organisasi kita. Di Medix, kami bangga meraikan semua pekerja dengan memperingati acara seperti Bulan Sejarah Wanita, Bulan Sejarah Kulit Hitam dan Bulan Pride. Kami menghargai bakat dan perspektif unik yang dibawa setiap individu.

Setiap tahun, amat penting bagi syarikat kami untuk benar-benar menghayati kepelbagaian pengalaman ini, dan menggunakan peluang ini untuk memupuk kefahaman serta rasa hormat antara satu sama lain.

Melaksanakan Nilai Dengan Tindakan

Bagaimanakah organisasi boleh meluahkan komitmen ini secara nyata? Salah satu cara berkesan adalah mendidik pasukan, memperluaskan ilmu tentang budaya berbeza dengan mengetengahkan kisah dan perspektif pelbagai latar. Dengan cara ini, kami berharap dapat membentuk tenaga kerja yang lebih inklusif. Seperti disebut dalam buku saya, "Culture Through Crisis: One Team’s Commitment to Winning with Purpose," tindakan yang disengajakan sangat berharga; bersatu sebagai pasukan untuk memperkasa setiap individu mendorong perkembangan bermakna.

Organisasi juga harus menyediakan ruang untuk pelbagai latar belakang budaya di kalangan pekerja mereka. Untuk yang mencari inspirasi, berikut beberapa cadangan bersama contoh dari sambutan Bulan Warisan Hispanik Medix baru-baru ini:

- Anjur panel budaya untuk perbincangan terbuka dan bermakna. Contohnya, semasa Bulan Warisan Hispanik, kami menjemput penceramah jemputan dari rangkaian kami berkongsi pengalaman peribadi dan profesional bersama pekerja Medix.

- Sediakan sesi pendidikan oleh ahli komuniti berkaitan. Semasa Bulan Warisan Hispanik, kami berkongsi tentang perbezaan istilah Hispanic dan Latiné.

- Kongsi fakta geografi dan budaya, misalnya tentang 33 negara yang membentuk Amerika Latin.

- Wujudkan kumpulan sumber pekerja atau kumpulan impak, iaitu kumpulan pimpinan pekerja yang memupuk kepelbagaian dan komuniti dalam organisasi.

- Anjur acara budaya untuk pengalaman secara langsung. Tahun ini, pejabat Medix meraikan serta menyokong perniagaan tempatan Hispanik dan Latiné. Ada yang adakan pertandingan 'salsa off' dan menjamu juadah bersama, manakala yang lain makan di restoran milik komuniti Hispanik/Latiné. Kami juga memperkenalkan permainan tradisional Loteria kepada pasukan.

- Sertai aktiviti khidmat masyarakat. Pada Hari Martin Luther King Jr., pasukan di Seattle membersihkan kawasan setempat, di Kansas City mereka berjalan santai di alam semula jadi, dan di Chicago bekerjasama dengan 'My Block My Hood My City' untuk menyediakan pakej bantuan warga emas.

- Beri platform untuk individu daripada budaya kurang diwakili berkongsi pengalaman mereka. Tahun ini, dua rakan sekerja dari Unidos ditemu bual mengenai tema "Kemajuan, Kuasa, dan Kemakmuran," berkongsi kisah keluarga serta membincangkan isu seperti mikro-agresi dan penukaran kod bahasa.

Tindak Balas Positif Pekerja

Sambutan daripada komuniti Medix terhadap pengiktirafan budaya dan keagamaan sangat menggalakkan. Penglibatan ini terus membakar semangat kami untuk menyatukan pelbagai komuniti bagi tujuan pembelajaran, jalinan ukhuwah, dan pastinya, keseronokan bersama!

article_content: In June 2021, NASA’s Juno spacecraft captured high-resolution images of Ganymede, Jupiter’s largest moon, during a close flyby with its JunoCam. Analysis of these images has revealed mineral salts and organic compounds on Ganymede’s surface. According to research led by Scott Bolton at the Southwest Research Institute, these substances are most concentrated in regions shielded by the moon’s magnetic field, hinting at traces from a once-deep underground ocean that may have reached the surface. Ganymede is remarkable not only as the solar system’s largest moon—bigger than Mercury and Pluto—but also as the only known moon with its own magnetic field. Scientists have discovered a vast subterranean ocean beneath its frozen shell, likely containing more water than all Earth’s oceans. Past missions, such as NASA’s Galileo and Hubble, have provided evidence for this ocean and for the escape of water vapor from Ganymede’s surface. It’s also believed that some of the moon’s grooves formed after a major collision. The European Space Agency’s JUICE spacecraft, launched in April, is scheduled to orbit Ganymede for nine months starting in late 2034, after flybys of Europa and Callisto. By studying Ganymede in detail, scientists hope to better understand other distant moons and planets. This week, Jupiter and its bright moons are at their closest to Earth—an event known as opposition. With binoculars, observers can spot Ganymede and its sibling moons near Jupiter in the constellation Aries. The next opposition will be on December 7, 2024—happy observing!

Analisis gambar ini telah mendedahkan garam mineral dan sebatian organik di permukaan Ganymede. Menurut kajian yang diketuai oleh Scott Bolton dari Southwest Research Institute, bahan-bahan ini paling banyak ditemui di kawasan yang terlindung oleh medan magnet bulan tersebut, memberi petunjuk kepada sisa dari lautan bawah tanah yang mungkin pernah sampai ke permukaan. Ganymede unik kerana ia bukan sahaja bulan terbesar dalam sistem suria—lebih besar daripada Mercury dan Pluto—tetapi juga satu-satunya bulan yang diketahui mempunyai medan magnet sendiri. Para saintis telah menemui lautan bawah tanah yang luas di bawah lapisan aisnya, mungkin mengandungi lebih banyak air daripada semua lautan di Bumi. Misi terdahulu seperti Galileo dan Hubble milik NASA telah memberi bukti tentang lautan ini serta pelepasan wap air dari permukaan Ganymede. Turut dipercayai bahawa beberapa alur pada permukaan Ganymede terbentuk akibat perlanggaran besar. Kapal angkasa JUICE milik Agensi Angkasa Eropah (ESA), yang dilancarkan pada April, dijadualkan mengorbit Ganymede selama sembilan bulan bermula hujung 2034, selepas melakukan flyby ke atas Europa dan Callisto. Dengan mengkaji Ganymede secara dekat, saintis berharap dapat memahami bulan-bulan dan planet-planet jauh dengan lebih baik. Minggu ini, Jupiter dan bulan-bulannya berada paling hampir dengan Bumi—fenomena yang dipanggil opposition. Dengan menggunakan teropong, anda boleh melihat Ganymede dan bulan-bulan saudaranya berhampiran Jupiter di buruj Aries. Opposition yang seterusnya ialah pada 7 Disember 2024—selamat memerhati bintang!

article_content: State Bank of India (SBI) reported a net profit of Rs 14,430 crore for the quarter ended September 2023, representing an 8% increase over Rs 13,265 crore in the same quarter last year. This rise was mainly due to a significant reduction in provisions for bad loans, indicating improved asset quality. Despite the increase in net profit, SBI’s operating profit was down 8% year-on-year to Rs 19,417 crore, compared to Rs 21,120 crore in the year-ago period. However, net interest income increased by 18% to Rs 39,500 crore. Gross advances jumped 12.4% year-on-year to Rs 33 lakh crore, and deposits climbed 11.9% to Rs 46.9 lakh crore. SBI chairman Dinesh Khara highlighted that asset quality had improved, with the gross non-performing asset (NPA) ratio falling to 2.55% from 3.52% a year earlier, and net NPA dropping to 0.64% from 0.8%. Looking ahead, Khara stated, 'The second half is the busy season. We expect to grow by 13%-14%. Growth is visible across all sectors, including retail, SME, and agriculture. Corporate growth stood at 6.6% due to underutilization of credit limits.' In response to concerns about increasing unsecured loans, Khara clarified that SBI has minimal lending in the small-ticket unsecured loan segment (loans below Rs 50,000) and maintains that the bank’s unsecured loan book is of better quality than its secured book. On the same day, Sun Pharmaceuticals reported a 5% increase in Q2 net profit to Rs 2,375.5 crore, bolstered by an 11.3% revenue rise. Bank of Baroda recorded a 28% surge in net profit to Rs 4,253 crore, also noting improved asset quality and growth in advances and deposits.

Kenaikan ini terutama disebabkan pengurangan ketara dalam peruntukan bagi pinjaman bermasalah, menunjukkan kualiti aset yang bertambah baik. Walaupun keuntungan bersih meningkat, keuntungan operasi SBI turun 8% tahun ke tahun kepada Rs 19,417 crore, berbanding Rs 21,120 crore setahun lalu. Namun, pendapatan faedah bersih meningkat 18% kepada Rs 39,500 crore. Jumlah pinjaman kasar naik 12.4% tahun ke tahun kepada Rs 33 lakh crore, manakala deposit meningkat 11.9% kepada Rs 46.9 lakh crore. Pengerusi SBI, Dinesh Khara, menekankan peningkatan kualiti aset, dengan nisbah aset tidak berprestasi (NPA) kasar turun kepada 2.55% daripada 3.52% setahun lalu, dan NPA bersih turun kepada 0.64% daripada 0.8%. Khara berkata, 'Separuh kedua adalah musim sibuk. Kami jangka pertumbuhan 13%-14%. Pertumbuhan dapat dilihat di semua sektor, termasuk runcit, PKS dan pertanian. Pertumbuhan korporat hanya 6.6% akibat penggunaan had kredit yang rendah.' Menjawab kebimbangan tentang pinjaman tanpa cagaran, Khara menjelaskan bahawa SBI mempunyai pendedahan minimum dalam segmen pinjaman tanpa cagaran kecil (pinjaman di bawah Rs 50,000) dan buku pinjaman tanpa cagaran bank ini berkualiti lebih baik berbanding pinjaman bercagar. Pada hari sama, Sun Pharmaceuticals melaporkan peningkatan 5% dalam keuntungan bersih suku kedua kepada Rs 2,375.5 crore, didorong kenaikan hasil 11.3%. Bank of Baroda pula mencatatkan lonjakan 28% keuntungan bersih kepada Rs 4,253 crore, disamping penambahbaikan kualiti aset serta pertumbuhan pinjaman dan deposit.

Asian shares mostly rose on Tuesday after a Wall Street rally, driven by gains in Microsoft, which announced it is hiring Sam Altman, the former CEO of OpenAI. U.S. futures pointed higher, while oil prices declined. Chinese markets advanced after Caixin reported that regulators have prepared a list of property developers eligible for low-cost financing. This move aims to support the real estate industry, which remains in crisis due to a crackdown on excessive borrowing and an economic slowdown. Hong Kong’s Hang Seng gained 1% to 17,958.33, and the Shanghai Composite climbed 0.5% to 3,082.30.

"Hopes continue to build that China’s persistent and deepening property slump might ease, especially as Beijing steps up stimulus efforts to support the housing sector," said Tan Boon Heng of Mizuho Bank. Tokyo's Nikkei 225 slipped nearly 0.1% to 33,362.07. Australia’s S&P/ASX 200 rose 0.2% to 7,073.30, and South Korea’s Kospi gained 0.9% to 2,512.38.

On Wall Street, the S&P 500 gained 0.7% to 4,547.38, marking its third consecutive week of increases. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.6% to 33,151.04, while the Nasdaq Composite added 1.1% to 14,284.53. Microsoft led the market higher, rising 2.1% after announcing the hiring of Sam Altman for a new project following his dismissal from OpenAI. Microsoft stated it would continue its partnership with OpenAI, as excitement around artificial intelligence and its potential profits energized Wall Street.

Stocks generally drifted higher before taking a stronger upward turn in the afternoon as bond yields fell after a Treasury auction. Lower Treasury yields have boosted stocks in recent weeks. This week brings few major reports, so investors will focus on the Federal Reserve's minutes, jobless claims (released Wednesday due to Thanksgiving), and preliminary U.S. business activity reports on Friday. Nvidia’s upcoming profit report, expected to show earnings per share more than quintupled and revenue near $16.2 billion (up from less than $6 billion a year ago), is highly anticipated. Nvidia, up 2.3% on Monday, is the fifth most valuable U.S. stock with significant AI exposure. Other companies reporting earnings this week include Best Buy, Deere, HP, and Lowe’s.

The 10-year Treasury yield fell to 4.40% from 4.44%, while the 2-year yield slipped to 4.89% from 4.90%. In commodities, U.S. crude dropped 30 cents to $77.53 per barrel, having added $1.79 on Monday. Brent crude, the global benchmark, dropped 28 cents to $82.04 per barrel. In currency trading, the U.S. dollar eased to 147.51 yen from 148.37 yen, and the euro inched up to $1.0961 from $1.0941.

AP Business Writer Stan Choe contributed to this report.
