article_content: NEW DELHI: Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced on Wednesday that India's initiative to reform multilateral development banks (MDBs) has gained strong support from several countries and global agencies, which are taking steps to make MDBs 'bigger, bolder, and more effective.' She emphasized there's significant progress on this agenda after a virtual meeting of G20 leaders. Sitharaman explained that not only agencies such as the World Bank, African Development Bank, and Inter-American Development Bank are moving forward with reforms, but also the US and Germany are working to provide more funding to MDBs. This funding will empower MDBs not only to focus on poverty reduction but also to address broader challenges like helping developing and emerging economies tackle climate change. She also mentioned that the regulatory framework for crypto assets is ready, and it's now up to individual countries to implement these measures. This framework aims to help developing and emerging economies manage the risks associated with crypto assets. According to Sitharaman, these initiatives cover almost 100 member nations of the Financial Stability Board (FSB), beyond just G20 countries. She added that the IMF, FSB, and FATF will work together to establish an effective mechanism for crypto regulation, with more clarity expected during Brazil’s upcoming G20 presidency. Sitharaman noted that before India's G20 presidency, international discussion on crypto assets mainly focused on financial stability. However, India recognized that risks associated with crypto assets vary across economies, with developing countries facing more severe risks. The Finance Minister highlighted India's focus on digital public infrastructure, which was noted by G20 leaders. She revealed that India has signed seven Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) for cross-border acceptance of its Unified Payments Interface (UPI), following the model set with Singapore and the UAE. According to government sources, MoUs have been signed with Antigua & Barbuda, Armenia, Sierra Leone, Suriname, Papua New Guinea, Tanzania, and Trinidad & Tobago. When asked about the Social Impact Fund proposed by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, officials stated that more details will be provided in the coming days.
translated_content: NEW DELHI: Menteri Kewangan Nirmala Sitharaman mengumumkan pada hari Rabu bahawa inisiatif India untuk mereformasi bank pembangunan pelbagai hala (MDB) telah mendapat sokongan kuat daripada beberapa negara dan agensi global, yang sedang mengambil langkah untuk menjadikan MDB 'lebih besar, lebih berani dan lebih berkesan.' Beliau menekankan bahawa terdapat kemajuan signifikan dalam agenda ini selepas mesyuarat maya pemimpin G20. Sitharaman menjelaskan bahawa bukan sahaja agensi-agensi seperti Bank Dunia, Bank Pembangunan Afrika, dan Bank Pembangunan Inter-Amerika yang bergerak ke hadapan dengan reformasi, malah Amerika Syarikat dan Jerman juga berusaha menyediakan dana tambahan kepada MDB. Dana ini akan membolehkan MDB bukan sahaja menumpukan kepada pengurangan kemiskinan tetapi juga menangani cabaran lebih besar seperti membantu negara membangun dan pasaran baru bangkit menghadapi perubahan iklim. Beliau turut menyebut bahawa rangka kerja pengawalseliaan untuk aset kripto sudah sedia, dan kini terpulang kepada negara masing-masing untuk melaksanakan langkah tersebut. Rangka kerja ini bertujuan membantu negara membangun dan pasaran baru bangkit menguruskan risiko yang berkaitan dengan aset kripto. Menurut Sitharaman, inisiatif ini merangkumi hampir 100 negara ahli Lembaga Kestabilan Kewangan (FSB), bukan hanya negara G20 sahaja. Beliau menambah bahawa IMF, FSB dan FATF akan bekerjasama untuk mewujudkan mekanisme pengawalseliaan aset kripto yang berkesan, dengan penjelasan lanjut dijangka semasa presiden G20 Brazil akan datang. Sitharaman juga menyatakan sebelum India menjadi presiden G20, perbincangan global mengenai aset kripto kebanyakannya tertumpu pada kestabilan kewangan. Namun, India mengiktiraf bahawa risiko berkaitan aset kripto berbeza mengikut ekonomi, di mana negara membangun menghadapi risiko yang lebih serius. Menteri Kewangan turut menekankan tumpuan India terhadap infrastruktur awam digital, yang turut diiktiraf oleh pemimpin G20. Beliau memaklumkan India telah menandatangani tujuh Memorandum Persefahaman (MoU) untuk penerimaan rentas sempadan antara Unified Payments Interface (UPI) India, seperti yang dilaksanakan bersama Singapura dan UAE. Menurut sumber kerajaan, MoU telah ditandatangani dengan Antigua & Barbuda, Armenia, Sierra Leone, Suriname, Papua New Guinea, Tanzania, dan Trinidad & Tobago. Ketika ditanya mengenai Dana Impak Sosial yang dicadangkan oleh Perdana Menteri Narendra Modi, pegawai kerajaan berkata penjelasan lebih lanjut akan diberikan dalam beberapa hari akan datang.

article_content: Authorities in the U.S. Virgin Islands have warned people living on St. Croix not to drink tap water after elevated levels of lead and copper were discovered. Officials are investigating the scope and cause of the contamination and have begun flushing water lines to lower toxin concentrations. The issue was first noticed in late September, following resident complaints of discolored water, which led to joint local and federal investigations. The territory’s government is seeking a federal emergency declaration to access more resources for ongoing testing and support efforts. The Department of Health has set up hotlines and is providing tests for lead exposure. While drinking tap water is unsafe, officials say it can still be used for bathing and cleaning.
translated_content: Pihak berkuasa di Kepulauan Virgin Amerika Syarikat telah mengingatkan penduduk St. Croix supaya tidak meminum air paip selepas kadar plumbum dan tembaga yang tinggi ditemui. Pegawai sedang menyiasat sejauh mana dan punca pencemaran ini serta telah memulakan pembilasan paip air untuk mengurangkan toksin. Masalah ini mula dikesan pada akhir September apabila penduduk melaporkan perubahan warna air, mendorong siasatan bersama pihak tempatan dan kerajaan persekutuan. Kerajaan wilayah sedang memohon pengisytiharan kecemasan persekutuan untuk mendapatkan lebih banyak sumber bagi ujian lanjut dan bantuan. Jabatan Kesihatan turut membuka talian hotline dan menyediakan ujian pendedahan plumbum. Walaupun air paip tidak selamat diminum, pegawai mengesahkan ia masih selamat untuk mandi dan membersihkan diri.

article_content: At a recent gathering in Gwalior, former Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Digvijaya Singh criticized the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), claiming the party is now split into three groups locally: the 'Maharaj BJP' led by Jyotiraditya Scindia, the 'Shivraj BJP' led by Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan, and a group of dissatisfied rebels known as the 'angry BJP.' Singh spoke at a Congress campaign office and described the upcoming assembly election as a contest between those who left Congress during the 2020 political turmoil and loyal Congress members. He characterized the race as one between money and manpower, and between so-called traitors and honest individuals. He noted that, compared to 2018—when he and Kamal Nath had little time to prepare—the Congress party is now much better organized. Singh maintained that internal rifts exist within the BJP which were not apparent in prior years. He pointed to growing public dissatisfaction with Chief Minister Chouhan and alleged that the BJP's policies have adversely affected workers. He also warned Congress hopefuls seeking election tickets but not actively participating in party work that they would no longer have his support. Singh expressed doubts about the transparency of Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs), suggesting that EVMs could be manipulated to favor the BJP by increasing their vote count, though he said Congress votes could not be reduced. He argued that only election authorities knew the full details about EVM functioning, raising suspicions about software control. He further noted that many countries, including India’s neighboring nations, no longer use EVMs, and voiced skepticism about their reliability. Assembly elections in Madhya Pradesh will be held in a single phase on November 17, and votes will be counted on December 3, with representatives set to be chosen for 230 assembly seats.
translated_content: Perhimpunan baru-baru ini di Gwalior menyaksikan bekas Ketua Menteri Madhya Pradesh, Digvijaya Singh, mengkritik Parti Bharatiya Janata (BJP) dengan dakwaan bahawa parti itu kini berpecah kepada tiga kumpulan di peringkat negeri: 'Maharaj BJP' diketuai Jyotiraditya Scindia, 'Shivraj BJP' di bawah Ketua Menteri Shivraj Singh Chouhan, dan sekumpulan pemberontak yang dikenali sebagai 'angry BJP'. Singh berucap di pejabat kempen Kongres dan menampilkan pilihan raya kali ini sebagai saingan antara mereka yang meninggalkan Kongres semasa kemelut politik 2020 dengan ahli-ahli yang setia. Beliau menggambarkan persaingan ini sebagai pertembungan antara kuasa wang dan kekuatan rakyat, serta antara individu yang dikatakan pengkhianat dan yang jujur. Beliau menyatakan bahawa jika dibandingkan dengan tahun 2018—di mana beliau dan Kamal Nath hanya sempat membuat persediaan dalam masa singkat—parti Kongres kini jauh lebih bersedia dan teratur. Singh menegaskan wujud perpecahan dalaman dalam BJP yang tidak pernah kelihatan sebelum ini. Katanya lagi, semakin ramai rakyat tidak berpuas hati dengan Ketua Menteri Chouhan dan menuduh polisi BJP telah memudaratkan pekerja. Singh turut memberi amaran kepada ahli Kongres yang mengharapkan tiket pilihan raya tetapi tidak aktif bekerja untuk parti, bahawa mereka tidak akan lagi menerima sokongannya. Beliau melahirkan keraguan terhadap ketelusan Mesin Pengundian Elektronik (EVM) dan mendakwa EVM boleh dimanipulasi untuk menambah undi BJP, walaupun undi Kongres tidak dapat dikurangkan. Hanya pihak berkuasa pilihan raya dikatakan mengetahui sepenuhnya cara EVM berfungsi, menyebabkan timbul syak wasangka mengenai kawalan perisian. Tambah beliau, banyak negara termasuk jiran India tidak lagi menggunakan EVM, justeru menimbulkan keraguan terhadap kebolehpercayaannya. Pilihan raya Dewan Undangan Negeri Madhya Pradesh akan berlangsung dalam satu fasa pada 17 November dan pengiraan undi dijangka pada 3 Disember. Sebanyak 230 kerusi dewan undangan bakal dipilih.

article_content: New data reveal that the UK Home Office has paid almost £15 million in compensation to immigrants unlawfully detained over the last three years. Immigration Minister James Brokenshire confirmed these figures. Sarah Teather, a former coalition minister, brought attention to these payments and criticized the Home Office for detaining individuals for indefinite periods, arguing this treatment is both inhumane and costly for the public. Teather is currently leading a cross-party inquiry on immigration detention and has highlighted evidence from former detainees about the serious psychological impact of being held with no time limit. She noted that the UK is the only country in the EU without a legal cap on how long immigrants can be detained. The compensation paid each year was £4.5 million in 2011-12, £5 million in 2012-13, and £4.8 million in 2013-14. These revelations come as the government faces criticism for renewing Serco’s contract to run Yarl's Wood, a women's detention center widely condemned by human rights groups. Yarl’s Wood has faced allegations of staff misconduct, prolonged detention, and the detention of pregnant women without valid justification. A report from the Centre Forum think tank showed that in 2013, after Greece, the UK detained the highest number of asylum seekers in Europe; more than 30,000 people were detained, with 2,796 still in detention at the end of the year. In one recent court decision, Mustafa Fardous, a Moroccan man, was awarded compensation after a judge found eight of his 22 months in detention were unlawful because officials failed to re-evaluate the necessity of holding him after one year, despite him having made a false asylum claim.

Menteri Imigresen James Brokenshire mengesahkan angka tersebut. Sarah Teather, bekas menteri gabungan, mengetengahkan pembayaran ini dan mengkritik Pejabat Dalam Negeri kerana menahan individu untuk tempoh yang tidak ditetapkan, dengan menyatakan bahawa layanan sebegini tidak berperikemanusiaan dan membebankan rakyat. Teather kini mengetuai satu siasatan rentas parti mengenai penahanan imigresen dan telah menekankan bukti daripada bekas tahanan mengenai kesan psikologi serius akibat ditahan tanpa had masa. Beliau menyatakan bahawa UK adalah satu-satunya negara di EU tanpa had undang-undang bagi tempoh penahanan pendatang. Pampasan yang dibayar setiap tahun ialah £4.5 juta pada 2011-12, £5 juta pada 2012-13, dan £4.8 juta pada 2013-14. Pendedahan ini berlaku ketika kerajaan menerima kecaman kerana memperbaharui kontrak Serco untuk mengurus Yarl's Wood, pusat tahanan wanita yang sering dikritik oleh kumpulan hak asasi manusia. Yarl's Wood telah menghadapi dakwaan salah laku kakitangan, penahanan yang lama, dan penahanan wanita hamil tanpa alasan munasabah. Laporan daripada kumpulan pemikir Centre Forum menunjukkan bahawa pada 2013, selepas Greece, UK menahan jumlah pemohon suaka kedua paling tinggi di Eropah; lebih 30,000 orang ditahan, dan 2,796 masih dalam tahanan pada akhir tahun tersebut. Dalam keputusan mahkamah baru-baru ini, Mustafa Fardous, seorang lelaki Maghribi, diberikan pampasan selepas hakim mendapati lapan daripada 22 bulan penahanannya adalah tidak sah kerana pihak berkuasa gagal menilai semula keperluan penahanannya selepas setahun, walaupun dia membuat permohonan suaka palsu.

article_content: Strategic thinking involves setting clear goals and working toward a long-term vision while preparing for potential challenges or changes along the way. These skills are characteristic of effective leaders. For example, in interviews for leadership roles, you will likely be asked about your ability to strategize and handle complex scenarios. Successful leaders focus on creating long-term plans and strategies for organizational and business achievement. If you aim for career and business growth as a leader, you need to look beyond daily tasks, cultivate a strategic mindset, and ensure your actions align with your overall vision. Strategic thinking is the ability to analyze key factors and variables, set adaptive goals, and plan for potential difficulties. Here are five practical ways to develop your strategic thinking skills: 1. Ask Strategic Questions to Find Opportunities Aspiring leaders should stay curious and ask questions to identify gaps and discover new opportunities. Three crucial questions to consider are: Where are we now? Where do we want to be? How can we get there? 2. Set Challenging Yet Attainable Long-Term Goals When setting goals, whether personally or professionally, balance challenge with achievability. Aim for stretch goals that motivate extra effort, but ensure they are realistic. Using the SMART method (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Realistic, Time-bound) helps set clear and effective targets. 3. Understand Your Industry Learn about your industry, the market on both local and global levels, and your organization’s context. Such knowledge informs your strategy and builds trust with stakeholders. 4. Seek Feedback and Fresh Ideas Develop your strategic thinking by actively seeking input from a broad range of people. External feedback and diverse ideas make your strategies stronger and foster innovation. 5. Start with Small Projects Even if you’re not in a senior role, you can practice strategic thinking by managing smaller projects or leading new initiatives. Apply the key questions mentioned earlier, set meaningful objectives, understand your context, gather feedback, and break your plan into achievable steps. By applying these approaches, you’ll build credibility, strengthen critical thinking and problem-solving skills, and demonstrate strong leadership potential within your organization and beyond.
translated_content: Pemikiran strategik melibatkan penetapan matlamat yang jelas dan bergerak ke arah visi jangka panjang sambil bersedia menghadapi sebarang cabaran atau perubahan yang bakal berlaku. Kemahiran ini merupakan ciri-ciri utama seorang pemimpin yang efektif. Misalnya, ketika temu duga untuk jawatan kepimpinan, anda mungkin akan ditanya tentang keupayaan anda merangka strategi dan mengendalikan situasi yang kompleks. Pemimpin yang berjaya memberi fokus pada rancangan dan strategi jangka panjang demi kejayaan organisasi dan perniagaan. Jika anda mahu berjaya dalam kerjaya dan perniagaan sebagai pemimpin, anda perlu berfikir melangkaui tugasan harian, membentuk minda strategik, dan memastikan tindakan anda seiring dengan visi menyeluruh. Pemikiran strategik ialah keupayaan untuk menganalisis faktor kritikal dan pembolehubah, menetapkan matlamat yang fleksibel, serta merancang untuk menghadapi segala kemungkinan. Berikut adalah lima langkah praktikal untuk meningkatkan kemahiran pemikiran strategik anda: 1. Tanyakan Soalan Strategik untuk Mengesan Peluang Sebagai pemimpin yang bercita-cita, anda perlu sentiasa rasa ingin tahu dan bertanya soalan untuk mengenalpasti jurang serta mencari peluang baharu. Antara tiga soalan penting yang perlu difikirkan: Di mana kita sekarang? Ke mana kita ingin pergi? Bagaimana kita hendak sampai ke sana? 2. Tetapkan Matlamat Jangka Panjang yang Mencabar tetapi Realistik Dalam menetapkan matlamat, sama ada peribadi atau profesional, pastikan ada keseimbangan antara cabaran dan kemampuan untuk mencapainya. Sasarkan matlamat yang mencabar untuk meningkatkan usaha, namun masih realistik. Kaedah SMART (Spesifik, Boleh Diukur, Boleh Dicapai, Realistik, Tempoh Masa) membantu anda menetapkan sasaran yang jelas dan berkesan. 3. Fahami Industri Anda Kenali industri anda, pasaran tempatan dan global, serta konteks organisasi anda. Pengetahuan ini amat penting untuk membantu merangka strategi dan membina kepercayaan bersama pihak berkepentingan. 4. Dapatkan Maklum Balas & Idea Baharu Bina pemikiran strategik dengan mendapatkan pandangan daripada pelbagai individu. Maklum balas luar dan idea berbeza memperkukuh strategi anda serta menggalakkan inovasi. 5. Mulakan dengan Projek Kecil Walaupun bukan berada di posisi kanan, anda masih boleh latih pemikiran strategik dengan mengurus projek kecil atau menerajui inisiatif baharu. Guna soalan asas tadi, tetapkan objektif bermakna, fahami persekitaran anda, kumpul maklum balas serta rendahkan perancangan kepada langkah kecil yang boleh dicapai. Dengan mengamalkan langkah-langkah ini, anda dapat membina kredibiliti, meningkatkan kemahiran penyelesaian masalah dan pemikiran kritikal, serta menyerlahkan potensi kepimpinan dalam organisasi mahupun masa depan kerjaya anda.

article_content: Earth system science researchers have developed a comprehensive global picture of how people allocate their daily time, especially emphasizing how little of it is spent on environmentally intensive actions. Using diverse data sources—such as time-use surveys, economic indicators, education records, and data from wearable technology—they charted an average 'Global Human Day.' On a typical day, an individual spends about nine hours sleeping and one and a half hours on health and biological needs. Nearly seven hours go to leisure, socializing, entertainment, eating, exercise, gaming, or religious activities. Education and research take up one hour, while another hour is set aside for managing societal affairs like governance, law, finance, and administration; commuting or travel adds another hour. Once these activities are accounted for, people spend just over three hours per day directly altering their environment, mostly by maintaining food systems and cleaning living areas. Remarkably, only about 45 minutes daily are spent on the most ecologically impactful actions such as resource extraction, manufacturing, and construction. Within this period, resource and energy extraction (including fossil fuels) occupies only six minutes, and construction and manufacturing roughly 39 minutes. Just one minute a day is given to dealing with waste. Although these activities account for the consumption of approximately 70 metric gigatons of material every year, their share of the daily schedule is minimal—demonstrating both the productivity and the substantial environmental impact of modern industry. The researchers argue that, because these activities make up such a small segment of each person's day, large-scale changes like switching to renewable energy systems are plausible if strong policy and economic incentives are created. They view this limited time usage as an opportunity to push for major sustainability shifts.
translated_content: Penyelidik sains sistem bumi telah membangunkan gambaran global menyeluruh tentang bagaimana manusia membahagikan masa seharian mereka, dan menekankan betapa sedikit masa diambil untuk aktiviti yang memberi impak besar kepada alam sekitar. Dengan menggunakan pelbagai sumber data—termasuk tinjauan penggunaan masa, indikator ekonomi, rekod pendidikan, dan data daripada peranti boleh pakai—mereka memetakan 'Hari Manusia Global' purata. Pada hari biasa, seseorang menghabiskan kira-kira sembilan jam tidur dan satu setengah jam untuk keperluan kesihatan serta biologi. Hampir tujuh jam diisi dengan bersantai, bersosial, media hiburan, makan, bersenam, bermain permainan, atau aktiviti keagamaan. Pendidikan dan penyelidikan mengambil masa sekitar satu jam, begitu juga semua urusan masyarakat seperti tadbir urus, undang-undang, kewangan, dan pentadbiran; satu jam lagi untuk perjalanan atau ulang-alik. Baki masa—sedikit lebih tiga jam sehari—digunakan manusia untuk mengubah persekitaran secara langsung, kebanyakannya menumpukan kepada sistem makanan dan pembersihan kawasan kediaman. Apa yang menarik, hanya sekitar 45 minit sehari dihabiskan untuk aktiviti berimpak ekologi terbesar seperti pengekstrakan sumber, pembuatan, dan pembinaan. Daripada waktu ini, pengekstrakan sumber dan tenaga (termasuk bahan api fosil) hanya mengambil masa enam minit, manakala pembinaan dan pembuatan sekitar 39 minit. Pengurusan sisa pula sekadar satu minit sehari. Walaupun aktiviti tersebut meliputi penggunaan sekitar 70 gigaton metrik bahan setahun, bahagiannya dalam rutin harian adalah kecil—menunjukkan keberkesanan dan kesan besar industri moden terhadap alam sekitar. Para penyelidik merumuskan, kerana aktiviti intensif ini hanya sebahagian kecil hari manusia, perubahan seperti peralihan ke tenaga boleh diperbaharui sangat munasabah jika wujud insentif dasar dan ekonomi yang kukuh. Mereka melihat corak penggunaan masa ini sebagai peluang mendorong transformasi mampan berskala besar.

article_content: For many years, people with chronic illnesses such as cancer, diabetes, or heart disease encountered serious obstacles in securing health insurance. Insurers regularly denied coverage to those with pre-existing conditions, terminated policies when treatment costs mounted, or raised premiums to unaffordable rates. As a result, many patients had to skip necessary treatments, reduce their care, or accrue significant debt just to access essential medical services. Health reforms enacted in 2010 started to change things. These laws introduced vital protections: preventing denial of coverage for pre-existing conditions, removing dollar limits on benefits, and prohibiting premium increases for those needing care most. These protections rely on having most Americans enrolled in health insurance, ensuring both the healthy and the sick are included to spread out costs and keep premiums more manageable, particularly for those with greater medical needs. However, the 'individual mandate'—requiring most people to have insurance—faces constitutional challenges, with federal courts divided and the Supreme Court preparing to consider the case. Organizations representing millions with serious diseases argue that the mandate is key to safeguarding patient protections. Evidence shows that removing such a requirement results in healthy people delaying the purchase of insurance until they are ill, causing premiums to rise and making coverage less affordable for everyone. Some states that tried providing protections without requiring insurance participation experienced sharp cost increases, leading Kentucky and New Hampshire to repeal their protections. Close to half of non-elderly Americans have a pre-existing condition, underlining the importance of these measures. The hope is that the Supreme Court will support continued access to comprehensive, affordable health insurance for all Americans. These views are those of Nancy Brown, Larry Hausner, and John Seffrin.
translated_content: Selama bertahun-tahun, individu yang menghadapi penyakit kronik seperti kanser, diabetes, atau penyakit jantung mengalami kesukaran besar mendapatkan insurans kesihatan. Syarikat insurans sering menolak permohonan mereka yang mempunyai penyakit sedia ada, membatalkan polisi apabila kos rawatan meningkat, atau menaikkan premium sehingga mereka tidak mampu membayar. Akibatnya, ramai pesakit terpaksa melangkau rawatan penting, mengurangkan penjagaan, atau menanggung hutang besar demi mendapatkan rawatan perubatan yang diperlukan. Reformasi kesihatan yang diperkenalkan pada tahun 2010 mula mengubah keadaan ini. Undang-undang ini memperkenalkan perlindungan utama: menghalang penolakan perlindungan bagi penyakit sedia ada, menghapuskan had manfaat tahunan atau seumur hidup, dan melarang kenaikan premium terhadap mereka yang memerlukan rawatan. Perlindungan ini bergantung kepada kebanyakan rakyat Amerika mendaftar insurans kesihatan, supaya orang sihat dan sakit sama-sama berkongsi risiko, lalu memastikan premium kekal mampu milik, terutama untuk mereka yang memerlukan rawatan lebih intensif. 'Mandat individu'—yang mewajibkan kebanyakan orang memiliki insurans—kini dipersoalkan dari segi perlembagaan, dengan mahkamah persekutuan berbelah bahagi dan Mahkamah Agung akan mengkaji isu ini. Organisasi yang mewakili berjuta-juta pesakit penyakit serius menyatakan bahawa mandat ini penting untuk mengekalkan perlindungan pesakit. Bukti menunjukkan tanpa keperluan tersebut, ramai orang sihat menangguhkan pembelian insurans sehingga mereka jatuh sakit, menyebabkan premium meningkat dan perlindungan menjadi mahal bagi semua. Negeri-negeri yang cuba melaksanakan perlindungan tanpa keperluan penyertaan insurans mendapati kos meningkat mendadak, hingga Kentucky dan New Hampshire terpaksa membatalkan perlindungan tersebut. Hampir separuh rakyat Amerika bukan warga emas mempunyai penyakit sedia ada, membuktikan kepentingan perlindungan sedemikian. Harapannya adalah Mahkamah Agung akan memastikan akses berterusan kepada insurans kesihatan yang mampu milik dan menyeluruh untuk semua rakyat Amerika. Pandangan ini disuarakan oleh Nancy Brown, Larry Hausner, dan John Seffrin.

President Droupadi Murmu is scheduled to visit Odisha and Andhra Pradesh from November 20 to 22, according to an official statement from Rashtrapati Bhavan. During her trip, she will participate in a range of programs. On November 20, she will attend the inaugural session of the 36th Annual Conference and Literary Festival of the All India Santali Writers' Association in Baripada, as well as inaugurate an Eklavya Model Residential School in Kuliana.

Born into a Santhali tribal family in Uparbeda village, Mayurbhanj, Odisha, President Murmu's visit carries personal significance. On November 21, she is set to inaugurate a skill training centre at Pahadpur village. Later, she will visit Badampahar railway station to flag off three new train services—Badampahar-Tatanagar MEMU, Badampahar-Rourkela Weekly Express, and Badampahar-Shalimar Weekly Express. She will also inaugurate the new Rairangpur postal division, release a commemorative cover, and lay the foundation stone for redevelopment of Badampahar railway station. President Murmu will then travel to Rairangpur on the Badampahar-Shalimar Express.

Prior to her presidency, Murmu taught at the Sri Aurobindo Integral Education Centre in Rairangpur (1994–1997) and served as a Member of the Legislative Assembly for Rairangpur from 2000 to 2009. On November 21, she will attend the 15th annual convocation of Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology in Burla.

On November 22, the president will launch the National Education Campaign—New Education for New India, organized by the Brahma Kumaris in Sambalpur. She will also visit Puttaparthi to attend the 42nd convocation of the Sri Sathya Sai Institute of Higher Learning.

The UK is set to experience an unseasonably cold and wintry Bank Holiday weekend, a stark contrast to last year’s warm May celebrations. Forecasters predict bitter winds, sub-zero temperatures, and even snow for parts of the country, with unsettled weather possibly lasting until June.

During last year’s May Bank Holiday, temperatures reached up to 25°C (77°F), drawing crowds to beaches and parks. This year, however, outdoor activities are unlikely as temperatures have fallen to as low as -4°C in Scotland overnight. Much of the UK is expected to have below-average temperatures through Monday.

Bournemouth Beach in Dorset, usually busy with holidaymakers, remained mostly deserted with chilly 6-8°C weather—up to 10°C below seasonal norms. Local tourism and businesses report quiet conditions, with visitors wearing coats, hats, and scarves.

Meteorologists say this could be the coldest start to May in over 70 years, citing early morning lows of -7.4°C at Cairngorm (Highland), -6.2°C at Saughall (Ayrshire), and -4.4°C at Shap (Cumbria), with several May temperature records broken. Southern regions are overcast, while the north faces wintry showers and sleet.

Weekend forecast highlights:
- Saturday: Patchy rain in the south and southeast clearing by afternoon. Sunny spells and scattered showers elsewhere. Highs of 12°C (54°F).
- Sunday: Bright, chilly, with some showers. Cloudier in the southeast. Highs of 12°C (54°F).
- Monday: Slightly milder, rain moving in from the west. Highs of 13°C (55°F).

The Met Office’s long-range forecast warns of continued unsettled weather through mid-May, with rain, risk of snow on higher ground in the north, and possible gales. Temperatures will stay below average with a risk of frost overnight. Later in May, rain and cloud are expected to be above average while mean temperatures may remain below normal.

These bleak conditions follow weeks of heavy rain and flooding, with April being the wettest on record. The Environment Agency continues to advise the public to avoid swollen rivers and not to walk or drive through floodwaters, as river levels and defenses are being closely monitored.

Tourism and businesses anticipate lower visitor numbers and reduced spending, with Bournemouth expecting a potential drop of £1 million compared to a typical Bank Holiday. The AA reports fewer people will travel, instead staying home for indoor activities.

Gardeners are advised to protect vulnerable plants from frost using horticultural fleece. Wildlife has suffered as well, with the RSPB noting nest losses due to recent flooding in several regions.

Forecasters expect daytime temperatures to remain below 12°C for the next two days, with colder conditions in the North East. Monday may bring slight improvement, but rain and heavy showers are expected in the South West. There are currently nine flood warnings and 51 flood alerts across the country.

Pakar cuaca anggap ini mungkin permulaan Mei paling sejuk lebih 70 tahun — rekod pagi seperti -7.4°C di Cairngorm (Highland), -6.2°C di Saughall (Ayrshire), dan -4.4°C di Shap (Cumbria) dicatatkan. Cuaca suram ini susulan beberapa minggu hujan lebat dan banjir — April ini paling basah dalam rekod. Agensi Alam Sekitar nasihat awam jauhi sungai yang deras dan jangan lintas air banjir kerana paras sungai & pertahanan masih dipantau.

Sektor pelancongan dan perniagaan jangka kunjungan dan pendapatan jatuh — Bournemouth mungkin rugi sekitar £1 juta berbanding hujung minggu biasa. AA ramal ramai orang pilih duduk rumah dan buat aktiviti dalam rumah.

Pencinta kebun kena lindungi pokok sensitif dengan kain penebat. Hidupan liar turut terkesan—RSPB kata banyak sarang musnah akibat banjir di beberapa kawasan.

Pakar cuaca jangka suhu siang tak lebih 12°C untuk dua hari lagi dan kawasan Timur Laut lebih sejuk. Isnin mungkin sedikit baik, tapi hujan lebat diramal di Barat Daya. Terkini, ada 9 amaran banjir dan 51 amaran berjaga-jaga di seluruh negara.

article_content: Montana legislators considered on Wednesday whether to adopt an anti-bullying law, which would make Montana the last state in the U.S. to do so. The bill, introduced by Representative Kimberly Dudik, a Democrat from Missoula, was presented to the Montana House Education Committee. It defines bullying, prohibits it in public schools, and requires school districts to develop their own anti-bullying policies. Pilar Petroski, a seventh-grader from Helena, and her father, Andrew, spoke in favor. Pilar, 12, expressed frustration with how school officials handled her reports of death threats and harassment, both in person and online. 'The school needs to know exactly what bullying is, because to them, I'm just a student being teased,' she said. 'I want others to recognize how serious this issue is.' In a previous 2014 interview, Pilar and her mother shared that severe bullying led them to remove her from CR Anderson Middle School in Helena. 'At first, I thought it wasn't a big deal and it would stop, so I didn't say much. But it got more serious over time,' she told KPAX. Her mother said they sought an order of protection after threats to Pilar's safety. No one testified against the bill at the hearing, but some lawmakers questioned the need for it because a recent state regulation already addresses bullying. The new bill would specifically define bullying as repeated harassment, hazing, or threats, online or in person. As a law, it could hold schools legally accountable if they don't comply, Dudik said. If approved, Montana would become the final state to pass an anti-bullying law. Violations of the current 2013 rule only impact school accreditation ratings. Most other states enacted such laws by 2010, with Hawaii, Michigan, and South Dakota being the most recent before Montana. Julie Hertzog, director of PACER's National Bullying Prevention Center, noted that most states set definitions and procedures for bullying in the mid-2000s and update their laws regularly to include issues like cyberbullying. She said these laws help create safe and consistent environments for students. Anti-bullying bills have been considered in almost every Montana legislative session since 2003, except for 2009. In 2013, Representative Jean Price introduced a similar bill but withdrew it after advice from Superintendent Denise Juneau, who was putting new rules in place. Republican lawmakers have often opposed anti-bullying laws, emphasizing local control. Previous bills mostly failed along party lines. Steve Meloy of the Montana School Boards Association warned against overriding local decisions with state law. Although he prepared to oppose the new bill, he became a neutral witness after hearing testimonies. Rep. Jeff Essmann, a Republican from Billings, questioned whether legislation alone could change school culture. Dudik argued that the law would send a message and help deter bullying. The committee took no action on the bill immediately, and Dudik is unsure if there is enough support for it to pass.
translated_content: Pada hari Rabu, penggubal undang-undang Montana mempertimbangkan sama ada untuk meluluskan undang-undang anti-buli, yang akan menjadikan Montana sebagai negeri terakhir di Amerika Syarikat yang berbuat demikian. Rang undang-undang ini, diperkenalkan oleh Wakil Kimberly Dudik, seorang Demokrat dari Missoula, dibentangkan kepada Jawatankuasa Pendidikan Dewan Montana. Ia mentakrifkan buli, melarangnya di sekolah awam, dan mengkehendaki setiap daerah sekolah membentuk dasar anti-buli mereka sendiri. Pilar Petroski, pelajar tingkatan tujuh dari Helena, bersama bapanya, Andrew, memberikan sokongan kepada rang undang-undang tersebut. Pilar, 12 tahun, meluahkan kekecewaan terhadap pegawai sekolah yang tidak mengambil serius aduannya mengenai ancaman bunuh dan gangguan yang dialaminya, sama ada secara bersemuka ataupun dalam talian. 'Sekolah perlu tahu apa itu buli dengan jelas, sebab bagi mereka saya cuma pelajar yang diejek,' katanya. 'Saya mahu orang lain sedar betapa seriusnya isu ini.' Dalam temubual pada tahun 2014, Pilar dan ibunya menceritakan buli serius yang memaksa mereka menarik Pilar keluar dari Sekolah Menengah CR Anderson di Helena. 'Pada mulanya saya fikir ia bukan isu besar dan akan berhenti, jadi saya tidak beritahu sesiapa. Tapi lama-kelamaan ia menjadi semakin serius,' beritahu Pilar kepada KPAX. Ibunya berkata mereka mendapatkan perintah perlindungan selepas Pilar menerima ugutan keselamatan. Tiada sesiapa yang membantah rang undang-undang itu dalam pendengaran, namun beberapa penggubal undang-undang mempersoalkan keperluannya memandangkan peraturan negeri yang baru juga menangani isu buli. Rang undang-undang baharu ini mentakrifkan buli sebagai gangguan berulang, hazing, atau ugutan sama ada secara dalam talian atau bersemuka. Jika menjadi undang-undang, ia boleh memegang sekolah secara undang-undang sekiranya mereka tidak mematuhi, menurut Dudik. Jika diluluskan, Montana akan menjadi negeri terakhir yang menggubal undang-undang anti-buli. Pelanggaran peraturan 2013 yang sedia ada hanya menjejaskan penarafan akreditasi sekolah. Kebanyakan negeri lain telah menggubal undang-undang ini menjelang 2010, dengan Hawaii, Michigan, dan South Dakota antara yang terakhir sebelum Montana. Julie Hertzog, Pengarah Pusat Pencegahan Buli Kebangsaan PACER, menyatakan kebanyakan negeri telah menetapkan definisi dan prosedur buli sejak pertengahan 2000-an dan terus memperbaharui undang-undang mereka termasuk isu buli siber. Beliau berkata undang-undang ini membantu mewujudkan persekitaran pembelajaran yang selamat dan konsisten. Rang undang-undang anti-buli telah dibentangkan dalam hampir setiap sesi badan perundangan Montana sejak 2003 kecuali tahun 2009. Pada 2013, Wakil Jean Price memperkenalkan rang undang-undang serupa tetapi menarik balik selepas mendapat nasihat daripada Penguasa Pendidikan Negeri, Denise Juneau, yang pada masa itu sedang melaksanakan peraturan baru. Ahli legislatif Parti Republikan sering membantah undang-undang anti-buli kerana menegaskan aspek kawalan tempatan. Kebanyakan rang undang-undang terdahulu gagal kerana undian mengikut parti. Steve Meloy dari Montana School Boards Association memberi amaran mengenai penggubalan undang-undang negeri yang boleh mengatasi keputusan tempatan. Walaupun pada awalnya bersedia untuk membantah, beliau bertindak sebagai saksi neutral selepas mendengar testimoni. Rep. Jeff Essmann, Republikan dari Billings, mempersoalkan sama ada undang-undang sahaja mampu mengubah budaya sekolah. Dudik berpendapat undang-undang itu akan memberi mesej yang jelas dan membantu mencegah buli. Jawatankuasa tidak mengambil tindakan segera ke atas rang undang-undang itu, dan Dudik tidak pasti sama ada ia mendapat sokongan yang mencukupi untuk diluluskan.

Caroline Molyneux, a science teacher at Sharples High School in Bolton, has pioneered an engaging approach to teaching by organizing informal study sessions at McDonald’s. On weekends, her students review past exam papers together while enjoying food in a comfortable setting, which has proven highly popular. This innovative technique has earned her a spot as one of three finalists nationwide for the 2014 School Biology Teacher of the Year Award from the Society of Biology.

Caroline’s teaching extends beyond biology to chemistry and astronomy, enriched by her previous experience as a researcher at the University of Molecular Microbiology. She also leads educational initiatives with the National Space Agency. Both students and colleagues commend her enthusiasm and creative strategies. Caroline views teaching as a vocation, embracing it with a mission to make science enjoyable and accessible. Dr. Mark Downs, leader of the Society of Biology, praised exceptional teachers like Caroline for their positive influence on students’ education and aspirations.

Setiap hujung minggu, pelajarnya mengulangkaji kertas peperiksaan lepas sambil menikmati makanan kegemaran mereka dalam suasana yang selesa—dan pendekatan ini mendapat sambutan yang sangat baik. Mercedes Sosa, the celebrated Argentine singer often referred to as 'the voice of Latin America,' passed away on Sunday at the age of 74, according to an announcement on her official website. She died in a clinic in Buenos Aires after reportedly suffering from several ailments, including liver, kidney, and heart conditions, as reported by the Washington Post.

Born on July 9, 1935, in San Miguel de Tucumán, Argentina, Sosa released 40 albums during her career and performed at iconic venues such as the Sistine Chapel at the Vatican and New York's Carnegie Hall. She also served as a UNICEF goodwill ambassador for Latin America.

Sosa’s music carried a powerful message of social engagement and was rooted in folk traditions. She was a pivotal figure in the New Song movement, which blended folklore with modern music and political themes. After a military junta took power in Argentina in 1976, many of her albums were banned, and she went into exile in Paris and Madrid, returning to Argentina in 1982.

Throughout her career, Sosa earned several Latin Grammy awards, with her most recent nomination coming last year for her album 'Cantora 1.' Her rendition of 'Gracias a la Vida' remains one of her most beloved performances. According to her website, Sosa’s undeniable talent, honesty, and convictions left a significant legacy for future generations, and she is recognized worldwide as a symbol of Latin American cultural heritage.

Sosa's son, Fabian Matus, shared that she lived her 74 years to the fullest, overcoming barriers and fears. A public viewing was scheduled for Sunday afternoon at the Salon de los Pasos Perdidos in the Congress of the Nation in Buenos Aires. CNN en Español's Javier Doberti contributed to this report.

Beliau menghembuskan nafas terakhir di sebuah klinik di Buenos Aires selepas dilaporkan menghidap beberapa penyakit, termasuk masalah hati, buah pinggang, dan jantung, seperti yang dilaporkan oleh Washington Post.

Dilahirkan pada 9 Julai 1935 di San Miguel de Tucumán, Argentina, Sosa menghasilkan 40 album sepanjang kerjayanya dan pernah membuat persembahan di lokasi ikonik seperti Sistine Chapel di Vatican dan Carnegie Hall di New York. Beliau juga pernah berkhidmat sebagai duta muhibah UNICEF untuk Amerika Latin.

Muzik Sosa menyampaikan mesej keterlibatan sosial yang mendalam dan berakar umbi dalam tradisi muzik rakyat. Beliau adalah tokoh utama dalam gerakan New Song, yang menggabungkan muzik rakyat dengan unsur moden dan tema politik. Selepas junta tentera mengambil alih Argentina pada tahun 1976, banyak albumnya diharamkan dan beliau hidup dalam buangan di Paris dan Madrid, sebelum pulang ke Argentina pada tahun 1982.

Sepanjang kerjayanya, Sosa menerima beberapa anugerah Latin Grammy, dengan pencalonan terbarunya tahun lalu untuk albumnya 'Cantora 1.' Nyanyian beliau 'Gracias a la Vida' kekal sebagai salah satu persembahan yang paling diminati. Menurut laman web rasminya, bakat Sosa yang luar biasa, kejujuran, dan prinsip teguhnya meninggalkan legasi bermakna untuk generasi masa depan, dan beliau diiktiraf di seluruh dunia sebagai simbol warisan budaya Amerika Latin.

Anak Sosa, Fabian Matus, berkongsi bahawa ibunya menjalani hidup selama 74 tahun dengan sepenuhnya, mengatasi segala halangan dan ketakutan. Satu upacara penghormatan awam dijadualkan pada petang Ahad di Salon de los Pasos Perdidos di Kongres Negara di Buenos Aires. Javier Doberti dari CNN en Español turut menyumbang kepada laporan ini.

article_content: Chris Allen, a gardener from Ashbourne, Derbyshire, discovered a valuable stash of Georgian silverware while cleaning up rubbish near his allotment. The silver was hidden in a plastic bag that broke open, revealing high-quality pieces estimated to be worth hundreds of pounds. The hoard included a 48-piece dinner service with dessert spoons, dessert forks, table forks, serving spoons, grape scissors, a mustard spoon, a pearl-handled button hook, and a solid silver shoehorn. After turning the collection in to the police in March and attempting to find its owner through various channels, the silver remained unclaimed. Allen then chose to auction the items, with Fiddler and Taylor auctioneers waiving their commission due to his honesty. The auction raised £530, but with additional donations, the total amount reached £800. Chris and his wife Noreen split the proceeds evenly between the Derbyshire Air Ambulance and the Aberdyfi Lifeboat Station in Wales, where they frequently holiday. Dave Williams, operations manager at Aberdyfi Lifeboat Station, thanked the Allens for their generous donation resulting from this unusual find.
translated_content: Chris Allen, seorang tukang kebun dari Ashbourne, Derbyshire, telah menemui timbunan perak Georgia yang berharga ketika membersihkan sampah di kebunnya. Perak tersebut tersembunyi dalam sebuah beg plastik yang pecah, memperlihatkan koleksi berkualiti tinggi yang dianggarkan bernilai ratusan paun. Selepas menyerahkan koleksi itu kepada polis pada bulan Mac dan berusaha mencari pemiliknya melalui pelbagai saluran, perak itu masih tidak dituntut. Allen kemudian memutuskan untuk melelong barangan tersebut, dan pihak lelong Fiddler and Taylor tidak mengambil sebarang komisen kerana kejujurannya. Hasil lelongan berjaya mengutip £530, tetapi dengan sumbangan tambahan, jumlah keseluruhan mencecah £800. Chris dan isterinya, Noreen, membahagikan hasil itu secara sama rata kepada Derbyshire Air Ambulance dan Aberdyfi Lifeboat Station di Wales, tempat mereka sering bercuti. Dave Williams, pengurus operasi di Aberdyfi Lifeboat Station, mengucapkan terima kasih kepada pasangan Allen atas sumbangan yang pemurah hasil penemuan yang luar biasa ini.

article_content: Hotels and resorts are unveiling spectacular holiday celebrations to attract travelers seeking memorable experiences. AAA Travel reports that over 112 million Americans traveled last Christmas, with expectations that this number could rise this year. December 1 remains a popular date for departures, thanks to airline discounts for those planning long holiday breaks. Spanning sunny coastlines to snowy retreats, select destinations are offering holiday experiences filled with unique festivities. In San Diego, Hotel del Coronado transforms with winter fun like Skating by the Sea, festive lounges, a new dynamic light show, beachside igloos, gingerbread workshops, elf visits, and the crowd-favorite Skydiving Santa during the Holiday Festival on December 6. article_content: Elite athletes are known for their unique—and sometimes extreme—diets tailored to meet the demands of intense training. Michael Phelps once claimed he consumed up to 12,000 calories daily, though he later clarified this number was exaggerated. Yohan Blake reportedly eats 16 bananas each day for potassium, while British weightlifter Jake Oliver starts his day with a shake containing colostrum, a nutrient-rich milk. Former Olympic marathon champion Naoko Takahashi could eat up to two kilograms of fish following a major session. Inside the Olympic Village, the dining hall provides both opportunity and temptation, offering a wide array of international dishes ranging from healthy choices to fast food such as unlimited McDonald's. The 5,000-seat, 24-hour facility was expected to serve around 1.2 million meals during London 2012, which included 25,000 loaves of bread, 232 tons of potatoes, 75,000 liters of milk, and over 330 tons of fruit and vegetables. Jess Corones, a sports scientist with the Australian Olympic swim team, notes that many athletes—especially younger ones—are excited by the sheer variety and abundance. However, she underscores the importance of maintaining discipline, following established nutrition routines, and avoiding overindulgence before competing. Despite stories of extraordinary eating, most athletes follow balanced nutrition plans. Proper vitamin intake, especially vitamin D for bone and muscle health, is essential rather than excessive amounts. British dietitian Becky Stevenson highlights that while vitamin D prevents deficiencies and certain injuries, excess levels have not been proven to enhance performance. Athletes in northern regions face a higher risk of deficiency due to limited sunlight exposure. Many athletes use supplements—from standard vitamins to advanced sports nutrition products like whey protein and BCAAs—but are cautioned to be vigilant, as they bear full responsibility for what they consume. With strict drug testing and an expanding list of banned substances, even trusted coaches cannot assume liability for supplement safety. Corones reinforces that teaching athletes to move beyond early habits of choosing convenient processed foods is crucial. Replacing salty and sugary snacks with healthier, minimally-processed options is key to supporting performance and reducing injury. Making informed nutritional choices is an essential part of reaching elite levels in sport.
translated_content: Atlet elit dikenali dengan diet mereka yang unik—dan kadang kala ekstrem—bagi memenuhi tuntutan latihan yang intensif. Michael Phelps pernah mendakwa beliau mengambil sehingga 12,000 kalori sehari, walaupun kemudian beliau menjelaskan angkanya agak keterlaluan. Yohan Blake dilaporkan makan 16 biji pisang setiap hari untuk potasium, manakala atlet angkat berat Britain, Jake Oliver, memulakan pagi dengan minuman shake yang mengandungi kolostrum, iaitu susu kaya nutrisi. Bekas juara maraton Olimpik, Naoko Takahashi, mampu makan sehingga dua kilogram ikan selepas sesi latihan utama. Di dalam Perkampungan Olimpik, dewan makan menawarkan peluang dan juga godaan, dengan pelbagai hidangan antarabangsa—daripada pilihan sihat hinggalah makanan segera seperti McDonald's tanpa had. Kemudahan 24 jam berkapasiti 5,000 orang ini dijangka menyajikan sekitar 1.2 juta hidangan sepanjang London 2012, termasuk 25,000 buku roti, 232 tan kentang, 75,000 liter susu, dan lebih 330 tan buah-buahan serta sayur-sayuran. Jess Corones, saintis sukan pasukan renang Olimpik Australia, menyatakan ramai atlet—terutama yang muda—teruja dengan pelbagai pilihan dan kelimpahan makanan. Namun, beliau menekankan pentingnya disiplin, mengekalkan rutin pemakanan, dan mengelakkan makan berlebihan sebelum bertanding. Walaupun terdapat kisah gaya makan luar biasa, kebanyakan atlet mengamalkan pemakanan seimbang. Pengambilan vitamin mencukupi—khususnya vitamin D untuk tulang dan otot—adalah penting, dan tidak perlu berlebihan. Pakar diet Britain, Becky Stevenson, menegaskan vitamin D mencegah kekurangan dan sesetengah kecederaan, namun tiada bukti lebihan vitamin D meningkatkan prestasi. Atlet di negara beriklim utara lebih terdedah kepada kekurangan vitamin D kerana cahaya matahari yang terhad. Ramai atlet mengambil suplemen—dari vitamin biasa ke produk nutrisi seperti whey protein dan BCAA—tetapi mereka diingatkan tentang tanggungjawab sepenuhnya atas segala yang diambil. Dengan pengujian dadah yang ketat serta senarai bahan terlarang yang semakin panjang, walaupun jurulatih dipercayai, keselamatan suplemen masih menjadi tanggungjawab atlet. Corones turut menekankan pendidikan atlet untuk mengubah tabiat lama yang cenderung kepada makanan proses mudah. Proses menggantikan snek tinggi garam dan gula dengan pilihan lebih sihat amat penting untuk prestasi dan pencegahan kecederaan. Membuat keputusan nutrisi bijak sangat penting untuk menjadi atlet elit.

article_content: AC Milan are set for a place in the Champions League quarterfinals after a commanding 4-0 victory over Arsenal at San Siro on Wednesday. Brazilian forward Robinho scored twice as the Serie A champions controlled the first leg of their last-16 clash against the north London side. Kevin Prince Boateng opened the scoring in the 15th minute with a superb half-volley, expertly bringing down a chipped pass from Alberto Nocerino before firing in off the underside of the bar, giving goalkeeper Wojciech Szczesny no chance. Robinho made it 2-0 seven minutes before halftime, heading in a cut-back from Zlatan Ibrahimovic. Despite the introduction of Thierry Henry in the second half—his last appearance for Arsenal before returning to the New York Red Bulls—the situation deteriorated further for the visitors. In the 49th minute, Ibrahimovic and Robinho combined at the edge of Arsenal’s penalty area, and a slip from Thomas Vermaelen gifted Robinho a clear opportunity to finish past Szczesny. Arsenal’s Robin van Persie forced a good save from Milan goalkeeper Christian Abbiati in the 65th minute, but chances for the Gunners were rare on a disappointing night for Arsene Wenger’s team. Ibrahimovic completed the rout 12 minutes from time, converting from the penalty spot after being brought down by Johan Djourou. Arsene Wenger admitted the extent of his side’s struggles, telling AFP: “We were never in the game; we were very poor both offensively and defensively. It was shocking to see how we were beaten everywhere—it was the worst performance in Europe by far. There was not one moment during the 90 minutes when we were really in the game.” The return leg at the Emirates Stadium is scheduled for March 6. In Wednesday’s other Champions League match, Russian champions Zenit St Petersburg came from behind to beat Portugal’s Benfica 3-2 in the first leg of their last-16 tie. Roman Shirokov scored twice and substitute Sergei Semak added another for Zenit. Benfica’s goals both followed errors by Zenit goalkeeper Yury Zhevnov and were scored by defender Maxi Pereira and Paraguayan striker Oscar Cardozo. Benfica took the lead in the 20th minute through Pereira, but Zenit equalized seven minutes later when Shirokov volleyed in his first of the night. Semak put Zenit ahead in the 71st minute, only for Cardozo to equalize with three minutes left. However, Shirokov capitalized on a defensive mistake to grab the winner two minutes from time. Zenit manager Luciano Spalletti praised his players, saying they showed great skill and heart to secure victory under pressure, doing exactly what had been planned before the match. “We won deservedly tonight,” Spalletti told AFP. In Serie A action, Juventus missed the chance to top the league after settling for a 0-0 draw at Parma—their tenth draw of the season and sixth away from home. AC Milan remain at the summit by a single point, though they have played one more game. Parma climbs to 12th place with 28 points. Elsewhere, Atalanta edged Genoa 1-0 courtesy of a goal from Guido Marilungo 12 minutes from time, moving Atalanta up to 13th with 27 points while Genoa stays 10th with 30 points.
translated_content: AC Milan hampir pasti mara ke suku akhir Liga Juara-Juara selepas meraih kemenangan bergaya 4-0 ke atas Arsenal di San Siro pada hari Rabu. Penyerang Brazil, Robinho, menjaringkan dua gol ketika juara Serie A itu menguasai perlawanan pertama pusingan 16 menentang pasukan dari utara London itu. Kevin Prince Boateng membuka jaringan pada minit ke-15 dengan voli separa yang menarik, selepas mengawal hantaran daripada Alberto Nocerino sebelum melepaskan rembatan yang mengenai bawah palang gol tanpa dapat dihalang penjaga gol, Wojciech Szczesny. Robinho menambah gol kedua tujuh minit sebelum separuh masa, menanduk kemas hantaran daripada Zlatan Ibrahimovic. Walaupun Thierry Henry dimasukkan pada babak kedua—penampilan terakhirnya untuk Arsenal sebelum kembali ke New York Red Bulls—keadaan menjadi semakin buruk bagi pelawat. Pada minit ke-49, kerjasama antara Ibrahimovic dan Robinho di kawasan penalti Arsenal serta tergelincirnya Thomas Vermaelen memberi peluang mudah kepada Robinho menjaringkan gol ketiga tanpa halangan. Robin van Persie dari Arsenal memaksa penjaga gol Milan, Christian Abbiati, melakukan satu penyelamatan baik pada minit ke-65, namun peluang untuk pasukan The Gunners sangat terhad pada malam yang mengecewakan buat pasukan Arsene Wenger. Ibrahimovic melengkapkan malam gemilang Milan dengan menyempurnakan sepakan penalti 12 minit sebelum tamat selepas dijatuhkan oleh Johan Djourou. Arsene Wenger mengakui betapa sukarnya aksi anak buahnya dengan berkata kepada AFP: “Kami langsung tidak berada dalam permainan; kami sangat lemah dari segi serangan dan pertahanan. Sungguh mengejutkan melihat kami dikalahkan di semua bahagian—ini adalah persembahan terburuk di Eropah setakat ini. Sepanjang 90 minit, tidak ada satu detik pun kami benar-benar berada dalam permainan.” Perlawanan timbal balik di Stadium Emirates dijadualkan pada 6 Mac. Dalam satu lagi perlawanan Liga Juara-Juara pada hari Rabu, juara Russia, Zenit St Petersburg, bangkit dari ketinggalan untuk menewaskan Benfica dari Portugal 3-2 dalam perlawanan pertama pusingan 16. Roman Shirokov menjaringkan dua gol dan pemain gantian, Sergei Semak, menambah satu lagi untuk Zenit. Dua gol Benfica masing-masing berpunca daripada kesilapan penjaga gol Zenit, Yury Zhevnov, dan dijaringkan oleh pertahanan Maxi Pereira serta penyerang Paraguay, Oscar Cardozo. Benfica mendahului pada minit ke-20 hasil jaringan Pereira, tetapi Zenit menyamakan kedudukan tujuh minit kemudian melalui voli Shirokov. Semak meletakkan Zenit di depan pada minit ke-71, tetapi Cardozo menyamakan kedudukan tiga minit sebelum tamat. Bagaimanapun, Shirokov mengambil peluang dari kesilapan pertahanan dan menjaringkan gol kemenangan dua minit kemudian. Pengurus Zenit, Luciano Spalletti, memuji para pemainnya kerana menunjukkan kemahiran dan semangat tinggi untuk menang di bawah tekanan, mengikut sepenuhnya apa yang dirancang sebelum perlawanan. “Kami benar-benar layak menang malam ini,” kata Spalletti kepada AFP. Dalam aksi Serie A, Juventus terlepas peluang untuk berada di puncak liga selepas terikat 0-0 dengan Parma—keputusan seri ke-10 musim ini dan keenam di tempat lawan. AC Milan kekal di tangga teratas dengan kelebihan satu mata, walaupun telah bermain satu perlawanan lebih banyak. Parma pula naik ke tangga ke-12 dengan 28 mata. Sementara itu, Atalanta menewaskan Genoa 1-0 hasil jaringan Guido Marilungo 12 minit sebelum tamat, mengangkat Atalanta ke tangga ke-13 dengan 27 mata manakala Genoa kekal di tangga ke-10 dengan 30 mata.

article_content: Computer chipmaker Broadcom has finalized its $69 billion (£55 billion) acquisition of cloud computing firm VMware, marking one of the largest takeover deals in the technology sector. The deal underwent regulatory scrutiny around the globe, with final approval coming from China amidst concerns about the impact of US-China tensions. The green light followed a recent meeting between US President Joe Biden and Chinese President Xi Jinping at the APEC summit in the United States. Broadcom, based in San Jose, California, specializes in designing, developing, and supplying semiconductor chips, as well as providing infrastructure software solutions. VMware, headquartered in Palo Alto, California, is known for its virtualization software, which allows users to operate virtual computers on physical machines for increased efficiency. Hock Tan, Broadcom's president and CEO, expressed excitement about integrating both companies’ teams to build what he called 'the world's leading infrastructure technology company.' Their shared goal is to create private and hybrid cloud environments, giving users flexibility to run applications anywhere. To complete the acquisition, Broadcom secured legal merger clearances from authorities in Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, the European Union, Israel, Japan, South Africa, South Korea, Taiwan, and the United Kingdom. As a result of the merger, VMware shares will cease to be traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). US-China trade tensions have loomed over advanced technologies, especially since the trade war began in 2018 when then-President Donald Trump imposed tariffs and barriers on Chinese goods. Advanced semiconductor chips, vital to products from smartphones to fighter jets, have become a central focus. Last month, China responded to new US restrictions on chip exports. Despite differences, the recent APEC summit saw both countries’ leaders agree on issues such as climate change cooperation and resuming military communication. Even as President Biden called President Xi a 'dictator,' Chinese state media described the summit as 'historic' and a 'new starting point' for bilateral relations. Broadcom has previously been entangled in US-China tech tensions; in 2017, its proposed record-breaking acquisition of Qualcomm was blocked by the Trump administration over national security concerns, with warnings it might help China overtake the US in 5G development. Shortly after, Broadcom moved its headquarters from Singapore to the US.
translated_content: Syarikat pembuat cip komputer Broadcom telah memuktamadkan pengambilalihan firma pengkomputeran awan VMware bernilai $69 bilion (£55 bilion), menjadikannya salah satu urus niaga pengambilalihan terbesar dalam sektor teknologi. Urus niaga ini menerima penelitian pengawal selia di seluruh dunia, dengan kelulusan akhir diterima daripada China di tengah-tengah kebimbangan mengenai impak ketegangan antara AS dan China. Kelulusan ini diberikan selepas pertemuan antara Presiden AS Joe Biden dan Presiden China Xi Jinping di sidang kemuncak APEC di Amerika Syarikat baru-baru ini. Broadcom, yang berpangkalan di San Jose, California, pakar dalam mereka bentuk, membangun dan membekalkan cip semikonduktor, serta menyediakan penyelesaian perisian infrastruktur. VMware yang beribu pejabat di Palo Alto, California pula dikenali dengan perisian pengvirtualan yang membolehkan pengguna mengoperasikan komputer maya di atas mesin sebenar untuk meningkatkan kecekapan. Presiden dan Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Broadcom, Hock Tan, menyatakan keterujaan untuk menggabungkan pasukan kedua-dua syarikat bagi membina 'syarikat teknologi infrastruktur terkemuka dunia.' Matlamat bersama mereka adalah untuk mewujudkan persekitaran awan peribadi dan hibrid, memberikan pengguna fleksibiliti untuk menjalankan aplikasi di mana-mana sahaja. Untuk melengkapkan pengambilalihan ini, Broadcom telah memperoleh kelulusan undang-undang penggabungan daripada pihak berkuasa di Australia, Brazil, Kanada, China, Kesatuan Eropah, Israel, Jepun, Afrika Selatan, Korea Selatan, Taiwan, dan United Kingdom. Hasil daripada penggabungan ini, saham VMware tidak lagi akan didagangkan di Bursa Saham New York (NYSE). Ketegangan perdagangan antara AS dan China terus melingkari sektor teknologi canggih, terutamanya sejak perang perdagangan bermula pada 2018 apabila Presiden AS ketika itu, Donald Trump, mengenakan tarif dan sekatan terhadap barangan dari China. Cip semikonduktor canggih, yang penting untuk produk seperti telefon pintar hingga jet pejuang, menjadi tumpuan utama. Bulan lalu, China bertindak balas terhadap sekatan baharu AS ke atas eksport cip. Walaupun terdapat perbezaan, sidang kemuncak APEC baru-baru ini menyaksikan pemimpin kedua-dua negara bersetuju mengenai isu seperti kerjasama perubahan iklim dan menyambung semula komunikasi ketenteraan. Walaupun Presiden Biden menggelar Presiden Xi sebagai 'diktator,' media milik kerajaan China menggambarkan sidang kemuncak itu sebagai 'bersejarah' dan 'titik permulaan baharu' bagi hubungan dua hala. Broadcom sebelum ini turut terlibat dalam ketegangan teknologi AS-China; pada 2017, cadangan pengambilalihan syarikat Qualcomm oleh Broadcom yang memecah rekod telah dihalang oleh pentadbiran Trump atas kebimbangan keselamatan negara, dengan amaran bahawa perjanjian itu boleh membantu China mengatasi AS dalam pembangunan teknologi 5G. Tidak lama selepas itu, Broadcom memindahkan ibu pejabatnya dari Singapura ke Amerika Syarikat.

article_content: Every Christmas brings a must-have gift, and this year, onesies are the season’s essential item. Retailers like Asda, M&S, and Debenhams have seen the cozy one-piece fly off the shelves, but high-street fashion store New Look is seeing particular success — selling one every three seconds. Since launching in May, New Look has hit record sales, with 100,000 onesies sold in September alone. This popularity isn’t just among the general public; celebrities including Rihanna, Robbie Williams, Tulisa, One Direction, Tom Daley, and Holly Willoughby have all been spotted in the fashionable rompers. Flawless, the dance group from Britain’s Got Talent, joined celebrations by performing in their onesies, while Amy Childs saw 2,000 of her £60 velour versions sell out in just two days online. Holly Willoughby wore a onesie on This Morning, Keith Lemon was seen in Asda’s Incredible Hulk onesie, and Amy Childs added glamour to the trend with her own line. Essex leads the nation in onesie purchases, with 2,500 sold in New Look stores in the region last week alone. From candy-stripe and zebra print (£15.99) to tiger print (£19.99), winter and khaki patterns (£24.99), and the ‘Me to You’ onesie (£24.99), there’s a style for everyone to enjoy this festive season.

article_content: Vasundhara Raje, the former Chief Minister, has filed her nomination papers for the Jhalrapatan Assembly seat in Jhalawar district in the upcoming Rajasthan Assembly elections. On Saturday, marking the fifth day of the process, 544 candidates submitted nominations for 191 constituencies, according to the Election Commission. So far, 1,079 candidates have filed 1,462 nomination forms across Rajasthan. Chief Electoral Officer Praveen Gupta stated that nominations would not be accepted on Sunday, making Monday the final day for submissions. After filing her nomination, Raje expressed gratitude on X, noting 'three and a half decades of togetherness and nomination for the 10th time,' crediting her Jhalawar supporters for her political journey. Assembly Speaker Dr CP Joshi filed his nomination for the Nathdwara seat. Voting for all 200 Rajasthan Assembly seats is scheduled for November 25. Separately, India has approved its first case of 100% foreign direct investment (FDI) in the defence sector, allowing Sweden’s Saab to set up a facility to manufacture rockets in India. State Bank of India (SBI), the country’s top lender, reported an 8% net profit increase for the second quarter, driven by steady loan demand and reduced provisions. The bank expects robust loan growth in line with broad-based economic expansion. Byju’s, an edtech major, announced delayed audited results for the year ended March 2022, showing standalone core business revenue of ₹3,569 crore and a reduced Ebitda loss of ₹2,253 crore, down from ₹2,406 crore in the previous year.
translated_content: Vasundhara Raje, bekas Ketua Menteri, telah menyerahkan borang pencalonan untuk kerusi Dewan Undangan Negeri Jhalrapatan di daerah Jhalawar bagi pilihan raya Dewan Undangan Negeri Rajasthan yang akan datang. Pada hari Sabtu, iaitu hari kelima proses tersebut, sebanyak 544 calon menghantar pencalonan untuk 191 kawasan, menurut Suruhanjaya Pilihan Raya. Setakat ini, 1,079 calon telah menyerahkan 1,462 borang pencalonan di seluruh Rajasthan. Ketua Pegawai Pilihan Raya, Praveen Gupta, menyatakan bahawa pencalonan tidak akan diterima pada hari Ahad, menjadikan Isnin sebagai hari terakhir penyerahan. Selepas mengemukakan pencalonan, Raje mengucapkan penghargaan di X, menyatakan 'tiga setengah dekad bersama dan pencalonan ke-10', serta mengiktiraf penyokongnya di Jhalawar atas perjalanan politiknya. Speaker Dewan Undangan Negeri, Dr CP Joshi, menyerahkan pencalonan bagi kerusi Nathdwara. Pengundian untuk semua 200 kerusi Dewan Undangan Negeri Rajasthan dijadualkan pada 25 November. Dalam perkembangan lain, India meluluskan kes pertama pelaburan langsung asing (FDI) 100% dalam sektor pertahanan, membenarkan Saab dari Sweden menubuhkan kemudahan pembuatan roket di India. State Bank of India (SBI), peminjam terbesar negara, melaporkan peningkatan keuntungan bersih sebanyak 8% untuk suku kedua, didorong oleh permintaan pinjaman yang stabil serta pengurangan peruntukan. Bank itu menjangkakan pertumbuhan pinjaman yang kukuh sejajar dengan pengembangan ekonomi yang meluas. Byju's, syarikat edtech utama, mengumumkan keputusan audit tertangguh bagi tahun berakhir Mac 2022, menunjukkan pendapatan teras perniagaan bersendirian sebanyak ₹3,569 crore dan kerugian Ebitda berkurang kepada ₹2,253 crore, berbanding ₹2,406 crore pada tahun sebelumnya.

article_content: Police are searching off the coast of New York for a wildlife medical dart after an attempted euthanasia of a beached baby humpback whale failed Thursday night, reports East Hampton Village Police Chief Jerry Larsen. The dart bounced off the whale and ricocheted into the Atlantic Ocean. Larsen noted that, although the dart is made of stainless steel, it could pose a significant risk to swimmers in the future. “We’re sending divers to recover the needle as soon as the surf calms down,” Larsen said. Authorities have closed part of the beach as a precaution, warning that the dart might wash ashore. The whale, discovered Tuesday on Main Beach in East Hampton, was determined to be too ill to survive according to Charles Bowman, president of the Riverhead Foundation for Marine Research and Preservation. Bowman said, “The whale was debilitated—thin and a young juvenile still dependent on its mother, unable to survive alone.” By Friday, the whale remained stranded, and the foundation advised the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration that euthanasia was the most humane option. “It’s heartbreaking for us. We’re used to saving animals and returning them to the ocean,” Bowman stated. “But in this case, there was just no chance.” A NOAA official euthanized the whale Friday morning.

Anak panah tersebut melantun dari badan paus dan terpelanting ke Lautan Atlantik. Larsen menyatakan, walaupun anak panah itu diperbuat daripada keluli tahan karat, ia boleh membahayakan perenang pada masa akan datang. “Kami akan menghantar penyelam untuk mengambil semula jarum itu sebaik ombak reda,” kata Larsen. Pihak berkuasa turut menutup sebahagian pantai sebagai langkah berjaga-jaga kerana anak panah tersebut mungkin terdampat ke darat. Paus tersebut, yang ditemui pada hari Selasa di Main Beach, East Hampton, didapati terlalu sakit untuk diselamatkan menurut Charles Bowman, presiden Riverhead Foundation for Marine Research and Preservation. Bowman berkata, “Paus itu lemah—kurus dan masih anak yang bergantung pada ibunya, tidak mampu hidup sendiri.” Menjelang Jumaat, paus itu masih tidak dapat bergerak dari pantai, dan yayasan menasihati Pentadbiran Lautan dan Atmosfera Kebangsaan (NOAA) bahawa eutanasia adalah pilihan paling berperikemanusiaan. “Kami rasa sangat sedih. Pro-independence parties in Catalonia announced Thursday in Barcelona their intention to hold a referendum in November on whether the prosperous northeastern region should become independent from Spain. The Spanish government strongly opposes both the referendum and the idea of Catalan independence. On Thursday, Justice Minister Alberto Ruiz-Gallardon stated in Spain's parliament: “The vote will not be held.”

Even supporters of the referendum acknowledge significant hurdles remain before the planned November 9, 2014 vote. “We expect to open negotiations with Madrid. The Spanish state can't ignore this,” said Joan Maria Pique, spokesman for Catalan regional president Artur Mas. Mas's Convergence and Union party made the announcement alongside three other pro-independence parties. Previously, they had only indicated the vote would take place sometime in late 2014.

The parties revealed a two-part referendum question: firstly, 'Do you want Catalonia to become a state?' If the answer is yes, the second question will be, 'Do you want that state to be independent?' This differs from Scotland’s single-question independence referendum scheduled for September 18, 2014. Pique explained that the two-part question in Catalonia was the result of negotiations among the supporting parties and commented on how the UK government agreed to the Scottish vote, while Spanish authorities have not done the same for Catalonia.

The Spanish government argues that Catalonia, home to 7.5 million people, already enjoys broad self-governance, including its own parliament, police force, and control over education and health. Madrid insists the Spanish Constitution forbids any of the country’s 17 regions from unilaterally seceding, even a distinct region like Catalonia, with its own language and flag.

The four pro-independence parties form a majority in the Catalan parliament. Recent years have seen large-scale pro-independence demonstrations, such as a human chain spanning Catalonia on September 11—the region’s national day—and last year, an estimated 1.5 million people marched in Barcelona, Spain's second-largest city, demanding self-determination. Polls show that many Catalans support the right to self-determination, but if independence comes to a vote, the outcome could be closely contested, potentially within the 50% range.

Kerajaan Sepanyol membantah keras referendum serta idea kemerdekaan Catalonia. Pada Khamis, Menteri Kehakiman Alberto Ruiz-Gallardon menyatakan di parlimen Sepanyol: "Undian itu tidak akan diadakan."

Malah penyokong referendum mengakui masih banyak halangan menjelang tarikh mengundi yang dijadualkan pada 9 November 2014. "Kami berharap untuk membuka rundingan dengan Madrid. Negara Sepanyol tidak boleh mengabaikan perkara ini," kata Joan Maria Pique, jurucakap presiden wilayah Catalonia, Artur Mas. Parti Convergence and Union pimpinan Mas membuat pengumuman itu bersama tiga lagi parti pro-kemerdekaan. Sebelum ini mereka hanya menyatakan bahawa pengundian akan diadakan sekitar hujung tahun 2014.

Jika jawapannya ya, soalan kedua ialah, 'Adakah anda mahu negara itu menjadi merdeka?' Ini berbeza dengan referendum kemerdekaan Scotland yang hanya ada satu soalan dan dijadualkan pada 18 September 2014. Madrid menegaskan Perlembagaan Sepanyol melarang mana-mana 17 wilayahnya berpisah secara unilateral, walaupun wilayah tersebut mempunyai bahasa dan bendera sendiri seperti Catalonia.

Keempat-empat parti pro-kemerdekaan menguasai majoriti dalam parlimen wilayah Catalonia. Beberapa tahun kebelakangan ini, terdapat demonstrasi besar-besaran menyokong kemerdekaan, seperti pembentukan rantai manusia di seluruh Catalonia pada 11 September—hari kebangsaan wilayah itu—dan pada tahun lalu, dianggarkan 1.5 juta orang berarak di Barcelona, bandar kedua terbesar di Sepanyol, menuntut hak menentukan nasib sendiri. Tinjauan menunjukkan ramai rakyat Catalan menyokong hak menentukan nasib sendiri, namun jika kemerdekaan diputuskan melalui undian, keputusannya dijangka amat sengit dan mungkin sekitar 50%.

article_content: Clifford's Tower in York has received its first shelter in 328 years, thanks to an art installation inspired by Britain's recent wet summer. The installation, called Umbrella Sky, features 45 colorful umbrellas suspended within the historic walls of the tower, offering visitors protection from the weather. This is the first time since 1684 that any roof or covering has sheltered the medieval tower; the original roof was destroyed by an explosion that year. Louise Wyatt and Steve Parker from English Heritage stand inside the new display, which was inspired by the idea of providing a giant umbrella for the open courtyard after the damp summer. The quatrefoil shape of Clifford's Tower made it ideal for such a unique exhibit, following examples of suspended umbrellas in various European streets. Louise Wyatt, site manager, noted that the tower had been used to store gunpowder and munitions in the 17th century, with the 1684 explosion leaving only the current shell seen today. Umbrella Sky will remain in place until Sunday, October 21, weather permitting. The umbrellas are installed at rampart level, so views over the city of York remain uninterrupted. Clifford's Tower, all that remains of York Castle, was originally built by William the Conqueror. The umbrellas would have been useful two weeks ago when the area surrounding the tower flooded. For more information, visit www.english-heritage.org.uk/cliffords.
translated_content: Clifford's Tower di York akhirnya mendapat perlindungan pertama selepas 328 tahun, hasil pemasangan seni yang diinspirasikan oleh musim hujan Britain baru-baru ini. Pemasangan seni ini, dinamakan ‘Umbrella Sky’, menampilkan 45 payung berwarna-warni yang digantung di dalam dinding bersejarah menara tersebut, memberikan perlindungan kepada pelawat daripada cuaca. Ini merupakan kali pertama sejak tahun 1684 menara zaman pertengahan itu memiliki sebarang penutup; bumbung asalnya musnah dalam letupan pada tahun tersebut. Louise Wyatt dan Steve Parker dari English Heritage berada di dalam pameran baharu ini, yang diinspirasikan oleh idea untuk meletakkan payung gergasi di kawasan terbuka selepas musim panas yang basah. Bentuk quatrefoil Clifford's Tower sangat sesuai untuk pameran unik ini, dengan inspirasi daripada contoh payung tergantung di beberapa jalan di Eropah. Louise Wyatt, pengurus tapak, menyatakan menara tersebut pernah digunakan sebagai stor simpanan serbuk letupan dan peluru pada abad ke-17, dan letupan 1684 hanya meninggalkan struktur yang kelihatan hari ini. Umbrella Sky akan kekal sehingga Ahad, 21 Oktober, bergantung pada keadaan cuaca. Payung-payung ini dipasang pada paras benteng supaya pemandangan bandar York tidak terhalang. Clifford's Tower, satu-satunya tinggalan York Castle, asalnya dibina oleh William the Conqueror. Payung-payung ini sangat berguna dua minggu lalu apabila kawasan sekitar menara dilanda banjir. Untuk maklumat lanjut, layari www.english-heritage.org.uk/cliffords.
