article_content: Yusupha Bojang, the deputy head of the Gambian diplomatic mission in London, has been sentenced to seven years in prison for leading a group that operated a tax-free tobacconist by abusing diplomatic privileges. The group, including other Gambian diplomats, turned their London embassy into a tax-free shop, evading nearly £5 million in taxes. The court heard that over three years, Bojang and his colleagues ordered 29 tonnes of rolling tobacco, equivalent to more than half a million pouches. The operation became so widespread that at times, people queued outside the embassy to buy tobacco. The Foreign and Commonwealth Office was alerted to possible misuse of diplomatic privileges, triggering an investigation. As the large volumes of tobacco could not plausibly be for personal use, the Gambian government waived the immunity of seven diplomats, permitting a criminal investigation. Judge Michael Gledhill QC described the operation as a significant fraud and said the diplomats had betrayed the trust of both British and Gambian citizens. Bojang, identified as the ringleader, received a seven-year prison sentence. Other convicted diplomats include Gaston Sambou (first secretary), Ebrima John (finance attaché), and Georgina Gomez (welfare officer), who received six and five-year sentences respectively. All four diplomats, who previously denied charges of conspiracy to cheat public revenue, were found guilty after a trial at Southwark Crown Court. They are expected to be deported after serving their sentences. Other embassy staff, Veerahia Ramarajaha, Audrey Leeward, and Hasaintu Noah, were also convicted of aiding the tax fraud and sentenced to three years each. None of these three held diplomatic status. The case highlighted the abuse of the Vienna Convention's diplomatic immunity provisions. The article notes that while diplomatic immunity is designed to allow diplomats to serve without fear of harassment, it can be waived by the sending government, as happened here. Judge Gledhill remarked that the criminals made substantial profits and the embassy resembled a warehouse due to the vast quantities of tobacco. The judge expressed that the defendants' justification of helping fellow Gambians was unfounded. The convicted staff experienced severe personal consequences, including financial hardship and the risk of deportation. Defence lawyers argued the consequences upon returning to Gambia might be serious. Ida Jeng Njie, who worked for the Gambian Tourist Authority, was acquitted of conspiracy to cheat revenue. The mission is now officially known as the Gambian Embassy after the country left the Commonwealth. Legal representatives for the convicted parties noted the severity of the sentences and raised international law questions about when diplomatic immunity should be waived.
translated_content: Yusupha Bojang, timbalan ketua misi diplomatik Gambia di London, telah dijatuhi hukuman penjara tujuh tahun kerana mengetuai kumpulan yang menjalankan kedai tembakau bebas cukai dengan menyalahgunakan keistimewaan diplomatik. Kumpulan ini, termasuk diplomat Gambia lain, menukar kedutaan mereka di London menjadi kedai bebas cukai dan mengelak hampir £5 juta cukai. Mahkamah diberitahu bahawa dalam tempoh tiga tahun, Bojang dan rakan sekerjanya telah memesan 29 tan tembakau gulung, bersamaan lebih setengah juta bekas. Operasi itu menjadi begitu meluas sehingga kadang-kadang orang beratur di luar kedutaan untuk membeli tembakau. Pejabat Luar Negeri dan Komanwel UK dimaklumkan tentang kemungkinan penyalahgunaan keistimewaan diplomatik, lalu memulakan siasatan. Oleh kerana kuantiti tembakau yang besar itu tidak munasabah untuk kegunaan peribadi, kerajaan Gambia telah mengetepikan kekebalan tujuh diplomat, membenarkan siasatan jenayah dijalankan. Hakim Michael Gledhill QC menyifatkan operasi itu sebagai penipuan besar dan menyatakan bahawa para diplomat telah mengkhianati kepercayaan rakyat Britain dan Gambia. Bojang, yang dikenal pasti sebagai ketua, menerima hukuman penjara tujuh tahun. Diplomasi lain yang turut disabitkan ialah Gaston Sambou (setiausaha pertama), Ebrima John (atase kewangan), dan Georgina Gomez (pegawai kebajikan), yang menerima hukuman enam dan lima tahun masing-masing. Keempat-empat diplomat ini, sebelum ini menafikan tuduhan konspirasi menipu hasil awam, didapati bersalah selepas perbicaraan di Mahkamah Southwark Crown. Mereka dijangka akan diusir selepas menjalani hukuman penjara. Staf kedutaan lain, Veerahia Ramarajaha, Audrey Leeward, dan Hasaintu Noah, juga disabitkan membantu penipuan cukai dan dijatuhi hukuman penjara tiga tahun setiap seorang. Ketiga-tiga mereka tidak mempunyai status diplomatik. Kes ini menonjolkan penyalahgunaan peruntukan kekebalan diplomatik dalam Konvensyen Vienna. Artikel ini menyatakan bahawa meskipun kekebalan diplomatik direka untuk membolehkan diplomat bertugas tanpa gangguan, ia boleh diketepikan oleh kerajaan asal, seperti yang berlaku di sini. Hakim Gledhill menyatakan para penjenayah memperoleh keuntungan besar dan kedutaan itu kelihatan seperti gudang disebabkan jumlah tembakau yang banyak. Hakim juga menegaskan alasan defendan kononnya untuk membantu rakyat Gambia adalah tidak berasas. Kakitangan yang disabitkan kesalahan itu mengalami kesan peribadi yang serius, termasuk masalah kewangan dan risiko diusir. Peguam bela berhujah bahawa akibat yang bakal dihadapi mereka sekiranya pulang ke Gambia boleh jadi sangat berat. Ida Jeng Njie, yang bekerja dengan Autoriti Pelancongan Gambia, telah dibebaskan daripada tuduhan konspirasi menipu hasil. Misi diplomatik itu kini secara rasmi dikenali sebagai Kedutaan Gambia selepas negara itu keluar dari Komanwel. Wakil peguam kepada mereka yang disabitkan menyatakan betapa beratnya hukuman yang dijatuhkan dan membangkitkan isu undang-undang antarabangsa mengenai bila kekebalan diplomatik boleh diketepikan.

article_content: Fritz Sdunek, former coach of heavyweight champions Wladimir and Vitali Klitschko, has died at the age of 67 from a heart attack, according to the boxers' statement on Tuesday. A former East German amateur boxer, Sdunek had worked with the Universum boxing group in Hamburg since the mid-1990s. He coached the Ukrainian brothers, leading both to world heavyweight titles before partially retiring in 2009. "Today we received the sad news that our friend and former coach Fritz Sdunek has passed away," the Klitschko brothers stated. "When we arrived in Germany, Fritz was the most important person to us. He always supported us and was the coach who made us world champions—we will forever be grateful. Fritz's death is a tremendous personal loss for us. During these difficult times, our thoughts and prayers are with his family," they added. Sdunek, highly respected in German boxing, continued coaching Vitali until the end of his boxing career, after which Vitali transitioned to politics following his final bout as WBC champion in 2012. Sdunek also coached Wladimir Klitschko to the WBO heavyweight title in 2000.
translated_content: Fritz Sdunek, bekas jurulatih juara heavyweight Wladimir dan Vitali Klitschko, telah meninggal dunia pada usia 67 tahun akibat serangan jantung, menurut kenyataan para peninju itu pada hari Selasa. Sdunek, bekas peninju amatur Jerman Timur, telah bekerja dengan kumpulan tinju Universum di Hamburg sejak pertengahan 1990-an. Beliau melatih dua beradik dari Ukraine itu sehingga mereka memenangi gelaran heavyweight dunia sebelum bersara sebahagian pada tahun 2009. "Hari ini kami menerima berita sedih bahawa kawan dan bekas jurulatih kami Fritz Sdunek telah meninggal dunia," kata adik-beradik Klitschko. "Ketika kami tiba di Jerman, Fritz adalah orang paling penting bagi kami. Dia sentiasa menyokong dan menjadi jurulatih yang menjadikan kami juara dunia—kami akan sentiasa berterima kasih kepadanya. Kehilangan Fritz adalah kehilangan peribadi yang amat besar buat kami. Dalam saat-saat sukar ini, doa dan ingatan kami bersama keluarganya," tambah mereka. Sdunek, yang sangat dihormati dalam dunia tinju Jerman, terus melatih Vitali sehingga akhir kerjaya tinjunya, selepas itu Vitali beralih ke bidang politik selepas pertarungan terakhirnya sebagai juara WBC pada tahun 2012. Sdunek juga melatih Wladimir Klitschko sehingga memenangi gelaran heavyweight WBO pada tahun 2000.
post_content: Legendary boxing coach Fritz Sdunek has passed away at 67 from a heart attack. He trained the Klitschko brothers to world titles and left a huge mark on the sport. Condolences to his family and all boxing fans. 🥊 #FritzSdunek #BoxingLegend #RIP

article_content: Young farmers in Ondo State have commended a partnership between Nigeria’s Federal Government and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) for creating new job opportunities in agriculture through the LIFE-ND (Livelihood Improvement Family Enterprises in Niger Delta) project. With the IFAD/LIFE-ND program, youths across 10 local government areas—including many graduates—have received hands-on training and support in cassava, poultry, fisheries, cocoa, and vegetable value chains. Upon completion, many launched their own agribusinesses and are now creating jobs for others. At a recent media roundtable, State Project Coordinator Prince Olawale Ademola explained that the initiative, started in 2020 with support from the Federal and Ondo State governments, is designed to promote food security and generate employment. ‘In the first phase over the last three years, we've trained 2,180 youths—some are now self-employed and equipped to succeed. By year-end, we expect to empower over 2,500 young people,’ he said. During field visits to recipients' businesses in Ondo East, young entrepreneurs described major improvements in their quality of life thanks to the program. Oluwatoyin Akintoye, a 33-year-old computer science graduate, shared how her poultry training led her to expand into marketing poultry products and supplies. She said, ‘IFAD/LIFE-ND provided valuable hands-on experience and a monthly stipend of N12,000 for around nine months, along with necessary inputs. They even invested N1.12 million in my startup. Now, I’ve built a thriving business in eggs, feeds, and equipment.' Fish farmer Feyisola Fasakin also credited the LIFE-ND training for his entrepreneurial achievements. ‘I received 1,500 juvenile fish and access to a pond, which got me started. The training taught me to save money and stay focused. Now, fish farming is my career and I’m able to support my family independently,’ he said. Project leaders and beneficiaries agree that the scheme is strengthening food sufficiency and job creation, with many former unemployed youths benefiting from practical training and startup funding.
translated_content: Para belia tani di Negeri Ondo memuji kerjasama antara Kerajaan Persekutuan Nigeria dan Tabung Pembiayaan Pertanian Antarabangsa (IFAD) kerana telah membuka peluang pekerjaan baharu dalam bidang pertanian melalui projek LIFE-ND (Usahawan Keluarga untuk Peningkatan Kehidupan di Delta Niger). Menerusi program IFAD/LIFE-ND, belia di 10 kawasan kerajaan tempatan—termasuk ramai graduan—telah menerima latihan amali dan sokongan dalam rantaian nilai ubi kayu, ayam, perikanan, koko, dan sayur-sayuran. Selepas tamat latihan, ramai yang berjaya membuka perniagaan pertanian sendiri serta memberi peluang pekerjaan kepada orang lain. Dalam satu sesi meja bulat media baru-baru ini, Penyelaras Projek Negeri, Prince Olawale Ademola, menerangkan bahawa inisiatif ini, yang bermula pada 2020 dengan sokongan daripada Kerajaan Persekutuan dan Kerajaan Negeri Ondo, bertujuan meningkatkan keselamatan makanan dan menyediakan peluang pekerjaan. ‘Dalam fasa pertama selama tiga tahun ini, kami telah melatih seramai 2,180 orang belia—sebanyak yang kini berdikari serta berjaya dalam bidang ini. Menjelang akhir tahun, kami jangka dapat membantu lebih 2,500 belia,’ katanya. Semasa lawatan ke perniagaan para penerima di Ondo East, usahawan muda menceritakan perubahan besar dalam hidup mereka hasil program ini. Oluwatoyin Akintoye, graduan sains komputer berusia 33 tahun, berkongsi pengalaman dalam bidang ternakan ayam yang membawanya mengembangkan perniagaan ke sektor pemasaran produk dan bekalan ayam. Katanya, ‘IFAD/LIFE-ND memberi saya pengalaman praktikal dan elaun bulanan N12,000 selama kira-kira sembilan bulan bersama input permulaan. Malah, mereka memberikan modal N1.12 juta untuk perniagaan saya. Kini, saya memiliki perniagaan telur, makanan ternakan dan peralatan yang semakin berkembang.’ Penternak ikan, Feyisola Fasakin, turut mengakui latihan LIFE-ND sangat membantu kejayaan keusahawanannya. ‘Saya menerima 1,500 benih ikan dan kolam untuk memulakan projek. Latihan ini mengajar saya menyimpan wang dan fokus. Sekarang, penternakan ikan ialah kerjaya saya dan saya mampu menampung keluarga sendiri,’ katanya. Para pemimpin projek dan penerima manfaat sepakat inisiatif ini memperkasa keselamatan makanan serta penciptaan pekerjaan, dengan ramai bekas belia menganggur kini mendapat manfaat daripada latihan praktikal dan modal permulaan.

article_content: After being trapped for hours in a huge 30-mile traffic jam on the M6 during extreme heat, Shelley Ruck, a new mother from Warrington, received an unexpected act of generosity. With only one bottle left for her eight-month-old son, George, Shelley found herself desperate for supplies. The standstill had been caused by an accident involving a cement truck and a heavy goods vehicle near junction 34, south of Lancaster. While Shelley, her baby, and her mother Denise waited anxiously in the blazing conditions, several bystanders atop a bridge noticed their difficulty. Compelled to assist, they drove 20 minutes to a nearby store. They returned with formula powder, two sterilized bottles filled with boiling water, and a bottle of spring water, lowering the items down using a jerry can. Shelley expressed immense gratitude, saying, 'Their kindness was unbelievable. Without their help, my baby would have gone hungry.' The Good Samaritans declined payment and chose to stay anonymous. In addition to Shelley's rescue, the extreme heat prompted police to hand out water to suffering drivers. Some people fainted from the conditions, and one elderly woman was taken away in an ambulance. Shelley recounted, 'It was horrific. If George had woken up, we would have had no milk.' Other motorists received help, too. Matthew Jones, a student from Cheshire, reported a farmer letting people use his field as a restroom, and lorry drivers providing essential shade. Water and food were shared among those stranded, and people supported each other throughout the incident. A spokesperson from the Highways Agency emphasized that drivers had to remain until the road was cleared for safety reasons and thanked everyone for waiting patiently.
translated_content: Selepas terperangkap selama beberapa jam dalam kesesakan lalu lintas sepanjang 30 batu di lebuh raya M6 ketika cuaca panas melampau, Shelley Ruck, seorang ibu baru dari Warrington, menerima bantuan yang tidak disangka-sangka. Dengan hanya tinggal satu botol susu untuk anak lelakinya yang berusia lapan bulan, George, Shelley sangat memerlukan bantuan. Kesesakan ini berpunca daripada kemalangan yang melibatkan sebuah lori simen dan kenderaan berat berhampiran persimpangan 34, selatan Lancaster. Ketika Shelley, bayi dan ibunya Denise menunggu cemas dalam cuaca membahang, beberapa orang awam yang berada di atas jejambat melihat kesusahan mereka. Tersentuh untuk membantu, mereka memandu 20 minit ke kedai terdekat dan kembali dengan susu formula, dua botol steril berisi air panas, serta sebotol air mineral. Semua barangan itu diturunkan menggunakan jerikin. Shelley sangat bersyukur dan berkata, 'Kebaikan mereka memang luar biasa. Tanpa bantuan itu, anak saya mungkin lapar.' Golongan dermawan itu enggan menerima bayaran dan memilih untuk kekal tanpa dikenali. Selain membantu Shelley, cuaca panas menyebabkan polis mengedarkan air kepada pemandu yang keletihan. Ada yang pengsan akibat kepanasan, dan seorang wanita tua terpaksa dibawa menaiki ambulans. Shelley berkata, 'Keadaan amat teruk. Kalau George terjaga, kami memang kehabisan susu.' Pengguna jalan raya lain turut menerima bantuan. Matthew Jones, pelajar dari Cheshire, melihat seorang petani membenarkan orang ramai menggunakan ladangnya sebagai tandas, dan pemandu lori membantu dengan menyediakan teduhan. Air dan makanan dikongsi, serta orang ramai saling membantu sepanjang kejadian itu. Jurucakap Agensi Lebuhraya menegaskan semua pemandu harus kekal di tempat masing-masing atas faktor keselamatan sehingga jalan dibuka semula, dan mengucapkan terima kasih atas kesabaran semua.
post_content: Heartwarming moment on the M6: Stranded mum and baby got surprise help from strangers who went out, bought formula, & lowered it down from a bridge! Community came together in the heat. #Kindness #GoodSamaritans #M6Stories
translated_post: Detik penuh kasih di M6: Ibu & bayi terkandas dibantu orang ramai yang sanggup beli susu formula & turunkan dari jejambat! Semangat komuniti membara walau cuaca panas. #Kebaikan #KomunitiM6 #Inspirasi

article_content: Edna Slann, 89, was filmed by her family pleading for food while at Grantley Court Nursing Home in Sutton, south-west London. In video footage, she expresses hunger and distress, saying, 'I’m starving. Have you got anything to eat here now?' Although dementia has left Mrs. Slann confused, she remains clear about her urgent need for food. Her granddaughter Becky recorded these moments after Edna was evacuated from the care home last year. The family began documenting their visits due to concerns about possible neglect. During her stay at Grantley Court, Mrs. Slann also suffered physical injuries, including severe facial bruising and a head wound requiring 12 stitches. According to her family, Mrs. Slann lost over half a stone in two months and now weighs just above five stone, relying on morphine for pain management. Edna, a former cleaner who worked until age 70, requires a wheelchair and suffers from dementia and arthritis. She was moved from a residential home to Grantley Court in July. Becky and her mother, Linda Cackett, became increasingly worried about Mrs. Slann's well-being, prompting them to film her during visits. In one recorded instance, Mrs. Slann pleads for food, expressing anger and despair. When food did not arrive promptly, she asked at least for a cup of tea. After staff noticed a bedsore on her foot, Mrs. Slann was taken to hospital. Hospital staff reported being told by Grantley Court that the issue was 'not that bad,' but doctors said the only way to stop the progression was to amputate her leg, a risky operation considering her health. Mrs. Slann’s daughter said it was horrible to see her mother suffer and expressed deep regret over her stay at the care home. She stated, 'No one should have to go through this.' Mrs. Slann’s care at Grantley Court cost £595 a week, funded by Surrey Downs Clinical Commissioning Group (CCG). A spokesman for Surrey Downs CCG said she was moved as soon as concerns were raised, while a Surrey council representative noted that Grantley Court had passed its most recent inspection at the time Mrs. Slann was admitted.
translated_content: Edna Slann, 89 tahun, dirakam oleh keluarganya merayu untuk mendapatkan makanan semasa di Grantley Court Nursing Home di Sutton, London barat daya. Dalam rakaman video, beliau meluahkan kelaparan dan kesedihan, berkata, 'Saya lapar. Ada apa-apa untuk dimakan sekarang?' Walaupun demensia menyebabkan Puan Slann keliru, beliau masih jelas tentang keperluannya untuk makan. Cucu perempuannya, Becky, merakam detik-detik ini selepas Edna dipindahkan dari rumah jagaan itu tahun lalu. Keluarganya mula mendokumentasikan lawatan mereka kerana bimbang berlaku pengabaian. Sepanjang tinggal di Grantley Court, Puan Slann juga mengalami kecederaan fizikal, termasuk lebam teruk di muka dan luka di kepala yang memerlukan 12 jahitan. Menurut keluarganya, Puan Slann kehilangan lebih setengah batu dalam masa dua bulan dan kini hanya seberat lebih lima batu, bergantung pada morfin untuk menguruskan kesakitan. Edna, bekas pencuci yang bekerja sehingga usia 70 tahun, memerlukan kerusi roda dan menghidap demensia serta artritis. Beliau dipindahkan dari rumah penjagaan ke Grantley Court pada bulan Julai. Becky dan ibunya, Linda Cackett, semakin bimbang tentang keadaan Puan Slann, menyebabkan mereka merakam beliau setiap kali melawat. Dalam satu rakaman, Puan Slann merayu makanan, menunjukkan kemarahan dan kesedihan. Apabila makanan tidak tiba dengan segera, beliau sekurang-kurangnya meminta secawan teh. Selepas kakitangan melihat luka tekanan di kaki beliau, Puan Slann dibawa ke hospital. Kakitangan hospital melaporkan Grantley Court mengatakan isu tersebut 'tidak begitu serius', namun doktor menyatakan satu-satunya cara untuk menghentikan keadaan itu ialah dengan memotong kakinya, satu pembedahan berisiko memandangkan kesihatannya. Anak perempuan Puan Slann berkata amat sukar melihat ibunya menderita dan meluahkan penyesalan yang mendalam mengenai penginapan ibunya di rumah jagaan itu. Beliau berkata, 'Tiada siapa patut melalui perkara ini.' Penjagaan Puan Slann di Grantley Court berharga £595 seminggu, dibiayai oleh Surrey Downs Clinical Commissioning Group (CCG). Jurucakap Surrey Downs CCG berkata beliau dipindahkan sebaik sahaja kebimbangan dibangkitkan, manakala wakil majlis Surrey memaklumkan bahawa Grantley Court telah melepasi pemeriksaan terbaharu ketika Puan Slann ditempatkan.
post_content: Shocking footage shows Edna Slann, 89, pleading for food in her care home – sparking big concerns about elderly care in the UK. Her family's videos and tough experiences got authorities to step in. #ElderCare #CareHomeCrisis

article_content: Katrina Kaif, a long-time fan of action films featuring stars like Charlize Theron and Halle Berry, shared her enthusiasm for the genre and for portraying powerful female characters. As 'Tiger 3' becomes a record-setting film for Kaif, she revealed ongoing discussions with Yash Raj Films (YRF) head Aditya Chopra about a potential standalone movie focusing on her spy character, Zoya. 'Tiger 3', the next installment following 'Ek Tha Tiger' (2012) and 'Tiger Zinda Hai' (2017), features Kaif reprising her role as former ISI agent Zoya, alongside Salman Khan’s Avinash Singh Rathore. The film, directed by Maneesh Sharma, is part of the YRF spy universe and is set after 'Pathaan', released in January. "Adi (Chopra) and I have had many discussions. At least once a week, I’ll approach him with ideas about my character. Our conversations have continued for years—even before he started working on 'Pathaan'," Kaif told PTI. Kaif highlighted that the YRF spy universe, which includes Hrithik Roshan's 'War', has developed into a strong franchise with compelling, well-defined characters. "What’s beautiful is that each character is strong and unique, and you can bring them into each other's worlds, adding depth to the overall story," she said. 'Tiger 3' was released on November 12, coinciding with Diwali, in Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu. The film, also starring Emraan Hashmi, has grossed Rs 324 crore at the worldwide box office. Kaif stated that with each movie, she gains more understanding of her character, allowing deeper exploration and better storytelling. She considers box office success as a validation, comparing it to achieving top marks in exams. "Validation at the box office is like taking an exam—you want to get that A grade. The ultimate validation is seeing those results," Kaif, 40, commented. She believes that the success of the 'Tiger' franchise comes from compelling stories, strong characters, and high-energy action. Kaif credits Kabir Khan, director of 'Ek Tha Tiger', for initiating the concept of agents Tiger and Zoya, and Ali Abbas Zafar for elevating the sequel. "With 'Tiger 3', the team put forth a fresh approach. The franchise allows room for a variety of stories, similar to 'Mission Impossible', 'Bourne Identity', or 'James Bond', where the agent’s journey can take new twists," Kaif said. Reuniting with Salman Khan has always been enjoyable for Kaif. The two have worked together on films including 'Maine Pyaar Kyun Kiya', 'Yuvvraaj', 'Partner', and 'Bharat'. "Salman often surprises me on set with his energy and spontaneous approach. He’s very honest, and our chemistry comes from years of working together and understanding each other's rhythms," she said. Kaif reiterated her admiration for action heroines like Charlize Theron and Halle Berry, as well as Anne Hathaway’s role in 'Batman'. She enjoys the physicality and strength of such roles. "I connect to the determination and perseverance of these characters—fighting until the end," she added. Kaif will next star in Sriram Raghavan's anticipated film 'Merry Christmas' with Vijay Sethupathi, set for release on January 12. Other news mentions include the government considering the transfer of unclaimed funds from the Sahara-Sebi Refund Account, Apple’s goal of producing nearly ₹1 lakh crore worth of iPhones in India by March 2024, and Nawaz Modi seeking a substantial portion of Gautam Singhania’s reported $1.4 billion net worth as part of their family settlement.
translated_content: Katrina Kaif, yang telah lama menjadi peminat filem aksi lakonan Charlize Theron dan Halle Berry, berkongsi semangatnya terhadap genre tersebut dan watak wanita berkuasa. Dengan kejayaan 'Tiger 3' yang mencipta rekod, Katrina mendedahkan bahawa dia sedang berbincang dengan ketua Yash Raj Films (YRF), Aditya Chopra, mengenai kemungkinan filem solo berdasarkan watak ejen perisiknya, Zoya. 'Tiger 3', kesinambungan kepada 'Ek Tha Tiger' (2012) dan 'Tiger Zinda Hai' (2017), menampilkan Katrina sebagai bekas ejen ISI Zoya bersama Salman Khan sebagai Avinash Singh Rathore. Filem arahan Maneesh Sharma ini adalah sebahagian daripada alam perisik YRF dan berlatar selepas peristiwa 'Pathaan' yang ditayangkan Januari lalu. "Saya dan Adi (Chopra) telah berbincang banyak kali. Sekurang-kurangnya seminggu sekali saya akan berbincang dengannya tentang idea watak saya. Perbualan ini telah berlangsung selama bertahun-tahun—sejak sebelum dia bekerja pada 'Pathaan'," kata Katrina kepada PTI. Katrina menekankan bahawa alam perisik YRF, termasuk 'War' lakonan Hrithik Roshan, kini menjadi francais kukuh dengan watak-watak yang kuat dan tersendiri. "Menariknya, setiap watak sangat kuat dan unik, dan mereka boleh muncul dalam dunia antara satu sama lain, menambah kedalaman kepada jalan cerita keseluruhan," tambahnya. 'Tiger 3' ditayangkan pada 12 November bersempena Deepavali, dalam bahasa Hindi, Tamil, dan Telugu. Filem itu, yang turut dibintangi Emraan Hashmi, telah mengutip Rs 324 crore di box office global. Katrina berkata setiap filem memberinya pemahaman yang lebih mendalam tentang wataknya, membolehkan eksplorasi dan penceritaan lebih baik. Baginya, kejayaan di box office adalah satu bentuk pengiktirafan, seperti meraih markah tertinggi dalam peperiksaan. article_content: Apple co-founder Steve Jobs died of respiratory arrest caused by a pancreatic tumor, according to a public health official. Jobs passed away at 3 p.m. on Wednesday at his home in Palo Alto, California, as confirmed by Amy Cornell of the Santa Clara County Public Health Department. His death was announced the same day by Apple, the Silicon Valley company he co-founded with Steve Wozniak. Jobs was 56 years old. Jobs was a pioneering executive who helped develop the personal computer and popularized the use of the mouse to navigate onscreen images. In recent years, he introduced revolutionary products including the iPod, iPhone, and iPad, all of which transformed the way people consume digital content. Jobs' death, although deeply felt by the many fans of Apple, was not unexpected. He had battled cancer for several years, took medical leave from Apple in January, and stepped down as CEO in August because he could no longer fulfill his duties and expectations. On October 19, Apple employees will hold a celebration of Jobs' life and contributions. In a company memo, Apple CEO Tim Cook wrote, 'Like many of you, I have experienced some of the saddest days of my life and shed many tears this past week. But I have found comfort in the extraordinary number of tributes and condolences from people around the world who were touched by Steve and his genius. I have also found comfort in sharing and listening to stories about Steve.' Cook added, 'Although our hearts are still heavy, we are planning a celebration of his life for Apple employees to reflect on Steve's incredible achievements and the many ways he made the world a better place.' Jobs was buried on Friday in Palo Alto. CNN's Dan Simon and Greg Morrison contributed to this report.
translated_content: Pengasas bersama Apple, Steve Jobs, meninggal dunia akibat kegagalan pernafasan yang disebabkan oleh tumor pankreas, menurut pegawai kesihatan awam. Jobs menghembuskan nafas terakhir pada jam 3 petang, hari Rabu di rumahnya di Palo Alto, California, seperti yang disahkan oleh Amy Cornell dari Jabatan Kesihatan Awam Santa Clara County. Kematian beliau diumumkan pada hari yang sama oleh Apple, syarikat Silicon Valley yang beliau tubuhkan bersama Steve Wozniak. Jobs berusia 56 tahun. Jobs merupakan eksekutif perintis yang membantu membangunkan komputer peribadi dan mempopularkan penggunaan tetikus untuk navigasi imej di skrin. Dalam beberapa tahun kebelakangan ini, beliau memperkenalkan produk revolusioner seperti iPod, iPhone, dan iPad, yang telah mengubah cara orang ramai menikmati kandungan digital. Kematiannya, walaupun dirasai secara mendalam oleh peminat Apple, tidaklah mengejutkan. Beliau telah bertarung dengan kanser selama beberapa tahun, mengambil cuti sakit dari Apple pada bulan Januari, dan meletak jawatan sebagai CEO pada bulan Ogos kerana tidak lagi dapat melaksanakan tanggungjawab dan harapan syarikat. Pada 19 Oktober, pekerja Apple akan mengadakan sambutan memperingati kehidupan dan sumbangan Jobs. Dalam memo syarikat, CEO Apple Tim Cook menulis, 'Seperti ramai di antara anda, saya mengalami hari-hari paling sedih dalam hidup saya dan menitiskan banyak air mata minggu ini. Namun saya mendapat kekuatan daripada banyak penghormatan dan ucapan takziah dari orang di seluruh dunia yang tersentuh oleh Steve dan kejeniusan beliau. Saya juga mendapat ketenangan berkongsi dan mendengar kisah tentang Steve.' Cook menambah, 'Walaupun hati kita masih terasa berat, kami sedang merancang sambutan memperingati kehidupan beliau untuk pekerja Apple, supaya kita dapat mengenang pencapaian luar biasa Steve dan semua cara beliau menjadikan dunia ini lebih baik.' Jobs telah dikebumikan pada hari Jumaat di Palo Alto. Dan Simon dan Greg Morrison dari CNN turut menyumbang kepada laporan ini.

article_content:
Airbnb is highlighting rental listings that receive top guest ratings, in an effort to bring hotel-like reliability to its platform. CEO Brian Chesky announced that the company will introduce a new 'Guest Favorites' label this week to about 2 million of Airbnb's 7 million listings globally.

To qualify as a 'Guest Favorite,' a property must maintain an average guest rating of at least 4.9 out of 5.0, have a cancellation rate and customer service incidents at or below 1%, and feature a special badge. Shoppers will be able to filter for these listings while browsing.

Chesky anticipates that 'Guest Favorites' will be able to charge higher prices than other listings, but noted that Airbnb does not guarantee the quality of the designated properties despite their high scores. There is uncertainty around how hosts who do not receive the badge will respond—some may lose bookings or lower prices to compete.

To promote transparency, Airbnb is encouraging hosts to create AI-organized photo tours of their properties. The platform is also enhancing tools to help hosts set prices based on daily demand.

Airbnb has also responded to complaints about cleaning fees by urging hosts to reduce excessive charges. A 2022 NerdWallet analysis found the median cleaning fee for a one-night stay was $75, approximately 25% of the total bill. The platform now lets users filter search results by all-in pricing, though this is not set by default. Airbnb reports that around 260,000 listings have lowered their cleaning fees since the push for price transparency began. Chesky expressed satisfaction with the steps taken toward fairer pricing.

Airbnb kini menonjolkan senarai sewaan yang menerima penilaian tertinggi daripada tetamu, sebagai usaha membawa kebolehpercayaan seperti hotel ke platformnya. CEO Brian Chesky mengumumkan bahawa syarikat akan memperkenalkan label 'Guest Favorites' minggu ini kepada kira-kira 2 juta daripada 7 juta senarai Airbnb di seluruh dunia.

Untuk layak sebagai 'Guest Favorite,' penginapan mesti mengekalkan penilaian purata sekurang-kurangnya 4.9 daripada 5.0, kadar pembatalan dan insiden khidmat pelanggan pada atau di bawah 1%, serta memiliki lencana khas. Pengguna boleh menapis carian untuk melihat hanya senarai ini semasa memilih.

Chesky menjangka 'Guest Favorites' boleh mengenakan harga lebih tinggi daripada senarai lain, namun beliau menjelaskan Airbnb tidak memberi jaminan terhadap kualiti senarai tersebut walaupun skor mereka tinggi. Terdapat ketidakpastian tentang bagaimana hos yang tidak mendapat lencana ini akan bertindak—ada yang mungkin kehilangan tempahan atau perlu menurunkan harga untuk bersaing.

Bagi meningkatkan ketelusan, Airbnb menggalakkan hos membuat lawatan bergambar dengan bantuan AI untuk menyusun gambar mengikut bilik. Platform ini turut mempertingkat alat bagi hos menyesuaikan harga mengikut permintaan harian.

Selain itu, Airbnb menangani aduan tentang yuran pembersihan dengan menggesa hos mengurangkan caj yang terlalu tinggi. Analisis NerdWallet 2022 mendapati yuran pembersihan median untuk satu malam ialah $75, sekitar 25% daripada jumlah bil. Kini, pengguna boleh menapis carian mengikut harga keseluruhan, walaupun itu bukan tetapan lalai. Airbnb melaporkan kira-kira 260,000 senarai telah menurunkan yuran pembersihan sejak inisiatif ketelusan harga diperkenalkan. Chesky memaklumkan beliau berpuas hati dengan kemajuan dalam penetapan harga yang lebih adil.

article_content: Former IMF chief Dominique Strauss-Kahn is suing the makers of a film he claims is loosely based on events from his life. 'Welcome To New York,' which premiered at Cannes this weekend, stars Gérard Depardieu as Mr Deveraux, a character depicted as a sex addict who, among other things, rapes a hotel maid. According to Strauss-Kahn's lawyer, the film is defamatory because the plot closely mirrors the accusations faced by Strauss-Kahn in a 2011 sexual assault case. In 2011, Strauss-Kahn was arrested in New York as he was preparing a bid for the French presidency. Hotel maid Nafissatou Diallo accused him of attempted rape. Although Strauss-Kahn's legal team argued the encounter was consensual, he resigned from his role as IMF chief. Diallo later filed a civil suit, which was settled financially in an undisclosed agreement. Strauss-Kahn's lawyer Jean Veil told Europe 1 radio that his client is 'frightened' and 'sickened' by the film, and has filed a defamation complaint based on the film's insinuations. 'Welcome To New York' portrays Mr Deveraux engaging in orgies in New York hotel rooms and sexually assaulting a hotel chambermaid, after which he is arrested. The film also shows a flashback of Deveraux assaulting a female journalist. The film features Jacqueline Bisset as Deveraux's wife and had a private premiere at Cannes. It will be released on video-on-demand in France and in cinemas elsewhere, including the UK. Before the screening at Cannes, Depardieu, director Abel Ferrara, and Bisset introduced the film. Depardieu expressed his dislike for politicians and his satisfaction in participating, while Ferrara emphasized his creative freedom and said Depardieu also co-financed the film. Ferrara rejected accusations from Strauss-Kahn, asserting his right to artistic expression. The film has received mixed reviews—some praise Depardieu's acting, while others criticize the film's approach. Producer Vincent Maraval claimed French media and political elites discouraged the film, and that no French TV stations wanted to finance it.

'Welcome To New York', yang ditayangkan di Cannes hujung minggu ini, dibintangi Gérard Depardieu sebagai Mr Deveraux, seorang watak yang digambarkan sebagai penagih seks yang, antara lain, merogol seorang pekerja hotel. Menurut peguam Strauss-Kahn, filem tersebut memfitnah kerana jalan ceritanya sangat mirip dengan tuduhan yang pernah dihadapi Strauss-Kahn dalam kes serangan seksual pada tahun 2011. Pada 2011, Strauss-Kahn telah ditangkap di New York semasa dia sedang bersedia untuk bertanding jawatan Presiden Perancis. Seorang pekerja hotel, Nafissatou Diallo, menuduh beliau cuba merogolnya. Walaupun pasukan guaman Strauss-Kahn berhujah bahawa hubungan itu adalah secara suka sama suka, beliau meletak jawatan sebagai ketua IMF. Diallo kemudiannya memfailkan saman sivil, yang telah diselesaikan secara kewangan dalam satu perjanjian yang tidak didedahkan. Peguam Strauss-Kahn, Jean Veil, memberitahu radio Europe 1 bahawa anak guamnya 'takut' dan 'muak' dengan filem itu, dan telah memfailkan aduan fitnah berdasarkan sindiran yang terdapat dalam filem tersebut. 'Welcome To New York' memaparkan Mr Deveraux terlibat dalam pesta seks di bilik hotel New York dan menyerang secara seksual seorang pekerja hotel, sebelum dia ditangkap. Filem itu juga menunjukkan adegan imbas kembali di mana Deveraux menyerang secara seksual seorang wartawan wanita. Filem ini menampilkan Jacqueline Bisset sebagai isteri Deveraux dan telah mempunyai tayangan perdana secara tertutup di Cannes. Ia akan ditayangkan melalui video-on-demand di Perancis dan di pawagam di negara lain termasuk UK. Sebelum tayangan di Cannes, Depardieu, pengarah Abel Ferrara, dan Bisset memperkenalkan filem itu. Depardieu menyatakan beliau tidak suka ahli politik dan berpuas hati dapat terlibat; Ferrara pula menegaskan kebebasan kreatifnya dan mengatakan Depardieu juga membiayai sebahagian daripada filem itu. Ferrara menolak tuduhan Strauss-Kahn dengan mempertahankan haknya untuk berkarya secara artistik. Filem ini menerima ulasan bercampur—ada yang memuji lakonan Depardieu, manakala ada yang mengkritik pendekatan filem ini. Penerbit Vincent Maraval mendakwa pihak elit media dan politik Perancis cuba menghalang filem ini dan tiada stesen TV Perancis mahu membiayainya.

article_content: An international manhunt has begun following the discovery of two dead women at a home in Southport, Merseyside. Angela Holgate, aged 54, and her 75-year-old mother Alice Huyton were found on Saturday evening. Police are investigating the deaths, treating the case as unexplained, with possible signs of strangulation or suffocation. Authorities want to speak with Barry Morrow, 51, a lodger at the address who may have left the country. Morrow is believed to have connections to France and Spain and is described as white, 5 feet 7 inches tall, and of medium to stocky build, with receding short brown hair and blue eyes. Police are also searching for Ms Holgate’s missing white Citroen car, license plate PN11 RWK. Officers are carrying out forensic work and speaking with neighbors while increasing patrols in the area. Chief Superintendent Nikki Holland offered condolences to the families and appealed for anyone with information to come forward—particularly Barry Morrow. Neighbors described Ms Holgate as a quiet and pleasant person who had lived in the semi-detached house for around 20 years, raising two daughters after her divorce. Morrow had only recently moved in and had done some work repaving the front garden. Residents were taken aback by the incident, noting there were no apparent sirens or emergency activity the night the bodies were found. Anyone with relevant information is urged to contact Merseyside Police at 0151 777 3165 or Crimestoppers at 0800 555 111.

Polis sedang menyiasat kematian tersebut, yang dianggap belum dapat dijelaskan, dengan kemungkinan tanda-tanda tercekik atau lemas. Pihak berkuasa ingin menemu ramah Barry Morrow, 51 tahun, seorang penyewa di alamat itu yang dipercayai telah meninggalkan negara. Morrow dipercayai mempunyai kaitan di Perancis dan Sepanyol serta digambarkan sebagai lelaki kulit putih, berketinggian 5 kaki 7 inci, berbadan sederhana hingga gempal, berambut coklat pendek yang makin menipis dan bermata biru. Polis juga sedang mencari kereta Citroen putih milik Cik Holgate, nombor pendaftaran PN11 RWK yang turut hilang. Pegawai sedang melakukan kerja forensik dan bercakap dengan jiran selain meningkatkan rondaan di kawasan sekitar. Ketua Superintenden Nikki Holland menyampaikan ucapan takziah kepada keluarga mangsa dan merayu sesiapa yang mempunyai maklumat agar tampil membantu—terutama Barry Morrow. Jiran menggambarkan Cik Holgate sebagai seorang yang pendiam dan baik hati serta telah tinggal di rumah separa berkembar itu selama kira-kira 20 tahun, membesarkan dua orang anak perempuannya selepas bercerai. Morrow baru sahaja berpindah masuk dan pernah melakukan kerja penurapan di halaman hadapan rumah berkenaan. Penduduk setempat terkejut dengan kejadian ini dan mengatakan tiada bunyi siren atau aktiviti kecemasan pada malam kejadian. Sesiapa yang mempunyai maklumat boleh menghubungi Polis Merseyside di 0151 777 3165 atau Crimestoppers di 0800 555 111.

article_content: Flood Christian Church, regularly attended by Michael Brown Sr. and his family, was one of more than a dozen buildings set on fire amid protests after the grand jury chose not to indict Officer Darren Wilson. While most destroyed buildings were located in downtown Ferguson, this church was about three miles away in a quieter area of Country Club Hills. Pastor Carlton Lee, a visible supporter of the Brown family since Michael Brown's death, suspects the church arson was carried out by white supremacists rather than protesters. He believes his advocacy, including calls for the arrest of Officer Wilson, made his church a target, and he mentioned having received multiple threats for his involvement. Remarkably, the fire happened just a day after Michael Brown Sr., along with his wife Cal and their children, participated in a baptism ceremony. The actual baptism took place at West Calvary Mission Baptist Church, but Flood Christian Church was their main place of worship. Pastor Lee voiced his heartbreak over losing the church, explaining how much effort went into building it from its previous existence as an auto shop. The church has been a non-denominational congregation since February 2013. Lee noted that Michael Brown Sr. was devastated by the incident, especially given its timing so soon after the family’s baptism. Having officiated the Browns’ wedding and supported them over the years, Pastor Lee reiterated his and Brown Sr.’s commitment to rebuild the church together, stating that this setback would not stop their work.
translated_content: Gereja Kristian Flood, yang sering dihadiri oleh Michael Brown Sr. dan keluarganya, merupakan salah satu daripada lebih selusin bangunan yang dibakar semasa protes selepas keputusan juri besar untuk tidak mendakwa Pegawai Darren Wilson. Walaupun kebanyakan bangunan yang musnah terletak di pusat bandar Ferguson, gereja ini terletak kira-kira tiga batu dari lokasi itu di kawasan yang lebih tenang di Country Club Hills. Pastor Carlton Lee, seorang penyokong tegar keluarga Brown sejak kematian Michael Brown, mengesyaki pembakaran gereja itu dilakukan oleh golongan pelampau kulit putih, bukannya penunjuk perasaan. Beliau percaya advokasinya, termasuk gesaan agar Pegawai Wilson ditahan, telah menyebabkan gerejanya dijadikan sasaran, dan beliau juga mendedahkan telah menerima pelbagai ugutan kerana penglibatannya. Lebih mengejutkan lagi, kebakaran itu berlaku hanya sehari selepas Michael Brown Sr., bersama isterinya Cal dan anak-anak mereka, mengambil bahagian dalam upacara pembaptisan. Upacara sebenar berlangsung di Gereja Baptis Misi West Calvary, namun Gereja Kristian Flood ialah tempat utama mereka beribadah. Pastor Lee meluahkan kesedihan atas kehilangan gereja tersebut, menceritakan betapa banyak usaha dicurahkan untuk membinanya daripada bekas bengkel kereta. Gereja ini telah menjadi gereja bukan denominasi sejak Februari 2013. Lee turut memberitahu bahawa Michael Brown Sr. amat terkilan dengan kejadian itu, lebih-lebih lagi kerana ia berlaku sejurus selepas pembaptisan keluarga mereka. Setelah menguruskan majlis perkahwinan keluarga Brown dan memberikan sokongan selama bertahun-tahun, Pastor Lee sekali lagi menegaskan komitmennya bersama Brown Sr. untuk membina semula gereja tersebut, dengan menyatakan cabaran ini tidak akan mematahkan semangat mereka.

article_content: Stillman College in Tuscaloosa, Alabama, established the Cybersecurity DEI Clinic in response to a 2017 cyberattack that disrupted the historically Black institution for nearly a year. Research shows ransomware attacks cost U.S. colleges and universities over $9.45 billion in 2021. The incident at Stillman underscored the importance of cybersecurity and highlighted the need to create opportunities for students across disciplines to learn more about it. Kevin Harris, Program Chair of Computational and Informational Sciences and Executive Director of Stillman’s Cybersecurity DEI Clinic, stated, 'If there was a silver lining to the attack, it’s that Stillman became the first Historically Black College to operate a university-based cybersecurity clinic under the Consortium of Cybersecurity Clinics. We’re now helping to share the importance of such clinics with peers at other HBCUs.' Interest in cybersecurity is growing at HBCUs. Twenty such institutions have established Cybersecurity Leadership Centers with support from IBM. Stillman College remains the only HBCU hosting a Cybersecurity Clinic, while other universities with similar clinics include UC-Berkeley, MIT, and Indiana University. The Clinic’s main goal is to increase cybersecurity awareness among students interested in related careers and among local small business owners. At Stillman, the clinic involves students in hands-on work with community organizations, providing training and awareness programs especially for minority-owned businesses and critical infrastructure. Drawing from prior industry experience, Harris recognized that small and medium-sized businesses—particularly those owned by people of color—are often overlooked in cybersecurity efforts. The Cybersecurity DEI Clinic aims to bridge this gap, supporting both the education of future professionals and the community's preparedness. Stillman is also creating an IT and Cybersecurity Training Center to offer non-credit courses for community members seeking valuable IT and cybersecurity skills without pursuing a formal degree. Research from Howard University and the University of Buffalo indicates that hands-on experience in college strongly motivates students—especially students of color—to enter cybersecurity. A diverse workforce is essential for fostering fresh insights and wider perspectives. As an HBCU graduate, Harris believes the diversity at HBCUs is invaluable. 'HBCUs offer a rich spectrum of perspectives, from rural to urban, small to large institutions, and across disciplines. Bringing this diversity into cybersecurity is crucial because minorities are still underrepresented,' he says. Stillman students show strong social awareness and a passion for social justice in their clinic work. Harris noted, 'Understanding how cybersecurity connects to social awareness helps our students enter the field with a broader perspective.' The clinic’s projects are diverse, including close collaborations with local organizations. Students are actively recruiting more participants, and the clinic recently received a $500,000 grant from Google’s Cybersecurity Clinics Fund to expand student teams and extend the model to other HBCUs. A key feature of the clinic is its inclusivity. Harris explained, 'Our student cohort includes both traditional and non-traditional students, including those working and supporting families. This diversity enriches our projects and learning.' Through these initiatives, Stillman College and Harris are committed to preparing students for cybersecurity careers and raising community awareness, thereby fostering a safer digital environment and strengthening resilience for both students and the broader community.
translated_content: Stillman College di Tuscaloosa, Alabama, menubuhkan Cybersecurity DEI Clinic selepas serangan siber pada 2017 yang menjejaskan institusi berkulit hitam ini hampir setahun. Kajian menunjukkan serangan ransomware menyebabkan kolej dan universiti di AS kerugian lebih $9.45 bilion pada 2021. Insiden di Stillman menekankan kepentingan keselamatan siber dan keperluan memastikan peluang untuk pelajar dari pelbagai bidang untuk mempelajarinya. Kevin Harris, Pengerusi Program Sains Komputer & Informasi serta Pengarah Eksekutif Cybersecurity DEI Clinic Stillman, berkata, 'Jika ada hikmah dari serangan itu, ialah Stillman menjadi kolej berkulit hitam pertama menjalankan klinik keselamatan siber berasaskan universiti di bawah Konsortium Klinik Keselamatan Siber. Kini kami membantu berkongsi kepentingan klinik sebegini dengan HBCU lain.' Minat terhadap keselamatan siber makin meningkat di HBCU. Dua puluh institusi sudah menubuhkan Pusat Kepimpinan Keselamatan Siber dengan sokongan IBM. Namun, Stillman College masih satu-satunya HBCU yang mempunyai Klinik Keselamatan Siber, di samping UC-Berkeley, MIT, dan Indiana University yang juga mempunyai klinik serupa. Matlamat utama klinik ini adalah untuk meningkatkan kesedaran keselamatan siber dalam kalangan pelajar dan pemilik perniagaan kecil komuniti. Di Stillman, klinik ini membabitkan pelajar secara langsung bersama organisasi masyarakat, memberikan latihan serta program kesedaran terutamanya kepada perniagaan milik minoriti dan infrastruktur penting. Melalui pengalaman industri terdahulu, Harris dapati perusahaan kecil dan sederhana—terutamanya milik golongan berwarna—sering terpinggir dalam keselamatan siber. Cybersecurity DEI Clinic mahu merapatkan jurang ini, menyokong pendidikan profesional masa depan serta kesiagaan komuniti. Stillman juga bakal membuka Pusat Latihan IT & Keselamatan Siber dengan kursus bukan kredit untuk komuniti yang mahu belajar kemahiran tersebut tanpa ijazah formal. Kajian dari Howard University dan University of Buffalo menunjukkan pengalaman amali dalam pengajian tinggi mendorong pelajar—khususnya pelajar berwarna—memilih kerjaya keselamatan siber. Tenaga kerja yang pelbagai penting bagi membuka perspektif baru dan lebih meluas. Sebagai graduan HBCU, Harris percaya kepelbagaian HBCU amat bernilai. 'HBCU membawakan pelbagai perspektif, dari luar bandar ke bandar, kecil hingga besar, dan dari pelbagai bidang. Membawa kepelbagaian ini ke keselamatan siber sangat penting kerana minoriti masih kurang diwakili,' katanya. Pelajar Stillman menonjolkan kesedaran sosial serta komitmen untuk keadilan sosial melalui projek di klinik. Harris berkata, 'Fahami kaitan keselamatan siber dengan kesedaran sosial membantu pelajar kami memasuki bidang ini dengan pandangan lebih luas.' Projek klinik ini pelbagai serta libatkan kerjasama dengan organisasi tempatan. Pelajar aktif merekrut peserta baru, dan klinik baru menerima geran $500,000 daripada Google’s Cybersecurity Clinics Fund untuk memperbesar pasukan dan meluaskan model ke HBCU lain. Ciri utama klinik ini ialah inklusivitinya. Harris jelaskan, 'Kumpulan pelajar terdiri daripada pelajar tradisional dan bukan tradisional termasuk yang bekerja dan menyara keluarga. Kepelbagaian ini memperkayakan projek dan pengalaman pembelajaran kami.' Melalui inisiatif ini, Stillman College dan Harris komited persiapkan pelajar untuk kerjaya keselamatan siber, tingkatkan kesedaran komuniti dan mewujudkan persekitaran digital lebih selamat serta ketahanan masyarakat yang lebih baik.

article_content: The idea of 'Dark Age medicine' often conjures images of bizarre and ineffective treatments, reinforced by popular culture. While some Middle Ages remedies—such as using vulture brains and bloodletting—sound unusual today, recent research shows that medieval healing had its own internal logic, blending both religious and rational elements. Although few classical medical texts were available before the 13th century, monasteries in northern Europe preserved and practiced older knowledge. Contrary to the belief that religious superstition dominated, the Dark Ages saw the emergence of 'human medicine,' where exploring nature's cures was considered a divine duty. For example, monks at the Lorsch monastery defended ancient Greek medical teachings as guided by God. Early medieval scholars worked to legitimize physicians, crafting works and illustrations that linked medical practice with Christian values. This effort led to medicine becoming a formal university subject and to the licensing of practitioners. Female healers, surgeons, and herbalists also contributed significantly, particularly in gynecology. Diagnosis in medieval times relied on careful observation—signs like urine, sweat, and pulse were key, as technology to look inside the body did not exist. It was widely believed that the body's balance mirrored forces in nature, like the cycles of the moon and seasonal shifts. Medieval treatments included fasting, bloodletting, and seasonal diets intended to keep the body in balance. Some remedies, like using a mixture of wine, cow bile, garlic, and onion for eye infections, have proven effective when tested with modern methods. The article suggests that medieval medicine was not purely superstitious, but instead combined faith and logic in complex ways. Modern trends, like detox diets, reflect echoes of these old ideas about balancing the body. In the end, readers are encouraged to look beyond simplistic stereotypes of medieval medicine and to see how historical perspectives continue to influence current health practices.

Bertentangan dengan kepercayaan bahawa takhayul agama mendominasi, Zaman Gelap sebenarnya menyaksikan kemunculan 'perubatan manusia', di mana mencari penawar dari alam dianggap sebagai tugas suci. Contohnya, rahib di biara Lorsch mempertahankan ajaran perubatan Yunani sebagai ilham Tuhan. Cendekiawan awal abad pertengahan berusaha mengiktiraf doktor sebagai profesional, menghasilkan karya dan ilustrasi yang mengaitkan amalan perubatan dengan nilai Kristian. Diagnosis masa itu bergantung pada pemerhatian teliti—petunjuk seperti air kencing, peluh dan nadi amat penting kerana tiada teknologi untuk melihat dalam badan. Masyarakat percaya bahawa keseimbangan badan terikat dengan kuasa alam seperti kitaran bulan dan perubahan musim. article_content:
Thanksgiving is a time for Americans to gather and celebrate, but not everyone agrees about what's best on the dinner table. While pumpkin pie is widely enjoyed, there’s ongoing debate over turkey preferences—whether white or dark meat is better. Arguments also arise over less traditional dishes, like marshmallows on sweet potatoes.

A new Associated Press-NORC Center for Public Affairs Research poll found that around 32% of U.S. adults celebrating Thanksgiving name turkey as their favorite dish. Stuffing or dressing was second at 19%, followed by mashed potatoes at 6%. “Thanksgiving—it’s about turkey,” says Ralph Caya, 71, from Pensacola, Florida. However, for lifelong vegetarian Vaidehi Upadhyaya, 27, from Glen Rock, New Jersey, side dishes are the main attraction.

Turkey tops menus across all ages and regions, but preferences differ by generation: Americans aged 45 and older are more likely to pick turkey as their favorite (39%), compared to only 24% of younger adults. When it comes to turkey meat, 43% of celebrators prefer white meat, 28% prefer dark meat, and 21% have no preference. Older Americans are more likely to choose dark meat (31%) than those under 45 (24%), and about 10% of adults under 45 don’t like turkey at all.

Carlos Stallworth, 58, of Los Angeles, favors white meat for making sandwiches: “You’re not going to get a great slice of dark meat to go on a sandwich. But with the white meat, you get that.”

Cranberries are less loved—about 20% say cranberries or cranberry sauce wouldn’t be missed, though KRC Research reports 80 million pounds are eaten during Thanksgiving week. Caya calls them “important,” while Upadhyaya is indifferent: “I’ll eat it if it’s there, but it’s not exciting.” Stallworth enjoys the contrast that cranberries bring, describing them as a must at the meal.

People are also divided on cranberry sauce: 24% prefer it canned, 22% like it homemade, and 35% don’t like cranberry sauce at all. Younger adults are more likely than older adults to dislike it.

Pumpkin pie is the most popular Thanksgiving dessert, with one-third of celebrators naming it their favorite, followed by pecan pie (17%), apple pie (15%), and sweet potato pie (12%). Chocolate, cherry, and berry pies get fewer votes. Caya goes for pecan pie, influenced by living close to Georgia.

A particularly contentious issue is the use of marshmallows on sweet potato dishes. About 32% prefer no marshmallows, 26% want them, while a quarter don’t like sweet potato dishes, and 16% have no preference. Regional differences show Northeasterners (42%) are more likely to skip marshmallows than Midwesterners or Southerners (both 29%). Upadhyaya, who has experienced both, feels marshmallows don’t change the dish much.

For Lauren Feldman, 39, of Indianapolis, the homemade touch is the secret to a memorable meal. Each year, her mother prepares turkey, sides, cranberry sauce from scratch, and pumpkin pie with homemade crust. For Feldman, this human touch makes all the difference compared to store-bought versions.

Among Thanksgiving cooks, women (34%) are more likely than men (19%) to do all or most of the cooking, while nearly half of men (46%) do little or none, compared with one-quarter of women.

The poll surveyed 1,239 adults from November 2 to 6, 2023, with a margin of error of ±3.9 percentage points.

Hari Kesyukuran ialah masa rakyat Amerika berkumpul dan meraikan, namun tidak semua bersetuju tentang hidangan terbaik di atas meja. Walaupun pai labu menjadi pilihan ramai, masih wujud perdebatan tentang ayam belanda—adakah bahagian putih atau gelap lebih sedap. Perselisihan turut timbul berhubung hidangan yang kurang tradisional seperti marshmallow atas ubi keledek.

Tinjauan baharu oleh Associated Press-NORC Center for Public Affairs Research mendapati kira-kira 32% orang dewasa di Amerika yang meraikan Hari Kesyukuran memilih ayam belanda sebagai hidangan kegemaran. Stafing atau dressing di tempat kedua (19%), diikuti kentang putar (6%). “Hari Kesyukuran—memang mengenai ayam belanda,” kata Ralph Caya, 71, dari Pensacola, Florida. Namun bagi vegetarian seumur hidup, Vaidehi Upadhyaya, 27, dari Glen Rock, New Jersey, hidangan sampingan adalah tumpuan utama.

Ayam belanda adalah pilihan utama semua peringkat umur dan kawasan tetapi citarasa berbeza mengikut generasi: mereka berumur 45 ke atas lebih memilih ayam belanda (39%), berbanding 24% golongan muda. Untuk bahagian ayam belanda, 43% suka bahagian putih, 28% suka bahagian gelap dan 21% tiada pilihan. Warga lebih tua lebih suka bahagian gelap (31%) berbanding bawah 45 tahun (24%), dan kira-kira 10% di bawah 45 tahun tidak gemarkan ayam belanda langsung.

Carlos Stallworth, 58, dari Los Angeles, pilih bahagian putih untuk sandwic: "Bahagian gelap susah nak buat sandwic. Bahagian putih, boleh.”

Cranberi kurang digemari—sekitar 20% rasa cranberi atau sosnya tidak diperlukan, walaupun KRC Research lapor 80 juta paun cranberi dimakan sepanjang minggu Hari Kesyukuran. Caya kata cranberi "penting", Upadhyaya tak kisah: "Saya makan kalau ada, tapi tak seronok sangat." Stallworth pula suka gabungan rasa cranberi dan anggap ia wajib.

Soal sos cranberi, orang ramai terbahagi: 24% suka versi tin, 22% suka buatan sendiri, 35% tak suka langsung sos cranberi. Golongan muda lebih tak suka berbanding warga tua.

Pai labu ialah pencuci mulut paling popular; satu pertiga memilihnya sebagai kegemaran, diikuti pai pecan (17%), pai epal (15%), dan pai ubi keledek (12%). Pai coklat, ceri, dan beri kurang pilihan. Caya pilih pai pecan memandangkan dia dekat Georgia.

Isu paling diperdebatkan ialah marshmallow atas ubi keledek: 32% kata tak nak, 26% nak, 25% tak suka ubi keledek, dan 16% tak kisah. Dari segi kawasan, Northeasterners (42%) lebih cenderung tolak marshmallow berbanding Midwest atau Selatan (kedua-dua 29%). Upadhyaya rasa marshmallow tak banyak ubah rasa hidangan.

Buat Lauren Feldman, 39, dari Indianapolis, sentuhan buatan sendiri rahsia kemeriahan. Ibunya sediakan ayam belanda, pelbagai lauk sampingan, sos cranberi buatan sendiri, dan pai labu dengan kerak homemade. Katanya, kalau semuanya beli di kedai, dia takkan suka sangat.

Wanita (34%) lebih cenderung memasak semua atau sebahagian besar hidangan berbanding lelaki (19%), manakala hampir separuh lelaki (46%) kata mereka jarang atau tak masak langsung, berbanding hanya suku wanita.

Tinjauan melibatkan 1,239 orang dewasa pada 2-6 November 2023, dengan margin ralat ±3.9 mata peratus.

India’s fifth and final phase of general elections concluded on Wednesday, marking the end of a month-long voting process to select the country’s federal government. With approximately 714 million eligible voters, counting for the 543 seats in the lower house of parliament is set for Saturday. According to election commission spokesperson Rajesh Malhotra, the last phase recorded a 62% voter turnout.

Elections took place across 28 states and seven federal territories. As polling closed on Wednesday, stock markets dropped by 138.4 points, reflecting investor unease over possible political instability.

Prime Minister Manmohan Singh’s Congress party, which led a communist-backed coalition to victory in 2004, seeks re-election, mainly facing an alliance led by the Hindu nationalist Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). Over recent years, regional parties have grown in importance, ensuring that power is now shared among coalition partners in the federal government. Last year, Singh’s Congress party lost the support of the communists after they opposed the U.S.-India civilian nuclear agreement; the government survived with backing from a powerful regional party.

Dengan kira-kira 714 juta pengundi yang layak, pengiraan bagi 543 kerusi di Dewan Rakyat akan diadakan pada hari Sabtu. Menurut jurucakap Suruhanjaya Pilihan Raya, Rajesh Malhotra, fasa terakhir ini mencatatkan peratusan keluar mengundi sebanyak 62%.

Pilihan raya dijalankan di 28 negeri dan tujuh wilayah persekutuan. Ketika pengundian ditutup pada hari Rabu, pasaran saham turun sebanyak 138.4 mata, menandakan kebimbangan pelabur mengenai kemungkinan ketidakstabilan politik.

Parti Kongres pimpinan Perdana Menteri Manmohan Singh, yang sebelum ini mengetuai gabungan yang disokong komunis pada kemenangan tahun 2004, bertanding untuk dipilih semula dan berdepan dengan gabungan utama yang diterajui Parti Bharatiya Janata (BJP) yang berfahaman nasionalis Hindu. Sejak beberapa tahun kebelakangan ini, parti-parti serantau semakin memainkan peranan penting sehingga kuasa di peringkat kerajaan pusat kini dikongsi rakan gabungan. Tahun lalu, Parti Kongres kehilangan sokongan komunis selepas mereka menentang perjanjian nuklear awam India-AS; kerajaan bertahan dengan sokongan parti serantau yang berkuasa.

article_content: Commuters in London may soon have the option to pick up Amazon orders at local Underground stations, as plans are underway to convert ticket offices into parcel collection points. Transport for London (TfL) is reportedly in discussions with Amazon after the announcement that all 240 ticket offices will close by 2015, resulting in the loss of 750 jobs. Mayor of London Boris Johnson announced the closures and a new 24-hour Tube service on certain lines over weekends, aiming to fully automate ticket sales. It has been reported that TfL may collaborate with Amazon to transform these soon-to-be empty offices into parcel pick-up locations. Pick-up lockers could be installed in these spaces, allowing customers to collect online purchases and avoid missed home deliveries. This news follows Asda’s recent partnership with TfL to offer similar ‘click and collect’ services at six Underground station car parks. Customers can choose to have Amazon deliveries dropped at a locker, reducing the risk of missing a delivery. Once a parcel arrives, buyers receive an email with a unique code and barcode for collection. Customers have three business days to collect their parcels before they are returned to Amazon for a refund. Next day locker delivery costs £1.99, while a free, two-day option is also available. Amazon declined to comment on the ongoing talks. Graeme Craig, Director of Commercial Development at TfL, stated that their vision for the future includes 24-hour weekend services, improved ticketing, easier refunds, and Wi-Fi across the network. He confirmed all stations will remain staffed during operations. TfL is working with retailers like Asda to trial click and collect services and is seeking similar partnerships. Mayor Johnson and London Underground Managing Director Mike Brown announced these major changes, which will be implemented over the next two years. Six central London stations will have customer points to assist with ticket machines, and every station will continue to be staffed while operational. The new night service will initially operate on the Piccadilly, Victoria, Central, Jubilee, and parts of the Northern lines, mainly north of the Thames. Other planned changes include upgraded ticket machines, contactless bank card payments, extended Wi-Fi coverage, and staff positioned in ticket halls and on platforms rather than in ticket offices. TfL asserts that these measures will benefit customers and are projected to save over £40 million annually. Mayor Johnson described the 24-hour service as a significant development for London, expected to boost jobs, the city's night-time economy, and its global reputation. Unions, including the TSSA and the Rail Maritime and Transport union, have opposed these plans, warning of major job cuts, impacts on staff safety, and threats of industrial action. Shadow London minister Sadiq Khan raised concerns about reduced staff and passenger safety, particularly regarding assistance for issues like lost or stolen Oyster cards and emergency situations. London Underground has stated their commitment to reducing staff numbers without compulsory redundancies. Managing Director Mike Brown reassured that all stations would remain staffed, with a focus on visibility, customer service, and safety. This plan seeks to achieve savings of £270 million as part of TfL’s business plan up to 2020/21.

Datuk Bandar London, Boris Johnson, mengumumkan penutupan ini serta perkhidmatan Tube 24 jam pada beberapa laluan hujung minggu, dengan tujuan untuk sepenuhnya mengautomasikan penjualan tiket. Graeme Craig, Pengarah Pembangunan Komersial TfL, menyatakan visi masa depan mereka termasuk perkhidmatan hujung minggu 24 jam, penambahbaikan tiket, bayaran balik yang lebih mudah, dan Wi-Fi di seluruh rangkaian. TfL sedang bekerjasama dengan peruncit seperti Asda untuk ujian perkhidmatan klik dan ambil serta mencari kerjasama serupa. Datuk Bandar Johnson dan Pengarah Urusan London Underground, Mike Brown, mengumumkan perubahan utama ini yang akan dilaksanakan dalam tempoh dua tahun akan datang. Enam stesen pusat London akan mempunyai tempat khas untuk membantu dengan mesin tiket dan semua stesen akan terus dikawal oleh kakitangan semasa operasi. Perubahan lain yang dirancang termasuk penaiktarafan mesin tiket, bayaran kad bank tanpa sentuh, liputan Wi-Fi yang diperluas, dan kakitangan diletakkan di dewan tiket serta di platform berbanding di pejabat tiket. TfL menegaskan langkah-langkah ini memberi manfaat kepada pelanggan dan dijangka menjimatkan lebih £40 juta setahun. Datuk Bandar Johnson menyifatkan perkhidmatan 24 jam ini sebagai kemajuan penting untuk London, dijangka meningkatkan peluang pekerjaan, ekonomi malam ibu kota, serta reputasinya di peringkat dunia. Kesatuan sekerja seperti TSSA dan Kesatuan Rel Maritim & Pengangkutan membantah rancangan ini, memberi amaran tentang pemotongan kerja besar-besaran, impak keselamatan staf, dan ancaman tindakan industri. Menteri bayangan London, Sadiq Khan, membangkitkan kebimbangan mengenai pengurangan kakitangan dan keselamatan penumpang, terutama dalam membantu isu seperti kad Oyster yang hilang atau dicuri dan situasi kecemasan. London Underground menyatakan komitmen mereka untuk mengurangkan bilangan kakitangan tanpa pemberhentian paksa. Pengarah Urusan Mike Brown memberi jaminan bahawa semua stesen akan terus dikendalikan kakitangan dengan penekanan pada keterlihatan, khidmat pelanggan, dan keselamatan. Rancangan ini bertujuan mencapai penjimatan sebanyak £270 juta sebagai sebahagian daripada pelan perniagaan TfL sehingga 2020/21.

article_content: Cesc Fabregas is making his return to the English Premier League after securing a five-year contract with Chelsea, following his transfer from Barcelona. Having started his professional career with Barcelona, Fabregas played for Arsenal from 2003 to 2011 before spending three seasons back at the Catalan club. "I want to thank everyone at Barcelona for three wonderful years. Playing for my childhood club was a dream come true, and I will always be proud of that," Fabregas remarked in a statement on Chelsea's website. At 27, he is currently representing Spain at the World Cup in Brazil. Chelsea finished third in last season’s Premier League, which earned them a place in the Champions League. Under returning manager Jose Mourinho, the team also reached the Champions League semifinals, where they were eliminated by Atletico Madrid. With Fabregas joining Chelsea, Mourinho will have even greater depth in midfield, adding to talents like Eden Hazard, Oscar, Ramires, Nemanja Matic, and John Obi Mikel. Fabregas shared his reasons for coming back to England, saying, "I feel I have unfinished business in the Premier League, and now is the right time to return. After considering my choices, I am convinced Chelsea is the best club for me, as their ambition and hunger for trophies align with mine." Barcelona released a statement thanking Fabregas for his professionalism and dedication during his years at the club. The Spanish club will receive at least $45.4 million for the transfer, with the final amount possibly increasing due to contractual bonuses. It is also reported that Chelsea is keen on signing Atletico Madrid’s Spanish striker, Diego Costa.
translated_content: Cesc Fabregas akan kembali ke Liga Perdana Inggeris selepas menandatangani kontrak lima tahun bersama Chelsea, susulan perpindahannya dari Barcelona. Fabregas, yang memulakan kerjaya profesionalnya bersama Barcelona, pernah bermain untuk Arsenal dari 2003 hingga 2011 sebelum kembali tiga musim di kelab Catalan itu. "Saya ingin mengucapkan terima kasih kepada semua di Barcelona atas tiga tahun yang penuh bermakna. Beraksi untuk kelab zaman kanak-kanak saya adalah impian jadi kenyataan dan saya akan sentiasa berbangga dengan itu," kata Fabregas dalam satu kenyataan di laman web Chelsea. Pada umur 27 tahun, dia kini mewakili Sepanyol di Piala Dunia di Brazil. Chelsea menamatkan saingan Liga Perdana musim lalu di tempat ketiga, yang memastikan kelab itu layak ke Liga Juara-Juara Eropah. Di bawah pengurus yang kembali, Jose Mourinho, mereka turut mara ke separuh akhir Liga Juara-Juara sebelum disingkirkan Atletico Madrid. Dengan kehadiran Fabregas di Chelsea, Mourinho kini mempunyai lebih banyak pilihan di bahagian tengah, menambah kekuatan kepada pemain sedia ada seperti Eden Hazard, Oscar, Ramires, Nemanja Matic, dan John Obi Mikel. Fabregas berkongsi sebabnya kembali ke England, "Saya rasa saya masih ada perkara yang belum selesai di Liga Perdana, dan sekaranglah masa yang tepat untuk kembali. Selepas meneliti pilihan yang ada, saya yakin Chelsea adalah kelab terbaik untuk saya kerana cita-cita dan keinginan mereka untuk meraih trofi selari dengan matlamat saya." Barcelona mengeluarkan kenyataan yang mengucapkan terima kasih kepada Fabregas atas profesionalisme dan dedikasinya sepanjang berada di kelab itu. Kelab Sepanyol itu akan menerima sekurang-kurangnya $45.4 juta daripada perpindahan ini, dengan jumlah akhir mungkin meningkat bergantung kepada bonus kontrak. Chelsea turut dilaporkan berminat untuk mendapatkan penyerang Sepanyol dari Atletico Madrid, Diego Costa.

article_content: To help repair his troubled marriage with Tori Spelling, Dean McDermott made it a priority to come home during a difficult time. While Dean was filming Chopped Canada, Tori managed her new TV show, Mystery Girls, and cared for their four children on her own. The situation intensified when their daughter Stella, age five, needed a tonsillectomy and their son Liam, age seven, fell ill with the flu. Feeling stressed, Tori received unexpected support when Dean asked producers for time off, allowing him to fly back to Los Angeles to assist. Dean arrived just in time to go with Tori and Stella to the hospital, help care for Liam, and manage the household. He prepared comforting meals, like chicken soup for Stella and casseroles for the family, and made sure the fridge was stocked for when he left. Continuing a family tradition, Stella brought a stuffed dog named Angel—passed down from Tori’s own childhood surgery—into her operation for comfort. Dean intended to stay until after Stella’s sixth birthday celebration, before returning to Toronto. Tori felt supported and saw Dean’s actions as a meaningful step forward for their relationship.

Keadaan bertambah mencabar apabila anak perempuan mereka, Stella, berumur lima tahun, perlu menjalani pembedahan tonsil dan anak lelaki mereka, Liam, tujuh tahun, terkena selesema. Apabila Tori terasa sangat tertekan, Dean telah meminta cuti daripada penerbit dan dibenarkan pulang ke Los Angeles untuk membantu. Dean sempat menemani Tori dan Stella ke hospital, menjaga Liam, dan menguruskan tugas rumah. Dia juga menyediakan hidangan seperti sup ayam untuk Stella dan kaserol untuk keluarga, serta memastikan peti sejuk terisi dengan makanan mudah untuk Tori panaskan selepas pemergiannya. Mengikut tradisi keluarga, Stella membawa bersama anjing mainan bernama Angel—yang asalnya milik Tori ketika beliau menjalani pembedahan tonsil masa kecil—sebagai peneman dalam pembedahan. Dean akan tinggal hingga selepas majlis sambutan hari jadi keenam Stella sebelum pulang semula ke Toronto. Tori begitu terharu dan menganggap usaha Dean ini satu langkah positif dalam memperbaiki hubungan mereka.

article_content: With the festive season underway, British shoppers are turning to supermarkets for affordable beauty products as they prepare for Christmas celebrations. Facing tighter budgets, many are choosing to add beauty essentials to their weekly grocery trips at stores like Morrisons, Sainsbury's, and Asda. Supermarkets are responding to the increased demand by heavily stocking their shelves. Morrisons, for example, has supplied 3,500 sets of false eyelashes, 22,000 units of fake tan, 62,000 units of hair dye, and over 85,000 bottles of nail varnish in the lead-up to December 25. A spokesperson from Morrisons said the office Christmas party is a chance to relax and celebrate the end of the work year. They emphasized that to help customers feel confident for their festivities, the supermarket has ensured an ample supply of beauty products. Demand at Asda is expected to soar, with projected sales increases of 60% for false eyelashes and 80% for mascara. Gemma Goldstraw, Asda's beauty expert, noted that their beauty products—including Shimmer Me bronzers and Cheeky Tint—offer affordable ways for customers to add a touch of glamour to their celebrations. She expects sales of fake tan, lip gloss, and Andrew Barton's S.O.S Last Another Day Dry Shampoo to rise as parties approach. At Sainsbury's, hair styling appliances are especially popular. According to Robert Cooke, Sainsbury's Head of Buying for Electrical Goods, the store has seen electrical beauty product sales rapidly increase as shoppers look for salon-quality results at home. This year’s top sellers include products from the exclusive Phil Smith Salon Collection, such as the Multi Styler, Curling Wand, and Salon Collection Hair Dryer. A new £20 beauty gift pack, called 'the supermarket facial,' has become a surprise hit at Sainsbury's, selling out 20,000 units in its first week. To meet demand, the retailer is ordering more stock. The kit, made by Nip + Fab, features spa-inspired treatments—such as facial scrub, hydrating mask, moisturiser, body wash, and hand and eye cream—typically costing much more at a spa. A Nip + Fab spokesperson highlighted that the pamper kit was created by beauty experts with twenty years of experience and is deliberately priced to be accessible. As more people seek effective at-home beauty options, this kit offers a 20-minute facial treatment at home for a fraction of spa prices. Celebrity beauty therapist Nuz Sugaa added that Nip + Fab products contain premium ingredients, aiming to mirror results of professional facials by covering exfoliation, cleansing, hydration, and protection. The growing popularity of the kit reflects rising beauty awareness and a desire for self-care despite busy lifestyles.
