article_content: By David Baker. Last updated at 2:02 PM on 28th January 2012. Anton Ferdinand was spared from having to shake John Terry's hand prior to QPR's FA Cup clash with Chelsea. The Football Association (FA) allowed both clubs to forego the traditional pre-match handshake due to uncertainty about whether QPR defender Ferdinand would accept Terry's gesture. This was the first encounter between the teams since Chelsea captain John Terry was charged with racially abusing Ferdinand during October's Premier League match. Terry denies the accusation while Ferdinand reportedly agonized over whether to accept his handshake. The FA stated: 'Following discussions involving senior officials from QPR, Chelsea and the FA, it has been agreed there will not be the usual team handshake before today's FA Cup fourth-round tie at Loftus Road. The FA agreed to the request by both clubs to help defuse tensions.' During the match, Ferdinand received loud support from the home fans on his first touch. After halftime, reports surfaced of objects being thrown between sections of both clubs’ supporters. Chelsea went ahead near the hour mark when QPR goalkeeper Paddy Kenny was beaten by a Juan Mata penalty, after Daniel Sturridge was fouled by Clint Hill. Mata’s spot kick secured a 1-0 victory for Chelsea. However, the handshake's cancellation remained a significant topic. This is not John Terry's first handshake controversy. Two years prior, Manchester City defender Wayne Bridge snubbed Terry's hand after allegations emerged about Terry's affair with Bridge's former partner, Vanessa Perroncel. Ahead of the match, Ferdinand reportedly received a death threat—a bullet sent through the post—prompting investigation by Metropolitan Police officers from Hammersmith and Fulham. The incident echoed previous threats against football figures, like Celtic manager Neil Lennon. Despite this, Ferdinand started the game. Ferdinand was allegedly subjected to racist abuse during the previous league encounter, which QPR won 1-0. This fixture took place just four days before Terry's court appearance. Security was reinforced at Loftus Road and the kickoff was brought forward to noon amid concerns about potential crowd trouble. Police were present as Chelsea players arrived. Officials from both clubs and law enforcement warned fans regarding their conduct. QPR manager Mark Hughes stated that any inappropriate behavior or chanting would lead to ejection. Chelsea manager Andre Villas-Boas highlighted the importance of sportsmanship, expressing hope that Ferdinand would not refuse Terry’s handshake and stressing the game’s values. Villas-Boas noted the issue had been discussed throughout the club and confirmed Terry’s availability. He said there were no extra instructions regarding the hostile atmosphere, trusting in professional conduct. Hughes emphasized that the handshake decision was Ferdinand’s alone and not influenced by the club or manager. Both managers wished the focus would stay on the match, encouraging supporters to act responsibly.

Anton Ferdinand tidak perlu berjabat tangan dengan John Terry sebelum perlawanan Piala FA antara QPR dan Chelsea. Persatuan Bola Sepak (FA) membenarkan kedua-dua kelab untuk tidak melakukan jabat tangan pra-perlawanan tradisional kerana ketidakpastian sama ada pemain pertahanan QPR, Ferdinand, akan menerima jabat tangan Terry. Ini adalah pertemuan pertama antara kedua-dua pasukan sejak kapten Chelsea, John Terry, didakwa melakukan penghinaan berunsur perkauman terhadap Ferdinand semasa perlawanan Liga Perdana pada bulan Oktober. Terry menafikan tuduhan ini manakala Ferdinand dilaporkan berbelah bahagi sama ada ingin menerima jabat tangan tersebut. FA menyatakan: 'Selepas perbincangan melibatkan pegawai kanan QPR, Chelsea dan FA, telah dipersetujui bahawa tiada jabat tangan berpasukan seperti biasa sebelum perlawanan Pusingan Keempat Piala FA di Loftus Road. FA bersetuju dengan permintaan kedua-dua kelab untuk membantu meredakan ketegangan.' Semasa perlawanan, Ferdinand menerima sorakan gemuruh daripada penyokong tuan rumah pada sentuhan pertamanya. Selepas separuh masa, terdapat laporan objek dilemparkan antara penyokong kedua-dua pasukan. Chelsea mendahului hampir sejam permainan apabila penjaga gol QPR, Paddy Kenny, ditewaskan sepakan penalti oleh Juan Mata selepas Daniel Sturridge dijatuhkan oleh Clint Hill. Sepakan penalti Mata memastikan kemenangan 1-0 untuk Chelsea. Namun, pembatalan ritual jabat tangan tetap menjadi topik utama. Ini bukan kali pertama John Terry terlibat dalam kontroversi jabat tangan. Dua tahun sebelum itu, pemain pertahanan Manchester City, Wayne Bridge, menolak tangan Terry selepas timbul dakwaan mengenai hubungan Terry dengan bekas pasangan Bridge, Vanessa Perroncel. Menjelang perlawanan, Ferdinand dilaporkan menerima ancaman bunuh — sebutir peluru dihantar melalui pos — menyebabkan Polis Metropolitan dari Hammersmith dan Fulham menjalankan siasatan. Insiden ini mengimbas kembali ancaman yang pernah diterima tokoh bola sepak lain seperti pengurus Celtic, Neil Lennon. Namun begitu, Ferdinand tetap bermain dalam perlawanan ini. Ferdinand didakwa menjadi mangsa penghinaan berunsur perkauman semasa pertemuan liga sebelum ini, yang dimenangi QPR 1-0. Perlawanan ini berlangsung hanya empat hari sebelum tarikh mahkamah Terry. Keselamatan di Loftus Road diperketatkan dan sepak mula diawalkan ke tengah hari bagi mengelak sebarang kekecohan. Polis mengawasi kehadiran pemain Chelsea. Pegawai kelab dan pihak berkuasa mengingatkan penyokong supaya menjaga tingkah laku mereka. Pengurus QPR, Mark Hughes, berkata sebarang perlakuan atau sorakan tidak sesuai akan menyebabkan penonton diusir. Pengurus Chelsea, Andre Villas-Boas, menekankan pentingnya nilai kesukanan, berharap Ferdinand tidak menolak bersalaman dengan Terry serta menekankan nilai-nilai permainan. Villas-Boas memaklumkan isu tersebut telah dibincangkan secara meluas dalam kelab dan Terry masih boleh bermain. Beliau berkata tiada arahan khusus diberikan mengenai suasana panas, percaya kepada profesionalisme pasukan. Hughes menegaskan keputusan bersalaman hanya terletak pada Ferdinand dan tidak dipengaruhi kelab mahupun pengurus. Kedua-dua pengurus berharap tumpuan kekal pada bola sepak dan penyokong bertindak secara bertanggungjawab.

article_content:
After years of silence, Swedish golfer Henrik Stenson has opened up about being defrauded by Allen Stanford in 2009, when he lost millions. Last year, Stenson marked a point of closure as he returned to Orlando after victories at the Tour Championship and FedEx Cup, having earned over $11 million—almost as much as he lost to Stanford. As his flight passed over the Florida prison where Stanford is likely incarcerated, Stenson reflected on how life sometimes restores balance. He expressed gratitude for his recovery but also empathy for those who were unable to recoup their losses.

Stenson acknowledged the pain the scam caused, but emphasized his ability to move forward. Although his coach, Pete Cowen, and others suspect his financial loss contributed to his period of poor performance, Stenson prefers to view it as an occupational risk—akin to the gamble of a professional golf career.

Recently, Stenson has re-established himself among golf’s best by topping money lists in both Europe and the U.S., totaling approximately $21 million in on-course earnings. He was the first to secure a spot on the European Ryder Cup team, where he will make his third appearance after a six-year gap. Despite a temporary drop in form, Stenson feels optimistic about his play and values his role as both a performer and leader in the team.

Uniquely, Stenson has twice rebounded from steep career setbacks, each time falling outside the world’s top 200 and later rising back into the top five. At age 38, his leadership and sense of humor make him a vital presence, able to mentor younger players like Victor Dubuisson and potentially partner with Thomas Bjorn.

At the BMW Championship, Stenson requires a top-four finish to qualify for upcoming titles in Atlanta. He started strongly with a first-round score of 68, alongside Sergio Garcia and Martin Kaymer. Rory McIlroy, Jordan Spieth, and Gary Woodland led with 67, while Justin Rose scored 69 and Graeme McDowell finished at 73.

Selepas bertahun-tahun berdiam diri, pemain golf dari Sweden, Henrik Stenson, akhirnya terbuka tentang pengalaman ditipu Allen Stanford pada tahun 2009 sehingga mengalami kerugian berjuta-juta dolar. Tahun lalu, Stenson mencapai detik penutup apabila pulang ke Orlando selepas menjuarai Tour Championship dan FedEx Cup, meraih lebih $11 juta—jumlah hampir sama seperti yang pernah hilang akibat Stanford. Ketika pesawat beliau melintasi penjara di Florida, lokasi Stanford didakwa dipenjarakan, Stenson merenung bagaimana hidup kadang-kadang mengembalikan imbangan. Dia bersyukur atas pemulihannya tetapi turut simpati kepada mereka yang tidak berpeluang menebus semula kerugian mereka.

Stenson mengakui detik sukar itu memberi kesan mendalam, namun menegaskan dirinya berjaya bangkit. Walaupun jurulatihnya, Pete Cowen, serta beberapa pihak percaya kerugian kewangan itu menjejaskan prestasinya, Stenson memilih menerima ia sebagai lumrah risiko profesional—sama seperti perjudian dalam dunia golf.

Kini, Stenson kembali unggul apabila mendahului senarai pendapatan di Eropah dan Amerika Syarikat, dengan kutipan lebih kurang $21 juta daripada kejohanan. Beliau pemain terawal melayakkan diri ke pasukan Ryder Cup Eropah, penampilan ketiganya selepas enam tahun. Walaupun prestasinya pernah menurun, Stenson kini optimis dan menghargai peranan utama dalam pasukan.

Menariknya, Stenson sudah dua kali pulih daripada kejatuhan besar, setiap kali jatuh di luar kedudukan 200 dunia sebelum kembali ke lima terbaik. Pada usia 38 tahun, kebolehan kepimpinan dan sifat humornya jadikan beliau tulang belakang pasukan—serasi membimbing pemain muda seperti Victor Dubuisson dan mungkin berpasangan mantap dengan Thomas Bjorn.

Di Kejohanan BMW, Stenson perlu menamatkan dalam empat teratas untuk layak ke kejohanan seterusnya di Atlanta. Dia bermula baik, mencatat 68 pada pusingan pertama, setaraf Sergio Garcia dan Martin Kaymer. Rory McIlroy, Jordan Spieth, dan Gary Woodland mendahului dengan 67, manakala Justin Rose memungut 69 dan Graeme McDowell mendapat 73.

article_content: Two police officers from Fruitland Park, Florida, are no longer with the department after allegations surfaced of their involvement in a local branch of the Ku Klux Klan. Deputy Chief David Borst, 49, resigned, and Officer George Hunnewell was dismissed following revelations in a confidential FBI report provided to the Fruitland Park Police by the Florida Department of Law Enforcement (FDLE). While membership in the Ku Klux Klan is not a criminal offense, Police Chief Terry Isaacs said the allegations raised concerns about the officers' credibility and the public's perception of the department. Chief Isaacs reported he had no direct proof the officers were members, but found the FBI report convincing enough to warrant action. Both officers were placed on administrative leave as an internal investigation was launched. David Borst, who had served more than 20 years and was also the city’s fire chief, denied involvement but resigned from both roles after contacting his family. George Hunnewell, with a disciplinary record including a demotion in 2013 and five counseling letters within a year, was dismissed following a review of his performance. The investigation was part of a larger FBI probe, with the FDLE then examining department standards and ethics before returning the matter to Chief Isaacs. In 2009, another officer, James Elkins, resigned after photos emerged of him in Klan attire. Police Chief Isaacs said the FBI assured him no other officers in the department are implicated.
translated_content: Dua anggota polis dari Fruitland Park, Florida, tidak lagi bersama jabatan selepas dakwaan timbul mengenai penglibatan mereka dalam cawangan setempat Ku Klux Klan. Walaupun menjadi ahli Ku Klux Klan bukan satu kesalahan jenayah, Ketua Polis Terry Isaacs berkata dakwaan tersebut menimbulkan kebimbangan tentang kredibiliti pegawai terbabit serta imej jabatan di mata masyarakat. Ketua Polis Isaacs menyatakan beliau tidak mempunyai bukti langsung pegawai-pegawai itu adalah ahli, tetapi mendapati laporan FBI cukup meyakinkan untuk mengambil tindakan. Kedua-dua pegawai telah diletakkan dalam cuti pentadbiran sementara siasatan dalaman dijalankan. article_content: At least 71 iPads, valued at more than $48,000, went missing last year from the Los Angeles Unified School District (LAUSD). These devices were part of a 13-school pilot of a $1 billion initiative designed to enhance education by providing an iPad to every student in the district. The majority of missing iPads, each worth about $678, disappeared from the Valley Academy of Arts and Sciences in Granada Hills, California, where 1,200 iPads were distributed. By the end of the year, 69 were unaccounted for from this school. Although each missing iPad was linked to a particular student, officials noted that if a student claimed they had returned their device, the district had little way to prove otherwise, according to the Los Angeles Times. Despite the loss, LAUSD plans to give free iPads to all 640,000 students by 2014. District officials have introduced new security measures since the devices went missing. 'We have a very vigorous control for this rollout,' said Lt. Jose Santome of the school district’s Police Department. 'We know what’s going out and deployed on every campus.' So far, around 14,000 iPads have been delivered across 49 of the district's K-12 schools as part of the ongoing rollout. However, implementation has faced delays. Recently, LAUSD suspended home use of the iPads after almost 300 students learned to bypass security settings, allowing them to access any website, including social media, instead of only educational content. As a result, officials are reviewing strategies to ensure that iPads—preinstalled with educational applications—are used strictly for academic purposes. CiteWorld reported that educators believe computer literacy is essential in today's workforce, driving the $1 billion initiative. 'We are making sure everyone can take tests electronically,' said Mark Hovatter, LAUSD’s chief facilities executive. 'Technology is involved in every profession; students need these skills to succeed.'
translated_content: Sekurang-kurangnya 71 iPad bernilai lebih $48,000 telah hilang tahun lalu dari Los Angeles Unified School District (LAUSD). Peranti ini adalah sebahagian daripada projek perintis di 13 sekolah dalam inisiatif bernilai $1 bilion yang bertujuan meningkatkan pendidikan dengan menyediakan iPad kepada setiap pelajar di daerah tersebut. Sebahagian besar iPad yang hilang, dengan setiap satu bernilai kira-kira $678, telah hilang dari Valley Academy of Arts and Sciences di Granada Hills, California, di mana 1,200 iPad telah diagihkan. Menjelang akhir tahun, 69 unit tidak dapat dikesan dari sekolah itu. Walaupun setiap iPad yang hilang dikaitkan dengan pelajar tertentu, pegawai menyatakan jika pelajar mendakwa mereka telah memulangkan peranti mereka, pihak daerah tiada cara yang pasti untuk membuktikannya, menurut Los Angeles Times. Walaupun kehilangan tersebut, LAUSD tetap merancang untuk memberi iPad percuma kepada semua 640,000 pelajar menjelang 2014. Pegawai daerah telah perkenalkan langkah keselamatan baharu sejak peranti tersebut mula hilang. 'Kami mempunyai kawalan yang sangat ketat untuk pelaksanaan ini,' kata Leftenan Jose Santome dari Jabatan Polis daerah sekolah. 'Kami tahu apa yang diedarkan dan digunakan di setiap kampus.' Setakat ini, kira-kira 14,000 iPad telah diedarkan di 49 sekolah K-12 dalam daerah sebagai sebahagian daripada pelaksanaan berterusan. Namun, pelaksanaan tersebut mengalami kelewatan. Baru-baru ini, LAUSD menggantung penggunaan iPad di rumah selepas hampir 300 pelajar berjaya melepasi tetapan keselamatan, membolehkan mereka melayari mana-mana laman web termasuk media sosial, bukan sahaja kandungan pembelajaran. Susulan itu, pegawai sedang mengkaji strategi bagi memastikan iPad—yang telah dipasang aplikasi pendidikan—digunakan hanya untuk tujuan pembelajaran sahaja. CiteWorld melaporkan pendidik percaya celik IT sangat penting untuk kerjaya masa kini, menjadi pendorong inisiatif $1 bilion ini. 'Kami pastikan semua orang boleh ambil ujian secara elektronik,' kata Mark Hovatter, ketua eksekutif fasiliti LAUSD. 'Teknologi terlibat dalam semua bidang; pelajar perlu kemahiran ini untuk berjaya.'

article_content: Lagos State has announced tailored initiatives to strengthen women-owned and women-led businesses, aiming to promote economic development and gender equality. This commitment was publicized on the state's official website on November 2 after a policy dialogue focused on advancing women's participation in public procurement. Governor Babajide Olusola Sanwo-Olu, represented by Finance Commissioner Abayomi Oluyomi, detailed this support during a session in Ikeja organized by the Lagos State Public Procurement Agency in collaboration with U.N. Women. The event, centered on expanding opportunities for women entrepreneurs, captures the government’s T.H.E.M.E. Plus Agenda goals—empowerment, social inclusion, and environmental consciousness. Sanwo-Olu emphasized that women entrepreneurs play a crucial role in fostering sustainable and responsible business environments. The Lagos State Head of Service, Olabode Agoro, with remarks delivered by SDG Permanent Secretary Mrs. Bose George, stressed the importance of increasing women’s access to public procurement. Leaders voiced optimism that the dialogue will lead to stronger strategies for the economic advancement of women-owned enterprises.

Komitmen ini diumumkan di laman rasmi kerajaan negeri pada 2 November selepas satu dialog polisi yang menekankan tentang keterlibatan wanita dalam perolehan awam. Gabenor Babajide Olusola Sanwo-Olu, yang diwakili oleh Pesuruhjaya Kewangan Abayomi Oluyomi, menerangkan sokongan ini dalam satu sesi di Ikeja yang dianjurkan oleh Agensi Perolehan Awam Negeri Lagos dengan kerjasama U.N. Women. Acara ini, berfokus kepada memperluas peluang perniagaan wanita, selari dengan sasaran Agenda T.H.E.M.E. Plus kerajaan—pemberdayaan, keterangkuman sosial dan kesedaran alam sekitar. Sanwo-Olu menegaskan usahawan wanita berperanan penting dalam mewujudkan persekitaran perniagaan yang mampan dan bertanggungjawab. Ketua Perkhidmatan Negeri Lagos, Olabode Agoro, menerusi ucapan yang dibacakan oleh Setiausaha Tetap SDG, Puan Bose George, menegaskan pentingnya meningkatkan akses wanita kepada peluang perolehan awam. Para pemimpin negeri yakin dialog ini akan memperkukuh strategi ke arah kemajuan ekonomi perusahaan milik wanita.

article_content: A recent study highlights that race continues to be a significant factor in partner selection on dating apps. Analysis of 'Are You Interested' (AYI), a Facebook dating platform with over 70 million users, shows that black men and women receive the fewest replies to their messages. The study also found that men from various racial groups are more likely to reach out to women outside their own race, while most women — except black women — are most attracted to white men. Looking at 2.4 million heterosexual interactions, primarily from users aged 35 and above, the data indicates that men are about three times more likely to reply to women than vice versa. The research further observed that Asian women are most responsive to white men, replying almost 8% of the time — more than any other group. Conversely, men are least likely to respond to black women’s messages, with a response rate of only 7.5%, lower than those for Asian, Latino, or white women. However, these results differ from a study by Professor Kevin Lewis of UC San Diego, which examined OkCupid data. His findings showed that people are generally more likely to initiate contact with individuals from their own racial background, particularly among Asians and Indians, and less so among white users. Professor Lewis also noted that when someone receives an initial message from a person of another race, they're initially more open to responding, possibly because it challenges preconceptions about discrimination. Yet, within about a week, people tend to revert to their established preferences. In summary, while there is some openness to connecting across racial lines on dating apps, longstanding preferences and social attitudes toward race still play a major role in shaping online interactions.
translated_content: Satu kajian terbaru menunjukkan bahawa faktor kaum masih memainkan peranan penting dalam pemilihan pasangan di aplikasi janji temu. Analisis terhadap 'Are You Interested' (AYI), sebuah platform janji temu berasaskan Facebook dengan lebih 70 juta pengguna, mendapati lelaki dan wanita kulit hitam menerima jumlah balasan mesej paling sedikit. Kajian ini juga mendapati lelaki dari pelbagai latar belakang kaum lebih cenderung untuk mendekati wanita daripada kaum lain, manakala kebanyakan wanita — kecuali wanita kulit hitam — paling tertarik kepada lelaki kulit putih. Melalui pemerhatian terhadap 2.4 juta interaksi heteroseksual, khususnya pengguna berumur 35 tahun ke atas, data menunjukkan lelaki adalah sekitar tiga kali lebih berkemungkinan membalas mesej wanita berbanding sebaliknya. Kajian turut mendapati wanita Asia paling banyak membalas mesej daripada lelaki kulit putih, dengan kadar hampir 8% — melebihi kumpulan lain. Sebaliknya, lelaki paling kurang membalas mesej daripada wanita kulit hitam, dengan kadar balasan hanya 7.5%, lebih rendah berbanding wanita Asia, Latino atau kulit putih. Namun begitu, hasil ini berbeza dengan kajian oleh Profesor Kevin Lewis dari UC San Diego yang meneliti data dari OkCupid. Dapatan beliau menunjukkan bahawa orang lebih cenderung memulakan interaksi dengan individu dari latar kaum yang sama, terutamanya dalam kalangan pengguna Asia dan India, dan lebih rendah dalam kalangan pengguna kulit putih. Profesor Lewis juga mendapati bahawa apabila seseorang menerima mesej pertama daripada individu berlainan kaum, mereka pada awalnya lebih terbuka untuk membalas — mungkin kerana jangkaan diskriminasi dicabar. Namun, dalam masa sekitar seminggu, kecenderungan asal akan kembali. Kesimpulannya, walaupun terdapat keterbukaan untuk berhubungan antara kaum di aplikasi janji temu, kecenderungan serta sikap masyarakat terhadap isu perkauman masih kukuh mempengaruhi interaksi atas talian.

article_content: Lambert-St. Louis International Airport is expected to resume a full flight schedule on Tuesday, less than four days after it was severely damaged by a powerful tornado, airport officials said. Although considerable progress has been made, restoration efforts at the airport are far from complete following Friday night’s storm, which shattered windows and ripped off parts of the roof. Airport Director Rhonda Hamm-Niebruegge told CNN's 'American Morning' that 'the damage occurred in just a couple of minutes. It will take weeks, maybe months, to finish all the cleanup.' She described recovery efforts as 'miraculous.' American Airlines returned to service on Monday, while Cape Air—the last of the airport’s 13 airlines—plans to resume flights on Tuesday. Both airlines were among the hardest hit when the tornado devastated the C concourse. Missouri Governor Jay Nixon reported that the tornado also damaged 750 homes near the airport. Preliminary estimates from the National Weather Service indicated that the tornado’s winds ranged from 111 to 165 miles per hour. No fatalities were reported—a result Nixon called 'absolutely amazing.' Hamm-Niebruegge credited the building’s sturdy construction and the prompt response to early warnings for helping to prevent injuries. She said, 'It’s a historic building, very well built, and early warnings helped.' In addition to the airport, the storm damaged businesses and tore through the roof of a church in Ferguson, Missouri, where dozens had gathered on Good Friday to watch 'The Passion of the Christ.' CNN’s Tom Laabs contributed to this report.

World-famous tenor Andrea Bocelli became a victim of a major wine fraud when fraudsters produced and sold counterfeit versions of his Bocelli a Lajatico wine. The scammers manufactured tens of thousands of fake bottles, which were sometimes priced up to ten times higher than the genuine wines. These bogus bottles circulated both within Italy and internationally, mimicking not only Bocelli’s brand but also celebrated Italian wines such as Chianti and Brunello di Montalcino.

Police carried out coordinated raids in regions including Tuscany, Lazio, Liguria, and Umbria, seizing thousands of low-quality bottles carrying fake DOCG labels, a mark meant to ensure authenticity. The fraudulent operation sought to exploit the prestigious reputation of Italian wines.

Bocelli, who runs a small winery near Pisa alongside his brother Alberto, with an annual output of roughly 300 bottles, was directly impacted. Italy’s Agriculture Minister Maurizio Martina praised law enforcement for their response and stressed the need to continue safeguarding Italian agricultural products and the respected ‘Made in Italy’ label. Authorities have launched an inquiry into six suspects believed to be involved in the scheme, which brings greater attention to the ongoing problem of counterfeit wines in the Italian industry.

Puluhan ribu botol palsu ini telah dihasilkan dan kadangkala dijual sehingga sepuluh kali ganda harga wain tulen. Botol-botol tiruan ini bukan sahaja diedarkan di Itali, malah di luar negara, termasuk jenama-jenama terkenal Itali lain seperti Chianti dan Brunello di Montalcino.

Polis telah melakukan serbuan bersepadu di beberapa wilayah seperti Tuscany, Lazio, Liguria dan Umbria, serta merampas ribuan botol berkualiti rendah dengan label DOCG palsu – tanda jaminan ketulenan yang diiktiraf. Sindiket ini dilihat mengambil kesempatan ke atas reputasi unggul wain Itali.

Bocelli, bersama abangnya Alberto, mengusahakan ladang wain kecil berhampiran Pisa dengan pengeluaran sekitar 300 botol setahun, dan mereka turut terjejas secara langsung. Menteri Pertanian Itali, Maurizio Martina, memuji tindakan pihak berkuasa serta menegaskan keperluan meneruskan perlindungan terhadap produk pertanian dan jenama 'Made in Italy'. Kini, enam suspek sedang disiasat dalam kes ini yang menonjolkan lagi masalah wain tiruan dalam industri Itali.

article_content: After five unsuccessful bids, Morocco will co-host the 2030 FIFA World Cup with Spain and Portugal, marking a historic achievement. The announcement comes on the heels of a recent earthquake in Morocco that claimed nearly 3,000 lives, bringing a sense of hope to the nation. A World Bank report suggests that this global sporting event could help stimulate Morocco’s economy, which is currently under strain from severe drought and high inflation. FIFA announced earlier than expected that Morocco, Spain, and Portugal would jointly organize the 2030 tournament. Uruguay, Argentina, and Paraguay will each host one match to celebrate the World Cup’s centennial. Experts note that convenient travel between Morocco and the Iberian countries favored their bid. Muhammad Suhail, a football analyst for BeIN Sports, remarked that geographic proximity and the trend toward joint hosting helped, showing how football can unite countries. Morocco’s earlier solo attempts to host the World Cup—1994, 1998, 2006, and 2026—were unsuccessful. The 2010 World Cup went to South Africa despite being limited to African nations. The 2026 event was hosted by the USA, Canada, and Mexico. This year, forming a partnership with Spain and Portugal, and having the support of Saudi Arabia (who is focusing on the 2034 bid), helped Morocco win hosting rights. Morocco has demonstrated its football capability by hosting the 2022 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations, where its team reached the final. In Qatar 2022, Morocco’s men’s team made African history by reaching the World Cup semi-finals, defeating Spain and Portugal along the way. Suhail added that while the three co-hosts have previously competed on the field, they now have a chance to show cooperation and make the tournament a shared success.

Pengumuman ini hadir tidak lama selepas gempa bumi di Maghribi yang meragut hampir 3,000 nyawa, membawa sinar harapan kepada negara tersebut. Menurut laporan Bank Dunia, acara sukan global ini berpotensi merangsang ekonomi Maghribi yang kini terkesan akibat kemarau teruk dan inflasi yang tinggi. FIFA mengumumkan lebih awal bahawa Maghribi, Sepanyol, dan Portugal akan menganjurkan kejohanan 2030 secara bersama. Uruguay, Argentina dan Paraguay pula akan menjadi tuan rumah bagi satu perlawanan setiap negara bagi memeriahkan ulang tahun ke-100 Piala Dunia. Pakar menyatakan kemudahan perjalanan antara Maghribi dan negara-negara Iberia memberi kelebihan kepada bidaan bersama ini. Muhammad Suhail, penganalisis bola sepak BeIN Sports, berkata bahawa kedekatan geografi dan trend penganjuran bersama telah membantu, membuktikan bola sepak mampu menyatukan negara-negara. Bidaan solo Maghribi untuk menjadi tuan rumah pada tahun 1994, 1998, 2006, dan 2026 sebelum ini gagal. Piala Dunia 2010 telah dianjurkan di Afrika Selatan walaupun fokus diberikan kepada negara-negara Afrika. Edisi 2026 pula dianjurkan oleh Amerika Syarikat, Kanada, dan Mexico. Tahun ini, kerjasama dengan Sepanyol dan Portugal serta sokongan Arab Saudi (yang beralih kepada bidaan 2034) turut membantu kemenangan bidaan Maghribi. Maghribi juga membuktikan keupayaannya apabila menganjurkan Kejohanan Bola Sepak Wanita Afrika 2022—pasukan wanitanya mara ke final. Pada Piala Dunia 2022 di Qatar, pasukan lelaki Maghribi mencatat sejarah apabila menjadi negara Afrika pertama layak ke separuh akhir, menewaskan Sepanyol dan Portugal. Suhail menambah, walaupun ketiga-tiga negara ini pernah bersaing di atas padang, kini mereka berpeluang untuk bekerjasama menjayakan kejohanan secara bersama.

article_content:
India is set to discuss various concerns with Canada at the forthcoming Parliament-20 (P20) Summit, with Canada's participation confirmed by Senate Speaker Raymonde Gagne. Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla announced in New Delhi that all countries had been invited and that Canada had just officially confirmed its attendance.

The summit, which gathers presiding officers from G20 parliaments, will be held at Yashobhoomi—the India International Convention and Expo Centre in Dwarka—on October 13-14, and will be inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This P20 meeting is the first high-level engagement between India and Canada since Prime Minister Justin Trudeau’s remarks in the Canadian Parliament connecting India to the killing of Khalistani separatist Hardeep Singh Nijjar, a statement that escalated diplomatic tensions.

Speaker Birla shared that the summit will prioritize its established agenda but may also address other issues informally. Asked whether allegations raised in the Canadian Parliament would be part of the discussions, Birla responded, “Other issues will be discussed informally.”

Birla also reported that over 50 Members of Parliament and 14 General Secretaries—including 26 parliamentary Presidents, 10 Vice Presidents, one Committee Chairman, and the Inter-Parliamentary Union President—have confirmed their participation, making this the largest P20 summit to date. For the first time, the President of the Pan African Parliament and a representative of the recently admitted African Union will attend.

The P20 Summit provides a forum for parliamentary leaders of G20 member countries to share approaches on major global topics. The central theme for this ninth edition is “Parliaments for One Earth, One Family, One Future,” featuring sessions on public digital platforms, women-led development, advancing Sustainable Development Goals, and sustainable energy transition.

A pre-summit event—the Parliamentary Forum on Lifestyle for Environment (LiFE)—will be held on October 12, along with an exhibition titled “Mother of Democracy,” highlighting India’s ancient and participative democratic history. Delegates can expect a tour of the Parliament House complex, tributes to Mahatma Gandhi, a visit to the new Parliament building, and a cultural evening with dinner hosted by the Lok Sabha Secretariat.

More than 350 delegates are anticipated at the three-day event, jointly organized by the Indian Parliament and the Ministry of External Affairs. The summit will end with a unified statement calling on G20 member states to tackle global challenges through equality, inclusivity, and peace. Officials have clarified that Germany and Argentina will not attend due to internal reasons. Since its full launch in Argentina in 2018, the P20 Summit has been hosted under some, but not all, G20 presidencies, with the most recent held in Indonesia in 2022.

India akan membincangkan pelbagai isu dengan Kanada pada Sidang Kemuncak Parliament-20 (P20) yang akan datang, dengan kehadiran Kanada disahkan oleh Speaker Senat, Raymonde Gagne. Speaker Lok Sabha, Om Birla, mengumumkan di New Delhi bahawa semua negara telah dijemput dan Kanada baru sahaja mengesahkan kehadirannya secara rasmi.

Sidang Puncak yang menghimpunkan pegawai tertinggi parlimen negara-negara G20 ini akan berlangsung di Yashobhoomi—Pusat Konvensyen dan Ekspo Antarabangsa India di Dwarka—pada 13-14 Oktober, dan akan dirasmikan oleh Perdana Menteri Narendra Modi. Mesyuarat P20 ini merupakan pertemuan penting pertama antara India dan Kanada sejak Perdana Menteri Kanada, Justin Trudeau, menghubungkan India dengan pembunuhan pemisah Khalistani, Hardeep Singh Nijjar dalam Parlimen Kanada, yang memanaskan hubungan diplomatik kedua-dua negara.

Birla menyatakan sidang ini akan menekankan agenda rasmi yang telah ditetapkan, tetapi isu lain juga mungkin dibincangkan secara tidak formal. Ketika ditanya sama ada tuduhan yang dibuat di Parlimen Kanada akan dibangkitkan, beliau berkata, "Isu lain akan dibincangkan secara tidak formal."

Birla turut memaklumkan lebih 50 Ahli Parlimen dan 14 Setiausaha Agung—termasuk 26 Presiden Parlimen, 10 Naib Presiden, seorang Pengerusi Jawatankuasa, dan Presiden Kesatuan Antara-Parlimen—sudah mengesahkan penyertaan, menjadikan ia Sidang P20 terbesar setakat ini. Buat pertama kali, Presiden Parlimen Pan Afrika, serta wakil Kesatuan Afrika yang baru diterima sebagai anggota G20, turut menghadiri.

Sidang Kemuncak P20 menjadi platform pemimpin parlimen negara-negara G20 berkongsi pendekatan mengenai isu global utama. Tema utama edisi ke-9 ialah “Parlimen untuk Satu Bumi, Satu Keluarga, Satu Masa Depan” dengan sesi membincangkan platform digital awam, pembangunan dipimpin wanita, kemajuan Matlamat Pembangunan Mampan (SDG), dan transisi tenaga lestari.

Acara pra-sidang, Forum Parlimen mengenai Gaya Hidup untuk Alam Sekitar (LiFE), akan diadakan pada 12 Oktober, bersama pameran bertajuk "Ibu Demokrasi" mempamerkan tradisi demokrasi purba dan partisipatif India. Delegasi juga akan melawat Kompleks Parlimen, memberi penghormatan kepada Mahatma Gandhi, melawat bangunan Parlimen baharu, serta menghadiri malam kebudayaan dan jamuan makan malam oleh Sekretariat Lok Sabha.

Lebih 350 delegasi dijangka hadir ke acara tiga hari ini yang dianjurkan bersama oleh Parlimen India dan Kementerian Hal Ehwal Luar Negeri. Sidang kemuncak ini akan diakhiri dengan kenyataan bersama yang menggesa ahli G20 menangani cabaran global melalui kesaksamaan, keterangkuman, dan keamanan. Pegawai telah mengesahkan Jerman dan Argentina tidak akan hadir atas sebab dalaman. Sejak sidang penuh pertama di Argentina pada 2018, P20 diadakan di bawah beberapa, namun tidak semua, presiden G20, dengan sidang terakhir dibuat di Indonesia pada 2022.

article_content: A well-regarded family in Bradford, West Yorkshire, was found dead in their home, prompting a police murder investigation. Jitendra Lad, 49, his wife Daksha, 44, and their daughters Trisha, 19, and Nisha, 16, were all discovered deceased on Monday evening after a neighbor entered their house. Police believe Jitendra Lad may have killed his wife and daughters before taking his own life. Detectives are not seeking any other suspects. The family, considered friendly and hardworking by neighbors, had not been seen for several days. Both parents worked as clerical officers for the local council. Trisha was a second-year biochemistry student at Leeds University, while Nisha was a sixth form student. Friends, neighbors, and local officials, expressing shock and sadness, are supporting the extended family and community. Forensic teams are continuing to examine the scene. West Yorkshire Police stated that post-mortem examinations will determine the exact cause of death, but the incident is being treated as murder. Tributes have been paid by friends, teachers, and university staff, all describing the family as caring and well-liked. Authorities state they are not seeking anyone else in connection with the tragedy.

Polis percaya Jitendra Lad mungkin telah membunuh isterinya dan anak-anak perempuan sebelum membunuh diri. Detektif tidak sedang mencari suspek lain. Keluarga ini dianggap mesra dan rajin oleh jiran-jiran dan tidak kelihatan selama beberapa hari. Kedua-dua ibu bapa bekerja sebagai pegawai kerani di majlis tempatan. Trisha merupakan pelajar tahun kedua biokimia di Universiti Leeds, manakala Nisha ialah pelajar tingkatan enam. Rakan-rakan, jiran dan pegawai tempatan yang terkejut dan sedih sedang memberi sokongan kepada keluarga dan komuniti. Pasukan forensik meneruskan pemeriksaan di lokasi kejadian. Polis West Yorkshire menyatakan bahawa bedah siasat akan menentukan punca kematian sebenar, namun insiden itu sedang disiasat sebagai kes bunuh. Pihak berkuasa memaklumkan bahawa mereka tidak mencari sesiapa lagi berkaitan tragedi ini.

article_content: Jared Harris has said that the Royal Family would be pleased with 'The Crown' because the show humanizes them. Harris, who portrayed King George VI—Queen Elizabeth II’s father—in the first two seasons of Netflix’s hit series, commented as the final season, which depicts Princess Diana’s death, continues to attract controversy. However, Harris denied that the UK’s most famous family would be offended by the show. 'There’s always a question about whether telling this story is disrespectful, but I think the royal family would be happy because it humanizes them,' he told the BBC’s 'Today' program. While 'The Crown' has faced increasing criticism as the narrative approaches more recent, well-known events, Harris—also known for his role in 'Chernobyl'—noted that there was significant scrutiny when he was on the show. 'Back then, there was a lot of attention from royal watchers and the media. We knew there would be tremendous interest from the start. I remember Vogue even did a photo spread, and when fashion magazines notice your show, it hits another level,' he added. Harris's character, King George VI, appeared in multiple episodes in Season 1 and through flashbacks in Season 2, earning Harris a BAFTA nomination. The first four episodes of 'The Crown' Season 6, including those depicting Diana’s death, were released 10 days ago and have continued to make headlines. On Friday, the Queen's former press secretary described Season 6 to Deadline as 'dramatic license gone bonkers.' Creator Peter Morgan, who has written every episode, has stated that his writing combines imagination with real-life events. Harris appeared on 'Today' to discuss his new play, Harold Pinter’s 'The Homecoming,' opening this week at the Young Vic.

Namun, Harris menafikan bahawa keluarga paling terkenal di UK itu akan tersinggung dengan rancangan tersebut. 'Selalu timbul persoalan sama ada bercerita tentang kisah ini dianggap tidak hormat, tetapi saya rasa keluarga diraja akan gembira kerana ia memanusiakan mereka,' katanya kepada program 'Today' BBC. Walaupun 'The Crown' menerima lebih banyak kritikan apabila naratifnya menghampiri peristiwa sebenar yang lebih dikenali ramai, Harris—yang juga dikenali melalui peranannya dalam 'Chernobyl'—menyatakan bahawa perhatian dan pemerhatian turut tinggi semasa dia terlibat dalam siri tersebut. Saya masih ingat Vogue pernah melakukan sesi fotografi khas, dan apabila majalah fesyen berminat dengan rancangan anda, ia berada di tahap yang berbeza,' tambahnya. Watak Harris, King George VI, muncul dalam beberapa episod Musim 1 dan menerusi imbas kembali dalam Musim 2 sehingga Harris menerima pencalonan BAFTA. Empat episod pertama 'The Crown' Musim 6, termasuk yang memaparkan kematian Diana, dilancarkan 10 hari lalu dan terus menjadi tajuk utama. article_content: More than 300,000 Americans are believed to be infected with Chagas disease, also known as 'kissing bug disease', but limited awareness among U.S. healthcare workers means many cases go undetected. Some doctors have called it the 'new AIDS' due to the disease's progression and severity. At the annual American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene meeting in New Orleans, researchers said that Chagas disease is curable if caught early, but the condition is often asymptomatic and treatment options are limited. According to the CDC, Chagas disease is caused by the parasite Trypanosoma cruzi, which is transmitted through the feces of kissing bugs. Early symptoms can include fever, fatigue, body aches, rash, diarrhea, and vomiting. One of the first visible signs may be a skin lesion or swelling of one eyelid. As the disease progresses, it can lead to serious complications such as heart failure, which may no longer be treatable by the time they are detected. Nolan Garcia, an epidemiologist at the Baylor College of Medicine, stated, 'We were astonished to not only find such a high rate of individuals testing positive for Chagas in their blood, but also high rates of heart disease that appear to be Chagas-related.' The CDC believes that most Americans diagnosed with Chagas contracted the parasite in Mexico or South America before arriving in the U.S. The Food and Drug Administration has not approved the drugs nifurtimox and benznidazole, which are commonly used to treat Chagas disease. These medications can cause side effects such as nerve damage, nausea, and weight loss, as reported by Aljazeera. The CDC only provides these drugs when no alternative treatments are available. 'The disease can be fatal if not treated,' said Melissa Nolan Garcia, a research associate at Baylor College of Medicine and co-author of a study on Chagas in Texas. 'You are normally asymptomatic until the disease has progressed, at which point treatment is often ineffective. We call this the silent disease.' Garcia added, 'The concerning thing is that the majority of patients I spoke to are going to physicians, and the physicians are telling them, ‘No, you don’t have the disease.’'
translated_content: Lebih daripada 300,000 warga Amerika dipercayai dijangkiti penyakit Chagas, juga dikenali sebagai 'penyakit bug cium', tetapi kesedaran yang rendah dalam kalangan pekerja kesihatan di AS menyebabkan banyak kes tidak dikesan. Beberapa doktor telah memanggilnya 'AIDS baharu' kerana cara penyakit ini berkembang dan tahap bahayanya. Pada mesyuarat tahunan American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene di New Orleans, para penyelidik berkata penyakit Chagas boleh dirawat jika dikesan awal, tetapi seringkali ia tidak bergejala dan pilihan rawatan juga terhad. Menurut CDC, penyakit Chagas disebabkan oleh parasit Trypanosoma cruzi, yang disebarkan melalui najis bug cium. Gejala awal termasuk demam, keletihan, sakit badan, ruam, cirit-birit, dan muntah. Antara tanda terawal yang kelihatan ialah luka pada kulit atau bengkak pada satu kelopak mata. Bila penyakit ini semakin teruk, ia boleh menyebabkan komplikasi serius seperti kegagalan jantung, yang biasanya tidak lagi boleh dirawat apabila dikesan. Nolan Garcia, seorang ahli epidemiologi di Baylor College of Medicine berkata, 'Kami sangat terkejut apabila mendapati kadar individu yang diuji positif untuk Chagas dalam darah mereka sangat tinggi, selain kadar penyakit jantung yang nampaknya berkaitan dengan Chagas juga tinggi.' CDC percaya kebanyakan rakyat Amerika yang dijangkiti Chagas mendapat parasit tersebut di Mexico atau Amerika Selatan sebelum datang ke AS. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) belum meluluskan ubat nifurtimox dan benznidazole, yang biasanya digunakan untuk merawat Chagas. Ubat ini boleh menyebabkan kesan sampingan seperti kerosakan saraf, loya, dan penurunan berat badan, menurut laporan Aljazeera. CDC hanya menyediakan ubat-ubatan ini jika tiada rawatan alternatif yang ada. 'Penyakit ini boleh membawa maut jika tidak dirawat,' kata Melissa Nolan Garcia, penolong penyelidik di Baylor College of Medicine dan penulis bersama kajian tentang Chagas di Texas. 'Kebiasaannya, anda tidak menunjukkan gejala sehingga penyakit ini sudah berkembang, dan waktu itu rawatan selalunya tidak lagi berkesan. Kami panggil ini penyakit senyap.' Garcia menambah, 'Apa yang membimbangkan ialah majoriti pesakit yang saya temui sudah pergi ke doktor, tetapi doktor memberitahu mereka, ‘Tidak, anda tak ada penyakit itu.’'

article_content: Two world records fell in Olympic swimming on Sunday, as France captured two gold medals—one in dramatic fashion in the men's 4x100m freestyle relay. The United States started the second evening of finals with Dana Vollmer delivering a standout performance in the women's 100m butterfly. Finishing in 55.98 seconds, she set a new world record and became the first woman ever to break the 56-second barrier. Later, South Africa’s Cameron van der Burgh also set a world record, winning the men’s 100m breaststroke title in 58.46 seconds. France’s momentum continued when Camille Muffat clinched gold in the women’s 400m freestyle, finishing ahead of Allison Schmitt from the U.S. and Great Britain’s Rebecca Adlington, who fought hard for the bronze. The most exciting race was the men’s 4x100m freestyle relay, where France’s Yannick Agnel chased down American Ryan Lochte in the final leg, securing France’s first ever gold in this event after several previous close finishes. Team USA, with Michael Phelps swimming a strong second leg, seemed poised for victory but ultimately settled for silver. Russia finished third, just ahead of a highly rated Australian squad. With this relay silver, Phelps earned his 17th career Olympic medal—just one behind the all-time leader, former Soviet gymnast Larisa Latynina. Vollmer dominated the 100m butterfly, finishing well ahead of China's Lu Ying and Australia's Alicia Coutts. She broke the previous world record of 56.06 seconds, held by Sweden’s Sarah Sjostrom, who took fourth place. Van der Burgh smashed an old world best from 2009, beating Australian Brenton Rickard's record. He dedicated his win to his former training partner, Norway’s Alexander Dale Oen, who died of heart failure in April. "Tonight I just wanted to honor Alexander Dale Oen," van der Burgh said. "I think he was with me as I finished the race so strongly. Being an Olympic champion is something that can never be taken away," he added. Van der Burgh beat out Australia’s Christian Sprenger and the U.S.’s Brendan Hansen.

article_content: Police in Palm Harbor, Florida, just northwest of Tampa, rescued a doe that had managed to get through a backyard fence and into the outdoor whirlpool spa of a home on Thursday morning. Homeowner Mike Wyers told the Tampa Bay Times, “She wasn’t moving at all and I told my wife, 'I don’t know if the deer’s alive.' But then I saw her ears start to twitch.” Wyers called the Pinellas County Sheriff’s Office when he realized the deer had apparently lost and regained consciousness but was unable to climb out of the spa. Deputies Tim McTaggart and Kevin Lewis arrived within 10 minutes and covered the deer’s head with a blanket to help keep it calm. Trapper George Lontakos arrived shortly after the deputies. Together, McTaggart and Lontakos lifted the doe out of the spa. The stunned deer tried to stand up several times and fell, but eventually regained its balance and ran into a nearby wooded area.

Pemilik rumah, Mike Wyers, memberitahu Tampa Bay Times, “Dia langsung tidak bergerak dan saya kata kepada isteri saya, 'Saya tak pasti rusa ini masih hidup.' Tapi kemudian saya nampak telinganya mula bergerak.” Wyers menghubungi Pejabat Sheriff Daerah Pinellas apabila sedar rusa itu telah hilang dan kembali sedar, tetapi tidak dapat memanjat keluar dari spa. article_content: After the global craze of the cronut—a hybrid of doughnut and croissant—a new contender has entered the pastry scene: the 'moonut.' Created by Bristol chefs John Barrett and Ben Dass, the moonut is a doughnut dusted with paprika and filled with Guinness-stewed beef shin and shiitake mushrooms. The idea was sparked after Barrett was made redundant, and together, the pair, known as The Feastie Boys, spent nearly a year perfecting this savory twist on a classic doughnut. They experimented with various flavors, facing several failed attempts, including less successful cheese and bacon combinations. However, the moonut has found its following, earning positive feedback from those who tried it despite some initial skepticism. The moonut is available for £3.50 every second and fourth Thursday at Bristol’s Temple Quay Market, sold alongside other locally sourced goods by The Feastie Boys. Inspired by the creativity and appeal of the cronut, their innovative approach is attracting curious food lovers looking for something new.

Idea ini muncul selepas Barrett diberhentikan kerja, dan bersama Dass, duo yang dikenali sebagai The Feastie Boys ini mengambil masa hampir setahun untuk mencipta variasi donat berperisa unik ini. Mereka telah mencuba pelbagai rasa, termasuk beberapa cubaan kurang berjaya seperti gabungan keju dan bacon. Namun, moonut kini mendapat sambutan, menerima maklum balas positif daripada mereka yang sudah mencubanya, walaupun ada juga yang ragu-ragu pada awalnya. Moonut dijual pada harga £3.50 setiap hari Khamis kedua dan keempat di Temple Quay Market, Bristol, bersama produk tempatan lain hasil air tangan The Feastie Boys. article_content: A coal mine fire in central Kazakhstan has killed at least 32 workers, with 14 others still unaccounted for, according to a statement by the mine operator, ArcelorMittal Temirtau. The fire broke out at the Kostenko coal mine, where 252 people were working at the time. The blaze is believed to have been caused by a pocket of methane gas. ArcelorMittal Temirtau is the local subsidiary of Luxembourg-based ArcelorMittal, the world's second-largest steel producer. The company operates eight coal mines in the Karaganda region and four iron ore mines in central and northern Kazakhstan. This tragedy is the latest in a series of workplace deaths at ArcelorMittal Temirtau sites. In August, four miners died after a fire at the same mine, and five others died following a methane leak at another site in November 2022. In its statement, the company expressed deep sorrow for the lives lost and said it is focusing on ensuring affected employees receive support and rehabilitation, in cooperation with government authorities. On Saturday, Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev announced that Kazakhstan will halt investment cooperation with ArcelorMittal Temirtau. The office of Kazakhstan’s Prosecutor General has announced an investigation into possible safety violations at the mine. After the incident, ArcelorMittal confirmed that it has signed a preliminary agreement with Kazakhstan to transfer ownership of its local subsidiary to the country, stating it will work to finalize the transaction as soon as possible.

Kebakaran berlaku di lombong arang batu Kostenko, di mana 252 orang sedang bekerja pada masa kejadian. Kebakaran tersebut dipercayai berpunca daripada poket gas metana. The Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) is considering introducing a time limit that could prevent victims of the UK's largest mis-selling scandal from making compensation claims. To date, banks have paid out £17.3 billion to individuals who were mis-sold Payment Protection Insurance (PPI) with loans and credit cards. If the FCA’s proposals are adopted, victims may only be able to make a claim within three years of discovering the mis-selling. The regulatory body is set to announce its plans this summer, which could include introducing the deadline, launching a public awareness campaign, or making other regulatory changes.

Martin Lewis of MoneySavingExpert.com stated, 'Banks have been attempting to impose a time limit for years. To make it fair for consumers, a substantial advertising campaign would be necessary before any limit is enforced, ensuring people are aware of their rights. More importantly, banks should stop rejecting valid claims when they know the ombudsman would side with the customer. I doubt either of these will happen, so a time limit should be ruled out.'

Between 1990 and 2010, tens of millions of PPI policies were sold to customers taking out loans, mortgages, and credit cards. These were intended to protect borrowers who became ill or lost their jobs but were frequently sold to individuals who did not qualify for coverage. Often, victims were unaware they had been paying for these policies for years.

Since the scandal became public, banks have received an overwhelming number of PPI complaints. While many are from genuinely affected consumers, some stem from claims management firms that approach people through persistent calls and texts. Alongside legitimate complaints, banks claim they have had to process numerous speculative or unfounded claims. The independent Financial Ombudsman Service currently receives around 4,000 new PPI complaints each week—down from a peak of 12,000—and rules in favor of consumers in about two-thirds of cases.

Marc Gander, founder of the Consumer Action Group, stated, 'I worry that the people most affected by a deadline will be the vulnerable or elderly. Banks benefited from these policies for years; victims should not suffer again.'

Pihak Berkuasa Kelakuan Kewangan (FCA) sedang mempertimbangkan untuk memperkenalkan had masa yang boleh menghalang mangsa skandal penjualan salah terbesar di UK daripada membuat tuntutan pampasan. Setakat ini, bank-bank telah membayar £17.3 bilion kepada individu yang telah dijual Insurans Perlindungan Pembayaran (PPI) secara salah bersama pinjaman dan kad kredit. Jika cadangan FCA ini diterima, mangsa hanya boleh membuat tuntutan dalam tempoh tiga tahun selepas mereka menyedari telah menjadi mangsa penjualan salah. Badan pengawalseliaan ini dijangka mengumumkan rancangannya pada musim panas ini, termasuk kemungkinan memperkenalkan had masa, melancarkan kempen kesedaran awam, atau membuat perubahan peraturan lain.

Martin Lewis dari MoneySavingExpert.com berkata, "Bank telah lama cuba menetapkan had masa. Untuk berlaku adil kepada pengguna, kempen pengiklanan besar-besaran diperlukan sebelum had itu dikuatkuasa supaya orang ramai tahu tentang hak mereka. Lebih penting lagi, bank perlu berhenti menolak tuntutan yang sah walaupun mereka tahu ombudsman akan memihak kepada pelanggan. Saya tidak nampak kedua-duanya akan berlaku, jadi had masa tidak sepatutnya diperkenalkan."

Antara 1990 dan 2010, puluhan juta polisi PPI dijual kepada pelanggan yang mengambil pinjaman, gadai janji dan kad kredit. Polisi ini bertujuan melindungi peminjam yang sakit atau kehilangan pekerjaan, tetapi sering dijual kepada mereka yang tidak layak menerima perlindungan. Ramai mangsa tidak sedar mereka telah membayar polisi ini selama bertahun-tahun.

Sejak skandal ini terdedah, bank menerima jumlah aduan PPI yang sangat tinggi. Ramai yang membuat aduan memang mangsa sebenar, tetapi ada juga yang berpunca daripada firma pengurusan tuntutan yang menghampiri orang ramai melalui panggilan dan mesej berulang. Di samping aduan yang sah, bank juga mendakwa terpaksa memproses banyak tuntutan spekulatif dan tidak berasas. Perkhidmatan Ombudsman Kewangan bebas kini menerima sekitar 4,000 aduan PPI baru setiap minggu—berkurang daripada kemuncak 12,000—dan membuat keputusan memihak kepada pengguna dalam kira-kira dua pertiga kes.

Marc Gander, pengasas Consumer Action Group, berkata, "Saya bimbang golongan paling terkesan jika had masa ini diperkenalkan ialah mereka yang lemah atau warga emas. Bank sudah lama mendapat keuntungan daripada polisi ini; mangsa tidak sepatutnya menanggung akibat sekali lagi."

Sir Jon Murphy, Chief Constable of Merseyside Police, has claimed that schools are inflating violent crime statistics by reporting minor playground disputes to the police. Previously, incidents such as fights between boys or hair-pulling among girls would have been handled internally by school staff. Now, these minor incidents are frequently reported to the police, contributing to a rise in recorded occurrences of less serious violent crimes.

Official data supports Sir Jon’s assertion, showing that cases of ‘assault without injury’—a category involving the application of force that causes no physical harm—have increased. After a period of notable declines, the latest figures indicate an uptick in violent crime across England and Wales, with the Office for National Statistics recording a 16% increase in the year to September 2014. In particular, the number of ‘assaults without injury’ reached 238,753 in that year, the highest in nearly a decade.

Despite these trends, the Department for Education has rejected claims that schools are responsible, stating it has not issued guidance instructing schools to contact police regarding such incidents. A department spokesperson emphasized that it remains rare for police to be called to schools.

Criminal policy expert Professor Mike Hough from Birkbeck, University of London, noted that the sharpest increase in police-recorded violent crime is for assaults without injury, attributing the rise primarily to changes in police recording practices rather than an actual spike in violent behavior. He acknowledged that the reporting of school incidents may be a contributing factor, but broader changes in practice are likely more significant.

Sir Jon Murphy, Ketua Polis Merseyside, mendakwa sekolah-sekolah telah meningkatkan statistik jenayah ganas dengan melaporkan perselisihan kecil di kawasan permainan kepada polis. Dahulu, insiden seperti pergaduhan antara pelajar lelaki atau menarik rambut antara pelajar perempuan akan diselesaikan oleh pihak sekolah sendiri. Kini, kejadian kecil seperti ini sering dilaporkan kepada polis, menyumbang kepada kenaikan kes jenayah ganas yang kurang serius dalam rekod rasmi.

Data rasmi menyokong dakwaan Sir Jon, menunjukkan bahawa kes ‘serangan tanpa kecederaan’—kategori yang melibatkan penggunaan kekerasan tanpa menyebabkan kecederaan fizikal—telah meningkat. Selepas tempoh penurunan ketara, angka terbaru menunjukkan peningkatan jenayah ganas di seluruh England dan Wales, dengan Pejabat Statistik Kebangsaan mencatat kenaikan 16% untuk tahun sehingga September 2014. Secara khusus, jumlah ‘serangan tanpa kecederaan’ mencecah 238,753 pada tahun itu, iaitu yang tertinggi dalam hampir sedekad.

Walaupun trend ini, Jabatan Pendidikan menolak dakwaan bahawa sekolah bertanggungjawab, menyatakan tiada arahan telah dikeluarkan kepada sekolah untuk menghubungi polis bagi kejadian seperti ini. Jurucakap jabatan menegaskan bahawa amat jarang polis dipanggil ke sekolah.

Pakar dasar jenayah, Profesor Mike Hough dari Birkbeck, Universiti London, berkata peningkatan paling ketara dalam statistik jenayah ganas yang direkodkan polis adalah bagi kes serangan tanpa kecederaan. Beliau mengaitkan kenaikan ini terutamanya kepada perubahan dalam amalan merekod polis, bukan peningkatan sebenar dalam tingkah laku ganas. Beliau juga mengakui pelaporan insiden di sekolah mungkin ada sumbangan, tetapi perubahan dalam amalan rekod secara menyeluruh mungkin faktor yang lebih utama.

article_content: The Minister of Works, David Umahi, has announced that the Nigerian government requires $35 billion to commence the construction of concrete roads across the country. Umahi further stated that the Ajaokuta Steel Company is expected to supply 16% of the total steel needed for these projects. This major development was the central focus of discussions between the Minister of Works and the Minister of Steel Development, Shuaib Audu, at the ministry’s headquarters in Abuja. Chief Press Secretary, Orji Uchenna, said in a statement that the meeting reinforced the need for coordination and cooperation in implementing the Federal Government’s action plans for national development. Umahi explained that securing such funding would involve collaboration with a commercial bank, pending approval by the Federal Executive Council. He outlined that the move towards concrete road construction requires significant financial resources, with 16% of materials being steel and 30% cement. "We need about $35 billion to begin. Delaying for government-only funding might stall progress, so we're exploring partnerships with commercial banks, subject to the Federal Executive Council's endorsement," Umahi said. "This will also demonstrate President Tinubu’s commitment to delivering on his promises." Both ministers agreed to work together and develop strategies to maximize opportunities from the Ajaokuta Steel Plant for building road infrastructure in Nigeria. Revitalizing the steel industry is also seen as a means to generate jobs, create wealth, and promote Nigeria’s participation in the global industrial market. David Umahi expressed support for Shuaib Audu to enhance Ajaokuta Steel Plant’s potential. He highlighted that President Tinubu inherited significant national debt but has chosen to focus on positive solutions and forward-looking initiatives. Minister Audu emphasized that reviving Ajaokuta is crucial—not only for infrastructure but as an economic booster capable of delivering thousands of direct and indirect jobs, particularly for skilled, non-skilled, and unskilled Nigerian workers. He stated the three main goals: to create employment, activate economic activity around key corridors such as the North Central Zone and Ajaokuta-Warri axis, and restart a plant that has been inactive for nearly forty years.
translated_content: Menteri Kerja Raya, David Umahi, telah mengumumkan bahawa kerajaan Nigeria memerlukan $35 bilion untuk memulakan pembinaan jalan konkrit di seluruh negara. Umahi turut berkata Syarikat Keluli Ajaokuta dijangka membekalkan 16% daripada jumlah keperluan keluli untuk projek-projek ini. Perkembangan penting ini menjadi fokus perbincangan antara Menteri Kerja Raya dan Menteri Pembangunan Keluli, Shuaib Audu, di ibu pejabat kementerian di Abuja. Ketua Setiausaha Akhbar, Orji Uchenna, dalam satu kenyataan berkata mesyuarat ini menekankan kepentingan koordinasi dan kerjasama bagi melaksanakan pelan tindakan kerajaan persekutuan untuk pembangunan negara. Umahi menerangkan bahawa pembiayaan tersebut memerlukan kerjasama dengan bank komersial, tertakluk kepada kelulusan Majlis Eksekutif Persekutuan. Beliau menjelaskan bahawa pembinaan jalan konkrit memerlukan sumber kewangan yang besar, di mana 16% bahannya adalah keluli dan 30% adalah simen. "Kita perlukan kira-kira $35 bilion untuk bermula. Menunggu dana kerajaan semata-mata mungkin memperlahankan kemajuan, jadi kita sedang mencari kerjasama dengan bank komersial, tertakluk kepada kelulusan Majlis Eksekutif Persekutuan," kata Umahi. "Ini akan menunjukkan komitmen Presiden Tinubu dalam menunaikan janji-janjinya." Kedua-dua menteri bersetuju untuk bekerjasama dan menggubal strategi bagi memaksimumkan peluang daripada Kilang Keluli Ajaokuta dalam pembangunan infrastruktur jalan di Nigeria. Pemulihan industri keluli turut dilihat dapat mewujudkan pekerjaan, menjana kekayaan serta menggalakkan penglibatan Nigeria dalam pasaran industri global. David Umahi menyuarakan sokongan terhadap Shuaib Audu untuk meningkatkan potensi Kilang Keluli Ajaokuta. Beliau menekankan bahawa Presiden Tinubu mewarisi hutang negara yang besar namun memilih fokus kepada penyelesaian positif dan inisiatif ke hadapan. Menteri Audu menegaskan bahawa menghidupkan semula Ajaokuta amat penting—bukan hanya untuk infrastruktur tetapi juga sebagai penggerak ekonomi yang mampu menyediakan ribuan peluang pekerjaan langsung serta tidak langsung, khususnya untuk pekerja mahir, separa mahir dan tidak mahir di Nigeria. Beliau menyatakan tiga matlamat utama: mencipta peluang pekerjaan, mengaktifkan kegiatan ekonomi di koridor penting seperti Zon Tengah Utara dan laluan Ajaokuta-Warri, serta menghidupkan kembali kilang yang telah hampir empat dekad tidak beroperasi.

article_content: Elaine Joyner, 53, from Deptford, south-east London, has been remanded in custody after appearing at Bromley Magistrates' Court charged with administering a noxious substance with intent to endanger life. Jonjo Freed, an 11-month-old boy, was visiting a McDonald's in Eltham, south London with his mother, Samantha Cherry, when he was given a bottle suspected to contain bleach. Jonjo became ill after drinking the unidentified liquid handed to him by a woman in the restaurant. While Jonjo was being watched by his grandmother, his mother had gone to buy ice-cream. Upon returning, she found her son frothing at the mouth and vomiting. Restaurant staff alerted authorities, and police and paramedics arrived at the McDonald's on Eltham High Street. Jonjo was taken to hospital with his mother. He was discharged after treatment and is now back home with his mother and her fiancé, Ashley Freed. Earlier in the week, a woman had also tried to give a bottle to a baby outside a Mothercare in Eltham but was stopped by the child’s mother. A Metropolitan Police spokesperson said that Joyner will appear at Woolwich Crown Court on September 21. The McDonald's restaurant in Eltham, where the incident took place, remained open. Comments are not being accepted for legal reasons.
translated_content: Elaine Joyner, 53, dari Deptford, tenggara London, telah ditahan selepas hadir di Mahkamah Majistret Bromley atas tuduhan memberikan bahan berbahaya dengan niat membahayakan nyawa. Jonjo Freed, seorang bayi lelaki berusia 11 bulan, sedang melawat McDonald's di Eltham, selatan London bersama ibunya, Samantha Cherry, apabila dia diberikan botol yang disyaki mengandungi peluntur. Jonjo menjadi sakit selepas meminum cecair yang tidak dikenal pasti yang diberikan oleh seorang wanita di restoran tersebut. Semasa Jonjo dijaga oleh neneknya, ibunya keluar membeli ais krim. Apabila kembali, dia mendapati anaknya berbuih di mulut dan muntah. Kakitangan restoran segera memaklumkan pihak berkuasa, dan polis serta paramedik tiba di McDonald's di Eltham High Street. Jonjo telah dibawa ke hospital bersama ibunya. Selepas menerima rawatan, dia telah dibenarkan pulang dan kini berada di rumah bersama ibunya dan tunangnya, Ashley Freed. Awal minggu itu, seorang wanita juga cuba memberikan botol kepada seorang bayi di luar kedai Mothercare di Eltham, tetapi telah dihalang oleh ibu bayi berkenaan. Jurucakap Polis Metropolitan berkata Joyner akan hadir di Mahkamah Mahkota Woolwich pada 21 September. Restoran McDonald's di Eltham, tempat kejadian berlaku, kekal dibuka. Komen tidak diterima atas sebab undang-undang.

article_content: Joseph Randle, the Dallas Cowboys running back, is the subject of a protective order sought by his ex-girlfriend, Dalia Jacobs. Jacobs alleges that during an incident at a Wichita hotel, Randle became angry in the presence of their son, Daniel, retrieved a handgun from his car, and pointed it at her friend. According to Jacobs’ petition filed in Sedgwick County, Kansas, Randle threatened to 'blast the vehicle' but instead broke the car window with his fist, causing glass to scatter onto their child and make him cry. Jacobs expressed her fear for her son's safety, describing how the breaking glass made her worry her child was hurt. In her filing, she also accused Randle of a history of physical and emotional abuse, as well as failing to pay child support. When police responded to the 911 call, they did not find a firearm but discovered a small amount of a green botanical substance, citing Randle with unlawful possession, though these charges were later dropped because of inconsistent statements from those present. The Wichita Police Department continues to investigate, emphasizing the seriousness with which they approach domestic violence cases. Randle posted a tweet about appreciating good legal counsel, which he subsequently deleted. His agent, Erik Burkhardt, claims Randle was only cited and not arrested, and denies that any violence took place, stating that Randle was just asking some guests to leave his hotel room. The protective order hearing is set for February 19.
translated_content: Joseph Randle, pemain running back Dallas Cowboys, kini berdepan permohonan perintah perlindungan oleh bekas teman wanitanya, Dalia Jacobs. Jacobs mendakwa ketika insiden di sebuah hotel di Wichita, Randle menjadi marah di hadapan anak mereka, Daniel, mengambil pistol dari keretanya, dan mengacukannya kepada rakannya. Menurut petisyen Jacobs yang difailkan di Sedgwick County, Kansas, Randle mengugut untuk 'meletupkan kenderaan' tetapi sebaliknya memecahkan cermin tingkap kereta itu dengan tangannya, menyebabkan serpihan kaca terkena anak mereka hingga menangis. Jacobs meluahkan kebimbangannya terhadap keselamatan anak mereka, menceritakan bagaimana kaca yang pecah itu membuatkan dia risau anaknya mungkin cedera. Dalam permohonannya, dia juga menuduh Randle mempunyai sejarah keganasan fizikal dan emosi serta gagal membayar nafkah anak. Apabila polis tiba selepas panggilan 911, tiada senjata dijumpai tetapi mereka menemui sedikit bahan botani hijau, lalu mendakwa Randle atas kesalahan memiliki bahan terlarang. Bagaimanapun, tuduhan ini telah digugurkan akibat kenyataan yang tidak konsisten daripada pihak yang terlibat. Jabatan Polis Wichita masih menyiasat kejadian ini dan menegaskan betapa seriusnya mereka memandang kes keganasan rumah tangga. Randle telah memuat naik status menghargai nasihat guaman yang baik di media sosial, namun telah memadamkannya kemudian. Ejen Randle, Erik Burkhardt, mendakwa Randle hanya dikenakan saman dan tidak ditahan, serta menafikan sebarang keganasan berlaku, sebaliknya mengatakan Randle hanya meminta beberapa tetamu keluar dari bilik hotelnya. Perbicaraan perintah perlindungan dijadualkan pada 19 Februari.

article_content: Former heavyweight champions Anthony Joshua and Deontay Wilder are in advanced talks to fight on the same boxing card in Saudi Arabia on December 23. Wilder’s team remains hopeful that a deal will be reached, as organizers look to fill the event’s main slot. The original plan was to have Tyson Fury fight Oleksandr Usyk as the headliner, but Fury’s recent challenging bout against Francis Ngannou disrupted those arrangements. Despite the setback, organizers are confident that agreements with Joshua and Wilder are close. Queensberry Promotions' Frank Warren stated this week that December 23 could be a ‘historic’ night for boxing. Negotiations are being led by Turki Alalshikh of Saudi Arabia’s General Entertainment Authority, working alongside Queensberry Promotions. Joshua, 34, is promoted by Matchroom Boxing and Eddie Hearn. American fighter Wilder, 38, has mostly worked with Premier Boxing Champions and his adviser, Al Haymon, in addition to his manager, Shelly Finkel. There are high hopes that deals will soon be finalized for Joshua and Wilder to fight different opponents, with an official announcement expected as the event is just weeks away. This December card could set up a direct fight between Joshua and Wilder in 2024, although a matchup involving both on the same night as Usyk vs. Fury seems unlikely. WBC champion Tyson Fury and unified champion Oleksandr Usyk (IBF, WBO, WBA titles) are expected to face each other in a much-anticipated undisputed heavyweight clash by February 2024 in Saudi Arabia. Earlier in the year, Joshua and Wilder were in discussions with Saudi-based Skills Challenge for a potential bout, but those talks collapsed. Turki Alalshikh's team has since become a central figure in boxing negotiations within Saudi Arabia. Both Joshua and Wilder are former world champions working towards regaining their status after losing their titles to Usyk and Fury respectively. Tyson Fury is undefeated in 35 professional fights, while former cruiserweight champion Usyk holds an unbeaten record in 21 bouts.
translated_content: Bekas juara heavyweight, Anthony Joshua dan Deontay Wilder, sedang dalam perbincangan lanjut untuk bertarung pada acara tinju yang sama di Arab Saudi pada 23 Disember. Pasukan Wilder optimis perjanjian akan tercapai kerana penganjur ingin mengisi slot utama acara tersebut. Rancangan asal adalah mempertemukan Tyson Fury dengan Oleksandr Usyk sebagai acara utama, namun perlawanan mencabar Fury menentang Francis Ngannou baru-baru ini mengganggu rancangan itu. Walaupun terdapat halangan, penganjur yakin perjanjian dengan Joshua dan Wilder hampir dimuktamadkan. Frank Warren dari Queensberry Promotions menyatakan minggu ini bahawa 23 Disember mungkin menjadi malam bersejarah untuk sukan tinju. Rundingan diketuai oleh Turki Alalshikh daripada Pihak Berkuasa Hiburan Umum Arab Saudi, bersama Queensberry Promotions. Joshua, 34, dipromosikan oleh Matchroom Boxing dan Eddie Hearn. Wilder, 38, dari Amerika Syarikat, kebanyakannya bersama Premier Boxing Champions serta penasihatnya, Al Haymon, selain pengurusnya Shelly Finkel. article_content:
Israel rolled out a law in 2013 to prevent the use of very thin models in fashion and advertising. The new rule requires that all models must have a Body Mass Index (BMI) above 18.5 to work professionally in Israel. Well-known model Bar Refaeli, for example, would pass this test with her reported BMI of 18.8.

To comply, models are obligated to provide a medical report verifying they have maintained a healthy BMI for at least three months before participating in photo shoots or runway events. In addition, advertisers and brands cannot make models appear slimmer through digital editing without clearly marking those photos as altered.

The law was motivated by increasing rates of eating disorders among young Israelis, especially girls between 12 and 20 years old. According to a report from 2002, about five percent of young people in Israel suffered from eating disorders, with girls making up 90 percent of cases. The legislation was championed by Danny Danon (Likud) and Rachel Adatto (Kadima). Dr. Adatto stressed that the law is a step toward ending unhealthy beauty standards, stressing that beauty does not mean extreme thinness.

Some Israeli officials, like Knesset chairwoman Einat Wilf, have expressed doubts about how strictly the law will be enforced. Similar measures restricting underweight models have been adopted in countries like Italy, India, Spain, and others, while the UK and US mainly rely on industry guidelines. There is also debate about whether BMI is the best health measure, as some naturally thin individuals could be affected despite being healthy.

Given that Israel has only about 300 working models, the law’s direct impact may be limited but aims to promote healthy body images and protect vulnerable youth.

Pada tahun 2013, Israel melaksanakan undang-undang baharu yang melarang penggunaan model terlalu kurus dalam industri fesyen dan pengiklanan. Semua model diwajibkan memiliki Indeks Jisim Badan (BMI) melebihi 18.5 untuk bekerja secara profesional di negara itu. Model terkenal Bar Refaeli memenuhi syarat ini dengan BMI yang dilaporkan sebanyak 18.8.

Syaratnya, model perlu menyerahkan laporan perubatan yang membuktikan mereka mengekalkan BMI sihat selama sekurang-kurangnya tiga bulan sebelum penggambaran atau pertunjukan fesyen. Pengiklan atau jenama turut dilarang mengedit gambar agar model nampak lebih kurus tanpa meletakkan tanda jelas pada gambar yang sudah diubah.

Undang-undang ini diperkenalkan akibat peningkatan masalah gangguan pemakanan dalam kalangan remaja Israel, terutamanya perempuan berumur 12 hingga 20 tahun. Laporan pada 2002 menunjukkan sekitar lima peratus remaja Israel mengalami gangguan pemakanan, dengan 90 peratus adalah perempuan. Usaha ini digerakkan oleh Danny Danon (Likud) dan Rachel Adatto (Kadima). Dr. Adatto menekankan undang-undang ini sebagai langkah memerangi standard kecantikan yang tidak sihat, kerana kecantikan sebenarnya bukan bermakna terlalu kurus.

Ada juga pegawai seperti Pengerusi Knesset, Einat Wilf, yang ragu sama ada penguatkuasaan undang-undang ini akan benar-benar efektif. Negara seperti Itali, India, dan Sepanyol telah memperkenalkan langkah serupa, sementara UK dan AS lebih mengutamakan garis panduan industri. Isu lain timbul apabila ada yang berpendapat BMI bukanlah petunjuk kesihatan yang tepat kerana individu yang secara semula jadi kurus boleh terkesan walaupun mereka sihat.

Walaupun hanya kira-kira 300 model profesional di Israel, undang-undang ini bertujuan memberi mesej jelas tentang pentingnya imej tubuh yang sihat dan melindungi golongan remaja.

article_content: Falcao Fever has hit London, with 13,000 tickets sold in the first four days for the upcoming friendly between the United States and Colombia at Craven Cottage. Jurgen Klinsmann's US team will face Colombia on November 14, and demand has been so high that the Fulham website temporarily crashed. This will be the first time the USA have played a home game at Craven Cottage, a stadium with strong links to American players like Brian McBride and Clint Dempsey, as well as owner Shad Khan. Interest in the match is surging, led by Manchester United's on-loan striker Radamel Falcao and Real Madrid's World Cup Golden Boot winner James Rodriguez, who are expected to play. London's Colombian community, estimated at around 20,000 people, is also fueling ticket sales, and the presence of these star players is attracting neutral fans as well. Falcao, who moved to England in August, has played only five times due to injury and missed Manchester United's recent draw with Chelsea. United fans are eager to see more of Falcao, and are pleased Colombia will play in England rather than North America, as in previous matches. The American contingent at Fulham is also excited, with the match taking place two days after the USA faces the Republic of Ireland in Dublin on November 12. Although this is the USA's first trip to Craven Cottage, Fulham's connections to American soccer remain strong. McBride called the fixture 'the perfect fit,' while former Fulham and US captain Carlos Bocanegra said he was thrilled about the match, recalling the supportive fans and unique atmosphere at the Cottage. Bocanegra compared the experience to sitting on a rooftop at Wrigley Field, urging every fan to attend at least once. Fulham fans will also be watching to see if young academy player Emerson Hyndman, who debuted for the US in September, will be included in Klinsmann's squad. Owner Shad Khan is set to visit London next month, when his NFL team, the Jacksonville Jaguars, faces the Dallas Cowboys at Wembley on November 9. US coach Jurgen Klinsmann, a former Tottenham player, returns to London in his managerial role for this high-profile match.
