article_content: MANCHESTER, N.H. — Former New Jersey Governor Chris Christie is making a direct appeal to disillusioned Democrats and independents in New Hampshire who are dissatisfied with the 2024 presidential frontrunners. “Vote in the Republican primary. We’re the only game in town, and we’re the only way to stop Donald Trump,” Christie told voters at a diner in Derry last week during his campaign through the first-in-the-nation primary state. While rival GOP candidates—like Florida Governor Ron DeSantis and South Carolina Senator Tim Scott—are focusing on Iowa in the final weeks before voting, Christie is dedicating most of his time to New Hampshire. He has positioned himself as the race’s most outspoken critic of former President Trump, portraying himself as the only Republican ready to confront Trump directly. Christie argues that Trump would lose to President Joe Biden if he's the party's nominee in November 2024. Although Christie is unpopular in national polls, some September surveys in New Hampshire show he has low double-digit support, comparable to Trump’s other leading opponents but still trailing Trump significantly. “Something’s happening,” Christie said in an interview last week in Manchester. “I walk through airports and people come up to me and say, ‘Save us from him,’ or ‘You’re the only one telling the truth.’” After an unsuccessful presidential run eight years ago, where he finished sixth in New Hampshire, Christie is now pursuing what he calls a mission. With a small campaign staff and relying on media appearances, Christie embraces his role as a vocal Trump critic and seems to genuinely enjoy his campaign trail. “If you told me when I got in this race in June that by the end of September I’d be only $700,000 behind Ron DeSantis in cash on hand, you would’ve said I was crazy. But here I am,” he said with enthusiasm. For Christie, who previously supported Trump in 2016 and served as a key adviser, the campaign is about both winning and redemption. After a long friendship with Trump, Christie broke ties on the night of the 2020 election when Trump falsely declared victory while votes were still being counted. Christie views his role as warning the party against supporting someone who has now been indicted four times and could potentially be a convicted felon by the general election. As a former prosecutor, he says: “My job—because no one else in this race has my experience—is to explain how bad this could be. If Trump is the nominee, it will be a disaster for the Republican Party.” With President Biden skipping New Hampshire’s primary, Christie is especially focused on attracting independent voters in the state. At his town halls, Christie tells stories, cracks jokes, and interacts directly with voters, sharing personal anecdotes such as his father's experience as a caregiver for a spouse with Alzheimer’s disease. Christie has hosted over 200 town halls during his career, using them as both campaign events and opportunities for catharsis among former Trump supporters. He criticizes Trump’s behavior while acknowledging the former president's accomplishments and encourages voters not to feel defeated. “It’s okay to admit Trump turned out to be a boor,” Christie told one voter at the Backyard Brewery and Kitchen in Manchester last week. About 80 people attended, including some former Trump voters disenchanted with his style, and Democrats searching for a non-Trump alternative. Robin Stewart, a 67-year-old retiree from Londonderry, said she switched her registration from Democrat to independent to support Christie in the Republican primary. “I think he’s honest and can work with people. We can’t keep having constant division and fighting,” she said. Stewart supports what Biden accomplished but believes the political landscape has changed and requires tougher leadership. Debi Rapson, a 67-year-old Manchester teacher and independent voter, previously chose Biden but is seeking better options and feels concern over Trump’s stronghold on the GOP. “I thought we were smarter as a country,” she said. “It makes me sad.” At a breakfast roundtable in Derry, Cynthia Mendez, a nurse, thanked Christie for standing up to Trump, calling Trump a narcissist and saying, “This isn’t about Republican or Democrat—it’s about a man who did wrong.” Some, like Republican Lou Abood, 71, believe Christie needs a strategy beyond criticizing Trump. An AP-NORC poll from October showed a majority of Republicans (56%) and Democrats (54%) view Christie negatively, with only about 1 in 5 holding a favorable opinion. Still, Christie insists he has a path to the nomination, believing that strong results in New Hampshire and South Carolina could position him as the main Trump alternative. He and his aides highlight his campaign’s efficiency, spending much less daily than DeSantis, operating with a small team, and relying on TV and radio spots. Asked whether he was disappointed that donors remain hesitant—with many anti-Trump groups refusing to endorse a candidate—Christie said that’s why he entered the race. “I am the cavalry. No one else was going to take him on.” (Reporting by Ramer from Derry.)

Kami sahaja opsyen di sini, dan ini satu-satunya cara hentikan Donald Trump,” kata Christie kepada pengundi di sebuah restoran di Derry minggu lalu semasa berkempen di negeri utama itu. Sementara pencabar GOP lain seperti Gabenor Florida Ron DeSantis dan Senator South Carolina Tim Scott tumpu di Iowa sebelum pengundian, Christie menumpukan hampir sepenuhnya ke New Hampshire. Beliau menonjol sebagai pengkritik Trump paling lantang dalam perlumbaan ini, mempersembahkan diri sebagai Republikan tunggal yang berani berdepan Trump terus terang. Christie berhujah bahawa jika Trump jadi calon, beliau akan tewas kepada Presiden Joe Biden pada November 2024. Walaupun popularitinya rendah di peringkat nasional, kajian pada bulan September di New Hampshire menunjukkan Christie meraih sokongan dua digit rendah, setara dengan pesaing utama Trump yang lain tetapi masih jauh di belakang Trump. “Ada sesuatu sedang berlaku,” kata Christie dalam satu temubual di Manchester minggu lalu. “Setiap kali saya berjalan di lapangan terbang, orang datang dan berkata, ‘Selamatkan kami dari dia,’ atau ‘Anda sahaja yang berkata benar.’” Selepas gagal dalam percubaan presiden lapan tahun lalu, Christie kini menganggap kempen ini sebagai satu misi. Dengan staf kempen kecil dan banyak bergantung kepada media, dia semakin selesa sebagai pengkritik utama Trump dan nyata menikmati kempen ini. “Jika anda kata semasa saya mula masuk pada Jun, saya hanya ketinggalan $700,000 daripada Ron DeSantis pada akhir September, anda pasti kata saya gila. Tapi saya di sini,” katanya dengan semangat. Bagi Christie, yang sebelum ini menyokong Trump pada 2016 dan menjadi penasihat utama, kali ini kempen adalah mengenai kemenangan dan penebusan. Setelah berteman lama dengan Trump, Christie memutuskan hubungan pada malam pilihan raya 2020 apabila Trump mengisytiharkan kemenangan secara palsu ketika undi masih dikira. Christie melihat peranannya memberi amaran kepada parti daripada menyokong individu yang telah didakwa empat kali dan berkemungkinan menjadi pesalah jenayah sebelum pilihan raya umum. Sebagai bekas pendakwa raya, katanya: "Tugas saya—kerana tiada orang lain dalam perlumbaan ini ada pengalaman saya—adalah terangkan betapa buruknya jika Trump jadi calon. Ia akan membawa malapetaka untuk Parti Republikan." Dengan Biden tidak bertanding di pemilihan awal New Hampshire, Christie memang sasarkan pengundi bebas di negeri itu. Di sesi townhall, Christie berkongsi kisah, bergurau, dan berinteraksi dengan pengundi, termasuk cerita peribadi tentang bapanya yang menjadi penjaga ibunya penghidap Alzheimer. Christie sudah menganjurkan lebih 200 sesi townhall sepanjang kerjaya, menggunakannya sebagai peluang berkongsi dan memberi harapan kepada bekas penyokong Trump. Dia mengkritik perilaku Trump tapi tetap akui pencapaiannya dan berikan semangat supaya pengundi tidak patah semangat. “Tak salah mengaku Trump bertukar jadi biadab,” kata Christie pada seorang pengundi di Backyard Brewery and Kitchen di Manchester minggu lalu. Sekitar 80 orang hadir—termasuk bekas pengundi Trump yang dah letih dengan gayanya, selain Demokrat yang mencari alternatif selain Trump. Robin Stewart, pesara 67 tahun dari Londonderry, kata dia tukar status pengundi dari Demokrat ke bebas untuk menyokong Christie dalam pemilihan Republikan. “Saya rasa dia orang yang jujur dan boleh bekerjasama. Kita tak boleh kekal berpecah dan bertelagah,” katanya. Stewart setuju dengan pencapaian Biden tetapi percaya suasana politik sekarang perlukan pemimpin lebih tegas. Debi Rapson, seorang guru 67 tahun dari Manchester dan pengundi bebas, dulu undi Biden tapi kini cari pilihan lebih baik dan risau pengaruh Trump dalam GOP. “Saya fikir negara kita lebih bijak,” katanya. “Ia menyedihkan saya.” Pada sesi meja bulat sarapan di Derry, jururawat Cynthia Mendez memuji Christie kerana berani menentang Trump, menggelarkan Trump seorang narsis dan berkata, “Ini bukan soal Republikan atau Demokrat—ini soal seseorang yang telah melakukan kesilapan.” Namun ada juga, seperti Republikan Lou Abood, 71, yang fikir Christie perlukan strategi lebih dari sekadar mengkritik Trump. Tinjauan AP-NORC bulan Oktober menunjukkan majoriti Republikan (56%) dan Demokrat (54%) memandang negatif kepada Christie, hanya lebih kurang 1 daripada 5 bersikap positif. Namun, Christie tetap yakin ada jalan. Dia percaya keputusan kuat di New Hampshire dan South Carolina akan jadikan dirinya pilihan utama lawan Trump. Christie dan pasukannya tekankan keberkesanan operasi kecil mereka, membelanjakan jauh lebih sedikit dari DeSantis dan banyak bergantung pada media TV serta radio. Apabila ditanya sama ada kecewa kerana ramai penderma masih belum menyokong—sedang banyak kumpulan anti-Trump tidak ingin berpihak kepada sesiapa—Christie kata, itulah sebab dia bertanding. “Saya sendiri adalah ‘cavalry’. Tiada siapa lagi nak lawan dia.” (Laporan oleh Ramer dari Derry.)

article_content: An ExxonMobil-operated pipeline spilled an unspecified quantity of crude oil into the Yellowstone River near Billings, Montana, prompting cleanup efforts, officials reported. Duane Winslow, director of disaster and emergency services in Yellowstone County, noted the seriousness of the incident and public concern, but believed ExxonMobil would take care of the cleanup. ExxonMobil Pipeline Company, which manages the line, set up a claims hotline for those impacted by the spill. Company representative Kevin Allexon apologized for the event and stated the response effort would be significant. Around 80 response team members were already on site, with an additional 70 on the way. Crews used absorbent pads and booms to help contain oil in the flooded river. Heavy rain and melting snow have pushed the Yellowstone River above its 13-foot flood stage to 13.51 feet as of Saturday evening. Officials hope the high water might push more contaminants ashore for cleanup. The pipeline had been transporting oil from fields at the Wyoming-Montana border to Billings and was closed shortly after the leak was discovered Friday night. The cause of the leak is still being investigated, with no information available on the pipe’s age, depth, or maintenance. ExxonMobil could not confirm if river conditions caused the incident. About 200 to 300 people in Laurel, near where the leak was detected, were evacuated late Friday due to fumes and were allowed home Saturday. Local officials estimate up to 70 miles of river in Yellowstone County may be affected, though a full assessment is pending. Cleanup is being coordinated by ExxonMobil, state agencies under Montana Governor Brian Schweitzer, and the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, with support from Clean Harbors. Local resident Jim Swanson expressed distress after noticing oil near his property.
translated_content: Sebuah saluran paip yang diuruskan oleh ExxonMobil telah menumpahkan sejumlah minyak mentah yang tidak diketahui ke dalam Sungai Yellowstone berhampiran Billings, Montana, lalu mencetuskan usaha pembersihan, menurut pegawai. Duane Winslow, pengarah perkhidmatan bencana dan kecemasan di Yellowstone County, menyatakan insiden ini sesuatu yang serius dan orang ramai memang bimbang, namun beliau yakin ExxonMobil akan menjalankan pembersihan tersebut. Syarikat ExxonMobil Pipeline, yang mengurus saluran paip berkenaan, telah menyediakan talian tuntutan untuk mereka yang terkesan. Wakil syarikat, Kevin Allexon, telah memohon maaf atas kejadian itu dan berkata usaha tindak balas akan berskala besar. Sekitar 80 anggota pasukan tindak balas sudah berada di lokasi, sementara 70 lagi sedang menuju ke sana. Pasukan pembersihan telah menggunakan pad penyerap dan penghadang minyak untuk menahan tumpahan di sungai yang dinaiki air. Hujan lebat dan salji cair telah menyebabkan paras Sungai Yellowstone melepasi tahap banjir 13 kaki, mencecah 13.51 kaki pada petang Sabtu. Pegawai berharap air yang tinggi dapat menolak lebih banyak pencemaran ke darat untuk memudahkan kerja pembersihan. Saluran paip itu membawa minyak dari sempadan Wyoming-Montana ke Billings dan telah ditutup sejurus kebocoran dikesan malam Jumaat. Punca kebocoran itu masih disiasat, dan tiada maklumat diberikan mengenai umur, kedalaman, atau rekod penyelenggaraan saluran paip. ExxonMobil tidak pasti sama ada keadaan sungai memainkan peranan dalam insiden ini. Kira-kira 200 hingga 300 penduduk di kawasan Laurel, berhampiran lokasi tumpahan, telah dipindahkan lewat Jumaat akibat bau kuat dan dibenarkan pulang pada Sabtu. Pegawai tempatan menganggarkan sehingga 70 batu sungai dalam Yellowstone County mungkin terjejas, walaupun penilaian penuh masih dijalankan. Usaha pembersihan sedang diselaraskan oleh ExxonMobil, agensi negeri di bawah Gabenor Montana Brian Schweitzer, serta EPA AS, dibantu oleh Clean Harbors. Penduduk Laurel, Jim Swanson, meluahkan rasa terkejut selepas melihat kesan minyak berhampiran rumahnya.

article_content: A seagull stole the spotlight at a Brighton horse race when it appeared to beat a top jockey to second place in a photo finish. The bird swooped through the frame just as the race concluded, seemingly clinching second by a beak during the 19:10 event on Tuesday. Jewelled, the 7/2 favorite ridden by Richard Hughes, won the race. Luke Morris, riding Sagesse, finished second despite the cheeky photo suggesting the seagull beat him to the line. George Hill, a spokesperson, remarked, ‘In all my years of racing, I’ve never seen anything like this before. The bookmakers acknowledged Sagesse’s rightful placing, and the result stood, with the seagull’s cameo simply a humorous coincidence. Being about a mile and a half from the sea, seagulls are common at Brighton Racecourse, but nothing like this has ever happened before. The bird's perfectly timed photo-bomb was captured by Event Image’s photo finish equipment.'

The United States soccer team exited the 2014 FIFA World Cup after a hard-fought 2-1 loss to Belgium in the Round of 16 in Salvador, Brazil. The thrilling match extended into extra time, where Belgium secured their victory with goals from Kevin De Bruyne and Romelu Lukaku. Substitute Julian Green offered hope to the American side with a late volley, cutting the deficit in the final fifteen minutes.

Goalkeeper Tim Howard delivered a remarkable performance, making 16 saves—the most in a World Cup match since records began in 1966—keeping the US competitive against Belgium's relentless attack. Despite trailing, the US fought back, creating opportunities through players like Jermaine Jones and Clint Dempsey, but were unable to find the equalizer.

US coach Jurgen Klinsmann expressed pride in his team, stating, "It’s hard for us to end up on the losing side after 120 minutes of giving absolutely everything. They’ve made the country proud."

The match is viewed as a significant moment for American soccer, showcasing the nation’s growing passion for the game. The US exceeded expectations by advancing from a challenging group, and though their journey ended in defeat, their resilience and determination left a lasting impression on fans at home and around the world.

Stunning new photographs offer a glimpse from a fish’s perspective inside the jaws of a tiger shark, moments before becoming its prey. Captured in striking detail by British underwater photographer Adam Hanlon, 46, during an expedition in the Bahamas, the images showcase the shark’s unique anatomy—including rows of razor-sharp teeth and pale gills.

The photos were taken when a curious tiger shark approached Hanlon’s camera, investigating it with its sensory organs. Hanlon, who leads expeditions for his photography resource Wetpixel, explained that sharks can detect electronic impulses using special organs called the ampullae of Lorenzini, which help them sense and explore their surroundings.

A reward system practiced by local fishermen encourages positive interactions, allowing divers to safely observe and photograph sharks up close. Hanlon describes the sharks as cautious and slow as they approach, using their senses to examine unfamiliar objects like cameras. Only when sharks display calm behavior are they rewarded with food, making extraordinary encounters possible and ensuring the safety of divers.

The expedition team encountered tiger, lemon, and reef sharks; they attracted the animals by releasing scented water and crates of food onto the seabed. While lemon and reef sharks rarely exceed 10 feet in length, tiger sharks often reach 14 feet, with the largest growing up to 25 feet. Despite their powerful jaws—capable of cracking open turtle shells—Hanlon says the sharks were inquisitive rather than aggressive, merely investigating the camera with their mouths.

Participants included divers from several countries, among them Olympic cyclist Chris Boardman. Hanlon, who has been diving since the mid-1980s and runs a dive school in Lancaster, England, called the experience amazing. He emphasized that sharks are intelligent and quickly learn the rules for being fed in these controlled interactions—positive behaviors are rewarded, while negative behaviors are not. This, he said, results in safe and fascinating photographic opportunities with these formidable sea creatures.

Foto-foto menakjubkan ini menawarkan pandangan unik dari perspektif seekor ikan di dalam rahang jerung harimau, seolah-olah beberapa detik sebelum menjadi mangsanya. Gambar-gambar yang dirakam dengan penuh terperinci oleh jurufoto bawah air British, Adam Hanlon, 46, semasa ekspedisi di Bahamas, menonjolkan anatomi unik jerung—termasuk barisan gigi tajam serta insang berwarna pucat.

Gambar ini diambil apabila seekor jerung harimau yang ingin tahu menghampiri kamera Hanlon dan menyiasat menggunakan organ sensori di dalam mulutnya. Hanlon, yang mengetuai ekspedisi untuk sumber fotografi Wetpixel, menerangkan bahawa jerung boleh mengesan impuls elektronik menggunakan organ khas dipanggil ampula Lorenzini, yang membantu mereka merasai dan meneroka persekitaran mereka.

Sistem ganjaran yang diamalkan oleh nelayan tempatan menggalakkan interaksi positif, membolehkan penyelam melihat dan merakam gambar jerung dengan selamat pada jarak dekat. Hanlon menyatakan jerung-jerung tersebut bergerak perlahan dan berhati-hati ketika menghampiri, menggunakan deria mereka untuk memeriksa objek tidak dikenali seperti kamera. Hanya apabila jerung menunjukkan tingkah laku tenang barulah mereka diberi makanan, membolehkan pertemuan luar biasa berlaku sambil memastikan keselamatan penyelam.

Pasukan ekspedisi berpeluang bertemu jerung harimau, lemon dan terumbu; mereka menarik haiwan ini dengan melepaskan air berbau serta kotak makanan ke dasar laut. Walaupun jerung lemon dan terumbu jarang melebihi 10 kaki panjang, jerung harimau biasanya mencapai 14 kaki, dan yang terbesar boleh membesar sehingga 25 kaki. Walaupun mempunyai rahang yang kuat—mampu memecahkan cengkerang penyu—Hanlon berkata jerung itu hanya ingin tahu, bukan agresif, sekadar menyiasat kamera dengan mulut mereka.

Peserta terdiri daripada penyelam dari beberapa negara termasuk pelumba basikal Olimpik, Chris Boardman. Hanlon, yang telah menyelam sejak pertengahan 1980-an dan memiliki sekolah menyelam di Lancaster, England, berkata pengalaman itu sangat menakjubkan. Dia menekankan bahawa jerung adalah haiwan yang bijak dan cepat memahami peraturan untuk mendapat makanan—tingkah laku positif diberi ganjaran, sementara tingkah laku negatif tidak. Katanya, ini membolehkan peluang fotografi yang selamat dan menarik bersama makhluk laut yang hebat ini.

article_content: Jungkook, a member of BTS, has officially released his highly anticipated first solo album, 'Golden'. The album's title track, 'Standing Next To You,' was accompanied by a music video released on Friday. Almost immediately after its premiere on YouTube, the romantic track garnered over 4.5 million views. Fans noted multiple nods to Michael Jackson within the music video, including a military-style jacket with metallic embellishments reminiscent of Jackson's iconic fashion, as well as signature dance moves like the crotch grab. Jungkook also honored BTS's own hits, such as 'Blood Sweat & Tears' and 'Black Swan,' by incorporating black angel wings into the video. The song explores themes of love and desire, featuring Jungkook performing intricate dance moves while serenading a female co-star. 'Golden' has set impressive records since its debut. Jungkook became the first soloist to sell over two million copies of an album on the first day, according to Hanteo. The album reached number one on the iTunes Album Charts in more than 60 countries, and debuted at number three on the US iTunes Album Chart, achieving the highest debut for an Asian artist. The album contains 11 tracks, all in English, and includes collaborations with acclaimed artists such as Ed Sheeran, Shawn Mendes, and DJ Snake. Jungkook stated in a PICKCON interview that his choice to create an all-English album was intended to reach international audiences and to push his creative boundaries.

Tidak lama selepas tayangan perdana di YouTube, lagu romantis ini telah memperoleh lebih daripada 4.5 juta tontonan. Peminat menyedari beberapa penghormatan kepada Michael Jackson dalam muzik video itu, termasuk jaket tentera dengan hiasan logam yang menyerupai gaya ikonik Jackson, serta gerakan tarian khas seperti 'crotch grab'. article_content: Palestinians searched for survivors following Israeli airstrikes on the Maghazi refugee camp in the Gaza Strip on Sunday, November 5, 2023. On the same day, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s office announced the suspension of Heritage Minister Amichay Eliyahu from government meetings, after he suggested in a radio interview that dropping a nuclear bomb on Gaza was 'one option.' Eliyahu, a far-right member of Netanyahu’s coalition, expressed dissatisfaction with Israel’s response in Gaza after the October 7 Hamas attack in southern Israel. According to Israeli officials, the attack killed 1,400 people, mostly civilians. Gaza’s Hamas-run health ministry says Israeli military actions have killed 9,488 people, most of them women and children, since then. During an interview on Kol Barama radio, Eliyahu responded to a question about using an atomic bomb on Gaza by saying, 'That’s one option.' Netanyahu’s office condemned the remarks as 'disconnected from reality' and reiterated Israel’s efforts to avoid harming non-combatants. After public backlash, Eliyahu later clarified on social media that his statement was metaphorical. Israel has never officially acknowledged possessing nuclear weapons. In separate business developments, Sweden’s Saab gained approval for India’s first 100% foreign direct investment in the defense sector to manufacture rockets. State Bank of India (SBI) reported an 8% rise in second-quarter net profit, driven by strong loan demand and reduced provisions. Edtech company Byju’s reported a 2.3-fold rise in core business revenue to ₹3,569 crore for the year ending March 2022, with EBITDA losses narrowing to ₹2,253 crore.

Novak Djokovic, the world’s top-ranked tennis player, now has a powerful motivation for his French Open campaign—winning in honor of his late childhood coach, Jelena Gencic. Gencic, who looked after Djokovic as both a coach and a second mother from his early years, passed away at 77. Wanting to protect his focus, Djokovic’s team withheld the news until right after his third-round victory against Grigor Dimitrov; upon hearing it, a visibly shaken Djokovic canceled his press conference and apologized to the media.

Following his win over Philipp Kohlschreiber that secured a quarterfinal spot at Roland Garros, Djokovic paid a heartfelt tribute to Gencic, reflecting on her huge influence on his character and career. He recalled their most recent talk—just weeks before her passing—when she urged him to stay focused on the tournament. Gencic’s lifelong dedication to tennis, including mentoring greats such as Goran Ivanisevic and Monica Seles, was renowned, and she continued coaching up until her last days, despite battling breast cancer. Having never married or had children, Gencic committed herself to nurturing young talent. Djokovic stated he feels responsible to continue her work and hopes to inspire future tennis stars as she inspired him.

This year’s tournament also marks success for veteran players. Thirty-five-year-old Tommy Haas became the oldest French Open quarterfinalist since 1971, benefiting from advances in training and fitness science. Fellow seasoned players Roger Federer, David Ferrer, and Tommy Robredo are also among the final eight.

Meanwhile, Rafael Nadal celebrated his 27th birthday with a decisive win over Kei Nishikori and aims to break records with an eighth title on the Parisian clay. Stan Wawrinka also advanced, pulling off a dramatic comeback to defeat Richard Gasquet in a five-set thriller, making this tournament memorable for both personal tributes and the enduring competitiveness of tennis veterans.

Selepas mengalahkan Philipp Kohlschreiber ke suku akhir Roland Garros, Djokovic memberi penghormatan mendalam, mengenang pengaruh besar Gencic terhadap karakter dan kerjayanya. Beliau mengimbas perbualan terakhir—beberapa minggu sebelum Gencic pergi—di mana jurulatihnya berpesan agar fokus pada kejohanan ini. article_content: A recent increase in the unemployment rate may suggest a recession is approaching. One of the most reliable short-term indicators of a recession is the job market. The October jobs report showed that the unemployment rate rose to 3.9%. Historically, small increases in unemployment have often led to recessions. This is known as the Sahm Rule. Currently, the Sahm Rule is not yet signaling a recession, but that could change if the unemployment rate does not improve. The Sahm Rule, created by economist Claudia Sahm, is designed to quickly determine if the U.S. economy is in recession, enabling policymakers to respond promptly. The rule relies on jobs data because it is released sooner than most other economic indicators and because unemployment strongly affects economic growth. Since about two-thirds of the U.S. economy relies on consumer spending, job losses usually result in weaker economic activity. To construct the Sahm Rule metric, the current three-month average of the unemployment rate is compared to the lowest unemployment rate of the past 12 months, which was 3.4% in January and April 2023. Recent unemployment rates for August, September, and October are 3.8%, 3.8%, and 3.9%, respectively. If the unemployment rate remains at or above 3.9% for November and December, or jumps significantly in November, the Sahm Rule would signal a recession. A recession could be called as early as the next jobs report on December 8. The Sahm Rule has accurately identified recessions since the 1960s, though it has occasionally produced false positives. There have been four times since the 1960s when the threshold was nearly reached without a subsequent recession. The rule is relatively new and based on historical data, so its predictive power for future trends is still being evaluated. The indicator typically triggers at a 0.5 percentage point increase from the 12-month low, but has sometimes approached 0.4 percentage points without signaling a recession. Unemployment usually rises further if a recession begins. Other measures, like the yield curve, S&P 500 index, and the Conference Board’s Leading Economic Index, also indicate possible economic weakness. These metrics have signaled a potential downturn since April 2022. According to forecasting site Kalshi, the chance of a 2024 recession is about 50%. In conclusion, while the Sahm Rule is not yet forecasting a recession, it is close to its threshold. The next jobs reports will be crucial for understanding recession risks, particularly if additional factors like a potential government shutdown come into play.
translated_content: Kenaikan kadar pengangguran baru-baru ini mungkin menunjukkan kemelesetan ekonomi hampir berlaku. Salah satu penunjuk jangka pendek yang paling boleh dipercayai untuk kemelesetan ialah pasaran pekerjaan. Laporan pekerjaan bulan Oktober menunjukkan kadar pengangguran meningkat kepada 3.9%. Secara sejarah, kenaikan kecil dalam pengangguran sering menyebabkan kemelesetan. Kaedah ini dikenali sebagai Peraturan Sahm. Pada masa ini, Peraturan Sahm masih belum memberi isyarat kemelesetan, tetapi keadaan boleh berubah jika kadar pengangguran tidak bertambah baik. Peraturan Sahm, yang dicipta oleh ahli ekonomi Claudia Sahm, direka untuk menentukan dengan cepat sama ada ekonomi AS mengalami kemelesetan supaya penggubal dasar dapat bertindak segera. Peraturan ini menggunakan data pekerjaan kerana ia dikeluarkan lebih awal berbanding kebanyakan penunjuk ekonomi lain dan kadar pengangguran sangat mempengaruhi pertumbuhan ekonomi. Memandangkan kira-kira dua pertiga ekonomi AS bergantung kepada perbelanjaan pengguna, kehilangan pekerjaan biasanya melemahkan aktiviti ekonomi. Untuk membina metrik Peraturan Sahm, purata tiga bulan kadar pengangguran semasa dibandingkan dengan kadar pengangguran terendah dalam tempoh 12 bulan lalu, iaitu 3.4% pada Januari dan April 2023. Kadar pengangguran terkini untuk Ogos, September, dan Oktober masing-masing adalah 3.8%, 3.8%, dan 3.9%. Jika kadar pengangguran kekal pada atau melebihi 3.9% bagi bulan November dan Disember, atau melonjak dengan ketara pada November, Peraturan Sahm akan mengisyaratkan kemelesetan. Kemelesetan mungkin diumumkan seawal laporan pekerjaan seterusnya pada 8 Disember. Peraturan Sahm telah mengenal pasti kemelesetan secara tepat sejak 1960-an, meskipun kadangkala menghasilkan amaran palsu. Terdapat empat kali sejak 1960-an di mana paras ambang hampir dicapai tanpa kemelesetan terjadi. Peraturan ini agak baru dan berdasarkan data sejarah, jadi kebolehpercayaannya masih dinilai untuk ramalan masa depan. Penunjuk ini biasanya mencetuskan isyarat pada kenaikan 0.5 mata peratusan daripada kadar terendah 12 bulan, tetapi kadang-kadang mendekati 0.4 mata peratusan tanpa mengisyaratkan kemelesetan. Jika kemelesetan bermula, kadar pengangguran kebiasaannya meningkat lebih tinggi. Penunjuk lain seperti keluk hasil bon, indeks S&P 500 dan Indeks Petunjuk Ekonomi Utama Conference Board juga menunjukkan kemungkinan kelemahan ekonomi. Petunjuk-petunjuk ini telah menunjukkan tanda-tanda penurunan sejak April 2022. Menurut laman ramalan Kalshi, kebarangkalian kemelesetan pada 2024 adalah sekitar 50%. article_content:
Russian President Vladimir Putin has signed amendments to a law that will further restrict media coverage of the country’s upcoming presidential election, according to local news agencies. The election is scheduled for March 2024. Although Putin, 71, has governed Russia for 24 years, he has not yet officially announced his candidacy for a new six-year term, stating he will do so only after parliament sets the election date.

The new amendments limit access to Central Election Commission (CEC) sessions to only registered media outlets, which could potentially exclude independent journalists and freelancers. In addition, media reporting on the CEC’s actions at military bases or in areas under martial law now requires prior clearance from regional and military authorities. The amendments also prohibit the publication of any campaign materials on so-called 'blocked sources', meaning restricted websites and social media platforms.

Amid a tightening information crackdown, Russian authorities have already banned a range of websites and services, including Facebook and Instagram. To strengthen these restrictions, the Ministry of Digital Development, Communications and Mass Media is reportedly planning to block certain VPN services and protocols identified as a threat by an expert commission, according to the state-run RIA news agency.

Since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, the government has further clamped down on independent and dissenting media. Hundreds of journalists have gone into exile after authorities shuttered many respected independent outlets and filed criminal cases against prominent journalists and regional bloggers. Amnesty International’s director for Eastern Europe and Central Asia, Marie Struthers, said in March 2022, 'After Russian tanks entered Ukraine, the authorities switched to a scorched-earth strategy that has turned Russia’s media landscape into a wasteland.'

Despite these restrictions, Russian polling agencies continue to show high approval ratings for Putin, with figures reaching up to 82 percent in October. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov recently stated, 'I have no doubt that if he puts forward his candidacy, he will win confidently.'

Presiden Rusia, Vladimir Putin, telah menandatangani pindaan undang-undang yang akan mengetatkan lagi liputan media terhadap pilihan raya presiden akan datang, menurut agensi berita tempatan. Pilihan raya tersebut dijangka berlangsung pada Mac 2024. Walaupun Putin, 71, telah memimpin Rusia selama 24 tahun, beliau masih belum mengumumkan secara rasmi pencalonan bagi penggal enam tahun yang baharu dan berkata hanya akan berbuat demikian selepas parlimen menetapkan tarikh pilihan raya.

Pindaan baharu ini mengehadkan akses ke sesi Suruhanjaya Pilihan Raya Pusat (CEC) kepada hanya organisasi media berdaftar, yang mungkin menyingkirkan wartawan bebas dan freelancer. Selain itu, liputan media mengenai tindakan CEC di pangkalan tentera atau kawasan di bawah undang-undang tentera kini memerlukan kelulusan awal daripada pihak berkuasa wilayah dan tentera. Pindaan ini juga melarang penerbitan bahan kempen di 'sumber yang disekat', iaitu laman web dan platform media sosial yang telah dihadkan.

Dalam usaha mengetatkan kawalan maklumat, pihak berkuasa Rusia telah pun mengharamkan pelbagai laman web dan perkhidmatan termasuk Facebook dan Instagram. Untuk mengukuhkan larangan tersebut, Kementerian Pembangunan Digital, Komunikasi dan Media Massa dilaporkan merancang untuk menyekat perkhidmatan VPN dan protokol tertentu yang dikenal pasti sebagai ancaman oleh suruhanjaya pakar, menurut agensi berita milik kerajaan, RIA.

Sejak pencerobohan ke atas Ukraine pada Februari 2022, kerajaan Rusia terus memperhebat tindakan terhadap media bebas dan suara pembangkang. Ratusan wartawan telah melarikan diri selepas pihak berkuasa menutup banyak organisasi media bebas yang berwibawa dan memfailkan kes jenayah terhadap wartawan dan blogger terkenal. Pengarah Amnesty International bagi Eropah Timur dan Asia Tengah, Marie Struthers, berkata pada Mac 2022, 'Selepas kereta kebal Rusia memasuki Ukraine, pihak berkuasa beralih kepada strategi bumi hangus yang telah menjadikan landskap media Rusia seperti padang jarak.'

Walaupun sekatan-sekatan ini, agensi tinjauan Rusia terus mencatatkan penarafan sokongan tinggi terhadap Putin, dengan angka setinggi 82 peratus pada Oktober. Jurucakap Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov, baru-baru ini berkata, 'Saya tidak ragu bahawa jika beliau mengemukakan pencalonan, beliau akan menang dengan yakin.'

article_content: I propose England adopt a bold and adventurous 4-1-3-2 formation at the World Cup, which could either make a major impact or see them exit as one of the best teams never to win the tournament.  The suggested lineup includes: Joe Hart in goal; a back four of Glen Johnson, Phil Jagielka, Gary Cahill, and Leighton Baines; Steven Gerrard as the holding midfielder; an energetic trio of Raheem Sterling, Ross Barkley, and Adam Lallana ahead of him; and a strike partnership of Wayne Rooney and Daniel Sturridge.  Adam Lallana should start England’s opening game against Italy, while Ross Barkley, a bright young talent, must have the chance to showcase his skills in South America.  Glen Johnson may be the weak link defensively at right-back, but if he can contribute something special in attack, it could offset his shortcomings.  The key to overcoming Italy, especially Andrea Pirlo, is for Sterling, Barkley, and Lallana to play with such energy that they disrupt Pirlo’s influence.  Rooney, who has an impressive record as a striker, should be played up front with Daniel Sturridge, rather than being used deeper or out wide. Together, their goal-scoring ability is vital — after all, scoring goals wins games.

article_content: Australia's government is considering both spending cuts and a possible special tax to help address the substantial economic impact of recent widespread flooding, Prime Minister Julia Gillard announced. In an interview with the Australian Broadcasting Corporation on Thursday, Gillard said, 'There will certainly be spending cuts ... and there may also be a levy.' She noted that specific details are still being determined. Official estimates of flood-related damage are still being calculated. Earlier this month, Queensland Premier Anna Bligh estimated that rebuilding would come with a 'multi-billion dollar price tag.' Floodwaters have inundated homes and devastated thousands of acres of crops in Queensland, as well as in New South Wales and Victoria. Gillard stressed the significant economic effects, saying, 'We have a lot of flood damage to repair in Queensland. There will be some economic effects on GDP growth, a short-term increase in inflation, especially for food prices, but our economy is strong and we will get through this by pulling together.' Victoria Premier Ted Baillieu also warned of the nationwide economic impact, saying, 'It is going to take some time. There is going to be a whack on our economy, and it will be that effect right across Australia from Queensland in the north to Victoria in the south.' Floods in Queensland, which began over a month ago, have taken at least 20 lives, according to police. One of the biggest economic impacts has been on Australia’s coal industry, a key factor that helped the country navigate the global financial crisis without falling into recession. Australia is the world’s largest supplier of coking coal and the second largest supplier of thermal coal. Because of the flooding, global coal prices recently hit a two-year high. Queensland is also a major exporter of sugar, cotton, and wheat, all industries affected by the flooding. (CNN's John Raedler and Kevin Voigt contributed to this report.)
translated_content: Kerajaan Australia sedang mempertimbangkan pemotongan perbelanjaan dan kemungkinan cukai khas bagi membantu menampung impak ekonomi besar akibat banjir besar-besaran baru-baru ini, kata Perdana Menteri Julia Gillard. Dalam temu bual bersama Australian Broadcasting Corporation pada hari Khamis, Gillard berkata, 'Pasti akan ada pemotongan perbelanjaan ... dan mungkin juga cukai khas.' Beliau juga menyatakan bahawa perincian masih sedang diperhalusi. Anggaran rasmi kerosakan akibat banjir masih dikira. Awal bulan ini, Premier Queensland Anna Bligh menganggarkan bahawa pemulihan akan melibatkan 'perbelanjaan berbilion dolar.' Banjir telah menenggelamkan rumah dan memusnahkan ribuan ekar tanaman di Queensland, New South Wales dan Victoria. Gillard menekankan impak ekonomi yang ketara dengan berkata, 'Kita ada banyak kerosakan banjir yang perlu dibaiki di Queensland. Akan ada kesan terhadap pertumbuhan KDNK, kenaikan inflasi jangka pendek terutama harga makanan, tetapi ekonomi kita kukuh dan kita akan menghadapinya bersama-sama.' Premier Victoria Ted Baillieu turut memberi amaran mengenai kesan ekonomi di seluruh negara, dengan berkata, 'Ia akan mengambil masa. Ekonomi kita pasti menerima kesan, dan ia akan dirasai dari Queensland di utara hingga Victoria di selatan.' Banjir di Queensland, yang bermula lebih sebulan lalu, telah meragut sekurang-kurangnya 20 nyawa menurut polis. Salah satu impak terbesar ialah kepada industri arang batu Australia, faktor utama yang membantu negara ini melalui krisis kewangan global tanpa mengalami kemelesetan. Australia ialah pembekal utama arang batu kok di dunia dan kedua terbesar untuk arang batu terma. Kesan banjir menyebabkan harga arang batu dunia mencecah paras tertinggi dua tahun. Queensland juga merupakan pengeksport utama gula, kapas dan gandum, yang turut menerima kesan akibat banjir. (Laporan oleh John Raedler dan Kevin Voigt dari CNN.)

article_content: Louis van Gaal firmly defended Manchester United’s playing style after being accused of favoring long-ball tactics in their 1-1 draw with West Ham. Bringing detailed Prozone stats to the press conference, van Gaal sought to counter West Ham manager Sam Allardyce’s claims about United’s approach. Van Gaal explained his interpretation of the match data, stating it did not support Allardyce’s perspective. He stressed that United’s long or forward passes—about 50%—mostly aimed to spread the play wide, not to target the main striker directly. In contrast, West Ham played a higher percentage of direct long balls, at 71%. He clarified that Manchester United's tactic only changed to use more direct balls after Marouane Fellaini came on for the final 20 minutes, a move that contributed to Daley Blind’s equalizer and, according to van Gaal, proved effective. To reinforce his argument, van Gaal pointed out United’s strong ball possession, approximately 60%, arguing that such control is inconsistent with a reliance on long-ball football. He emphasized the importance of interpreting match statistics in context while addressing Allardyce’s comments. This incident drew comparisons to Rafael Benitez’s previous defense using statistics during his Liverpool tenure, but van Gaal appeared more intent on protecting his coaching reputation. Despite these discussions, questions remain about Manchester United’s entertainment value and van Gaal’s ability to bring out the squad’s best. With Wayne Rooney now playing in midfield and on his lowest scoring run since 2006, van Gaal said the captain’s future role is still flexible. Van Gaal admitted that while the team aims to both win and entertain, factors like injuries and a changing lineup make the task difficult. He pointed to strong fan attendance as an indication of continued support. Noting United's upcoming game against Burnley, it’s worth observing that only Burnley have more long passes this season. Burnley manager Sean Dyche has also rejected suggestions of relying on long-ball tactics, saying it’s a misconception spread by the media.
translated_content: Louis van Gaal dengan tegas mempertahankan gaya permainan Manchester United selepas dituduh mengamalkan taktik bola panjang dalam keputusan seri 1-1 menentang West Ham. Dengan membawa statistik terperinci Prozone ke sidang media, van Gaal mahu menolak dakwaan pengurus West Ham, Sam Allardyce, mengenai pendekatan United. Van Gaal menerangkan interpretasinya terhadap data perlawanan, menyatakan bahawa ia tidak menyokong perspektif Allardyce. Beliau menekankan bahawa hantaran panjang atau ke hadapan United—kira-kira 50%—kebanyakannya bertujuan membuka permainan lebar, bukannya mencari penyerang utama secara langsung. Sebaliknya, West Ham menggunakan peratusan hantaran panjang terus yang lebih tinggi, iaitu 71%. Beliau memperjelas bahawa taktik Manchester United hanya berubah kepada lebih banyak hantaran terus selepas Marouane Fellaini dimasukkan untuk 20 minit terakhir, langkah yang menyumbang kepada jaringan penyamaan Daley Blind yang dianggap berhasil oleh van Gaal. Untuk mengukuhkan hujahnya, van Gaal menekankan penguasaan bola yang kuat oleh United, sekitar 60%, dengan menyatakan bahawa kawalan sebegitu tidak selari dengan penggunaan bola panjang secara berlebihan. Beliau menegaskan pentingnya mentafsir statistik perlawanan dengan konteks yang tepat, sambil memberi respons kepada kenyataan Allardyce. Insiden ini dibandingkan dengan pertahanan Rafael Benitez yang pernah menggunakan statistik semasa mengendalikan Liverpool, namun van Gaal dilihat lebih ingin melindungi reputasi kejurulatihannya. Walaupun perbincangan ini berlanjutan, persoalan mengenai nilai hiburan Manchester United dan keupayaan van Gaal memaksimakan potensi skuad masih timbul. Dengan Wayne Rooney kini sering bermain di tengah dan dalam prestasi jaringan terendah sejak 2006, van Gaal menyatakan bahawa peranan kapten itu masih boleh berubah. Van Gaal mengakui bahawa walaupun pasukan berusaha untuk menang dan menghiburkan, faktor seperti kecederaan dan pertukaran barisan utama menyukarkan usaha tersebut. Beliau menyebut kehadiran penyokong yang ramai sebagai bukti sokongan yang berterusan. Menjelang perlawanan menentang Burnley, hanya Burnley yang mencatat lebih banyak hantaran panjang musim ini. Pengurus Burnley, Sean Dyche, turut menolak dakwaan bergantung pada taktik bola panjang dan menyifatkannya sebagai salah faham media.

article_content: Baghdad recently witnessed its first public Christmas festival, a symbol of hope and unity organized by Iraq's Interior Ministry. Held in a park in eastern Baghdad, the celebration was marked by strong security, including checkpoints and personnel on rooftops. A vibrant hot-air balloon displaying an image of Jesus and the national flag floated overhead, while Santa Claus and his helpers greeted attendees among palm trees. The event featured a decorated tree, a Santa draped in the Iraqi flag waving to the audience, and a military band playing stirring marches. Children representing Iraq's diverse ethnic and religious backgrounds—Kurds, Turkmen, Yazidis, Christians, and Arab Muslims—noted for their unity, sang about rebuilding their nation on stage. Interior Ministry spokesman Major-General Abdul Karim Khalaf highlighted that the event demonstrated progress beyond past sectarian violence, emphasizing stronger community ties and improved safety. Attendees included many Muslims, among them Suad Mahmoud, who enjoyed celebrating alongside her daughter, reflecting the inclusive spirit of the festival. Father Saad Sirop Hanna, a Chaldean priest and former kidnapping victim, observed that Baghdad seemed to be changing for the better, though he urged patience to see if such changes would endure. Having returned from Rome, he spoke of the importance of interfaith friendship. Celebrations included families sharing sweets and viewing art exhibits crafted by children. These displays realistically depicted daily life and portrayed resilience against terrorism. One model showed soldiers arresting would-be school attackers, while another illustrated scenes of weddings, public parks, shopping, and peaceful worship. Children and their teachers underlined themes of overcoming hardship, with one display symbolizing the defeat of terrorism. Despite the atmosphere of hope and optimism, participants recognized that making these aspirations a reality would require sustained effort.

Sebuah belon udara panas berwarna-warni dengan gambar Yesus dan bendera negara melayang di atas, sementara Santa Claus serta pembantunya menyambut tetamu di bawah pokok palma. Acara tersebut menampilkan pokok Krismas yang dihiasi, seorang Santa mengenakan bendera Iraq melambai kepada hadirin, dan kumpulan muzik tentera memainkan lagu-lagu perarakan yang menaikkan semangat. Kanak-kanak mewakili pelbagai latar etnik serta agama di Iraq—Kurdi, Turkmen, Yazidi, Kristian, dan Arab Muslim—menonjolkan perpaduan ketika menyanyi tentang usaha membina semula negara mereka di pentas. Jurucakap Kementerian Dalam Negeri, Mejar-Jeneral Abdul Karim Khalaf, menegaskan acara ini membuktikan kemajuan selepas keganasan sektarian lalu, dengan penekanan kepada ikatan komuniti yang lebih kukuh dan tahap keselamatan yang bertambah baik. Ramai Muslim hadir termasuk Suad Mahmoud, yang menikmati sambutan bersama anak perempuannya, mencerminkan semangat inklusif festival itu. Bapa Saad Sirop Hanna, seorang paderi Chaldean dan bekas mangsa penculikan, menyatakan Baghdad kini sedang berubah ke arah yang lebih baik, namun mengingatkan agar masyarakat bersabar demi melihat perubahan ini berkekalan. Baru kembali dari Rom, beliau menitikberatkan kepentingan persahabatan antara agama. Sambutan turut dimeriahkan oleh keluarga yang berkongsi juadah manis dan melihat pameran seni hasil karya kanak-kanak. Pameran itu menggambarkan kehidupan harian dan ketabahan menentang keganasan. Model yang dipamerkan termasuk tentera menahan penyerang sekolah, serta adegan perkahwinan, taman santai, membeli-belah, dan ibadah aman. Kanak-kanak dan guru mereka tekankan tema ketabahan, dengan satu pameran mewakili kekalahan keganasan. Walaupun suasana penuh harapan dan optimistik, para peserta sedar impian ini hanya dapat direalisasikan dengan usaha berterusan.

Three Japanese-born scientists—Isamu Akasaki, Hiroshi Amano, and Shuji Nakamura—were awarded the 2014 Nobel Prize in Physics for inventing blue light-emitting diodes (LEDs), a development that revolutionized global lighting. Akasaki and Amano are professors in Japan, while Nakamura moved to the United States and is now a professor at the University of California, Santa Barbara.

Their work in the 1990s enabled the production of bright blue light from semiconductors, making white LED bulbs possible. These bulbs are far more energy-efficient and durable than traditional lighting. The Nobel Committee highlighted the major environmental and practical benefits of this technology, especially since about a quarter of global electricity is used for lighting.

Initially, Nakamura received only about £125 ($200) for his breakthrough while working at Nichia Corporation in Japan. The technology’s worth later reached an estimated £50 billion ($80 billion) by 2020, and Nakamura was ultimately awarded £5.04 million ($8.1 million)—the largest compensation ever for an employee invention in Japan—after legal proceedings with the company.

LEDs are now prevalent worldwide, supporting not only home and commercial lighting but also advancements in medicine and power electronics. For example, researchers are developing tiny LED devices for use in cancer treatments to help guide radiotherapy with greater precision.

The Nobel Prize in Physics has been awarded 107 times from 1901 to 2013 to distinguished scientists such as Marie Curie, Albert Einstein, and Peter Higgs. Winners are announced just before the ceremony, which takes place on December 10, the anniversary of Alfred Nobel’s death. This year, each laureate receives 8 million Swedish kronor (just over £690,000 or $1.1 million).

article_content: Taylor Swift delighted her Brazilian fans at Rio de Janeiro’s Estádio Olímpico Nilton Santos by performing ‘Stay Beautiful’ from her debut album and debuting ‘Suburban Legends’ from ‘1989 (Taylor’s Version) [From the Vault].’ Swift said she wanted to honor the Brazilian fans who have supported her since the beginning and selected songs she hadn’t played in years. Before the 'Surprise Songs' section, Swift told concertgoers she dug into her catalog for tracks she hasn’t performed during the Eras Tour. ‘Stay Beautiful,’ written when she was about fourteen or fifteen, was performed live for the first time since 2008, as Swift played it acoustically. Swift then took to the piano for the first live rendition ever of ‘Suburban Legends,’ a Vault song from the recently re-released ‘1989 (Taylor's Version).’ The show was shadowed by tragedy when a fan, intending to attend, died reportedly from cardiac arrest linked to the extreme heat in Rio. Swift was visibly shaken and shared online how heartbroken she was, expressing deep sympathy for the fan’s family and friends and saying she never expected such a loss when planning the tour stop in Brazil. Rio was facing record temperatures and a dangerous heatwave, with a heat index soaring to about 137°F before the concert. Fans struggled with the intense conditions in the stadium, asking for water. Swift responded by stopping the show to highlight those in need and, at one point, even tossed water bottles into the crowd. article_content: Air Canada, the country’s largest airline, announced Monday that it has suspended flights to and from Caracas, the capital of Venezuela, as violent protests continue in the country. "Due to ongoing civil unrest in Venezuela, Air Canada can no longer ensure the safety of its operations and has suspended flights to Caracas until further notice," the airline said in a statement. Air Canada stated its last flight departed Caracas on Sunday, March 16. Until the suspension, Air Canada operated three return flights per week between Toronto and Caracas. Customers with tickets for future flights will receive refunds. "Air Canada will continue to monitor the situation and evaluate the re-introduction of flights, with the aim of resuming operations on the route once the situation in Venezuela has stabilized," the statement added. For over a month, demonstrators have clashed with security forces in Venezuela, posing the biggest challenge President Nicolas Maduro has faced since his election last year. Students and other anti-government protesters have expressed discontent over Venezuela's economy and rising crime rates. Despite being among the world’s top 10 oil-producing countries, more than 25% of Venezuelans live below the poverty line. Government figures report that more than 20 people have died during the demonstrations. Air Canada's suspension of its Caracas service comes amid a financial dispute between airlines and the Venezuelan government. Tony Tyler, CEO of the International Air Transport Association (IATA), said on March 12 that the Venezuelan government is preventing airlines from repatriating around $3.7 billion in earnings. For several months, airlines have reportedly been unable to access proceeds from ticket sales in Venezuela due to strict currency controls. Ecuadorian flag carrier Tame suspended flights to Venezuela for three days in January over blocked payments. Tyler said, "It is unacceptable that the Venezuelan government is not playing by the rules to which it is treaty bound. The impact of this blocked cash is clear, considering that airlines are expected to earn only $18.7 billion globally this year. This represents cash, not pure profit. Airlines cannot sustain operations indefinitely without being paid. I have written to President Maduro seeking his urgent attention to this issue." According to Venezuelan newspaper el Nacional, President Maduro told reporters on March 14 that any airline withdrawing from the country would not be allowed to return while he remains in power.

"Disebabkan pergolakan awam yang berterusan di Venezuela, Air Canada tidak lagi dapat memastikan keselamatan operasi dan telah menggantung penerbangan ke Caracas sehingga diberitahu kelak," kata syarikat penerbangan itu dalam satu kenyataan. Air Canada menyatakan bahawa penerbangan terakhirnya dari Caracas berlepas pada Ahad, 16 Mac. Sebelum penggantungan ini, Air Canada mengendalikan tiga penerbangan pergi balik setiap minggu antara Toronto dan Caracas. Lebih sebulan, para penunjuk perasaan bertembung dengan pasukan keselamatan di Venezuela, menjadi cabaran terbesar dihadapi Presiden Nicolas Maduro sejak pemilihannya tahun lalu. Pelajar dan penunjuk perasaan anti-kerajaan lain meluahkan ketidakpuasan hati terhadap ekonomi Venezuela serta kadar jenayah yang semakin meningkat. Walaupun menjadi antara sepuluh negara pengeluar minyak terbesar di dunia, lebih 25% warga Venezuela hidup di bawah garis kemiskinan. Menurut angka kerajaan, lebih dari 20 orang dilaporkan maut sepanjang demonstrasi itu. Penggantungan Air Canada ke Caracas berlaku di tengah pertikaian kewangan antara syarikat penerbangan dan kerajaan Venezuela. Tony Tyler, Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Persatuan Pengangkutan Udara Antarabangsa (IATA), berkata pada 12 Mac bahawa kerajaan Venezuela menghalang syarikat penerbangan daripada membawa balik sekitar $3.7 bilion pendapatan. Beberapa bulan, syarikat penerbangan dilaporkan tidak dapat mengakses hasil jualan tiket di Venezuela akibat kawalan mata wang yang ketat. Tyler berkata, "Adalah tidak boleh diterima bahawa kerajaan Venezuela tidak mematuhi peraturan yang telah dipersetujui. article_content: A recently viral video has brought to light troubling hygiene issues in the production of Rusk biscuits—a staple snack enjoyed with tea throughout India. The video, originally posted by Amar Sirohi on Instagram and later shared by X user @Ananth_IRAS, shows factory workers preparing biscuit dough with their bare hands. Notably, one worker is even seen smoking while mixing the ingredients. These behind-the-scenes glimpses have sparked serious conversations online about food safety and cleanliness in local manufacturing facilities. Many viewers expressed concern and disappointment upon seeing the lack of sanitary practices inside the bakery. The process, as caught on camera, involves kneading and shaping the dough, baking it into loaves, and then slicing and rebaking to create the crunchy biscuits known as Rusk. With over 62,000 likes and more than five million views, the post has fueled debates about quality control, especially for foods many consider part of their daily routine. While the viral video has shocked the online community and raised questions about broader industry practices, some have noted that these visuals may not represent every manufacturer. Still, the incident underscores the importance of improved food safety standards and public scrutiny around everyday snacks.

article_content: Britain has enjoyed another day of beautiful sunshine, but the pleasant weather isn’t expected to last, as storms and cooler temperatures are on the way. Early signs of the unsettled conditions were seen in Scotland yesterday, when a tornado hit Bothwell in Lanarkshire, ripping off roof tiles and damaging trees. The storms are forecast to spread quickly across Britain. The South East of England could see up to 30mm of rain in just one hour tomorrow. While places such as Hitchin, Hertfordshire, basked in the sun, this weather isn’t expected to continue through the weekend. Children like six-year-old Tom Stocks have only a short time left to enjoy the lavender fields before rain arrives. Teenager Bethany Joseph was seen picking lavender at Cadwell Farm in Hitchin amid the summery conditions, which have also been ideal for plant growth. However, the sunshine is expected to end soon. The tornado that struck Bothwell yesterday left residents frightened as it tore through the village, scattering tree branches, roof tiles, and debris in the streets. A major clean-up operation followed. Locals described how the sky suddenly darkened and violent winds made the atmosphere feel like an earthquake. John Rundell, 69, said, 'I was sitting in the living room when the fireplace started shaking as if it was going to collapse. I looked outside and saw roof tiles flying and crashing onto the street. The whole event lasted about a minute, and afterwards, neighbours came out to help with the clean-up.' Ross Neilson, 25, who filmed the tornado, recalled, 'I had just left a meeting when I noticed it was very windy. As I crossed the road, the wind changed and debris started flying around. The sky grew dark and there was thunder before the wind began swirling and picking up debris.' Despite the week of sunny weather, the Met Office has warned that a sudden downpour is expected tomorrow in many areas. The South East could receive 30mm of rain within an hour, compared to an average of 78.1mm for the whole month of July. Visitors enjoyed brightly colored beach huts in Scarborough, which have been a seaside feature for over a hundred years, enjoying the sun before the weekend’s heavy rain and storms. A Met Office spokesperson said, 'It will be very wet for some over the weekend. We have a warning for Saturday as thunderstorms and heavy rain move northwards from France affecting the South East and Cambridgeshire. On Sunday, warnings are in place for the South West, south-west Wales, East of England, East Midlands, North West, Yorkshire and Humberside, and North East.' However, unsettled conditions do not necessarily mean the end of summer. The spokesperson added, 'July will probably end with unsettled weather, but temperatures outside storm-hit areas will be normal for this time of year. Compared to previous weeks, temperatures will be lower but still around or a bit above average. It will feel fresher, especially at night, but still pleasantly warm in the sunshine. Over the weekend, where storms miss, it should reach around 26°C in the South East, mid-20s in central parts, and about 20–21°C in the South West.' The dry weather this month has affected crops such as wheat in County Durham, and many farmers and gardeners will welcome the prospect of rain. Across the UK, water levels have dropped in places like Dowry Reservoir near Oldham. Blueberry picker Eva Vavrova reported a record crop of exceptionally sweet berries at Trehane Nurseries in Wimborne, Dorset. The Met Office has issued yellow rain warnings—meaning residents should be aware of possible flooding—for storms expected in the South East and North over the weekend. This stormy forecast is a stark contrast to the previous two weekends, when Britain saw temperatures up to 31°C before a peak of 33.5°C was recorded this week.

article_content: Arriving at an airport and hopping into a taxi is often the preferred—and sometimes essential—choice for time-pressed business travelers. However, try submitting a $300 taxi bill for the journey from Tokyo's Narita airport to the city center, and your company's finance team may have questions. According to a new survey by British foreign exchange company Moneycorp, this route boasts the world's most expensive airport-to-city taxi fare. In contrast, a single ticket on the Narita Express train to central Tokyo costs only $28. The main international airport is 66 kilometers (41 miles) from the city center, explaining much of the steep price. Despite Japan's weakening currency making the trip around 10% cheaper than last year, the country remains a costly destination for many visitors. Per kilometer, the Narita taxi ride works out to $4.42. Yet, it's not the most expensive by distance. That record goes to Copenhagen, Denmark, where the airport is just 8 km from downtown but the average fare is $50 ($6.50 per kilometer). Geneva in Switzerland also ranks among the priciest airports per kilometer. Travelers heading from Oslo's Gardermoen airport or Milan's Malpensa will also face high transfer costs, at $112 and $106 respectively, with both cities located over 40 kilometers from their airports. Tracey Tivnan of Moneycorp commented, "It's interesting that some of the biggest variations in taxi costs are in mainland Europe. For example, the taxi fare from Milan Malpensa airport to the city center will cost you more than £70 ($106), compared to just £2.17 ($3.30) from Sofia airport to downtown Sofia." Elsewhere, the survey found that the cheapest airport taxi fares among popular destinations are in Asia: Delhi’s traffic-heavy ride averages $4.10, while Bangkok’s is just $8.58.

Lapangan terbang antarabangsa utama ini terletak 66 kilometer (41 batu) dari pusat bandar, yang menerangkan mengapa tambangnya begitu tinggi. Walaupun nilai mata wang Jepun yang menurun menyebabkan perjalanan ini kira-kira 10% lebih murah berbanding tahun lalu, negara itu masih menjadi destinasi mahal bagi ramai pelawat. Mengikut setiap kilometer, tambang teksi dari Narita ialah $4.42. Namun, ini bukan yang paling mahal dari segi jarak. Rekod itu dipegang oleh Copenhagen, Denmark, di mana lapangan terbang hanya 8 km dari pusat bandar tetapi tambang teksi purata ialah $50 ($6.50 setiap kilometer). Geneva di Switzerland juga tersenarai antara yang paling mahal dari segi kadar per kilometer. Pelancong yang menuju dari Lapangan Terbang Gardermoen, Oslo atau Malpensa, Milan juga akan menanggung kos tinggi, masing-masing $112 dan $106, dengan kedua-dua bandar ini terletak lebih 40 kilometer dari lapangan terbang. Tracey Tivnan dari Moneycorp berkata, "Menarik bahawa beberapa variasi terbesar dalam kos teksi terdapat di tanah besar Eropah. Contohnya, tambang teksi dari Lapangan Terbang Milan Malpensa ke pusat bandar melebihi £70 ($106), berbanding hanya £2.17 ($3.30) dari Lapangan Terbang Sofia ke pusat bandar Sofia." Tinjauan itu juga mendapati bahawa tambang teksi lapangan terbang paling murah di destinasi popular adalah di Asia: perjalanan melalui kesesakan ke Delhi secara purata $4.10, manakala di Bangkok hanya $8.58.

article_content: Gammon joints, parmesan, and coffee may not seem like essentials likely to spark theft, but these items are now among those most frequently stolen from high street shops in the UK. Increasingly, people are resorting to shoplifting to maintain their lifestyles. Food theft has become so serious that many supermarkets are introducing electronic security tags to deter thieves from stealing items like turkey and steak. According to the latest Global Retail Theft Barometer, the total cost of retail theft has reached £3.4 billion, which equates to £124.60 per household. These costs are often passed on to consumers through higher prices. The most commonly stolen items include gammon joints, frozen chicken breasts, beef joints, bacon, gourmet cheeses like brie and parmesan, Nescafe Gold Blend coffee, and alcoholic drinks such as wine and Glen’s Vodka. In response, one Tesco store has placed manuka honey, which can cost up to £20 per jar, in large plastic security boxes to deter theft. Health and beauty products are also popular targets, with items such as razor blades, mascara, lipsticks, perfumes, skin care products, sun protection, hair straighteners, electric toothbrushes, and sports nutrition items frequently stolen. DIY and home improvement stores are most often targeted for power tools, cables, batteries, and door locks. The report, compiled by Euromonitor and funded by retail security firm Checkpoint Systems, highlights an increase in food theft, particularly fresh meat, due to the weak economy. Russell Holland of Checkpoint Systems notes that some people are stealing food out of necessity, while others from middle-income backgrounds want to maintain their lifestyles despite not receiving bonuses or pay rises. He adds that shoplifters now come from all walks of life, as shown by the variety of items stolen. Marks & Spencer places security tags on turkey crowns before Christmas, and Tesco and Sainsbury’s allow store managers to tag products if their store is in a high-theft area. If a shopper tries to leave without paying, the tags trigger an alarm. Professor Joshua Bamfield, director of the Centre for Retail Research in Nottingham, said, 'More people are stealing, and they are stealing more.'

Menurut Global Retail Theft Barometer terbaru, jumlah kos kecurian runcit telah mencecah £3.4 bilion, bersamaan dengan £124.60 bagi setiap isi rumah. Kos ini sering dipindahkan kepada pengguna melalui kenaikan harga. Barangan yang paling kerap dicuri termasuk sendi gammon, dada ayam beku, sendi daging lembu, bacon, keju gourmet seperti brie dan parmesan, kopi Nescafe Gold Blend, serta minuman keras seperti wain dan Glen’s Vodka. Sebagai tindak balas, sebuah kedai Tesco telah meletakkan madu manuka yang boleh mencecah harga £20 sebalang dalam kotak keselamatan plastik besar untuk mengelakkan kecurian. Produk kesihatan dan kecantikan juga menjadi sasaran, seperti bilah pencukur, maskara, gincu, minyak wangi, produk penjagaan kulit, perlindungan matahari, pelurus rambut, berus gigi elektrik, dan nutrisi sukan yang sering dicuri. Kedai DIY dan pembaikan rumah pula paling sering kehilangan alat kuasa, kabel, bateri, dan kunci pintu. Laporan yang disusun oleh Euromonitor dan dibiayai oleh syarikat keselamatan runcit Checkpoint Systems, menyorot peningkatan kecurian makanan, terutamanya daging segar, disebabkan ekonomi yang lemah. Russell Holland dari Checkpoint Systems menyatakan bahawa ada yang mencuri makanan kerana terpaksa, sementara yang lain dari latar belakang berpendapatan sederhana ingin mengekalkan gaya hidup walaupun tidak menerima bonus atau kenaikan gaji. Beliau menambah, pencuri kini datang dari semua lapisan masyarakat, seperti yang ditunjukkan oleh pelbagai barangan yang dicuri. Marks & Spencer meletakkan tag keselamatan pada ayam belanda sebelum Krismas, manakala Tesco dan Sainsbury’s membenarkan pengurus kedai menanda produk jika kedai mereka berada di kawasan berisiko tinggi. Jika pembeli cuba keluar tanpa membayar, tag akan mengaktifkan penggera. Profesor Joshua Bamfield, pengarah Centre for Retail Research di Nottingham, berkata, 'Lebih ramai orang mencuri, dan mereka mencuri lebih banyak.'

article_content: The Israeli military reported destroying an unidentified aerial object and, separately, intercepting a surface-to-surface missile over the Red Sea. Yemen's Houthi rebels claimed responsibility for launching several ballistic missiles and drones toward Israel, warning of further attacks. On Tuesday morning, Israel confirmed the destruction of an aerial target over the Red Sea, stating there was no risk to civilians. The incident triggered air raid sirens in Eilat, a Red Sea resort city, causing residents to seek shelter. Additionally, Israel utilized the 'Arrow' aerial defense system for the first time since the October 7 conflict with Hamas began, intercepting a missile fired towards its territory from the Red Sea. Yahya Saree, a Houthi spokesperson, said this was their third attack aimed at Israel and threatened more strikes unless what he called 'Israeli aggression' ceases. A senior Houthi official previously told AFP that Iran-backed Yemen forces had sent drones toward southern Israel; Prime Minister Abdelaziz bin Habtour asserted, 'These drones belong to the state of Yemen.' These developments come amid increasing regional tensions during the Israel-Hamas conflict in Gaza. According to Al Jazeera's Sara Khairat, this situation is concerning for Israel, already facing conflict with Iran-backed Hezbollah on its northern border. On October 27, drone-related explosions occurred in Egypt’s Red Sea towns of Taba and Nuweiba, near the Israeli border. Israel's Ministry of Foreign Affairs accused the Houthis of launching drones and missiles intended to harm Israel. These events followed soon after Hamas fired a rocket at Eilat, which landed in an unpopulated area, according to the Israeli military. Last week, the US military stated a navy warship in the northern Red Sea intercepted projectiles launched by the Houthis, potentially targeting Israel. Tensions across the region have risen since Hamas’s surprise attack inside Israel on October 7. Since then, Hezbollah has engaged in increasingly intense exchanges of cross-border fire with Israel. Iran has denied involvement in the Hamas attack. Meanwhile, Israel has intensified air and ground operations in the Gaza Strip over the past three weeks. Officials in Gaza report more than 8,000 Palestinians killed by Israeli airstrikes, while Israeli authorities report over 1,400 deaths in Israel.

Insiden ini mencetuskan siren kecemasan udara di Eilat, sebuah bandar peranginan di Laut Merah, menyebabkan penduduk bergegas mencari perlindungan. Selain itu, Israel menggunakan sistem pertahanan udara 'Arrow' buat kali pertama sejak konflik dengan Hamas bermula pada 7 Oktober, untuk memintas peluru berpandu yang ditembak ke wilayahnya dari Laut Merah. Jurucakap Houthi, Yahya Saree, berkata ini adalah serangan ketiga mereka terhadap Israel dan mengancam akan melakukan lebih banyak serangan jika 'pencerobohan Israel' tidak dihentikan. Seorang pegawai kanan Houthi sebelum ini memberitahu AFP bahawa pasukan Yaman yang disokong Iran telah menghantar dron ke selatan Israel; Perdana Menteri kerajaan Houthi, Abdelaziz bin Habtour menegaskan, 'Dron ini milik negara Yaman.' Perkembangan ini berlaku di tengah ketegangan serantau yang memuncak semasa konflik Israel-Hamas di Gaza. Menurut Sara Khairat dari Al Jazeera, situasi ini membimbangkan Israel yang turut berdepan konflik dengan Hezbollah yang disokong Iran di sempadan utara. Pada 27 Oktober, letupan berkaitan dron berlaku di bandar Taba dan Nuweiba di Laut Merah, Mesir, berhampiran sempadan Israel. Kementerian Luar Negeri Israel menuduh Houthi melancarkan dron dan peluru berpandu untuk mencederakan Israel. Kejadian ini berlaku selepas Hamas melancarkan roket ke Eilat, yang jatuh di kawasan tidak berpenghuni menurut tentera Israel. Minggu lalu, tentera AS memaklumkan kapal perangnya di Laut Merah utara memintas peluru berpandu yang dilancarkan oleh Houthi, berkemungkinan disasarkan ke Israel. Ketegangan di rantau ini meningkat sejak serangan mengejut Hamas ke atas Israel pada 7 Oktober. Sejak itu, Hezbollah terlibat dalam tembak-menembak rentas sempadan yang bertambah hebat dengan Israel. Iran menafikan penglibatan dalam serangan Hamas. Sementara itu, Israel telah meningkatkan serangan udara dan darat di Genting Gaza dalam tempoh lebih tiga minggu lalu. Pegawai Gaza melaporkan lebih 8,000 rakyat Palestin terbunuh akibat serangan udara Israel, manakala pihak berkuasa Israel melaporkan lebih 1,400 kematian di Israel.

article_content: Gianluca Grimalda, a senior researcher at the Kiel Institute for the World Economy (IfW Kiel), claims he is facing possible dismissal for refusing to take a flight back to Germany after completing a research trip in Papua New Guinea. Grimalda spent six months examining the social impacts of climate change in the Pacific island nation. He traveled to Papua New Guinea mostly by land and sea—a journey that lasted 35 days and covered roughly 16,000 kilometers. He stated he wants to return to Germany only using cargo ships, ferries, trains, and buses, citing his environmental principles. This was shared in a statement with the campaign group Scientist Rebellion. However, IfW Kiel has allegedly informed Grimalda that his approval for the trip expired on September 10 and that he must return by plane immediately. Grimalda said, 'I am faced with this dilemma: keep my job while betraying my principles or lose my job by upholding them. I won’t board that plane. For me, flying when lower-carbon alternatives exist is immoral.' He explained that his research trip required a 45-day extension due to security threats and logistical issues. Grimalda noted, 'There is nothing that urgently requires my presence in Kiel. I do not teach or need to attend seminars or meetings. Everything I need to do, I can accomplish while traveling. I am actually very productive on the move.' He also said he had offered to take unpaid leave. A spokesperson for IfW Kiel commented that the institute does not discuss internal personnel matters but stated, 'The institute supports its employees in traveling in a climate-friendly manner for business trips.'
translated_content: Gianluca Grimalda, seorang penyelidik kanan di Kiel Institute for the World Economy (IfW Kiel), mendakwa beliau berdepan kemungkinan dibuang kerja kerana enggan menaiki kapal terbang pulang ke Jerman selepas menamatkan tugasan penyelidikan di Papua New Guinea. Grimalda telah menghabiskan enam bulan mengkaji kesan sosial perubahan iklim di negara kepulauan Pasifik itu. Beliau melakukan perjalanan ke Papua New Guinea kebanyakannya melalui darat dan laut—perjalanan yang memakan masa 35 hari dan meliputi kira-kira 16,000 kilometer. Beliau menyatakan hasrat untuk pulang ke Jerman hanya menggunakan kapal kargo, feri, kereta api, dan bas atas dasar prinsip alam sekitar. Kenyataan itu dikongsi bersama kumpulan kempen Scientist Rebellion. Namun, IfW Kiel didakwa telah memaklumkan kepada Grimalda bahawa kelulusan untuk perjalanannya tamat pada 10 September dan beliau perlu kembali segera dengan menaiki kapal terbang. Grimalda berkata, 'Saya berdepan dilema ini: mengekalkan pekerjaan tetapi mengetepikan prinsip saya, atau kehilangan pekerjaan demi mempertahankan prinsip. Saya tidak akan menaiki kapal terbang itu. Bagi saya, memilih penerbangan apabila wujud pilihan rendah karbon adalah tidak bermoral.' Beliau menjelaskan perjalanan penyelidikannya perlu dilanjutkan selama 45 hari akibat ancaman keselamatan dan masalah logistik. Grimalda turut menyatakan, 'Tiada keperluan mendesak untuk saya menghadiri sebarang urusan di Kiel. Saya tidak mengajar atau perlu menghadiri seminar atau mesyuarat. Semua tugasan boleh dilakukan semasa dalam perjalanan. Malah, saya sangat produktif ketika bergerak.' Beliau juga berkata telah menawarkan untuk mengambil cuti tanpa gaji. Jurucakap IfW Kiel memaklumkan bahawa institusi itu tidak mengulas hal dalaman kakitangan tetapi berkata, 'Institut menyokong kakitangan melakukan perjalanan mesra iklim semasa urusan kerja.'
