The bouncer has been a staple of cricket since the days of Fred 'The Demon' Spofforth, who is said to have once parted W.G. Grace’s beard with a short ball in the earliest Ashes contests. However, the tragic death of Phillip Hughes has led even Merv Hughes—one of the game’s premier fast bowlers and a master of the bouncer—to reflect on its future in cricket. In an interview with Daily Mail Australia, Merv Hughes said, “I can't begin to speak for the current players, but certainly the tragic passing of Phil Hughes will remain on everyone's minds for some time. Different people will process it in their own ways, and it may take some longer than others to recover.”

Hughes suggested that fast bowlers would be especially aware of the potential consequences of the short ball. Speaking about the somber atmosphere gripping the cricketing world, he added, “I can't remember anything like this in any sport, to be honest.”

Phillip Hughes was brought into the Australian Test team by a selection panel that included Merv Hughes himself. Known for his attacking style, Hughes made significant contributions in games such as the third test against Sri Lanka at the SCG and scored a memorable century against Sri Lanka in Colombo in 2011. Merv Hughes, 53, is recognized as one of Australia’s all-time great fast bowlers, having played 53 Tests and taken 212 wickets over a decade-long international career. Renowned for his combative approach on the pitch yet gentle demeanor off it, Hughes believes the competitive nature of Test cricket will eventually return—though he isn’t sure when that will be. “It’s part of the game, and it will affect people differently. Over time, though, it’s hard to imagine bowlers won’t resort to the bouncer. It's about taking wickets and planting seeds of doubt. As a bowler, you never intend to injure or harm a batsman.”

Reminiscing about his encounter with Sir Vivian Richards in the Caribbean, Hughes pointed out, “Fast bowlers don’t try to hit or hurt batsmen; we're aiming to take wickets. When we bowl a bouncer, we’re often hoping for a glove to the wicketkeeper or a catch at deep field—not to hit the batsman.”

The incident has also drawn attention to Sean Abbott, the young bowler involved in Hughes’ accident. “My heart goes out to him—a young man at the start of his career,” said Hughes. “I hope he doesn’t blame himself, as this was a tragic accident. Many bowlers have worried after hitting a batsman, but it’s a very tough situation.”

Reflecting on the events, Hughes noted, “This is the saddest time I’ve known in sport. Three games of cricket were called off after Hughes was struck, and the ensuing grief was profound. He was a young man with a bright future, having played 26 Test matches at age 25. The selectors invested a lot in him, and he was set to become a major figure in Australian cricket.”

Since retiring, Merv Hughes has served as a selector and has authored the book 'Merv Hughes’ 104 Cricket Legends', among other ventures such as acting and television. “I’ve been fortunate—cricket gave me many opportunities. Even two decades after my playing days, I’m thankful to be recognised for my contribution to the sport,” Hughes concluded.

Bouncer telah menjadi sebahagian daripada kriket sejak zaman Fred 'The Demon' Spofforth, yang dikatakan pernah memecahkan janggut W.G. Grace dengan bola pendek dalam perlawanan Ashes yang terawal. Namun, kematian tragis Phillip Hughes telah menyebabkan Merv Hughes—salah seorang pemain boling pantas terhebat permainan—memikirkan semula masa depan bouncer dalam kriket. Dalam temu bual bersama Daily Mail Australia, Merv Hughes berkata, “Saya tak boleh bercakap bagi pihak pemain-pemain sekarang, tetapi kematian tragis Phil Hughes pasti akan kekal dalam ingatan semua untuk beberapa lama. Setiap orang akan menghadapinya dengan cara berbeza, dan mungkin ambil masa untuk sesetengah orang pulih.”

Hughes mencadangkan bahawa pemain boling pantas akan lebih berhati-hati terhadap kemungkinan akibat daripada bola pendek. Mengenai suasana suram dalam komuniti kriket, beliau menambah, “Saya tak ingat apa-apa seperti ini dalam mana-mana sukan, sejujurnya.”

Phillip Hughes telah dipilih menyertai pasukan Test Australia oleh panel pemilihan yang turut dianggotai oleh Merv Hughes sendiri. Dikenali dengan gaya menyerangnya, Hughes telah memberi sumbangan besar seperti dalam perlawanan ketiga menentang Sri Lanka di SCG dan juga apabila menjaringkan satu abad hebat menentang Sri Lanka di Colombo pada tahun 2011. Merv Hughes, 53, diiktiraf sebagai salah seorang pemain boling pantas terhebat Australia, telah bermain dalam 53 Test dan mengambil 212 wicket sepanjang sepuluh tahun kerjaya antarabangsa. Dikenali dengan gaya agresif di padang tetapi berhati lembut di luar padang, Hughes percaya semangat kompetitif Test akan kembali—walaupun beliau tidak pasti bila. “Ia sebahagian daripada permainan, dan setiap orang akan terkesan dengan cara berbeza. Lama-kelamaan, saya rasa pemain boling tetap akan menggunakan bouncer. Matlamatnya adalah mengambil wicket dan menanam rasa was-was, bukannya mencederakan pemukul.”

Mengenang kembali insidennya menentang Sir Vivian Richards di Caribbean, Hughes berkata, “Pemain boling pantas tak cuba mencederakan pemukul; kami cuba mengambil wicket. Bila kami membaling bouncer, kami harap bola itu dapat mengenai sarung tangan ke wicketkeeper atau tangkapan di padang dalam—bukan untuk mencederakan pemukul.”

Insiden ini juga menarik perhatian kepada Sean Abbott, pemain boling muda yang terlibat dalam kemalangan Hughes. “Saya simpati terhadapnya—anak muda yang baru bermula dalam kerjayanya,” kata Hughes. “Saya harap dia tidak menyalahkan diri sendiri, kerana ini hanyalah satu insiden tragis. Ramai pemain boling risau selepas terkena pemukul, tetapi keadaan ini memang sangat sukar.”

Mengenang kejadian itu, Hughes menyatakan, “Ini adalah masa paling sedih yang saya alami dalam sukan. Tiga perlawanan kriket dibatalkan selepas Hughes tercedera, dan kesedihan yang dirasai memang mendalam. Dia anak muda yang cukup berbakat dan telah bermain 26 Test pada usia 25 tahun. Pihak pemilihan banyak melabur padanya, dan dia sepatutnya menjadi tokoh besar dalam kriket Australia.”

Selepas bersara, Merv Hughes berkhidmat sebagai pemilih dan telah menulis buku 'Merv Hughes’ 104 Cricket Legends', serta terlibat dalam lakonan dan televisyen. “Saya sangat bertuah—kriket telah membuka banyak peluang kepada saya. Selepas lebih dua dekad tidak bermain, saya tetap bersyukur diiktiraf atas sumbangan saya dalam sukan ini,” kata Hughes.

Duncan Crabtree-Ireland, chief negotiator and national executive director of SAG-AFTRA, expressed appreciation for Taylor Swift while showing frustration towards Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos during a panel on artificial intelligence at New York Comic-Con. Talks between SAG-AFTRA and major studios broke down after the union proposed a revenue-sharing model, costing companies less than 57 cents per subscriber each year. Studios rejected this offer, claiming the measure would cost them over $2.4 billion across a new three-year contract and labeled the proposal an 'untenable economic burden.'

At Bloomberg’s Screentime event, Sarandos described SAG-AFTRA’s proposal as a 'levy on subscribers,' suggesting it was an unfair extra cost. In response, SAG-AFTRA accused studios of overstating the projected cost of their proposal by approximately 60% and misrepresenting their approach to AI and performer consent. Crabtree-Ireland emphasized the importance of authentic content and fair compensation for creatives, urging collective action among union members.

Crabtree-Ireland cited Taylor Swift’s box office hit, 'The Eras Tour,' which operates under a SAG-AFTRA interim agreement, as evidence of the value artists bring to projects—noting members are allowed to promote projects operating under such agreements. He praised Swift for her industry contributions and highlighted the film’s success as a sign for studios to recognize the importance of fair deals for artists.

Addressing the rapid evolution of artificial intelligence, Crabtree-Ireland underscored the need for lasting safeguards. He argued that performers should always retain the right to informed consent regarding the use of their likeness or digital replicas in any format. He stressed that ensuring fair compensation and informed consent are enduring principles that can adapt alongside technological advancements.

article_content: An isolated Indigenous tribe in Brazil has apparently vanished from its location in the Amazon rainforest, raising concerns among officials and activists. The tribe, filmed for the first time last year, may have been forced to flee by suspected drug traffickers. According to Survival International, a guard post built to protect the tribe was destroyed by these traffickers. The organization expressed worries that a nearby river is being used as a route for cocaine smuggled from Peru. Bruno Perez, a spokesperson for Brazil’s National Indian Foundation (FUNAI), told CNN that aerial surveys did not show any tribe members present. While their huts and crops appeared untouched—suggesting no immediate conflict—the absence of people remains troubling. Earlier video footage released in February had depicted residents in vibrant body paint near thatched structures, which drew international attention. However, it remains unclear whether these images are of the same tribe. "Previous overflights did not alarm this group; we were able to photograph them," Perez said. He suggested the tribe could be hiding or may have escaped, but emphasized that there is no evidence of direct contact. Officials recovered a backpack thought to belong to a trafficker, which contained an arrow. However, Perez noted that this alone does not confirm any meeting between traffickers and the tribe. Survival International estimates that over 100 uncontacted tribes exist worldwide, with around half in the Amazon regions of Peru and Brazil. These groups face multiple threats, such as logging and disease. The movement of loggers from Peru into Brazil raises the likelihood of conflict. Brazilian authorities reported that approximately 40 armed men had crossed the border from Peru, though their nationalities and group affiliations are unknown. The Ashaninka people first reported the presence of armed men in July after their village—five days by boat from the area where several isolated tribes live—was ransacked. In response, a team of federal police was sent to the region. Major Luis Baca of Peru’s National Police stated that there is a Peruvian outpost nearby, but he had not received recent reports of trafficking activity in the vicinity. Perez explained that drug trafficking is a relatively new issue in this part of the Amazon. "In this region, drug trafficking is an isolated problem," he said, indicating this is the first report of traffickers entering the area near the tribe.
translated_content: Sebuah suku Orang Asli yang terasing di Brazil nampaknya telah hilang dari lokasi mereka di hutan Amazon, menimbulkan kebimbangan dalam kalangan pegawai dan aktivis. Suku ini, yang dirakam buat kali pertama tahun lalu, mungkin telah melarikan diri akibat ancaman yang dipercayai dilakukan oleh pengedar dadah. Menurut Survival International, pos kawalan yang dibina untuk melindungi suku ini telah dimusnahkan oleh pengedar tersebut. Organisasi itu turut menyuarakan kebimbangan bahawa sungai berdekatan kini digunakan sebagai laluan penyeludupan kokain dari Peru. Jurucakap Yayasan Orang Asli Kebangsaan Brazil (FUNAI), Bruno Perez, memberitahu CNN bahawa tinjauan udara tidak mengesan kehadiran ahli suku berkenaan. Walaupun pondok dan tanaman mereka kelihatan tidak terusik—menunjukkan tiada konflik segera—ketiadaan penduduk tetap membimbangkan. Rakaman video terdahulu yang dikeluarkan pada Februari memaparkan penduduk dengan badan dicat warna-warni berhampiran struktur beratap rumbia, yang menarik perhatian antarabangsa. Namun, tidak pasti sama ada gambar-gambar ini adalah daripada suku yang sama. "Tinjauan udara sebelum ini tidak menakutkan kumpulan ini; kami dapat mengambil gambar mereka," kata Perez. Beliau mencadangkan suku itu mungkin bersembunyi atau telah melarikan diri, namun menegaskan tiada bukti hubungan langsung berlaku. Pihak berkuasa menemui sebuah beg galas yang dipercayai milik pengedar dadah, mengandungi anak panah. Bagaimanapun, Perez menegaskan perkara ini sahaja tidak mengesahkan berlaku pertemuan antara pengedar dan suku tersebut. Survival International menganggarkan terdapat lebih 100 suku terpencil di seluruh dunia, dengan kira-kira separuh daripadanya berada di wilayah Amazon di Peru dan Brazil. Kumpulan-kumpulan ini menghadapi pelbagai ancaman termasuk pembalakan dan penyakit. Pergerakan pembalak dari Peru ke Brazil turut meningkatkan risiko konflik. Pihak berkuasa Brazil melaporkan kira-kira 40 lelaki bersenjata telah menyeberangi sempadan dari Peru, namun identiti dan kumpulan mereka tidak diketahui. Kaum Ashaninka mula-mula melaporkan kehadiran lelaki bersenjata itu pada bulan Julai selepas kampung mereka—lima hari perjalanan bot dari kawasan penempatan beberapa suku terpencil—dirompak. Sebagai tindak balas, pasukan polis persekutuan dihantar ke kawasan tersebut. Mejar Luis Baca dari Polis Kebangsaan Peru berkata terdapat pos kawalan di Peru berhampiran kawasan kejadian, namun beliau tidak menerima laporan baru tentang aktiviti penyeludupan dadah di kawasan itu. Perez menjelaskan bahawa isu pengedaran dadah di bahagian Amazon ini adalah perkara baharu. "Di rantau ini, pengedaran dadah adalah masalah terpencil," katanya, merujuk ini adalah laporan pertama tentang pencerobohan pengedar ke kawasan berhampiran suku berkenaan.

Inito, a Bengaluru-based medical technology startup founded in 2015, has raised $6 million in a Series A funding round led by Fireside Ventures. Inito specializes in helping women track fertility hormones and offers personalized reproductive health analytics through its flagship product, the Fertility Monitor.

The company combines hardware, biotechnology, and machine learning to increase the accuracy and efficiency of its test strips, allowing measurement of multiple parameters on a single platform.

With this funding, Inito plans to expand its hormone test globally, enhance analytics using artificial intelligence, and invest in research and development for new diagnostic tests. The company’s long-term vision is to offer a variety of diagnostic tests for different health issues via a smartphone-based platform.

Cofounders Aayush Rai and Varun AV noted that their partnership with Fireside Ventures has provided crucial financial support and mentorship, guiding Inito’s growth as a global health technology brand from India.

Inito memfokuskan kepada membantu wanita menjejak hormon kesuburan dan menawarkan analisis kesihatan reproduktif yang diperibadikan melalui produk utamanya, Fertility Monitor.

Syarikat ini menggabungkan perkakasan, bioteknologi, dan pembelajaran mesin untuk meningkatkan ketepatan serta kecekapan jalur ujian, membolehkan pelbagai parameter diukur pada satu platform.

Dengan pembiayaan ini, Inito merancang untuk mengembangkan ujian hormonnya ke peringkat global, mempertingkatkan analitik menggunakan kecerdasan buatan, dan melabur dalam penyelidikan serta pembangunan untuk ujian diagnostik baharu. Visi jangka panjang syarikat adalah menawarkan pelbagai ujian diagnostik untuk pelbagai isu kesihatan melalui platform berasaskan telefon pintar.

Pengasas bersama, Aayush Rai dan Varun AV, menyatakan bahawa kerjasama mereka dengan Fireside Ventures memberikan sokongan kewangan dan bimbingan penting, membantu pertumbuhan Inito sebagai jenama teknologi kesihatan global dari India.

Government officials have frequently failed to attend legal hearings for benefit appeals, allowing some claimants to retain payments they might not otherwise be entitled to, according to recent reports. In the past year, lawyers from the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) were present at only 4 percent of benefit tribunal hearings, where decisions to reduce benefits are reviewed. This means many claimants have a higher chance of successfully appealing benefit cuts, as government representatives are often not there to contest the appeals.

Official figures indicate that the DWP wins more cases when its representatives are present. With DWP officers present, claimants succeeded in 41 percent of cases, compared to a 50 percent success rate when DWP was absent. In the year covered, roughly 250,000 benefits tribunals took place, a significant increase as stricter welfare assessments led to more people challenging benefits reductions. These assessments were introduced by then-Work and Pensions Secretary Iain Duncan Smith, resulting in many people losing benefits and challenging the decisions in court.

Politicians from the Labour Party, including Shadow Justice Secretary Sadiq Khan, criticized the government's handling of the rising number of tribunals and the increased costs for the Ministry of Justice. Khan noted a 35 percent increase in tribunals over three years related to government benefit decisions. From April to December 2013, only 4.3 percent of cases were attended by a DWP official, compared to 8 percent in 2010 and 40 percent in 2000. 

Solicitor Joseph Hughes commented that without DWP representation, the evidence presented in appeals cannot be properly challenged or cross-examined. Shadow Work and Pensions Secretary Rachel Reeves described the situation as evidence of chaos and incompetence within the DWP. Justice Minister Shailesh Vara stated that it is up to the relevant department or local authority to decide whether to send a presenting officer to an appeal unless specifically directed to do so by the Tribunal. The DWP downplayed suggestions that failing to send officers contributes to more lost appeals but admitted it has conducted no studies into the issue.

Pegawai kerajaan sering gagal menghadiri perbicaraan rayuan faedah, membolehkan sesetengah penerima kekal menerima bayaran yang mungkin tidak mereka layak, menurut laporan terkini. Tahun lalu, peguam daripada Jabatan Kerja dan Pencen (DWP) hanya hadir dalam 4 peratus pendengaran tribunal faedah di mana keputusan pemotongan faedah dikaji semula. Ini bermakna ramai pemohon mempunyai peluang yang lebih tinggi untuk berjaya merayu pemotongan faedah kerana wakil kerajaan sering tidak hadir untuk mencabar rayuan.

Angka rasmi menunjukkan DWP lebih kerap memenangi kes apabila wakilnya hadir. Dengan kehadiran pegawai DWP, 41 peratus pemohon menang kes berbanding kadar kejayaan 50 peratus apabila DWP tidak hadir. Sepanjang tempoh dilaporkan, sekitar 250,000 tribunal faedah diadakan, iaitu peningkatan besar berikutan penilaian kebajikan yang lebih ketat menyebabkan lebih ramai mencabar pengurangan faedah. Penilaian ini diperkenalkan oleh bekas Setiausaha Kerja dan Pencen, Iain Duncan Smith, yang menyebabkan ramai kehilangan faedah dan mencabar keputusan di mahkamah.

Ahli politik Parti Buruh, termasuk Setiausaha Keadilan Bayangan Sadiq Khan, mengkritik cara kerajaan menangani peningkatan tribunal dan kos kepada Kementerian Kehakiman. Khan menyatakan terdapat peningkatan 35 peratus dalam jumlah tribunal berkaitan keputusan faedah oleh jabatan kerajaan selama tiga tahun. Dari April hingga Disember 2013, hanya 4.3 peratus kes dihadiri pegawai DWP, berbanding 8 peratus pada 2010 dan 40 peratus pada 2000.

Peguam Joseph Hughes berkata tanpa wakil DWP, bukti dalam rayuan tidak dapat dicabar atau disoal balas dengan sewajarnya. Setiausaha Bayangan Kerja dan Pencen, Rachel Reeves, menyifatkan keadaan ini sebagai bukti kekalutan dan ketidakcekapan dalam DWP. Menteri Kehakiman Shailesh Vara pula berkata menjadi hak jabatan atau pihak berkuasa tempatan untuk memutuskan sama ada mahu menghantar pegawai ke rayuan kecuali diarahkan Tribunal. DWP menafikan kegagalan menghantar pegawai menyebabkan lebih banyak rayuan kalah tetapi mengakui tiada kajian dijalankan tentang isu ini.

article_content: The podcast industry is seeing more unionization as SAG-AFTRA introduces two new contracts: the Independent Podcast Agreement and the MicroPod Agreement. Table Read, a podcast that features unproduced scripts to help writers gain exposure, is among the first to sign the Independent Podcast Agreement. This agreement brings union protections to its actors, comedians, musicians, and influencers, offering them fair pay, better working conditions, and union resources. The agreement also protects against the unauthorized replication and AI misuse of performers’ voices, and payments made under the contract support eligibility for union health and pension plans. It applies to podcasts of any genre or platform with budgets or income above $10,000 per season, setting a 20% contribution rate for benefits, with a cap of $15,000 per episode or $100,000 per season per performer. Table Read is produced by Jack Levy—known for 'The Lower Bottoms'—together with ex-MTV executive Mark Knell and Shaan Sharma from 'The Chosen.' The show is developed by Manifest Media Productions and obtains scripts from writers, showrunners, and services like Coverfly. In addition, Table Read has international production partners and plans to record live shows globally. Duncan Crabtree-Ireland, SAG-AFTRA’s National Executive Director, welcomed Table Read into the union, noting the protection it brings creative performers. Producer Jack Levy highlighted their enthusiasm to be among the first major podcasts to sign, stressing how it enables them to attract high-level talent and provide listeners with a quality experience.

Perjanjian ini memberikan perlindungan kesatuan kepada pelakon, pelawak, pemuzik, dan influencer, serta menawarkan bayaran adil, syarat kerja yang lebih baik, dan akses kepada sumber kesatuan. Perjanjian ini juga melindungi daripada penggunaan suara tanpa kebenaran serta penyalahgunaan AI, dan bayaran di bawah kontrak ini membantu kelayakan untuk pelan kesihatan dan pencen kesatuan. Ia merangkumi mana-mana podcast tanpa mengira genre atau platform yang memiliki bajet atau pendapatan melebihi $10,000 setiap musim, dengan kadar sumbangan manfaat 20%, dihadkan pada $15,000 bagi setiap episod atau $100,000 setiap musim untuk setiap individu. Duncan Crabtree-Ireland, Pengarah Eksekutif Nasional SAG-AFTRA, mengalu-alukan penyertaan Table Read ke dalam kesatuan dan menekankan perlindungan untuk kreatif. article_content: NEW YORK (AP) — Donald Trump, the former U.S. president and businessman, is preparing to testify Monday in his New York civil fraud trial. The case, brought by New York Attorney General Letitia James, threatens Trump's control over major properties like Trump Tower and challenges his long-cultivated image as a successful entrepreneur. Trump’s testimony follows appearances by his eldest sons, Eric Trump and Donald Trump Jr., who are executives at the Trump Organization, and comes ahead of testimony from his eldest daughter, Ivanka Trump. This deeply personal trial centers on allegations that Trump and his company inflated his net worth by billions of dollars in financial statements used to secure loans and better insurance terms. Trump denies wrongdoing. Prosecutors seek $250 million in penalties and a ban on Trump and top executives conducting business in New York. Trump has extensive experience as a witness, having testified in at least eight trials and numerous depositions since 1986. His appearances are marked by a blend of confidence, defensiveness, and combative language—a style that mirrors his approach as a public figure. Past testimonies reveal Trump’s tendency to deflect responsibility, use rhetorical flourish, and sometimes evade direct answers. He has often attributed business failures or controversial financial moves to subordinates or normal business practices. The trial is non-jury and questions center on how involved Trump and others were in valuing assets for annual financial statements. Trump’s sons have said they relied on outside accounting firms, while Trump himself has argued the statements were never meant to be taken literally, pointing to disclaimers. The judge has already ruled that some of Trump’s statements were fraudulent, shifting partial control of certain Trump businesses to a court-appointed receiver, though an appeals court has put this on hold. Trump frequently attacks the case publicly, describing it as politically motivated and part of a broader effort to undermine his 2024 presidential campaign. He continues to insist that his business practices were typical within the real estate industry and maintains that lenders were not harmed. Previous court cases involving Trump have covered a broad range of subjects, from casino operations to labor disputes and failed business ventures. Notably, Trump’s court demeanor has fluctuated between charm, assertiveness, resistance, and lengthy, sometimes off-topic explanations. The trial, now into its second month, raises significant issues about business integrity and legal accountability for public figures.
translated_content: NEW YORK (AP) — Donald Trump, bekas presiden Amerika Syarikat dan ahli perniagaan, dijangka memberi keterangan pada hari Isnin dalam perbicaraan penipuan sivil di New York. Kes ini, yang difailkan oleh Peguam Negara New York, Letitia James, mengancam kawalan Trump ke atas hartanah utama seperti Trump Tower dan mencabar imejnya sebagai usahawan berjaya. Keterangan Trump akan menyusuli testimoni daripada kedua-dua anak lelakinya, Eric Trump dan Donald Trump Jr., yang juga eksekutif Trump Organization, serta diikuti oleh anak perempuan sulungnya, Ivanka Trump. Perbicaraan ini memfokus kepada dakwaan bahawa Trump dan syarikatnya telah membesar-besarkan nilai kekayaannya berbilion dolar dalam penyata kewangan untuk mendapatkan pinjaman dan kadar insurans lebih baik. Trump menafikan salah laku. Pendakwa menuntut penalti sebanyak $250 juta dan larangan kepada Trump serta eksekutif utama daripada menjalankan perniagaan di New York. Trump mempunyai pengalaman luas sebagai saksi, pernah memberi keterangan dalam sekurang-kurangnya lapan perbicaraan dan pelbagai deposisi sejak 1986. Penampilannya sering dicirikan dengan keyakinan, sikap defensif, dan gaya berdebat—cerminan personaliti umumnya. Keterangan sebelum ini menunjukkan Trump cenderung untuk melepaskan tanggungjawab, menggunakan gaya retorik, dan kadang kala mengelak soalan secara langsung. Beliau sering menyalahkan kegagalan perniagaan atau tindakan kewangan kontroversi ke atas pekerja atau menganggapnya sebagai amalan biasa dalam dunia perniagaan. Perbicaraan ini dijalankan tanpa juri dan memberi tumpuan kepada sejauh mana penglibatan Trump dan lain-lain dalam menilai aset untuk penyata kewangan tahunan. Anak-anak lelaki Trump menyatakan mereka bergantung kepada firma perakaunan luar, manakala Trump pula berhujah bahawa penyata kewangan itu tidak seharusnya diambil terlalu serius, dengan merujuk kepada penafian yang disertakan. Hakim telah memutuskan bahawa beberapa penyata Trump adalah palsu dan telah memindahkan sebahagian kawalan syarikat kepada penerima mahkamah, namun keputusan ini tertangguh kerana rayuan masih berjalan. Trump sering mengkritik kes ini secara terbuka, menyifatkannya bermotifkan politik dan sebagai sebahagian usaha untuk menjejaskan kempen pilihan raya presidennya 2024. Beliau tetap mempertahankan bahawa amalan perniagaannya adalah sesuatu yang biasa dalam industri hartanah dan bahawa institusi kewangan tidak mengalami kerugian. Kes-kes mahkamah terdahulu yang melibatkan Trump merangkumi pelbagai isu, daripada operasi kasino kepada pertikaian buruh dan projek perniagaan yang gagal. Sikap Trump di mahkamah kerap berubah antara berkarisma, tegas, melawan, serta memberikan jawapan panjang lebar dan kadangkala lari daripada topik. Perbicaraan yang kini memasuki bulan kedua ini menimbulkan isu penting mengenai integriti perniagaan dan akauntabiliti tokoh awam.

article_content: England's Ben Stokes was seen using an inhaler during a practice session in Bangalore, underscoring the difficult air quality faced by teams during the ICC Cricket World Cup. On Friday, Delhi's Air Quality Index (AQI) soared above 550, entering the 'severe' category, and topped the real-time global pollution list compiled by IQAir with an AQI of 611, followed by Lahore, Pakistan at 277. Delhi will host its last league match amid these hazardous conditions.  On November 6, Delhi’s Arun Jaitley Stadium is set to host a World Cup match between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. Deteriorating air quality has revived concerns, recalling a 2017 incident when several Sri Lankan players wore masks and Indian bowler Mohammed Shami fell ill during a test match due to high pollution. England cricketers, including Test captain Ben Stokes, have begun using inhalers as a precaution.  On Friday, Mumbai’s AQI was recorded at 219 by the Air Quality Early Warning System for Delhi. Mumbai is scheduled to host a league match between Afghanistan and Australia on November 7 and a semifinal match after Diwali, on November 15.  BCCI Secretary Jay Shah acknowledged the urgent concerns over air pollution in Mumbai and Delhi, stating that fireworks will not be part of match celebrations in these host cities. 'While we strive to host the ICC World Cup in a manner befitting the celebration of cricket, we remain steadfast in our commitment to prioritising the health and safety of all our stakeholders,' Shah said.  Cricketers have voiced their worries, with England's Joe Root discussing breathing difficulties during matches and India's captain Rohit Sharma calling for change to protect the next generation.  In other updates, Apple Inc. recorded a new quarterly revenue high in India in September, reflecting substantial growth. Younger buyers are also fueling luxury car sales in India, with brands like Audi, Mercedes-Benz, and BMW seeing stronger sales among customers under 40.  Leadership for the proposed Sony-Zee merger remains uncertain, as ZEEL chief Punit Goenka is under SEBI investigation for alleged financial misconduct.  For more news, visit The Economic Times.

article_content: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) has reiterated its intention to continue investigating the Adani Group over alleged overvaluation of coal imports. In an affidavit submitted to the Supreme Court on October 10, the DRI stated that it properly followed procedure in seeking a Letter Rogatory—a formal judicial request—for documents pertaining to the case in Singapore. The Supreme Court has combined the Adani Group matter with a separate case involving alleged gold smuggling by a Hyderabad-based jeweller. The DRI initially went to the apex court in November 2019 to challenge a Bombay High Court decision in favor of the Adani Group. The case has had five hearings in four years and has not yet reached final arguments. The DRI's affidavit accuses the Adani Group, rather than the agency, of questionable conduct before the court. The DRI argued that, had its investigation lacked merit, both Indian and Singaporean courts would have rejected its requests at the outset. The DRI pointed out that after the Letter Rogatory was issued in August 2016, Singapore’s Attorney General’s Chamber obtained multiple Production Orders from Singaporean courts against Adani Global Pte Ltd and associated companies and banks. These orders were served in July-August 2017. The agency reported ongoing difficulties in accessing necessary documents, citing non-cooperation from Adani Group companies and their banks. As a result, the DRI argued that obtaining the documents through a Letter Rogatory became imperative, and that approval was granted by the Ministries of Finance and Home Affairs. The DRI is investigating about 40 companies—including six Adani Group companies—for alleged overvaluation of coal imports from Indonesia amounting to Rs 29,000 crore between 2011 and 2015. The Adani Group denies any wrongdoing. In 2016, the DRI issued a nationwide alert to customs offices about suspected schemes for inflating procurement prices of imported coal, potentially to transfer money abroad and claim higher power tariff compensation. According to the alert, invoices for Indonesian coal shipped to India were routed through intermediary firms in Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, and the British Virgin Islands. The DRI suggested that these intermediaries appeared to be either subsidiaries or front companies of Indian importers and estimated overvaluation at about 50% to 100%. The investigation is significant, as a 2017 Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC) finding noted that any proof of over-invoicing of Indonesian coal imports by Adani Power could affect the compensation it received from power distributors in several states. The Adani Group has received such compensation in Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Maharashtra. Overvaluation of coal may raise production expenses, leading to higher electricity tariffs for consumers. After the Bombay High Court quashed all Letters Rogatory in September 2018, the DRI appealed to the Supreme Court, which stayed the order in January 2020. Multiple delays followed, including late filing of a counter affidavit by Adani. In July, the Supreme Court directed the DRI to submit more documents and scheduled the next hearing for October 10. On October 10, the Supreme Court identified two main issues for examination: whether DRI officers qualify as police officers, and whether an FIR under the Customs Act is required before arresting an accused. The next hearing is scheduled for February 6.
translated_content: Direktorat Perisikan Hasil (DRI) telah mengulangi pendiriannya untuk meneruskan siasatan terhadap Kumpulan Adani berhubung dakwaan penilaian berlebihan import arang batu. Dalam afidavit yang difailkan kepada Mahkamah Agung pada 10 Oktober, DRI memaklumkan ia telah mematuhi prosedur untuk memohon Surat Rogatori—permintaan kehakiman rasmi—bagi mendapatkan dokumen berkaitan kes di Singapura. Mahkamah Agung telah menggabungkan kes Kumpulan Adani dengan satu kes lain membabitkan dakwaan penyeludupan emas oleh tukang emas dari Hyderabad. DRI membawa kes itu ke peringkat mahkamah tertinggi pada November 2019 untuk mencabar keputusan Mahkamah Tinggi Bombay yang menyebelahi Kumpulan Adani. Kes ini telah didengar lima kali dalam tempoh empat tahun tanpa hujahan akhir. Afidavit DRI menegaskan bahawa Kumpulan Adani, bukan agensi itu sendiri, bertindak tidak telus di hadapan mahkamah. DRI menegaskan bahawa jika siasatan tidak berasas, mahkamah di India dan Singapura pasti telah menolak permintaan mereka sejak awal. DRI menjelaskan selepas Surat Rogatori dikeluarkan pada Ogos 2016, Pejabat Peguam Negara Singapura telah memperoleh beberapa Perintah Pengeluaran dari mahkamah Singapura terhadap Adani Global Pte Ltd dan syarikat serta bank berkaitan. Perintah ini telah diserahkan sekitar Julai-Ogos 2017. Agensi berdepan kesukaran mendapat dokumen penting disebabkan kurang kerjasama daripada syarikat-syarikat Kumpulan Adani dan bank berkaitan. Justeru, mendapatkan dokumen melalui Surat Rogatori dianggap perlu dengan kelulusan Kementerian Kewangan dan Kementerian Dalam Negeri. DRI kini menyiasat lebih kurang 40 syarikat—enam daripadanya syarikat bawah Kumpulan Adani—berkaitan dakwaan penilaian berlebihan import arang batu dari Indonesia berjumlah sekitar Rs 29,000 crore antara 2011 dan 2015. Kumpulan Adani menafikan sebarang salah laku. Pada 2016, DRI mengeluarkan amaran kepada pejabat kastam seluruh negara berhubung kemungkinan harga arang batu import dinaikkan untuk memindahkan wang ke luar negara dan menuntut pampasan kadar tarif kuasa lebih tinggi. Invois bagi penghantaran arang batu dari Indonesia didakwa disalurkan melalui firma perantara di Singapura, Dubai, Hong Kong dan British Virgin Islands. DRI menyatakan, firma-firma ini adalah anak syarikat atau syarikat depan pengimport India dengan tahap penilaian berlebihan sekitar 50% hingga 100%. Siasatan ini penting kerana keputusan Suruhanjaya Kawal Selia Elektrik Pusat (CERC) pada 2017 menyatakan, pembuktian isu penilaian berlebihan boleh mempengaruhi jumlah pampasan diterima Adani Power daripada pengedar tenaga negeri. Kumpulan Adani turut menerima pampasan di Rajasthan, Gujarat dan Maharashtra. Penilaian harga arang batu yang berlebihan boleh meningkatkan kos pengeluaran dan membebankan pengguna dengan tarif elektrik lebih tinggi. Selepas Mahkamah Tinggi Bombay membatalkan semua Surat Rogatori pada September 2018, DRI membuat rayuan ke Mahkamah Agung yang kemudian menangguhkan keputusan itu pada Januari 2020. Pelbagai kelewatan berlaku akibat kelewatan afidavit balas Adani. Pada Julai, Mahkamah Agung mengarahkan DRI mengemukakan dokumen tambahan dan kes dijadualkan untuk 10 Oktober. Pada 10 Oktober, Mahkamah Agung mengenal pasti dua isu utama: sama ada pegawai DRI dikira sebagai pegawai polis, dan sama ada laporan FIR di bawah Akta Kastam diperlukan sebelum penahanan tertuduh. Pendengaran seterusnya ditetapkan pada 6 Februari.

article_content: The sixth Atlas Workshops at the Marrakech Film Festival kick off today, curated for the first time by former indie film sales agent and publicist Hédi Zardi. Running from November 27th to 30th in a large riad on the outskirts of Marrakech, this project and talent incubator is presenting 25 projects from the MENA region and Africa—16 are in development and nine are in production or post-production. Zardi, previously co-founding head of Paris-based sales company Luxbox alongside Fiorella Moretti, brings extensive experience from the film festival and market circuit. Together, they helped launch acclaimed films, including Ava DuVernay’s ARRAY acquisition of Isabel Sandoval’s 'Lingua Franca,' Oscilloscope Laboratories’ deal for Nathalie Alvarez Mesen’s 'Clara Sola,' and KimStim’s acquisition of Suzanne Lindon’s debut 'Spring Blossom.' Following eight years in film sales, including the pandemic period, Zardi is acutely aware of the hurdles facing independent, non-English-language films. He has used this expertise to guide his first Atlas Workshops selection. “I was looking for projects that are artistically bold, but also stand a realistic chance of engaging the market and audiences, whether via theatrical release or digital platforms,” Zardi explained. “I’ve also invited guests who reflect emerging trends, widening the network beyond the classic French and European connections to include producers from Germany, the Nordics, and the United States.” Notably, this year’s guests from the US include Oscar-nominated 'Winter’s Bone' producer Alix Madigan and 'War Pony' and 'Manodrome' producer Ryan Zacarias. On the sales front, major companies like Charades, Kinology, and A24 are involved. “We’re not niche anymore,” Zardi remarked. This year’s Atlas Workshops selection has an increased number of genre films, reflecting a broader trend among MENA and African filmmakers moving away from purely social dramas. “There’s a new energy—young filmmakers are exploring various genres. Even when their stories reflect local realities, the style and codes they use are different,” Zardi noted. Examples of in-development projects include Tunisian director Youssef Chebbi’s thriller 'Plague'; Lebanese director Sandra Tabet’s drama 'Rabies' centering on rabid dogs in Beirut; Moroccan filmmaker Ismaël El Iraki’s crime tale 'Wolfmother'; and the action feature 'Thundering Smoke' by Finnish-Somali director Khadar Ayderus Ahmed, following his breakthrough with 'The Gravedigger’s Wife.' To further support genre storytelling, the workshops feature talks such as a discussion with 'Cairo Conspiracy' director Tarik Saleh about using thriller and investigative codes, and a case study on VFX in Sofia Alaoui’s award-winning fantasy drama 'Animalia.' “'Animalia' is a visual achievement, especially in its VFX. Sofia Alaoui collaborated with Arnaud Fouquet in Paris,” Zardi shared. “We’ll discuss how this new director established a creative relationship with the VFX team and managed to control expenses, showing that ambitious VFX is possible even on a limited budget.” In addition to development projects, nine films in production or post-production are part of the program. Highlights include 'Motherhood' by Tunisian director Meryam Joobeur (Oscar-nominated for 'Brotherhood') and 'Agora' by Ala Eddine Slim (winner of Venice’s Luigi de Laurentiis Award for 'Last Of Us'). Festival representatives from Venice, Toronto, and Locarno are attending the work-in-progress screenings. Projects are eligible for Atlas Prizes for production and post-production valued at €30,000, €20,000, and €10,000. This year’s jury includes Ava Cahen (Cannes Critics’ Week), Mohamed Hefzy (Egyptian producer), and Meryem Benm’Barek (Moroccan director). Prizes for in-development projects (€30,000, €20,000, two x €5,000) will be decided by Katrin Pors (producer), Fayçal Hassaïri (Moroccan producer), and Sarah Chazelle (French distributor). This year’s edition was impacted by the last-minute withdrawal of guest mentor Martin Scorsese due to personal reasons. According to Zardi, participants remained focused on their projects and wished Scorsese well.
translated_content: Atlas Workshops ke-6 di Festival Filem Marrakech bermula hari ini dan dikendalikan buat pertama kali oleh bekas ejen jualan filem indie serta publisiti, Hédi Zardi. Berlangsung dari 27 hingga 30 November di sebuah riad besar di pinggir Marrakech, inkubator projek dan bakat ini mempersembahkan 25 projek dari rantau MENA dan Afrika—16 dalam pembangunan, sembilan lagi dalam produksi atau pasca-produksi. Zardi, bekas ketua bersama Luxbox yang berpangkalan di Paris bersama Fiorella Moretti, membawa pengalaman luas dari dunia festival dan pasaran filem. Mereka berdua telah membantu melancarkan filem-filem terkenal seperti 'Lingua Franca' (diambil oleh Ava DuVernay’s ARRAY, arahan Isabel Sandoval), 'Clara Sola' (Oscilloscope Laboratories, arahan Nathalie Alvarez Mesen), dan 'Spring Blossom' (KimStim, arahan Suzanne Lindon). Selepas lapan tahun dalam bidang jualan filem, termasuk semasa pandemik, Zardi amat memahami cabaran filem bebas bukan berbahasa Inggeris. Dia menggunakan kepakaran ini untuk membimbing pemilihan projek Atlas Workshops pertamanya. "Saya mencari projek yang berani secara artistik dan juga punya peluang sebenar untuk menembusi pasaran serta penonton, sama ada melalui tayangan pawagam atau platform digital," kata Zardi. "Saya juga menjemput tetamu yang mewakili trend baru, memperluas jaringan dari kerjasama Perancis dan Eropah kepada penerbit dari Jerman, Nordik dan Amerika Syarikat." Antara tetamu AS tahun ini ialah Alix Madigan (penerbit 'Winter’s Bone', calon Oscar) serta Ryan Zacarias (penerbit 'War Pony' dan 'Manodrome'). Syarikat jualan utama seperti Charades, Kinology dan A24 juga turut serta. “Kami sudah bukan ‘niche’ lagi,” tambah Zardi. Pilihan tahun ini memperlihatkan lebih banyak filem genre, seiring dengan trend pembuat filem MENA dan Afrika yang mula bergerak keluar dari drama sosial tradisional. “Ada tenaga baru—generasi muda kini menjelajah pelbagai genre. Walaupun topik mencerminkan realiti setempat, gaya dan kod cerita mereka berbeza,” ujar Zardi. Antara projek pembangunan ialah thriller 'Plague' oleh pengarah Tunisia Youssef Chebbi; drama 'Rabies' oleh Sandra Tabet dari Lubnan tentang anjing gila di Beirut; kisah jenayah 'Wolfmother' (Ismaël El Iraki, Maghribi); dan filem aksi 'Thundering Smoke' oleh Khadar Ayderus Ahmed dari Finland/Somali yang dikenali melalui 'The Gravedigger’s Wife.' Sebagai sokongan kepada bercerita genre, bengkel menawarkan sesi bersama pengarah 'Cairo Conspiracy', Tarik Saleh, membincangkan penggunaan kod genre thriller & penyiasatan; serta kajian kes kesan khas (VFX) dalam drama fantasi pemenang anugerah 'Animalia' arahan Sofia Alaoui. "'Animalia' ialah kejayaan visual terutama dari segi VFX. Sofia Alaoui bekerjasama dengan Arnaud Fouquet di Paris," tambah Zardi. "Kami akan bincangkan bagaimana pengarah muda ini membina hubungan kreatif dengan pasukan VFX dan berjaya mengawal kos produksi; membuktikan VFX berkualiti tidak mustahil dengan bajet terhad." Selain projek pembangunan, sembilan filem dalam produksi atau pasca-produksi turut dipersembahkan, termasuk 'Motherhood' oleh Meryam Joobeur (Tunisia, calon Oscar 'Brotherhood') dan 'Agora' oleh Ala Eddine Slim (Venice Luigi de Laurentiis Award, 'Last Of Us'). Wakil festival utama seperti Venice, Toronto, dan Locarno hadir ke tayangan pratonton kerja. Projek projek ini layak menerima Anugerah Atlas untuk produksi dan pasca-produksi sebanyak €30,000, €20,000, dan €10,000. Para juri tahun ini termasuk Ava Cahen (Cannes Critics’ Week), Mohamed Hefzy (penerbit Mesir), dan Meryem Benm’Barek (pengarah Maghribi). Hadiah untuk projek pembangunan (€30,000, €20,000, dua x €5,000) akan ditentukan oleh Katrin Pors, Fayçal Hassaïri dan Sarah Chazelle. Edisi tahun ini sedikit terjejas berikutan mentor undangan, Martin Scorsese, menarik diri pada saat akhir atas sebab peribadi. Menurut Zardi, peserta tetap fokus pada projek dan mendoakan kesihatan dan kesejahteraan Scorsese.

A joint survey of the no man's land on the Indo-Nepal border in Uttarakhand is scheduled for October 26, following reports of widespread encroachments in the Khatima area of Udham Singh Nagar district and nearby Champawat district. Ravindra Singh Bisht, Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) of Khatima, stated, "Military and administrative officials from both countries will convene on Thursday to discuss and demarcate the border area to address the escalating issue on the international frontier. After the survey, steps will be taken to quickly remove encroachments from the no man's land."

A total of 269 demarcation pillars, intended to mark the Indo-Nepal border in southeast Uttarakhand, have been found missing. According to a senior official, encroachments have been reported along the stretch from pillar 700 in Palia Kalan (India) to pillar 811 in Brahmdev (Nepal). People from both sides of the border are alleged to have encroached upon the no man's land. Local sources claim that farmers, primarily from Nepal's Madhesi community, have started cultivating the land and setting up temporary structures, while some individuals from the Indian side have also begun farming activities there.

Udham Singh Nagar District Magistrate, Udayraj Singh, said, "Departments responsible for reclaiming the no man's land near Khatima have been instructed to act promptly. A joint team comprising members from the local administration, forest department, irrigation department, and Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) is being formed."

In the neighboring Tanakpur area of Champawat district, SDM Akash Joshi reported that administrative officials, together with the revenue department, local police, and SSB personnel, surveyed the no man's land around pillar 796-1. "Farming was observed in the area, but no evidence of other illegal activities, such as human trafficking, was found," he noted.

Commenting on the situation, DIG SSB (area headquarters) D N Bhombe said, "There are 54 border outposts along the 254-kilometer Indo-Nepal border from Kalapani to Tanakpur. People with dual citizenship living on the border are being monitored. We remain fully alert in light of the festive season and the upcoming Lok Sabha elections."

Satu tinjauan bersama di kawasan tanah kosong di sempadan Indo-Nepal di Uttarakhand dijadualkan pada 26 Oktober, susulan laporan pencerobohan meluas di kawasan Khatima, daerah Udham Singh Nagar dan daerah berdekatan Champawat. Ravindra Singh Bisht, Penolong Pegawai Daerah (SDM) Khatima berkata, "Pegawai tentera dan pentadbiran dari kedua-dua negara akan bertemu pada hari Khamis untuk membincangkan dan menandakan kawasan sempadan bagi menangani isu yang semakin memuncak di sempadan antarabangsa. Selepas tinjauan, tindakan segera akan diambil untuk menghapuskan pencerobohan di tanah kosong itu."

Sebanyak 269 tiang sempadan, yang bertujuan menandakan sempadan Indo-Nepal di tenggara Uttarakhand, didapati hilang. Menurut seorang pegawai kanan, pencerobohan telah dilaporkan di sepanjang kawasan dari tiang 700 di Palia Kalan (India) ke tiang 811 di Brahmdev (Nepal). Difahamkan, penduduk dari kedua-dua belah sempadan telah menceroboh kawasan tanah kosong itu. Sumber tempatan mendakwa bahawa petani, terutamanya dari komuniti Madhesi Nepal, telah mula mengusahakan tanah tersebut dan mendirikan struktur sementara, manakala beberapa individu dari pihak India juga telah memulakan aktiviti pertanian di sana.

Pegawai Daerah Udham Singh Nagar, Udayraj Singh, berkata, "Jabatan yang bertanggungjawab untuk mendapatkan semula tanah kosong berhampiran Khatima telah diarahkan supaya bertindak dengan segera. Sebuah pasukan bersama yang terdiri daripada pihak pentadbiran tempatan, jabatan hutan, jabatan pengairan, dan Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) sedang dibentuk."

Di kawasan Tanakpur bersebelahan di daerah Champawat, SDM Akash Joshi melaporkan bahawa pegawai pentadbiran bersama jabatan hasil, polis tempatan dan anggota SSB telah meninjau tanah kosong sekitar tiang 796-1. "Aktiviti pertanian dilihat di kawasan tersebut, tetapi tiada bukti aktiviti haram lain seperti pemerdagangan manusia ditemui," katanya.

Mengenai situasi ini, DIG SSB (ibu pejabat kawasan) D N Bhombe berkata, "Terdapat 54 pos kawalan sempadan di sepanjang 254 kilometer sempadan Indo-Nepal dari Kalapani ke Tanakpur. Mereka yang mempunyai dua kewarganegaraan yang tinggal di sempadan sedang dipantau. Kami sentiasa berwaspada memandangkan musim perayaan dan pilihan raya Lok Sabha yang bakal tiba."
post_content: Big moves on the Indo-Nepal border! 🇮🇳🇳🇵 Officials from both countries are teaming up for a joint survey after missing border pillars and reports of illegal farming. Security’s tight for the festive season & upcoming polls! #BorderAlert #IndiaNepal #NewsUpdate

article_content: Thousands of Opel workers in Germany went on strike Thursday in response to General Motors’ (GM) decision to cancel the planned sale of Opel. Earlier this week, GM stunned German officials by announcing it would keep its European Opel and Vauxhall divisions, abandoning an agreement to sell them to the Canadian firm Magna. Had the sale gone through, thousands of jobs in Spain and at Vauxhall plants in the UK would have been lost. GM’s reversal prompted celebrations in the UK, but significant anger in Germany, where many Opel workers now fear job cuts. At a rally at Opel’s Ruesselsheim headquarters, Hesse state Premier Roland Koch – a strong supporter of the sale to Magna – told workers, 'We want Opel to continue to exist. We will have to fight again with the goal of saving jobs.' GM has announced a restructuring plan for Opel that could see up to 10,000 jobs cut at its European subsidiary, where about half of the 50,000 Opel employees are based in Germany. GM confirmed to CNN that its updated plan for Opel would 'likely include cuts in that range.' Jürgen Rüttgers, Premier of North Rhine-Westphalia, where a GM plant faces closure, told the Financial Times: 'General Motors’ behavior shows the ugly face of turbo-capitalism. That is completely unacceptable.' German Opel workers oppose GM’s restructuring plan, fearing vehicle development will shift from Germany to the United States. Workers also demand to be compensated for past concessions, including a forfeited pay rise, their 2008 Christmas bonus, and 2009 vacation pay. GM has pledged to work with European labor unions on Opel’s restructuring. According to GM, improved business conditions and the importance of Opel and Vauxhall to its global strategy influenced the decision to keep the brands. GM’s decision halts Magna’s acquisition efforts—the deal had been brokered in September by German Chancellor Angela Merkel. GM initially considered selling Opel after reporting a $30.9 billion loss in 2008. Opel, along with Vauxhall, is the fourth-largest car brand in Europe, trailing Volkswagen, Ford, and Renault, and accounts for over 70% of GM’s European sales. While the restructuring may still involve layoffs, it could, in the short term, protect some jobs. Employees at the Vauxhall plant in Ellesmere Port, England, welcomed the news. 'I think it’s a good idea, because a lot of people will have jobs,' said one worker. Another noted, 'We’ve had a three-day week for a long time. We’ve lost money, so now we’re going to start getting some back.' Unite union head Tony Woodley expressed delight at GM keeping the Opel and Vauxhall brands, stating, 'GM was once the biggest company in the world—we have no reason to believe it cannot restructure to address its current difficulties.' Woodley said he was concerned that Magna would lack the expertise to run a global car business. CNN’s Fred Pleitgen in Berlin contributed to this report.

Jika penjualan itu diteruskan, ribuan pekerjaan di Sepanyol dan di kilang Vauxhall di UK akan terjejas. Pekerja juga menuntut pembayaran semula atas pengorbanan masa lalu, termasuk kenaikan gaji yang dibatalkan, bonus Krismas 2008, dan bayaran cuti tahun 2009. Walaupun penstrukturan semula ini mungkin melibatkan pemberhentian kerja, ia boleh melindungi beberapa pekerjaan dalam jangka pendek. Pekerja di kilang Vauxhall di Ellesmere Port, England, menyambut baik berita ini. 'Saya rasa ia keputusan yang baik kerana ramai orang akan kekal bekerja,' kata seorang pekerja. Seorang lagi berkata, 'Kami sudah lama bekerja hanya tiga hari seminggu. Kami telah kehilangan pendapatan, jadi sekarang kami boleh mula dapatkan semula.' Ketua kesatuan Unite, Tony Woodley, menyatakan kegembiraannya kerana GM mengekalkan jenama Opel dan Vauxhall, dengan berkata, 'GM pernah menjadi syarikat terbesar di dunia—tiada sebab ia tidak boleh menstruktur semula untuk mengatasi kesukaran sekarang.' Woodley turut menyatakan kebimbangannya bahawa Magna mungkin tidak mempunyai kepakaran untuk mengendalikan perniagaan kereta bertaraf global. Fred Pleitgen dari CNN di Berlin turut menyumbang kepada laporan ini.

article_content: Tom Gray believed he had won £80,000 after finding two matching numbers on his National Lottery scratchcard. When he saw a pair of dice each displaying four dots, the 75-year-old cancer patient started making plans to support his children and grandchildren with the winnings. However, when his daughter Alison Gray tried to help him claim the prize, lottery officials explained he had actually won only £2. Officials stated that the card, which was bought in Romford, Essex, appeared to have a printing error. One dice should have shown five dots, but a misprint concealed this detail. Mr. Gray, diagnosed with prostate cancer in October, intended to share any prize with his four children and eight grandchildren. The former gas and central heating fitter from Harold Hill, Essex, said, 'The card said if you match the dots on the dice you’ve won, and both dice showed four dots. If there’s a printing error, that’s their fault. I hope they own up to the mistake.' Alison Gray, 51, commented, 'I felt so bad for my dad because he had started thinking about helping his family. That’s what upset him most. He’s really down about it. It feels unfair. Even if it’s a misprint, who is responsible?' Ms. Gray, an accountant with Ford Credit, has cared for her father since his illness began. She had bought them both scratchcards at a Tesco supermarket near Romford last month. The questionable scratchcard has a printing defect: a line with missing ink that runs through one die, covering the spot where a fifth dot would have appeared. Ms. Gray said, 'My dad finished scratching, saw the second dice, and handed it to me saying, “I can’t believe it.”' The £2 Lucky Streak card offers a prize if two identical dice are shown, which Mr. Gray thought he saw. The possible prize amounts were £10, £50, £5,000, and £80,000—the top prize displayed next to the apparent match. According to Camelot, he only won £2, likely from a separate game on the same card. Ms. Gray said, 'He had started talking about using the money to pay off his car and asking how much I still owe on my mortgage.' But when she called to claim, officials told her the serial number did not match a jackpot winner. She said, 'I called the number and provided the serial details, but was only told, “You’ve won £2.”' A spokesperson for Camelot said this was the first time anyone had raised a query about a win on a Lucky Streak scratchcard. The company requested that the scratchcard be posted in for investigation so they could find out what happened. The spokesperson added, 'Outcomes for each National Lottery scratchcard game are predetermined when printed. Our operations are regularly reviewed by our internal auditors, independent external auditors, and the Gambling Commission.' Lucky Streak scratchcards provide two games with eight chances to win various cash prizes. They have been available since the start of September. To date, £15.2 million has been paid out in prizes, including five top prizes of £80,000. Camelot says each card has a one-in-four chance of winning.

Bagaimanapun, apabila anak perempuannya, Alison Gray, cuba membantunya menuntut hadiah, pegawai loteri menjelaskan bahawa dia sebenarnya hanya menang £2. Ms. Gray, seorang akauntan di Ford Credit, telah menjaga ayahnya sejak sakit. Dia membeli dua kad gores itu di Tesco berhampiran Romford bulan lalu. Syarikat meminta kad gores itu dipos untuk siasatan lanjut. Jurucakap itu menambah, 'Keputusan setiap permainan kad gores National Lottery telah ditentukan semasa ia dicetak. Setakat ini, £15.2 juta telah dibayar dalam bentuk hadiah, termasuk lima hadiah utama bernilai £80,000. Camelot berkata setiap kad mempunyai peluang satu dalam empat untuk menang.

article_content:
When guests visit my home for the first time, there are only a few personal items of interest worth showing. It’s a short and rather uninspiring tour—the gift shop is just pudding, and I’m usually not wearing pants. Still, the first thing I showcase is a framed original 1972 Rolling Stone cover with Jerry Garcia. It’s the main conversation starter I own. Otherwise, visitors can marvel at a vase filled with large sticks or browse my lackluster condiment collection, which never seems to impress.

Thankfully, I finally discovered the perfect decorative talking point to display in the small space my dog hasn't claimed: a giant egg—perfect for the Easter season! It’s so large that you could hide it behind a Honda Civic, and if your kids can’t find it, that’s on you. This egg is a foot high and eight inches wide, about the size of John Madden’s head (with less residue from turducken). It would certainly look great next to my sticks, but there’s a catch: when it goes up for auction at Christie’s in London during a science and travel sale at the end of April, it’s expected to fetch over $45,000.

The hefty price tag comes from its rarity—it’s a fully intact fossilized egg from the long-extinct elephant bird. While some specimens are pieced together from fragments, this one is pristine. It’s a remarkable way to honor a truly unique animal. Elephant birds once roamed Madagascar until the 17th century and, at ten feet tall, were the largest winged creatures on land. They couldn’t fly, but their sheer size set them apart—much larger than an ostrich. Their massive eggs could feed a group for a month, or perhaps the entire Kansas City Chiefs offensive line for a few minutes.

To put it in perspective, a single elephant bird egg equals around 120 chicken eggs. Scientists believe their eggs were even larger than those of dinosaurs. As a mammal, it’s hard to imagine laying such a giant, shelled oval—which makes for an interesting but perhaps impolite topic of conversation.

No one knows who will win the auction, but it will surely require a collector fond of spending on the unusual. “Jim, what did you just buy?” “It’s a used toothpick from Shaquille O’Neal—for my collection.” Then again, maybe that would look good in my vase of sticks too.

Apabila tetamu datang ke rumah saya buat kali pertama, hanya ada beberapa barangan peribadi yang menarik untuk ditunjukkan. Lawatan rumah saya singkat dan kurang mengujakan—‘kedai cenderamata’ cuma ada puding, dan saya biasanya tak pakai seluar. Tapi, benda pertama yang saya pamerkan ialah bingkai majalah Rolling Stone asli tahun 1972 dengan Jerry Garcia di muka depan. Itu saja bahan bual utama saya. Selebihnya, tetamu boleh tengok pasu berisi ranting besar atau koleksi sos saya yang tampak hambar.

Nasib baik saya dah jumpa dekorasi perbualan yang sempurna untuk dipamer di ruang kecil yang tidak dikuasai anjing: telur gergasi—tepat untuk musim Easter! Telur ni sangat besar, boleh disembunyikan di belakang Honda Civic, dan kalau anak anda tak jumpa juga, memang kes anda. Tingginya satu kaki dan selebar lapan inci, lebih kurang besar kepala John Madden (tapi lebih bersih berbanding turducken). Memang sesuai letak sebelah ranting saya, tapi ada satu masalah: bila ia dilelong di Christie’s, London, sempena jualan sains dan kembara hujung April nanti, harga dijangka melebihi $45,000.

Mahal sebab ianya sangat jarang—sebiji telur gajah burung yang telah pupus dan masih utuh sepenuhnya. Banyak spesimen lain hanya serpihan, tapi yang ini betul-betul sempurna. Cara luar biasa untuk mengiktiraf haiwan unik ini. Burung gajah pernah hidup di Madagascar hingga abad ke-17, dengan ketinggian sepuluh kaki—yang paling besar antara burung tidak terbang di dunia. Mereka tak boleh terbang, tapi saiznya luar biasa—lebih besar dari burung unta. Telur mereka yang raksasa boleh jadi makanan satu kumpulan selama sebulan, atau barisan serangan Kansas City Chiefs dalam beberapa minit.

Sebiji telur burung gajah sama dengan kira-kira 120 telur ayam. Saintis percaya ianya lebih besar daripada telur dinosaur. Sebagai mamalia, memang susah nak bayangkan macam mana rasanya ‘melahirkan’ benda sebesar itu—topik menarik tapi mungkin kurang sesuai untuk perbualan biasa.

Tiada siapa tahu siapa yang akan membida telur ini, tapi pasti hanya pengumpul yang suka benda pelik sanggup membayar. "Jim, apa kamu beli tu?" "Pencungkil gigi terpakai Shaquille O’Neal—untuk koleksi saya." Bila fikir balik, itu pun elok juga letak dalam pasu ranting saya.

The Indian government is once again grappling with excessive rice stocks, only months after halting the sale of its reserves to state governments to stabilize prices. This situation has developed as the Food Corporation of India (FCI) continues robust paddy procurement during the current Kharif season while selling very little rice on the open market. Officials project that when procurement wraps up, rice reserves could exceed the required buffer by more than twofold.

Authorities are now exploring strategies to release stocked rice, with a particular focus on fortified varieties. The upcoming national elections may also prompt increased allocations of food grains to underprivileged citizens. 

Key factors behind the surplus include the central government’s decision in June to discontinue allowing states to purchase rice for their own schemes under the Open Market Sale Scheme (OMSS), and a pause on sales to ethanol-producer plants. Since FCI began e-auctioning rice in July, just about one lakh tonnes have been sold—well below the 25 lakh tonnes target set for next March.

As per official records, 170 lakh tonnes of rice have been procured so far this season (which began last month), with total procurement expected to top 500 lakh tonnes as buying in some states, such as Odisha and Jharkhand, has yet to commence. Currently, the FCI holds 194 lakh tonnes of rice—well above the prescribed buffer stock of 76 lakh tonnes for January 1—not counting 230 tonnes still awaited from millers, and another estimated 50-60 lakh tonnes expected from the next (Rabi) season.

India’s Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana, designed to distribute free foodgrain to nearly 81 crore people, requires about 400 lakh tonnes of rice annually. Officials stress that a decision must soon be made to draw down these surpluses, especially of fortified rice, and have ensured that all current stock figures are communicated with all concerned departments.

Pegawai menjangkakan stok beras boleh melebihi dua kali ganda keperluan penampan selepas musim perolehan berakhir.

Pihak berkuasa kini sedang meneliti jalan penyelesaian—terutama beras diperkaya—untuk mengurangkan lambakan stok. Pilihan raya umum yang akan datang mungkin menjadi peluang untuk menambah agihan makanan kepada golongan miskin.

Faktor utama lambakan ini termasuk keputusan kerajaan pusat pada bulan Jun untuk menghentikan pembelian beras negeri melalui Skim Jualan Pasaran Terbuka (OMSS) dan penangguhan penjualan kepada kilang etanol. Sejak lelongan e-beras FCI bermula Julai, hanya sekitar satu lakh tan terjual—jauh daripada sasaran 25 lakh tan menjelang Mac tahun depan.

Menurut data rasmi, sebanyak 170 lakh tan beras telah diperoleh setakat musim ini (bermula bulan lalu), dan jumlah keseluruhan dijangka melebihi 500 lakh tan kerana pembelian di beberapa negeri seperti Odisha dan Jharkhand masih belum bermula. Kini, FCI menyimpan 194 lakh tan beras—lebih dua kali ganda stok penampan 76 lakh tan untuk 1 Januari—tidak termasuk 230 tan lagi yang masih diterima daripada pengilang dan 50–60 lakh tan lagi dijangka dari musim Rabi akan datang.

Program Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana yang memberi bekalan makanan percuma kepada hampir 81 crore rakyat memerlukan kira-kira 400 lakh tan beras setiap tahun. Pegawai menekankan perlunya keputusan segera untuk menyusutkan lebihan—terutama beras diperkaya—dan semua data stok telah dikongsi dengan jabatan berkaitan.

article_content: The conflict between Israel and Palestine has reached its 25th day, with new developments unfolding on the ground. Recent events include Israeli airstrikes in Gaza, violence in the occupied West Bank, and clashes between Israeli forces and Hezbollah at the Israel-Lebanon border. The Gaza Strip, where approximately 2.3 million people live, has been under an Israeli air, land, and sea blockade since 2007. The Strip is divided into five governorates: North Gaza, Gaza City, Deir el-Balah, Khan Younis, and Rafah. North Gaza stretches for 10 km (6 miles) and contains the only crossing into Israel, called Beit Hanoon or the Erez crossing. The Jabalia refugee camp, the largest in the Gaza Strip, is located here. Gaza City is the largest and most populous city in the Strip, home to more than 750,000 residents. Shifa Hospital, the biggest medical facility in Gaza, is located in the Rimal neighbourhood. Deir el-Balah is one of Gaza’s main agricultural producers and has a population of about 320,000. It contains four refugee camps: Nuseirat, Al Bureij, Al Maghazi, and Deir el-Balah. Khan Younis is home to roughly 430,000 people. The Khan Younis refugee camp, with about 90,000 residents, is at its centre. Rafah is the southernmost governorate, with a population of about 275,000. The Rafah crossing, connecting Gaza with Egypt, is located here.

Peristiwa terkini termasuk serangan udara Israel di Gaza, keganasan di Tebing Barat yang diduduki, dan pertempuran antara tentera Israel dan Hezbollah di sempadan Israel-Lubnan. Wilayah Gaza, yang didiami kira-kira 2.3 juta orang, telah berada di bawah sekatan udara, darat dan laut Israel sejak 2007. Wilayah ini dibahagikan kepada lima kawasan: Gaza Utara, Bandar Gaza, Deir el-Balah, Khan Younis, dan Rafah. Russian-installed authorities in Ukraine's southern Kherson region have reported that Ukrainian strikes killed at least nine people and injured nine others. The incident allegedly took place at an employment centre in Chaplynka, about 100 kilometres southeast of Kherson city, according to Moscow-appointed Governor Vladimir Saldo. "Nine dead have been pulled out from under the rubble, along with nine who are badly injured," Saldo told Russian state television. Moscow-backed official Konstantin Basyuk claimed that Ukrainian forces targeted civilian infrastructure in Chaplynka, including the pensions office and job centre.

Ukrainian officials and media have not confirmed these reported attacks, and Al Jazeera was unable to independently verify the strikes or report any resulting casualties or damage. Russia captured parts of the Kherson region after launching its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, but has since retreated from the region's main town and other areas on the west bank of the Dnipro River. These reported strikes come as Ukraine mounts a counteroffensive focused on reclaiming territory in the south.

Insiden itu dikatakan berlaku di sebuah pusat pekerjaan di Chaplynka, kira-kira 100 kilometer di tenggara bandar Kherson, menurut Gabenor yang dilantik Moscow, Vladimir Saldo. "Sembilan mayat telah dikeluarkan dari runtuhan, bersama sembilan lagi yang cedera parah," kata Saldo kepada televisyen negeri Rusia. Pegawai yang disokong Moscow, Konstantin Basyuk, juga mendakwa bahawa tentera Ukraine menyasarkan infrastruktur awam di Chaplynka, termasuk pejabat pencen dan pusat pekerjaan.

Serangan yang dilaporkan ini berlaku ketika Ukraine melancarkan serangan balas untuk merampas semula wilayah di selatan.

JK Tyre is forecasting ongoing strong tyre sales in India as the nation’s automotive industry thrives amid favorable economic conditions. According to Chairman and Managing Director Raghupati Singhania, the growth in India’s GDP and substantial infrastructure investments are spurring greater vehicle and tyre purchases. Singhania pointed out factors such as consistent freight activity and rising disposable incomes which continue to support car sales, thereby increasing tyre demand. The company identifies improved road networks, particularly those constructed in the past 18 months, as an additional driver for heightened vehicle use and tyre consumption.

JK Tyre remains a leader in the truck and bus radial tyre market, but is now intensifying its focus on the passenger car radial (PCR) tyre segment, recognizing greater potential for expansion. Over the past few quarters, JK Tyre’s revenue has shown consistent growth, culminating in a fivefold increase in net profit to Rs 249 crore during the September quarter—largely due to robust domestic performance. In response, JK Tyre plans to raise its production capacity by 20% before 2025, up from its current annual output of 3.5 million tyres, focusing primarily on boosting PCR production.

The company is also broadening its domestic reach by increasing the number of exclusive retail outlets to access untapped markets.

Other notable business news: Sweden’s Saab has gained approval for India’s first 100% FDI in defense and will establish a rocket manufacturing facility. State Bank of India (SBI) reported an 8% increase in Q2 profit backed by steady credit growth. Edtech firm Byju’s posted significant revenue gains from its core business for FY22, while remaining in a net loss position.

Recent findings reveal that certain Hamas fighters who participated in last month’s attacks in southern Israel were carrying Captagon, a synthetic stimulant also known as fenethylline. American and Israeli officials suspect that Captagon helped suppress emotions such as fear and anxiety, possibly increasing the militants’ aggression and willingness to commit violent acts against civilians. Israeli Defense Forces confirmed retrieving these pills from both deceased and captured members of Hamas.

Intelligence sources point to large-scale production and distribution of Captagon by the Syrian government under Bashar al-Assad, as well as by Hezbollah in Lebanon. The drug is inexpensive to produce and widely available, reaching markets throughout the Middle East and Europe.

Previously, Israeli authorities were hesitant to discuss Hamas’ suspected drug use, concerned that it might overshadow efforts to hold the group fully accountable for their deliberate actions. Officials stress that the ideological motivation behind these attacks remains crucial.

The reach of Captagon extends across Western Asia, with reports of its use among various militant groups. Evidence indicates that the Assad regime is deeply involved in both production and trafficking, leveraging intelligence channels for distribution. Captagon is cheap in Syria and Lebanon—often less than $2 per tablet—but fetches much higher prices, over $14, when trafficked into Saudi Arabia. Some militants reportedly exchange the drug for arms or cash. Alarmingly, in Saudi Arabia, approximately 40% of fenethylline users aged 12 to 22 are considered addicted, signaling a significant addiction crisis.

Pegawai Amerika Syarikat dan Israel percaya bahawa Captagon digunakan untuk menekan perasaan takut dan cemas, yang boleh meningkatkan keberanian serta kecenderungan militan untuk melakukan keganasan terhadap orang awam. Pasukan Pertahanan Israel telah mengesahkan mereka menemui pil ini pada anggota Hamas yang terbunuh dan juga yang ditangkap.

Menurut sumber perisikan, penghasilan dan pengedaran Captagon secara besar-besaran dikendalikan oleh kerajaan Syria di bawah Bashar al-Assad serta kumpulan Hezbollah di Lubnan. Ubat ini mudah dan murah dihasilkan, menyebabkan ia mudah didapati di seluruh rantau Timur Tengah dan Eropah.

Pihak berkuasa Israel sebelum ini agak berhati-hati untuk membincangkan isu penggunaan dadah oleh Hamas kerana bimbang ia boleh mengalihkan fokus daripada usaha menuntut pertanggungjawaban sepenuhnya atas tindak-tanduk yang dirancang. Pegawai menekankan bahawa faktor ideologi di sebalik serangan tersebut perlu terus dijadikan perhatian utama.

Captagon telah tersebar luas di seluruh Asia Barat, dengan bukti menunjukkan penggunaannya melibatkan pelbagai kumpulan militan. Penyelidikan mendapati rejim Assad memainkan peranan utama dalam penghasilan dan pengedaran Captagon dengan menggunakan rangkaian perisikan. Di Syria dan Lubnan, Captagon dijual pada harga rendah—sering kurang daripada $2 sebiji—namun harga boleh melonjak melebihi $14 sebiji apabila diseludup ke Arab Saudi. Terdapat kumpulan militan yang didakwa menukar Captagon dengan senjata atau wang. Membimbangkan, di Arab Saudi, sekitar 40% pengguna fenetilin berumur antara 12 hingga 22 tahun dikatakan mengalami ketagihan, menunjukkan isu kesihatan awam yang kritikal.

article_content: Two rare Andy Warhol paintings, Triple Elvis (Ferus Type) and Four Marlons, will be auctioned at Christie's in New York City later this year and are anticipated to fetch a substantial sum. Both works are considered among Warhol's most renowned portraits. Each painting is nearly seven feet tall and has never previously appeared at auction. Together, they could reach a combined sale price of $130 million when they go up for bid on November 12. Christie's has noted that the paintings will be sold separately but has not provided individual estimates yet. Triple Elvis (Ferus Type), created in 1963 with ink and silver paint, features Elvis Presley depicted as a cowboy, brandishing a gun in a dynamic pose. Four Marlons, produced three years later, is a silkscreen that presents Marlon Brando on a motorcycle in a black leather jacket—the iconic image repeated four times. Both paintings are being sold by WestSpiel, a German casino company that acquired them in the late 1970s for one of its casinos. WestSpiel director Lothar Dunkel stated that the current strength of the art market, particularly for Warhol's works, made this the right time to sell. Warhol created 22 images of Elvis in total, and another version, Double Elvis (Ferus Type), sold for $37 million at Sotheby's in 2012. Recently, Warhol's work has reached new heights in the art market. Last fall, his Silver Car Crash (Double Disaster) sold for $105.4 million at Sotheby's, setting an auction record for the artist. The buyer remains unidentified. Brett Gorvy, Christie's international head of post-war and contemporary art, explained that Warhol frequently used repetition in his art to craft narratives and offer social commentary. Regarding Triple Elvis, Gorvy noted its cinematic quality, observing that the repeated image gives a sense of motion despite being static. He also emphasized the rarity of Four Marlons, mentioning that only one other silkscreen featuring four images of Brando exists, housed at the Louisiana Museum of Modern Art in Copenhagen. A Double Marlon painting sold at Christie's for $32.5 million in 2008.

Kedua karya ini dianggap antara potret Warhol yang paling terkenal. Setiap lukisan hampir tujuh kaki tinggi serta tidak pernah dilelong sebelum ini. Jumlah jualan gabungan boleh mencecah $130 juta ketika lelongan pada 12 November. Christie's memaklumkan lukisan-lukisan ini akan dijual secara berasingan tapi belum mengeluarkan anggaran harga untuk setiap satu. Triple Elvis (Ferus Type), dihasilkan pada tahun 1963 menggunakan dakwat dan cat perak, menampilkan Elvis Presley sebagai koboi sedang mengacukan pistol dalam pose dinamik. Four Marlons, dihasilkan tiga tahun selepas itu, ialah silkskrin yang memaparkan Marlon Brando menaiki motosikal dan memakai jaket kulit hitam—imej ikonik ini diulang sebanyak empat kali. Kedua-dua lukisan dijual oleh WestSpiel, syarikat kasino dari Jerman yang memperolehnya pada penghujung 1970-an untuk salah satu kasino mereka. Pengarah WestSpiel, Lothar Dunkel berkata kekuatan pasaran seni masa kini, terutama karya Warhol, menjadikan ini masa paling sesuai untuk melepaskannya. Warhol telah hasilkan 22 imej Elvis keseluruhannya, dan versi lain, Double Elvis (Ferus Type), pernah dijual pada harga $37 juta di Sotheby's pada 2012. Baru-baru ini, karya Warhol mencapai rekod tertinggi dalam pasaran seni. Musim luruh lalu, Silver Car Crash (Double Disaster) dijual pada harga $105.4 juta di Sotheby's, satu rekod lelongan untuk artis itu. Identiti pembeli masih belum diketahui. Brett Gorvy, ketua antarabangsa seni pasca-perang dan kontemporari Christie’s, menjelaskan Warhol kerap menggunakan pengulangan dalam seninya untuk membentuk naratif dan memberi komentar sosial. Mengenai Triple Elvis, Gorvy berkata karya itu ada rasa sinematik, dengan imej yang diulang memberi kesan gerakan walaupun imej itu statik. Beliau juga tekankan keunikan Four Marlons, di mana hanya satu lagi silkskrin dengan empat imej Brando wujud di Louisiana Museum of Modern Art, Copenhagen. Satu lukisan Double Marlon pernah terjual di Christie's pada harga $32.5 juta pada tahun 2008.
