article_content: Air quality in India's capital, Delhi, has reached poor levels and is expected to worsen in the coming days, according to officials. Delhi is consistently among the world's most polluted cities, with air quality deteriorating further each winter due to multiple factors, including the burning of crop residue by farmers, low wind speeds, and the use of firecrackers during festivals. The polluted air leads to significant public health issues for Delhi residents every year. On Monday, government data showed the PM 2.5 level—a fine particulate matter that can clog lungs and cause various diseases—was 306 in the city. Air quality index (AQI) readings between 101 and 200 are considered moderate, 201 to 300 are poor, over 300 is very poor, and readings above 500 are deemed severe. VK Soni, a scientist from India's weather department, stated that air quality is expected to remain in the 'very poor' category for the next several days. Many residents have complained about morning smog in the city. A cyclist told news agency ANI, 'I think pollution levels have been rising in Delhi for the past 10-12 days. We can feel it in our eyes.' Some residents believe this is only the beginning of Delhi's annual pollution cycle and that the situation may worsen. Environment Minister Gopal Rai announced that the second phase of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) has been implemented to address rising pollution levels. As part of this strategy, public transport services—including the Delhi metro and electric buses—have been instructed to increase their frequency to help reduce vehicle emissions. In addition to the 13 pollution hotspots identified so far, special teams will be deployed at eight more locations recording high pollution levels. Minister Rai stated that these teams will focus on identifying sources of pollution, such as biomass burning, dust, congestion, or vehicle emissions. A combination of vehicle and industrial emissions, dust, and prevailing weather patterns contribute to Delhi being the world's most polluted capital. During this season, low wind speeds trap pollutants in the lower atmosphere. The burning of crop stubble—a major pollution source in regions near Delhi—has not yet intensified this year but is expected to increase in coming days. Farmers in neighboring states like Punjab, Haryana, and western Uttar Pradesh burn crop residue to clear fields for the next sowing cycle. According to the air quality forecast agency SAFAR, northwesterly winds from these states will gradually increase, bringing smoke from stubble burning into Delhi. India's pollution problem extends beyond Delhi—Indian cities frequently appear among the world's most polluted. Last week, India's financial capital, Mumbai, also experienced a drop in air quality, at times surpassing Delhi's pollution levels this month. Officials attributed this to retreating rains and ongoing construction activities. BBC News India is on YouTube. Click here to subscribe and watch our documentaries, explainers, and features.
translated_content: Kualiti udara di ibu negara India, Delhi, telah mencapai tahap yang tidak sihat dan dijangka bertambah buruk pada hari-hari akan datang, menurut pegawai. Delhi secara konsisten berada di antara bandar paling tercemar di dunia, dengan kualiti udara semakin merosot setiap musim sejuk akibat pelbagai faktor, termasuk pembakaran sisa tanaman oleh petani, kelajuan angin yang rendah, dan penggunaan mercun semasa perayaan. Udara yang tercemar menyebabkan masalah kesihatan awam yang ketara kepada penduduk Delhi setiap tahun. Pada hari Isnin, data kerajaan menunjukkan tahap PM 2.5—partikel halus yang boleh menyumbat paru-paru dan menyebabkan pelbagai penyakit—adalah 306 di bandar tersebut. Bacaan indeks kualiti udara (AQI) antara 101 hingga 200 dianggap sederhana, 201 hingga 300 dikategorikan sebagai tidak sihat, lebih 300 sangat tidak sihat, dan bacaan melebihi 500 dianggap teruk. VK Soni, seorang saintis dari jabatan cuaca India, menyatakan bahawa kualiti udara dijangka kekal dalam kategori 'sangat tidak sihat' untuk beberapa hari akan datang. Ramai penduduk telah mengadu mengenai jerebu pada waktu pagi di bandar tersebut. Seorang penunggang basikal memberitahu agensi berita ANI, 'Saya rasa tahap pencemaran terus meningkat di Delhi dalam 10-12 hari lepas. Kami dapat rasakan di mata kami.' Sesetengah penduduk percaya ini hanyalah permulaan kitaran pencemaran tahunan Delhi dan keadaannya mungkin akan bertambah buruk. Menteri Alam Sekitar Gopal Rai mengumumkan bahawa fasa kedua Pelan Tindakan Respons Berperingkat (GRAP) telah dilaksanakan bagi menangani peningkatan pencemaran. Sebagai sebahagian daripada strategi ini, perkhidmatan pengangkutan awam—termasuk metro Delhi dan bas elektrik—telah diarahkan untuk menambah kekerapan bagi membantu mengurangkan pelepasan kenderaan. Selain 13 kawasan panas pencemaran yang dikenal pasti setakat ini, pasukan khas akan ditempatkan di lapan lagi lokasi yang mencatatkan tahap pencemaran tinggi. Menteri Rai menyatakan bahawa pasukan-pasukan ini akan memfokuskan untuk mengenal pasti sumber pencemaran seperti pembakaran biojisim, habuk, kesesakan, atau pelepasan kenderaan. Gabungan pelepasan kenderaan dan industri, habuk, serta corak cuaca semasa menyebabkan Delhi menjadi ibu negara paling tercemar di dunia. Pada musim ini, kelajuan angin yang rendah memerangkap pencemar di atmosfer rendah. Pembakaran jerami—salah satu penyumbang utama pencemaran di kawasan berhampiran Delhi—belum meningkat tahun ini tetapi dijangka bertambah dalam beberapa hari akan datang. Petani di negeri-negeri jiran seperti Punjab, Haryana, dan barat Uttar Pradesh membakar sisa tanaman untuk membersihkan kawasan sebelum musim menanam seterusnya. Menurut agensi ramalan kualiti udara SAFAR, angin barat laut dari negeri-negeri ini akan semakin bertambah, membawa asap pembakaran sisa tanaman ke Delhi. Masalah pencemaran di India bukan terhad kepada Delhi—bandar-bandar di India kerap tersenarai antara yang paling tercemar di dunia. Minggu lepas, ibu kota kewangan India, Mumbai, juga mengalami penurunan kualiti udara, kadangkala melepasi tahap pencemaran Delhi bulan ini. article_content: Jyah Divall, a 12-year-old boy from Penrith in southwestern Sydney, has been found safe and well after being missing for more than 24 hours. He was last seen leaving a train at Redfern Railway Station, just after 6:30pm on Thursday. Police expressed concerns for his welfare, noting he was believed to be without money or food and was only wearing a t-shirt and shorts at the time. Jyah was located in the neighbouring suburb of Waterloo at 8:45pm on Friday. Police thanked the community and the media for their help in the successful search for Jyah.

Dia kali terakhir dilihat keluar dari kereta api di Stesen Kereta Api Redfern, kira-kira jam 6:30 petang pada hari Khamis. Polis menyuarakan kebimbangan mengenai kebajikannya kerana dia dipercayai tiada wang atau makanan dan hanya memakai t-shirt serta seluar pendek ketika itu. Jyah ditemui di kawasan berdekatan iaitu Waterloo pada jam 8:45 malam pada hari Jumaat. Polis mengucapkan terima kasih kepada komuniti dan media atas bantuan mereka dalam pencarian Jyah yang membuahkan hasil.

article_content: Two student nurses in Namibia are under investigation after sharing a TikTok video of themselves dancing in a health clinic, prompting disciplinary action. The trainees, Charmaine Keandra and Smart Muranda, said they were celebrating after assisting with a successful childbirth, reports local media. Their institution, Welwitchia Health Training Centre, considered such behavior unacceptable and summoned them before a disciplinary panel. The video, featuring the nurses in uniform dancing by an empty patient bed, was reportedly filmed at the clinic two weeks ago after the health of both the mother and newborn had been confirmed, according to The Namibian newspaper. Although the original video was deleted, it had attracted significant attention online. Welwitchia Health Training Centre accused the students of violating the student code of conduct and damaging the institution’s reputation. In response, the Student Union of Namibia (SUN), represented by president Benhard Kavau, criticized the school’s handling of the situation, saying previous dancing incidents were not met with suspension. Kavau argued that a positive mood helps nurses be more productive and suggested that a warning, rather than suspension, would be appropriate. Kavau also stated SUN is ready to pursue legal steps should their request for fair treatment not be considered. The students’ disciplinary hearing was set for Friday, while Welwitchia has yet to comment publicly.

article_content: A recent study suggests that while popular diets such as Atkins, South Beach, Weight Watchers, and the Zone may help people lose weight quickly, they are not significantly more effective than traditional healthy lifestyle changes over the long term. The study found that many individuals following these diets often regain much of the lost weight within two years, indicating that traditional approaches like low-fat diets, behavioral interventions, and nutritional counseling can be just as effective. This research comes amid an obesity crisis in England, where one in four adults is obese and three in ten children aged two to fifteen are overweight or obese. Researchers analyzed clinical trials comparing the Atkins, South Beach, Weight Watchers, and Zone diets with 'usual care,' defined as traditional weight loss methods. For example, those on Weight Watchers lost between 7.7 and 13.2 pounds after one year compared to 1.8 to 11.9 pounds for usual care participants. However, much of this weight was regained after two years. A single study comparing the South Beach diet with usual care showed no significant difference at twelve months, but the participants were severely obese and had undergone gastric bypass surgery. Analysis of various trials showed inconsistent results for the Atkins diet. In head-to-head comparisons, all four diets led to modest weight loss after one year. No substantial differences were found between Atkins, Weight Watchers, and Zone diets in terms of weight loss or improvements in cholesterol, blood pressure, blood sugar, or other cardiovascular risk factors. Additionally, millions in Britain are not receiving enough calories, protein, vitamins, and minerals, largely due to increased fast-food consumption and binge-drinking. This can lead to malnutrition, which causes symptoms ranging from muscle wasting and lethargy to more severe health problems. Senior author Dr. Mark Eisenberg, Professor of Medicine at the Jewish General Hospital/McGill University, notes that more large-scale research is needed to determine the long-term effectiveness of these popular diets. He suggests that broader lifestyle changes involving healthcare professionals may be more successful for sustained weight loss. The study's findings have been published in the journal Circulation: Cardiovascular Quality and Outcomes.
translated_content: Satu kajian baru-baru ini menunjukkan bahawa walaupun diet popular seperti Atkins, South Beach, Weight Watchers dan Zone dapat membantu penurunan berat badan dengan cepat, ia tidak jauh lebih berkesan daripada amalan gaya hidup sihat tradisional dalam jangka masa panjang. Kajian mendapati ramai individu yang mengikuti diet ini sering mendapat semula berat badan yang hilang dalam tempoh dua tahun, menunjukkan bahawa pendekatan tradisional seperti diet rendah lemak, intervensi tingkah laku dan kaunseling pemakanan juga boleh sama berkesan. Penyelidikan ini muncul di tengah-tengah krisis obesiti di England, di mana satu daripada empat orang dewasa adalah obes dan tiga daripada sepuluh kanak-kanak berumur dua hingga lima belas tahun berlebihan berat badan atau obes. Para penyelidik menganalisis ujian klinikal yang membandingkan diet Atkins, South Beach, Weight Watchers dan Zone dengan ‘aturan biasa’, iaitu kaedah penurunan berat badan tradisional. Contohnya, mereka yang mengikuti Weight Watchers kehilangan antara 7.7 hingga 13.2 paun selepas setahun berbanding 1.8 hingga 11.9 paun bagi peserta aturan biasa. Namun, sebahagian besar berat ini didapati semula selepas dua tahun. Satu kajian yang membandingkan diet South Beach dengan aturan biasa tidak menunjukkan perbezaan ketara selepas dua belas bulan, namun peserta tersebut mengalami obesiti yang teruk dan telah menjalani pembedahan pintasan gastrik. Analisis beberapa ujian menunjukkan keputusan yang tidak konsisten untuk diet Atkins. Dalam perbandingan langsung, keempat-empat diet menghasilkan penurunan berat badan sederhana selepas setahun. Tiada perbezaan ketara antara Atkins, Weight Watchers dan Zone dari segi penurunan berat badan mahupun penambahbaikan kolesterol, tekanan darah, paras gula darah atau faktor risiko kardiovaskular lain. Selain itu, berjuta-juta orang di Britain tidak mendapat cukup kalori, protein, vitamin dan mineral, terutamanya akibat peningkatan pengambilan makanan segera dan tabiat minum berlebihan. Ini boleh menyebabkan malnutrisi, yang mengakibatkan simptom seperti kehilangan otot dan kelesuan hinggalah kepada masalah kesihatan yang lebih serius. Pengarang utama Dr. Mark Eisenberg, Profesor Perubatan di Hospital Umum Yahudi/McGill University, menyatakan lebih banyak kajian berskala besar diperlukan untuk menentukan keberkesanan jangka panjang diet-diet popular ini. Beliau mencadangkan perubahan gaya hidup menyeluruh bersama profesional kesihatan mungkin lebih berjaya untuk menurunkan berat badan secara berterusan. Penemuan kajian ini telah diterbitkan dalam jurnal Circulation: Cardiovascular Quality and Outcomes.

article_content: Former Turkish military chief Ilker Basbug was sentenced to life imprisonment Monday in the highly controversial Ergenekon trial, according to CNN Turk. Basbug, a former chief of staff, is the most prominent of hundreds accused of plotting to overthrow the government in a lengthy and divisive court case. Alongside Basbug, other retired senior military officers, journalists, academics, and politicians were also sentenced. One of those sentenced was retired navy colonel Dursun Cicek, who also received a life sentence, Turkish media reported. His daughter, Irem Cicek, described the ruling as 'a grave injustice' and vowed to continue fighting the system. 'I will never forget this court, the names of the prosecutors, the names of the judges. I will never forget or let them be forgotten,' she said. Muharrem Ince, spokesman for the opposition Republican People's Party, called the sentences 'hostage-takings,' emphasizing that those convicted are 'not convicts.' The case underscores the polarization in Turkey between secularist elements in the military and opposition, and Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdogan’s Islamist-oriented Justice and Development Party (AKP) government. Prosecutors accused hundreds of suspects of belonging to a clandestine ultranationalist group aiming to topple the government and create chaos. They allege the group set up dozens of websites to spread anti-government propaganda. Supporters of the case point to the military’s history of overthrowing four governments since the 1960s, while critics claim the case is a politically motivated effort to weaken secular and military opposition through false evidence. The Ergenekon investigation began in 2007 after authorities discovered grenades and bomb-making materials in Istanbul. The trials took place at the 13th Istanbul High Criminal Court within the Silivri Prison Complex. Over 60 of the 267 suspects had been detained for years as the trial proceeded. The accused came from diverse backgrounds: military, media, academia, and politics. Security forces blocked all roads leading to the court, preventing citizens from approaching the courthouse. As verdicts were announced, police attempted to disperse approximately 1,000 protestors using water cannons, paint balls, and tear gas. One protestor, identifying herself as Sibel, stated she was protesting for justice and her right to demonstrate, insisting that protestors were unarmed and were exercising constitutional rights. Besides Basbug and Cicek, those sentenced include Dogu Perincek (Workers Party chairman, life), Sevgi Erenerol (former Turkish Orthodox Patriarchate spokeswoman, life), Kemal Guruz (former Council of Higher Education head, 13 years), author Ergun Poyraz (29 years 7 months), Istanbul official Gurbuz Capan (1 year 3 months), and academic Umit Sayin (4 years). Retired Generals Muzaffer Tekin and Veli Kucuk, and retired Colonel Arif Dogan, also received life sentences. Other sentences included Oktay Yildirim (nearly 34 years), Mehmet Ali Celebi (over 16 years), and Osman Paksut’s wife (2 years 6 months). Some, like opposition lawmaker Mehmet Haberal, were acquitted. Journalist Tuncay Ozkan was sentenced to life, prompting outrage from his daughter, Nazli. 'We will not pretend not to see this injustice. This is just the beginning for us. They will not silence us, and we will prevail,' she declared. Perincek’s attorney, Nurperi Sancak, told CNN that the defense proved their clients were not part of a 'fictional organization' and asserted the trial was political. She expressed disappointment in the outcome and the use of alleged fabricated evidence. Deputy Prime Minister Bulent Arinc commented that while opinions may vary on the verdict, all must respect the court's decision. 'No one has the privilege to commit a crime. The judiciary made the decision it saw fit. We are not personally happy to see anyone convicted or arrested, but there is a court decision and everyone must respect that,' he said. Reporting by CNN’s Gul Tuysuz in Istanbul and Talia Kayali and Joe Sterling in Atlanta.
translated_content: Bekas ketua tentera Turki, Ilker Basbug, dijatuhkan hukuman penjara seumur hidup pada Isnin dalam perbicaraan Ergenekon yang sangat kontroversi, menurut CNN Turk. Basbug, bekas ketua staf, adalah individu paling terkenal di antara ratusan orang yang dituduh merancang untuk menggulingkan kerajaan dalam kes mahkamah yang panjang dan berbelah bahagi ini. Bersama Basbug, beberapa pegawai tentera kanan bersara, wartawan, ahli akademik, dan ahli politik juga telah dijatuhkan hukuman. Salah seorang yang dijatuhkan hukuman ialah Kolonel Laut bersara Dursun Cicek, yang turut menerima hukuman penjara seumur hidup, lapor media Turki. Anak perempuannya, Irem Cicek, menyifatkan keputusan itu sebagai 'satu ketidakadilan yang besar' dan berikrar akan terus melawan sistem ini. 'Saya tidak akan lupa mahkamah ini, nama pendakwa, nama hakim. Saya tidak akan lupa atau membiarkan mereka dilupakan,' katanya. Jurucakap Parti Rakyat Republikan pembangkang, Muharrem Ince, menyifatkan hukuman itu sebagai 'pengambilan tebusan,' dan menekankan bahawa mereka yang didapati bersalah bukanlah benar-benar pesalah. Kes ini menonjolkan polarisasi di Turki antara golongan sekular dalam tentera dan pembangkang dengan kerajaan Perdana Menteri Recep Tayyip Erdogan yang berorientasikan Islam melalui Parti Keadilan dan Pembangunan (AKP). Pihak pendakwa menuduh ratusan suspek sebagai ahli kumpulan ultra-nasionalis rahsia yang bertujuan untuk menggulingkan kerajaan dan mencetuskan huru-hara. Mereka mendakwa kumpulan itu menubuhkan puluhan laman web untuk menyebarkan propaganda anti-kerajaan. Penyokong perbicaraan ini merujuk kepada sejarah tentera menggulingkan empat kerajaan sejak tahun 1960-an, manakala pengkritik mendakwa kes ini bermotif politik untuk melemahkan pihak pembangkang sekular dan tentera melalui bukti palsu. Siasatan Ergenekon bermula pada 2007 selepas pihak berkuasa menemui grenad dan bahan buat bom di Istanbul. Perbicaraan berlangsung di Mahkamah Jenayah Tinggi ke-13 Istanbul di Kompleks Penjara Silivri. Lebih 60 daripada 267 suspek telah ditahan selama bertahun-tahun sepanjang perbicaraan. Tertuduh datang daripada pelbagai latar belakang: tentera, media, akademik, dan politik. Pasukan keselamatan menutup semua jalan ke arah mahkamah, menghalang orang ramai daripada menghampiri. Semasa hukuman diumumkan, polis cuba menyuraikan kira-kira 1,000 penunjuk perasaan dengan meriam air, bola cat dan gas pemedih mata. Seorang penunjuk perasaan yang memperkenalkan diri sebagai Sibel berkata beliau turun berhimpun demi keadilan dan hak untuk berdemonstrasi, menegaskan bahawa penunjuk perasaan tidak bersenjata dan hanya melaksanakan hak perlembagaan mereka. Selain Basbug dan Cicek, mereka yang dijatuhkan hukuman termasuk Dogu Perincek (Pengerusi Parti Pekerja, seumur hidup), Sevgi Erenerol (bekas jurucakap Patriarkat Ortodoks Turki, seumur hidup), Kemal Guruz (bekas ketua Majlis Pengajian Tinggi, 13 tahun), penulis Ergun Poyraz (29 tahun 7 bulan), pegawai Istanbul Gurbuz Capan (1 tahun 3 bulan), dan ahli akademik Umit Sayin (4 tahun). Jeneral bersara Muzaffer Tekin dan Veli Kucuk, serta Kolonel bersara Arif Dogan juga menerima hukuman penjara seumur hidup. Hukuman lain termasuk Oktay Yildirim (hampir 34 tahun), Leftenan Mehmet Ali Celebi (lebih 16 tahun), dan isteri Osman Paksut (2 tahun 6 bulan). Ada yang dibebaskan, seperti Ahli Parlimen pembangkang Mehmet Haberal. Wartawan Tuncay Ozkan turut dijatuhkan hukuman seumur hidup, mencetuskan kemarahan anak perempuannya, Nazli. 'Kami tidak akan berpura-pura tidak nampak ketidakadilan ini. Ini hanyalah permulaan. Mereka tidak akan dapat menutup mulut kami, dan kami akan terus berjuang,' tegasnya. Peguam Perincek, Nurperi Sancak, memberitahu CNN bahawa pihak pembelaan telah membuktikan anak guam mereka bukan sebahagian daripada 'organisasi rekaan' dan menyatakan bahawa perbicaraan ini bermotifkan politik. Beliau meluahkan rasa kecewa terhadap keputusan dan penggunaan bukti yang didakwa palsu. Timbalan Perdana Menteri, Bulent Arinc, berkata walaupun pandangan orang terhadap keputusan mahkamah mungkin berbeza, semua pihak perlu menghormatinya. 'Tiada siapa berhak melakukan jenayah. Badan kehakiman telah membuat keputusan yang difikirkan wajar. Kami secara peribadi tidak gembira melihat sesiapa dihukum atau ditahan, tetapi itu keputusan mahkamah dan semua harus menghormatinya,' katanya. Laporan disediakan CNN: Gul Tuysuz di Istanbul dan Talia Kayali serta Joe Sterling di Atlanta.

article_content:
South Carolina State Senator Thomas Corbin drew backlash after making a controversial statement during a debate on a criminal domestic violence bill. Corbin, a Republican, remarked that women are 'a lesser cut of meat' than men—a comment reportedly aimed at Senator Katrina Shealy, the only woman in the 46-member state Senate. Referring to the Biblical creation story at a dinner with judiciary committee members, Corbin said, 'God created man first, then took a rib from man to make woman. A rib is a lesser cut of meat.'

This statement followed Shealy's criticism of Corbin over his repeated comments about women. Although Corbin later told reporters, 'everyone was joking and laughing,' the remarks were widely condemned as sexist and inappropriate. He also allegedly made a separate comment referencing outdated gender stereotypes, claiming he got Shealy 'wearing shoes.' 

Shealy firmly responded to Corbin, stating she had to work much harder than her male colleagues to earn her role and demanded the respect she deserved. According to Senate staff, Corbin is known for making such remarks frequently. The incident has led to renewed scrutiny of sexist attitudes in the state legislature and attracted significant media attention.

Senator Carolina Selatan, Thomas Corbin, menerima kecaman selepas mengeluarkan kenyataan kontroversi semasa perbahasan rang undang-undang keganasan rumah tangga jenayah. Corbin, dari parti Republikan, menyebut wanita sebagai 'potongan daging yang lebih rendah' berbanding lelaki—komen yang dipercayai ditujukan kepada Senator Katrina Shealy, satu-satunya wanita dalam Dewan Senat negeri yang mempunyai 46 ahli. Ketika makan malam bersama ahli jawatankuasa kehakiman, Corbin merujuk kisah penciptaan dalam Bible dengan berkata, 'Tuhan menciptakan lelaki dulu, kemudian mengambil tulang rusuk lelaki untuk mencipta wanita. Tulang rusuk ialah potongan daging yang lebih rendah.'

Kenyataan ini timbul selepas Shealy menegur Corbin atas komennya yang kerap mengenai wanita. Meskipun Corbin kemudian memberitahu pemberita bahawa 'semua orang hanya bergurau dan ketawa', kenyataan itu dikecam hebat sebagai seksis dan tidak sesuai. Beliau juga dikatakan membuat komen lain berkaitan stereotaip usang, mengatakan beliau membuat Shealy 'memakai kasut.'

Shealy membalas dengan tegas, menyatakan dia bekerja lebih keras daripada rakan sekerja lelaki untuk mencapai jawatannya dan menuntut penghormatan yang sewajarnya. Menurut kakitangan Senat, Corbin sering mengeluarkan kenyataan seumpama ini. Insiden ini mencetuskan semula perbincangan mengenai sikap seksis dalam lembaga legislatif negeri dan mendapat perhatian media yang meluas.

article_content: Nearly 470,000 immigrants in the UK were granted publicly funded housing between 2001 and 2011, according to newly released data. Over the same timeframe, the waiting list for social housing climbed to a record 1.8 million families, most of whom are British-born. Current figures indicate about 1.2 million foreign-born residents now live in social housing—roughly one in eight across the country; in cities like London, it is closer to one in five. These statistics have renewed concerns about added strain on public services, particularly with anticipated arrivals from Romania and Bulgaria due to new EU labor rules in 2014. Census data reveals that over 100,000 immigrants from Eastern European countries that joined the EU in 2004, especially from Poland, received social housing. In the mid-2000s, officials estimated the annual cost to taxpayers for maintaining each social housing unit was approximately £620. Considering average occupancy, the total cost of post-2001 migrants in social housing is estimated between £5 billion and £8 billion. Sir Andrew Green from MigrationWatch argues these figures underline the significant financial impact of large-scale immigration. Conversely, a 2009 report from the Equality and Human Rights Commission found no substantial evidence that migrants receive priority for social housing over UK-born individuals. To address public concerns, Prime Minister David Cameron announced in 2013 plans to give priority to local residents on social housing waiting lists, proposing a two-year local residency rule before migrants become eligible. Nevertheless, local authorities stress that councils are still legally required to assist any homeless EU migrants, which can incur considerable costs. While the majority of migrants receive modest housing, occasional high-profile cases stand out. For instance, Somali asylum seeker Saeed Khaliif and his family were reportedly housed in a costly London property in 2011 with housing benefits nearing £8,000 a month, due to moving before benefit caps were enforced.

article_content: The UK Home Office has confirmed it will not move forward with plans for a £3,000 bond designed to deter illegal immigration, after the proposal was vetoed by Deputy Prime Minister Nick Clegg. The initiative would have required temporary visitors from countries deemed 'high-risk', such as Sri Lanka, Nigeria, Ghana, India, Pakistan, and Bangladesh, to pay a refundable deposit before entering the UK. The bond would be forfeited if visitors overstayed their visas. The scheme, a Conservative election pledge, was scheduled to be piloted later this month. However, Nick Clegg and other Liberal Democrat members opposed the plan, citing concerns over its fairness and possible indiscriminate application. In March, Mr. Clegg had initially appeared to support the policy’s objective but later withdrew his support over its broad implementation. Business Secretary Vince Cable also raised issues with the plan, which he suggested could be misused, drawing criticism from Home Secretary Theresa May, who disagreed with his interpretation. Conservative MPs criticized the Liberal Democrats' shifting position on immigration, while Labour MP Keith Vaz described the bond scheme as 'unfair and discriminatory'. Government sources stated the bond plan was not acceptable to the Liberal Democrats and lacked support from other departments. The Home Office spokesperson clarified that the government had considered piloting the scheme but has ultimately decided not to proceed. The government continues its efforts to reduce net migration to fewer than 100,000 before the next general election.
translated_content: Pejabat Dalam Negeri UK telah mengesahkan bahawa mereka tidak akan meneruskan rancangan untuk bon £3,000 yang bertujuan menghalang imigresen haram selepas cadangan itu diveto oleh Timbalan Perdana Menteri Nick Clegg. Inisiatif ini akan mewajibkan pelawat sementara dari negara yang dikategorikan sebagai 'berisiko tinggi', seperti Sri Lanka, Nigeria, Ghana, India, Pakistan dan Bangladesh, membayar deposit yang boleh dikembalikan sebelum memasuki UK. Bon tersebut akan dilucutkan sekiranya pelawat tinggal melebihi tempoh visa mereka. Skim ini, satu janji pilihan raya Parti Konservatif, dijadualkan untuk diuji pada bulan ini. Namun, Nick Clegg dan ahli Liberal Demokrat lain membantah pelan tersebut atas kebimbangan mengenai keadilan dan kemungkinan pelaksanaan yang semborono. article_content: Amazon is using advanced artificial intelligence (AI) to identify and block fake product reviews on its platform, especially ahead of Black Friday and the holiday shopping season. The company announced on Friday that all reviews are analyzed by AI for signs of inauthenticity before they are published online. "The vast majority of reviews meet Amazon’s high authenticity standards and are posted immediately. However, when our systems detect possible review abuse, we take various actions," Amazon stated. If Amazon’s AI is confident a review is fake, it is promptly blocked or removed. The company may also revoke a customer’s review privileges, block suspicious accounts, or even initiate legal action against the parties involved. For reviews that seem suspicious but need further evidence, specially trained investigators conduct a deeper analysis before deciding on further action. In 2022, Amazon proactively blocked over 200 million suspected fake reviews across its global stores. Fake reviews are defined by Amazon as those that intentionally mislead customers by providing information that is not unbiased, authentic, or relevant to the product or service. Josh Meek, a senior data science manager at Amazon’s Fraud Abuse and Prevention team, said, "We work diligently to enforce our policies and ensure that reviews reflect real customer opinions, protecting both buyers and honest sellers." Among its preventive measures, Amazon uses cutting-edge AI technologies, including machine learning and natural language processing, to analyze large volumes of proprietary data. This includes examining advertising investments by sellers, reports submitted by customers, behavioral patterns, and review histories. AI models also detect anomalies that might indicate a review was incentivized by offers like gift cards or free products. Meek added, "Distinguishing between authentic and fake reviews can be difficult, even for people outside Amazon." By leveraging these technologies, Amazon aims to ensure that customers can trust the information they find and that honest sellers are protected.

Syarikat itu mengumumkan pada hari Jumaat bahawa semua ulasan akan dianalisis oleh AI untuk mengenal pasti tanda-tanda kepalsuan sebelum diterbitkan dalam talian. "Majoriti besar ulasan memenuhi piawaian ketulenan Amazon yang tinggi dan akan disiarkan serta-merta. Namun, apabila sistem kami mengesan kemungkinan penyalahgunaan ulasan, pelbagai tindakan akan diambil," kata Amazon. Jika AI Amazon yakin sesuatu ulasan adalah palsu, ia akan segera disekat atau dipadamkan. Syarikat juga boleh menarik balik hak ulasan pelanggan, menyekat akaun yang mencurigakan, atau mengambil tindakan undang-undang terhadap pihak yang terlibat. Bagi ulasan yang mencurigakan tetapi memerlukan bukti tambahan, penyiasat khas yang terlatih akan menjalankan analisis lebih lanjut sebelum sebarang tindakan diambil. Pada tahun 2022, Amazon secara proaktif telah menghalang lebih 200 juta ulasan palsu yang disyaki di kedai-kedai seluruh dunia. Amazon mentakrifkan ulasan palsu sebagai ulasan yang sengaja mengelirukan pelanggan dengan memberikan maklumat yang tidak berkecuali, tidak sahih, atau tidak berkaitan dengan produk atau perkhidmatan tersebut. Josh Meek, pengurus kanan sains data di pasukan Pencegahan Penyalahgunaan dan Penipuan Amazon, berkata, "Kami bekerja keras untuk menegakkan dasar kami dan memastikan ulasan mencerminkan pandangan sebenar pelanggan, demi melindungi pembeli dan penjual yang jujur." Antara langkah pencegahan, Amazon menggunakan teknologi AI terkini termasuk pembelajaran mesin dan pemprosesan bahasa semulajadi, untuk menganalisis sejumlah besar data proprietari. Ini meliputi pemeriksaan pelaburan iklan oleh penjual, laporan pelanggan, corak tingkah laku, dan sejarah ulasan. Meek menambah, "Membezakan antara ulasan asli dan palsu boleh menjadi sukar bagi mereka di luar Amazon." Dengan menggunakan teknologi ini, Amazon ingin memastikan pelanggan boleh mempercayai maklumat di platform mereka dan penjual yang jujur sentiasa dilindungi.

Emma and Dylan Smith, parents of four from Frome, Somerset, used to eat fast food at nearly every meal—including breakfast, lunch, and dinner from chains like McDonald's and Burger King. Their routine involved three McMuffins each in the morning, two chicken wraps for lunch, and burgers for dinner, with snacks such as McFlurries and hot chocolate throughout the day. As a result, Emma reached 22 stone and Dylan 17 stone, bringing their combined weight close to 40 stone.

Their health suffered; both became anemic due to poor nutrition, and Emma rarely cooked at home. They struggled to keep up with their kids and felt embarrassed about their lifestyle. Things changed after a family trip to Butlins in June 2011 for their son’s birthday, where they were unable to fit on amusement park rides. The incident upset their children and motivated the couple to take action.

Unable to lose weight on their own, they joined Slimming World in January. By adopting healthier meals—like steamed vegetables and cereals—they lost a combined 17 stone within a year. Emma dropped from a size 28 to 14, and Dylan lost nearly seven stone, trimming ten inches from his waist.

The couple now leads an active lifestyle, taking long walks, long boarding, and planning to swim and run more. Emma reports no more knee pain, and Dylan’s blood pressure is now normal. Returning to Butlins, they could finally join their kids on the rides, marking a happy new chapter. Emma says they don’t miss fast food and enjoy their healthy habits and greater family happiness.

Global research publications on sugar cane have increased exponentially since 2006, with Brazil publishing more articles on the topic than any other country, according to a review in BioEnergy Research. From 1999 to 2006, an average of five articles per year were published on sugar cane, but this number soared, reaching 327 articles in 2021. Brazil currently has double the number of sugar cane-related articles compared to the United States, which otherwise leads the world in overall scientific output. The review also notes that Brazil outpaces other top sugar cane growers, including Australia, China, and India.

The authors, affiliated with the Laboratory of Plant Physiological Ecology (LAFIECO) at the University of São Paulo's Institute of Biosciences (IB-USP), highlight the significance of this research. They state that sugar cane is crucial in Brazil's response to climate change, with ethanol derived from it being one of the most vital renewable biofuels for replacing fossil fuels. However, current ethanol production is insufficient to meet global demand, necessitating advances in sugar cane genetics.

Marcos Buckeridge, the review's senior author and head of LAFIECO, explains that while Brazil has made significant progress in improving sugar cane varieties since colonial times, further advances in genetic engineering are needed. To boost sugar storage, research must focus on increasing the number or size of cells, which will require sophisticated techniques, big data, bioinformatics, and considerable computational power. The goal is to enhance physiological performance and yield without expanding the area under cultivation.

Scientists worldwide face two major challenges: improving whole genome sequencing in sugar cane and developing precise genome editing techniques. In Brazil, Diego Pachon from USP's Center for Nuclear Energy in Agriculture (CENA) is leading genome sequencing efforts. Once the full genome is mapped, the next step is to enable targeted modifications, with many researchers placing high hopes on CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing. This technology is currently being trialed by Marcelo Menossi at the Institute of Biology, State University of Campinas (IB-UNICAMP).

Recent years have seen significant progress at major research centers in other sugar cane-producing nations, including the United States, India, and Australia.

Untuk meningkatkan penyimpanan gula, penyelidikan perlu memberi tumpuan kepada penambahan bilangan atau saiz sel, yang memerlukan teknik canggih, data besar, bioinformatik, serta kuasa pengkomputeran yang besar. Tujuannya adalah untuk meningkatkan prestasi fisiologi dan hasil tuaian tanpa memperluas kawasan tanaman.

Saintis di seluruh dunia berdepan dua cabaran utama: mempertingkatkan penjujukan genom penuh tebu dan membangunkan teknik penyuntingan gen yang tepat. Di Brazil, Diego Pachon dari Pusat Tenaga Nuklear dalam Pertanian Universiti São Paulo (CENA) mengetuai inisiatif penjujukan genom ini. Selepas keseluruhan genom dipetakan, langkah seterusnya ialah membolehkan pengubahsuaian khusus, dan ramai penyelidik kini menaruh harapan besar kepada teknologi penyuntingan gen CRISPR-Cas9. Teknologi ini sedang diuji oleh Marcelo Menossi di Institut Biologi Universiti Negeri Campinas (IB-UNICAMP).

Beberapa tahun kebelakangan ini turut menyaksikan kemajuan ketara di pusat penyelidikan utama negara-negara pengeluar tebu utama lain, termasuk Amerika Syarikat, India dan Australia.

The royal box also welcomed Princess Anne, Zara Phillips (there as a new mum), and Autumn Phillips. Country-inspired fashion was everywhere, with guests donning tweeds, warm coats, and boots. The festival's laid-back dress code allows for a true showcase of rural elegance, blending glamour with practicality.

Camilla, an avid racing enthusiast, attended at the invitation of Cheltenham racecourse chairman Robert Waley-Cohen. She later presented the champion trophy to Sire de Grugy, the Queen Mother Champion Chase winner. The event balanced classic fashion—from pearls to feathered hats—with the warmth and informal style that have become Cheltenham trademarks.

During the festivities, Zara Phillips enjoyed a day off from parenting and even admired another baby in the VIP area. While unseasonable spring warmth tempted some guests into lighter attire, the royal party wrapped up in long coats and boots, underscoring Cheltenham’s renowned country chic atmosphere.

Are you glossophobic? That term refers to the fear of public speaking—a common phobia believed to affect about three out of four people. Symptoms may vary from mild nervousness to intense panic. Even with strong technical skills and subject expertise, struggling with communication—including in informal or spontaneous situations—can limit your value in the workplace.

Matt Abrahams, a lecturer in organizational behavior at Stanford University and a communication consultant for Fortune 100 companies, specializes in strategic and spontaneous communication. His latest book, 'Think Faster, Talk Smarter: How to Speak Successfully When You’re Put on the Spot,' explores techniques for effective impromptu speaking. His previous work, 'Speaking Up Without Freaking Out,' addressed similar challenges.

Abrahams distinguishes spontaneous speaking from traditional prepared presentations. 'Most of our daily communication is not scripted like a meeting or a pitch,' he explains. 'Whether we're answering questions, making small talk, providing feedback, or handling mistakes, we typically communicate in the moment. This type of speaking requires agility, presence, and concise clarity.'

Many people find spontaneous speaking difficult because of the pressure to respond quickly and fear of making mistakes—challenges often made worse by a lack of training or feedback. To help manage anxiety around speaking, Abrahams recommends addressing both symptoms and underlying sources. Symptoms include changes like rapid heartbeat, shakiness, sweating, and blushing; sources involve worries about not meeting communication goals.

Abrahams encourages developing a personal 'anxiety management plan' using three to five strategies tailored to individual needs. Tools might include deep belly breaths to calm nerves, self-affirmations such as 'I have value to bring' to combat negative thoughts, and present-focused activities like listening to music or reciting a tongue twister.

The Think Faster, Talk Smarter method outlines six steps, split between mindset and messaging: (1) Managing speaking anxiety; (2) Reducing self-judgment; (3) Reframing spontaneous speaking as an opportunity; (4) Listening intently; (5) Structuring information effectively; and (6) Keeping communication concise and clear.

Abrahams advises aiming to 'maximize mediocrity' when practicing speaking skills. Pursuing perfection, he says, often hampers performance. 'There’s no single 'right' way to communicate, only better or worse ways. By focusing less on perfection and more on simply accomplishing communicative tasks—answering a question, giving feedback, or engaging in small talk—we free up cognitive resources and can communicate more effectively. As I tell my students: maximize mediocrity so you can achieve greatness.'

Adopting a mindset that views spontaneous speaking as an opportunity, rather than a threat, can transform the experience and make it more collaborative and responsive.

Story-based or structured communication enhances engagement and clarity. Abrahams recommends using clear frameworks, such as problem-solution-benefit or the simple model 'What? So What? Now What?' to organize thoughts logically. These structures help both the speaker and the audience follow and retain key messages.

Lastly, Abrahams emphasizes that active listening is a critical but often overlooked aspect of spontaneous speaking. By paying close attention to what is said and how, communicators can respond appropriately, offering support or feedback as needed.

Adakah anda glossophobic? Istilah ini merujuk kepada ketakutan untuk bercakap di hadapan umum — satu fobia biasa yang dipercayai menjejaskan kira-kira tiga daripada empat orang. Simptomnya boleh berbeza dari kegelisahan ringan hingga panik sepenuhnya. Walaupun anda mempunyai kemahiran teknikal atau kepakaran dalam bidang tertentu, jika anda sukar berkomunikasi — termasuk dalam situasi santai atau spontan — nilai anda di tempat kerja mungkin terjejas.

Matt Abrahams, pensyarah tingkah laku organisasi di Stanford University dan perunding komunikasi untuk syarikat Fortune 100, mahir dalam komunikasi strategik dan spontan. Buku terbarunya, 'Think Faster, Talk Smarter: How to Speak Successfully When You’re Put on the Spot', berkisar pada teknik berucap spontan secara berkesan, manakala buku terdahulunya 'Speaking Up Without Freaking Out' turut membincangkan cabaran yang serupa.

Abrahams membezakan antara ucapan spontan dan persembahan yang sudah dirancang. 'Sebahagian besar komunikasi harian kita tidak dirancang seperti pembentangan atau mesyuarat,' jelasnya. 'Sama ada menjawab soalan, berbual ringkas, memberi maklum balas, atau memperbetul kesilapan, biasanya kita berkomunikasi secara spontan. Kecekapan ini memerlukan kelincahan, fokus, dan kejelasan.'

Ramai orang sukar bercakap secara spontan kerana tekanan untuk respons segera dan takut silap — ditambah kurang bimbingan atau maklum balas. Untuk mengurus keresahan, Abrahams cadangkan tumpu pada simptom dan punca: contohnya, degupan jantung laju, berpeluh, ataupun bimbang tidak mencapai matlamat komunikasi.

Abrahams galak setiap individu membina 'pelan pengurusan keresahan' dengan 3 hingga 5 strategi yang sesuai, seperti pernafasan dalam, penegasan diri seperti 'Saya ada nilai untuk dikongsi', atau aktiviti fokus masa kini seperti dengar lagu atau baca ayat lidah berbelit.

Kaedah Think Faster, Talk Smarter ada enam langkah — empat berkaitan mindset: (1) Mengurus keresahan bercakap; (2) Kurangkan penilaian diri; (3) Anggap ucapan spontan peluang, bukan ancaman; (4) Mendengar dengan teliti. Dua lagi pada mesej: (5) Susun maklumat dengan berstruktur; (6) Sampaikan secara jelas dan ringkas.

Abrahams syor 'maksimumkan tahap sederhana' bila berlatih bercakap. Mengejar sempurna selalunya berakhir dengan hambatan. 'Tak ada satu cara mutlak betul berkomunikasi — cuma ada cara yang lebih baik atau sebaliknya. Kurangkan obsesi kesempurnaan, fokus pada selesaikan tugas — jawab soalan, beri maklum balas, mulakan perbualan — supaya kapasiti mental tak dibazir. Itulah rahsia komunikasi berkesan.'

Mindset yang menganggap ucapan spontan sebagai peluang boleh menjadikan pengalaman lebih terbuka dan responsif.

Gunakan struktur seperti masalah-penyelesaian-manfaat atau 'Apa? Kenapa? Apa Seterusnya?' untuk mudahkan penyampaian dan pemahaman. Struktur sebegini bantu pemidato dan pendengar untuk hadam mesej penting.

Akhir sekali, Abrahams tekankan bahawa mendengar aktif amat kritikal dalam ucapan spontan. Peka dengan butiran yang disampaikan membolehkan kita beri respons yang tepat — sama ada sokongan ataupun maklum balas.

article_content: PODGORICA, Montenegro – On Tuesday, the European Commission’s top official urged Montenegro to continue advancing its European Union integration process after the NATO member elected a new government, ending a prolonged political deadlock that had stalled its EU bid. EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen met with senior Montenegrin leaders shortly after parliament confirmed the new government in a heated overnight session. The Cabinet was approved with 46 votes in favor and 19 against. Although Montenegro's assembly has 81 members, not all were present. “Montenegro has long been the most advanced Western Balkan country on the EU accession path, and I am pleased to see your commitment to maintaining that status,” von der Leyen said following talks with President Jakov Milatovic. “My first message is that I welcome your renewed focus on the accession objective. Together, we should now take the final steps to complete this process.” The new government was formed after months of political disagreements following parliamentary elections in June. Prime Minister Milojko Spajic’s centrist Europe Now party won the election, but lacked enough support to govern alone. Forming the coalition required backing from strongly anti-Western groups, on the condition that their leader, Andrija Mandic, be chosen as parliament speaker. Spajic has emphasized that his government will pursue a pro-European agenda, regardless of Mandic’s new role. He denied claims that his Cabinet would be influenced by neighboring Serbia, from which Montenegro separated in 2006 after a referendum. “We want to unblock European integration, move forward quickly, and become the next EU member,” Spajic told reporters. Spajic later met von der Leyen, who is touring Western Balkan nations seeking EU membership. Prior to Montenegro, she had visited North Macedonia and Kosovo, and traveled to Serbia on Tuesday. In Belgrade, von der Leyen said that enlargement remains high on the EU agenda, particularly given current global instability. After meeting with Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic, von der Leyen said the EU wants to enhance unity and security in Europe, and reaffirmed that Serbia’s potential membership represents ‘a promise of peace and prosperity.’ Serbia is officially seeking EU entry but has strong ties with Russia and has refused to join Western sanctions against Moscow following the invasion of Ukraine. Six Western Balkan countries are at various stages in the EU accession process, which is expected to take years. In light of the ongoing war in Ukraine, EU officials are encouraging Balkan nations to speed up reforms needed to qualify for membership. Von der Leyen was in the region discussing a proposed 6 billion-euro ($6.37 billion) EU support package for Western Balkan countries, as well as persistent regional tensions since the ethnic wars of the 1990s. Recent violence between Serbia and Kosovo remains a key concern as the EU mediates negotiations. Kosovo declared independence from Serbia in 2008, but Serbia has not recognized Kosovo’s sovereignty. President Vucic stated after his meeting with von der Leyen that Kosovo and sanctions against Russia are the main obstacles for Serbia’s EU bid. He reiterated Serbia’s intention to pursue EU membership while safeguarding national interests. Von der Leyen stressed in Montenegro that there is no set date for any country’s entry into the EU, and that progress depends entirely on implemented reforms. U.S. and EU officials have advised that Montenegro’s government should not include anti-NATO or anti-Western parties if it wishes to join the bloc. Mandic, who formerly advocated for closer ties with Russia and criticized Montenegro’s NATO membership, said as parliament speaker that he is prepared to “send new messages.” Meanwhile, hundreds of opposition supporters waving Montenegrin flags demonstrated outside parliament, and opposition lawmakers criticized the new government as anti-European due to the participation of pro-Serb parties.

Presiden Suruhanjaya EU Ursula von der Leyen bertemu pemimpin tertinggi Montenegro setelah parlimen mengesahkan kerajaan dalam sesi hangat sepanjang malam. Kabinet baharu mendapat 46 undian menyokong dan 19 menolak. Dewan Montenegro mempunyai 81 ahli, namun tidak semua hadir. “Montenegro telah lama menjadi negara Balkan Barat paling maju di laluan penyertaan EU, dan saya gembira dengan komitmen anda untuk mengekalkan kedudukan itu,” kata von der Leyen selepas berbincang dengan Presiden Jakov Milatovic. “Pesanan utama saya ialah saya mengalu-alukan tumpuan anda pada matlamat penyertaan ini. Kini, bersama kita perlu ambil langkah terakhir untuk menamatkan proses ini.” Kerajaan baharu dibentuk selepas beberapa bulan ketidaksepakatan politik susulan pilihan raya parlimen pada bulan Jun. Parti centrist Europe Now pimpinan Perdana Menteri Milojko Spajic menang pilihan raya itu tetapi tidak cukup majoriti untuk memerintah sendirian. Pembentukan koalisi memerlukan sokongan daripada kumpulan anti-Barat, dengan syarat ketua mereka, Andrija Mandic, menjadi speaker parlimen. Spajic menegaskan kerajaannya akan meneruskan agenda pro-Eropah walaupun Mandic menjadi speaker. Beliau menafikan dakwaan kabinetnya akan dipengaruhi Serbia, negara jiran yang berpisah dari Montenegro pada 2006 selepas referendum. “Kami mahu mempercepatkan integrasi Eropah, bergerak pantas, dan menjadi ahli EU seterusnya,” kata Spajic kepada pemberita. Spajic kemudian bertemu von der Leyen yang sedang melawat negara-negara Balkan Barat. Sebelum itu, beliau mengunjungi Macedonia Utara dan Kosovo, serta ke Serbia pada Selasa. Di Belgrade, von der Leyen berkata pembesaran adalah agenda utama EU di sebalik ketidaktentuan global. Selepas bertemu Presiden Serbia Aleksandar Vucic, von der Leyen menyatakan EU ingin mengukuhkan perpaduan dan keselamatan Eropah, serta menegaskan keahlian Serbia membawa ‘janji keamanan dan kemakmuran’. Serbia secara rasmi memohon keahlian EU tetapi mempunyai hubungan kuat dengan Rusia dan enggan menyertai sekatan terhadap Moscow selepas pencerobohan Ukraine. Enam negara Balkan Barat kini di peringkat berbeza dalam proses penyertaan EU, yang dijangka mengambil masa bertahun-tahun. Dengan perang Ukraine yang berterusan, EU menggesa reformasi dipercepatkan di rantau ini. Von der Leyen membincangkan pakej sokongan EU bernilai 6 bilion euro (~RM32 bilion) untuk negara-negara Balkan Barat serta ketegangan serantau berlarutan sejak perang etnik 1990-an. Keganasan antara Serbia dan Kosovo kekal isu utama dalam perbincangan. Kosovo mengisytiharkan kemerdekaan dari Serbia pada 2008 namun Serbia belum mengiktirafnya. Presiden Vucic menyatakan selepas pertemuan dengan von der Leyen bahawa halangan utama Serbia ke EU ialah isu Kosovo dan sekatan terhadap Rusia. Beliau ulangi hasrat Serbia menyertai EU tanpa menjejaskan kepentingan negara. Von der Leyen menegaskan di Montenegro bahawa tiada tarikh tetap untuk mana-mana negara memasuki EU; proses bergantung sepenuhnya pada pembaharuan yang dicapai. Pegawai EU dan AS menasihatkan kerajaan Montenegro supaya tidak melibatkan parti anti-NATO atau anti-Barat untuk keanggotaan blok itu. Mandic, yang pernah menyokong hubungan rapat dengan Rusia dan mengkritik NATO, berkata sebagai speaker parlimen dia bersedia memberi 'mesej baru'. Sementara itu, ratusan penyokong pembangkang berarak dengan bendera Montenegro di luar parlimen, dan ahli parlimen pembangkang mengkritik kerajaan baharu sebagai anti-Eropah kerana penyertaan parti pro-Serbia.

Royal Mail has introduced a special set of first class stamps, known as the Diamond Jubilee Miniature Sheet, to honor Queen Elizabeth II’s 60-year reign. Launched at the Bank of England Museum, this collection combines official portraits of the Queen that have graced UK stamps, coins, and banknotes throughout her time on the throne.

Key features of the set include a new diamond blue stamp, which will replace the standard gold first class stamp in post offices throughout 2012. The collection highlights historical portraits such as the 1952 stamp image shot by Dorothy Wilding, a 1953 coin portrait, and images from the £1 note first issued in 1960 and the £5 note from 1971. There’s also a portrait from coins introduced in 1968.

These commemorative stamps reflect the Queen’s lasting influence—her likeness has appeared on more than 220 billion stamps worldwide. Royal Mail CEO Moya Greene expressed pride in their role celebrating this significant milestone and in showcasing these iconic images.

The Diamond Jubilee Miniature Sheet is the second in a series of three special stamp issues released in 2012 for the Jubilee. The first, focused on the House of Windsor and Saxe-Coburg-Gotha with a 1954 portrait, was issued the previous week. The last set, featuring eight stamps dedicated to each decade of the Queen’s reign, will be issued on May 31.

Antara ciri utama koleksi ini ialah setem baharu berwarna biru berlian yang bakal menggantikan setem kelas pertama berwarna emas di pejabat pos sepanjang tahun 2012. Koleksi ini menampilkan potret bersejarah seperti gambar setem 1952 yang dirakam oleh Dorothy Wilding, potret pada syiling 1953 dan juga imej dari wang kertas £1 yang pertama kali dikeluarkan pada tahun 1960 serta wang kertas £5 dari tahun 1971. Selain itu, terdapat potret daripada syiling yang digunakan sejak tahun 1968.

Setem peringatan ini memperlihatkan pengaruh berterusan Ratu—wajah baginda telah dicetak pada lebih 220 bilion setem di seluruh dunia. Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Royal Mail, Moya Greene, menzahirkan rasa bangga mereka memainkan peranan dalam meraikan peristiwa bersejarah ini dan menonjolkan imej-imej ikonik Ratu.

Lembaran Mini Jubilee Berlian ini merupakan yang kedua daripada tiga siri keluaran setem khas sempena Jubilee pada tahun 2012. Keluaran pertama memfokuskan kepada House of Windsor dan Saxe-Coburg-Gotha dengan potret tahun 1954, telah pun diterbitkan minggu lepas. Keluaran terakhir, menampilkan lapan setem khas bagi setiap dekad pemerintahan Ratu, bakal dilancarkan pada 31 Mei.

article_content: The Amekpa/Affirsere bridge on the Ughelli axis of the East-West road in Delta State is at risk of collapse, a situation linked to ongoing illegal dredging activities in the community. Chief Morison Olori, a leader of the All Progressives Congress (APC) in Delta State, raised alarm during a media briefing in Ughelli. He appealed to both the Federal and Delta State governments to urgently address and halt illegal mining and sand dredging in the area to protect residents. Olori specifically called on President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and the Nigeria Inland Waterways Authority (NIWA) to urge the Delta State government and Ughelli North Local Government Area to prevent further illegal dredging in Ughelli and across the state, highlighting environmental destruction and serious risks to public safety. As a solution, he recommended that the Delta State government promptly begin issuing licenses to prospective dredging operators. He emphasized with concern that illegal dredgers are undermining the bridge’s foundations and nearby buildings, endangering the lives of people living in the area.

A woman from Sierra Leone showing potential Ebola symptoms was tested after being detained at Dungavel Detention Centre in South Lanarkshire, Scotland. She was isolated at Monklands Hospital in Airdrie, and it was later confirmed she did not have Ebola. Authorities took thorough precautions, limiting staff exposure and preparing emergency responses until test results were received. During this period, the Home Office halted transfers and releases from the detention centre as a safety measure and alerted UK health officials.

This event occurred amid a serious Ebola outbreak across West Africa, where countries including Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone, and Nigeria faced rapidly increasing cases and fatalities. Health organizations like the WHO and Doctors Without Borders warned that the epidemic was likely to continue for several months and described the situation as highly challenging to control. Ebola transmits through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals and can be lethal, often beginning with fever and muscle aches and progressing to vomiting, bleeding, and organ failure in the worst instances. At the time, no approved vaccine or specific treatment was available for Ebola; care focused on supporting patients’ recovery. The outbreak had caused over a thousand deaths by August 2014, with experts believing actual numbers may be even higher.

Previously, two Sierra Leonean athletes had tested negative for Ebola while in Scotland for the Commonwealth Games and were cleared to compete. Additionally, the first European Ebola victim, Spanish priest Miguel Pajares, died after treatment in Madrid despite receiving an experimental therapy. Health officials emphasized that, for people in the UK and travelers, Ebola risk was extremely low unless there was direct contact with the bodily fluids of someone infected.

Seorang wanita dari Sierra Leone yang mengalami simptom yang menyerupai Ebola telah menjalani ujian selepas beliau ditahan di Pusat Tahanan Dungavel di South Lanarkshire, Scotland. Beliau telah diasingkan di Hospital Monklands, Airdrie, dan keputusan kemudiannya mengesahkan beliau negatif Ebola. Pihak berkuasa mengambil pelbagai langkah berjaga-jaga, termasuk menghadkan pendedahan kakitangan dan menyediakan pelan kecemasan sehingga keputusan diperoleh. Sepanjang penyiasatan, Pejabat Dalam Negeri menghentikan sebarang pemindahan atau pelepasan dari pusat tahanan sebagai langkah berjaga-jaga serta memaklumkan pihak kesihatan di seluruh UK.

Kejadian ini berlaku ketika berlakunya wabak Ebola yang serius di Afrika Barat, melibatkan Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone, dan Nigeria dengan peningkatan pesat dalam jumlah kes dan kematian. Organisasi kesihatan antarabangsa seperti WHO dan Doctors Without Borders memberi amaran bahawa wabak ini mungkin berpanjangan selama beberapa bulan dan amat sukar dikawal. Virus Ebola disebarkan melalui sentuhan langsung dengan cecair badan individu yang dijangkiti dan sering kali membawa maut, bermula dengan demam dan sakit otot sebelum menjadi muntah, pendarahan serta kegagalan organ dalam keadaan teruk. Pada masa itu, tiada vaksin atau rawatan khusus yang diluluskan untuk Ebola; rawatan hanya memberi sokongan kepada pesakit untuk pulih. Wabak ini telah meragut lebih seribu nyawa menjelang Ogos 2014, dan angkanya diyakini sebenar lebih tinggi.

Terdahulu, dua atlet dari Sierra Leone diuji negatif Ebola semasa di Scotland untuk Sukan Komanwel dan dibenarkan bertanding. Sementara itu, mangsa pertama Ebola dari Eropah, seorang paderi Sepanyol bernama Miguel Pajares, meninggal dunia selepas menerima rawatan di Madrid walaupun telah diberikan rawatan percubaan. Pegawai kesihatan menekankan bahawa risiko jangkitan Ebola kepada rakyat UK dan pelancong sangat rendah kecuali jika berlaku sentuhan langsung dengan cecair badan individu yang dijangkiti.

article_content: The United Kingdom recently organized an influential summit about artificial intelligence (AI), gathering global political figures and technology leaders. The focus was to discuss both the benefits and potential risks of AI, as countries aim to create common frameworks as the technology matures. One of the summit’s main outcomes was the Bletchley Declaration, signed by 28 countries, including leading nations like the UK, US, and China. This agreement seeks to increase transparency from AI developers and promote more scientific collaboration for evaluating AI risks. Though it does not offer exhaustive guidelines, it represents a significant step toward harmonizing AI governance worldwide. During the event, US Vice President Kamala Harris highlighted existing issues caused by AI, such as discrimination, misinformation, and challenges to democracy, often affecting those most vulnerable. She provided assurance that the US would take further actions to address these concerns, focusing on ethical governance to protect marginalized groups. Elon Musk, who leads Tesla and SpaceX, reiterated his warning that advanced AI could surpass human intelligence, making it difficult to control. He encouraged responsible innovation but acknowledged that fully managing powerful AI may be beyond human reach. Mustafa Suleyman, co-founder of DeepMind, suggested that a temporary pause in AI development could be necessary within the next five years, while also stating that there is no current evidence of significant harm from state-of-the-art systems like ChatGPT or GPT-4. The UK government unveiled a £225 million plan for a supercomputer called Isambard-AI, to be built at the University of Bristol and expected to drive advancements in healthcare, energy, climate research, and more. Together with another upcoming supercomputer, Dawn, these investments signal the UK’s ambition to be a global leader in AI. Despite the summit’s focus on collaboration and safety, global leaders like the US, EU, and China are advancing their distinct AI strategies. President Biden has issued an executive order to strengthen the US’s position, the EU is actively working on regulations, and China has outlined its policy direction. Nevertheless, initiatives like the Bletchley Declaration provide a platform for shared efforts to manage AI responsibly.

Tujuan utama adalah untuk membincangkan faedah dan risiko AI, dengan negara-negara berusaha mewujudkan rangka kerja bersama seiring perkembangan teknologi ini. Antara pencapaian utama sidang kemuncak ini ialah Deklarasi Bletchley, yang ditandatangani oleh 28 negara termasuk UK, Amerika Syarikat, dan China. Perjanjian ini bertujuan meningkatkan ketelusan daripada pembangun AI dan menggalakkan kerjasama saintifik untuk menilai risiko AI dengan lebih baik. Walaupun tidak memberikan garis panduan yang terperinci, deklarasi ini dianggap sebagai langkah penting ke arah penyelarasan tadbir urus AI di peringkat global. Semasa acara tersebut, Naib Presiden Amerika Syarikat, Kamala Harris, menekankan isu-isu semasa yang disebabkan oleh AI seperti diskriminasi, maklumat palsu dan cabaran terhadap demokrasi, yang sering memberi kesan kepada golongan yang paling terdedah. Beliau memberi jaminan bahawa Amerika Syarikat akan mengambil tindakan lanjut untuk menangani perkara ini, dengan menumpukan kepada etika dan perlindungan golongan terpinggir. Elon Musk, ketua Tesla dan SpaceX, sekali lagi memberi amaran bahawa AI maju boleh mengatasi kecerdasan manusia sehingga sukar dikawal. Beliau menekankan keperluan inovasi yang bertanggungjawab tetapi turut mengakui bahawa sukar untuk manusia mengawal sepenuhnya AI yang berkuasa. Mustafa Suleyman, pengasas bersama DeepMind, menyatakan penangguhan sementara pembangunan AI mungkin diperlukan dalam tempoh lima tahun akan datang. Namun, beliau juga menegaskan bahawa belum ada bukti kukuh bahawa model AI terkini seperti ChatGPT atau GPT-4 berbahaya secara signifikan buat masa ini. Kerajaan UK turut mengumumkan pelaburan £225 juta untuk membina superkomputer bernama Isambard-AI di Universiti Bristol, yang dijangka membawa kemajuan dalam bidang kesihatan, tenaga, sains iklim dan lain-lain. Bersama superkomputer lain yang akan datang, Dawn, pelaburan ini menunjukkan hasrat UK untuk menjadi peneraju dunia dalam AI. Walaupun sidang kemuncak ini menekankan kerjasama dan keselamatan, kuasa besar seperti Amerika Syarikat, EU dan China masih memacu strategi AI mereka sendiri. Presiden Biden telah mengeluarkan perintah eksekutif untuk mengukuhkan kedudukan AS, EU sedang merangka peraturan AI, dan China telah menggariskan polisi mereka. Namun, inisiatif seperti Deklarasi Bletchley memberikan ruang kerjasama demi memastikan AI berkembang dengan bertanggungjawab.

Rebekah Brooks, recently found not guilty in the phone hacking case, is now facing renewed questions after reports allege attempts to influence who would head London’s Metropolitan Police. According to The Mail on Sunday, prior to Sir Paul Stephenson’s 2009 appointment as Commissioner, a high-ranking News International associate reportedly told the Prime Minister’s office that Brooks opposed appointing Sir Hugh Orde, the other leading contender. Orde’s prospects had already been affected after News of the World revealed he had a child through an affair with an undercover officer, which harmed his standing for the top job.

Sir Paul ultimately secured the position, bolstered by the backing of politicians including then Prime Minister Gordon Brown, Home Secretary Jacqui Smith, and London Mayor Boris Johnson. There is no clear indication that News International’s reported communication had any direct impact on the final decision. Stephenson later resigned in 2011 after it emerged that he had links with former News of the World executive Neil Wallis and had accepted a complimentary stay at a health spa where Wallis worked as a PR adviser.

Brooks, her husband Charlie Brooks, and Neil Wallis all faced investigations related to the phone hacking scandal but were either acquitted or not charged. The incident in which Brooks was loaned a police horse, also ridden by her friend Prime Minister David Cameron, further raised questions about her relationship with the police.

Sir Hugh Orde, commended earlier for his work in Northern Ireland and in the Stephen Lawrence inquiry, saw his bid for Commissioner weakened by media revelations about his personal life. The News of the World, then overseen by Andy Coulson, was instrumental in bringing this information to light.

Associates of Orde have criticized the notion of external media interference in such appointments, while Brooks and her representatives have denied attempting to block his nomination. Neither Brooks nor Sir Paul Stephenson have commented. Gordon Brown was also unavailable for comment.

Rebekah Brooks, yang baru-baru ini didapati tidak bersalah dalam kes penggodaman telefon, kini berdepan persoalan baharu selepas laporan mengatakan terdapat cubaan untuk mempengaruhi pemilihan Ketua Polis Metropolitan London. Menurut The Mail on Sunday, sebelum pelantikan Sir Paul Stephenson sebagai Pesuruhjaya pada tahun 2009, seorang pegawai kanan News International dilaporkan memberitahu pejabat Perdana Menteri bahawa Brooks tidak menyokong pelantikan Sir Hugh Orde, calon utama yang lain. Peluang Orde sudahpun terjejas selepas News of the World mendedahkan beliau mempunyai anak hasil hubungan sulit dengan seorang pegawai polis penyamaran, yang merosakkan kedudukannya untuk jawatan tersebut.

Sir Paul akhirnya dilantik ke posisi itu dengan sokongan beberapa ahli politik termasuk Perdana Menteri Gordon Brown, Setiausaha Dalam Negeri Jacqui Smith, dan Datuk Bandar London Boris Johnson. Tiada bukti jelas bahawa komunikasi daripada News International secara langsung mempengaruhi keputusan muktamad. Stephenson kemudiannya meletak jawatan pada tahun 2011 selepas didedahkan beliau mempunyai hubungan dengan bekas eksekutif News of the World, Neil Wallis, dan menerima penginapan percuma di sebuah spa kesihatan yang menggaji Wallis sebagai penasihat PR.

Brooks, suaminya Charlie Brooks dan Neil Wallis semuanya telah disiasat berhubung skandal penggodaman telefon, namun sama ada dibebaskan atau tidak pernah didakwa. Insiden Brooks dipinjamkan seekor kuda polis, yang juga pernah ditunggang oleh rakannya, Perdana Menteri David Cameron, turut menimbulkan persoalan mengenai hubungannya dengan pihak polis.

Sir Hugh Orde, yang pernah dipuji atas kerja beliau di Ireland Utara dan siasatan pembunuhan Stephen Lawrence, terjejas peluangnya untuk menjadi Pesuruhjaya selepas pendedahan mengenai kehidupan peribadinya. News of the World di bawah Andy Coulson ketika itu memainkan peranan besar dalam mendedahkan cerita ini.

Rakan-rakan Orde mengkritik sebarang cubaan campur tangan media luar dalam pelantikan seperti ini, manakala Brooks dan wakilnya menafikan mereka pernah cuba menghalang pencalonan Orde. Brooks dan Sir Paul Stephenson tidak memberi komen, dan Gordon Brown juga tidak dapat dihubungi.

article_content: Arsenal may miss out on signing Hamburg midfielder Tolgay Arslan, who is reportedly close to reaching an agreement with Turkish club Besiktas. The 24-year-old, whose contract expires on June 30, is able to negotiate pre-contract terms with clubs outside the Bundesliga during the current transfer window. Arsenal manager Arsene Wenger has been monitoring Arslan, who is available for free in the summer. Arslan and his representatives are awaiting a decision from Wenger before finalizing any deal with Besiktas. The midfielder is seeking wages of £40,000 per week and is reportedly tempted by Besiktas’s offer. Wenger is currently short of options in central midfield due to injuries to Mikel Arteta and Jack Wilshere. He has indicated his intent to pursue defensive reinforcements this transfer window and recently acknowledged interest in Ipswich Town defender Tyrone Mings. Arslan, born in Paderborn to Turkish parents, has played for Turkey’s Under-19 and Under-21 teams and for Germany’s Under-20 and Under-21 sides. Arsenal have been tracking Arslan’s situation since November. Known for his strong work ethic and short passing game in front of the defense, Arslan is seen as a good fit for Wenger’s style of play. In addition to Arslan, Arsenal have also shown interest in Ipswich Town’s Tyrone Mings.

Beliau telah menyatakan hasrat untuk mencari pertahanan baharu dalam jendela perpindahan ini dan baru-baru ini mengakui berminat dengan pemain pertahanan Ipswich Town, Tyrone Mings. Dikenali kerana etika kerjanya yang tinggi dan kepakaran hantaran pendek di hadapan pertahanan, Arslan dilihat sesuai dengan corak permainan Wenger. Selain Arslan, Arsenal turut berminat dengan Tyrone Mings dari Ipswich Town.

article_content: The U.N. Committee Against Torture described events in Ferguson, Missouri as a "tragedy," but emphasized respect for the decision by authorities not to prosecute police Officer Darren Wilson in the shooting death of Michael Brown, according to committee member Alessio Bruni on Friday. Bruni made his remarks at a news conference presenting a committee report, which criticizes racial profiling and excessive use of force by U.S. police. While the report does not single out the Ferguson incident, it expresses concern about the growing militarization of U.S. police departments. The United States was among eight countries reviewed for compliance with the U.N. Convention against Torture and Other Cruel, Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment. Other countries under review included Sweden, Ukraine, Venezuela, Australia, Burundi, Croatia, and Kazakhstan. The 16-page report dedicates significant attention to Guantanamo Bay and detainee treatment but also examines police brutality, particularly against racial and ethnic minorities. About two weeks prior to the report’s release, Brown’s parents testified privately before the committee in Geneva, Switzerland, stating that Michael Brown’s killing and the police actions during subsequent protests amounted to violations of the Convention. The U.N. report voices deep concern over recurring police shootings or fatal pursuits of unarmed Black individuals, and it recommends that cases of police brutality be investigated independently, with no connection between investigators and alleged perpetrators. The committee also raised issues related to juveniles in the justice system, the use of the death penalty, and sexual violence in the U.S. military.

Bruni membuat kenyataan ini dalam sidang media semasa pembentangan laporan jawatankuasa, yang mengkritik profil perkauman dan penggunaan kekerasan berlebihan oleh polis Amerika Syarikat. Walaupun laporan tersebut tidak menyebut secara khusus insiden Ferguson, ia menzahirkan kebimbangan tentang peningkatan pemiliteran jabatan polis di Amerika Syarikat. Amerika Syarikat adalah antara lapan negara yang dikaji pematuhannya terhadap Konvensyen PBB Menentang Penyeksaan dan Layanan atau Hukuman Kejam, Tidak Berperikemanusiaan atau Menhina. Negara lain yang turut dikaji ialah Sweden, Ukraine, Venezuela, Australia, Burundi, Croatia dan Kazakhstan. Laporan setebal 16 muka surat itu memberi tumpuan khusus kepada Teluk Guantanamo dan layanan terhadap tahanan, namun juga membincangkan kekejaman polis, terutama terhadap golongan minoriti kaum dan etnik. Sekitar dua minggu sebelum laporan itu dikeluarkan, ibu bapa Brown memberi keterangan secara tertutup di hadapan jawatankuasa di Geneva, Switzerland, menyatakan bahawa kematian Michael Brown dan tindakan polis semasa protes selepas kejadian itu melanggar Konvensyen tersebut. Laporan PBB menyuarakan kebimbangan mendalam terhadap kejadian tembakan atau kejaran maut oleh polis terhadap individu kulit hitam tidak bersenjata, serta mengesyorkan kes kekejaman polis disiasat secara bebas tanpa kaitan institusi antara penyiasat dan tertuduh. Jawatankuasa itu turut membangkitkan isu berkaitan remaja dalam sistem keadilan jenayah, penggunaan hukuman mati, dan keganasan seksual dalam angkatan tentera Amerika Syarikat.

article_content: On November 9, 2023, Worthington Industries, Inc. (NYSE: WOR) announced its Board of Directors approved the separation of its Steel Processing business, forming Worthington Steel as a new public company. Each shareholder of Worthington Industries as of November 21, 2023 (the record date), will receive one share of Worthington Steel for every WOR share owned. The distribution of Worthington Steel shares is scheduled to occur before the market opens on December 1, 2023. 'When-issued' trading for Worthington Steel (symbol 'WS WI') will begin around November 28, 2023, and continue until the distribution date. During this period, shares of Worthington Industries may be traded either with or without the right to receive Worthington Steel shares. Worthington Steel will begin regular trading on the NYSE under the ticker 'WS' on December 1, 2023. Worthington Industries will change its name to Worthington Enterprises and remain listed as 'WOR.' Valuation analysis applies 2024 estimated EV/EBITDA multiples: Worthington Enterprises (Stub) at $47.00 per share and Worthington Steel (Spin-Off) at $23.00 per share. The consolidated target price is $70.00, indicating a 7% potential upside from the closing price of $65.45 (as of November 15, 2023). The stock maintains a 'Hold' rating. Risks to the outlook include lower sales growth or market share from economic slowdown, inflation, increased raw material costs, and reduced returns on reinvested free cash flow. Shareholders will automatically receive Worthington Steel shares via book-entry or their brokerage accounts. Fractional Worthington Steel shares will be settled with a cash payment. No shareholder action is necessary. After the spin-off, Worthington Enterprises will focus on Building Products, Consumer Products, and Sustainable Energy Solutions. Its brands and products include propane cylinders, LPG tanks, hand tools, and solutions for industrial gases, with brands such as Coleman, Bernzomatic, Balloon Time, and Level5. Worthington Steel, following separation, will concentrate on steel processing, electrical steel laminations, and lightweight automotive and infrastructure solutions. In FY23, the Steel Processing business generated about $3.5 billion in sales.
