article_content: As the conflict between Israel and Hamas escalated this week, WIRED investigated the intelligence oversights that allowed Hamas’ initial attack to succeed, along with the rise of hacktivism and online disorder tied to the crisis. This unrest spurred massive misinformation, especially on X (formerly Twitter), where forged images, outdated footage, and video game clips went viral. Despite X’s Trust and Safety team's claims of tackling the problem, CEO Elon Musk added further confusion by sharing conspiracy theories and engaging with QAnon posts, making it even harder for everyday users to discern truth from fiction. Notably, a graphic video distributed by Donald Trump Jr. from Hamas turned out to be real, though it was initially suspected to be part of the misinformation flood. In another development, widespread hoaxes about a 'Global Day of Jihad' led to dangerous digital rumors that heightened the risk of real-world incidents. In other cybersecurity news, WIRED provided an in-depth look into the theft of hundreds of millions from crypto exchange FTX during its bankruptcy. New evidence revealed that the stolen money passed through multiple middlemen before ending up with groups tied to Russian money laundering. In US politics, Republican discord in the House led to a ban on mobile phones within certain meetings, a move intended to keep negotiations private amid ongoing internal disputes. Also, the United Nations’ plan to hold major internet governance events in countries infamous for harsh online restrictions faces criticism for potentially promoting censorship. White supremacist 'active clubs' have expanded their footprint on Telegram, using the messaging platform for coordination. Meanwhile, Google announced that passkeys—a safer alternative to passwords—will become the default login method for personal users to improve security. A serious vulnerability named 'HTTP/2 Rapid Reset' has emerged, threatening nearly all web servers and potentially allowing denial-of-service attacks globally for years. Additionally, new findings show that the Predator spyware, previously used against activists and journalists, was recently deployed by Vietnam to target at least four US members of Congress (Michael McCaul, Chris Murphy, John Hoeven, Gary Peters), policy experts, and journalists like CNN’s Jim Sciutto. The spyware was distributed through links embedded in replies on X, risking infection for anyone who clicked. Experts believe these hacking attempts were timed to coincide with diplomatic meetings between the US and Vietnam regarding their stance toward China. WIRED continues to compile weekly summaries of security and privacy news, urging readers to stay cautious in a fast-evolving digital landscape.

Keadaan ini mencetuskan penyebaran maklumat palsu secara besar-besaran, terutamanya di X (dahulu dikenali sebagai Twitter), di mana imej palsu, video lama dan rakaman permainan video menjadi tular. Walaupun pasukan Trust and Safety X mendakwa mereka mengambil tindakan, CEO Elon Musk memburukkan lagi keadaan dengan berkongsi teori konspirasi dan berinteraksi dengan posting QAnon, menjadikan pengguna semakin sukar membezakan maklumat sahih. Kumpulan pelampau kulit putih semakin aktif menggunakan Telegram sebagai saluran komunikasi. Dalam masa sama, Google umumkan passkey—alternatif lebih selamat bagi kata laluan—sebaga kaedah log masuk lalai untuk pengguna biasa. Kerentanan besar baharu, 'HTTP/2 Rapid Reset', mengancam hampir semua pelayan web global dan boleh membolehkan serangan ‘denial-of-service’ berpanjangan. Kajian juga mendedahkan perisian pengintip Predator, yang sebelum ini menyasarkan aktivis dan wartawan, digunakan Vietnam untuk cuba menggodam telefon empat ahli Kongres Amerika (Michael McCaul, Chris Murphy, John Hoeven, Gary Peters), pakar polisi, dan wartawan seperti Jim Sciutto dari CNN. Taktik ini menggunakan pautan di balasan X, di mana sesiapa yang menekan boleh dijangkiti. Pakar percaya cubaan ini bertepatan dengan pertemuan diplomatik AS-Vietnam mengenai hubungan dengan China. WIRED terus membuat sorotan mingguan berita keselamatan dan privasi, mengingatkan pembaca untuk sentiasa berwaspada dalam era digital kini.

article_content: An explosion struck a military vehicle traveling through Turkey’s Tunceli province on Tuesday, killing at least four people — including three soldiers and a bystander — according to local authorities and state media reports. Turkish broadcaster TRT confirmed several deaths and injuries, attributing the incident to a terrorist act, while the exact number of wounded remains unverified. Numerous ambulances were sent to the site, reports the Anatolia news agency. An unnamed official from the Tunceli governor’s office told CNN that the casualty figures could not yet be confirmed. So far, no group has claimed responsibility for the blast. Nevertheless, suspicion within Turkey is likely to focus on Kurdish militants, as Tunceli is predominately Kurdish and has seen ongoing violence between Turkish forces and the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK). The International Crisis Group recently reported that conflict between Turkey and the PKK has worsened, resulting in more than 700 deaths over the past 14 months. The PKK is recognized as a terrorist group by Turkey, the United States, and the European Union. Kurds, who comprise roughly 20% of Turkey’s population, form the country’s largest ethnic minority. Reporting contributed by CNN's Yesim Comert.

Penyiar Turki, TRT, mengesahkan beberapa kematian dan kecederaan, menyalahkan insiden itu sebagai tindakan keganasan, namun jumlah sebenar mangsa cedera masih belum dapat dipastikan. Banyak ambulans dikerahkan ke lokasi, menurut laporan agensi berita Anatolia. Seorang pegawai tanpa nama dari pejabat gabenor Tunceli memberitahu CNN bahawa angka mangsa masih belum dapat disahkan. Laporan terkini oleh International Crisis Group menyatakan bahawa konflik antara Turki dan PKK telah bertambah buruk, menyebabkan lebih 700 kematian dalam tempoh 14 bulan yang lalu. PKK dikategorikan sebagai kumpulan pengganas oleh Turki, Amerika Syarikat, dan Kesatuan Eropah. article_content: Techtober has started with major technology launches, including Samsung’s Galaxy S23 FE, Tab S9 FE, and Buds. Google followed with a significant event focusing on AI developments and new devices. I’m particularly looking forward to Google’s ‘Assistant with Bard’ announcement, even more than the new Pixel 8 Pro camera features. Though I haven’t used Bard or ChatGPT extensively, Google fulfilled the anticipation many had when Bard was released earlier this year. Users are frustrated with digital assistants that have become inconvenient. Bard, now coming to Assistant, promises to improve this. The launch of Bard Extensions, which lets Bard access Google services, hinted at the growing integration. With Assistant with Bard now official, I’m very excited. Bard can currently handle tasks such as finding travel information or specific Gmail content, and organizing tasks into project lists in Google Docs or Tasks. With upcoming integration, these abilities will be available straight from Google Assistant. Google will also expand Google Lens features, such as letting you take a photo and ask questions, or have Assistant with Bard draft a social media post based on your pictures. For example, you could photograph your pet and generate a post automatically. The feature is slated for release ‘in the coming months,’ and like many, I am eager for its arrival. Google’s objective appears to be simplifying daily tasks using AI. Rick Osterloh, Google’s Senior Vice President of Devices & Services, recently pointed out that the best way to use Google services is on Pixel. This rationale could also apply to Assistant with Bard across various devices. Looking forward, Microsoft has integrated ChatGPT with Bing and Copilot for Windows 11, but Chromebooks have long offered easy Assistant access via the Launcher. Bringing Bard-based improvements to ChromeOS is highly anticipated. Before Assistant with Bard was announced, AI-focused enhancements for ChromeOS were revealed with Chromebook Plus devices. There is optimism for further development in ChromeOS and updates to Google’s smart home offerings. If Google’s timeline holds, Assistant with Bard will launch alongside new smart home hardware. article_content: Peter Obi, leader of Nigeria's Labour Party and the third-place candidate in February's presidential election, has acknowledged the conclusion of his legal battle over the results. Alongside Atiku Abubakar—the runner-up—Obi tried unsuccessfully to overturn Bola Tinubu’s win in the Supreme Court last month. The justices dismissed their claims, citing insufficient evidence of electoral misconduct. Obi voiced his disappointment with the court's decision, arguing that it undermines public trust in Nigeria's judiciary. In response, the presidency refuted his criticism and called it baseless. Speaking to journalists in Abuja, Obi reiterated that, while his legal options have been exhausted, his vision for transforming Nigeria remains alive. His campaign was notable for energizing young voters and pushing against the dominance of the two main parties since 1999. In the election, Tinubu received 37% of the vote, with Abubakar gaining 29% and Obi 25%. Both opposition leaders alleged serious flaws in the election process and questioned Tinubu's eligibility, but the legal system ultimately upheld the result. Although Obi did not specify whether he will contest the presidency in 2027, he asserted that efforts for a better Nigeria would continue. He described the court's judgment as a setback for justice, pointing to what he believed was strong evidence of election irregularities. Meanwhile, presidential aide Bayo Onanuga dismissed Obi’s critiques and suggested he should accept the court’s decision as a statesman. Atiku Abubakar also condemned the verdict, claiming it harmed Nigeria's democratic prospects, while Tinubu and his supporters welcomed the ruling.
translated_content: Peter Obi, ketua Parti Buruh Nigeria dan calon tempat ketiga dalam pilihan raya presiden Februari lalu, telah mengakui bahawa perjuangan undang-undangnya mengenai keputusan pilihan raya telah berakhir. Bersama Atiku Abubakar—naib juara—Obi cuba membatalkan kemenangan Bola Tinubu di Mahkamah Agung bulan lalu tetapi gagal. Para hakim menolak tuntutan mereka kerana kekurangan bukti salah laku pilihan raya. Obi menyuarakan kekecewaannya terhadap keputusan mahkamah, mendakwa ia menjejaskan kepercayaan rakyat terhadap sistem kehakiman Nigeria. Pihak presiden menolak kritikan beliau dan menganggapnya tidak berasas. Ketika bercakap dengan wartawan di Abuja, Obi menegaskan bahawa walaupun semua saluran perundangan telah digunakan, visinya untuk mengubah Nigeria tetap utuh. Kempen beliau sebelum ini menarik minat ramai pengundi muda dan mencabar penguasaan dua parti utama sejak tahun 1999. Dalam pilihan raya itu, Tinubu memperoleh 37% undian, diikuti Abubakar (29%) dan Obi (25%). Kedua-dua pemimpin pembangkang mendakwa proses pilihan raya mempunyai banyak kelemahan dan mempersoalkan kelayakan Tinubu, tetapi sistem kehakiman mengesahkan keputusan tersebut. Walaupun Obi tidak menyatakan sama ada beliau akan bertanding semula pada 2027, beliau menegaskan usaha untuk masa depan Nigeria yang lebih baik akan diteruskan. Beliau menyifatkan keputusan mahkamah itu sebagai satu kemunduran keadilan, berdasarkan bukti kukuh yang dikemukakan pasukannya. Sementara itu, pembantu presiden Bayo Onanuga menolak kritikan Obi dan mencadangkan beliau menerima keputusan mahkamah sebagai seorang negarawan. Atiku Abubakar turut mengutuk keputusan tersebut, mendakwa ia menjejaskan prospek demokrasi Nigeria, manakala Tinubu dan penyokongnya mengalu-alukan keputusan itu.

article_content: Senate Leader Opeyemi Bamidele has announced that the Senate will consider granting voting rights to Nigerians living abroad as part of the ongoing constitutional review. Bamidele made this statement during a virtual dialogue with members of the Nigerian diaspora, affirming the National Assembly's commitment to revisiting diaspora voting and related issues. According to Bamidele, a bill on diaspora voting is already before the 10th Senate, having passed its first reading two weeks ago, with a second reading scheduled for this week. He assured participants that after the second reading, the bill would be referred to the Senate Committee on the Review of the 1999 Constitution. Bamidele, who is also Vice Chairman of the constitution review committee chaired by the Deputy Senate President, urged stakeholders to engage state governors and the Speakers of State Houses of Assembly to ensure the bill’s passage at the state level. He emphasized that granting diaspora voting rights is a matter of ensuring greater inclusion in Nigeria's electoral process, calling it a generational cause and a right that must be recognized in the Nigerian Constitution. If the Senate passes the bill, it will move to the House of Representatives for concurrence, after which it must be approved by two-thirds of Nigeria's 36 state assemblies to become law.
translated_content: Ketua Senat, Opeyemi Bamidele, mengumumkan bahawa Dewan Senat akan mempertimbangkan pemberian hak mengundi kepada rakyat Nigeria di luar negara sebagai sebahagian daripada semakan Perlembagaan yang sedang dijalankan. Bamidele berkata demikian dalam dialog maya bersama komuniti diaspora Nigeria, sambil menegaskan komitmen Parlimen untuk menilai semula hak mengundi diaspora dan isu-isu berkaitan. Menurut Bamidele, rang undang-undang mengenai hak mengundi diaspora kini telah berada di Senat ke-10 dan telah melepasi bacaan pertama dua minggu lalu, dengan bacaan kedua dijadualkan minggu ini. Beliau memberi jaminan bahawa selepas bacaan kedua, rang undang-undang ini akan dirujuk kepada Jawatankuasa Semakan Perlembagaan 1999. Bamidele, yang juga Naib Pengerusi jawatankuasa itu yang diketuai oleh Timbalan Presiden Senat, menggesa pihak berkepentingan supaya berhubung dengan gabenor negeri serta Speaker Dewan Undangan Negeri agar rang undang-undang ini diluluskan di peringkat negeri. Beliau menekankan bahawa memberi hak mengundi kepada diaspora adalah untuk memastikan penyertaan lebih luas dalam proses pilihan raya Nigeria, menyifatkannya sebagai perjuangan generasi dan hak yang wajib diiktiraf dalam Perlembagaan negara. Sekiranya rang undang-undang itu diluluskan Senat, ia akan dikemukakan ke Dewan Perwakilan untuk kelulusan, dan selepas itu memerlukan sokongan dua pertiga daripada 36 Dewan Undangan Negeri sebelum menjadi undang-undang.

article_content: Asian stock markets rose for the most part on Tuesday, with investors anticipating several significant events, including a U.S.-China summit and upcoming economic data releases from the U.S., Japan, and China. Japan's Nikkei 225 increased by 0.5% to 32,757.44, Australia's S&P/ASX 200 climbed 0.6% to 6,992.10, and South Korea's Kospi advanced by 1.1% to 2,429.21. However, Hong Kong's Hang Seng slipped 0.4% to 17,359.13, while the Shanghai Composite gained less than 0.1% to close at 3,047.13. Stephen Innes, managing partner at SPI Asset Management, noted that Asian stocks benefited from investor optimism ahead of U.S. inflation data, which could signal whether interest rates have peaked. He also highlighted positive geopolitical sentiment as anticipation builds for the upcoming talks between the U.S. and China. China is scheduled to release its latest monthly economic indicators on Wednesday, while Japan will publish its most recent GDP figures. Chinese President Xi Jinping is set to meet U.S. President Joe Biden at a Pacific Rim summit in California—the first face-to-face meeting in a year between the leaders of the world’s two largest economies. On Monday, U.S. stock markets closed with mixed results. The S&P 500 edged down by 0.1% to 4,411.55, the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 0.2% to finish at 34,337.87, and the Nasdaq Composite fell by 0.2% to 13,767.74. Most companies have surpassed analysts’ expectations as the summer earnings season winds down, and upcoming reports from Target, TJX, and Walmart are expected to shift investor focus to trends for the coming months. While the U.S. economy has remained robust despite Federal Reserve interest rate hikes—the highest since 2001—concerns persist about how longer-term rate increases might impact future growth. Investors are closely watching Tuesday’s inflation report, hoping for further cooling in inflation from its June 2022 peak of over 9%. A continued downturn could convince the Fed to pause further rate hikes and potentially accelerate interest rate cuts. Economists predict October's inflation data will show consumer prices rose by 3.3% annually, down from 3.7% in September. Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell recently suggested that a rise in longer-term Treasury yields may offset the need for more rate hikes, although he emphasized that the Fed remains prepared to act if necessary. In bond markets, the yield on the 10-year Treasury was at 4.63%, unchanged from late Friday. Although yields have eased over the past month on expectations that the Fed might have finished raising rates, they are still well above recent years’ levels. High rates and yields can negatively affect various investments, especially in technology and other high-growth sectors. Some leading technology stocks weighed on the S&P 500, with Apple falling by 0.9% and Microsoft declining by 0.8%. Credit-rating agency Moody’s warned on Friday that the U.S. could face a downgrade to its top-tier “AAA” rating due to higher borrowing costs and increased political polarization amid an upcoming government funding deadline. Concerns about budget deficits and legislative gridlock have contributed to the upward pressure on Treasury yields. In commodities trading, U.S. crude oil rose by 16 cents to $78.42 per barrel in electronic trading on the New York Mercantile Exchange, after gaining $1.09 on Monday. Brent crude, the global benchmark, added 17 cents to $82.69 per barrel. The U.S. dollar remained steady at 151.72 Japanese yen, whereas the euro slipped slightly to $1.0699 from $1.0701. ___ AP Business Writer Stan Choe contributed to this report.

article_content: The Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC) has arrested two suspects for their alleged involvement in crude oil theft, pipeline vandalism, and illegal oil refining in Rivers State. NSCDC spokesperson Babawale Afolabi announced in a statement on Friday in Abuja that the arrests were made by the Commandant General’s Special Intelligence Squad after receiving a tip-off from concerned citizens. Items recovered from the suspects included a motorcycle, eight makeshift refineries (commonly referred to as 'cooking pots') located at different sites, a welding tool, a bottle of crude oil, a list of alleged accomplices, and mapped points of a multinational oil company’s truck line. Afolabi noted that the illegal refineries were destroyed on-site as they could not be transported away. Upon interrogation, the suspects reportedly confessed that they were planning to illegally refine crude oil, which they had obtained after vandalising a pipeline belonging to a multinational oil company. They also provided the names of five accomplices who are still at large. Afolabi said efforts are ongoing to apprehend the remaining suspects for further questioning and investigation before formal charges are filed in court. He reiterated the NSCDC Commandant General Ahmed Audi’s commitment to eradicating crude oil theft, illegal dealings in petroleum products, and pipeline vandalism.
translated_content: Pasukan Keselamatan dan Pertahanan Awam Nigeria (NSCDC) telah menahan dua suspek atas dakwaan terlibat dalam pencurian minyak mentah, vandalisme saluran paip, dan penapisan minyak secara haram di Negeri Rivers. Jurucakap NSCDC, Babawale Afolabi, dalam satu kenyataan pada hari Jumaat di Abuja, memaklumkan bahawa tangkapan dibuat oleh Skuad Perisikan Khas Komandan Jeneral selepas menerima maklumat daripada orang awam prihatin. Barangan yang dirampas daripada suspek termasuk sebuah motosikal, lapan penapisan haram (juga dikenali sebagai 'periuk memasak') di beberapa lokasi, peralatan kimpalan, sebotol minyak mentah, senarai individu yang disyaki sebagai rakan jenayah, serta titik laluan trak milik syarikat minyak multinasional. Afolabi menjelaskan bahawa penapisan haram tersebut telah dimusnahkan di lokasi kerana tidak dapat dipindahkan. Semasa soal siasat, suspek dilaporkan mengaku bahawa mereka merancang untuk menapis minyak mentah secara haram yang telah diperoleh selepas merosakkan saluran paip milik syarikat minyak multinasional. Mereka turut memberikan nama lima rakan jenayah lain yang masih bebas. Afolabi berkata usaha sedang dijalankan untuk menahan suspek-suspek lain bagi siasatan lanjut sebelum pertuduhan rasmi dikemukakan di mahkamah. Beliau menegaskan komitmen Komandan Jeneral NSCDC, Ahmed Audi, untuk membanteras kecurian minyak mentah, urusniaga haram produk petroleum, serta vandalisme saluran paip.

article_content: Clarence "Clancy" Prevost, a flight instructor in Minnesota, received a $5 million reward from the U.S. State Department’s Rewards for Justice program after alerting his superiors to the suspicious behavior of his student, Zacarias Moussaoui. Moussaoui was later convicted in 2006 for conspiring to kill Americans as part of the September 11, 2001 attacks. Prevost, who worked at the Pan Am International Flight Academy in Eagan, Minnesota, became concerned after noticing that Moussaoui paid most of his $8,300 simulator course fee in hundred-dollar bills and lacked proper flight credentials. His concerns led him to recommend notifying the FBI. According to Prevost’s testimony during Moussaoui’s sentencing, Moussaoui acted like a typical student until a tense lunchtime discussion about the Hajj pilgrimage, during which Moussaoui responded defensively when asked about his religion. Prevost reported his worries to his managers, stating, ‘We don’t know anything about this guy, and we’re teaching him how to operate a 747.’ Initially, his managers dismissed his concerns. However, the day after Prevost urged action, Pan Am officials contacted the FBI. This led to Moussaoui’s arrest on an immigration violation. Moussaoui, who admitted to being an al Qaeda operative, was prevented from participating directly in the 9/11 attacks due to his arrest and is serving life in prison without parole at the federal Supermax facility in Florence, Colorado. In November, the Air Line Pilots Association honored Prevost with its 2007 Presidential Citation Award for his actions. Prevost, a retired Northwest Airlines pilot, rarely spoke publicly about Moussaoui except during the trial’s sentencing phase. CNN’s Kevin Bohn contributed to this report.
translated_content: Clarence "Clancy" Prevost, seorang instruktor penerbangan di Minnesota, menerima ganjaran sebanyak $5 juta daripada program Rewards for Justice di bawah Jabatan Negara Amerika Syarikat selepas beliau memaklumkan kepada pihak atasan mengenai tingkah laku mencurigakan pelajarnya, Zacarias Moussaoui. Moussaoui kemudiannya disabitkan bersalah pada tahun 2006 kerana berpakat membunuh rakyat Amerika dalam serangan 11 September 2001. Prevost, yang bekerja di Pan Am International Flight Academy di Eagan, Minnesota, mula berasa curiga selepas melihat Moussaoui membayar sebahagian besar yuran kursus simulator bernilai $8,300 dengan wang kertas seratus dolar dan tidak mempunyai kelayakan juruterbang yang sewajarnya. Kerisauannya mendorong beliau untuk mencadangkan agar FBI dimaklumkan. Menurut keterangan Prevost semasa hukuman Moussaoui, Moussaoui nampak seperti pelajar biasa sehinggalah berlaku perbualan tegang ketika makan tengah hari mengenai ibadah Haji, di mana Moussaoui bertindak defensif apabila ditanya tentang agamanya. Prevost melaporkan kebimbangannya kepada pihak pengurusan dengan berkata, 'Kita tidak tahu apa-apa tentang lelaki ini, tapi kita ajar dia cara kendalikan 747.' Pada mulanya, pengurusnya mengambil ringan perkara tersebut. Namun, sehari selepas Prevost mendesak tindakan, pegawai Pan Am menghubungi FBI dan ini membawa kepada penangkapan Moussaoui atas kesalahan imigresen. Moussaoui, yang mengaku sebagai anggota al-Qaeda, tidak dapat terlibat secara langsung dalam serangan 9/11 kerana ditahan dan kini menjalani hukuman penjara seumur hidup tanpa parol di penjara Supermax persekutuan di Florence, Colorado. Pada bulan November, Air Line Pilots Association telah menganugerahkan Prevost dengan Presidential Citation Award 2007 atas tindakannya. Prevost, seorang juruterbang bersara Northwest Airlines, jarang bercakap secara terbuka tentang Moussaoui kecuali ketika fasa hukuman perbicaraan. Kevin Bohn dari CNN turut menyumbang kepada laporan ini.

article_content: Students say they feel safer with a new app that allows them to discreetly send emergency messages during nights out. The app, called Flare, was developed by three University of Cambridge graduates to improve campus safety. Co-founder Gabriel Brown said he hoped the app would give students "an extra layer of confidence" in situations where they feel uncomfortable or unsafe. "It's the kind of app you want to have, but hope you never need to use," said Ruby Cline, a 20-year-old Cambridge student and Flare user. Launched last week, Flare - Stay Safe allows users to send pre-written emergency messages to trusted contacts via text, either through the app or by tapping a notification on their phone's locked screen. Gabriel Brown, 21, who created the app with fellow King's College alumni Morgan Saville and Geno Racklin Asher, said they wanted to provide a resource for students who might not feel comfortable contacting emergency services directly. He recalled past situations where he wished such an app had existed, such as when he was heckled by cyclists for being gay while walking home in Cambridge. "I remember feeling extremely uncomfortable. I got my phone out to call 999, but my hands were shaking. I thought, 'This probably isn’t life-threatening, but I still feel unsafe.' Many people may feel unsafe but don’t want to trouble emergency services. That’s where Flare offers another layer of protection, letting people notify trusted friends if they need help or feel at risk," Mr Brown explained. Ruby Cline added, "With university being the first time away from home for many, you could be missing for days before anyone notices. I feel safer walking home at night knowing I can send that message. I’d feel even better if my friends and housemates had the app too, especially for blind dates or nights out." Naabil Khan, a third-year medical student at the University of Exeter, said the app acts as a "safety net" for students, not just during nights out, but also when attending protests. "When I went to protests in London, they could get chaotic. Not always dangerous, but sometimes overwhelming," she said. The app is currently used by 15 students' unions and groups in England, and these organizations are forming an advisory board for its ongoing development, Mr Brown said. Naomi Vince, 20, president of the Trinity College Students Union at Cambridge, explained that the union is promoting Flare as part of a safety campaign. She said hearing others' experiences with spiking and helplessness made her realize the value of a "safety net." "Hopefully nothing will happen, but if you're worried, you can do something instead of feeling helpless. After spiking, people don’t always make rational decisions, but sending a pre-planned message to a trusted friend is simple," Naomi said. She hopes that by advising the app's development, further improvements can be made, including adding location sharing—something the founders are working on. translated_content: Para pelajar berkata mereka berasa lebih selamat dengan aplikasi baharu yang membolehkan mereka menghantar mesej kecemasan secara diam-diam ketika keluar malam. Aplikasi itu, Flare, dibangunkan oleh tiga graduan Universiti Cambridge untuk meningkatkan keselamatan kampus. Pengasas bersama, Gabriel Brown, berkata beliau berharap aplikasi ini akan memberi "lapisan keyakinan tambahan" kepada pelajar dalam situasi yang tidak selesa atau tidak selamat. "Ini adalah jenis aplikasi yang anda mahu ada, tetapi harap anda tidak perlu gunakannya," kata Ruby Cline, pelajar Cambridge berusia 20 tahun dan pengguna Flare. Dilancarkan minggu lalu, Flare - Stay Safe membenarkan pengguna menghantar mesej kecemasan yang telah ditulis lebih awal kepada kenalan dipercayai melalui mesej teks, sama ada melalui aplikasi atau dengan mengetik notifikasi pada skrin kunci telefon. Gabriel Brown, 21, yang mencipta aplikasi ini bersama alumni King's College, Morgan Saville dan Geno Racklin Asher, berkata mereka ingin menyediakan sumber untuk pelajar yang mungkin tidak selesa menghubungi perkhidmatan kecemasan secara terus. Beliau mengimbas kembali situasi lalu di mana beliau berharap aplikasi seperti ini wujud, seperti ketika diejek oleh penunggang basikal kerana orientasi seksualnya ketika berjalan pulang di Cambridge. "Saya ingat berasa sangat tidak selesa. Saya keluarkan telefon untuk hubungi 999, tapi tangan saya menggigil. Saya fikir, 'Ini mungkin bukan ancaman nyawa, tapi saya tetap berasa tidak selamat.' Ramai orang mungkin rasa tidak selamat tetapi tidak mahu menyusahkan perkhidmatan kecemasan. Di sinilah Flare menawarkan satu perlindungan tambahan, membolehkan seseorang memaklumkan rakan-rakan dipercayai sekiranya perlukan bantuan atau rasa terancam," jelas Brown. Ruby Cline menambah, "Bagi ramai, universiti adalah kali pertama berjauhan dari rumah, dan seseorang boleh hilang selama beberapa hari sebelum ada yang perasan. Saya rasa lebih selamat berjalan pulang waktu malam kerana saya boleh menghantar mesej itu. Saya akan rasa lebih tenang jika rakan dan penghuni rumah saya juga ada aplikasi itu, terutamanya untuk janji temu buta atau keluar malam." Naabil Khan, pelajar perubatan tahun ketiga di Universiti Exeter, berkata aplikasi ini bertindak sebagai "jaring keselamatan" bukan sahaja untuk keluar malam, malah ketika menghadiri protes. "Ketika saya pergi ke protes di London, suasana boleh jadi agak kacau-bilau. Tidak selalu berbahaya, tetapi kadang-kadang melemaskan," katanya. Aplikasi ini kini digunakan oleh 15 kesatuan pelajar dan kumpulan di England, dan organisasi ini membentuk lembaga penasihat untuk pembangunan aplikasi ini, kata Brown. Naomi Vince, 20, presiden Kesatuan Pelajar Trinity College di Cambridge, menjelaskan bahawa kesatuan sedang mempromosikan Flare sebagai sebahagian daripada kempen keselamatan. Beliau berkata, mendengar pengalaman orang lain yang pernah menjadi mangsa 'spiking' dan rasa tidak berdaya, membuatnya sedar betapa bernilainya "jaring keselamatan". "Harap-harap tiada apa-apa yang berlaku, tetapi jika anda risau, anda boleh buat sesuatu, bukan sekadar rasa tidak berdaya. Selepas terkena 'spiking', orang biasanya tidak berfikir dengan rasional, jadi menghantar mesej yang sudah dirancang kepada rakan dipercayai sangat mudah," kata Naomi. Beliau berharap dengan menasihati pembangunan aplikasi ini, penambahbaikan lanjut boleh dilakukan, termasuk perkongsian lokasi—yang kini dalam perancangan pengasas aplikasi. article_content: A newly published study in the journal mBio suggests that the Middle East Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus (MERS) may have the potential to be airborne. According to recent World Health Organization (WHO) data, a total of 836 lab-confirmed MERS cases and at least 288 related deaths have occurred since its initial emergence in 2012. The transmission process for MERS remains unclear. Researchers at the King Fahd Medical Research Center in Saudi Arabia collected air samples from a camel barn where previous tests had shown both a camel and its owner (who later died) were infected with MERS. Analysis detected the presence of MERS RNA in the air, with the positive test occurring on the same day that one of the nine camels in the barn also tested positive. The viral genetic sequence from the air sample matched those from the infected camel and its owner. However, experts caution that finding viral RNA does not confirm that infectious virus is present in the air, as dead virus particles can also be detected. Dr. Mark Denison from Vanderbilt University emphasized that the detection of viral genetic material doesn’t necessarily indicate a risk of airborne transmission. Kevin Olival from EcoHealth Alliance supported this view, noting that while MERS is known to be in camel nasal secretions, it’s still unclear if airborne exposure poses a risk for human infection. While past reports show MERS can infect people who have close contact with patients, the precise pathways of its transmission remain unknown. Both Denison and Olival highlight the need for further research to better understand whether airborne transmission contributes to the spread of MERS.
translated_content: Satu kajian baru yang diterbitkan dalam jurnal mBio mencadangkan bahawa Sindrom Pernafasan Timur Tengah Coronavirus (MERS) mungkin berpotensi tersebar melalui udara. Berdasarkan data terkini Pertubuhan Kesihatan Sedunia (WHO), sebanyak 836 kes MERS yang disahkan di makmal dan sekurang-kurangnya 288 kematian berkaitan telah direkodkan sejak kemunculan pertama virus ini pada tahun 2012. Cara penularan MERS masih belum jelas. Penyelidik dari Pusat Penyelidikan Perubatan King Fahd di Arab Saudi telah mengambil beberapa sampel udara dari kandang unta, di mana ujian sebelum ini menunjukkan seekor unta dan pemiliknya (yang kemudiannya meninggal dunia) dijangkiti MERS. Analisis mendapati kehadiran RNA MERS dalam udara itu, dan ujian positif ini berlaku pada hari yang sama apabila salah satu daripada sembilan unta di kandang tersebut juga diuji positif. Urutan genetik virus dalam sampel udara itu sepadan dengan sampel dari unta dan pemiliknya yang dijangkiti. Namun demikian, para pakar menegaskan bahawa pengesanan RNA virus tidak bermakna terdapat virus berjangkit dalam udara, kerana zarah virus mati juga boleh dikesan. Dr. Mark Denison dari Universiti Vanderbilt menerangkan bahawa pengesanan bahan genetik virus tidak semestinya menunjukkan risiko penularan melalui udara. Kevin Olival dari EcoHealth Alliance turut bersetuju, menyatakan walaupun MERS sudah diketahui terdapat dalam rembesan hidung unta, sama ada pendedahan udara boleh menyebabkan jangkitan manusia masih belum jelas. Walaupun laporan lalu menunjukkan MERS boleh menjangkiti mereka yang mempunyai kontak rapat dengan pesakit, jalan penularan sebenar virus masih tidak diketahui. Kedua-dua Denison dan Olival menegaskan perlunya lebih banyak penyelidikan untuk memahami sama ada penularan melalui udara memainkan peranan dalam penyebaran MERS.

article_content: Chinese officials in the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region have reported the fourth infant death connected to the country's widening contaminated infant formula scandal. More than 6,200 babies have fallen ill after consuming milk powder tainted with melamine, a chemical compound added to artificially increase apparent protein content. On Thursday, authorities arrested 12 additional suspects, raising the total detained to 18, as confirmed by the Hebei Public Security Bureau. Of these, 12 are associated with milk collection and product manufacturing, while six are accused of illegally selling melamine. Over 1,300 infants remain hospitalized due to malnutrition, kidney stones, and acute renal failure, according to Li Changjiang, China's director of quarantine and inspection. Inspectors have been sent nationwide to test milk powder from manufacturers. As a result, 66 of China’s 175 baby formula producers have halted operations. Two brothers selling the raw milk used in contaminated baby formula were arrested earlier in the week. Investigators say the brothers admitted diluting their milk and adding melamine after previous rejections by the factory, reportedly to recoup losses. The two face charges of producing and selling toxic food, which may result in the death penalty if convicted. Health experts caution that ingesting melamine may cause kidney stones, urinary tract ulcers, and skin or eye irritation. Melamine is primarily used in manufacturing materials, such as coatings and adhesives. The chemical has been found in nearly 70 milk products from more than 20 different companies; products from Sanlu Group showed the highest levels. Thousands of tons of tainted milk powder have been recalled, including shipments by leading Chinese dairies Mengniu and Sanlu. Sanlu’s involvement recalls a similar scandal in 2004, when milk powder falsely labeled with the Sanlu brand contributed to at least 13 infant deaths in Anhui province. While most contaminated formula was consumed in China, exports have reached Taiwan, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Yemen, Chad, and Burundi. The US Food and Drug Administration assures consumers that no Chinese-origin baby formula is allowed on the US market, and US manufacturers do not use Chinese ingredients. This case marks another episode in a series of safety scandals involving Chinese products.
translated_content: Pegawai China di Wilayah Autonomi Xinjiang Uygur telah melaporkan kematian bayi keempat yang dipercayai berkaitan dengan skandal susu formula bayi tercemar yang semakin merebak di negara itu. Lebih 6,200 bayi jatuh sakit selepas meminum susu tepung yang mengandungi melamin, sejenis bahan kimia yang ditambah untuk menipu kandungan protein. Pada hari Khamis, pihak berkuasa menahan 12 lagi suspek, menjadikan jumlah tahanan kepada 18 orang menurut Biro Keselamatan Awam Hebei. Daripada jumlah itu, 12 orang terlibat dalam pengumpulan dan pengeluaran susu, manakala enam lagi dituduh menjual melamin secara haram. Lebih 1,300 bayi masih dirawat di hospital akibat malnutrisi, batu karang dan kegagalan buah pinggang akut, menurut Li Changjiang, pengarah kuarantin dan pemeriksaan China. Pemeriksa dihantar ke seluruh negara untuk menguji susu tepung daripada para pengeluar. Akibatnya, 66 daripada 175 syarikat pengeluar susu formula bayi di China telah menghentikan operasi. Dua beradik yang menjual susu mentah yang digunakan dalam penghasilan susu formula bayi tercemar juga telah ditahan. Siasatan mendapati mereka mengaku mencampurkan air dan melamin ke dalam susu selepas penghantaran mereka sebelum ini ditolak oleh kilang, dalam usaha menampung kerugian. Kedua-duanya didakwa menghasilkan dan menjual makanan beracun, satu kesalahan yang boleh dikenakan hukuman mati jika sabit kesalahan. Pakar kesihatan memberi amaran bahawa pengambilan melamin boleh menyebabkan batu karang, ulser saluran kencing, serta iritasi pada kulit dan mata. Melamin biasanya digunakan dalam penghasilan bahan seperti salutan dan pelekat. Bahan kimia ini ditemui dalam hampir 70 produk tenusu daripada lebih 20 syarikat; produk keluaran Sanlu Group mengandungi paras melamin tertinggi. Beribu tan susu tepung tercemar telah dipanggil balik, termasuk oleh pengeluar utama China, Mengniu dan Sanlu. Kaitan Sanlu mengingatkan skandal sama pada tahun 2004, apabila susu tepung berlabel palsu Sanlu menyebabkan sekurang-kurangnya 13 kematian bayi di wilayah Anhui. Kebanyakan susu formula tercemar telah digunakan di dalam negara, namun ada juga yang dieksport ke Taiwan, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Yaman, Chad, dan Burundi. Pentadbiran Makanan dan Ubat-Ubatan Amerika Syarikat (FDA) menegaskan bahawa tiada susu formula bayi dari China dibenarkan di pasaran Amerika Syarikat dan pengeluar domestik tidak menggunakan bahan dari China. Kes ini menjadi satu lagi episod dalam siri skandal keselamatan produk dari pengeluar China.

article_content: Google is expanding the refreshed At a Glance widget to more Pixel smartphones after its gradual release on other Android devices. According to 9to5Google, more Pixel users now have access to the updated widget, which displays additional helpful information in a more visually appealing design. The redesigned widget was first discovered in July through a 9to5Google APK deep dive, revealing customizable style options, including transparent and solid color choices. Google officially unveiled the widget in September as part of the Android 13 September Feature Drop, and later released it to some flagship Android phones such as the Motorola Razr Plus and the Galaxy Z Fold 5. Currently, the widget is still unavailable on the Pixel Tablet and Pixel Fold. The rollout is happening via server-side update, so it is expected to reach these devices in the future. The new At a Glance widget features a pill-shaped outline and allows users to customize its appearance to their liking. On the right, a fluted Material You shape presents weather details and the current temperature. Users can customize the widget by tapping the three-dot icon to open the Assistant At a Glance menu. From there, they can select widget styles: semi-transparent, transparent, or solid. The types of glanceable information shown can also be personalized. With this updated widget, users can view upcoming calendar events, check travel times for commutes, receive recommended departure times, monitor flight information from Gmail, and track food delivery or pickup statuses. It’s worth noting that the redesigned widget still differs from the fixed launcher version.

article_content: Alto Peru, a nonprofit based in Lima, runs a surf school that offers more than just lessons—it provides surf therapy for local children. As 7-year-old Boran Bumovich Hignio excitedly dashes across Playa Sombrillas, he's joined by a group of kids eager to dive into the Pacific Ocean. Their instructor, Diego Villarán, who founded the surf school, reminds them to start with warmups. Surf therapy harnesses surfing’s mental health benefits, helping children build self-esteem and cope with difficult emotions. The wider aim is to create safe, supportive spaces for children to process feelings and form positive connections. Studies have shown that surf therapy helps combat depression, fosters self-confidence, and can aid recovery from trauma such as post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Initiatives around the world, like Alto Peru and South Africa’s Waves for Change, use surfing as a tool for healing. Alto Peru operates in a neighborhood known for crime and limited resources. Villarán, who grew up in the community, has trained around 400 local children over ten years, supported by donations and paid public surf classes. Beyond surfing, the nonprofit builds community trust, paints murals, and has transformed a former trash dump into a playground. Many children in the program face significant challenges—some have experienced violence or family addiction. With a psychologist on staff, Alto Peru focuses on generating a safe, nonjudgmental environment. The global surf therapy movement began with Waves for Change in Cape Town in 2009. This program now spans more than a dozen countries, providing evidence-based surf therapy that includes trauma support, group sessions, and aftercare. Former participants often return as coaches. Research supports surf therapy’s efficacy: studies in the UK, South Africa, and the United States show improvements in mental health, social connectedness, and reductions in symptoms of depression and PTSD. Waves for Change and similar organizations emphasize not just the physical activity, but also the importance of strong coach-participant relationships, teaching coping skills, and connecting children with broader social services. Jamie Marshall, a researcher specializing in surf therapy, notes that while exercise benefits mental health, structured surf therapy adds additional, significant improvements through safe spaces and support. Surf therapy models are expanding. The Wave Alliance project helps spread best practices globally, and organizations trained by Waves for Change now operate in several countries. Programs like Waves for Hope in Trinidad & Tobago adapt surf therapy to local contexts, focusing on youth affected by trauma. Alto Peru is helping to spread surf therapy in Peru and across Latin America. As the children play in the sea, they find relief and joy—a respite from difficult circumstances.
translated_content: Alto Peru, sebuah organisasi bukan untung di Lima, menjalankan sekolah luncur yang menawarkan lebih dari sekadar kelas—ia menyediakan terapi luncur untuk kanak-kanak tempatan. Ketika Boran Bumovich Hignio yang berusia 7 tahun berlari dengan penuh teruja di Playa Sombrillas, dia diikuti oleh sekumpulan kanak-kanak lain yang tidak sabar meredah ombak Lautan Pasifik. Jurulatih mereka, Diego Villarán, yang merupakan pengasas sekolah ini, mengingatkan mereka supaya memulakan sesi dengan pemanasan badan dahulu. Terapi luncur memanfaatkan faedah kesihatan mental daripada aktiviti meluncur, membantu kanak-kanak membina keyakinan diri dan mengatasi emosi yang sukar. Matlamat utamanya ialah menyediakan ruang yang selamat dan memberi sokongan, agar mereka dapat meluahkan perasaan serta membina hubungan positif. Kajian membuktikan terapi luncur membantu melawan kemurungan, meningkatkan keyakinan, dan membantu pemulihan daripada trauma seperti gangguan tekanan selepas trauma (PTSD). Inisiatif seperti Alto Peru dan Waves for Change dari Afrika Selatan menggunakan luncur ombak sebagai alat pemulihan. Alto Peru beroperasi di kawasan kejiranan yang terkenal dengan jenayah serta kekurangan kemudahan. Villarán, yang berasal dari komuniti itu, telah melatih sekitar 400 kanak-kanak tempatan selama sepuluh tahun, dengan dana daripada sumbangan dan kelas berbayar untuk orang ramai. Selain luncur ombak, organisasi ini memperkukuhkan kepercayaan komuniti, melukis mural, dan mengubah kawasan bekas tapak buangan menjadi taman permainan. Ramai kanak-kanak dalam program ini menghadapi cabaran besar—ada yang terdedah kepada keganasan atau masalah keluarga. Dengan kehadiran ahli psikologi, Alto Peru menekankan suasana yang selamat dan bebas penilaian. Gerakan terapi luncur global bermula dengan Waves for Change di Cape Town pada 2009. Kini, program ini telah berkembang ke lebih sedozen negara, menawarkan terapi luncur berasaskan bukti yang merangkumi sokongan trauma, sesi berkumpulan, dan penjagaan susulan. Peserta dahulu juga kerap kembali sebagai jurulatih. Kajian menyokong keberkesanan terapi luncur: penyelidikan di UK, Afrika Selatan dan Amerika Syarikat menunjukkan peningkatan kesihatan mental, hubungan sosial yang lebih baik, dan pengurangan gejala kemurungan serta PTSD. Waves for Change dan organisasi serupa menekankan bukan hanya aktiviti fizikal, tetapi juga peranan hubungan baik antara jurulatih dan peserta, mengajar kemahiran mengatasi masalah, serta membantu kanak-kanak mendapatkan akses kepada perkhidmatan sosial lain. Jamie Marshall, penyelidik terapi luncur, menyatakan senaman memang bagus untuk kesihatan mental, tetapi struktur terapi luncur yang teratur memberi peningkatan ketara tambahan melalui ruang selamat dan sokongan. Model terapi luncur kini semakin berkembang. Projek Wave Alliance membantu menyebarkan amalan terbaik secara global, dan organisasi yang menerima latihan daripada Waves for Change kini beroperasi di beberapa negara. Program seperti Waves for Hope di Trinidad & Tobago menyesuaikan terapi luncur dengan konteks tempatan, memfokuskan belia yang pernah mengalami trauma. Alto Peru kini menjadi penyokong utama terapi luncur di Peru dan seluruh Amerika Latin. Ketika kanak-kanak bermain di lautan, mereka dapat merasa kelegaan dan kegembiraan—istirahat sejenak dari kerumitan hidup.

article_content: Amid ongoing media coverage in recent months, Vanessa Stiviano was seen enjoying a night out in Los Angeles. This appearance came just days after charges were dropped against a man previously accused of assaulting her in New York City. Stiviano, renowned for her distinctive fashion, wore a tight black dress and a faux-fur fringed gilet, with black paw prints painted down her face to emphasize her unique style. Earlier, she shared an Instagram photo of herself wearing a Lakers championship ring, sparking rumors regarding her involvement in the Lakers-Clippers rivalry. Abandoning her trademark visor, she displayed a new look with the painted paw prints. Stiviano also praised the late Lakers owner, Dr. Jerry Buss, highlighting his legacy as a philanthropist and American hero. Her public outing followed the news that charges were dropped against Dominick Diorio, the man initially accused of assaulting her and using racial slurs. The police continue to seek information about the alleged hate crime. The case attracted continued attention due to Stiviano's previous connection to Donald Sterling, the former Clippers owner banned from the NBA after racist remarks were leaked by Stiviano. Diorio has denied the charges, claiming Stiviano seeks attention. Nevertheless, images taken after the alleged assault appear to show visible bruising and swelling on Stiviano’s face. After turning himself in, Diorio was released without bail, and his legal team maintains that all charges will eventually be dismissed. The circumstances surrounding Stiviano, her public persona, and her role in the NBA controversy have kept her frequently in the public eye. The sale of the Clippers to Steve Ballmer remains pending NBA approval following Sterling’s removal.

Holiday shopping this year is forecasted to be the slowest in five years, as shoppers search out bargains rather than spending freely. According to the National Retail Federation, November and December sales are only expected to rise by 3% to 4%, a notable drop from last year’s 5.4% growth and well below the pandemic-era spike in 2021. Persistent inflation and increased credit card debt are making consumers more cautious, perhaps bringing an end to the era of robust spending that followed COVID-19.

Statistics from TransUnion and the Federal Reserve Bank of New York reveal US credit card debt jumped $45 billion in just the first quarter of 2023, surpassing $1 trillion for the first time. The average balance per cardholder now stands at $5,733, highlighting concerns about consumer finances ahead of the holidays.

Internationally, Mastercard has been granted approval by China’s central bank to issue yuan-denominated cards in the country, representing a major advancement after years of waiting. Payment processes remain vital to retailers—research from the UK shows shoppers are quick to abandon a store after bad payment experiences or limited options, making speedy and flexible payment systems essential.

Apple is facing a proposed class-action lawsuit from Venmo and Cash App users, who claim that Apple limits competition and drives up payment fees by restricting features—including those involving cryptocurrency—in peer-to-peer payment apps.

Mobile wallets continue to grow rapidly in use, particularly among millennials. By March 2023, 60% of consumers had used mobile wallets for bill payments, with millennials at nearly 80% adoption.

In legislative developments, Australia is set to introduce laws making digital wallets like Apple Pay and Google Pay subject to the same regulations as other payment methods, responding to their increasing prevalence and current lack of oversight.

Although ‘buy now, pay later’ services are drawing interest, experts caution that they may not automatically be safer than credit cards, despite marketing claims.

National Retail Federation melaporkan jualan November dan Disember diunjurkan naik hanya 3% hingga 4%, jauh lebih rendah berbanding pertumbuhan 5.4% tahun lalu dan lonjakan semasa pandemik pada 2021. article_content: Craig Gordon is set to become the first signing of Ronny Deila’s tenure at Celtic. The former Scotland international goalkeeper has drawn interest from Rangers, Hearts, and Motherwell, but sources reveal the 31-year-old recently completed a medical for Celtic at a private hospital in Glasgow. Celtic goalkeeping coach Stevie Woods is a fan of Gordon, who has been a free agent since leaving Sunderland with knee injuries in 2012. Gordon’s likely arrival raises questions about the future of current first-choice keeper Fraser Forster. Forster, currently with the England squad in the US, reportedly has a £10 million price tag from Celtic. Signing Gordon, who previously played for Hearts and Sunderland, increases speculation that Forster could return to the English Premier League before the 31 August transfer deadline. Gordon has declared himself fitter than ever after two years out of the game and confirmed he has received several offers. He hopes to regain his place as Scotland’s number one goalkeeper. ‘You know yourself when you’re ready, and I feel as good as ever in my career. Fitness-wise, I’m there—it’s now about getting matches and proving it to others.’ Last season, Gordon spent time training with Rangers at Murray Park and received an offer from Hearts before Celtic expressed interest. Meanwhile, Ronny Deila, formerly of Stromsgodset, is set to be named Celtic manager by the end of the week and has expressed he is flattered by the club’s interest. All transfer moves remain on hold until his appointment is finalized.

Jurulatih penjaga gol Celtic, Stevie Woods, merupakan peminat Gordon, yang menjadi ejen bebas sejak meninggalkan Sunderland akibat kecederaan lutut pada 2012. Gordon menyatakan beliau kini lebih cergas berbanding sebelum ini selepas dua tahun tidak beraksi dan mengesahkan bahawa beliau telah menerima beberapa tawaran. Beliau berharap dapat kembali sebagai penjaga gol nombor satu Scotland. ‘Anda sendiri tahu bila anda sudah bersedia, dan saya rasa setanding, jika tidak lebih baik daripada, dulu dalam kerjaya saya. Dari segi kecergasan, saya sudah bersedia—sekarang cuma perlu dapatkan minit perlawanan dan membuktikannya pada semua.’ Musim lalu, Gordon menjalani latihan bersama Rangers di Murray Park dan menerima tawaran daripada Hearts sebelum Celtic menunjukkan minat. article_content: Akor Adams' impressive start at Montpellier in Ligue 1 is turning heads as he joins the ranks of Nigerian strikers excelling across Europe’s top leagues. The 23-year-old forward made a strong impact since signing for €4.5 million from Lillestrom over the summer, scoring twice in Montpellier’s recent 3-0 victory over Toulouse, bringing his season total to seven goals in just nine league appearances. Only France captain Kylian Mbappé, with ten goals, sits above him in the scoring chart. Adams’ rapid adaption and efficiency in front of goal have surprised Montpellier coach Michel Der Zakarian, who noted how Adams’ performances have quickly made fans forget key departures from the squad. Club president Laurent Nicollin, however, foresaw Adams’ potential, stating at the season’s start that he could be a 'great surprise.' Before arriving in France, Adams left Nigeria’s Jamba F.A. in 2018 to join Norway’s Sogndal before moving permanently to Lillestrom, where he became one of the top forwards in the league, scoring 17 goals with two assists in 17 league games during his final Norwegian season. His successful partnership with Thomas Lehne Olsen at Lillestrom and prolific form earned him the move to Ligue 1. Dreaming big, Adams has publicly shared his ambitions, including playing for Montpellier in the Champions League and representing Nigeria at the World Cup. Despite his breakthrough performances, he revealed he hasn’t yet been contacted by the Super Eagles’ coach, Jose Peseiro, but remains focused on his club duties. Montpellier’s win against Toulouse featured a standout volley from Adams, listed among the top three goals of Ligue 1’s match-day 10, alongside efforts by PSG's Warren Zaire-Emery and Reims’ Josh Wilson-Esbrand. The victory lifted Montpellier to 11th place in the league with 11 points. With Nigeria preparing for upcoming 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifiers and main striker Victor Osimhen recovering from injury, Adams’ remarkable form could earn him a first call-up to the national team. He is set for a significant test next weekend as Montpellier travels to face champions PSG.

Hanya kapten Perancis, Kylian Mbappé, dengan sepuluh gol, berada di atasnya dalam carta penjaring. Adaptasi pantas dan ketajaman Adams di depan gol mengejutkan ketua jurulatih Montpellier, Michel Der Zakarian, yang berkata persembahan Adams membantu peminat melupakan pemain utama yang telah meninggalkan pasukan. Presiden kelab, Laurent Nicollin pula telah menjangkakan potensinya dan menyebut pada awal musim bahawa Adams mungkin jadi 'kejutan besar.' Sebelum tiba di Perancis, Adams meninggalkan Jamba F.A. di Nigeria pada 2018 untuk bersama Sogndal di Norway, kemudian berpindah tetap ke Lillestrom. Di situ, dia menjadi antara penyerang paling prolifik dengan 17 gol dan dua assist dalam 17 perlawanan musim akhirnya di liga Norway. Gabungannya bersama Thomas Lehne Olsen dan prestasi konsisten membawanya ke Ligue 1. Berimpian besar, Adams sering berkongsi cita-citanya termasuk bermain di Liga Juara-Juara bersama Montpellier dan mewakili Nigeria di Piala Dunia. Walaupun cemerlang, dia akui belum dihubungi ketua jurulatih Super Eagles, Jose Peseiro, dan kekal fokus pada tugas di kelab. Kemenangan Montpellier ke atas Toulouse turut menampilkan sepakan voli menarik Adams yang tersenarai antara tiga gol terbaik Ligue 1 minggu ke-10, bersama Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) dan Josh Wilson-Esbrand (Reims). Kemenangan ini melonjakkan Montpellier ke tangga ke-11 liga dengan 11 mata. Dengan Nigeria bakal memulakan kelayakan Piala Dunia FIFA 2026 dan penyerang utama Victor Osimhen masih pulih dari kecederaan, prestasi hebat Adams mungkin memberikannya panggilan pertama ke skuad kebangsaan. Minggu depan, Adams dijangka berdepan ujian besar apabila Montpellier bertemu juara bertahan PSG.

article_content: Senator Adeniyi Adegbomire (Ondo Central, All Progressives Congress) has stated that off-season elections strengthen Nigerian democracy by ensuring that the people's votes genuinely count. Speaking in Akure, he asserted that societies where leaders come to power without the people's mandate are headed for failure. As Chairman of the Senate Committee on Agriculture Colleges and Institutions, Adegbomire emphasized that according to current interpretations of Nigerian law, the National Assembly cannot legislate against off-season elections. He reiterated that these elections are constitutionally grounded, noting: 'It is a constitutional matter and the Supreme Court has been clear. The Constitution says you serve a four-year term, starting from the day you're sworn in as governor or president.' He highlighted a distinction, pointing out that while the Electoral Act requires two-thirds of local government votes for victory, the Constitution only sets criteria for tenure, not election victory. Adegbomire further argued that any person removed from office by a court or tribunal should not be recognized as having governed that state, although the law recognizes official acts taken while that person was in office to avoid chaos and legal uncertainty. He suggested adjusting the electoral calendar by shortening the gap between party primaries and general elections. This, he argued, would create more time to resolve disputes and litigation before the main election, ultimately reducing conflicts after results are announced. Contrastingly, former President Goodluck Jonathan recently called on the National Assembly to pass legislation ending off-cycle elections. Speaking after voting in the recent Bayelsa State governorship election, Jonathan said off-season polls are 'odd' and not in line with global best practice. He expressed concern that persisting with off-season polls could eventually lead to presidential elections being held outside the regular schedule. Jonathan pointed out that in countries like the United States, while elections may be staggered for some offices, nationally elected officials are selected on synchronized dates. He and Adegbomire thus present opposing views: Jonathan urges an end to off-season elections, while Adegbomire insists current constitutional practice must be respected.
translated_content: Senator Adeniyi Adegbomire (Ondo Tengah, Parti Kongres Semua Progresif) menyatakan bahawa pilihan raya luar musim mengukuhkan demokrasi di Nigeria kerana ia memastikan undi rakyat benar-benar diambil kira. Bercakap di Akure, beliau menegaskan bahawa masyarakat yang pemimpinnya naik tanpa mandat rakyat akan menuju kehancuran. Sebagai Pengerusi Jawatankuasa Senat bagi Kolej dan Institusi Pertanian, Adegbomire menekankan bahawa mengikut tafsiran undang-undang Nigeria sekarang, Dewan Negara tidak boleh menggubal undang-undang untuk menghapuskan pilihan raya luar musim. Beliau menegaskan bahawa pilihan raya ini berlandaskan perlembagaan, sambil berkata: 'Ini soal perlembagaan, dan Mahkamah Agung sudah jelas. Perlembagaan menyatakan anda berkhidmat empat tahun dari tarikh mengangkat sumpah sebagai gabenor atau presiden.' Beliau turut mengetengahkan, Akta Pilihan Raya mensyaratkan dua pertiga undi kerajaan tempatan untuk menang, sedangkan Perlembagaan hanya menetapkan syarat untuk tempoh perkhidmatan, bukan kemenangan pilihan raya. Adegbomire juga berpendapat bahawa sesiapa yang disingkirkan oleh mahkamah atau tribunal tidak harus diiktiraf sebagai pernah mentadbir negeri itu, walaupun undang-undang tetap mengiktiraf tindakan rasmi ketika memegang jawatan supaya tidak timbul kekeliruan dan ketidaktentuan undang-undang. Beliau mencadangkan agar takwim pilihan raya diselaraskan dengan memendekkan jurang antara pemilihan calon parti dan pilihan raya umum. Katanya, ini akan memberi lebih banyak masa untuk menyelesaikan pertikaian sebelum pilihan raya utama berlangsung, seterusnya mengurangkan konflik selepas keputusan diumumkan. Sebaliknya, bekas Presiden Goodluck Jonathan baru-baru ini menyeru Dewan Negara meluluskan undang-undang untuk menamatkan pilihan raya luar musim. Berucap selepas mengundi pada pilihan raya gabenor Bayelsa baru-baru ini, Jonathan berkata pilihan raya luar musim adalah 'janggal' dan tidak selari dengan amalan terbaik dunia. Beliau bimbang jika trend ini berterusan, pilihan raya presiden mungkin akan turut diadakan di luar jadual biasa. Jonathan menyatakan, di negara seperti Amerika Syarikat, meskipun pilihan raya beberapa jawatan diadakan secara berperingkat, pegawai yang dipilih di peringkat nasional tetap dipilih pada tarikh yang diselaraskan. Kedua-dua mereka mempunyai pandangan bertentangan: Jonathan mahu pilihan raya luar musim dihentikan, manakala Adegbomire menegaskan supaya amalan berperlembagaan sekarang dikekalkan.

article_content: On Tuesday, the BJP in Bihar organized a major event to engage Yadavs, the state's largest caste group, who usually support the ruling RJD. The 'Yaduvanshi Milan Samaroh' took place at Bapu Sabhagar auditorium during Govardhan Puja, a festival significant to Yadavs as descendants of Lord Krishna. Nityanand Rai, Union Minister of State for Home and former state BJP president, was highlighted as the main force behind the event. Online, '#YadavWithModi' trended for several hours. Rai used his speech to criticize RJD chief Lalu Prasad, arguing he hadn't improved life for Yadavs despite leading Bihar for many years. Rai cited a recent caste survey that found Yadavs, though 14% of Bihar’s population, occupy less than 2% of OBC government jobs. The same survey confirmed Yadavs as Bihar’s largest caste, though BJP members sometimes dispute this, given their core base among upper castes. Earlier, Union Home Minister Amit Shah claimed numbers for Yadavs and Muslims (groups seen as RJD supporters) were ‘inflated’, raising controversy ahead of Lok Sabha polls. To reassure the community, Rai pointed out that the BJP now has more Yadav MPs and MLAs than any other party, and blamed Lalu Prasad’s RJD for associating Yadavs with lawlessness. He also accused Prasad of failing to appoint any other Yadav leader as Chief Minister after his own resignation related to the fodder scam—passing the leadership to Rabri Devi instead. Rai stated that Lalu Prasad was convicted when Congress ruled at the Centre, and that HD Deve Gowda, whose PM bid Prasad supported, was in office when initial charges were filed. Rai criticized Tejashwi Yadav, Lalu’s son and Bihar’s Deputy CM, for not objecting to CM Nitish Kumar’s offensive assembly comments about women, referencing the Mahabharata to emphasize his point. He further criticized the Bihar government over slaughterhouses, promising a complete ban on cattle slaughter if the BJP wins all Lok Sabha seats and governs Bihar after 2025. Separately, India’s Income Tax Department continues to probe Apple, Google, and Amazon’s Indian units for possible tax issues related to transfer pricing since 2021. Indians have become the leading real estate buyers in Dubai, playing a major role in that city's property market. Digital payments company Razorpay may move its parent registration to India, potentially incurring $250-300 million in US taxes.
translated_content: Pada hari Selasa, BJP di Bihar telah menganjurkan satu acara besar untuk menarik komuniti Yadav, kumpulan kasta terbesar di negeri itu yang biasanya setia menyokong RJD yang memerintah. 'Yaduvanshi Milan Samaroh' berlangsung di auditorium Bapu Sabhagar sempena Govardhan Puja, sebuah perayaan penting bagi Yadav kerana dianggap keturunan Dewa Krishna. Nityanand Rai, Menteri Negara Dalam Negeri dan bekas presiden BJP negeri, menjadi wajah utama acara berkenaan. Di media sosial, '#YadavWithModi' trending selama beberapa jam. Dalam ucapannya, Rai mengkritik ketua RJD Lalu Prasad dengan mengatakan beliau gagal memajukan kehidupan komuniti Yadav biarpun lama memerintah Bihar. Rai merujuk kajian kasta baru-baru ini yang mendapati Yadav, walaupun merangkumi 14% penduduk Bihar, memegang kurang 2% jawatan kerajaan bagi golongan OBC. Kajian sama turut mengesahkan Yadav sebagai kumpulan kasta terbesar di Bihar, walaupun sebahagian ahli BJP kadangkala mempertikaikan angka ini kerana asas penyokong utama mereka ialah dari kasta atasan. Sebelum ini, Menteri Dalam Negeri Amit Shah mendakwa angka Yadav dan Muslim—dua kumpulan utama penyokong RJD—adalah 'dinaikkan', mencetuskan kontroversi menjelang pilihan raya Lok Sabha. Rai cuba meyakinkan komuniti dengan menegaskan BJP kini mempunyai lebih ramai Yadav sebagai Ahli Parlimen dan ADUN berbanding parti lain, sambil menuduh Lalu Prasad dan RJD mengaitkan nama Yadav dengan isu jenayah. Beliau turut mengkritik Prasad yang tidak melantik pemimpin Yadav lain sebagai Ketua Menteri selepas beliau meletak jawatan akibat skandal pakan, sebaliknya menyerahkan jawatan itu kepada Rabri Devi. article_content: Asexuality has become increasingly visible in recent years, with more asexual characters appearing in TV series like 'Heartstopper' and 'Sex Education.' However, misconceptions about what it means to be asexual still persist. In simple terms, asexuality is a sexual orientation characterized by little or no sexual attraction to others. Yet, this label covers a spectrum: some asexual people experience romantic attraction, form relationships, and may even enjoy sex, while others may not be interested in any sexual activity at all. Within the broader ace community, there are different identities. For example, demisexuals only feel sexually attracted to people they have a strong emotional bond with. Asexuality can also overlap with other identities—some ace individuals are queer, transgender, or otherwise gender diverse. There’s limited data about how many people identify as asexual. A 2004 population survey in the UK found that about 1% of people had never felt sexually attracted to anyone, but many within the asexual community might not describe themselves this way. In 2019, an Australian LGBTQIA+ survey showed that 3.2% of respondents identified as asexual. The Asexual Visibility and Education Network, an international group for ace people, now has more than 120,000 members. The asexual movement began to gather momentum in the early 2000s, supported by the growth of the internet which helped asexual people connect, share experiences, and build community—much like the earlier LGBTQ+ movements. Asexuality is recognized as a valid identity on par with heterosexuality, homosexuality, and bisexuality. However, it's often misunderstood, sometimes criticized as just a temporary lack of interest in sex, rather than a distinct orientation. Understanding the difference between sexual identity and sex drive is key. While sex drive refers to how much or little someone desires sex, sexual identity is about who we are and the pattern of our attractions. Sociologist Jeffrey Weeks highlighted how Western societies only began viewing sexuality as central to a person’s identity in the late 1800s, especially with the emergence of categories like 'homosexual' and 'heterosexual.' Before that, sex was considered merely an action, not a reflection of who someone is. Asexuality hasn’t faced the same level of legal or cultural persecution as homosexuality, but many ace individuals still don’t fit mainstream expectations about sex, relationships, or marriage. This can lead to misunderstanding or lack of acceptance by family, friends, and society. Since sexual relationships, desirability, marriage, and having children are highly valued in many cultures, asexual people are sometimes wrongly seen as broken or deficient. Medical or psychological frameworks can reinforce these negative messages. For example, the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM) lists Hypoactive Sexual Desire Disorder, which can pathologize people with low sexual desire. Although diagnoses like this can help those who feel distress, they also risk framing asexuality as a disorder when, for many, it's simply part of their identity. Raising awareness about asexuality helps challenge these harmful assumptions. The ace movement isn’t against sex; rather, it advocates for the full acceptance and celebration of asexuality as one facet of human sexual diversity, inviting everyone to broaden their understanding of what it means to live a fulfilling life.
translated_content: Aseksualiti kini semakin mendapat perhatian, dengan lebih banyak watak aseksual muncul dalam siri TV seperti 'Heartstopper' dan 'Sex Education'. Walaupun begitu, masih banyak salah faham tentang maksud sebenar aseksualiti. Secara ringkas, aseksualiti ialah orientasi seksual di mana seseorang mengalami sedikit atau tiada tarikan seksual terhadap orang lain. Namun, label ini merangkumi pelbagai spektrum: ada individu aseksual yang mengalami tarikan romantik, membina hubungan, malah ada yang menikmati seks, manakala sebahagian lagi langsung tidak berminat dengan sebarang aktiviti seksual. Dalam komuniti ace yang lebih luas, terdapat pelbagai identiti. Sebagai contoh, demiseksual hanya merasa tarikan seksual terhadap seseorang yang mempunyai ikatan emosi yang kukuh. Aseksualiti juga boleh bertindih dengan identiti lain—ada individu ace yang juga queer, transgender, atau beridentiti jantina selainnya. Data berkaitan jumlah sebenar orang yang mengenal pasti diri sebagai aseksual masih terhad. Kajian populasi di UK pada tahun 2004 mendapati sekitar 1% responden tidak pernah merasa tarikan seksual terhadap sesiapa, namun, ramai dalam komuniti aseksual mungkin tidak menggambarkan diri mereka begitu. Pada tahun 2019, satu tinjauan LGBTQIA+ di Australia melaporkan 3.2% responden mengenal pasti diri sebagai aseksual. Asexual Visibility and Education Network, kumpulan antarabangsa untuk individu ace, kini mempunyai lebih 120,000 ahli. Pergerakan aseksual mula mendapat momentum pada awal 2000-an, dipacu oleh perkembangan internet yang membolehkan individu aseksual berhubung, berkongsi pengalaman, dan membina komuniti—seperti pergerakan LGBTQ+ sebelum ini. Aseksualiti kini diiktiraf sebagai identiti yang sah, setaraf dengan heteroseksualiti, homoseksualiti, dan biseksualiti. Namun, ia masih sering disalah faham atau disalah anggap sekadar kekurangan minat seks sementara, bukan satu orientasi yang berbeza. Penting untuk memahami perbezaan antara identiti seksual dan nafsu seks. Nafsu seks ialah tahap keinginan seseorang terhadap seks, manakala identiti seksual berkaitan siapa diri kita dan corak tarikan kita. Ahli sosiologi Jeffrey Weeks menyatakan bahawa masyarakat Barat hanya mula melihat seksualiti sebagai inti identiti seseorang pada akhir 1800-an, terutamanya dengan kemunculan kategori seperti 'homoseksual' dan 'heteroseksual.' Sebelum itu, seks dianggap hanya sebagai satu perbuatan, bukan cerminan identiti seseorang. Walaupun aseksualiti tidak mengalami penindasan undang-undang atau budaya seperti homoseksualiti, ramai individu ace tetap tidak memenuhi harapan arus perdana tentang seks, hubungan atau perkahwinan. Ini boleh menyebabkan salah faham atau kurang penerimaan daripada keluarga, rakan dan masyarakat. Memandangkan hubungan seksual, keinginan, perkahwinan, dan anak sangat dihargai dalam banyak budaya, individu aseksual kadangkala dianggap 'rosak' atau tidak cukup sempurna. Kerangka perubatan dan psikologi turut boleh mengukuhkan mesej negatif ini. Sebagai contoh, Manual Diagnostik dan Statistik Gangguan Mental (DSM) menyenaraikan Hypoactive Sexual Desire Disorder, yang boleh memandang rendah keinginan seks sebagai satu masalah. Walaupun diagnosis sebegini boleh membantu mereka yang tertekan, ia juga boleh memberikan gambaran salah bahawa aseksualiti itu satu gangguan walhal, bagi ramai orang, ia adalah sebahagian identiti diri. Meningkatkan kesedaran tentang aseksualiti dapat mencabar tanggapan negatif ini. Pergerakan ace bukan anti-seks, malah menggalakkan penerimaan dan penghargaan aseksualiti sebagai salah satu aspek kepelbagaian seksual manusia, dan mengajak semua untuk merangkumkan pemahaman kita tentang makna hidup yang bermakna.

Channing Tatum's "Magic Mike" is set to return to theaters. On July 3, 2015, Tatum will reprise his role as the popular male stripper in a new sequel after the success of 2012's "Magic Mike." Rather than calling it simply "Magic Mike 2," the sequel gets a more striking name: "Magic Mike XXL." 

In the original film, Tatum played Mike, a construction worker and aspiring furniture designer by day who transforms into a top stripper by night. The movie, directed by Steven Soderbergh and featuring Matthew McConaughey, Joe Manganiello, and Alex Pettyfer, was a summer hit that made $113 million in the U.S.

According to Tatum, "Magic Mike XXL" will take the story on the road, departing from the Florida nightclub setting. Speaking at the 2014 MTV Movie Awards after receiving the Trailblazer Award, Tatum said, "This one will be a road trip movie. We want to keep some realism, but pack in a lot of fun and outrageous moments—things you wouldn't ordinarily see in a movie." While the first movie included some darker elements that surprised audiences, the sequel aims for more conflict, adventure, and fun, without being too serious.

Tatum is co-writing and producing "Magic Mike XXL" with Reid Carolin, with Gregory Jacobs directing. Although Tatum expects most of the original cast to return, the full lineup has not been finalized. The sequel comes during a prolific period for Tatum, who has starred in eight films since 2012. Among his 2014 releases are "22 Jump Street," co-starring Jonah Hill, and the science fiction film "Jupiter Ascending," with Mila Kunis.

England coach Steve Borthwick’s bold team selections paid off in Sunday’s Rugby World Cup quarter-final, as England secured a 30-24 win over Fiji. While some saw the results as vindication, Borthwick dismissed the notion, focusing instead on team development.

A key move was starting Marcus Smith at fullback. Though Smith struggled at times to break Fiji's line, his eagerness with the ball forced Fiji’s defense to adjust, creating space for others. Critics questioned Smith’s physicality compared to Freddie Steward, but Smith demonstrated resilience and technical skill in defense, battling on after a heavy head collision early in the match. "He defended with a huge amount of courage," Borthwick said, praising Smith’s often-overlooked defensive ability.

Another significant decision was dropping George Ford, moving Owen Farrell to flyhalf. Farrell shone in his familiar number 10 role, directing play with sharpness and ambition. His goalkicking proved vital—he landed five out of six penalties, a conversion, and a crucial late drop goal after Fiji had leveled the match. Borthwick called him "a fantastic leader," praising his composure and performance in high-stakes moments.

Selecting two specialist centres also paid dividends. Both Manu Tuilagi and Joe Marchant scored tries—a rare feat for England’s centres—and put in determined defensive shifts. Ben Earl’s selection at Number Eight continued his impressive tournament, with Borthwick credited for reinstating him after previous exclusion under Eddie Jones.

In response to questions about his selection choices, Borthwick dismissed outside opinions. "I don’t care what other people think," he said. "This is a squad packed with talented players who perform on big occasions. Many doubted we’d get this far, but the team topped the group and found ways to win."
