article_content: This is a personal essay based on a conversation with Jason Eddy, who shared his experience of moving from London to New York. The following has been edited for length and clarity. In 2019, I relocated from London to New York with my husband. I'm a professional actor, and my husband is an engineer at Google. It was his first time living outside the UK. When he was offered a transfer to the US, we both recognized it as an unmissable opportunity. I was born and raised in Bermuda, completed my schooling in Canada, trained as an actor in New York, and lived in London for 18 years. Living in different countries broadens your perspective and deepens self-understanding. However, my relationship with New York is complex. I love the city, but our connection is shaped by challenging experiences. The first time I lived in New York was as an 18-year-old acting student in 2000. It was exciting to explore the city and experience things I had only seen in movies. Then, 9/11 occurred—a devastating and transformative event. I hadn’t returned since then. When we moved back at the end of 2019, the Covid-19 pandemic unfolded shortly after. The city was dramatically altered; Times Square was empty and the streets were deserted. It brought back memories and emotions from the past that I had to process. One thing I've learned is that New Yorkers have a unique way of responding to hardship. The city’s resilience is remarkable. Despite stereotypes about rudeness, New York is very community-minded. People come together during difficult times—just as they did during 9/11 and again during the pandemic. Residents support each other and work to recover. I’ve also noticed New York’s open-minded attitude. There’s a sense of 'show me what you’ve got,' especially in creative fields. Opportunities in my profession seem more attainable here than they were in London. At first, my British background held me back, but New York has encouraged me to pursue possibilities. Now, when I walk through the city, I feel like I belong. New Yorkers are straightforward; they want to know what you need so they can help efficiently. The city moves at a relentless pace—people are always working. For example, when searching for an apartment, our broker would reply to emails even at 2 a.m. The work ethic and ambition here shape the city's energy, making it both exhilarating and exhausting. One of the most valuable lessons New York has taught me is to live in the moment. Although English is spoken here, cultural differences in outlook and behavior are significant. Adapting to a new country also means adjusting to the local political environment. When we arrived, the US was approaching the end of Trump’s presidency, which was concerning. Americans are very vocal about politics. Witnessing the nation’s reaction to Covid-19 and the protests following George Floyd’s death was unsettling, especially as a person of color. We still talk about what we might do depending on the outcome of the next election. The healthcare system has been one of the hardest adjustments. Many people are dissatisfied with it, while others accept it as normal. Although people in Britain may criticize the NHS, it provides dependable healthcare. Here in the US, I’ve seen friends set up GoFundMe pages to pay for medical bills after illnesses or accidents—even when employed. It’s even more difficult for those living in poverty. I’ve realized there are aspects of life in the UK that shouldn’t be taken for granted.

Earlier this month, a 32-year-old male gamer was found dead in a Taiwanese Internet café after an uninterrupted three-day gaming session. This incident followed the death of another male gamer in Taipei earlier this year, who died after a five-day gaming binge. While such occurrences are extremely rare, they raise questions about why gaming can sometimes lead to extreme behaviors.

Having spent nearly thirty years researching video game addiction, I have reviewed numerous medical and psychological studies indicating that excessive gaming can lead to various health issues, ranging from repetitive strain injuries and obesity to auditory and visual hallucinations and addiction. It is important to note that scientific research also highlights many educational and therapeutic benefits of gaming. However, there is a small minority of gamers who develop problematic behaviors due to overuse.

What makes gaming compulsive and addictive for this minority? At its core, addiction stems from continual reinforcement—the constant rewards offered during gameplay. These rewards can be physiological (feeling a rush or euphoria when playing or achieving a high score), psychological (gaining a sense of control or satisfaction from winning), social (receiving praise from fellow gamers), and sometimes financial (winning tournaments). The unpredictable nature of these rewards encourages some players to continue playing, hoping the next reward is just around the corner.

In the past decade, the shift from standalone console games to massively multiplayer online games has contributed to excessive gaming. Online games never truly end, requiring players to compete or cooperate with others in real time, making it difficult to pause and return later. Many excessive gamers report discomfort about logging off, as they fear missing out on in-game developments.

Scientific studies on problematic gaming have increased significantly over the last five years. In May 2013, the American Psychiatric Association released the fifth edition of the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM-5), which, for the first time, included Internet Gaming Disorder (IGD) as a psychological condition requiring further research. Throughout my career, I have observed that all addictions share common features, such as intense preoccupation, mood changes, cravings, increased tolerance, withdrawal symptoms, conflicts with work or relationships, and loss of control—indicating similar underlying causes.

A critical question is when does a healthy enthusiasm become an addiction? Generally, healthy pursuits enhance life, while addictions begin to detract from it. Determining what constitutes 'too much' can be challenging, as some people game for many hours without negative consequences.

The DSM-5 lists nine criteria for IGD. A gamer is likely to be diagnosed with IGD if five or more of the following are present: (1) preoccupation with internet games, (2) withdrawal symptoms when not gaming, (3) increased time needed to achieve satisfaction, (4) unsuccessful attempts to reduce gaming, (5) loss of interest in other hobbies, (6) continued excessive use despite problems, (7) deceit regarding gaming time, (8) use of gaming to escape negative moods, and (9) loss of significant relationships or opportunities because of gaming.

Fortunately, only a small proportion of gamers suffer from IGD. Most online games offer enjoyment and excitement. Yet, like any activity taken to excess, gaming can become addictive for some. Engaging in any activity for days on end poses health risks—even death—and gaming is no exception. Rather than demonize gaming, it's crucial to educate players about the risks of excessive use.

Awal bulan ini, seorang gamer lelaki berusia 32 tahun ditemui mati di sebuah kafe Internet di Taiwan selepas sesi permainan tanpa henti selama tiga hari. Kejadian ini mengikuti kematian seorang lagi gamer lelaki di Taipei pada awal tahun ini, yang juga meninggal dunia selepas maraton permainan selama lima hari. Walaupun perkara sebegini sangat jarang berlaku, ia menimbulkan persoalan mengapa permainan video kadangkala boleh membawa kepada tingkah laku yang melampau.

Saya telah mengkaji ketagihan permainan video hampir tiga dekad dan pelbagai kajian perubatan serta psikologi menunjukkan bahawa ketagihan bermain secara berlebihan boleh membawa kepada pelbagai masalah kesihatan, daripada kecederaan strain berulang dan obesiti, kepada halusinasi pendengaran dan visual, serta ketagihan. Penting untuk diingat bahawa banyak penyelidikan sains juga menunjukkan pelbagai faedah pendidikan dan terapeutik daripada bermain. Namun, terdapat sebilangan kecil gamers yang mengalami masalah akibat keterlaluan bermain.

Apa yang menjadikan permainan video begitu ketagih bagi golongan kecil ini? Pada asasnya, ketagihan berpunca daripada ganjaran berterusan semasa bermain. Ganjaran ini boleh berbentuk fisiologi (merasai 'high' atau kegembiraan ketika bermain atau memecahkan rekod peribadi), psikologi (merasai keyakinan atau kepuasan kerana menang), sosial (menerima pujian dari rakan gamers), dan kadangkala kewangan (memenangi kejohanan). Sifat ganjaran yang tidak menentu menyebabkan sesetengah pemain terus bermain dengan harapan ganjaran seterusnya akan datang tidak lama lagi.

Dalam dekad lepas, peralihan daripada konsol permainan solo kepada permainan dalam talian berbilang pemain, turut meningkatkan permainan berlebihan. Permainan dalam talian tidak pernah tamat dan memerlukan pemain bersaing atau bekerjasama secara masa nyata, menjadikannya sukar untuk berhenti seketika dan kembali pada masa lain. Ramai gamers yang bermain secara berlebihan melaporkan tidak selesa untuk log keluar kerana takut ketinggalan perkembangan dalam permainan.

Kajian saintifik tentang masalah permainan video meningkat dengan ketara dalam lima tahun kebelakangan ini. Pada Mei 2013, Persatuan Psikiatri Amerika menerbitkan edisi kelima Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM-5), yang buat pertama kali menyenaraikan Internet Gaming Disorder (IGD) sebagai keadaan psikologi yang memerlukan kajian lanjut. Sepanjang kerjaya saya, saya dapati semua ketagihan berkongsi ciri umum seperti terlalu asyik, perubahan mood, keinginan melampau, toleransi meningkat, gejala pengunduran, konflik dengan kerja atau hubungan, dan kehilangan kawalan—menunjukkan punca yang sama.

Persoalan penting ialah bilakah minat sihat bertukar menjadi ketagihan? Secara amnya, minat sihat menambah nilai kehidupan, manakala ketagihan mula mengurangkannya. Sukar menentukan bila 'terlalu banyak' kerana ada individu yang bermain berjam-jam sehari tanpa kesan negatif.

DSM-5 menyenaraikan sembilan kriteria untuk IGD. Seorang gamer berkemungkinan didiagnosis IGD jika lima atau lebih perkara berikut berlaku: (1) sentiasa fikirkan tentang permainan internet, (2) mengalami simptom pengunduran bila berhenti main, (3) perlukan masa bermain lebih lama untuk kepuasan, (4) gagal mengurangkan masa bermain, (5) hilang minat terhadap hobi lain, (6) terus bermain walaupun tahu ada masalah, (7) menipu tentang masa bermain, (8) bermain untuk lari daripada emosi negatif, dan (9) kehilangan hubungan atau peluang penting kerana permainan.

Nasib baik, hanya sebilangan kecil gamers yang mengalami IGD. Kebanyakan permainan dalam talian menyeronokkan dan mengujakan. Namun, seperti aktiviti lain jika berlebihan, permainan video boleh jadi ketagihan bagi segelintir orang. Melakukan apa-apa secara ekstrem selama berhari-hari boleh membahayakan kesihatan—dan permainan video juga tidak terkecuali. Sebaliknya, kita perlu mendidik pemain tentang risiko bermain secara berlebihan daripada memburukkan permainan video.

article_content: The BBC has issued an update on its investigation into Russell Brand’s conduct during his time as a radio presenter. To date, five complaints have been lodged about Brand’s workplace behavior at BBC 6 Music and Radio 2 between 2006 and 2008. Two individuals voiced concerns both during Brand’s employment and again after he left the BBC. In 2019, a third person raised issues regarding Brand’s actions at the BBC’s Los Angeles site in 2008. Since starting this review, two more complaints have emerged. Peter Johnston, the BBC’s director of editorial complaints, is overseeing the investigation. The review began following reports from The Times, The Sunday Times, and Channel 4, which alleged that Brand sexually assaulted four women at the peak of his fame—accusations Brand strongly refutes, stating all of his relationships were consensual. The BBC emphasized that the ongoing investigation is focused on workplace conduct rather than accusations of serious sexual misconduct. Complaints include claims that Brand’s behavior in the radio studios fell short of standard expectations, such as reportedly urinating in a bottle in front of colleagues during a show in 2007. There was also a complaint about inappropriate use of BBC vehicles. The corporation noted that it no longer has detailed records of specific car journeys, nor does any staff recall driving Brand, but the inquiry is still ongoing. Earlier, The Times and Sunday Times reported that Brand allegedly sent a car to a 16-year-old’s school to bring her to his home, beginning a relationship at the time when he was 30. Johnston pointed out that due to the lapse of time and not having centralized complaint logs from that era, piecing together a full picture is difficult. He concluded that no final judgments will be made until every avenue has been explored.

Joe Royle has joined Norwich City as a football consultant. The former Everton, Manchester City, and Oldham manager becomes part of a new-look setup at Carrow Road following the club’s relegation from the Premier League. Last month, Neil Adams was confirmed as Norwich’s full-time manager, and the club also appointed former Falkirk boss Gary Holt and ex-Under-21 coach Mark Robson as first team coaches.

Adams commented, “Mark and Gary are two people I’ve worked with closely, and both will bring enthusiasm, hunger, and experience to the coaching team. They have also played at the highest levels in this country. Joe is someone I have played for at both Championship and Premier League level, and he has amassed a vast amount of knowledge during his time in the game. He has been there, seen it, and done it so to speak, and has also been very successful during his time as both a player and a manager.”

Royle will provide support and advice to Adams’ management team. He initially worked with Adams when he managed Oldham Athletic during Adams’ playing career.

Norwich plans to announce a new technical director soon and is currently interviewing candidates for the director of recruitment position.

Gary Holt is returning to Norwich with his family. Early on Monday, Falkirk released a statement explaining to their supporters that Holt was moving to Carrow Road. However, they later retracted the announcement, clarifying that no deal had been agreed and Holt remained in charge at Falkirk. Later that day, Norwich officially announced Holt’s appointment, after which Falkirk reposted their original statement and removed their earlier apology.

Holt, a former Scotland international and ex-Norwich player, will reunite with Adams, whom he previously worked alongside in the Norwich academy before moving to Falkirk last year. After resolving the confusion, Falkirk wished Holt well in his new role.

Falkirk chairman Martin Ritchie said, “The Club fully understands Gary’s wishes to return with his family to Norwich. We wish him every success in the future and thank him for his work at Falkirk over the last year.”

Holt led Falkirk to a third-place finish in the Scottish Championship this season, though they missed out on promotion after losing to Hamilton in the play-off semi-finals. Falkirk has initiated their search for Holt’s replacement, aiming to appoint a new head coach before pre-season training starts on June 26.

article_content: In an animal shelter near Athens, veterinarian Kleopatra Gkika gently applies soothing cream to the leg of a tortoise, one of hundreds injured in devastating wildfires that swept through Greece this summer. The healing process is progressing well—burnt skin has fallen off, and the tortoise may soon be released back into its natural habitat. However, much of that habitat may have been destroyed. In July and August, Greece was struck by a series of wildfires across the country, leaving at least 26 people dead. The area near the shelter in Kalyvia Thorikou, about 60 kilometers (37 miles) southeast of Athens, was among the first affected. Weeks later, Dadia forest in northeastern Greece—a protected natural park—was also engulfed by flames. The wildfires eventually consumed around 94,000 hectares of forest, making it the largest blaze ever recorded on European soil. The conservative government of Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis, who was re-elected in June, attributed the disaster mainly to climate change. Around 400 tortoises were rescued from fire zones around Athens and on the nearby island of Evia. They were brought to Anima, a non-profit wildlife aid group, and to a nearby zoo. Some tortoises had burns on their legs or shells, while others suffered from smoke inhalation, according to Vassilis Sfakianopoulos, founder of the volunteer group 'Save your hood,' which usually cleans litter but joined animal rescue efforts this summer. The group also saved snakes, cats, and other animals trapped by the fires. Celine Sissler-Bienvenu of the International Fund for Animal Welfare (IFAW) said the fires were so intense that 'there was nothing left—shrubs turned to charcoal.' She noted that with thousands of people forced to leave for safety, wildlife was often overlooked. Tortoises are resilient creatures, Sissler-Bienvenu explained. 'Tortoises can lower their metabolism, surviving without food for weeks, and at the first rainfall, they'll reemerge to feed.' At the Kalyvia shelter, the first step for injured tortoises is immersion in a water basin to rehydrate. If internal injuries are suspected, vets try to detect them by smell. Animal rescue volunteers aim to release the tortoises back into the wild as quickly as possible. Tortoises ready for relocation are marked with a blue chalk cross on their shells. About 100 had already been relocated by September. Time is critical, as keeping wild tortoises in captivity is highly stressful. Male tortoises, in particular, need to be kept apart from females to prevent injury. Tortoises are very attached to their home territory, recognizing local hiding places and water sources. Moving them to unfamiliar areas may cause them to stop eating. Vassilis Sfakianopoulos, a 38-year-old engineer, expressed frustration over the lack of wildlife care in Greece since the financial crisis. Nonetheless, he finds hope in rescue work, noting it's an opportunity for growth and to positively impact the environment.
translated_content: Di sebuah pusat perlindungan haiwan berhampiran Athens, doktor haiwan Kleopatra Gkika dengan lembut menyapu krim penenang pada kaki seekor kura-kura, salah satu daripada ratusan yang cedera akibat kebakaran hutan dahsyat yang melanda Greece musim panas ini. Proses pemulihan berjalan dengan baik—kulit terbakar telah gugur, dan kura-kura itu mungkin akan dilepaskan semula ke habitat asalnya tidak lama lagi. Namun, sebahagian besar habitat itu mungkin telah musnah. Pada bulan Julai dan Ogos, Greece dilanda siri kebakaran hutan di seluruh negara yang mengorbankan sekurang-kurangnya 26 nyawa. Kawasan berhampiran pusat perlindungan di Kalyvia Thorikou, kira-kira 60 kilometer (37 batu) tenggara Athens, antara yang terjejas paling awal. Beberapa minggu kemudian, hutan Dadia di timur laut Greece—taman semula jadi yang dilindungi—juga telah terbakar. Kebakaran ini akhirnya memusnahkan kira-kira 94,000 hektar hutan, menjadikannya kebakaran terbesar yang pernah direkodkan di benua Eropah. Kerajaan konservatif di bawah Perdana Menteri Kyriakos Mitsotakis, yang baru dipilih semula pada Jun, menyatakan bencana ini berpunca terutamanya daripada perubahan iklim. Sekitar 400 kura-kura diselamatkan dari zon kebakaran sekitar Athens dan pulau berhampiran Evia. Mereka dibawa ke Anima, kumpulan bantuan hidupan liar bukan untung, serta ke zoo yang berdekatan. Ada kura-kura yang mengalami luka bakar pada kaki atau cangkerang, manakala yang lain menghadapi masalah pernafasan kerana asap, menurut Vassilis Sfakianopoulos, pengasas kumpulan sukarelawan 'Save your hood'. Kumpulan ini biasanya melakukan pembersihan, namun turut serta dalam penyelamatan haiwan musim panas ini. Mereka juga menyelamatkan ular, kucing, dan haiwan lain yang terperangkap dalam kebakaran. Celine Sissler-Bienvenu dari International Fund for Animal Welfare (IFAW) menyatakan kebakaran kali ini sangat dahsyat hingga 'tidak tinggal apa-apa—belukar menjadi arang.' Katanya lagi, ribuan orang yang terpaksa meninggalkan kediaman menyebabkan hidupan liar sering terabai. Kura-kura adalah haiwan yang sangat tahan lasak, terang Sissler-Bienvenu. 'Kura-kura boleh memperlahankan metabolisme, bertahan tanpa makan selama berminggu-minggu, dan bila hujan turun, mereka akan keluar untuk mencari makanan.' Di pusat perlindungan Kalyvia, langkah pertama untuk kura-kura yang cedera adalah rendaman dalam kolam untuk rehidrasi. Sekiranya ada petanda kecederaan dalaman, doktor haiwan cuba mengesannya melalui deria bau. Sukarelawan penyelamat berusaha melepaskan kura-kura ke habitat liar secepat mungkin. Kura-kura yang siap dilepaskan akan ditanda pangkah kapur biru pada cangkerang. Sekitar 100 ekor telah dilepaskan semula pada September. Masa amat kritikal kerana menempatkan kura-kura liar secara berkumpulan boleh menjadi sangat menekan. Kura-kura jantan khususnya perlu dipisahkan daripada betina bagi mengelakkan kecederaan. Kura-kura sangat terikat dengan kawasan asal mereka, mengenali tempat berlindung dan sumber air. Jika dipindahkan ke kawasan baru, mereka boleh berhenti makan. Vassilis Sfakianopoulos, seorang jurutera berusia 38 tahun, menyuarakan rasa kecewa kerana kekurangan langkah penjagaan hidupan liar di Greece sejak krisis kewangan. Namun, beliau tetap mendapat harapan dalam usaha penyelamatan, melihatnya sebagai peluang untuk belajar dan memberi impak positif kepada alam sekitar.

In the wake of last week's deadly train crossing accident in Valhalla, New York, witnesses described the heroics of Patrick Izzo, 29, who held open the doors for other passengers to escape as flames engulfed him. Despite his hands and hair being on fire, Izzo braced the exit of the burning carriage so others could flee. When the pain became too much, he leapt out and extinguished his burning hands in the snow. Izzo is now recovering at Westchester Medical Center with second-degree burns to his hands, and additional injuries to his face and leg. The crash claimed six lives and injured 15 others.

Photographed by his sister Sally Izzo as he enjoyed a well-deserved meal in his hospital bed, Patrick remains humble, insisting he simply acted on instinct. Sally, a producer at The Blaze, continues to call him a hero, though he modestly rejects the label. Patrick recounted to her the terrifying moment the Metro-North train struck an SUV stuck on the tracks on February 3, describing a jolt so powerful he feared derailment. Following the collision, flames erupted as the third rail pierced the carriage. Injured and aflame, Patrick used his elbow to break the emergency box and unlatch the exit doors, holding them open for others despite the excruciating pain. Sally noted that Patrick is always alert to the location of emergency equipment, calling him "just one of those people."

After escaping, Patrick did what he could to help other passengers, but his injuries limited his actions. Sally recounted the grim aftermath, describing severe injuries among other riders and the tragic loss of life. The six fatalities were officially attributed to blunt force trauma and burns, according to Dr. Kunjlata Ashar, Westchester County's medical examiner. The investigation, conducted by the National Transportation Safety Board, is ongoing pending a final report.

Among the victims were the SUV driver, Ellen Brody, 49, and five men commuting home: Aditya Tomar, 41; Eric Vandercar, 53; Walter Liedtke, 69; Robert Dirks, 36; and Joseph B. Nadol, 42. The accident occurred when Brody’s Mercedes SUV was struck at a grade crossing, triggering a fire likely fueled by the SUV’s gasoline, and causing electrified rail sections to puncture both vehicles. Emergency crews responded promptly, working to recover the vehicles and support survivors as authorities investigate the incident.

Selepas kemalangan maut di lintasan kereta api Valhalla, New York minggu lalu, saksi memuji keberanian Patrick Izzo, 29, yang menahan pintu supaya penumpang lain dapat melarikan diri walaupun dirinya disambar api. Walaupun tangan dan rambutnya terbakar, Izzo menahan pintu keluar koc yang sedang dijilat api untuk menyelamatkan orang lain. Apabila kesakitannya tidak tertahan, dia melompat keluar dan menenggelamkan tangannya dalam salji untuk memadamkan api. Izzo kini dirawat di Westchester Medical Center akibat melecur darjah kedua pada tangan serta kecederaan di muka dan kakinya. Nahas itu mengorbankan enam nyawa dan mencederakan 15 orang lagi.

Dipaparkan dalam gambar yang diambil oleh adiknya, Sally Izzo, ketika dia menikmati hidangan di katil hospital, Patrick tetap merendah diri, menegaskan dia hanya bertindak mengikut naluri. Sally, seorang penerbit di The Blaze, sering memanggilnya wira walaupun dia menolak gelaran itu. Patrick menceritakan detik mengerikan kepada Sally apabila kereta api Metro-North merempuh sebuah SUV yang tersekat di landasan pada 3 Februari, menyebabkan hentakan amat kuat sehingga dia bimbang kereta api mungkin tergelincir. Selepas perlanggaran, api marak apabila rel ketiga menembusi koc. Walaupun cedera dan terbakar, Patrick menggunakan siku untuk memecahkan kotak kecemasan dan membuka pintu keluar buat penumpang lain walaupun menanggung kesakitan teruk. Sally memberitahu, Patrick memang sentiasa peka dengan lokasi peralatan kecemasan, menggambarkannya sebagai "jenis orang yang begitu".

Setelah menyelamatkan diri, Patrick cuba membantu penumpang lain, namun kecederaan menyekat usahanya. Sally menceritakan keadaan ngeri selepas kejadian dengan kecederaan teruk dan kehilangan nyawa di kalangan penumpang. Keenam-enam kematian itu disahkan berpunca daripada trauma tumpul dan melecur oleh Dr. Kunjlata Ashar, pemeriksa perubatan daerah Westchester. Siasatan oleh Lembaga Keselamatan Pengangkutan Kebangsaan masih dijalankan sementara menunggu laporan akhir.

Antara mangsa ialah pemandu SUV, Ellen Brody, 49, dan lima lelaki yang dalam perjalanan pulang: Aditya Tomar, 41; Eric Vandercar, 53; Walter Liedtke, 69; Robert Dirks, 36; dan Joseph B. Nadol, 42. Kemalangan berlaku apabila SUV Mercedes Brody dilanggar di lintasan bertingkat, menyebabkan kebakaran yang dipercayai berpunca daripada petrol SUV berkenaan dan beberapa bahagian rel elektrik menembusi kedua-dua kenderaan tersebut. Pasukan kecemasan bertindak segera untuk memulihkan kenderaan serta membantu mangsa sementara pihak berkuasa terus menyiasat kejadian.

article_content: Global stock markets are anticipated to post moderate increases in the coming year, but are likely to end 2024 below previous record highs, as indicated by a recent Reuters survey of over 120 stock market specialists. A narrow majority believes that major indices might reach new peaks within the next six months. The outlook for markets hinges largely on interest rate policies. Central banks have mostly stopped the aggressive hikes that followed the pandemic, although inflation remains above target. Many analysts forecast a possible interest rate cut by the U.S. Federal Reserve by mid-2024, but this expectation is uncertain and does not directly mirror official statements. According to the Reuters poll, 46 out of 82 participants expect most leading stock indexes to touch record highs soon. However, only a few among the top 15 stock indexes are seen reaching those levels by the end of 2024. Ajay Rajadhyaksha, Global Chairman of Research at Barclays, stated that after recommending cash over equities and bonds for two consecutive quarters, they now anticipate stocks to deliver high single-digit returns in 2024, outperforming core fixed income. He also pointed out that global economic downside risks have eased, suggesting a positive environment for equities. A substantial majority of survey respondents (72 out of 85) foresee an increase in corporate earnings in their home markets over the next six months, while 13 expect earnings to decline. Despite elevated interest rates and moderating global inflation, just over half (44 out of 80) believe value stocks will outperform growth stocks in the six-month outlook. Markets are currently factoring in possible 2024 rate cuts, resulting in lower bond yields and higher stock prices. Last month, yields on U.S. 10-year Treasuries briefly topped 5% for the first time since 2007, but are not expected to reach that level again soon, according to other Reuters surveys of bond strategists. Lower bond yields may be needed for further stock market gains. While yields have increased from historically low levels, further decreases are uncertain, especially after U.S. 10-year yields fell about 60 basis points in recent weeks. Marko Kolanovic, Chief Global Markets Strategist at J.P. Morgan, cautions that although falling bond yields have benefited equities recently, stocks could soon face less attractive risk-reward prospects because of high valuations, overly optimistic earnings expectations, declining pricing power, risks to profit margins, and an anticipated slowdown in revenue growth, especially if the Fed maintains higher rates. The S&P 500 is forecasted to end 2024 at approximately 4,700, a 3% increase from current levels, with a potential U.S. economic slowdown or recession listed among key risks. European equity markets are likewise expected to see modest increases, buoyed by hopes that interest rates have peaked, but weighed down by recession fears. The STOXX 600 is expected to end 2024 about 4% higher at 475 points. Canada’s primary stock index is predicted to grow less than previously estimated, as global economic headwinds could impact corporate earnings. Japan’s Nikkei 225 is projected to climb to a 30-year high of 35,000 by June 2024, while India’s BSE is seen reaching new record highs in 2024. The IPO market is currently strong, with recent offerings such as Tata Technologies, Flair Writing Industries, and Gandhar Oil Refinery seeing full subscriptions within hours of opening. IndiGo, India’s largest airline, is reportedly exploring the introduction of premium services—such as upgraded seats, in-flight meals, and a loyalty program—by the end of 2024, aiming to appeal to business travelers and better compete with Air India on international routes. Indian creditors have withdrawn nearly 26,518 insolvency cases, representing defaults of ₹9.33 lakh crore, before reaching formal proceedings since the enactment of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.

article_content: A powerful winter storm swept through Dallas, leaving the city frozen, before moving on to the East Coast on Sunday. The National Weather Service reports that Washington, Philadelphia, and New York City are facing snow, ice, or freezing rain, but the worst of the weather should pass quickly. Temperatures in these cities are expected to rise into the 40s by Monday, allowing snow and ice to melt after the morning rush hour. Elsewhere in the United States, much of the nation is dealing with unseasonably cold weather, while residents along the Gulf Coast and in parts of the Southeast are bracing for heavy rain. High temperatures in the northern and central Rockies, as well as the northern Plains and Midwest, are only around 10 degrees. Sleet and freezing rain are spreading from the Tennessee Valley into the mid-Atlantic, with the central Appalachian Mountains forecasted to get the heaviest snow. Some areas in the mid-Atlantic and Northeast could receive up to three inches of snow. The severe weather is causing widespread flight delays and cancellations at major airports. According to the Federal Aviation Administration, arriving flights at Philadelphia International Airport had delays averaging 100 minutes, with nearly hour-long delays also at New York's Kennedy and Chicago's O'Hare airports. At Reagan National in Washington, flights were temporarily halted so crews could de-ice the runways, and travelers were advised to check with their airlines. Data from FlightAware.com shows 2,459 flight cancellations in the U.S. on Sunday, with 804 more expected for Monday. NFL games were played in wintry conditions, with the Pittsburgh Steelers sharing images of their snow-covered field before facing Miami, and Philadelphia's game seeing even heavier snowfall. Meanwhile, the cold snap in Texas led Southern Methodist University to offer free football tickets, but the stadium remained mostly empty. At Dallas/Fort Worth airport, Saturday's high was just 26 degrees—the coldest high temperature for any December 7 and the coldest December day in 23 years, according to WFAA-TV. At least seven deaths across several states have been linked to the storm. Texas authorities reported two weather-related fatalities, including a driver who lost control and crashed into Lake Lewisville, and another person killed in a crash in Hockley County. Arkansas saw one fatality due to a tree falling on a camper, Oklahoma reported a weather-related death in Muskogee, and New Mexico had one in a semi-truck crash. In Arizona, a Saturday night snowstorm stranded about 300 vehicles on Interstate 15, leading to minor injuries and prompting authorities to provide assistance and close the road for more than twelve hours. Many areas are experiencing snow and cold much earlier and harsher than normal. Farmersburg, Indiana, recorded up to ten inches of snow on Thursday, while East Kingsford, Michigan saw temperatures drop to zero—well below the typical December averages. Across the High Plains and Great Lakes, wind chill readings were as much as 35 to 45 degrees below zero. CNN reporters Melissa Lefevre, Jennifer Gray, Dave Alsup, Samantha Mohr, Jason Morris, and Dave Hennen contributed to this report.

Arkansas mencatatkan satu kematian akibat pokok tumbang ke atas rumah bergerak, Oklahoma melaporkan satu kematian berkaitan cuaca di Muskogee, dan New Mexico turut satu kematian dalam kemalangan trak separuh. Di High Plains dan Great Lakes, indeks kesejukan angin pula serendah 35 hingga 45 darjah di bawah sifar. article_content:
Kansas Senator Pat Roberts, a Republican seeking re-election, has secured a major endorsement from the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, a notable development in his unexpectedly close race against independent businessman Greg Orman. Although Kansas is a historically Republican state, Roberts faces strong competition this election cycle.

Roberts and his backers have repeatedly pointed to Orman's professional association with Rajat Gupta, a former Wall Street executive convicted of insider trading, as a concern. They have also criticized Orman's business practices and labeled his political stance as too liberal for Kansas voters.

The Chamber of Commerce, an organization that generally favors pro-business candidates from the Republican Party, has committed its full support for Roberts. Rob Engstrom, a senior executive at the Chamber, stated that they plan to emphasize the policy differences between Roberts and Orman and to provide campaign resources. Engstrom also noted that Orman did not complete the Chamber’s endorsement questionnaire, distinguishing himself from other candidates.

A wave of support from prominent Republicans—such as Bob Dole, Jeb Bush, John McCain, Mitt Romney, as well as Tea Party leaders—has converged on Kansas to strengthen Roberts’ campaign. Sarah Palin and Ted Cruz have also participated in campaign events or have scheduled appearances.

Both Roberts and Kansas Governor Sam Brownback are facing difficult re-election prospects this year. When questioned about Brownback’s low poll numbers, Roberts declined to comment directly, but expressed some optimism about the governor’s campaign.

article_content: Prince Harry and his girlfriend, Cressida Bonas, made a rare public appearance together at Twickenham Stadium, where they watched England defeat Wales in rugby with a score of 29-18. Known for his enthusiasm for sports, Prince Harry regularly attends England matches, but this event marked the first time 24-year-old Cressida joined him for a game. article_content: For a thriving container garden, start with pots that have drainage holes—this helps protect roots from drowning. Lightweight planters made from materials like plastic, resin, or fiberglass are not only easier to handle, but also retain more water for the plants compared to clay and wood containers. Use potting mix from your local garden store rather than soil from your yard to prevent problems from weeds or pests. Potting mixes are typically made with peat moss, vermiculite, and other organic ingredients that create a good environment for roots. Succulents and cacti will benefit from specialty mixes. Look for mixes that include time-release fertilizer and moisture crystals, or add those yourself as directed. Choose plants that suit your available sunlight and space. Be sure to check plant labels or ask for guidance, since each variety has its own light and moisture requirements. Using one plant per pot is easiest, but if you mix varieties, ensure they need similar conditions. Set large containers where you want them before adding soil, as they are hard to move later. Cover the drain holes with a coffee filter or a pottery shard to keep soil in place but let water out. Dampen your potting mix until it feels like a sponge, fill the container so the plant's base is an inch from the top, and gently press the soil to remove air pockets. When transferring a plant from its pot, gently support the root ball and ease it out. If the roots are circling tightly, loosen them before planting. Settle the plant at the right depth, fill in with soil, and water well. If the soil settles too much, top it up so roots remain covered. Adjust watering as the season changes. In mild spring weather, once a week may be enough, but more frequent watering is necessary as it gets hotter, especially for small or hanging pots. Water until excess drips from the bottom, and direct water to the soil—not foliage—to help prevent disease. Don’t allow containers to sit in standing water. Potted plants depend on extra nutrients since frequent watering leaches fertilizer. Use a time-release fertilizer and complement it with liquid feeding every couple of weeks, according to package instructions. Pinch or trim faded blooms to encourage more flowers. While some plants shed old flowers on their own (like impatiens), others benefit from trimming by about a third if blooms fade in late summer. Great flowering container picks for sunny spots include angelonia, zinnia, and purple fountain grass. For shade, try begonias, fuchsia, or torenia. Leafy plants such as caladiums or coleus work in varied light. Always match plant choices to your particular space for the best results.
translated_content: Untuk memastikan taman pasu anda subur, mulakan dengan memilih pasu yang mempunyai lubang saliran agar akar tidak tenggelam. Pasu ringan seperti plastik, resin, atau gentian kaca lebih mudah dialihkan dan boleh mengekalkan lebih banyak air berbanding pasu tanah liat atau kayu. Gunakan campuran tanah pasu dari kedai kebun dan elakkan guna tanah kebun sendiri bagi mengelak masalah rumput liar atau serangga. Campuran ini biasanya mengandungi gambut, vermikulit, dan bahan organik sesuai untuk akar. Sukulen dan kaktus memerlukan campuran khas. Pilih campuran dengan baja pelepasan perlahan serta kristal pengekalan air, atau tambah sendiri mengikut arahan. Pilih tanaman yang serasi dengan tahap cahaya dan ruang yang disediakan. Pastikan baca label tanaman atau tanya pakar kerana setiap spesies ada keperluan berbeza. Gunakan satu tanaman satu pasu untuk mudah, tapi jika gabungkan beberapa jenis, pastikan kesemuanya perlukan keadaan yang sama. Letakkan pasu besar di tempat tetap sebelum mengisinya dengan tanah kerana ia sukar dialihkan kemudian. Tutup lubang saliran dengan penapis kopi atau serpihan seramik untuk elak tanah keluar tapi masih membenarkan air mengalir. Lembapkan campuran tanah hingga terasa seperti span, isi agar pangkal pokok ada satu inci dari permukaan, dan tekan tanah perlahan-lahan untuk buang ruang udara. Apabila memindahkan tanaman, pegang bongkah akar dan keluarkan dengan cermat. Jika akar berpusing rapat, longgarkan sebelum menanam. Letakkan tanaman pada kedalaman sesuai, tambah tanah di sekeliling akar, dan siram dengan baik. Jika tanah terlalu mendap, tambahkan supaya akar sentiasa tertutup. Ubah jumlah siraman mengikut musim. Musim bunga boleh siram seminggu sekali, tapi bila cuaca panas, perlu lebih kerap terutama pasu kecil atau tergantung. Siram hingga air keluar dari bawah pasu dan sasarkan siraman pada tanah, bukan daun, untuk elak penyakit. Jangan biar air bertakung di bawah pasu. Tanaman pasu perlukan nutrien tambahan kerana siraman kerap mengurangkan baja. Guna baja pelepasan perlahan dan tambah baja cair setiap dua minggu mengikut arahan. Pangkas bunga yang layu agar tanaman terus berbunga. Ada tumbuhan seperti impatiens akan gugurkan bunga sendiri, tapi jika kurang berbunga waktu hujung musim, pangkas sepertiga tanaman. Antara pilihan bunga berwarna untuk kawasan panas ialah angelonia, zinnia, dan rumput hias ungu. Untuk teduhan, cuba begonia, fuchsia atau torenia. Pokok berdaun seperti kaladium atau coleus juga sesuai di pelbagai pencahayaan. Pilih tanaman yang sesuai dengan ruang dan cahaya untuk hasil terbaik.

article_content: Ultravisual is a new mobile app that allows users to easily create animated GIFs or edit media directly on their phones. Designed by New York-based developers Ultravisual LLC, the app is often described as the 'Instagram for GIFs' due to its editing features and social sharing capabilities. Users can capture photos and videos within the app or import existing media. The app lets users edit images and videos, apply filters, and organize their creations into collections. To turn a video into a GIF, users upload or record a video and double-click it, automatically dividing it into eight-second clips. Each clip can be trimmed, edited, reordered, or deleted as needed. Trimming is done with a convenient sliding bar, while the Looks Tool and Framing Tool let users adjust the video's style and composition. Users can add text to images, drag and drop files to arrange a collection, and share collaborations with other users. Accidental deletions of clips or edits can be undone by simply shaking the phone. Files can be deleted from collections by swiping left, or removed from the library by swiping down and tapping the bin icon. Currently, Ultravisual is only available for iOS devices running iOS 7 or higher. The developer has not announced any plans to release an Android version.

article_content: Barcelona secured a thrilling 3-2 win over Villarreal at Camp Nou, rallying twice from behind with Lionel Messi netting the decisive goal. Villarreal, unbeaten in their previous 18 matches, took leads through Denis Cheryshev and Luciano Vietto, with Cheryshev cashing in on a defensive error for the opener. Neymar drew Barcelona level just before halftime, scoring his 21st goal of the campaign when he reacted to a rebound off Rafinha’s initial shot, denied by Villarreal’s keeper Sergio Asenjo. In the early second half, Vietto finished a cross from Giovani Dos Santos to restore Villarreal’s lead. Barcelona hit back immediately, as Rafinha scored the team's second equalizer after Messi’s attempt was saved, and minutes later, Suarez assisted Messi just outside the area for the winner. Suarez’s two assists proved crucial in Barcelona’s comeback. The match included controversy, with Barcelona’s penalty claim being waved away after Neymar went down under pressure from Asenjo. Despite the tense finish, the hosts protected their advantage, showcasing resolve seen in recent big matches. With challenging fixtures approaching—including games against Manchester City and further semi-final clashes with Villarreal—Barcelona's form and Messi’s standout display bode well for the upcoming tests. Barcelona was managed by Luis Enrique and started: Bravo; Pique, Mascherano, Alba, Alves; Busquets, Iniesta, Rafinha; Suarez, Messi, Neymar. Villarreal’s lineup comprised Asenjo; Gaspar, Musacchio, Ruiz, Costa; Pina, J Dos Santos, Cheryshev, Soriano, Vietto, G Dos Santos.

article_content: A common question on social media is why passengers on Malaysia Airlines Flight 370 did not make mobile phone calls. Many remember that during the 2001 hijacking of United Flight 93, passengers made calls using mobile phones and airphones. Experts believe that Flight 370 may have been flying too high or too fast for phones to connect with cell towers. Careful analysis of passengers' mobile records is underway. Malaysia Airlines CEO Ahmad Jauhari Yahya said at a press conference that there is no evidence so far of attempted calls, but investigations are ongoing. Authorities are processing millions of records. Radar indicates the plane was flying between 23,000 and 45,000 feet, a height experts say is too high for mobile phones to connect to ground towers. Professor Vincent Lau explained that even at lower altitudes, connecting can be very difficult due to distance and weak signals. Business class seats were equipped with satellite phones, but these could potentially be disabled from inside the plane. Reports that the plane flew as low as 5,000 feet over mountainous terrain, possibly to evade radar, are unconfirmed. Telecom director Bill Rojas said that for a phone to register with a tower, the plane would need to fly at or below around 10,000 feet. In rural areas, cell towers are generally taller and their signals cover larger distances. Rojas stated that in regions like northern Malaysia or southern Thailand, it is technically possible for a low-flying plane's phones to connect to a tower, assuming they were on. If any passengers' phones connected to towers, those records should be easy to retrieve, although each operator’s retention period varies. Authorities are likely checking passenger numbers against network records in Malaysia and Thailand for possible pings or connection attempts. Phones without international roaming would be blocked by the network, but some metadata could still be temporarily stored. Mobile operators have their own guidelines for how long metadata is stored, and these are not typically made public. Rojas also said the plane would need to fly below 250 km/h (155 mph) for phones to register with towers. In other countries, high-speed trains can support calls at up to 240 km/h. Ongoing questions about the missing flight remain, as experts discuss technology and recovery efforts.

Pihak berkuasa sedang memproses berjuta-juta rekod. Radar menunjukkan pesawat terbang antara 23,000 hingga 45,000 kaki, satu ketinggian yang menurut pakar terlalu tinggi untuk telefon bimbit berhubung dengan menara di darat. Profesor Vincent Lau berkata walaupun pada altitud lebih rendah, ia tetap sukar kerana jarak dan isyarat lemah. Kerusi kelas perniagaan mempunyai telefon satelit, namun peranti ini boleh dimatikan dari dalam pesawat. Laporan yang mengatakan pesawat terbang serendah 5,000 kaki di kawasan berbukit — mungkin untuk elak radar — masih belum disahkan. Pengarah telekom, Bill Rojas, berkata telefon hanya boleh berdaftar dengan menara jika pesawat terbang sekitar atau di bawah 10,000 kaki. Di kawasan luar bandar, menara telekomunikasi lebih tinggi dan isyaratnya meliputi kawasan luas. Rojas menyatakan di utara Malaysia atau selatan Thailand, memang secara teknikal telefon dari pesawat rendah boleh berhubung dengan menara jika telefon dihidupkan. Jika telefon penumpang berjaya bersambung dengan menara, rekodnya patut mudah diakses namun tempoh simpanan data berbeza mengikut syarikat telekom. Syarikat telekom mempunyai garis panduan sendiri berapa lama metadata disimpan — selalunya tidak didedahkan kepada umum. Rojas juga menjelaskan pesawat perlu terbang kurang dari 250 km/j supaya telefon dapat berdaftar dengan menara. Di negara lain, panggilan masih boleh dibuat di kereta api laju sehingga 240 km/j. Persoalan tentang kehilangan pesawat ini masih jadi misteri, manakala pakar membincangkan teknologi dan usaha pencarian yang ada.

article_content: More than 1,000 people in Bangladesh have died from dengue fever in 2023, according to official data, making it the deadliest year on record since the country’s first epidemic in 2000. At least 1,017 deaths and nearly 209,000 infections have been reported in the first nine months of the year, nearly four times higher than all of last year. Among the deceased are 112 children aged 15 or younger, including infants. Hospitals across Bangladesh are struggling to accommodate the surge of patients as dengue spreads quickly in the densely populated country. Dengue is a mosquito-borne disease common in tropical regions, causing high fever, headaches, nausea, vomiting, muscle pain, and in severe cases, internal bleeding that can be fatal. The World Health Organization (WHO) has warned that dengue and other mosquito-borne diseases like chikungunya, yellow fever, and Zika are spreading more rapidly and widely due to climate change. There is currently no vaccine or specific treatment for dengue. Outbreaks are most common in South Asia during the June-to-September monsoon, as the Aedes aegypti mosquito thrives in stagnant water. Recently, however, hospitals have also seen dengue cases during the winter months. People suffering repeat dengue infections are at greater risk of severe complications. Dr. Mohammad Rafiqul Islam from Dhaka’s Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College and Hospital says most patients currently admitted are experiencing their second or third dengue infection. "When people have dengue multiple times, the severity increases and deaths are more frequent," Dr. Islam told AFP. "Many come to the hospital late in their illness, making treatment more complicated." Bangladesh reported sporadic dengue cases since the 1960s, recording its first significant outbreak of dengue hemorrhagic fever in 2000. The dengue virus is now endemic in Bangladesh, with outbreaks worsening since the turn of the century. Rising cases have prompted the government to intensify anti-dengue efforts, including public awareness campaigns and initiatives to eliminate mosquito larvae after rains. However, lack of adequate preventive measures has let the dengue-carrying mosquito spread nationwide, said Kabirul Bashar, an entomologist at Jahangirnagar University. "From 2000 to 2018, dengue was largely confined to Dhaka city, but it spread to other cities in 2019 and, this year, has also reached rural areas," Bashar explained.
translated_content: Lebih 1,000 orang di Bangladesh telah meninggal dunia akibat demam denggi pada tahun 2023, menurut data rasmi, menjadikannya tahun paling mematikan sejak wabak pertama di negara itu pada tahun 2000. Sekurang-kurangnya 1,017 kematian dan hampir 209,000 jangkitan telah dilaporkan dalam sembilan bulan pertama tahun ini, hampir empat kali ganda jumlah tahun lalu. Antara yang meninggal dunia ialah 112 kanak-kanak berumur 15 tahun ke bawah, termasuk bayi. Hospital di seluruh Bangladesh sedang kekurangan ruang kerana jumlah pesakit denggi yang meningkat dengan pantas di negara yang padat penduduk ini. Demam denggi ialah penyakit bawaan nyamuk yang biasa di kawasan tropika, menyebabkan demam tinggi, sakit kepala, loya, muntah, sakit otot dan dalam kes teruk, pendarahan dalaman yang boleh membawa maut. Pertubuhan Kesihatan Sedunia (WHO) telah memberi amaran bahawa denggi dan penyakit lain yang disebarkan oleh nyamuk seperti chikungunya, demam kuning dan Zika semakin merebak dengan cepat akibat perubahan iklim. Buat masa ini, tiada vaksin atau rawatan khusus untuk denggi. Wabak biasanya berlaku di Asia Selatan pada musim monsun Jun hingga September, ketika nyamuk Aedes aegypti membiak dalam air bertakung. Kini, hospital juga menerima pesakit denggi pada bulan-bulan musim sejuk. Mereka yang dijangkiti denggi berulang kali berisiko mendapat komplikasi serius. Dr. Mohammad Rafiqul Islam dari Kolej Perubatan & Hospital Shaheed Suhrawardy di Dhaka berkata kebanyakan pesakit yang dimasukkan kini mengalami jangkitan denggi kedua atau ketiga. "Apabila seseorang mendapat denggi beberapa kali, tahap keparahan meningkat dan kematian juga lebih kerap berlaku," kata Dr. Islam kepada AFP. "Ramai yang datang ke hospital lewat dalam tempoh penyakit, menyebabkan rawatan menjadi lebih rumit." Bangladesh telah merekodkan kes sporadik denggi sejak 1960-an dan mencatatkan wabak besar demam denggi berdarah pertama pada tahun 2000. Virus denggi kini endemik di Bangladesh, dengan wabak yang semakin teruk sejak awal abad ini. Peningkatan kes telah mendorong kerajaan memperhebat kempen anti-denggi termasuk program kesedaran awam dan usaha memusnahkan larva nyamuk selepas hujan. Namun, kurangnya langkah pencegahan berkesan menyebabkan nyamuk pembawa denggi merebak ke seluruh negara, kata Kabirul Bashar, pakar entomologi di Universiti Jahangirnagar. "Dari tahun 2000 hingga 2018, denggi banyak berlaku di Dhaka, namun pada 2019 ia merebak ke bandar lain, dan tahun ini telah sampai ke kawasan luar bandar juga," jelas Bashar.

article_content: Peter Bane, a 48-year-old father of three, died by suicide after making at least three unanswered calls for help to his GP's surgery in the 11 days before his death. Mr. Bane, a road safety engineer from Norfolk, was being treated for occasional depression. Two weeks prior to his death in February 2010 at Witham station in Essex, he told his GP surgery he was considering taking his own life, but his requests for help were not passed on to mental health services. Nearly four years later, his family received an undisclosed compensation payment from the Norfolk and Suffolk NHS Foundation Trust. The Trust admitted that if Mr. Bane had been admitted to a psychiatric hospital and given appropriate treatment when he sought help, his suicide likely could have been prevented. His widow Angela Bane, 48, expressed disappointment at the inadequate referral process within the Trust and highlighted concerns about cuts to mental health services. She hopes the Trust’s improved procedures will be adopted more widely to prevent similar tragedies. Dr. Hadrian Ball, the Trust’s medical director, stated that services have substantially improved since Mr. Bane’s death and that the Trust remains committed to ongoing improvements and sharing best practices.
translated_content: Peter Bane, seorang bapa kepada tiga anak berumur 48 tahun, meninggal dunia akibat membunuh diri selepas membuat sekurang-kurangnya tiga panggilan meminta bantuan ke klinik doktornya dalam 11 hari sebelum kematiannya, namun tidak dijawab. Bane, seorang jurutera keselamatan jalan raya dari Norfolk, sedang menerima rawatan untuk masalah kemurungan secara berkala. Dua minggu sebelum kematiannya di Stesen Witham di Essex pada Februari 2010, beliau memberitahu klinik doktornya bahawa beliau mempertimbangkan untuk mengambil nyawanya sendiri, namun permintaannya untuk bantuan tidak disampaikan kepada perkhidmatan kesihatan mental. Hampir empat tahun kemudian, keluarganya menerima bayaran pampasan dengan jumlah tidak didedahkan daripada Norfolk dan Suffolk NHS Foundation Trust. Pihak Trust mengakui bahawa jika Bane telah dimasukkan ke hospital psikiatri dan diberikan rawatan yang sesuai ketika beliau meminta bantuan, kematiannya berkemungkinan besar dapat dielakkan. Balunya, Angela Bane, 48, meluahkan kekecewaan terhadap proses rujukan yang tidak memuaskan dalam Trust dan menzahirkan kebimbangan berhubung pemotongan bajet perkhidmatan kesihatan mental. Beliau berharap prosedur yang telah diperbaiki oleh Trust akan diperluaskan ke seluruh negara untuk mengelakkan tragedi yang sama daripada berulang. Dr Hadrian Ball, pengarah perubatan Trust, menyatakan bahawa perkhidmatan telah banyak bertambah baik sejak kematian Bane dan Trust komited untuk terus melakukan penambaikan serta berkongsi amalan terbaik.

article_content: A 17-year-old girl in Walker, Louisiana, was disciplined by her public school after she was seen dancing at an off-campus party during homecoming celebrations. According to ABC News, she was removed from the student government association, had her college scholarship recommendations withdrawn, and was told by the school's principal, Jason St. Pierre, that she was not 'living in the Lord's way.' The student's mother said St. Pierre printed out Bible verses and highlighted passages for her daughter's religious instruction. After the incident gained media attention, the Livingston Parish Public Schools district posted a statement on Facebook in which St. Pierre reversed his decision. Citing significant public attention and additional reflection, the principal apologized to the student's family and reinstated her opportunities. He also addressed his prior use of religious justification. As of now, the principal has been placed on leave.

article_content: Commuters in London experienced a morning surprise at Tottenham Court Road station when lingerie brand Bluebella turned the Underground platform into a runway, courtesy of permission from Transport for London. The brand showcased its new lingerie collection, with models mingling among travelers and turning heads on the Northern Line. Emily Bendell, founder of Bluebella, said the initiative was meant to uplift the spirits of people starting their workday and show that high-end lingerie is for everyday enjoyment, not just special moments. She highlighted how confident people can feel wearing beautiful pieces, even if hidden under daily clothes and surrounded by crowds. Model Jennifer Anstead recounted how the event was both exciting and challenging, making it one of her most memorable catwalk experiences. She appreciated sharing the buzz directly with London commuters. Bluebella, founded a decade ago by Oxford graduate Emily Bendell, is based in Chiswick and has become known for bold designs. Their recent partnership with author E L James resulted in the official 'Fifty Shades of Grey' Black Label lingerie line, launched around the film’s release.

Pengasas Bluebella, Emily Bendell, berkata usaha ini bertujuan menceriakan hari mereka yang memulakan kerja dan menunjukkan bahawa pakaian dalam mewah boleh dipakai setiap hari, bukan hanya untuk majlis istimewa. article_content: Joby Matthew, a 36-year-old athlete from Kerala, has confronted challenges head-on despite standing just 3 feet 5 inches tall due to Proximal Femoral Focal Deficiency. Rather than being defined by his disability, Joby has accomplished feats many would find difficult. He has recently completed intensive training in New Zealand as part of his preparation to climb Mount Everest, a dream he is determined to achieve. 'Climbing Everest is my greatest ambition. I've begun my training, and I am fully committed,' he shared. Joby boasts an impressive track record, having won gold medals in badminton, javelin, discus throw, and shot put at the 2013 World Dwarf Games in Michigan. He is also recognized as a world champion arm wrestler and has found success in several competitive sports. His positive attitude began in childhood, when, after being excluded from school sports, Joby focused on building his upper body strength and turned his attention to arm wrestling. Despite early disappointments, his perseverance paid off. Daily, Joby trains by spending an hour at the gym and swimming in a nearby river. He has faced numerous hardships but continues to overcome them with determination. Joby is married to Megha, a classical dancer, and together with their son Jyothis, they make a strong family unit. Megha admires his persistence, saying, 'His disability never bothered me; his drive inspires me, though it can be nerve-wracking.' She described occasions when Joby undertook long journeys at short notice for competitions. Having collected over sixteen national and international sports titles, Joby is now setting his sights on new challenges. Reaching the top of Mount Everest stands to be his greatest accomplishment yet.

Joby tidak pernah membiarkan kekurangan diri menjejaskan kejayaannya, malah telah meraih pencapaian luar biasa. Beliau baru menamatkan latihan intensif di New Zealand bagi persiapan mendaki Gunung Everest—impian terbesar dalam hidupnya. 'Mendaki Everest adalah impian saya yang paling besar. Latihan sudah bermula dan saya sangat komited,' ujar Joby. Joby memiliki rekod sukan yang memukau, termasuk menang pingat emas dalam badminton, lembing, lontar cakera, dan lontar peluru di World Dwarf Games 2013 di Michigan. Beliau juga juara dunia gusti lengan dan berjaya dalam pelbagai sukan lain. Sikap positif Joby bermula sejak kecil, apabila dia diketepikan dari sukan sekolah, lalu menumpukan usaha kepada kekuatan badan bahagian atas dan akhirnya berjaya dalam gusti lengan. Walaupun pernah gagal, ketabahan dan kecekalan memberinya kemenangan. Setiap hari, Joby melatih diri selama sejam di gim dan berenang di sungai berdekatan. Beliau pernah melalui pelbagai dugaan, tetapi sentiasa bersemangat kental. Joby berkahwin dengan Megha, seorang penari klasik, dan bersama anak lelaki mereka, Jyothis, mereka adalah keluarga yang kuat menyokong satu sama lain. Megha mengakui semangat Joby sangat luar biasa, 'Kekurangannya langsung tidak mengganggu saya. Semangat gigihnya benar-benar memberi inspirasi, walaupun kadang-kadang buat saya risau.' Katanya, Joby pernah mengharungi perjalanan jauh secara tiba-tiba demi menyertai pertandingan. Selepas lebih enam belas gelaran sukan tempatan dan antarabangsa, Joby kini mengejar impian baru. Menawan puncak Everest bakal menjadi pencapaian terbaiknya.

article_content: A woman is in critical condition after being attacked by a dog at a property in south-east London. Emergency services, including the Metropolitan Police, ambulance, and air ambulance, were called to Bedwell Road in Belvedere at around 09:00 GMT following reports of the attack. The woman was taken to hospital, along with a man who suffered minor injuries. Police stated that the dog, an Alapaha Blue Blood Bulldog, was injured during the incident and was secured in a separate room after officers used a Taser. The dog has since died. A spokesperson for the London Ambulance Service said both individuals were transported to a major trauma centre as a priority.

Wanita itu telah dibawa ke hospital bersama seorang lelaki yang hanya mengalami kecederaan ringan. Polis menyatakan bahawa anjing yang terlibat, iaitu Alapaha Blue Blood Bulldog, cedera semasa kejadian dan telah dikurung di dalam bilik berasingan selepas pegawai menggunakan Taser. Anjing itu kini telah mati. Seorang jurucakap Perkhidmatan Ambulans London berkata kedua-dua mangsa telah dibawa ke pusat trauma utama sebagai keutamaan.

article_content:
Global assets invested in spot bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have reached $4.16 billion, according to CoinGecko, a cryptocurrency data and analysis provider. Nearly half of this investment—about $2 billion—is concentrated in the seven spot bitcoin ETFs introduced in Canada since 2021, including the Purpose Bitcoin ETF, which is the largest of these products with $819.1 million in assets.

To date, US regulators have approved only bitcoin ETFs based on futures contracts, such as the ProShares Bitcoin Strategy ETF, which holds approximately $1.2 billion in assets. The United States Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is currently reviewing up to ten applications to launch spot bitcoin ETFs, but approvals have not been granted due to concerns regarding investor protection and market manipulation.

Supporters of spot-based ETFs claim that they are a more accurate and cost-effective way to track bitcoin’s performance than futures-based products. CoinGecko highlights that other regions have taken the lead: Germany’s ETC Group Physical Bitcoin ETF was launched in June 2020 and is now the world’s second-largest spot bitcoin ETF with $802 million in assets. Additional European spot bitcoin ETFs are based in jurisdictions such as Jersey, the Cayman Islands, and Liechtenstein, while smaller products exist in Brazil and Australia.

Discussions are ongoing about the potential demand for US-based spot bitcoin ETFs, with some estimates predicting first-day inflows of $1 billion or more if approved. According to CoinGecko, it is uncertain whether American spot bitcoin ETFs will attract greater investor participation and surpass the existing Canadian and German funds.

Aset global yang dilaburkan dalam dana dagangan bursa (ETF) spot bitcoin kini berjumlah $4.16 bilion, menurut CoinGecko, penyedia data dan analisis kriptowang. Hampir separuh daripada jumlah pelaburan ini—sekitar $2 bilion—terkumpul dalam tujuh ETF spot bitcoin yang diperkenalkan di Kanada sejak 2021, termasuk Purpose Bitcoin ETF, iaitu produk terbesar dengan aset sebanyak $819.1 juta.

Setakat ini, pihak berkuasa AS hanya meluluskan ETF bitcoin yang berpandukan kontrak niaga hadapan, seperti ProShares Bitcoin Strategy ETF yang memegang sekitar $1.2 bilion dalam aset. Suruhanjaya Sekuriti dan Bursa Amerika Syarikat (SEC) kini sedang meneliti sehingga sepuluh permohonan untuk melancarkan ETF spot bitcoin, tetapi tiada kelulusan diberikan setakat ini kerana kebimbangan berkaitan perlindungan pelabur serta manipulasi pasaran.

Penyokong ETF berasaskan spot mendakwa bahawa ia adalah cara yang lebih tepat dan kos efektif untuk menjejak prestasi bitcoin berbanding produk niaga hadapan. CoinGecko turut mengetengahkan bahawa rantau lain telah ke hadapan: ETF ETC Group Physical Bitcoin di Jerman dilancarkan pada Jun 2020 dan kini menjadi ETF spot bitcoin kedua terbesar di dunia dengan aset $802 juta. ETF spot bitcoin Eropah lain berpangkalan di kawasan seperti Jersey, Kepulauan Cayman, dan Liechtenstein, sementara produk lebih kecil wujud di Brazil dan Australia.

Perbincangan masih berlangsung tentang potensi permintaan untuk ETF spot bitcoin di AS, dengan beberapa unjuran memasuki aliran dana melebihi $1 bilion pada hari pertama sekiranya mendapat kelulusan. Menurut CoinGecko, masih belum pasti sama ada ETF spot bitcoin AS akan menarik lebih banyak minat pelabur dan mengatasi dana dari Kanada dan Jerman.

At a London event, billionaire Elon Musk commended China’s involvement in talks about artificial intelligence (AI) safety, highlighting the crucial need for collaboration between China, the UK, and the US in overseeing AI advancements. Musk strongly supported China’s presence at the first UK AI Safety Summit at Bletchley Park, which gathered world leaders and tech industry representatives to address AI’s rapid progress and related risks.

Appearing beside UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak at Lancaster House, Musk said that alignment between the US, UK, and China on AI safety would set the standard globally. He emphasized that China’s participation was not just helpful but essential, implying that their absence would undermine the summit’s impact.

The summit concluded with an interview where Sunak, a self-proclaimed technology enthusiast, showcased Britain’s favorable conditions for tech startups, including supportive tax policies. Musk and Sunak both agreed on the need for strong safety mechanisms like physical off-switches for advanced AI to keep robots in check, drawing parallels to scenarios in movies such as 'The Terminator.'

Musk remarked that AI could become the most disruptive force in history, possibly making traditional jobs obsolete. He raised thought-provoking questions about how people might search for meaning in life if AI can fulfill every wish, seeing this as both an exciting and challenging future.

Dalam satu acara di London, bilionair Elon Musk memuji penglibatan China dalam perbincangan mengenai keselamatan kecerdasan buatan (AI), menekankan betapa pentingnya kerjasama antara China, UK, dan AS dalam memantau kemajuan AI. Musk sangat menyokong kehadiran China di Sidang Kemuncak Keselamatan AI UK yang pertama di Bletchley Park, yang menghimpunkan pemimpin dunia dan wakil industri teknologi untuk membincangkan perkembangan pesat AI serta risiko yang terlibat.

Bersama Perdana Menteri UK, Rishi Sunak di Lancaster House, Musk berkata bahawa keserasian antara AS, UK, dan China dalam keselamatan AI akan menjadi penanda aras global. Beliau menegaskan penyertaan China amat penting, dan ketiadaan mereka akan menjejaskan impak sidang kemuncak.

Sidang kemuncak tersebut diakhiri dengan sesi temubual di mana Sunak, yang menyatakan dirinya peminat teknologi, mengetengahkan suasana mesra UK terhadap permulaan syarikat teknologi termasuk dasar cukai yang menggalakkan. Musk dan Sunak bersetuju tentang keperluan mekanisme keselamatan kukuh seperti suis tutup fizikal bagi AI canggih untuk mengawal robot, merujuk kepada filem seperti 'The Terminator.'

Musk menyatakan bahawa AI boleh menjadi kuasa paling mengubah dalam sejarah, mungkin menyebabkan pekerjaan tradisional pupus. Beliau membangkitkan persoalan bagaimana manusia mencari makna dalam hidup jika AI mampu memenuhi semua keperluan — sebuah masa depan yang menarik dan mencabar.

article_content: Salman Khan and Katrina Kaif’s latest film 'Tiger 3' began its box-office run impressively, earning Rs 44 crore on its opening day. However, the movie saw a sharp decline in earnings from the third day onwards. On November 17, 'Tiger 3' collected only Rs 13 crore, which was lower compared to the previous daily earnings of Rs 18 crore and Rs 21 crore. According to the box office tracking portal Sacnilk.com, the film’s total collection in its first week was about Rs 200 crore. Trade analyst Sumit Kadel shared daily box-office figures for the movie, describing its performance as 'below-par.' He noted that all eyes are now on whether the film’s earnings improve over the weekend. Some experts have suggested that the India vs New Zealand cricket World Cup semi-final may have diverted attention from the movie, affecting its performance. 'Tiger 3', directed by Maneesh Sharma, is the third installment in the popular Tiger franchise and marks the on-screen reunion of Salman Khan and Katrina Kaif. Emraan Hashmi stars as Aatish Rehman, an ex-ISI agent turned antagonist. The ensemble cast also includes Revathi, Riddhi Dogra, Ranvir Shorey, Vishal Jethwa, Kumud Mishra, and others.

Namun, pendapatan filem ini merosot dengan ketara mulai hari ketiga. Pada 17 November, 'Tiger 3' hanya berjaya mengutip Rs 13 crore, lebih rendah berbanding kutipan harian sebelumnya sebanyak Rs 18 crore dan Rs 21 crore. Menurut portal penjejak kutipan pawagam Sacnilk.com, jumlah kutipan filem ini dalam minggu pertama ialah sekitar Rs 200 crore. Penganalisis perdagangan, Sumit Kadel, turut berkongsi angka kutipan harian filem ini dan menyifatkan prestasinya sebagai 'biasa-biasa.' Beliau berkata, semua pihak kini menanti sama ada kutipan filem ini akan meningkat pada hujung minggu. Beberapa pakar berpendapat bahawa perlawanan separuh akhir Piala Dunia kriket antara India dan New Zealand mungkin telah mengalihkan tumpuan penonton daripada filem ini. 'Tiger 3', arahan Maneesh Sharma, merupakan filem ketiga dalam francais Tiger yang popular dan menyatukan semula Salman Khan dan Katrina Kaif di layar perak. Barisan pelakon turut merangkumi Revathi, Riddhi Dogra, Ranvir Shorey, Vishal Jethwa, Kumud Mishra dan lain-lain.

article_content: Ethiopian long-distance runner Haile Gebrselassie is preparing to compete in the 10,000 meters at the 2008 Beijing Olympics, but the event is no longer his primary focus. Gebrselassie, who won Olympic gold in 1996 and 2000, finished fifth in 2004 after an Achilles tendon injury disrupted his training. Now injury-free and training regularly in Addis Ababa, Gebrselassie acknowledges that the 10,000 meters is not his top priority, noting that younger athletes like Kenenisa Bekele and Sileshi Sihine are leading the field. He decided not to run the Olympic marathon in Beijing due to asthma concerns and air quality risks, clarifying this was not a protest against China or the organizers. Running the 10,000 meters serves as a compromise, allowing him to support his team and fulfill fans' expectations. Jos Hermens, Gebrselassie’s manager, states that while Haile has his own ambitions, he is supportive of his teammates hoping for their success. Gebrselassie is comfortable with not taking gold and would be satisfied with a bronze or simply being part of the team. His main objective in 2008 is the Berlin Marathon on September 28th, aiming to break his own marathon world record of 2:04:26 set in November 2007. In January's Dubai Marathon, he narrowly missed improving his record by 27 seconds, attributing it to pacing errors. Training for both the 10,000 meters and marathon demands a careful balance of speed and endurance, a novel challenge for Gebrselassie and his coach. At age 35, Gebrselassie continues to innovate his training approach, merging endurance and speed work. He recognizes Kenenisa Bekele, who broke his 10,000-meter world record in 2004 and 2005, as the new standard-bearer in the event and believes an Ethiopian will win in Beijing.
translated_content: Pelari jarak jauh Ethiopia, Haile Gebrselassie, sedang bersiap untuk bertanding dalam acara 10,000 meter di Sukan Olimpik Beijing 2008, namun acara itu bukan lagi tumpuan utamanya. Gebrselassie, yang memenangi pingat emas Olimpik pada tahun 1996 dan 2000, menduduki tempat kelima pada tahun 2004 selepas kecederaan tendon Achilles menjejaskan latihannya. Kini bebas kecederaan dan menjalani latihan secara tetap di Addis Ababa, Gebrselassie mengakui acara 10,000 meter bukan lagi keutamaannya, sambil menyatakan atlet muda seperti Kenenisa Bekele dan Sileshi Sihine kini mendominasi acara itu. Dia memutuskan untuk tidak menyertai maraton Olimpik di Beijing kerana bimbang tentang asmanya dan risiko kualiti udara, dan menegaskan keputusan itu bukan bantahan terhadap China atau penganjur. Berlari dalam acara 10,000 meter merupakan satu kompromi, membolehkannya menyokong pasukan dan memenuhi harapan peminat. Jos Hermens, pengurus Gebrselassie, menyatakan walaupun Haile ada cita-cita sendiri, dia menyokong kejayaan rakan sepasukannya. Gebrselassie berpuas hati jika tidak menang emas dan akan gembira dengan pingat gangsa atau sekadar menjadi sebahagian daripada pasukan. Matlamat utamanya pada tahun 2008 ialah Maraton Berlin pada 28 September, dengan harapan memecahkan rekod dunia maraton miliknya sendiri 2:04:26 yang dicatat pada November 2007. Dalam Maraton Dubai pada Januari, dia hampir memecahkan rekod itu tetapi terlepas 27 saat, yang dikatakan berpunca daripada kesilapan mengatur rentak. Latihan untuk kedua-dua acara 10,000 meter dan maraton memerlukan keseimbangan ketangkasan dan ketahanan, cabaran baru untuk Gebrselassie dan jurulatihnya. Pada usia 35 tahun, Gebrselassie terus berinovasi dengan menggabungkan latihan ketahanan dan kepantasan. Dia mengiktiraf Kenenisa Bekele, yang memecahkan rekod dunia 10,000 meter miliknya pada tahun 2004 dan 2005, sebagai peneraju baru acara itu dan yakin seorang atlet Ethiopia akan menang di Beijing.

article_content: David Askew, a 64-year-old man with learning difficulties, died after decades of harassment and bullying by local youths in Hattersley, Greater Manchester. After years of abuse, including physical intimidation, vandalism, and frequent mockery, Mr Askew suffered a fatal heart attack following a confrontation with youths outside his home. Coroner John Pollard ruled that Mr Askew was unlawfully killed, highlighting the failures of local authorities and police to provide effective protection despite numerous complaints. During a two-month period, Mr Askew and his mother repeatedly contacted Tameside Council and the police, but the harassment persisted. No one was prosecuted for Mr Askew's death, but Kial Cottingham, a local youth, was convicted of harassment and sentenced to 16 months in a young offenders institution. The coroner criticized council officials for their lack of action, describing the response as showing 'staggering inertia and complacency.' An Independent Police Complaints Commission report revealed systemic failings by the police, including a failure to link the family's calls or to treat the abuse as a hate crime. CCTV cameras installed were found ineffective because of poor image quality. After the inquest, David’s mother Rose, now 90, said she remains angry about what happened but mentioned the family now feels welcome in the community. Authorities say they have made improvements in how such crimes are handled and acknowledged the need for agencies to work more closely to protect vulnerable individuals.
translated_content: David Askew, seorang lelaki berusia 64 tahun yang mempunyai masalah pembelajaran, meninggal dunia selepas berdekad-dekad diganggu dan dibuli oleh remaja di kawasan Hattersley, Greater Manchester. Selepas bertahun-tahun penderaan seperti ancaman fizikal, vandalisme, dan ejekan yang berterusan, Encik Askew mengalami serangan jantung yang membawa maut selepas berdepan dengan remaja di luar rumahnya. Koroner John Pollard memutuskan bahawa Encik Askew dibunuh secara tidak sah, menekankan kegagalan pihak berkuasa tempatan dan polis untuk memberikan perlindungan walaupun banyak aduan telah dibuat. Dalam tempoh dua bulan, Encik Askew dan ibunya kerap menghubungi Majlis Tameside dan polis, namun gangguan itu terus berlaku. Tiada siapa yang didakwa atas kematian Encik Askew, tetapi Kial Cottingham, seorang remaja tempatan, disabitkan dengan kesalahan gangguan dan dihukum penjara selama 16 bulan di institusi remaja. Koroner turut mengkritik pegawai majlis kerana tidak bertindak, menyifatkan respons mereka sebagai 'inertia dan sikap sambil lewa yang mengejutkan'. Laporan Suruhanjaya Aduan Bebas Polis mendedahkan kegagalan sistemik polis, termasuk gagal menghubungkan panggilan keluarga dan tidak menganggap penderaan itu sebagai jenayah kebencian. Kamera litar tertutup juga didapati tidak berkesan kerana kualiti imej yang rendah. Selepas inkues, ibu David, Rose, kini berusia 90 tahun, berkata dia masih marah dengan apa yang berlaku tetapi keluarga mereka kini rasa diterima dalam komuniti. Pihak berkuasa berkata mereka telah menambah baik cara kes seperti ini diuruskan dan mengakui keperluan kerjasama lebih erat antara agensi untuk melindungi golongan rentan.
