article_content: In 1965, William F. Buckley, Jr., then 40, entered the New York City mayoral race more as a platform for his ideas than with the expectation of winning. When asked how he’d respond to a victory, he famously said he would demand a recount. With a decade of the National Review behind him and having helped Barry Goldwater’s conservative campaign, Buckley considered the mayoral contest an opportunity to raise the profile of conservatism. Despite earning only 13.4% of the vote, he succeeded in his aims and, some believe, helped John V. Lindsay become New York’s first Republican mayor since Fiorello LaGuardia. Anthony Weiner’s later mayoral campaign drew similar speculation, with some suggesting it was more about advancing other agendas than securing a win. For example, Elspeth Reeve in The Atlantic theorized that Weiner’s run was a strategic move to protect his wife, Huma Abedin—either to support her future in politics or to defend Hillary Clinton’s 2016 presidential hopes. The idea was that had Abedin emerged first after Weiner’s resignation, she would have borne the brunt of his scandal’s fallout. This scenario, some argued, could have also distracted Clinton’s campaign. Yet, in practice, Abedin’s reputation suffered through Weiner’s campaign. Events like the awkward 'Women for Weiner' gatherings and magazine articles portraying their troubles as resolved proved misleading, especially since Weiner’s problematic online behavior persisted after his resignation. Beyond scandal, observers struggled to understand why a highly accomplished woman like Abedin would support someone whose campaign appeared so chaotic, combative, and ineffective. Weiner was known for arguing with voters, calling a senior opponent ‘grandpa’ at an AARP event, and making obscene gestures to reporters. If the goal was to assist Abedin, the strategy apparently did not work. Others thought Weiner aimed to revive his own prospects, perhaps in television, following a path familiar to former politicians. However, his negative campaign outcomes likely hindered such aspirations, as cable media frequently platform people without any history of electoral defeat. Some believed Weiner sought retribution against the media and political establishment for his downfall, hoping a strong primary showing would show he was wronged. But placing nearly last with just 5% of the Democratic vote made this narrative unlikely. In summary, while Buckley strengthened his movement, Weiner’s campaign damaged himself, his wife, and those around them. His effort produced more public embarrassment than meaningful political debate, with the tabloid press the only real winners. Perhaps Weiner truly believed he could win. But in politics, serious miscalculations often occur when power is at stake. If he values his party, his family, or his reputation, it may be wise for him to withdraw from political life for the foreseeable future. These opinions belong to S.E. Cupp.

Apabila ditanya apa yang akan dilakukan jika menang, dia terkenal menjawab secara bergurau bahawa dia akan meminta pengiraan semula undi. Selepas sepuluh tahun menubuhkan National Review dan membantu kempen konservatif Barry Goldwater, Buckley melihat peluang dalam pilihan raya datuk bandar ini untuk mengangkat nama konservatisme. Walaupun hanya memperoleh 13.4% undi, beliau berjaya mencapai matlamat utamanya. Malah, ada yang berpendapat pencalonannya membantu John V. Lindsay menjadi Datuk Bandar Republikan pertama New York sejak Fiorello LaGuardia. Kempen Datuk Bandar Anthony Weiner kemudian turut menimbulkan spekulasi serupa, apabila ada pihak menganggapnya bukan bertujuan memenangi jawatan, tetapi lebih kepada agenda peribadi. Sebagai contoh, Elspeth Reeve dalam The Atlantic berteori bahawa kempen Weiner ialah strategi untuk melindungi isterinya, Huma Abedin—sama ada demi kerjaya politik masa depan atau bagi membantu kempen Hillary Clinton pada 2016. Teori itu mengatakan, jika Abedin yang kembali ke arena politik dahulu selepas peletakan jawatan Weiner, dia yang akan menanggung kesan negatif skandal suaminya. Malah, isu ini juga boleh mengganggu kempen Clinton. Namun, realitinya, reputasi Abedin tetap terjejas disebabkan kempen suaminya. Acara seperti 'Women for Weiner' yang janggal dan artikel majalah yang menggambarkan masalah mereka sudah selesai ternyata mengelirukan, memandangkan tingkah laku Weiner secara dalam talian masih berterusan selepas meletak jawatan. Selain skandal, ramai yang sukar memahami mengapa wanita seberjaya Abedin ingin menyokong seseorang yang kempen politiknya dianggap bercelaru, agresif dan tidak efektif. Weiner dikenali kerana bertengkar dengan pengundi, memanggil lawan yang lebih tua ‘atok’ di program AARP, serta menunjukkan isyarat lucah kepada wartawan. Jika matlamatnya adalah membantu Abedin, strategi ini jelas tidak berjaya. Ada juga teori bahawa Weiner mahukan peluang baharu untuk dirinya sendiri, mungkin dalam dunia televisyen seperti sesetengah bekas ahli politik lain. Walau bagaimanapun, publisiti negatif sepanjang kempen besar kemungkinan telah menjejaskan peluangnya, sedangkan ramai tokoh media tidak pernah bertanding dalam pilihan raya. Ada juga pendapat mengatakan Weiner mahu membalas dendam terhadap media dan pihak politik yang memusnahkan kerjayanya dengan harapan pencapaian yang baik dalam pemilihan akan membuktikan bahawa dia dianiaya. Namun, selepas hampir tercorot dengan hanya 5% undi Demokrat, naratif sebegini sukar dipertahankan. Sebagai kesimpulan, sementara Buckley berjaya mengukuhkan gerakan politiknya, kempen Weiner sebaliknya menyebabkan kerosakan kepada dirinya, isterinya dan rakan seangkatannya. Usahanya membawa lebih banyak aib dan sensasi daripada perdebatan politik yang sihat, dan tabloid merupakan pihak yang paling diuntungkan daripada drama ini. Mungkin Weiner benar-benar percaya dia boleh menang. Namun dalam politik, salah kira seperti ini sering berlaku bila kuasa menjadi taruhan. Jika dia menghargai partinya, keluarganya atau reputasinya, lebih baik Weiner berundur daripada dunia politik untuk masa yang panjang. Pandangan ini merupakan pendapat S.E. Cupp.

article_content: Residents of Delhi woke up to smoky skies after Diwali, as air quality sharply declined. Despite a ban on fireworks due to high pollution, many in the city still set off firecrackers late into Sunday night. Delhi has faced toxic air for weeks, with authorities ordering an early winter break for schools to protect children. While pollution is a year-round problem driven by vehicle emissions and dust, things worsen in winter due to farmers in neighboring states burning crop stubble. Low wind speeds trap pollutants like those from firecrackers close to the ground, making breathing difficult. On Monday afternoon, the Indian federal government’s Safar app reported Delhi’s Air Quality Index (AQI) at 445, with some areas recording levels above 520. The AQI measures harmful PM 2.5 particles, which can damage the lungs and cause various diseases. An AQI over 400 is considered ‘severe’; the World Health Organization recommends PM 2.5 exposure not exceed 15 micrograms per cubic meter over 24 hours, but Delhi’s levels are up to 30 times higher in some locations. Lung specialists liken breathing Delhi’s air to smoking 25-30 cigarettes a day. Prolonged exposure can cause discomfort, breathing difficulties, and increase the risk of skin, eye, neurological, cardiovascular, and respiratory illnesses, including asthma, bronchitis, emphysema, cancer, and higher mortality rates. The Supreme Court of India has banned most firecrackers during Diwali, allowing only ‘green crackers’ with reduced emissions. Delhi’s government has banned firecrackers in recent years, but the rules are rarely enforced. The ban has become politically charged, with some claiming it unfairly targets Hindu festivals. On Monday, Delhi’s environment minister, Gopal Rai (AAP), accused leaders from the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of encouraging people to set off firecrackers, increasing pollution. Rai said that while not everyone burnt firecrackers, some did so deliberately in certain areas. Virendra Sachdeva, BJP’s Delhi president, responded by saying it is unfair to blame festival-goers and instead criticized AAP for lacking a solid pollution management plan. The spike in pollution came after rains on Friday had temporarily improved air quality over the weekend.
translated_content: Penduduk Delhi bangun dengan langit berasap selepas Diwali apabila kualiti udara merosot teruk. Walaupun bunga api telah dilarang kerana pencemaran tinggi, ramai masih membakarnya hingga lewat malam Ahad. Delhi telah menghadapi udara beracun selama berminggu-minggu, menyebabkan pihak berkuasa mengumumkan cuti musim sejuk awal untuk sekolah demi melindungi kanak-kanak. Masalah pencemaran berlaku sepanjang tahun kerana pelepasan kenderaan dan habuk, tetapi keadaan makin parah pada musim sejuk apabila petani di negeri jiran membakar sisa tanaman. Kelajuan angin rendah menyebabkan pencemar seperti asap mercun terperangkap berhampiran permukaan tanah, menyukarkan pernafasan. Pada petang Isnin, aplikasi Safar kerajaan persekutuan India melaporkan Indeks Kualiti Udara (AQI) Delhi pada 445, dengan beberapa kawasan melebihi 520. AQI mengukur PM 2.5, zarah halus yang merosakkan paru-paru serta menyebabkan pelbagai penyakit. Bacaan AQI melebihi 400 dikategorikan sebagai ‘teruk’. WHO mengesyorkan pendedahan PM 2.5 tidak melebihi 15 mikrogram per meter padu sehari, namun tahap di Delhi boleh 30 kali ganda lebih tinggi. Pakar paru-paru mengaitkan menghirup udara Delhi seperti merokok 25-30 batang rokok sehari. Pendedahan berterusan boleh menyebabkan ketidakselesaan, sukar bernafas, meningkatkan risiko kerengsaan kulit, mata, penyakit neurologi, jantung dan pernafasan seperti asma, bronkitis, emfisema, kanser serta kadar kematian yang lebih tinggi. Mahkamah Agung India telah melarang kebanyakan bunga api pada Diwali, hanya membenarkan 'green crackers' yang kurang pencemaran. Kerajaan Delhi juga melarang bunga api pada tahun-tahun kebelakangan ini tetapi penguatkuasaan lemah. Larangan tersebut turut mencetuskan perselisihan politik, dengan sesetengah pihak mendakwa ia menyasarkan perayaan Hindu. Pada Isnin, Menteri Alam Sekitar Delhi, Gopal Rai (AAP), menuduh pemimpin BJP menggalakkan orang ramai menyalakan bunga api hingga meningkatkan pencemaran. Rai berkata tidak semua menggunakan bunga api, tetapi ada yang melakukannya secara khusus di kawasan tertentu. Presiden BJP Delhi, Virendra Sachdeva, membalas bahawa tidak adil menyalahkan mereka yang meraikan perayaan, malah menuduh AAP kurang pelan pengurusan pencemaran. Peningkatan pencemaran ini berlaku selepas hujan pada pagi Jumaat sebelumnya yang sempat memperbaiki kualiti udara pada hujung minggu.

article_content: Katherine Jackson and Michael Jackson's three children will immerse themselves in the late pop star's world this Sunday by attending Cirque du Soleil’s premiere of “Michael Jackson: The Immortal World Tour” in Montreal, Canada. Recently, Katherine came to an agreement with the estate executors and Cirque du Soleil to attend the opening event, a move which reportedly marks a thaw in the relationship that has been strained since Michael Jackson’s passing in 2009. Katherine had initially contested the legitimacy of John Branca and John McClain as executors named in Michael’s will but eventually dropped her challenge several months later. Since then, the family and the estate have experienced tension, though this collaborative gesture suggests improved relations. The trip for Katherine and Jackson’s children—Prince, Paris, and Blanket—will also include their presence at the Michael Forever Tribute concert in Cardiff, Wales, after which they plan to return to Los Angeles on October 9. Their absence, along with other siblings headed to Wales, means most of the Jackson family’s seats in court at Dr. Conrad Murray’s trial will likely remain empty for the next week. Although the children never saw Michael perform live, Cirque du Soleil’s production is designed to capture his spirit and influence. The show is set to tour at least 47 cities in the United States and Canada throughout the next year. Discussions about creating a Michael Jackson-themed show began between Cirque du Soleil and Jackson seven years ago, and the partnership with the estate was publicly announced in April 2010. Both Cirque and the estate are equal partners in this venture. Additionally, the MGM Mirage in Las Vegas will become the host for the residency beginning in 2012, and a new nightclub inspired by the Jackson-themed show is also set to open at the hotel.

Baru-baru ini, Katherine telah mencapai persetujuan dengan pentadbir harta pusaka serta Cirque du Soleil untuk menghadiri acara pembukaan tersebut, menandakan hubungan mereka yang sebelum ini tegang sejak kematian Michael Jackson pada 2009 kini semakin pulih. Sejak itu, keluarga dan pihak harta pusaka telah mengalami ketegangan, namun langkah kerjasama ini mencerminkan hubungan yang semakin baik. Perjalanan Katherine bersama anak-anak Jackson—Prince, Paris dan Blanket—juga akan menyaksikan mereka menghadiri konsert Michael Forever Tribute di Cardiff, Wales, sebelum pulang ke Los Angeles pada 9 Oktober. Ketiadaan mereka, bersama beberapa adik-beradik lain yang turut ke Wales, bermakna kebanyakan tempat duduk keluarga Jackson di mahkamah untuk perbicaraan Dr. Conrad Murray kemungkinan besar akan kosong sepanjang minggu depan. Walaupun anak-anak itu tidak pernah menyaksikan Michael membuat persembahan secara langsung, produksi Cirque du Soleil ini direka untuk menghidupkan semangat dan pengaruh beliau. Pementasan itu akan menjelajah sekurang-kurangnya 47 bandar di Amerika Syarikat dan Kanada sepanjang tahun hadapan. Perbincangan tentang pementasan bertemakan Michael Jackson antara Cirque du Soleil dan Jackson bermula tujuh tahun lalu, dan kerjasama antara Cirque dan pihak harta pusaka diumumkan secara rasmi pada April 2010. article_content: A makeshift settlement occupied by around 50 Eastern European migrants is set to be cleared following a High Court order. The cluster of shacks and tents, built on woodland in Lee Valley Park, North London, has been home for about a year to migrants from Romania, Poland, and Bulgaria. High Court officials granted Transport for London (TfL) immediate possession of the site, where the migrants have been living. Located near a busy roundabout in Edmonton by a canal, the area consists of roughly 15 huts constructed from discarded materials. Residents, including squatter Marcel Ion, live without legal permission. TfL’s solicitor, David Linklater, argued in court that the landowners’ rights outweigh any potential human rights claims by the squatters, who are regarded as illegal trespassers. Fire officials expressed concern about fire hazards; the camp uses gas canisters for heating and cooking, increasing explosion risks. According to TfL, the site is in poor condition, with makeshift structures and sanitation issues. Most of the migrants work as informal laborers such as painters and builders, and none attended the High Court hearing to contest the order. Earlier in the week, Marian Dumitrache—age 30 and originally from Buzau, Romania—guided reporters around the site. He works as a house painter, sending earnings home to his family. Dumitrache described the difficulties of living in the camp: cold nights, a lack of utilities, and makeshift cooking and washing arrangements, including using the canal for water. He emphasized that despite the harsh conditions, the residents are not relying on state support and are working to support families back home. TfL plans to first ask the occupants to vacate the site voluntarily; if not, the area will likely be cleared by next week.
translated_content: Satu penempatan sementara yang didiami kira-kira 50 pendatang Eropah Timur akan dikosongkan selepas perintah Mahkamah Tinggi. Kumpulan pondok dan khemah yang dibina di kawasan hutan di Taman Lee Valley, London Utara, telah menjadi tempat tinggal selama kira-kira setahun bagi pendatang dari Romania, Poland dan Bulgaria. Pegawai Mahkamah Tinggi telah memberikan Transport for London (TfL) pemilikan segera tapak di mana para pendatang itu tinggal. Terletak berhampiran bulatan sibuk di Edmonton di tepi terusan, kawasan tersebut terdiri daripada kira-kira 15 pondok yang dibina daripada bahan buangan. Penduduk, termasuk penghuni tanpa kebenaran, Marcel Ion, tinggal di situ tanpa izin sah. Peguam TfL, David Linklater, berhujah di mahkamah bahawa hak pemilik tanah mengatasi sebarang tuntutan hak asasi manusia oleh penghuni, yang dianggap sebagai penceroboh haram. Pihak bomba melahirkan kebimbangan mengenai risiko kebakaran; kem tersebut menggunakan silinder gas untuk pemanasan dan memasak, meningkatkan risiko letupan. Menurut TfL, tapak tersebut berada dalam keadaan kurang memuaskan, dengan struktur sementara dan isu sanitasi. Kebanyakan pendatang bekerja secara tidak formal seperti pelukis dan pembina, dan tiada yang hadir ke pendengaran Mahkamah Tinggi untuk membantah perintah itu. Awal minggu ini, Marian Dumitrache—berumur 30 tahun dan berasal dari Buzau, Romania—membawa wartawan melawat kawasan tersebut. Beliau bekerja sebagai pelukis rumah dan menghantar wang kepada keluarganya di kampung. Dumitrache menceritakan kesukaran hidup di kem itu: malam yang sejuk, ketiadaan kemudahan asas, serta cara memasak dan mencuci secara sementara termasuk menggunakan air terusan. Beliau menekankan bahawa walaupun keadaan sukar, penduduk tidak bergantung kepada bantuan kerajaan dan bekerja untuk menyara keluarga di tanah air. TfL bercadang untuk meminta penghuni berpindah secara sukarela terlebih dahulu; jika tidak, kawasan itu dijangka akan dikosongkan minggu depan.

article_content:
Julie Bishop holds one of Australia’s top government posts as Foreign Minister and is also Deputy Leader of the Liberal Party. Though her position includes meeting global leaders and traveling abroad, Bishop says the role is far less glamorous than it appears. In a recent interview, she revealed that her approach to staying healthy is simply keeping fit, rather than worrying about her physical appearance.

Bishop has faced significant public scrutiny and protests in recent months, particularly over government policies like education funding cuts. In June, after Bishop spoke at the C20 Summit in Melbourne on issues such as job losses and university fees, a protester confronted her vehicle. She was also targeted by demonstrators at Sydney University and in her Perth office, where about 200 students rallied before police intervened.

Bishop’s work often involves meeting high-profile figures including US President Barack Obama and former UN Secretary-General Ban Ki Moon. Additionally, she visited Myanmar in 2014 to meet Speaker Shwe Mann. Through these experiences, Bishop underscores that her demanding responsibilities leave little time to focus on her appearance.
translated_content:
Julie Bishop memegang salah satu jawatan tertinggi dalam kerajaan Australia sebagai Menteri Luar Negeri, selain menjadi Timbalan Ketua Parti Liberal. Walaupun kerja beliau melibatkan pertemuan dengan pemimpin dunia dan kerap ke luar negara, Bishop mengakui peranan itu tidak seindah yang disangka. Dalam temu bual baru-baru ini, beliau menyebut menjaga kesihatan bagi dirinya hanyalah dengan kekal cergas, bukan terlalu ambil peduli tentang rupa paras.

Beberapa bulan kebelakangan ini, Bishop berdepan kritikan dan protes awam, khususnya berkaitan dasar kerajaan seperti pemotongan dana pendidikan. Pada Jun, selepas beliau berucap di Sidang Kemuncak C20 di Melbourne mengenai isu kehilangan pekerjaan dan yuran universiti, kenderaannya didekati penunjuk perasaan. Beliau turut dihadapkan dengan demonstrasi di Universiti Sydney, serta protes oleh sekitar 200 pelajar di pejabatnya di Perth sebelum polis campur tangan.

Tugas Bishop merangkumi pertemuan dengan tokoh terkenal seperti Presiden Amerika Syarikat Barack Obama dan bekas Setiausaha Agung PBB Ban Ki Moon. Beliau juga pernah ke Myanmar pada 2014 untuk bertemu Speaker Shwe Mann. Dengan segala pengalaman ini, Bishop menegaskan bahawa tanggungjawab berat membuatkan beliau kurang memberi tumpuan kepada soal penampilan.

article_content: WASHINGTON (CNN) -- President Obama hosted a White House reception on Monday to celebrate Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual and Transgender (LGBT) Pride Month, amid criticism that he has not fulfilled some campaign promises to the community. Earlier this month, President Obama signed legislation extending certain benefits to same-sex partners. 'I continue to support measures to bring the full spectrum of equal rights to LGBT Americans,' Obama said in a proclamation. 'These measures include enhancing hate crime laws, supporting civil unions and federal rights for LGBT couples, outlawing workplace discrimination, ensuring adoption rights, and ending the 'don't ask, don't tell' policy in a manner that strengthens our armed forces and national security.' However, critics argue these steps are insufficient. One memorandum signed by Obama allows same-sex partners of federal employees to be included in long-term care programs, permits employees to use sick leave to care for domestic partners, and covers children and partners of Foreign Service employees in medical evacuations and housing, according to the White House. This order does not provide full health care coverage, which would require congressional approval. 'It seems to me to be a nice gesture, but a disappointment,' said Richard Kim, senior editor at The Nation. He noted the lack of full health insurance and limited impact for most people. The Defense of Marriage Act prevents extending health and retirement benefits to same-sex partners of federal employees. Tony Perkins, president of the Family Research Council, stated that Obama’s order violates DOMA. 'This executive order uses taxpayer money to pacify a dissatisfied part of his base at the expense of the rule of law,' Perkins wrote. Charles Moran, spokesperson for the Log Cabin Republicans, said the absence of full benefits demonstrates a lack of commitment to the gay community. He cited unfulfilled promises on health, retirement, and spousal benefits, as well as the continued support for DOMA. 'Here we are, several months after he's been inaugurated, and we've gotten basically nothing. So it is too little, too late,' said Moran. Obama has reiterated his intention to repeal DOMA, as he did during his campaign. 'I believe it's discriminatory. I think it interferes with states’ rights, and we will work with Congress to overturn it,' he stated. Though Obama spoke in favor of gay and lesbian rights during the campaign, he maintains his opposition to same-sex marriage. Before his inauguration, he described himself as 'a fierce advocate for gay and lesbian Americans.' Despite strong LGBT support in the election—according to CNN exit polls, 70 percent of voters identifying as gay, lesbian, or bisexual voted for Obama—some activists feel let down so far. Obama is the second U.S. president to officially recognize Pride Month for this community, following Bill Clinton, who designated June 2000 as Gay and Lesbian Pride Month.
translated_content: WASHINGTON (CNN) -- Presiden Obama telah mengadakan majlis di White House pada hari Isnin sempena meraikan Bulan Kebanggaan Lesbian, Gay, Biseksual dan Transgender (LGBT), di tengah kritikan bahawa beliau belum memenuhi beberapa janji kempen kepada komuniti tersebut. Awal bulan ini, Presiden Obama telah menandatangani undang-undang yang memperluaskan beberapa faedah kepada pasangan sejenis. ‘Saya terus menyokong langkah-langkah ke arah hak sama rata sepenuhnya untuk warga LGBT,’ kata Obama dalam satu kenyataan. ‘Langkah-langkah ini termasuk mempertingkat undang-undang jenayah kebencian, menyokong kesatuan sivil dan hak persekutuan untuk pasangan LGBT, menghapuskan diskriminasi di tempat kerja, memastikan hak adopsi, dan menamatkan dasar ‘don't ask, don't tell’ dengan cara yang memperkukuh angkatan tentera dan keselamatan negara.’ Namun, pengkritik berkata langkah ini masih tidak mencukupi. Satu memorandum yang ditandatangani Obama membolehkan pasangan sejenis kakitangan persekutuan layak dalam program penjagaan jangka panjang, membenarkan pekerja menggunakan cuti sakit untuk menjaga pasangan, serta melindungi anak-anak dan pasangan sejenis kakitangan Perkhidmatan Luar dalam pengungsian perubatan dan peruntukan perumahan, menurut White House. Perintah ini tidak meliputi perlindungan penjagaan kesihatan sepenuhnya, yang memerlukan persetujuan Kongres. ‘Pada saya ini satu isyarat baik tetapi juga satu kekecewaan,’ kata Richard Kim, editor kanan di The Nation. Beliau menegaskan kekurangan insurans kesihatan penuh dan impak terhad bagi kebanyakan orang. Akta Pertahanan Perkahwinan menghalang faedah kesihatan dan persaraan daripada diperluaskan kepada pasangan sejenis kakitangan persekutuan. Tony Perkins, presiden Family Research Council, menyatakan arahan Obama itu melanggar akta tersebut. ‘Arahan eksekutif ini menggunakan wang pembayar cukai untuk memuaskan sebahagian penyokongnya dengan menidakkan kedaulatan undang-undang,’ tulis Perkins. Charles Moran, jurucakap Log Cabin Republicans, berkata ketiadaan faedah penuh itu menunjukkan kurangnya komitmen terhadap komuniti gay. Beliau menyebut janji yang belum dipenuhi berkaitan faedah kesihatan, persaraan dan perlindungan pasangan, serta sokongan berterusan terhadap akta terbabit. ‘Sudah beberapa bulan selepas beliau dilantik, tetapi masih tiada perubahan besar. Maka ini terlalu sedikit, terlalu lambat,’ kata Moran. Obama telah berulang kali menegaskan niatnya untuk memansuhkan akta tersebut, seperti dinyatakan dalam kempen beliau. ‘Saya percaya ia bersifat diskriminasi. Saya rasa ia mengganggu hak negeri, dan kita akan bekerjasama dengan Kongres untuk memansuhkannya,’ ujar beliau. Walaupun bercakap tentang hak golongan gay dan lesbian semasa kempen, Obama masih menolak perkahwinan sejenis. Sebelum dilantik, beliau digambarkan sebagai ‘pendukung teguh untuk warga gay dan lesbian Amerika.’ Walaupun menerima sokongan padu komuniti LGBT dalam pilihan raya — menurut tinjauan keluar CNN, 70 peratus pengundi yang mengaku sebagai gay, lesbian atau biseksual memilih Obama — beberapa aktivis berasa kecewa setakat ini. Obama ialah presiden AS kedua yang secara rasmi mengiktiraf Bulan Kebanggaan untuk komuniti ini, selepas Bill Clinton, yang menetapkan Jun 2000 sebagai Bulan Kebanggaan Gay dan Lesbian.

Lebanon is tense ahead of Hezbollah leader Syed Hassan Nasrallah’s highly anticipated Friday speech on Israel’s ongoing military campaign in Gaza. Residents and analysts are concerned his remarks could ignite a wider regional conflict if he calls for increased attacks against Israel.

Clashes along the Lebanon-Israel border have intensified in recent weeks. Hezbollah reports losing 57 fighters, while Israel says six of its soldiers and at least six civilians have been killed. In South Lebanon, many are anxious about the risk of expanded conflict, recalling heavy suffering during previous Israeli occupations, including a 15-year occupation from 1985 to 2000.

"Even some of Nasrallah's supporters feel the south has always borne the brunt of fighting Israel, and right now, we’re not ready for war," said Mohamad, a South Lebanon resident who withheld his last name for safety.

Tensions surged after Hamas’s October 7 surprise attack on Israeli targets, which killed around 1,400 people, according to Israeli officials. Israel responded with prolonged bombardment and ground operations in Gaza. The Gaza Health Ministry reports over 8,000 Palestinians killed, including more than 3,000 children. Legal experts say Israel’s blockade, restricting food, fuel, and medical supplies, amounts to a violation of international law.

While some aid shipments have entered Gaza via Egypt’s Rafah crossing, Israel continues to block fuel deliveries, severely impacting hospitals that need electricity for life-saving equipment.

Despite rising international calls for a ceasefire, Israel insists its campaign will not end until Hamas is eradicated. Analysts believe Hezbollah sees the conflict as existential and fears it may become Israel’s next target if Hamas is defeated.

Hezbollah’s credibility among many Sunni Arabs suffered after its intervention in Syria to support President Bashar al-Assad—who facilitated Iranian arms transfers to Hezbollah—especially after being accused of besieging opposition-held areas. The current crisis in Gaza is seen by some as a chance for Nasrallah to regain influence in the Arab world.

"This is Nasrallah’s moment," said Mohannad Hage Ali of the Carnegie Middle East Center. "Millions across the Arab world will be watching, as he offers a rare voice addressing anger and despair over Gaza."

Some Palestinian refugees in Lebanon and Sunni fighters are already cooperating with Hezbollah against Israel. Mohamad, the South Lebanon resident, says more Sunnis could join if the conflict widens: "Everything in Syria was forgotten when Gaza happened."

While many Lebanese fear escalation, Palestinian refugees like Ahed Bahr—a political party member from Beirut’s Sabra and Shatila camps—hope Nasrallah will endorse greater action against Israel. Bahr believes images of children killed in Gaza should spur the so-called Axis of Resistance to intensify efforts from multiple fronts. "This is the chance to free Palestine, but most Arab states are inactive," he said.

Iranian-backed groups in Syria and Iraq have launched rockets and drones at US forces, apparently in response to Washington’s support for Israel, and the US has retaliated with airstrikes. The US has warned Hezbollah against escalation, but Nasrallah has remained silent for three weeks—until now.

"A big decision may be coming from the resistance axis," Mohamad added. "That could happen Friday."

Lebanon berada dalam keadaan tegang menjelang ucapan penting pemimpin Hezbollah, Syed Hassan Nasrallah, pada hari Jumaat mengenai kempen ketenteraan Israel di Gaza. Penduduk dan penganalisis bimbang ucapan beliau boleh mencetuskan konflik serantau yang lebih meluas jika beliau menggesa serangan lebih hebat ke atas Israel.

Pertempuran di sepanjang sempadan Lebanon-Israel semakin sengit dalam beberapa minggu kebelakangan ini. Hezbollah melaporkan kehilangan 57 pejuang, manakala Israel menyatakan enam tentaranya dan sekurang-kurangnya enam orang awam terbunuh. Ramai penduduk di Selatan Lebanon bimbang risiko konflik semakin meluas, mengingat penderitaan berat semasa penjajahan Israel terdahulu, termasuk penjajahan selama 15 tahun dari 1985 hingga 2000.

"Malah ada penyokong Nasrallah yang merasakan selatan selalu menanggung beban pertempuran dengan Israel, dan ketika ini, kami belum bersedia untuk perang," kata Mohamad, seorang penduduk Selatan Lebanon yang tidak mahu mendedahkan nama penuh demi keselamatan.

Ketegangan meningkat selepas serangan mengejut Hamas terhadap sasaran Israel pada 7 Oktober, yang menyebabkan sekitar 1,400 orang terkorban, menurut pegawai Israel. Israel membalas dengan pengeboman berterusan serta operasi darat di Gaza. Kementerian Kesihatan Gaza melaporkan lebih 8,000 rakyat Palestin terbunuh, termasuk lebih 3,000 kanak-kanak. Pakar undang-undang berkata sekatan Israel yang mengehadkan makanan, bahan api serta bekalan perubatan melanggar undang-undang antarabangsa.

Walaupun beberapa penghantaran bantuan telah masuk ke Gaza melalui lintasan Rafah di Mesir, Israel masih menahan kemasukan bahan api, menjejaskan hospital yang memerlukan tenaga elektrik untuk peralatan penting.

Walaupun tekanan antarabangsa untuk gencatan senjata semakin meningkat, Israel bertegas bahawa operasi mereka tidak akan berakhir sebelum Hamas dihapuskan. Penganalisis percaya Hezbollah menganggap konflik ini sebagai isu hidup atau mati, bimbang mereka menjadi sasaran seterusnya jika Hamas ditewaskan.

Hezbollah kehilangan sokongan dalam kalangan Arab Sunni selepas campur tangan di Syria menyokong Presiden Bashar al-Assad—yang membenarkan penghantaran senjata Iran ke Hezbollah—terutama selepas didakwa mengepung kawasan pembangkang. Krisis Gaza kini dilihat sebagai peluang Nasrallah mengembalikan pengaruhnya di dunia Arab.

"Inilah saat Nasrallah," kata Mohannad Hage Ali dari Carnegie Middle East Center. "Jutaan orang di dunia Arab akan memerhati dan mendengar beliau sebagai suara unik yang mampu merangkum kemarahan dan keputusasaan tentang Gaza."

Beberapa pelarian Palestin di Lebanon dan pejuang Sunni kini bekerjasama dengan Hezbollah menentang Israel. Menurut Mohamad, lebih ramai Sunni mungkin akan menyokong jika konflik melarat: "Peristiwa di Syria dilupa bila berlaku krisis Gaza."

Walaupun ramai warga Lebanon gusar, pelarian Palestin seperti Ahed Bahr—ahli parti politik dari kem Sabra dan Shatila di Beirut—berharap Nasrallah akan membenarkan tindakan lebih agresif terhadap Israel. Bahr yakin imej kanak-kanak terbunuh di Gaza harus mendorong Paksi Penentangan untuk memperhebat serangan dari pelbagai arah. "Ini peluang untuk membebaskan Palestin, tapi kebanyakan negara Arab tidak ambil tindakan," katanya.

Kumpulan disokong Iran di Syria dan Iraq melancarkan roket dan dron terhadap tentera AS, dipercayai sebagai reaksi kepada sokongan AS terhadap Israel, lalu dibalas dengan serangan udara. AS memberi amaran kepada Hezbollah supaya tidak meningkatkan serangan, namun Nasrallah diam membisu selama tiga minggu—hingga kini.

"Mungkin keputusan besar akan diambil oleh paksi penentangan," tambah Mohamad. "Kemungkinan ia diumum Jumaat ini."

article_content: A group of amateur rocketeers from Portland, Oregon, known as Team Numb, are taking space exploration in a new direction by sending kegs of beer on rocket launches. This September, they are preparing for their most ambitious attempt yet—a two-stage rocket designed to carry beer almost 20,000 feet (about 3.8 miles or 6.1 kilometers) into the sky. Team Numb has previously completed two successful launches: their first, in 2008, sent a 15-gallon (68-liter) keg of beer to a height of 6,200 feet (1,900 meters) with their 11-foot (3.4-meter) tall, 350-pound (160-kilogram) rocket. Their second launch, in 2012, reached 7,700 feet (2,350 meters). The upcoming 2024 mission aims to more than double their previous record, with the rocket traveling at speeds up to 650 miles (1,050 kilometers) per hour. Although this falls short of the 62-mile (100-kilometer) internationally recognized border of space, Team Numb sees it as a significant achievement. The team’s rocket features two stages, each with separate fuel and cargo sections. The first stage uses four large N-Class motors delivering 1,000 pounds of thrust for 3.5 seconds. By comparison, NASA’s Saturn V rocket produced 7.5 million pounds of thrust. Their rocket uses solid Alumaflame propellant, which resembles gray Styrofoam and burns with a violet flame. After reaching its peak altitude, a parachute deploys to bring the kegs safely back to Earth. Typically, the team celebrates their achievement by tapping the keg and enjoying the beer. The 2024 launch will use a five-gallon (23-liter) keg in the first stage and a 15-gallon (68-liter) keg in the second. After landing, the team repeats their tradition of sharing the beer among themselves. They raised more than their £1,160 ($2,000) Kickstarter funding goal and are now set for the September launch, reminding participants and supporters that, as always in rocketry, success isn’t guaranteed. As Team Numb notes, 'No one else has ever tried to launch a full keg.'
translated_content: Sekumpulan roket amatur dari Portland, Oregon yang dikenali sebagai Team Numb sedang membawa penerokaan angkasa ke arah baharu dengan menghantar tong bir menaiki roket. Pada bulan September ini, mereka merancang pelancaran paling mencabar setakat ini—roket dua peringkat yang akan membawa bir hampir 20,000 kaki (kira-kira 3.8 batu atau 6.1 kilometer) ke langit. Team Numb sebelum ini telah menyelesaikan dua pelancaran berjaya: yang pertama pada 2008, menghantar tong bir 15-gelen (68-liter) setinggi 6,200 kaki (1,900 meter) menggunakan roket setinggi 11 kaki (3.4 meter) dan seberat 350 paun (160 kilogram). Pelancaran kedua pada 2012 berjaya mencapai ketinggian 7,700 kaki (2,350 meter). Misi 2024 yang akan datang ini bertujuan mengatasi rekod sebelumnya, dengan roket dijangka mencecah kelajuan sehingga 650 batu (1,050 kilometer) sejam. Walaupun masih jauh dari sempadan rasmi angkasa sejauh 62 batu (100 kilometer), Team Numb melihat pencapaian ini sebagai sesuatu yang membanggakan. Roket pasukan ini mempunyai dua peringkat, setiap satu dengan bahagian bahan api dan kargo yang berasingan. Peringkat pertama menggunakan empat motor N-Kelas yang memberikan tujahan 1,000 paun selama 3.5 saat. Sebagai perbandingan, roket Saturn V NASA menghasilkan 7.5 juta paun tujahan. Roket ini menggunakan propelan pepejal Alumaflame, yang kelihatan seperti Styrofoam kelabu dan terbakar dengan nyalaan ungu. Selepas mencapai ketinggian maksimum, payung terjun akan digunakan untuk membawa tong-tong bir itu turun dengan selamat. Biasanya, pasukan ini meraikan kejayaan mereka dengan mengetuk tong dan menikmati bir tersebut. Pelancaran 2024 ini akan menggunakan tong 5-gelen (23-liter) di peringkat pertama dan tong 15-gelen (68-liter) di peringkat kedua. Selepas mendarat, pasukan akan meneruskan tradisi berkongsi bir bersama. Mereka telah berjaya melebihi sasaran pembiayaan £1,160 ($2,000) di Kickstarter dan kini bersedia untuk pelancaran September ini, tetapi mereka mengingatkan bahawa kejayaan tidak pernah dijamin dalam penerbangan roket. Menurut Team Numb, 'Tiada siapa lagi pernah cuba melancarkan tong bir penuh.'

article_content: Conor McGregor electrified the O2 Arena in Dublin by stopping Diego Brandao in the first round on Saturday night. The featherweight star backed up his pre-fight predictions, dropping Brandao with a left hand before finishing the bout on the canvas. With this victory, McGregor remains undefeated in his three UFC fights. He was returning to action after almost a year away, recovering from torn knee ligaments suffered against Max Holloway last August. Gunnar Nelson also maintained his unbeaten record, submitting Zak Cummings just before the end of the second round after a tactical contest. Ian McCall outpointed Brad Pickett over three rounds, dashing Pickett's hopes for a title shot at flyweight. Notable results from the main card included: Norman Parke defeating Naoyuki Kotani by TKO in round two; Ilir Latifi earning a first-round TKO over Chris Dempsey; Neil Seery, Cathal Pendred, Trevor Smith, Nikita Krylov, and Patrick Holohan all securing wins in their respective bouts. After his fight, McGregor said: 'This is the feeling of success bursting through every vein in my body. I’ve been saying all week that I'd finish this guy in the first round—I seem to be predicting the future. Something tells me that by the end of the year, I’ll be world champion. I want to get straight back in there.' Following his victory, Gunnar Nelson commented: 'This was a tough fight. Zak is a very tough opponent—he is strong everywhere and knows what he is doing. The atmosphere was incredible. The title is on my mind, but I want to take it a step at a time.' Brad Pickett admitted disappointment after his loss, saying: 'I am a very competitive person and I hate losing...I came down to flyweight to get a title shot, but that is out of the window now. The natural move for me is to go back up a weight division.' Ian McCall set his sights on champion Demetrious Johnson after his win, stating: 'There is unfinished business with Demetrious Johnson—he has something that is mine.'
translated_content: Conor McGregor menghangatkan Arena O2 di Dublin apabila menewaskan Diego Brandao pada pusingan pertama malam Sabtu. Bintang featherweight itu membuktikan ramalannya, menjatuhkan Brandao dengan pukulan kiri sebelum menamatkan pertarungan di atas kanvas. Dengan kemenangan ini, McGregor kekal tanpa kalah dalam tiga pertarungan UFC. Dia kembali beraksi selepas hampir setahun berehat akibat kecederaan ligamen lutut yang dialaminya ketika menentang Max Holloway pada Ogos lalu. Gunnar Nelson juga mengekalkan rekod tanpa kalah dengan mengunci Zak Cummings menerusi 'rear naked choke' sebelum tamat pusingan kedua, selepas pertarungan taktikal. Ian McCall mengatasi Brad Pickett melalui keputusan mata selepas tiga pusingan, sekali gus menutup impian Pickett untuk mendapatkan peluang kejuaraan di kelas flyweight. Keputusan utama lain termasuk: Norman Parke menewaskan Naoyuki Kotani dengan TKO pada pusingan kedua; Ilir Latifi mendapat TKO pusingan pertama ke atas Chris Dempsey; manakala Neil Seery, Cathal Pendred, Trevor Smith, Nikita Krylov dan Patrick Holohan turut mencatat kemenangan dalam perlawanan masing-masing. Selepas kemenangannya, McGregor berkata: 'Inilah rasa kejayaan mengalir di setiap urat saya. Saya ulang berkali-kali minggu ini bahawa saya akan tamatkan lawan pada pusingan pertama—nampaknya saya boleh ramal masa depan. Sesuatu beritahu saya, menjelang hujung tahun ini, saya akan jadi juara dunia. Saya nak terus masuk gelanggang lagi.' Gunnar Nelson pula berkata selepas menang: 'Pertarungan ini memang sukar. Zak lawan yang sangat kuat—hebat di semua aspek dan tahu apa yang dia buat. Suasana di sini luar biasa. Kejuaraan memang dalam fikiran saya, tapi saya nak ambil langkah demi langkah.' Brad Pickett meluahkan kekecewaan selepas kalah: 'Saya sangat kompetitif dan memang tak suka kalah...Saya turun ke flyweight untuk peluang kejuaraan, tapi sekarang peluang itu dah tertutup. Langkah seterusnya, saya akan naik semula ke kelas atas.' Ian McCall pula memasang impian bertemu juara Demetrious Johnson selepas menang: 'Ada urusan belum selesai dengan Demetrious Johnson—dia pegang sesuatu yang sepatutnya milik saya.'

article_content: Martin Skrtel revealed that his former Liverpool teammate, Luis Suarez, had taught him some harsh phrases which he directed at Diego Costa during Slovakia’s 2-1 victory over Spain in last Thursday’s Euro qualifier. Following Slovakia’s unexpected win against the defending European champions, Suarez sent Skrtel a congratulatory text, to which Skrtel replied with thanks for the words he’d learned and used against Costa. Throughout the match, Skrtel and Costa clashed multiple times, especially in the penalty area. At the time, Diego Costa was leading Chelsea at the top of the Premier League with nine goals. Despite intense on-field duels, Slovakia claimed triumph as former Chelsea youth player Miroslav Stoch scored an 87th-minute winner, celebrating by removing his shirt. Suarez, who played alongside Skrtel at Liverpool for two and a half seasons before his £75 million move to Barcelona in July, maintained a close friendship with Skrtel during their stay at Anfield.

Selepas kemenangan mengejut Slovakia ke atas juara Eropah bertahan itu, Suarez mengirim mesej tahniah kepada Skrtel, yang membalas dengan ucapan terima kasih atas kata-kata yang dia pelajari dan gunakan terhadap Costa. Sepanjang perlawanan, Skrtel dan Costa beberapa kali bertembung, terutama di kawasan penalti. article_content: Karen Carney is set to earn her 100th cap on Sunday as England's women's team faces Germany in their first-ever international match at Wembley Stadium. While this milestone is significant, Carney is focused on an even bigger goal: helping England win the Women's World Cup in Canada next summer, moving past their disappointing Euro 2013 exit. She confidently told Press Association Sport that England has the talent, management, and support staff to achieve success, noting, 'We're all moving in the right direction.' At 27, Carney has already competed in five major tournaments, coming closest to victory at Euro 2009, when England beat hosts Finland and the Netherlands before falling 6-2 to Germany in the final. Germany, current European champions and FIFA’s No. 2 ranked team, will again test England's progress under manager Mark Sampson, who took over in December. Carney sees the squad as more well-rounded and mentally and physically stronger than ever. 'If I play, it will be a special moment for me, but even more special for the team, being the first England women's team to play at Wembley,' she said. Previously, Carney played at various Football League venues, as Wembley was not an option until now. The Football Association had to halt ticket sales for Sunday’s match after they surpassed 55,000 due to concerns about potential travel disruptions caused by nearby London Underground line closures. Carney cherishes the chance to return to Wembley, recalling the excitement of playing for Great Britain in a 2012 Olympic victory over Brazil before more than 70,000 fans. Still, she’s grateful for her previous 99 international appearances and looks forward to more opportunities at Wembley. Carney debuted for England at 17, scoring in a 4-1 win over Italy at Milton Keynes in February 2005. She still remembers every detail of that day, from her warm-up music to scoring her first goal. Manager Mark Sampson has described her as ‘an incredible football talent, one of the world’s best’. Carney credits Sampson for boosting her confidence and encouraging her to play to her strengths. Reflecting on the transition from Hope Powell’s 15-year tenure, which ended after a disappointing Euro 2013 campaign, Carney believes the team has become stronger through the process. 'We’ll give our best against Germany. If the result isn’t what we want, we still have six months to prepare for the World Cup,' she concluded.
translated_content: Karen Carney bakal mencatatkan penampilan ke-100 pada Ahad apabila pasukan wanita England bertemu Jerman dalam aksi antarabangsa pertama mereka di Stadium Wembley. Walaupun ini satu pencapaian besar, Carney lebih fokus kepada matlamat yang lebih tinggi: membantu England menjuarai Piala Dunia Wanita di Kanada musim panas depan, selepas kekecewaan di Euro 2013. Beliau yakin England memiliki bakat, pengurusan, dan sokongan untuk berjaya, berkata, 'Kita semua menuju ke arah yang betul.' Pada usia 27, Carney sudah bermain di lima kejohanan utama, paling hampir membawa pulang trofi di Euro 2009 apabila England mengatasi Finland dan Belanda sebelum tewas 6-2 kepada Jerman di perlawanan akhir. Jerman, juara Eropah semasa dan pasukan nombor dua dunia mengikut ranking FIFA, sekali lagi menjadi ujian buat England di bawah bimbingan pengurus Mark Sampson yang mengambil alih pada Disember. Carney melihat skuad sekarang lebih seimbang, kuat dari segi mental dan fizikal. 'Jika saya turun bermain, ia saat istimewa buat saya, namun lebih bermakna untuk pasukan menjadi pasukan wanita England pertama beraksi di Wembley,' katanya. Sebelum ini, Carney hanya pernah bermain di stadium-stadium Liga Bola Sepak kerana Wembley belum dapat diakses pasukan wanita hingga kini. Persatuan Bola Sepak England (FA) terpaksa hentikan jualan tiket selepas melebihi 55,000 sebab bimbang gangguan perjalanan akibat penutupan laluan Underground London yang berdekatan. Carney begitu menghargai peluang kembali ke Wembley, terkenang suasana sewaktu membantu Great Britain menewaskan Brazil pada Olimpik 2012 di depan lebih 70,000 penonton. Namun, dia tetap menghargai 99 penampilan sebelum ini dan berharap dapat beraksi lebih banyak kali di Wembley pada masa depan. Carney membuat penampilan sulung untuk England ketika berumur 17 tahun, menjaringkan gol dalam kemenangan 4-1 ke atas Itali di Milton Keynes pada Februari 2005. Dia masih ingat segalanya—dari lagu pemanas badan sehingga jaringannya. Pengurus Mark Sampson menyifatkannya 'bakat bola sepak luar biasa, antara yang terbaik di dunia.' Carney mengaku Sampson telah meningkatkan keyakinannya dan menggalakkan dia bermain mengikut kekuatan sendiri. Mengenang perubahan dari era Hope Powell selama 15 tahun yang berakhir selepas kempen Euro 2013 yang kurang berjaya, Carney percaya pasukan kini semakin kuat hasil pengalaman itu. 'Kami akan beri segalanya menentang Jerman. Jika keputusan kurang memihak, kami masih ada enam bulan untuk bersedia menghadapi Piala Dunia,' jelasnya.

article_content: Vice President Kashim Shettima, speaking via a speech delivered by Senate President Godswill Akpabio at a book launch in Abuja, attributed the continued hardship in North East Nigeria to terrorism. He emphasized that the region has endured the effects of terrorism for a long time, but expressed hope that, through collective understanding and action, these challenges can be overcome. Shettima insisted that restoring peace to the region requires unified efforts from all stakeholders. 'The North East has faced the scourge of terrorism for too long. Innocent people have suffered due to extremist violence. However, through knowledge and collective action, there is hope for stability,' he stated. Air Marshal Hassan Abubakar, Chief of Air Staff, highlighted the significant role of the Nigerian Air Force in the fight against terrorism. He explained that airpower has enabled more effective surveillance, intelligence gathering, and direct action against terrorists, which has weakened their capabilities. Abubakar stressed that fighting terrorism is not solely a military matter; a comprehensive approach—including tackling the root causes of extremism, strengthening social cohesion, and encouraging economic development—is essential. He also pointed out that the perspectives detailed in the new book offer important guidance for policymakers, military strategists, and practitioners who seek holistic, long-term solutions beyond military actions.
translated_content: Naib Presiden Kashim Shettima, melalui ucapan yang dibacakan oleh Presiden Senat Godswill Akpabio ketika pelancaran buku di Abuja, mengaitkan kesukaran berterusan di Timur Laut Nigeria dengan kegiatan keganasan. Beliau menekankan bahawa rantau tersebut telah lama mengalami akibat keganasan, namun tetap berharap bahawa dengan pemahaman serta tindakan bersama, cabaran ini dapat diatasi. Shettima menegaskan bahawa pemulihan keamanan di rantau tersebut memerlukan kerjasama semua pihak berkepentingan. 'Timur Laut sudah lama menghadapi kesan keganasan. Orang awam yang tidak berdosa telah menderita akibat kekejaman ekstremis. Namun, melalui pengetahuan serta usaha kolektif, ada harapan untuk mencapai kestabilan,' katanya. Ketua Staf Udara, Marsyal Udara Hassan Abubakar, menyorot peranan penting Tentera Udara Nigeria dalam memerangi keganasan. Beliau menerangkan bahawa penggunaan kuasa udara memudahkan pengawasan, pengumpulan risikan dan tindakan langsung terhadap pengganas, sekali gus melemahkan keupayaan mereka. Abubakar menekankan bahawa memerangi keganasan bukanlah tanggungjawab tentera semata-mata; pendekatan menyeluruh diperlukan—termasuk menangani punca utama ekstremisme, memperkukuh perpaduan sosial dan menggalakkan pembangunan ekonomi. Beliau turut menyatakan bahawa perspektif yang diketengahkan dalam buku baharu ini adalah panduan penting untuk pembuat dasar, perancang strategi ketenteraan dan pelaksana yang mencari penyelesaian holistik serta jangka panjang melebihi tindakan ketenteraan semata-mata.

article_content: Republican Jim Jordan is preparing for a second attempt to be elected Speaker of the US House of Representatives after missing the mark by 17 votes in the first round on Tuesday. The House is now entering its third week without a leader, after right-wing Republicans removed former Speaker Kevin McCarthy, leaving the chamber unable to address key issues such as support for Ukraine and the conflict between Israel and Palestine. McCarthy was voted out on October 3 following backlash from hard-right members of his party for collaborating with Democrats on a debt ceiling bill that narrowly avoided a government shutdown. Since then, the deeply divided House—requiring a majority of those present to choose a leader—has failed to unite behind a new Speaker. This dysfunction means the House is unable to pass bills or authorize assistance overseas. Former Speaker Newt Gingrich suggested expanding the powers of current Speaker Pro Tempore Patrick McHenry to help break the stalemate. 'We can’t wait around and hope the world pauses while House Republicans resolve their issues,' he told Fox News. On Tuesday, Jim Jordan fell short in his first Speaker bid, with 20 Republicans voting against him. All 212 Democrats backed Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries. Jordan will try again for the leadership on Wednesday, but it is unclear if he has gained enough support to win. At least one Republican who previously voted against him, Representative Doug LaMalfa, now says he will support Jordan in the second round. Still, Jordan remains well short of the 17 votes he needs. The House is scheduled to convene at 11:00 a.m. EST (15:00 GMT) for the next vote. Jordan, chair of the Judiciary Committee and endorsed by former President Donald Trump, is under pressure to show progress. However, many Republican holdouts remain firm in their opposition, with some predicting Jordan could lose even more votes. Jordan does not have the same goodwill among his peers that McCarthy had, making a lengthy voting process unlikely. There is increasing support to give temporary powers to McHenry, allowing him to bring legislation to the floor. Lawmakers may soon vote on whether to formally empower McHenry until the end of the year or until a permanent Speaker is chosen if Jordan fails in the second round. Ohio Congressman Dave Joyce said in a statement reported by The Hill, 'After two weeks without a speaker and no candidate with 217 votes, it is time to consider other options. By empowering Patrick McHenry as Speaker Pro Tempore, we can address urgent issues, such as supporting Israel, while searching for a new Speaker.'
translated_content: Ahli Republikan, Jim Jordan, bersiap untuk percubaan kedua bagi dipilih sebagai Speaker Dewan Perwakilan Amerika Syarikat selepas gagal mendapatkan 17 undi dalam pusingan pertama pada hari Selasa. Dewan kini memasuki minggu ketiga tanpa pemimpin selepas kumpulan sayap kanan Republikan menyingkirkan Speaker terdahulu, Kevin McCarthy, menyebabkan dewan tidak dapat menangani isu utama seperti bantuan kepada Ukraine dan konflik Israel-Palestin. McCarthy disingkirkan pada 3 Oktober selepas mendapat tentangan daripada ahli parti yang lebih konservatif kerana bekerjasama dengan Demokrat dalam rang undang-undang siling hutang yang hampir mengelakkan penutupan kerajaan. Sejak itu, Dewan yang sangat terbahagi—memerlukan majoriti daripada ahli yang hadir untuk memilih ketua—gagal mencapai kata sepakat mengenai Speaker baharu. Kekacauan ini menyebabkan Dewan tidak dapat meluluskan rang undang-undang atau meluluskan bantuan ke luar negara. Bekas Speaker, Newt Gingrich, mencadangkan agar kuasa Speaker Sementara, Patrick McHenry, diperluaskan untuk membantu menyelesaikan kebuntuan. 'Kita tidak boleh duduk menunggu dan berharap dunia akan menunggu sehingga Republikan Dewan selesai masalah mereka,' katanya kepada Fox News. Pada hari Selasa, Jim Jordan gagal dalam percubaan pertamanya sebagai Speaker, dengan 20 ahli Republikan mengundi menentangnya. Semua 212 ahli Demokrat menyokong Ketua Minoriti, Hakeem Jeffries. Jordan akan mencuba sekali lagi pada hari Rabu, namun masih tidak pasti sama ada sokongan yang diperoleh sudah mencukupi. Sekurang-kurangnya seorang Republikan yang sebelum ini menentang, Perwakilan Doug LaMalfa, kini menyokong Jordan dalam pusingan kedua. Namun begitu, Jordan masih kekurangan 17 undi yang diperlukan. Dewan dijadual bersidang pada pukul 11:00 pagi EST (15:00 GMT) untuk undian seterusnya. Jordan, yang merupakan pengerusi Jawatankuasa Kehakiman dan mendapat sokongan daripada bekas Presiden Donald Trump, kini ditekan untuk menunjukkan kemajuan. Walaubagaimanapun, ramai ahli Republikan yang menentang masih tetap dengan pendirian mereka, dengan beberapa pihak meramalkan Jordan boleh kehilangan lebih banyak undi. Jordan tidak mempunyai sokongan meluas seperti yang dinikmati McCarthy, menyebabkan proses undian berpanjangan sukar berlaku. Sokongan semakin meningkat untuk memberi kuasa sementara kepada McHenry bagi membolehkannya membawa usul ke dewan. Penggubal undang-undang mungkin akan mengundi untuk memberi kuasa rasmi kepada McHenry sehingga hujung tahun atau sehingga Speaker tetap dilantik, sekiranya Jordan gagal dalam pusingan kedua. Ahli Kongres Ohio, Dave Joyce berkata dalam kenyataan yang dilaporkan oleh akhbar politik The Hill, 'Selepas dua minggu tanpa Speaker dan tiada calon dengan 217 undi, sudah tiba masanya untuk mempertimbangkan pilihan lain. Dengan memberi kuasa kepada Patrick McHenry sebagai Speaker Sementara, kita boleh menangani isu penting seperti menyokong Israel sambil mencari Speaker baharu.'

article_content: Colin Furze, a 34-year-old inventor from Lincolnshire known for eccentric creations like X-Men Wolverine claws and magnetic shoes, has unveiled his latest project: a machine that replicates the sound of a fart using a valveless pulse jet. Furze set up the device in Dover and directed it across the English Channel towards France, covering 26 miles (42 km). The loud noise from the pulse jet was reportedly heard by two people in Calais. A pulse jet engine operates by combusting fuel in loud pulses and generally contains few or no moving parts. These engines are often used in drones, radio-controlled aircraft, industrial drying, and home heating equipment because of their simple, lightweight design. Companies like Boeing have developed proprietary pulse jet technologies, such as the Pulse Ejector Thrust Augmentor (PETA), and are researching vertical takeoff for military and commercial aircraft using these types of engines. In the featured video, Furze and a crowd of fans observe as he ignites the jet, which produces a noise he describes as ‘similar to a fart from a distance.’ He contacts acquaintances in Calais, who confirm they heard the sound. Furze’s valveless pulse jet is built from a U-shaped pipe with fuel pumped directly into the combustion chamber. Once ignited, it produces a distinctive roaring sound. Furze notes that, while pulse jets are inefficient because most energy is lost as heat and noise, their simplicity and ability to generate loud sound make them ideal for this stunt. He claims this pulse jet is one of the largest he has built and shows the construction process in a previous video.
translated_content: Colin Furze, seorang pencipta berusia 34 tahun dari Lincolnshire yang terkenal dengan ciptaan-ciptaan pelik seperti kuku Wolverine X-Men dan kasut magnet, telah melancarkan projek terbarunya: sebuah mesin yang meniru bunyi kentut menggunakan enjin pulse jet tanpa injap. Furze memasang peranti itu di Dover dan mengarahkannya merentasi Selat Inggeris ke Perancis, sejauh 26 batu (42 km). Bunyi kuat dari pulse jet tersebut dilaporkan didengari oleh dua orang di Calais. Enjin pulse jet beroperasi dengan membakar bahan api secara berdenyut kuat dan biasanya mempunyai sedikit atau tiada bahagian bergerak. Enjin ini sering digunakan dalam dron, pesawat radio kawalan jauh, pengeringan industri, dan peralatan pemanasan rumah kerana reka bentuknya yang ringkas dan ringan. Syarikat seperti Boeing telah membangunkan teknologi pulse jet milik mereka, seperti Pulse Ejector Thrust Augmentor (PETA), dan sedang mengkaji pelepasan menegak untuk pesawat tentera serta komersial menggunakan enjin jenis ini. Dalam video yang ditunjukkan, Furze bersama sekumpulan peminat menyaksikan beliau menyalakan enjin tersebut, yang menghasilkan bunyi digambarkan sebagai ‘mirip kentut dari jauh.’ Beliau menghubungi kenalan di Calais, yang mengesahkan bahawa mereka mendengar bunyi itu. Pulse jet tanpa injap yang dicipta Furze ini dibina daripada paip berbentuk-U dengan bahan api dipam terus ke ruang pembakaran. Setelah dinyalakan, ia mengeluarkan bunyi menderu yang unik. Furze menyatakan bahawa walaupun pulse jet kurang efisien kerana kebanyakan tenaga hilang sebagai haba dan bunyi, kesederhanaan serta keupayaannya menghasilkan bunyi kuat menjadikannya sesuai untuk aksi ini. Beliau mendakwa pulse jet ini antara yang terbesar pernah dibina olehnya dan turut menunjukkan proses pembinaannya dalam video terdahulu.

article_content: Michael Steinberg, a portfolio manager at Steven A. Cohen's $15 billion hedge fund SAC Capital Advisors, was arrested by the FBI at his New York City home early Friday morning in connection with a long-running insider trading investigation, according to an FBI spokesman. Steinberg later pleaded not guilty in federal court to charges that he traded Dell Inc shares using insider information, sources familiar with the matter said. He was released on $3 million bail. SAC Capital suspended Steinberg from his position in October 2012, and he had reportedly been staying at various hotels in New York City in recent weeks to avoid arrest at his Upper East Side home, where he lives with his wife and two children. Steinberg’s lawyer, Barry Berke, told Reuters his client had done 'absolutely nothing wrong.' Berke stated that Steinberg’s trading decisions were based on detailed analysis and information he believed was properly obtained through typical institutional channels. FBI Assistant Director George Venizelos described Steinberg’s sources as 'well-timed tips from an extensive network of well-sourced analysts' and accused Steinberg of being part of an elite criminal group that rewarded cheating. Steinberg, 40, is the most senior SAC Capital Advisors employee charged in the government's probe into alleged illegal use of insider information in hedge fund trading. Including Steinberg, nine people have been charged or implicated for wrongful trading while working at the Connecticut-based SAC Capital. A spokesman for SAC Capital declined to comment. Steinberg’s arrest was widely anticipated after former SAC analyst Jon Horvath, who had worked closely with him, pleaded guilty last year to using illegal information for trading in Dell and Nvidia Corp and began cooperating with authorities. Manhattan U.S. Attorney Preet Bharara issued a statement alleging Steinberg cultivated insider information from other professionals and quickly used it for personal gain. Two weeks prior to the arrest, SAC agreed to pay a record $616 million to the U.S. SEC to settle civil insider trading charges, without admitting or denying wrongdoing. As part of that settlement, SAC also agreed to pay $14 million for improper trading in Dell Inc, which involved a former trader reporting to Steinberg. Meanwhile, SAC's founder Steven A. Cohen recently purchased Picasso’s Le Rêve for $155 million and a Hamptons home for $60 million.
translated_content: Michael Steinberg, seorang pengurus portfolio di dana lindung nilai SAC Capital Advisors bernilai $15 bilion milik Steven A. Cohen, telah ditahan oleh FBI di rumahnya di New York City awal pagi Jumaat berkaitan siasatan perdagangan orang dalam yang berpanjangan, menurut jurucakap FBI. Steinberg kemudian mengaku tidak bersalah di mahkamah persekutuan atas tuduhan bahawa beliau memperdagangkan saham Dell Inc menggunakan maklumat orang dalam, kata sumber yang rapat dengan perkara ini. Beliau dibebaskan dengan jaminan $3 juta. SAC Capital telah menggantung Steinberg daripada jawatannya pada Oktober 2012, dan beliau dilaporkan tinggal di beberapa hotel di New York City sejak beberapa minggu kebelakangan ini untuk mengelak ditahan di rumahnya di Upper East Side, di mana dia tinggal bersama isteri dan dua anaknya. Peguam Steinberg, Barry Berke, memberitahu Reuters bahawa anak guamnya tidak melakukan sebarang kesalahan. Berke mengatakan keputusan dagangan Steinberg berdasarkan analisis terperinci dan maklumat yang beliau percaya telah diperolehi secara sah melalui saluran institusi yang biasa. Penolong Pengarah FBI, George Venizelos, menggambarkan sumber Steinberg sebagai 'petua yang tepat pada masanya daripada rangkaian penganalisis yang berpengetahuan luas' dan menuduh Steinberg sebagai sebahagian daripada kumpulan jenayah elit yang memberi ganjaran kepada penipuan. Steinberg, 40, adalah pekerja paling kanan di SAC Capital Advisors yang didakwa dalam siasatan kerajaan terhadap salah guna maklumat orang dalam dalam dagangan dana lindung nilai. Termasuk Steinberg, sembilan orang telah didakwa atau dikaitkan dengan dagangan salah semasa bekerja di SAC Capital yang berpusat di Connecticut. Jurucakap SAC Capital enggan mengulas. Penahanan Steinberg sudah dijangka selepas bekas penganalisis SAC, Jon Horvath, yang pernah bekerja rapat dengannya, mengaku bersalah tahun lalu atas penggunaan maklumat haram untuk berdagang dalam Dell dan Nvidia Corp dan mula bekerjasama dengan pihak berkuasa. Peguam Amerika Syarikat Manhattan, Preet Bharara, mengeluarkan kenyataan yang mendakwa Steinberg mengumpul maklumat orang dalam daripada profesional lain dan segera menggunakannya untuk keuntungan peribadi. Dua minggu sebelum penahanan, SAC bersetuju membayar $616 juta kepada Suruhanjaya Sekuriti dan Bursa (SEC) AS untuk menyelesaikan pertuduhan sivil perdagangan orang dalam tanpa mengaku atau menafikan kesalahan. Sebagai sebahagian penyelesaian itu, SAC juga bersetuju membayar $14 juta untuk dagangan tidak wajar dalam Dell Inc yang melibatkan bekas pedagang yang melapor kepada Steinberg. Sementara itu, pengasas SAC, Steven A. Cohen, baru-baru ini membeli karya Picasso ‘Le Rêve’ dengan harga $155 juta dan sebuah rumah di Hamptons bernilai $60 juta.

article_content: Steve Chmelar, inventor of the iconic foam finger, expressed disappointment over singer Miley Cyrus's use of the prop during her controversial 2013 MTV Video Music Awards performance with Robin Thicke. Chmelar created the first foam finger in 1971 as a 16-year-old, aiming to cheer for his school basketball team at the Iowa state championships. Although Chmelar never expected his creation to become a pop culture symbol, he was dismayed to see it associated with such a provocative performance. 'She took an honorable icon that is seen in sporting venues everywhere and degraded it. Fortunately, the foam finger has been around long enough that it will survive this incident,' Chmelar told Fox Sports. The foam finger first drew attention when an Associated Press photographer captured Chmelar cheering with his homemade design—crafted from galvanized hardware cloth, paper mache, spray paint, and a red marker. The photo appeared in the 1971 Ottumwa High School yearbook, featuring Chmelar at the state semifinal and championship games in Des Moines. In 1978, Geral Fauss began commercially selling foam fingers at the Cotton Bowl, helping popularize them as a must-have symbol for fans at sports events. Chmelar believes his own creation inspired the later adoption, though direct evidence is limited. The foam finger used by Cyrus was originally made by stylist Lisa Katnic for a fashion shoot, later appearing in Robin Thicke's 'Blurred Lines' music video. The prop gained notoriety when Cyrus used it during her VMA act. Chmelar only learned of the performance after a family member showed him a clip online. He remarked, 'For people that like that kind of entertainment, I’m sure that it met their needs. If I had a choice between Julie Andrews singing The Sound of Music and Miley Cyrus performing Can't Stop, I’d choose Julie Andrews.'
translated_content: Steve Chmelar, pencipta foam finger ikonik, meluahkan kekecewaannya terhadap penggunaan prop itu oleh penyanyi Miley Cyrus semasa persembahan kontroversi beliau di MTV Video Music Awards 2013 bersama Robin Thicke. Chmelar mencipta foam finger pertama pada tahun 1971 ketika berusia 16 tahun untuk menyokong pasukan bola keranjang sekolahnya di kejohanan negeri Iowa. Walaupun Chmelar tidak pernah menyangka ciptaannya akan menjadi simbol budaya pop, beliau berasa kecewa apabila ia dikaitkan dengan persembahan yang begitu kontroversi. 'Dia mengambil ikon terhormat yang sering dilihat di tempat sukan dan merosakkannya. Mujurlah, foam finger sudah cukup lama wujud untuk terus bertahan,' kata Chmelar kepada Fox Sports. Foam finger itu mula mendapat perhatian apabila jurugambar Associated Press merakam gambar Chmelar bersorak dengan reka bentuk buatannya sendiri—diperbuat daripada dawai besi tergalvani, papier mache, cat sembur, dan penanda merah. Gambar itu dimuatkan dalam buku tahunan Ottumwa High School 1971, menunjukkan Chmelar di perlawanan separuh akhir dan akhir kejohanan negeri di Des Moines. Pada tahun 1978, Geral Fauss mula menjual foam finger secara komersial di Cotton Bowl, menjadikannya item wajib di acara sukan. Chmelar percaya ciptaannya memberi inspirasi kepada penggunaan foam finger secara meluas, walaupun bukti langsung terhad. Foam finger yang digunakan oleh Cyrus asalnya dibuat oleh stylist Lisa Katnic untuk sesi fotografi fesyen, kemudian dipaparkan dalam video muzik Robin Thicke 'Blurred Lines.' Prop itu mendapat perhatian meluas setelah digunakan oleh Cyrus di pentas VMA. Chmelar hanya mengetahui tentang persembahan itu selepas ahli keluarga menunjukkan klip tersebut kepadanya secara atas talian. Beliau berkata, 'Bagi orang yang sukakan hiburan seperti itu, pasti ia memenuhi citarasa mereka. Jika saya diberi pilihan antara Julie Andrews menyanyikan The Sound of Music dan Miley Cyrus membawa Can't Stop, saya pilih Julie Andrews.'

article_content: Union Minister Piyush Goyal stated on Sunday that the opposition bloc Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance (INDIA) has begun to disintegrate, claiming it has now become 'INDI zero'. Goyal referenced recent disputes between Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav and Madhya Pradesh Congress president Kamal Nath over seat sharing for the Assembly polls, as well as Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar’s remarks that Congress is more focused on elections than setting the future direction for the INDIA bloc. Goyal said at a press conference during his tour of poll-bound Madhya Pradesh, 'The opposition alliance has started breaking apart even before being fully formed. The parties within are contesting against each other in Assembly polls in various states. It has now turned into the 'INDI zero' alliance.' He further added, 'Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar is disheartened by the alliance’s condition. The Aam Aadmi Party criticizes Congress, and in West Bengal, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka, alliance members are fighting each other.' The INDIA alliance consists of over 25 parties opposed to the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), including Congress and Nitish Kumar’s Janata Dal (United). Goyal also called MP Congress chief Kamal Nath and senior leader and Rajya Sabha MP Digvijaya Singh a 'mismatched pair' and claimed they are at odds, focusing on promoting their sons’ political careers. He said, 'Kamal Nath has already lost credibility among the masses and is now isolated in Congress politics.' When questioned about the BJP not naming Chief Minister candidates for the five states with upcoming Assembly polls, Goyal remarked, 'We have the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. We are all generals under him. Congress's failure lies in not having a popular leader who connects with the people.' Addressing the topic of rising onion prices, Goyal said the government has increased the buffer stock of onions from two lakh tonnes to five lakh tonnes due to irregular rainfall in different parts of the country and subsequently added another two lakh tonnes through additional purchases. He stated, 'This is the first time since Independence that the central government is supplying onions at Rs 25 per kg to retail consumers from the buffer stock. Due to this, onion prices have stabilized in many places.' Goyal, the Union Minister for Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, said prices are expected to fall further when onions sown late in the Kharif season reach the markets in the next one to two weeks. In business news, Sweden’s Saab has been granted approval for the first 100% foreign direct investment (FDI) in India’s defense sector, allowing the company to establish a facility to manufacture rockets. State Bank of India (SBI), the country’s largest lender, reported an 8% increase in second-quarter net profit, driven by steady credit demand and lower provisions. The bank anticipates strong loan growth in line with the country's broad economic expansion. Edtech company Byju’s reported delayed, partial audited financials for the year ending March 2022, showing standalone business revenue of ₹3,569 crore—a 2.3x increase from the previous year. The core business EBITDA loss decreased to ₹2,253 crore in FY22, down from ₹2,406 crore the prior year.
translated_content: Menteri Kesatuan, Piyush Goyal, berkata pada Ahad bahawa blok pembangkang Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance (INDIA) telah mula berpecah, menyatakan ia kini menjadi 'INDI sifar'. Goyal merujuk kepada pertikaian terkini antara ketua Parti Samajwadi, Akhilesh Yadav dan presiden Kongres Madhya Pradesh, Kamal Nath, mengenai pembahagian kerusi untuk pilihan raya Dewan Undangan. Beliau juga menyebut kenyataan Ketua Menteri Bihar, Nitish Kumar, bahawa Kongres lebih fokus kepada pilihan raya daripada menentukan hala tuju masa depan blok INDIA. Dalam sidang media semasa lawatan ke Madhya Pradesh yang bakal mengadakan pilihan raya, Goyal berkata, 'Pakatan pembangkang telah mula berpecah walaupun belum benar-benar terbentuk. Parti dalam pakatan bertanding menentang satu sama lain dalam pilihan raya Dewan Undangan. Ia kini menjadi pakatan 'INDI sifar'.' Beliau menambah, 'Ketua Menteri Bihar Nitish Kumar kecewa dengan keadaan pakatan ini. Parti Aam Aadmi mengkritik Kongres, dan di Bengal Barat, Tamil Nadu, serta Karnataka, ahli pakatan turut bertelagah.' Pakatan INDIA terdiri daripada lebih 25 parti yang menentang Parti Bharatiya Janata (BJP), termasuk Kongres dan Janata Dal (United) pimpinan Nitish Kumar. Goyal turut memanggil ketua Kongres MP, Kamal Nath dan pemimpin senior serta Ahli Parlimen Rajya Sabha, Digvijaya Singh sebagai 'pasangan yang tidak sepadan' dan mendakwa mereka bertelagah serta menumpukan perhatian pada kerjaya politik anak-anak mereka. Beliau berkata, 'Kamal Nath telah kehilangan kredibiliti di kalangan rakyat dan kini terasing dalam politik Kongres.' Ketika ditanya tentang BJP tidak menamakan calon Ketua Menteri untuk lima negeri dengan pilihan raya akan datang, Goyal berkata, 'Kami mempunyai kepimpinan Perdana Menteri Narendra Modi. Kami semua jeneral di bawah beliau. Kegagalan Kongres adalah kerana ketiadaan pemimpin popular yang boleh dekati rakyat.' Mengenai kenaikan harga bawang, Goyal berkata kerajaan telah meningkatkan stok penimbal bawang dari dua lakh tan kepada lima lakh tan berikutan hujan tidak menentu di beberapa kawasan, serta menambah dua lakh tan lagi menerusi pembelian tambahan. Beliau menyatakan, 'Ini kali pertama sejak Kemerdekaan, kerajaan pusat membekalkan bawang pada harga RM25 sekilogram terus kepada pengguna melalui stok penimbal. Harga bawang juga telah stabil di banyak tempat.' Goyal, Menteri Kesatuan bagi Hal Ehwal Pengguna, Makanan dan Pengedaran Awam, berkata harga dijangka makin turun apabila bawang yang ditanam lewat musim Kharif sampai ke pasaran dalam masa satu hingga dua minggu akan datang. Dalam berita perniagaan, syarikat Sweden, Saab, mendapat kelulusan untuk pelaburan langsung asing (FDI) 100% pertama dalam sektor pertahanan India, membolehkan mereka membina kilang pengeluaran roket. State Bank of India (SBI), peminjam terbesar negara, melaporkan peningkatan 8% dalam keuntungan bersih suku kedua, didorong permintaan kredit stabil dan pengurangan peruntukan. Bank itu menjangka pertumbuhan pinjaman yang kukuh sejajar perkembangan ekonomi negara. Syarikat edtech Byju's melaporkan penyata kewangan teraudit yang tertunda dan separa untuk tahun berakhir Mac 2022, menunjukkan pendapatan perniagaan tunggal sebanyak ₹3,569 crore—peningkatan 2.3 kali daripada tahun sebelumnya. Kerugian EBITDA perniagaan teras menurun kepada ₹2,253 crore dalam FY22, berbanding ₹2,406 crore tahun sebelumnya.

article_content: Chelsea manager Jose Mourinho strongly criticized referee Anthony Taylor following Chelsea's 1-1 draw with Southampton. Mourinho was particularly upset that Taylor did not award a penalty when Cesc Fabregas appeared to be fouled by Southampton’s Matt Targett, and instead punished Fabregas for diving. After the game, Mourinho told Taylor he should be ashamed of his officiating. Mourinho argued that the penalty incident was obvious. He voiced frustration about ongoing accusations from other coaches and pundits that Chelsea players dive, specifically mentioning Diego Costa, Gary Cahill, Branislav Ivanovic, and Willian as having been targeted. He claimed these criticisms amount to a coordinated campaign against Chelsea. He also suggested officials should be able to overturn yellow cards if mistakes are later recognized, using video review. Mourinho called the current system of penalizing players for simulation without possibility of reversal 'unbelievable.' Replays suggested Targett did trip Fabregas, but Taylor issued a yellow card for diving. Mourinho insisted his team is being treated more harshly than others in similar situations. On the field, Southampton took the lead through Sadio Mane and displayed strong organization to secure a point. Southampton manager Ronald Koeman said he was proud of his team’s discipline and effort and stated he was unsure about the penalty call, deferring to the referee. The result saw Chelsea miss an opportunity to increase their Premier League lead, while Southampton remained fourth ahead of Arsenal.

Mourinho amat kecewa apabila Taylor tidak memberikan penalti selepas Cesc Fabregas kelihatan dijatuhkan oleh pemain Southampton, Matt Targett, dan sebaliknya menghukum Fabregas kerana menjatuhkan diri. Selepas perlawanan, Mourinho berkata kepada Taylor bahawa beliau sepatutnya malu dengan pengadilannya. Mourinho menegaskan insiden penalti itu sangat jelas. Beliau melahirkan rasa tidak puas hati terhadap tuduhan berterusan dari jurulatih dan pengulas lain bahawa pemain Chelsea suka menjatuhkan diri, dengan menyebut nama Diego Costa, Gary Cahill, Branislav Ivanovic, dan Willian yang turut pernah menjadi sasaran. Beliau mendakwa kritikan itu adalah satu kempen terancang terhadap Chelsea. Beliau juga mencadangkan agar pengadil boleh membatalkan kad kuning sekiranya didapati telah melakukan kesilapan selepas menggunakan bantuan video. Mourinho menyifatkan sistem sedia ada yang menghukum pemain kerana simulasi tanpa peluang pembetulan sebagai 'tidak masuk akal.' Ulangan video menunjukkan Targett memang menjatuhkan Fabregas, namun Taylor tetap memberikan kad kuning kerana menjatuhkan diri. Mourinho menegaskan pasukannya dilayan lebih keras berbanding pasukan lain dalam situasi serupa. Di atas padang, Southampton mendahului menerusi jaringan Sadio Mane dan memperlihatkan organisasi yang baik untuk memperoleh satu mata. Pengurus Southampton, Ronald Koeman, berkata beliau bangga dengan disiplin dan usaha pasukannya serta menyatakan beliau tidak pasti mengenai insiden penalti berkenaan dan menyerahkan keputusan kepada pengadil. Keputusan seri itu menyebabkan Chelsea gagal menjarakkan kedudukan dalam Liga Perdana, manakala Southampton kekal di tempat keempat di atas Arsenal.
