article_content: On Thursday, European Union lawmakers accused Azerbaijan of expelling Armenian residents from Nagorno-Karabakh, labeling it as "ethnic cleansing." They advised EU nations to enact sanctions on certain Azerbaijani officials and to consider reducing Europe's reliance on Azerbaijani gas. Azerbaijan rejected these claims, stating Armenians could remain and promising to protect their rights—though most Armenian residents have left since the region was swiftly retaken by Azerbaijan last month. The European Parliament adopted a resolution urging all 27 EU member states to impose targeted sanctions on members of Azerbaijan's government, pointing to the recent offensive and alleged human rights violations in Nagorno-Karabakh. Lawmakers further encouraged the EU to reevaluate its energy partnership with Azerbaijan. Despite these recommendations, the resolution is not binding, meaning the EU is not obligated to act. European diplomats have indicated that sanctions are not under current consideration and would only be revisited if conditions in the region deteriorate. After Russia invaded Ukraine, the EU increased its natural gas imports from Azerbaijan. In 2022, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen agreed with Azerbaijan to more than double these imports by 2027. Additionally, Azerbaijan’s security service released footage showing the arrest of Arayik Harutyunyan, the former Nagorno-Karabakh leader, on Thursday. This followed the recent detention of three other top separatist figures after Azerbaijan regained control of the area. The Nagorno-Karabakh region, a mountainous enclave in the South Caucasus, has been a longstanding conflict zone between Armenia and Azerbaijan, dating back to the Russian Empire's collapse in 1917.

Azerbaijan menolak tuduhan ini, menyatakan bahawa rakyat Armenia boleh terus tinggal di sana dan berjanji untuk melindungi hak mereka—walaupun kebanyakan penduduk Armenia telah meninggalkan kawasan itu selepas Azerbaijan mengambil alih dengan cepat bulan lalu. Parlimen Eropah meluluskan resolusi yang menggesa kesemua 27 negara anggota EU mengenakan sekatan bersasar ke atas ahli kerajaan Azerbaijan, merujuk kepada serangan baru-baru ini dan dakwaan pelanggaran hak asasi manusia di Nagorno-Karabakh. Ahli parlimen juga mengajak EU menilai semula kerjasama tenaga dengan Azerbaijan. Walau bagaimanapun, resolusi ini tidak mengikat dan EU tidak wajib bertindak. article_content: Swedish photographer Annika Nordenskiöld won the inaugural Prompted Peculiar International AI Prize at the Ballarat International Foto Biennale with her image 'Twin Sisters in Love.' The striking black-and-white photo shows two women tightly embracing each other—and an octopus. As humans rarely interact in such an intimate way with cephalopods, this unusual scene was created using artificial intelligence. Nordenskiöld collaborated with Midjourney, an AI tool that transforms text prompts into hyper-realistic images by referencing a vast database of human-created visual art. The Ballarat competition, held in Australia and running through October 22, is considered one of the first AI-art awards. "None of the places, people or creatures in my prompts exist in the physical realm," Nordenskiöld said. "They were conjured from the collective human experience, envisioned from my perspective." AI art tools like Midjourney, Dall-E, and Stable Diffusion have enabled people to generate images from text in creative, sometimes bizarre ways. This development has ignited debate about whether machines can produce real art, and what art truly is. Previously, AI-generated art has won awards, such as at the 2022 Colorado State Fair, sparking backlash from some artists who argue this approach undermines traditional artistry. Unlike the state fair competition, the Ballarat Biennale specifically invited AI-generated entries, receiving more than 100 submissions globally. Twenty works were shortlisted, including Morganna Magee’s 'A Friend in Need'—an image of a kangaroo with a human-like arm embracing an alien-looking creature. According to the festival's judges, the entries showed imaginative use of AI with strong visual appeal. However, the rise of AI-generated art has also raised ethical and copyright concerns among creative professionals. Nordenskiöld acknowledged both excitement and apprehension about AI art, saying, “I understand the fear of AI and find it somewhat healthy, but I see it more like a colleague I am working with.” Other prize winners at the festival include Australian artist Hanna Silver. Her sepia-toned image, 'Robot Intermarriage, Melbourne 1895, 2023,' depicts a 19th-century gentleman holding hands with a robot on a Melbourne street, based on her text prompt submitted to Midjourney. The image was chosen as the audience favorite by over 1,000 festival visitors. Although Midjourney didn’t exactly match Silver’s prompt—showing a robot marrying a man instead of a tram—she embraces the unpredictability AI brings to art, stating, "There’s a lot I find charming about this image. And love is love."
translated_content: Fotografer Sweden, Annika Nordenskiöld, memenangi anugerah pertama Prompted Peculiar International AI Prize di Ballarat International Foto Biennale menerusi gambar beliau, 'Twin Sisters in Love.' Foto hitam putih yang menonjol ini memaparkan dua wanita saling berpelukan erat—bersama seekor sotong. Memandangkan manusia jarang berinteraksi sebegitu rapat dengan cephalopod, adegan luar biasa ini dicipta menggunakan kecerdasan buatan. Nordenskiöld bekerjasama dengan Midjourney, satu alat AI yang menukar arahan teks kepada imej hiper-realistik dengan merujuk kepada pangkalan data besar seni visual manusia. Pertandingan Ballarat, yang diadakan di Australia sehingga 22 Oktober, dianggap antara anugerah seni AI terawal. "Tiada tempat, manusia, atau makhluk dalam arahan saya yang wujud di dunia sebenar," kata Nordenskiöld. "Mereka terhasil dari pengalaman kolektif manusia, dilihat dari perspektif saya." Alat seni AI seperti Midjourney, Dall-E, dan Stable Diffusion membolehkan orang ramai mencipta imej dari teks dengan cara yang kreatif, kadang kala pelik. Perkembangan ini telah mencetuskan perdebatan tentang sama ada mesin boleh menghasilkan seni sebenar, dan apa makna seni itu sendiri. Sebelum ini, seni AI pernah memenangi anugerah seperti di Colorado State Fair 2022, menyebabkan reaksi negatif daripada sesetengah artis yang menganggap cara ini menjejaskan seni tradisional. Berbeza dengan pertandingan di state fair, Biennale Ballarat secara khusus menjemput hasil seni AI, menerima lebih 100 penyertaan dari seluruh dunia. Dua puluh karya disenarai pendek, termasuk karya Morganna Magee, 'A Friend in Need'—gambar kanggaru berlengan seperti manusia memeluk makhluk asing. Menurut para juri festival, penyertaan menampilkan penggunaan AI yang penuh imaginasi dengan daya tarikan visual yang kuat. Namun, kebangkitan seni AI turut menimbulkan isu etika dan hak cipta dalam kalangan profesional kreatif. Nordenskiöld mengakui rasa teruja dan juga kebimbangan tentang seni AI, berkata, 'Saya faham ketakutan terhadap AI dan anggap ia sihat, tetapi saya melihatnya sebagai rakan sekerja.' Pemenang lain termasuk artis Australia, Hanna Silver. Imej bertona sepia beliau, 'Robot Intermarriage, Melbourne 1895, 2023,' memaparkan lelaki abad ke-19 memegang tangan robot di jalan raya Melbourne, dihasilkan berdasarkan arahan beliau kepada Midjourney. Imej tersebut terpilih sebagai pilihan penonton oleh lebih 1,000 pengunjung festival. Walaupun Midjourney tidak sepenuhnya memenuhi arahan Silver—gambar menunjukkan robot mengahwini seorang lelaki, bukannya trem—beliau tetap suka dengan elemen mengejut AI dalam seni, berkata, 'Banyak perkara saya rasa menarik tentang gambar ini. Dan cinta tetap cinta.'

article_content: A four-year-old British boy has drowned after falling into his grandparents’ swimming pool on Spain’s Costa del Sol. Relatives tried to save him after finding him floating in the water at the start of a family holiday in Cartama, near Malaga. The boy, named locally as Shae Colford, had arrived with his parents and a sibling on Saturday. He was staying at his grandparents' house in Cartama when the incident occurred. An autopsy is scheduled, and an investigating judge has been assigned to the case. Police have stated that all evidence points to the child’s death being a tragic accident. Police and paramedics were alerted at around 6pm yesterday after the boy’s mother saw him in the water and pulled him out. The incident took place at a house located next to the main road connecting the villages of Coin and Cartama, about a 20-minute drive inland from Malaga. Shae was believed to be the youngest of two children and had traveled to Spain with his family to visit his expatriate grandparents. A spokesperson for the Guardia Civil said: 'The autopsy is yet to take place but we are treating it as a tragic accident.' Spanish media dubbed the day 'Black Sunday' for drowning deaths, citing two other fatalities—one involving a 50-year-old man found in the sea near Torrox, and another involving a 46-year-old Romanian woman who drowned off the coast of Castellon earlier that day.
translated_content: Seorang kanak-kanak lelaki British berusia empat tahun telah lemas selepas terjatuh ke dalam kolam renang milik datuk dan neneknya di Costa del Sol, Sepanyol. Keluarga cuba menyelamatkannya selepas menemui beliau terapung di dalam air pada permulaan percutian keluarga di Cartama, berhampiran Malaga. Kanak-kanak itu, yang dikenali sebagai Shae Colford, tiba bersama ibu bapa dan adik-beradiknya pada hari Sabtu. Dia menginap di rumah datuk dan neneknya di Cartama ketika kejadian berlaku. Bedah siasat dijadualkan, dan seorang hakim penyiasat telah dilantik untuk menyiasat kes tersebut. Polis menyatakan bahawa semua bukti menunjukkan kematian anak itu adalah satu kemalangan tragis. Polis dan paramedik dimaklumkan sekitar jam 6 petang semalam selepas ibu kanak-kanak itu melihat beliau di dalam air dan menariknya keluar. Kejadian berlaku di sebuah rumah yang terletak di sebelah jalan utama yang menghubungkan kampung Coin dan Cartama, kira-kira 20 minit memandu dari Malaga. Shae dipercayai anak bongsu daripada dua beradik dan telah datang ke Sepanyol bersama keluarganya untuk melawat datuk dan nenek yang tinggal di luar negara. Seorang jurucakap Guardia Civil berkata: 'Bedah siasat masih belum dijalankan tetapi kami menganggapnya sebagai kemalangan tragis.' Media Sepanyol menamakan hari itu sebagai 'Ahad Hitam' untuk kejadian lemas, dengan dua kematian lain—seorang lelaki berumur 50 tahun ditemui di laut berhampiran Torrox, dan seorang wanita Romania berumur 46 tahun yang lemas di pantai Castellon pada awal hari yang sama.

article_content: Rwanda's President Paul Kagame has confirmed he will run for re-election in August 2024, seeking a fourth presidential term. At age 66, Kagame expressed gratitude for the confidence of Rwandans in an interview with Jeune Afrique, stating he will serve as long as he is able. Kagame, in power since June 2000, has consistently won presidential elections by overwhelming margins: 93% in 2010, 98.6% in 2017, and 95.05% in 2003. Constitutional amendments from a 2015 referendum allow him to seek two additional five-year terms after this current term, potentially keeping him in office through 2034. Rwanda has made significant socioeconomic progress since the 1994 genocide, with some international observers describing it as an African success story. However, critics highlight government crackdowns on free speech, restrictions on independent media, and limited space for political opposition. Instances have included presidential hopefuls Victoire Ingabire Umuhoza and Diane Rwigara being barred from running, and reports of dissidents, such as Patrick Karegeya, facing severe repercussions including assassination. Such actions have fueled doubts about the fairness of Rwanda’s elections and the actual degree of public support for Kagame. While Rwanda maintains the structures and symbols of democracy, many analysts describe its governance as authoritarian. Kagame's approach has been praised by some leaders in the region. Guinea’s military leader, Colonel Mamadi Doumbouya, who came to power following a 2021 coup, called Kagame’s style of governance an ‘African reference’ and praised him during recent official visits. At the 2023 United Nations General Assembly, Doumbouya critiqued Western models of governance as difficult to adapt to African realities. Kagame has also argued that democracy is not solely a Western ideal and labeled some external criticism as interference. Afrobarometer research from January 2023 shows that a majority of Africans—including 77% of Guineans—support democracy and favor stronger democratic institutions. Most survey respondents rejected military governments and autocratic leaders. Despite claims by some in power, survey data suggests Africans widely value democracy. Even though democracy is not without flaws, it is broadly seen as the best route to peaceful development. Much of Africa’s democratization in the 20th century was a homegrown reaction to colonial injustices, not a product of Western pressure. Historical examples like South Africa’s 1995 Freedom Charter highlight indigenous support for multi-racial democracy. Still, full democratic participation remains elusive for many Africans due to persistent authoritarian tendencies. In conclusion, critics argue that Rwanda’s governance under Kagame is less a model of democracy and more an example of strongman rule. Both Rwandans and other Africans are seen as deserving genuine democratic governance. Whether Kagame should run again remains a subject of debate. translated_content: Presiden Rwanda, Paul Kagame, telah mengesahkan bahawa beliau akan bertanding semula dalam pilihan raya presiden pada Ogos 2024 untuk merebut penggal keempat. Pada usia 66 tahun, Kagame menzahirkan penghargaan atas kepercayaan rakyat Rwanda dalam satu temu bual dengan Jeune Afrique, dan berkata beliau akan berkhidmat selagi mampu. Kagame, menerajui negara sejak Jun 2000, memenangi pilihan raya presiden dengan majoriti besar: 93% pada 2010, 98.6% pada 2017, dan 95.05% pada 2003. Pindaan perlembagaan melalui referendum pada tahun 2015 membenarkan beliau bertanding untuk dua penggal lima tahun tambahan selepas penggal semasa, yang bererti beliau mungkin kekal memegang jawatan sehingga 2034. Rwanda telah mencatat kemajuan sosioekonomi yang ketara sejak tragedi pembunuhan beramai-ramai tahun 1994, bahkan diiktiraf oleh beberapa pemerhati antarabangsa sebagai kisah kejayaan Afrika. Namun, pengkritik menyorot tindakan kerajaan mengekang kebebasan bersuara, had terhadap media bebas, dan ruang terhad untuk pembangkang politik. Terdapat insiden, seperti calon presiden Victoire Ingabire Umuhoza dan Diane Rwigara yang dihalang bertanding, serta laporan mengenai penentang kerajaan seperti Patrick Karegeya yang menerima akibat serius termasuk pembunuhan. Tindakan-tindakan ini menimbulkan keraguan terhadap keadilan pilihan raya di Rwanda dan sokongan sebenar rakyat kepada Kagame. Walaupun Rwanda mempamerkan struktur serta simbol demokrasi, ramai penganalisis menyifatkan pemerintahannya sebagai autoritarian. Pendekatan Kagame dipuji oleh beberapa pemimpin serantau. Ketua tentera Guinea, Kolonel Mamadi Doumbouya, yang mengambil alih kuasa melalui rampasan kuasa pada 2021, menyifatkan gaya pemerintahan Kagame sebagai 'rujukan Afrika' dan memujinya dalam lawatan rasmi baru-baru ini. Pada Perhimpunan Agung PBB 2023, Doumbouya mengkritik model pentadbiran Barat yang dianggap sukar disesuaikan dengan realiti Afrika. Kagame juga menyatakan bahawa demokrasi bukan eksklusif cita-cita Barat dan menganggap sesetengah kritikan luar sebagai campur tangan. Tinjauan Afrobarometer pada Januari 2023 mendapati majoriti rakyat Afrika—termasuk 77% rakyat Guinea—menyokong demokrasi dan mahukan institusi yang lebih demokratik. Kebanyakan responden menolak pemerintahan tentera dan pemimpin autokratik. Ini membuktikan bahawa rakyat Afrika sangat menghargai demokrasi. Walaupun demokrasi mempunyai kelemahan, ia secara umumnya dilihat sebagai jalan terbaik ke arah pembangunan yang aman. Pendemokrasian di Afrika pada abad ke-20 kebanyakannya didorong oleh reaksi tempatan terhadap ketidakadilan penjajahan, bukannya tekanan dari Barat. Sejarah seperti Piagam Kebebasan Afrika Selatan 1995 menunjukkan sokongan tempatan terhadap demokrasi masyarakat majmuk. Namun, ramai warga Afrika masih belum merasai penglibatan demokrasi sepenuhnya akibat kecenderungan pemerintahan autoritarian yang berterusan. Kesimpulannya, pengkritik berpendapat pentadbiran Rwanda di bawah Kagame bukanlah lambang kejayaan demokrasi, tetapi lebih kepada pemerintahan individu berkuasa. Rakyat Rwanda dan rakyat Afrika wajar mendapat pemerintahan demokrasi sejati. Sama ada Kagame wajar bertanding lagi kekal menjadi perdebatan. Pendapat dalam artikel ini adalah pandangan penulis dan tidak semestinya mencerminkan pendirian editorial Al Jazeera.

article_content: Marmite has sparked controversy with a new television commercial that parodies animal cruelty documentaries. In the ad, actors dressed as inspectors raid households, 'rescuing' neglected jars of Marmite while an emotive soundtrack, narrated by esteemed BBC journalist Michael Buerk, plays in the background. The commercial features scenes such as a man appearing distressed on his doorstep and children's faces blurred, mirroring the style of actual investigative programs. The premise of the commercial is that some Marmite owners have neglected their jars, prompting mock 'RSPCA' inspectors to intervene and 'rehome' the spreads. Marmite, known for its slogan 'Like It, Hate It, Just Don’t Forget It,' apparently miscalculated the public response. After the advertisement aired during a break in ITV’s Coronation Street, the brand's Facebook and YouTube pages were inundated with critical comments. Some viewers condemned the advert as being in poor taste and accused it of trivializing both animal and child cruelty. One Facebook user stated, 'Your new advert is in very bad taste. Animal abuse is no laughing matter and it's wrong to use it as a marketing scheme.' Another said, 'Disgraceful advert! The implications are dreadful and shame on Michael Buerk for taking part.' Despite the criticism, the ad was also met with support from fans who appreciated its humor and defended its approach as light-hearted. In response to the backlash, Marmite apologized to offended viewers on its website, stating, 'Sorry you feel that way.' The company emphasized that the advert was set in a fictional world focused on 'rescuing' unused Marmite jars and that no actual animals were harmed, with only a family pet briefly shown. The RSPCA acknowledged the concerns and indicated a willingness to collaborate with Marmite on animal welfare initiatives. A spokesperson said, 'We understand that animal lovers are concerned on our behalf—people either love the advert or hate it. We plan to talk to the makers of Marmite about working together on animal welfare.' Unilever, Marmite’s manufacturer, reiterated that offending viewers was never their intention. A spokesperson said, 'This is the first time Marmite has appeared on television in two years. We made every effort to ensure the commercial would entertain, and our testing indicated strong performance and clear branding. We hope viewers see it as the light-hearted, unmistakably Marmite advert it was meant to be.'
translated_content: Marmite telah mencetuskan kontroversi dengan iklan televisyen terbarunya yang menyindir dokumentari kekejaman haiwan. Dalam iklan itu, pelakon berpakaian seperti pegawai melakukan serbuan ke rumah, 'menyelamatkan' balang Marmite yang diabaikan dengan diiringi runut bunyi menyentuh hati yang disampaikan oleh wartawan BBC terkenal, Michael Buerk. Iklan ini memaparkan adegan seperti seorang lelaki yang kelihatan sedih di depan pintunya dan wajah kanak-kanak dikaburkan, sama seperti gaya program penyiasatan sebenar. Premis iklan ini ialah ada pemilik Marmite yang mengabaikan balang mereka, lalu 'pegawai RSPCA' palsu tampil untuk 'mengambil semula' sapuan tersebut. Marmite yang menggunakan slogan 'Like It, Hate It, Just Don’t Forget It' nampaknya tersilap menjangka reaksi orang ramai. Selepas iklan ini disiarkan sewaktu rehat Coronation Street di ITV, laman Facebook dan YouTube mereka dipenuhi komen-komen kritikal. Sebilangan penonton mengkritik iklan ini sebagai tidak sensitif dan menuduhnya memandang ringan isu kekejaman terhadap haiwan dan kanak-kanak. Seorang pengguna Facebook menulis, 'Iklan baru anda sangat tidak sensitif. Penyalahgunaan haiwan bukan perkara lawak dan tak wajar digunakan untuk pemasaran.' Seorang lagi berkata, 'Iklan memalukan! Implikasinya sangat teruk dan memalukan Michael Buerk kerana turut serta.' Walaupun ada kritikan, iklan ini juga mendapat sokongan daripada peminat yang menganggap ia lucu dan mempertahankan sifat santainya. Sebagai respons kepada kecaman, Marmite memohon maaf kepada yang tersinggung di laman web mereka dengan berkata, 'Maaf anda rasa begitu.' Syarikat itu menekankan bahawa iklan ini berlatar dunia fiksyen yang memberi tumpuan kepada 'menyelamatkan' balang Marmite tidak digunakan dan tiada haiwan sebenar dicederakan, cuma haiwan peliharaan keluarga dipaparkan sebentar. RSPCA mengakui kebimbangan tersebut dan menyatakan hasrat untuk bekerjasama dengan Marmite dalam inisiatif kebajikan haiwan. Jurucakapnya berkata, 'Kami faham pencinta haiwan bimbang untuk kami—penonton sama ada suka atau tidak iklan ini. Kami bercadang berbincang dengan Marmite mengenai kerjasama kebajikan haiwan.' Unilever, pengeluar Marmite, menegaskan bahawa bukan niat mereka untuk menyinggung perasaan sesiapa. Jurucakap mereka berkata, 'Ini kali pertama Marmite muncul di televisyen dalam dua tahun. Kami berusaha untuk menghasilkan iklan yang menghiburkan dan ujian kami menunjukkan prestasi yang bagus serta penjenamaan jelas. Kami harap penonton menikmati iklan santai Marmite seperti yang dimaksudkan.'

article_content: During the Diwali festival season, India's trade landscape revealed some underlying concerns as the country's merchandise trade deficit widened to a record $31.5 billion in October 2023. This increase was primarily driven by a surge in imports, particularly for commodities like oil and gold, which saw rising prices. Research firm Nomura highlighted that strong investment demand and government measures to control food inflation also contributed to the record-high deficit. Despite signs of a potential recovery in exports, the trade deficit jumped from $19.4 billion in September to $31.5 billion in October. India’s exports grew by 6.21% year-on-year to $33.57 billion in October, while imports rose even more sharply to $65.03 billion. Nomura’s analysts, Aurodeep Nandi and Sonal Varma, suggested this 'Diwali effect' is expected to ease in November. However, persistent high prices for oil and gold, along with steady demand and ongoing trade policies, could keep the monthly trade deficit in the $23–25 billion range unless there is a significant drop in oil prices. In October, export growth rebounded to 6.2% year-on-year, following a decline of 2.6% in September. This increase was partly due to a favourable base effect, but the momentum in export recovery remains weak. As a major importer of crude oil, India felt the impact of higher global oil prices, with crude reaching $90 per barrel in September. Seasonal demand during the festivals also pushed up imports of gold, silver, and jewelry, increasing India’s import bill. Imports of pulses and fruits & vegetables rose as the country worked to address shortages of essential food items. Meanwhile, rice exports fell by 19.6% in October due to export restrictions, and coal imports climbed to close gaps between supply and demand. Demand also strengthened for machinery and electronics, partly as consumers and businesses restocked ahead of the festive period. India’s services sector provided some relief, with services exports rising by 13.4% in October after declining 2.7% in September. The country’s services trade surplus reached $14.4 billion in October, up from $13.8 billion in September, helping to counter the rising goods trade deficit. Nomura estimates that India’s current account deficit (CAD) will widen to 2.2% of GDP in the fourth quarter of 2023, increasing from 0.8% in the previous quarter. However, for the full fiscal year, India's CAD is expected to remain manageable at 1.4% of GDP, down from 2.0% in the previous year, partly due to higher services exports. In unrelated financial news, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Thursday tightened capital requirements for unsecured retail loans, directing banks to hold more capital and to implement board-approved risk controls to manage growth in consumer lending. Elsewhere, the Ministry of Mines requested that Hindustan Zinc Ltd (HZL) secure formal government approval for any restructuring or creation of separate business entities.
translated_content: Semasa musim perayaan Diwali, landskap perdagangan India menunjukkan beberapa kebimbangan apabila defisit dagangan barangan negara itu melebar ke paras rekod $31.5 bilion pada Oktober 2023. Peningkatan ini didorong terutamanya oleh lonjakan import, terutamanya komoditi seperti minyak dan emas yang mengalami kenaikan harga. Firma penyelidikan Nomura menekankan bahawa permintaan pelaburan yang kukuh dan langkah kerajaan untuk mengawal inflasi makanan turut menyumbang kepada defisit rekod ini. Walaupun terdapat tanda pemulihan dalam eksport, defisit dagangan meningkat daripada $19.4 bilion pada September kepada $31.5 bilion pada Oktober. Eksport India meningkat sebanyak 6.21% tahun ke tahun kepada $33.57 bilion pada Oktober, manakala import melonjak lebih tinggi kepada $65.03 bilion. Penganalisis Nomura, Aurodeep Nandi dan Sonal Varma, mencadangkan 'kesan Diwali' ini dijangka reda pada November. Namun, harga tinggi minyak dan emas yang berterusan, permintaan yang stabil dan polisi dagangan sedia ada boleh menyebabkan defisit dagangan bulanan kekal dalam julat $23–25 bilion melainkan berlaku penurunan harga minyak yang ketara. Pada Oktober, pertumbuhan eksport melonjak kepada 6.2% tahun ke tahun selepas penurunan 2.6% pada September. Kenaikan ini sebahagiannya disebabkan oleh asas perbandingan yang menguntungkan, tetapi momentum pemulihan eksport masih lemah. Sebagai pengimport utama minyak mentah, India merasai kesan kenaikan harga minyak global, dengan harga minyak mentah mencecah $90 setong pada September. Permintaan bermusim semasa musim perayaan turut meningkatkan import emas, perak dan barang kemas, menambah bil import India. Import kekacang, buah dan sayur juga meningkat ketika negara berusaha mengatasi kekurangan bekalan makanan asas. Sementara itu, eksport beras merosot sebanyak 19.6% pada Oktober akibat sekatan eksport dan import arang batu turut naik untuk menampung kekurangan bekalan. Permintaan terhadap mesin dan barangan elektronik juga mengukuh, sebahagiannya kerana pengguna dan perniagaan menambah stok menjelang musim perayaan. Sektor perkhidmatan India memberi sedikit kelegaan, dengan eksport perkhidmatan meningkat 13.4% pada Oktober selepas menyusut 2.7% pada September. Lebihan dagangan perkhidmatan negara mencecah $14.4 bilion pada Oktober, naik daripada $13.8 bilion pada September, membantu mengimbangi defisit barangan. Nomura menganggarkan defisit akaun semasa (CAD) India akan melebar kepada 2.2% daripada KDNK pada suku keempat 2023, meningkat daripada 0.8% pada suku sebelumnya. Namun, untuk keseluruhan tahun fiskal, CAD dijangka kekal terkawal pada 1.4% daripada KDNK, turun daripada 2.0% tahun sebelumnya, sebahagiannya akibat peningkatan eksport perkhidmatan. Dalam berita kewangan lain, Bank Rizab India (RBI) pada Khamis mengetatkan keperluan modal untuk pinjaman runcit tanpa cagaran, mengarahkan bank menambah simpanan modal dan melaksanakan kawalan risiko yang diluluskan lembaga untuk mengurus pertumbuhan pinjaman pengguna. Di tempat lain, Kementerian Perlombongan meminta Hindustan Zinc Ltd (HZL) mendapatkan kelulusan rasmi kerajaan untuk sebarang penyusunan semula atau penciptaan entiti perniagaan berasingan.

article_content: Saudi Arabia is now virtually certain to host the men's FIFA World Cup in 2034 after Australia stepped back from the bidding process ahead of FIFA's deadline. With the only other major contender dropping out, the kingdom stands as the sole candidate for the tournament, pending official confirmation from FIFA next year—a move that now seems almost guaranteed. This marks a significant milestone in Saudi Arabia’s extensive efforts to position itself as a central player in global sports. The country has invested huge sums in attracting international athletes, acquiring English Premier League club Newcastle United, organizing high-profile boxing matches, and launching new ventures like the LIV Golf tour. Australia, rather than competing for the World Cup, will focus on bids for the 2029 Club World Cup and the 2026 Women’s Asian Cup. According to Football Australia, they believe they have strong chances to host both events, especially after their recent success co-hosting the Women's World Cup with New Zealand, and with Brisbane set to host the 2032 Olympics. FIFA fast-tracked the 2034 World Cup selection, making only Asian and Oceanian football associations eligible to submit bids, and gave them less than a month to finalize their submissions and secure government guarantees. Soon after the announcement, Saudi Arabia declared its intention to bid, with the Asian Football Confederation throwing its support behind the kingdom. Like Qatar, which hosted the 2022 edition during the cooler months to avoid severe heat, Saudi Arabia may shift the timing of the tournament away from the traditional summer months. Saudi Arabia is already slated to host the men's Asian Cup in 2027 and is investing in building or upgrading stadiums, as FIFA requires at least 14 venues for the 48-team tournament. However, human rights organizations have voiced concerns about the living and working conditions of the kingdom’s estimated 13 million migrant workers, particularly in light of the issues observed during Qatar's preparations for the 2022 World Cup. Critics accuse FIFA of disregarding these issues; Minky Worden of Human Rights Watch argued that awarding the tournament to Saudi Arabia would undermine FIFA’s stated commitments to human rights.

Ini menandakan satu pencapaian besar dalam usaha bersungguh-sungguh Arab Saudi untuk menjadi pemain utama dalam sukan global. Negara itu telah melakukan pelaburan besar untuk menarik atlet antarabangsa, mengambil alih kelab Liga Perdana Inggeris Newcastle United, menganjurkan perlawanan tinju terkenal dan melancarkan inisiatif baharu seperti LIV Golf tour. Australia memilih untuk tidak menawar sebagai tuan rumah Piala Dunia, sebaliknya memfokuskan bidaan kepada Piala Dunia Kelab FIFA 2029 dan Piala Asia Wanita 2026. Football Australia menyatakan mereka yakin berpeluang tinggi menjadi tuan rumah kedua-dua acara itu, lebih-lebih lagi selepas kejayaan bersama New Zealand untuk Piala Dunia Wanita, selain Brisbane dijadual menjadi tuan rumah Sukan Olimpik 2032. FIFA mempercepatkan proses pemilihan tuan rumah Piala Dunia 2034, dengan hanya memberi peluang kepada persatuan bola sepak Asia dan Oceania untuk membida dan memberikan masa kurang sebulan untuk melengkapkan permohonan serta mendapatkan sokongan kerajaan. Sejurus selepas pengumuman itu, Arab Saudi segera mengumumkan hasratnya, disokong sepenuhnya oleh Konfederasi Bola Sepak Asia. Seperti Qatar yang menganjurkan edisi 2022 pada bulan lebih sejuk bagi mengelakkan cuaca panas melampau, Arab Saudi juga berkemungkinan menukar tarikh kejohanan ke luar musim panas tradisional. Arab Saudi juga dijadualkan menjadi tuan rumah Piala Asia lelaki 2027 dan kini dalam usaha untuk membina atau menaiktaraf stadium, memandangkan FIFA menetapkan syarat sekurang-kurangnya 14 venue untuk kejohanan 48 pasukan. Bagaimanapun, badan hak asasi manusia mengutarakan kebimbangan terhadap keadaan kehidupan dan pekerjaan kira-kira 13 juta pekerja migran di Arab Saudi, terutama selepas isu yang berlaku ketika persediaan Piala Dunia di Qatar. Pihak pengkritik menuduh FIFA mengabaikan perkara ini; Minky Worden dari Human Rights Watch menegaskan bahawa pemberian hak penganjuran kepada Arab Saudi akan menjejaskan komitmen FIFA terhadap hak asasi manusia.

article_content:
In an era dominated by video-advertising boards and interactive screens, a classic billboard in Pennsylvania is turning heads for a different reason. Spearheaded by academics Jon Rubin, 50, and Pablo Garcia, the project known as 'The Last Billboard' transforms an old-fashioned structure into an evolving public art piece. Each month, the pair invites an artist to craft a message, which is then displayed using large wooden letters mounted on a metal rack.

The messages featured are as diverse as their creators. Some, like poet Joshua Beckman, share phone numbers and field calls from the public, reading poetry or listening to others recite verse. Others provide social commentary, as seen when Charlie Humphrey used his platform to comment on Facebook and social media culture. Marc Horowitz also made his phone number public, spending a month chatting and offering advice to callers.

Not all the board’s messages come from established artists—one memorable contribution came from 11-year-old Maude Liotta, who listed curious ideas for her blog such as 'Who invented tape?' and 'When did "skinny" become fashionable?'. The notes range from witty remarks and short poems to conceptual art statements like 'These words hold no power over you.'

While submissions are mainly from artists contacted by Jon or Pablo, suggestions from the internet or via email are sometimes featured. For Rubin, the project is both a celebration and a lament for traditional billboarding, which he fears may soon become obsolete amid instant digital messaging. 'A month is a long time in today’s world of instant digital messaging,' Jon remarks. The Last Billboard serves as a creative homage to slower, more tangible means of public communication.
translated_content:
Dalam era papan iklan video dan skrin interaktif yang menguasai, sebuah papan iklan klasik di Pennsylvania mencuri tumpuan dengan cara yang unik. Projek hasil inisiatif Jon Rubin, 50, dan Pablo Garcia ini, dikenali sebagai 'The Last Billboard', menukar papan billboard lama menjadi karya seni awam yang sentiasa berubah. Setiap bulan, mereka menjemput artis untuk menghasilkan mesej, dan mesej itu dipamerkan menggunakan huruf kayu besar yang disusun di rak logam.

Mesej-mesej yang ditampilkan sangat pelbagai mengikut penciptanya. Ada seperti penyair Joshua Beckman, meletakkan nombor telefon dan menerima panggilan orang ramai—membaca puisi atau mendengar puisi mereka. Charlie Humphrey pula menggunakan papan tersebut untuk memberi ulasan sosial tentang budaya Facebook dan media sosial. Marc Horowitz turut memaparkan nombor telefonnya dan melayan panggilan sepanjang sebulan, memberikan nasihat dan berbual.

Bukan semua mesej datang daripada artis terkenal—antara yang menarik ialah sumbangan Maude Liotta yang berumur 11 tahun, dengan idea blog seperti 'Siapa cipta pita pelekat?' dan 'Bila "kurus" mula jadi fesyen?'. Nota atas papan ini merangkumi jenaka, puisi ringkas dan kenyataan seni seperti 'Perkataan ini tiada kuasa ke atas anda.'

Walaupun kebanyakan mesej diambil daripada artis jemputan Jon atau Pablo, cadangan dari internet atau email juga dipertimbangkan. Bagi Rubin, projek ini adalah satu penghargaan dan juga lamunan terhadap papan iklan tradisional yang dijangkakan akan pupus dek pesanan digital yang pantas. 'Sebulan sangat lama dalam dunia pesanan digital segera hari ini,' kata Jon. The Last Billboard ialah penghormatan kreatif untuk komunikasi awam yang lebih perlahan dan berasas.

article_content: A crime boss and his associates have been sentenced to a total of 17 years in prison after confronting a rival’s family at their home in Guisborough, Teesside, armed with imitation firearms and baseball bats. The incident left a mother and her two children terrified and seeking refuge upstairs as Simon Thirlwall Senior, 41, and his group arrived in convoy. This attack marked the culmination of a series of disputes between Thirlwall and Sidney Kellam Hodgson. Prosecutors revealed that Thirlwall had previously threatened to kill Hodgson. The confrontation involved realistic imitation firearms and bat-wielding assailants. Alongside Simon Thirlwall Senior, his son Aaron Thirlwall, 22, Steven Bremner, 23, and David Richardson, 25, were all sentenced for their roles in the attack. The four men, with a collective 167 prior offenses, were described as members of an organized crime group with significant unexplained wealth. The attackers believed the Hodgson family had maligned them, leading to a series of retaliatory exchanges. During the night of October 7 of the previous year, the group sought out Hodgson at his home, forcing the front door and causing damage while searching for him, ultimately chasing him and ramming his vehicle nearby. After fleeing, the group retrieved £69,000 in concealed cash. Police subsequently discovered imitation shotguns, a samurai sword, and other weapons near their homes. Simon Thirlwall was arrested at a Leeds hotel with nearly £50,000 in cash, and additional amounts were found with Aaron Thirlwall. All four men admitted violent disorder, with the Thirlwalls also pleading guilty to money laundering. Defense lawyers argued the incident stemmed from a misunderstanding, and some defendants expressed remorse and aspirations for rehabilitation. Judge Simon Bourne-Arton QC sentenced Simon Thirlwall to six years, describing him as the leader. Aaron Thirlwall received four years and five months. Bremner was sentenced to four years, and Richardson to two years and eight months. The judge concluded, 'The court will not tolerate criminals seeking to resolve grievances through violence. You were driven by revenge.'
translated_content: Seorang ketua jenayah dan kumpulannya telah dijatuhkan hukuman penjara selama keseluruhan 17 tahun selepas menyerang keluarga seteru mereka di rumah di Guisborough, Teesside, dengan senjata api tiruan dan kayu besbol. Insiden itu menyebabkan seorang ibu dan dua orang anaknya ketakutan dan terpaksa berlindung di tingkat atas apabila Simon Thirlwall Senior, 41, bersama kumpulannya tiba secara berkonvoi. Serangan ini merupakan kemuncak kepada siri perselisihan antara Thirlwall dan Sidney Kellam Hodgson. Pendakwa raya mendedahkan Thirlwall pernah mengugut akan membunuh Hodgson sebelum ini. Insiden tersebut melibatkan senjata api tiruan yang kelihatan nyata serta kayu besbol. Selain Simon Thirlwall Senior, anaknya Aaron Thirlwall, 22, Steven Bremner, 23, dan David Richardson, 25, turut dijatuhkan hukuman kerana peranan mereka dalam serangan itu. Keempat-empat lelaki itu, yang mempunyai 167 kesalahan lampau secara kolektif, digambarkan sebagai anggota kumpulan jenayah terancang dengan kekayaan yang tidak dapat dijelaskan. Para penyerang percaya keluarga Hodgson telah memburuk-burukkan mereka, menyebabkan berlakunya beberapa tindakan balas. Pada malam 7 Oktober tahun lalu, kumpulan ini telah mencari Hodgson di rumahnya, memaksa pintu utama dan menyebabkan kerosakan ketika mencari beliau, sebelum mengejar serta melanggar kenderaan Hodgson. Selepas melarikan diri, kumpulan tersebut mengambil kembali wang tunai £69,000 yang disorokkan. Polis kemudiannya menemui senapang tiruan, pedang samurai dan beberapa senjata lain berhampiran rumah mereka. Simon Thirlwall ditahan di sebuah hotel di Leeds dengan hampir £50,000 tunai, manakala sejumlah wang juga ditemui bersama Aaron Thirlwall. Kesemua mereka mengaku bersalah atas kesalahan kekacauan ganas, manakala keluarga Thirlwall juga mengaku bersalah atas pengubahan wang haram. Peguam bela berhujah insiden itu berpunca daripada salah faham, dan ada antara tertuduh yang menunjukkan penyesalan serta ingin berubah. Hakim Simon Bourne-Arton QC menjatuhkan hukuman enam tahun penjara kepada Simon Thirlwall yang digambarkan sebagai ketua kumpulan. Aaron Thirlwall dihukum empat tahun lima bulan penjara. Bremner dijatuhi empat tahun penjara, sementara Richardson dua tahun lapan bulan. Hakim menegaskan, 'Mahkamah tidak akan bertoleransi terhadap penjenayah yang ingin menyelesaikan masalah dengan keganasan. Anda didorong oleh dendam.'

article_content: Vietnam's agricultural sector is thriving thanks to a favorable tropical climate, abundant natural resources, and local policies prioritizing sustainable farming. This growth has made Vietnam an increasingly popular destination for U.S. companies sourcing high-quality agricultural products such as rice, green coffee, cashews, and walnuts. According to Vietnam's Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development, the sector grew by 3.36% in 2022, the highest increase in the last three years, fueled by government support and incentives. The U.S. has now become Vietnam’s largest agricultural trading partner, overtaking China and Cambodia, with export turnover reaching $10.8 billion, according to the Census Bureau. One key example is the rise of Vietnamese coffee in the international market. Nguyen Coffee Supply, founded in 2018 by Sahra Nguyen, a first-generation Vietnamese American, has played a significant role in transforming the perception of Vietnamese robusta coffee. Previously overlooked, robusta is now recognized for its high caffeine content, antioxidant benefits, and environmental resilience. Nguyen Coffee Supply promotes transparency and elevates robusta coffee, challenging previous negative perceptions. Vietnam accounts for over half the world's robusta supply, positioning the country as a leader in this segment. Local chains like Highlands Coffee, The Coffee House, Phuc Long, and Trung Nguyên Legend dominate Vietnam's coffee market, while Starbucks maintains a minimal presence, with just 0.9 locations per million people—the lowest ratio in Southeast Asia's six main economies. The U.S. market for Vietnamese coffee is expanding rapidly. Nguyen Coffee Supply has seen 1,100% year-over-year retail distribution growth at Whole Foods and other regional stores. Other brands such as Sang and Nam Coffee are also entering the U.S. market, and Trung Nguyên Legend recently opened its first U.S. cafe in Little Saigon, California. Vietnam's attractiveness as a sourcing destination extends beyond coffee. Favorable labor market conditions and strengthening U.S.-Vietnam ties make the country appealing for American companies, especially amid global supply chain shifts away from China. Dominic Purpura, CEO of Mela, a premium watermelon juice brand, praised Vietnamese partners for their partnership mindset and the stable business environment. Farmers in the Mekong Delta are shifting from rice to high-value crops like watermelon, mango, jackfruit, and coconut, which offer up to VND 200 million ($8,200) in profit per hectare annually according to Dong Thap province’s Department of Agriculture and Rural Development. Watermelons, for example, can be harvested in just 50-60 days. The nutrient-rich Mekong Delta not only supports crop growth but also provides vital transportation routes for agricultural products. In Bến Tre Province—a key coconut-producing area—farmers use natural waterways to transport coconuts, which are then processed in Ho Chi Minh City. CoAqua, a premium coconut water company, sources its coconuts from this region and employs unique processing methods for a caramelized taste. The company has reported 400% year-over-year growth, with distribution in major U.S. retailers like Sprouts and Wegmans. Vietnam’s commitment to sustainable farming and the pride of its producers are raising the country’s status as a supplier of premium-quality agricultural products internationally.

Amerika Syarikat kini menjadi rakan perdagangan pertanian terbesar Vietnam, mengatasi China dan Kemboja, dengan nilai eksport mencecah $10.8 bilion menurut Biro Bancian. Salah satu contoh utama ialah peningkatan kopi Vietnam di pasaran antarabangsa. Dahulu kurang dihargai, robusta kini diiktiraf kerana kandungan kafein yang tinggi, manfaat antioksidan, dan daya tahan terhadap persekitaran. Rangkaian tempatan seperti Highlands Coffee, The Coffee House, Phuc Long, dan Trung Nguyên Legend mendominasi pasaran kopi Vietnam, sementara Starbucks hanya mempunyai 0.9 cawangan bagi setiap sejuta orang—nisbah terendah di antara enam ekonomi utama Asia Tenggara. Permintaan kopi Vietnam di pasaran Amerika Syarikat berkembang dengan pesat. Nguyen Coffee Supply mencatat pertumbuhan pengedaran runcit tahunan sebanyak 1,100% di Whole Foods dan kedai serantau lain. Daya tarikan Vietnam sebagai destinasi sumber melangkaui kopi. Keadaan pasaran buruh yang kompetitif dan hubungan AS-Vietnam yang kukuh menarik minat syarikat Amerika, terutamanya di tengah perubahan rantaian bekalan global dari China. Dominic Purpura, CEO Mela—jenama jus tembikai premium, memuji rakan kongsi Vietnam atas sikap kerjasama dan persekitaran perniagaan yang stabil. Petani di Delta Mekong beralih daripada menanam padi ke tanaman bernilai tinggi seperti tembikai, mangga, nangka, dan kelapa yang menawarkan keuntungan hingga VND 200 juta ($8,200) per hektar setiap tahun menurut Jabatan Pertanian dan Pembangunan Luar Bandar Dong Thap. Sebagai contoh, tembikai boleh dituai dalam masa 50-60 hari sahaja. Delta Mekong yang kaya dengan nutrien bukan sahaja menyokong pertumbuhan tanaman tetapi juga menyediakan laluan pengangkutan penting untuk hasil pertanian. Di Wilayah Bến Tre—kawasan pengeluar kelapa utama—petani menggunakan saluran air semula jadi untuk mengangkut kelapa, yang kemudiannya diproses di Ho Chi Minh City. CoAqua, syarikat air kelapa premium, mendapatkan kelapanya dari kawasan ini dan menggunakan kaedah pemprosesan unik untuk rasa berkaramel. Syarikat ini mencatat pertumbuhan tahunan sebanyak 400%, dengan produk diedarkan di pasar raya utama AS seperti Sprouts dan Wegmans. Komitmen Vietnam terhadap pertanian lestari dan kebanggaan pengeluar tempatan menaikkan lagi reputasi negara sebagai pembekal produk pertanian berkualiti tinggi di persada dunia.

article_content: Disney+ is one of the most popular streaming services today, in part due to Disney’s vast portfolio of properties. The Disney+ app offers hundreds of hours of entertainment, including children’s Disney and Pixar movies, action-adventure films from the Star Wars and Marvel franchises, animated series like The Simpsons, and National Geographic documentaries. There is content available for every age group. At $8 per month for the basic plan, Disney+ remains one of the more affordable streaming platforms. There are several subscription tiers and bundle options available. Are Disney+ Black Friday deals likely? Looking at last year provides perspective. In 2022, Disney did not offer a Black Friday deal for Disney+. Instead, the price increased a few weeks after Black Friday, suggesting that a special deal is unlikely based on prior trends. However, this September, Disney briefly reduced the price of the basic Disney+ subscription from $8 to $2 per month for three months—a limited-time offer that indicates Disney is open to offering discounts at times. At present, while there are options to subscribe to Disney+, there are no standing discounts or free trials available. You need to purchase a subscription to use the service. The most cost-effective option is through the Disney Bundle, which combines Disney+ with other platforms. Disney+ and Hulu together (both ad-supported) cost $10 per month. For $15 per month, you can get Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN+ together (all with ads). Ad-free versions of these bundles are offered at higher prices. Bundling does not provide savings if you are only interested in Disney+, but can be economical if you plan to also use Hulu or ESPN+.

article_content: Geert Wilders, a Dutch politician recognized for his far-right and anti-Islam views, has achieved a major victory in the recent Dutch parliamentary elections. This result marks a pivotal moment in Dutch politics and is expected to have widespread implications across Europe. Born on September 6, 1963, in Venlo, Wilders was raised in a conservative Catholic household but left the church as he grew older. With studies in law and experience working in health insurance and social services, he developed an early understanding of public policy. Wilders began his political career with the People’s Party for Freedom and Democracy (VVD). However, he departed from the VVD in 2004 due to disagreements over issues such as the European Union and immigration—specifically the party's support for Turkey joining the EU. In 2006, Wilders established the Party for Freedom (PVV), which quickly gained prominence for its nationalist and anti-immigration positions. Wilders has consistently voiced strong criticism of Islam, advocating for policies such as banning the Quran and closing mosques, measures that have attracted both controversy and security threats. His tough stance on immigration, especially regarding Muslim-majority countries, is closely tied to his views on preserving Dutch cultural identity. Under Wilders’ leadership, the PVV has become a significant force in Dutch politics, symbolizing the growing influence of right-wing populism and Euroscepticism in Europe. Wilders has publicly supported a Dutch exit from the European Union, emphasizing concerns about national sovereignty. Wilders and the PVV's influence extend beyond national borders, shaping debates within the EU on issues like immigration and sovereignty. His rhetoric has contributed to the polarization of Dutch and European politics and has prompted other parties to reconsider their own policy positions. Despite these successes, analysts suggest Wilders will face challenges due to the coalition system in the Netherlands and strong checks within the political and judicial system—factors that may require him to moderate some of his more radical proposals to form a functioning government.

Keputusan ini menandakan satu detik penting dalam landskap politik negara itu dan dijangka memberi impak besar ke seluruh Eropah. Beliau berpendidikan dalam bidang undang-undang dan pernah bekerja dalam bidang insurans kesihatan serta perkhidmatan sosial, memberikan beliau pemahaman awal tentang dasar awam. Wilders memulakan kerjaya politiknya bersama Parti Rakyat untuk Kebebasan dan Demokrasi (VVD), namun keluar pada tahun 2004 kerana perbezaan pendapat mengenai isu Kesatuan Eropah dan imigresen—khususnya sokongan VVD terhadap kemasukan Turki ke dalam EU. Pada tahun 2006, beliau menubuhkan Parti untuk Kebebasan (PVV) yang segera mendapat perhatian kerana pendirian nasionalis dan anti-imigresen. Wilders kerap mengkritik Islam secara lantang, serta menyokong dasar melarang al-Quran dan menutup masjid, yang membawa kontroversi dan ancaman keselamatan. Pendekatan tegas beliau terhadap imigresen terutama dari negara majoriti Muslim sangat berkait dengan keinginannya mempertahankan identiti budaya Belanda. Di bawah kepimpinan Wilders, PVV menjadi kuasa utama dalam politik Belanda, melambangkan kebangkitan populisme kanan dan gerakan Euroskeptik di Eropah. Wilders secara terbuka menyokong Belanda keluar daripada EU, menekankan isu kedaulatan negara. Pengaruh Wilders dan PVV menjangkaui sempadan negara, mempengaruhi perdebatan dalam EU berhubung isu imigresen dan kedaulatan. Retorik beliau juga menyebabkan polarisasi politik dan mendorong parti-parti lain menilai semula pendirian mereka. Meskipun memperoleh kejayaan besar, penganalisis menjangkakan Wilders bakal menghadapi cabaran daripada sistem politik koalisi dan institusi Belanda—yang berkemungkinan memaksa beliau menyesuaikan beberapa cadangan radikal untuk membentuk kerajaan yang stabil.

article_content: The Director-General of the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC), Dr. Jean Kaseya, has called on African nations to take the lead in strengthening their public health systems. He made this call at a press briefing before the opening of the third International Conference on Public Health in Africa (CPHIA 2023), held in Lusaka, Zambia. The conference, themed 'Breaking Barriers: Repositioning Africa in the Global Health Architecture,' took place from November 27 to 30, 2023. Dr. Kaseya emphasized that improving public health systems is crucial to reduce vulnerability to disease outbreaks. 'We aim not only to position Africa but also Africans in the global health space,' he stated. He highlighted that African leaders have the capacity to unite the region and play a vital role in global health security. 'Today, we celebrate a significant moment as Africa hosts the world to discuss how we can overcome barriers. We must recognize and value Africa's contributions to global health,' he added. Prof. Margaret Gyapong, Director of the Institute of Health Research and Co-chair of CPHIA 2023, noted that Africa is experiencing rapid advancements in health technology. She explained that innovation is helping to bridge gaps in healthcare access and delivery across the continent. Prof. Gyapong credited robust collaborations among governments, private sector entities, and civil society organizations for these advancements. She emphasized that public-private partnerships are fostering knowledge exchange, resource mobilization, and technological improvements in public health. She also highlighted the leadership of African scientists in developing vaccines designed to address regional diseases such as malaria and tuberculosis. The introduction of a new malaria vaccine showcases the significant impact of Africa's scientific community. 'These efforts demonstrate the commitment of African governments, international organizations, and partners to improve public health outcomes and protect citizens from vaccine-preventable diseases,' she said. Zambia's Minister of Health, Sylvia Masebo, stated that the Zambian president's commitment to health aligns closely with the Africa CDC's mission. Masebo, also Chairperson of the Africa CDC governing board, expressed optimism that the conference would positively impact the region. She called on the media and partners to support efforts to reposition Africa within the global health landscape. 'I urge the media to highlight Africa's dedication to global health as a leading player,' she said. CPHIA is an annual conference organized by the Africa CDC, providing a platform for African leaders to reflect on lessons learned in health and science, and to chart a course towards stronger, more resilient health systems.
translated_content: Ketua Pengarah Pusat Kawalan dan Pencegahan Penyakit Afrika (Africa CDC), Dr. Jean Kaseya, menyeru negara-negara Afrika untuk mengambil peranan utama dalam memperkukuh sistem kesihatan awam mereka. Seruan ini dibuat semasa sidang media sebelum pembukaan Persidangan Antarabangsa Ketiga mengenai Kesihatan Awam di Afrika (CPHIA 2023) yang berlangsung di Lusaka, Zambia. Persidangan bertemakan 'Memecah Halangan: Memposisikan Semula Afrika dalam Seni Bina Kesihatan Global' ini diadakan dari 27 hingga 30 November 2023. Dr. Kaseya menegaskan bahawa penambahbaikan sistem kesihatan awam adalah penting untuk mengurangkan kerentanan kepada wabak penyakit. 'Kami berhasrat bukan sekadar memposisikan Afrika, tetapi juga warga Afrika dalam ruang kesihatan global,' katanya. Beliau menekankan bahawa pemimpin Afrika mempunyai keupayaan untuk menyatukan wilayah ini dan memainkan peranan penting dalam keselamatan kesihatan global. 'Hari ini, kita meraikan detik penting apabila Afrika menjadi tuan rumah kepada dunia untuk membincangkan cara-cara mengatasi halangan. Kita mesti mengiktiraf dan menghargai sumbangan Afrika kepada kesihatan global,' tambahnya. Profesor Margaret Gyapong, Pengarah Institut Penyelidikan Kesihatan dan Pengerusi Bersama CPHIA 2023, menyatakan bahawa Afrika sedang mengalami kemajuan pesat dalam teknologi kesihatan. Beliau menerangkan bahawa inovasi membantu merapatkan jurang akses dan penyampaian penjagaan kesihatan di seluruh benua. Profesor Gyapong mengiktiraf kerjasama kukuh antara kerajaan, sektor swasta, dan organisasi masyarakat sivil sebagai pendorong utama kepada kemajuan ini. Beliau menekankan bahawa perkongsian awam-swasta memperkukuh pertukaran ilmu, mobilisasi sumber, dan penambahbaikan teknologi dalam bidang kesihatan awam. Beliau turut menyoroti kepimpinan saintis Afrika dalam membangunkan vaksin yang disasarkan kepada penyakit serantau seperti malaria dan batuk kering. Pengenalan vaksin malaria baharu menunjukkan impak besar komuniti saintifik Afrika. 'Usaha ini menunjukkan komitmen kerajaan Afrika, organisasi antarabangsa dan rakan kongsi untuk meningkatkan hasil kesihatan awam serta melindungi rakyat daripada penyakit yang boleh dicegah melalui vaksin,' ujarnya. Menteri Kesihatan Zambia, Sylvia Masebo, menyatakan bahawa komitmen presiden Zambia terhadap sistem kesihatan sangat selari dengan misi Africa CDC. Masebo, yang juga Pengerusi Lembaga Pengelola Africa CDC, menyatakan keyakinan bahawa persidangan ini akan memberi impak positif kepada rantau ini. Beliau menyeru pihak media dan rakan kerjasama untuk menyokong usaha memposisikan semula Afrika dalam landskap kesihatan global. 'Saya menggesa media mengetengahkan dedikasi Afrika terhadap kesihatan global sebagai pemain utama,' katanya. CPHIA ialah persidangan tahunan yang dianjurkan oleh Africa CDC, menyediakan platform untuk pemimpin Afrika membincangkan pengajaran dalam sains dan kesihatan serta merangka hala tuju ke arah sistem kesihatan yang lebih kuat dan berdaya tahan.

article_content: A Beijing court began compensation hearings on Monday for Chinese relatives of those who died on Malaysia Airlines flight MH370, which disappeared in 2014 during a flight from Kuala Lumpur to Beijing. Nearly a decade later, the case remains unresolved and shrouded in mystery. Security was heightened around Beijing’s Chaoyang District Intermediary Court, with scant information disclosed to the public. Police checked journalists’ identities and restricted them to a designated area, preventing interviews with family members before the proceedings. The court did not provide immediate comments. China’s Foreign Ministry referred inquiries to legal authorities, with spokesman Wang Wenbin stating, 'The Chinese government pays close attention to the follow-up actions regarding MH370. We hope all parties will maintain close communication and handle the matter appropriately.' Various theories have been proposed regarding the fate of MH370, including mechanical failure, hijacking, or deliberate actions by crew members, but limited evidence has surfaced about why the plane diverted from its route. The Boeing 777, carrying 227 passengers and 12 crew, is believed to have crashed in the Southern Ocean south of India. Despite months of intensive searching, only a few pieces of debris have been found. Of the passengers onboard, 153 or 154—according to different reports—were Chinese citizens. The disaster deeply affected China, with daily briefings and vigils held for the missing. Some relatives have rejected the airline’s compensation offers, continuing to hope their loved ones are still alive or seeking more information. While details of the lawsuit are unclear, it seems to contend that Malaysia Airlines failed to take adequate measures to locate the missing aircraft after it vanished from radar about 38 minutes into the flight over the South China Sea on March 8, 2014. Families remain in communication online and expect the hearings to continue into mid-December. Owing to ongoing uncertainty, the airline's financial responsibilities remain unclear, and no charges have been filed against the crew. Still, families are pursuing compensation, citing both their loss and resulting financial hardship. China’s relatively opaque legal system grants judges wide discretion in handing down financial penalties when criminal liability is undetermined. Similar lawsuits in the United States targeting the airline and its affiliates have been dismissed, with courts deferring to Malaysian jurisdiction. Separately, China is still investigating the crash of a China Eastern Airlines jet in March 2022 that killed 132 people. That Boeing 737-800, en route from Kunming to Guangzhou, entered a nosedive from altitude, appeared to recover, then crashed into a mountainside—a rare disaster for the country’s airline industry, which had dramatically improved safety since the 1990s.
translated_content: Sebuah mahkamah di Beijing telah memulakan perbicaraan pampasan pada hari Isnin untuk waris rakyat China yang terkorban dalam tragedi kehilangan pesawat Malaysia Airlines MH370 yang hilang pada tahun 2014 semasa penerbangan dari Kuala Lumpur ke Beijing. Hampir sedekad berlalu, kes ini masih misteri dan belum menemui penyelesaian. Keselamatan diperketatkan di Mahkamah Perantaraan Daerah Chaoyang di Beijing, dengan maklumat kepada awam sangat terhad. Polis memeriksa pengenalan wartawan dan menghadkan mereka ke kawasan tertentu, melarang temubual dengan keluarga sebelum prosiding. Tiada ulasan serta-merta dari mahkamah. Kementerian Luar China menyerahkan pertanyaan kepada pihak berkuasa undang-undang, dengan jurucakap Wang Wenbin berkata, 'Kerajaan China memberi perhatian penuh kepada tindakan susulan MH370. Kami harap pihak berkaitan dapat terus berkomunikasi erat dan menguruskan perkara ini sebaiknya.' Pelbagai teori dikaitkan dengan kehilangan MH370, seperti kerosakan mekanikal, rampasan, atau tindakan sengaja oleh kru, namun bukti masih terbatas untuk menerangkan mengapa pesawat menyimpang dari laluan asal. Boeing 777 yang membawa 227 penumpang dan 12 anak kapal dipercayai terhempas di Lautan Selatan, selatan India. Selepas pencarian besar-besaran berbulan-bulan, hanya beberapa serpihan pesawat ditemui. Daripada penumpang tersebut, 153 atau 154—mengikut laporan berbeza—adalah warganegara China. Tragedi ini memberi impak besar di China, dengan sesi taklimat harian dan upacara memperingati mangsa. Ada waris menolak pampasan yang ditawarkan syarikat penerbangan, masih berharap orang tersayang ditemui atau menuntut penjelasan. Butiran saman masih kabur, namun dipercayai ia berasaskan tuduhan Malaysia Airlines gagal mencari pesawat secukupnya selepas hilang dari radar kira-kira 38 minit selepas berlepas, di atas Laut China Selatan, pada malam 8 Mac 2014. Waris kekal berhubung secara atas talian dan menjangka prosiding berlanjutan sehingga pertengahan Disember. Oleh kerana misteri berterusan, tanggungjawab kewangan syarikat penerbangan tidak jelas dan tiada pertuduhan terhadap kru. Namun, waris masih menuntut pampasan atas kehilangan dan tekanan kewangan. Sistem undang-undang China yang agak tidak telus membuatkan hakim bebas menjatuhkan penalti kewangan jika tiada liabiliti jenayah. Saman berkaitan di AS telah ditolak kerana mahkamah menyerahkan kepada bidang kuasa Malaysia. Selain itu, China masih menyiasat tragedi China Eastern Airlines pada Mac 2022 yang mengorbankan 132 nyawa. Boeing 737-800 dari Kunming ke Guangzhou itu menjunam dari ketinggian, mahu pulih, kemudian terhempas ke lereng gunung — tragedi jarang berlaku bagi industri penerbangan China yang kini jauh lebih selamat berbanding era 1990-an.

article_content: A viral video that appeared to show CNN correspondent Clarissa Ward and her crew staging a rocket attack has been proven false. The video, filmed near the border between Israel and Gaza, included a fabricated audio track where an off-screen voice seemed to instruct the CNN crew to act as if they were sheltering from rockets. For example, the voice is heard saying, 'Look around as if you're in danger' and 'Try to look nice and scared.' According to a CNN spokesperson, the audio in the video posted and shared on X is fabricated and inaccurately represents what happened during the live CNN coverage. They stated that the video irresponsibly distorts the reality of the covered event and encouraged viewers to watch the full broadcast on a trusted platform. Since the conflict between Israel and Hamas began on October 7, social media platforms—particularly X (formerly Twitter)—have seen a rise in misinformation. Some of this has included repurposed video game footage, old videos, and even clips from Algerian football celebrations. The original CNN clip, broadcast on October 9, actually showed Ward reporting the on-the-ground situation to CNN anchors. The fabricated clip, shared by TheQuartering, a social commentary account, has been viewed over 5 million times and reposted more than 12,000 times. Elon Musk responded to the viral post with a laughing emoji, and his reply was retweeted more than 1,500 times. The post now carries a community note—a feature that allows users to add context to potentially misleading content. In a follow-up post, TheQuartering clarified that the voice-over was fake. Experts, including Sander van der Linden from the University of Cambridge, suggest that recent changes implemented by Musk on X may be contributing to the growing problem of misinformation on the platform.
translated_content: Sebuah video tular yang kelihatan menunjukkan wartawan CNN, Clarissa Ward, dan kru beliau mereka cipta serangan roket telah dibuktikan palsu. Video tersebut, yang dirakam berhampiran sempadan Israel dan Gaza, mengandungi trek audio palsu di mana suara luar skrin kelihatan mengarahkan kru CNN untuk bertindak seolah-olah mereka berlindung dari serangan roket. Contohnya, suara itu kedengaran berkata, 'Lihat sekeliling seolah-olah anda dalam bahaya' dan 'Cuba nampak takut.' Menurut jurucakap CNN, audio dalam video yang dipos dan dikongsi di X adalah palsu dan tidak menggambarkan apa yang berlaku semasa liputan langsung CNN. Mereka berkata video itu secara tidak bertanggungjawab memesongkan realiti peristiwa yang dilaporkan dan menggalakkan penonton menonton siaran penuh di platform yang dipercayai. Sejak konflik antara Israel dan Hamas bermula pada 7 Oktober, platform media sosial — terutamanya X (dahulunya Twitter) — menyaksikan peningkatan maklumat palsu. Ini termasuk rakaman permainan video, video lama, dan juga klip perayaan bola sepak Algeria. Klip CNN asal, yang disiarkan pada 9 Oktober, sebenarnya menunjukkan Ward melaporkan situasi semasa kepada hos CNN. Klip palsu ini, yang dikongsi oleh TheQuartering, sebuah akaun ulasan sosial, sudah ditonton lebih 5 juta kali dan dikongsi semula lebih 12,000 kali. Elon Musk membalas pos tular itu dengan emoji ketawa, dan balasannya telah diulang kicau lebih 1,500 kali. Pos itu kini mengandungi nota komuniti — ciri yang membolehkan pengguna menambah konteks pada kandungan yang boleh mengelirukan. Dalam pos susulan, TheQuartering mengesahkan bahawa suara latar itu adalah palsu. Pakar, termasuk Sander van der Linden dari University of Cambridge, menyatakan perubahan yang dibuat oleh Musk di X mungkin menyumbang kepada peningkatan masalah maklumat palsu di platform tersebut.
post_content: Wow! That viral video showing CNN faking a rocket attack? Turns out it was all a hoax with a fake audio track. Even the account behind it admitted the voice was fake! Misinformation’s everywhere these days, especially on X. #FakeNews #FactCheck

article_content: Thousands of abortion opponents received praise from Pope Francis via Twitter as they participated in the 'March for Life' rally, marking the 41st anniversary of the Supreme Court's Roe v. Wade decision legalizing abortion. Tweeting from his official account (@Pontifex), Pope Francis expressed support for demonstrators who braved freezing temperatures to march on Capitol Hill, stating: 'I join the March for Life in Washington with my prayers. May God help us respect all life, especially the most vulnerable.' The event saw anti-abortion demonstrators gather on the snow-covered National Mall in Washington, alongside pro-choice activists like Jade Reindl, an intern with the Feminist Majority Foundation, who held signs as the march approached the U.S. Supreme Court. Meanwhile, groups such as Citizens Concerned For Life from Minnesota participated in similar marches in sub-zero temperatures. Pope Francis, who often highlights poverty alongside divisive social issues, shared his support for the annual event, which attracts numerous Catholic students from across the United States every January. This year's march began with a rally on the National Mall, followed by a walk along Constitution Avenue to Capitol Hill and the Supreme Court, coordinated with police ensuring demonstrators' free speech rights. Founded by Nellie Gray in 1974, the March for Life includes rallies and prayer vigils culminating in a march protesting the 1973 Supreme Court decision declaring abortion a constitutional right. Protestors marched on Capitol Hill, sometimes facing off with pro-choice supporters, while President Obama issued a statement reiterating support for women's reproductive rights. The landmark 1973 Roe v. Wade decision legalized abortion within the first two months of pregnancy. Prior to this, individual states regulated abortions, and many women sought unsafe or illegal procedures. Roe v. Wade stemmed from the case of Norma McCorvey, known as 'Jane Roe,' who challenged Texas's restrictive abortion laws. Ultimately, the Supreme Court ruled that the right to privacy included a woman's decision to terminate a pregnancy. The March for Life annually draws notable speakers and continued media attention. This year's theme was 'Adoption: A Noble Decision,' highlighting adoption as an alternative to abortion. Participants traveled from states such as Georgia, Missouri, and Pennsylvania, with students coming from schools and colleges in cities like Chicago and Cleveland. Social media buzzed with hashtags such as '#TeamLife.' Amid cheering crowds, participants also reacted negatively when House Majority Leader Eric Cantor from Virginia mentioned expanded abortion coverage under the nation's health care reforms. President Obama, meanwhile, stated that the Roe v. Wade anniversary should reinforce the principle that every woman deserves autonomy over her body and health care decisions. Despite snow and freezing weather, tens of thousands attended the rally, including Beverly Miller of Mankato, Minnesota, making her first trip alongside her son and church youth group. She noted the hope and courage brought by uniting with others sharing similar beliefs. Demonstrators included those praying before the Supreme Court and carrying statues such as the Virgin Mary. On the same day as the March for Life, two expectant mothers underwent sonograms before the Kansas Senate Public Health Committee. Amanda Kennedy, a 20-year-old anti-abortion activist who is 12 weeks pregnant, volunteered for a demonstration to show committee members fetal development. The procedure, performed by a sonographer from the Wyandotte Pregnancy Clinic, sparked debate. Supporters saw it as educational, while opponents from organizations like Planned Parenthood argued that medical procedures should not be performed in legislative settings.

Wade yang menghalalkan pengguguran. Dengan akaun rasminya (@Pontifex), Paus Francis menyampaikan sokongan kepada penunjuk perasaan yang bersemangat, walaupun menghadapi cuaca sejuk, dengan kenyataan: 'Saya bersama March for Life di Washington dalam doa saya. Semoga Tuhan membantu kita menghormati semua kehidupan, terutamanya yang paling lemah.' Acara ini menyaksikan penunjuk perasaan anti-pengguguran berkumpul di National Mall yang dilitupi salji di Washington, bersama aktivis pro-pilihan seperti Jade Reindl, pelatih di Feminist Majority Foundation, yang menunjukkan plakad sewaktu perarakan mendekati Mahkamah Agung AS. Pada masa yang sama, kumpulan seperti Citizens Concerned For Life dari Minnesota turut berarak dalam suhu sangat sejuk. Paus Francis, yang kerap mengetengahkan isu kemiskinan selain isu sosial yang memecah belah, berkongsi sokongan terhadap acara tahunan ini yang menarik ramai pelajar Katolik dari seluruh Amerika setiap Januari. Tahun ini, perarakan dimulakan dengan perhimpunan di National Mall, diikuti dengan berjalan kaki di Constitution Avenue ke Capitol Hill dan Mahkamah Agung, dengan kerjasama polis yang memastikan hak bersuara para peserta. March for Life yang diasaskan oleh Nellie Gray pada 1974, terdiri daripada perhimpunan dan vigil doa yang memuncak dengan perarakan membantah keputusan Mahkamah Agung 1973 yang mengisytiharkan pengguguran sebagai hak perlembagaan. Para penunjuk perasaan berarak ke Capitol Hill, kadang kala berhadapan dengan penyokong pro-pilihan, sementara Presiden Obama mengeluarkan kenyataan yang menegaskan sokongan terhadap hak kesihatan reproduktif wanita. Keputusan bersejarah Roe v. Wade pada 1973 menghalalkan pengguguran dalam dua bulan pertama kehamilan. Sebelum itu, setiap negeri menentukan peraturan pengguguran, menyebabkan ramai wanita terpaksa menjalani prosedur tidak selamat atau haram. Roe v. Wade bermula daripada kes Norma McCorvey, dikenali sebagai 'Jane Roe', yang mencabar undang-undang ketat Texas. Akhirnya, Mahkamah Agung memutuskan bahawa hak privasi termasuk keputusan wanita untuk menggugurkan kandungan. March for Life setiap tahun mendapat perhatian media dan menampilkan penceramah terkenal. Tema tahun ini ialah 'Adoption: A Noble Decision', menggalakkan pengambilan anak angkat sebagai alternatif kepada pengguguran. Peserta hadir dari negeri-negeri seperti Georgia, Missouri, dan Pennsylvania, termasuk pelajar dari sekolah dan kolej di bandar seperti Chicago dan Cleveland. Media sosial turut meriah dengan tanda pagar seperti '#TeamLife.' Ketika sorakan kedengaran, peserta turut memberikan reaksi negatif apabila Pemimpin Majoriti Dewan Eric Cantor dari Virginia menyebut tentang peluasan perlindungan pengguguran dalam reformasi penjagaan kesihatan negara. Sementara itu, Presiden Obama menyatakan bahawa ulang tahun Roe v. Wade harus mengukuhkan prinsip bahawa setiap wanita berhak membuat keputusan ke atas tubuh dan kesihatannya sendiri. Walaupun cuaca bersalji dan sejuk, puluhan ribu orang hadir ke perhimpunan, termasuk Beverly Miller dari Mankato, Minnesota, yang pertama kali hadir bersama anak lelakinya dan kumpulan belia gereja. Beliau berkata, melihat ramai yang sehaluan menjana harapan dan semangat. Dalam kalangan peserta, ada yang berdoa di hadapan Mahkamah Agung serta membawa patung seperti Virgin Mary. Pada hari yang sama dengan March for Life, dua ibu mengandung menjalani pemeriksaan sonogram di hadapan Jawatankuasa Kesihatan Awam Senat Kansas. Amanda Kennedy, seorang aktivis anti-pengguguran berusia 20 tahun yang hamil 12 minggu, secara sukarela menjalani demonstrasi untuk menunjukkan perkembangan janin kepada ahli jawatankuasa. Prosedur ini, yang dilakukan oleh sonografer dari Wyandotte Pregnancy Clinic, mencetuskan perdebatan. Penyokong melihatnya sebagai pendidikan sains, manakala penentang dari organisasi seperti Planned Parenthood membantah prosedur perubatan dijalankan di dalam dewan legislatif.

article_content: CHENNAI: Former Reserve Bank of India (RBI) governor S Venkitaramanan passed away in Chennai on Saturday at the age of 92, following a brief illness. Venkitaramanan, a member of the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), previously served as Union Finance Secretary and later as an adviser to the government of Karnataka. He led the RBI from December 1990 to December 1992. Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M K Stalin, RBI Governor Shaktikanta Das, and senior Congress leader Jairam Ramesh expressed their condolences to his family. 'I am saddened to learn about the demise of Venkitaramanan. He served as the 18th governor of the Reserve Bank of India and as Union Finance Secretary, earning respect for his efficient service,' said Stalin. He also extended condolences to Venkitaramanan's family, including his daughter and former Chief Secretary Girija Vaidyanathan. RBI Governor Shaktikanta Das referred to Venkitaramanan as an 'outstanding personality' and 'public servant', highlighting his significant contributions during a period of crisis. According to the RBI, Venkitaramanan's tenure saw India adopt the IMF's stabilization programme, which included the devaluation of the Rupee and the initiation of economic reforms.
translated_content: CHENNAI: Bekas Gabenor Bank Rizab India (RBI), S Venkitaramanan telah meninggal dunia di Chennai pada hari Sabtu pada usia 92 tahun akibat sakit yang singkat. Venkitaramanan, seorang anggota Perkhidmatan Pentadbiran India (IAS), sebelum ini berkhidmat sebagai Setiausaha Kewangan Kesatuan dan kemudian sebagai penasihat kepada kerajaan Karnataka. Beliau mengetuai RBI dari Disember 1990 hingga Disember 1992. Ketua Menteri Tamil Nadu, M K Stalin, Gabenor RBI Shaktikanta Das, dan pemimpin senior Kongres Jairam Ramesh menyampaikan ucapan takziah kepada keluarganya. 'Saya sedih mendengar tentang pemergian Venkitaramanan. Beliau berkhidmat sebagai gabenor ke-18 Bank Rizab India dan juga sebagai Setiausaha Kewangan Kesatuan, serta telah mendapat penghormatan atas perkhidmatan cekapnya,' kata Stalin. Beliau turut mengucapkan takziah kepada keluarga Venkitaramanan, termasuk anak perempuannya dan bekas Ketua Setiausaha Girija Vaidyanathan. Gabenor RBI Shaktikanta Das menyifatkan Venkitaramanan sebagai seorang 'individu cemerlang' dan 'penjawat awam', serta menonjolkan sumbangannya yang besar semasa tempoh krisis. Menurut RBI, tempoh perkhidmatan Venkitaramanan menyaksikan India menerima pakai program penstabilan IMF, termasuk penyusutan nilai Rupee dan pelancaran pembaharuan ekonomi.
